--- FILE: src/core/protocolBus.ts ---
import { createLogger } from './logger';
import { eventBus } from './eventBus';
const logger = createLogger('ProtocolBus');
export type Protocol = 'REST'|'WebSocket'|'GraphQL'|'gRPC';
export interface UBERequest { id:string; protocol:Protocol; method:string; path:string; headers:Record<string,string>; body?:any; query?:Record<string,string>; clientId?:string; timestamp:string; }
export interface UBEResponse { requestId:string; status:number; data?:any; error?:string; timestamp:string; processingTime:number; }
type Handler = (req:UBERequest)=>Promise<any>;
class UBEProtocolBus {
  private handlers:Map<string,Handler> = new Map();
  private middleware:Array<(req:UBERequest)=>Promise<UBERequest>> = [];
  register(method:string, path:string, handler:Handler):void {
    const key = method.toUpperCase()+':'+path;
    this.handlers.set(key, handler);
    logger.info('Registered: '+key);
  }
  use(mw:(req:UBERequest)=>Promise<UBERequest>){ this.middleware.push(mw); }
  async process(req:Omit<UBERequest,'id'|'timestamp'>):Promise<UBEResponse> {
    const start = Date.now();
    const request:UBERequest = { ...req, id:'req_'+Date.now()+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).substr(2,9), timestamp:new Date().toISOString() };
    logger.info(request.protocol+' '+request.method+' '+request.path, { id:request.id });
    try {
      let r = request;
      for(const mw of this.middleware) r = await mw(r);
      const key = r.method.toUpperCase()+':'+r.path.split('?')[0];
      const handler = this.handlers.get(key);
      if(!handler){ eventBus.publish('request.notfound','ProtocolBus',{ path:r.path }); return { requestId:r.id, status:404, error:'No handler: '+key, timestamp:new Date().toISOString(), processingTime:Date.now()-start }; }
      const data = await handler(r);
      eventBus.publish('request.success','ProtocolBus',{ path:r.path, ms:Date.now()-start });
      return { requestId:r.id, status:200, data, timestamp:new Date().toISOString(), processingTime:Date.now()-start };
    } catch(e:any) {
      logger.error('Request failed: '+request.path, { error:e.message });
      eventBus.publish('request.error','ProtocolBus',{ path:request.path, error:e.message });
      return { requestId:request.id, status:500, error:e.message, timestamp:new Date().toISOString(), processingTime:Date.now()-start };
    }
  }
  getRegisteredRoutes(){ return Array.from(this.handlers.keys()); }
}
export const protocolBus = new UBEProtocolBus();

--- FILE: src/core/authLayer.ts ---
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { createLogger } from './logger';
import { eventBus } from './eventBus';
import { getStore } from './database';

const logger = createLogger('AuthLayer');

export interface APIKey {
  key: string;
  clientId: string;
  name: string;
  permissions: string[];
  createdAt: string;
  lastUsed?: string;
}

export interface AuthResult {
  success: boolean;
  clientId?: string;
  permissions?: string[];
  error?: string;
}

class UBEAuthLayer {

  generateAPIKey(clientId: string, name: string, permissions: string[] = ['read']): APIKey {
    const store = getStore('api_keys');
    const rawKey = 'ube_' + crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    const keyHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawKey).digest('hex');
    const prefix = rawKey.slice(0, 12);
    const keyId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();

    store.set(keyHash, {
      keyId,
      keyHash,
      prefix,
      clientId,
      clientName: name,
      permissions,
      isActive: true,
      createdAt,
      lastUsed: null
    });

    eventBus.publish('auth.key.created', 'AuthLayer', { clientId, name });
    logger.info('API key created for: ' + clientId);

    return { key: rawKey, clientId, name, permissions, createdAt };
  }

  validate(rawKey: string): AuthResult {
    if (!rawKey) return { success: false, error: 'No API key provided' };

    const store = getStore('api_keys');
    const keyHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawKey).digest('hex');
    const record = store.get(keyHash) as any;

    if (!record || !record.isActive) {
      logger.warn('Auth failed: invalid key');
      return { success: false, error: 'Invalid API key' };
    }

    // Update last used
    record.lastUsed = new Date().toISOString();
    store.set(keyHash, record);

    return {
      success: true,
      clientId: record.clientName,
      permissions: record.permissions
    };
  }

  hasPermission(rawKey: string, permission: string): boolean {
    const result = this.validate(rawKey);
    if (!result.success || !result.permissions) return false;
    return result.permissions.includes(permission) || result.permissions.includes('admin');
  }

  revokeKey(rawKey: string): boolean {
    const store = getStore('api_keys');
    const keyHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawKey).digest('hex');
    const record = store.get(keyHash) as any;
    if (!record) return false;
    record.isActive = false;
    store.set(keyHash, record);
    logger.info('API key revoked');
    return true;
  }

  listKeys(): any[] {
    const store = getStore('api_keys');
    return (store.filter(() => true).map((r: any) => ({
      keyId: r.keyId,
      prefix: r.prefix,
      clientName: r.clientName,
      permissions: r.permissions,
      isActive: r.isActive,
      createdAt: r.createdAt,
      lastUsed: r.lastUsed
    })));
  }
}

export const authLayer = new UBEAuthLayer();

--- FILE: src/core/eventBus.ts ---
import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { createLogger } from './logger';
const logger = createLogger('EventBus');
export interface UBEEvent { id:string; type:string; source:string; timestamp:string; payload:any; }
class UBEEventBus extends EventEmitter {
  private history:UBEEvent[] = [];
  publish(type:string, source:string, payload:any):UBEEvent {
    const event:UBEEvent = { id:'evt_'+Date.now()+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).substr(2,9), type, source, timestamp:new Date().toISOString(), payload };
    this.history.push(event);
    if(this.history.length>1000) this.history.shift();
    this.emit(type, event);
    this.emit('*', event);
    logger.info('Event: '+type, { id:event.id });
    return event;
  }
  subscribe(type:string, handler:(e:UBEEvent)=>void){ this.on(type,handler); }
  subscribeAll(handler:(e:UBEEvent)=>void){ this.on('*',handler); }
  getHistory(type?:string){ return type ? this.history.filter(e=>e.type===type) : this.history; }
}
export const eventBus = new UBEEventBus();
--- FILE: src/core/logger.ts ---
import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

type LogLevel = 'INFO' | 'WARN' | 'ERROR' | 'DEBUG';

interface LogEntry {
  timestamp: string;
  level: LogLevel;
  module: string;
  message: string;
  data?: any;
}

class UBELogger extends EventEmitter {
  private module: string;

  constructor(module: string) {
    super();
    this.module = module;
  }

  private log(level: LogLevel, message: string, data?: any) {
    const entry: LogEntry = {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      level,
      module: this.module,
      message,
      data
    };

    console.log(
      `[${entry.timestamp}] [${level}] [${this.module}] ${message}`,
      data ? JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) : ''
    );

    this.emit('log', entry);
  }

  info(m: string, d?: any)  { this.log('INFO', m, d); }
  warn(m: string, d?: any)  { this.log('WARN', m, d); }
  error(m: string, d?: any) { this.log('ERROR', m, d); }
  debug(m: string, d?: any) { this.log('DEBUG', m, d); }
}

export const createLogger = (module: string) => new UBELogger(module);

--- FILE: src/core/automationEngine.ts ---
import { createLogger } from './logger';
import { eventBus } from './eventBus';
import { getStore } from './database';

const logger = createLogger('AutomationEngine');

export type RiskLevel = 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL';
export type ActionStatus = 'PENDING' | 'RUNNING' | 'SUCCESS' | 'FAILED' | 'ROLLED_BACK' | 'WAITING_APPROVAL';
export type UndoPeriod = 'last_action' | 'last_hour' | 'last_day' | 'last_week' | 'last_month' | 'last_year';

export interface AutomationRule {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  trigger: {
    type: string;
    condition: (input: any) => boolean;
  };
  risk: RiskLevel;
  requiresApproval: boolean;
  action: (input: any) => Promise<any>;
  undo?: (result: any) => Promise<any>;
}

export interface AutomationLog {
  id: string;
  ruleId: string;
  ruleName: string;
  status: ActionStatus;
  risk: RiskLevel;
  input: any;
  result?: any;
  error?: string;
  dryRun: boolean;
  startedAt: string;
  finishedAt?: string;
  canUndo: boolean;
}

class UBEAutomationEngine {
  private rules: Map<string, AutomationRule> = new Map();
  private readonly MAX_FAILURES = 3;

  private saveLog(log: AutomationLog): void {
    const store = getStore('automation_history');
    store.set(log.id, log);
  }

  private loadLog(id: string): AutomationLog | null {
    const store = getStore('automation_history');
    return (store.get(id) as AutomationLog) || null;
  }

  private loadLogsByTimeOffset(offsetMs: number): AutomationLog[] {
    const store = getStore('automation_history');
    const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - offsetMs).toISOString();
    return (store.filter((log: any) =>
      log.status === 'SUCCESS' && log.startedAt > cutoff
    ) as AutomationLog[]).sort((a: any, b: any) => b.startedAt.localeCompare(a.startedAt));
  }

  private getFailureCount(ruleId: string): number {
    const store = getStore('automation_history');
    const oneHourAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 3600000).toISOString();
    return (store.filter((log: any) =>
      log.ruleId === ruleId &&
      log.status === 'FAILED' &&
      log.startedAt > oneHourAgo
    ).length);
  }

  registerRule(rule: AutomationRule): void {
    this.rules.set(rule.id, rule);
    logger.info('Rule registered: ' + rule.name, { risk: rule.risk });
    eventBus.publish('automation.rule.registered', 'AutomationEngine', {
      ruleId: rule.id, name: rule.name, risk: rule.risk
    });
  }

  async execute(triggerId: string, input: any, dryRun: boolean = false): Promise<AutomationLog> {
    const rule = this.rules.get(triggerId);
    if (!rule) throw new Error('No rule found: ' + triggerId);
    if (!rule.enabled) throw new Error('Rule is disabled: ' + rule.name);

    const failures = this.getFailureCount(triggerId);
    if (failures >= this.MAX_FAILURES) {
      logger.error('Circuit breaker OPEN for: ' + rule.name);
      eventBus.publish('automation.circuit.open', 'AutomationEngine', { ruleId: triggerId });
      throw new Error('Circuit breaker open — too many failures for: ' + rule.name);
    }

    if (!rule.trigger.condition(input)) {
      throw new Error('Trigger condition not met for: ' + rule.name);
    }

    const log: AutomationLog = {
      id: 'auto_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9),
      ruleId: rule.id,
      ruleName: rule.name,
      status: 'PENDING',
      risk: rule.risk,
      input,
      dryRun,
      startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      canUndo: !!rule.undo
    };

    this.saveLog(log);

    if (rule.risk === 'CRITICAL' || rule.requiresApproval) {
      log.status = 'WAITING_APPROVAL';
      this.saveLog(log);
      logger.warn('Waiting approval: ' + rule.name);
      eventBus.publish('automation.approval.required', 'AutomationEngine', {
        logId: log.id, ruleName: rule.name, risk: rule.risk, input
      });
      return log;
    }

    return await this._run(rule, log, input, dryRun);
  }

  async approve(logId: string): Promise<AutomationLog> {
    const log = this.loadLog(logId);
    if (!log) throw new Error('No pending approval found: ' + logId);
    if (log.status !== 'WAITING_APPROVAL') throw new Error('Log is not waiting approval');
    const rule = this.rules.get(log.ruleId);
    if (!rule) throw new Error('Rule not found');
    logger.info('Approved: ' + log.ruleName);
    eventBus.publish('automation.approved', 'AutomationEngine', { logId });
    return await this._run(rule, log, log.input, log.dryRun);
  }

  reject(logId: string): void {
    const log = this.loadLog(logId);
    if (!log) throw new Error('No pending approval: ' + logId);
    log.status = 'FAILED';
    log.error = 'Rejected by operator';
    log.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    this.saveLog(log);
    logger.warn('Rejected: ' + log.ruleName);
    eventBus.publish('automation.rejected', 'AutomationEngine', { logId });
  }

  async undo(logId: string): Promise<void> {
    const log = this.loadLog(logId);
    if (!log) throw new Error('Log not found: ' + logId);
    if (log.status !== 'SUCCESS') throw new Error('Can only undo successful actions');
    const rule = this.rules.get(log.ruleId);
    if (!rule?.undo) throw new Error('No undo function defined for: ' + log.ruleName);
    logger.warn('Undoing: ' + log.ruleName);
    await rule.undo(log.result);
    log.status = 'ROLLED_BACK';
    log.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    this.saveLog(log);
    eventBus.publish('automation.undone', 'AutomationEngine', { logId, ruleName: log.ruleName });
  }

  async undoLast(count: number = 1): Promise<any[]> {
    const store = getStore('automation_history');
    const rows = store.filter((log: any) => log.status === 'SUCCESS')
      .sort((a: any, b: any) => b.startedAt.localeCompare(a.startedAt))
      .slice(0, count);

    const results = [];
    for (const row of (rows as any[])) {
      try {
        await this.undo(row.id);
        results.push({ id: row.id, ruleName: row.ruleName, undone: true });
      } catch (e: any) {
        results.push({ id: row.id, ruleName: row.ruleName, undone: false, reason: e.message });
      }
    }
    logger.warn('Undo last ' + count, { results });
    return results;
  }

  async undoByTime(period: UndoPeriod): Promise<any[]> {
    const periodMap: Record<UndoPeriod, number> = {
      last_action: 60000,
      last_hour:   3600000,
      last_day:    86400000,
      last_week:   604800000,
      last_month:  2592000000,
      last_year:   31536000000
    };

    const offsetMs = periodMap[period];
    if (!offsetMs) throw new Error('Invalid period: ' + period);

    const logs = this.loadLogsByTimeOffset(offsetMs);
    if (logs.length === 0) return [{ undone: false, reason: 'No actions found in ' + period }];

    const results = [];
    for (const log of logs) {
      try {
        await this.undo(log.id);
        results.push({ id: log.id, ruleName: log.ruleName, undone: true, executedAt: log.startedAt });
      } catch (e: any) {
        results.push({ id: log.id, ruleName: log.ruleName, undone: false, reason: e.message });
      }
    }
    logger.warn('Undo by time: ' + period, { total: logs.length });
    eventBus.publish('automation.undo.bulk', 'AutomationEngine', { period, total: logs.length });
    return results;
  }

  getUndoHistory(): any[] {
    const store = getStore('automation_history');
    return (store.filter((log: any) =>
      log.status === 'ROLLED_BACK' || log.status === 'SUCCESS'
    ).sort((a: any, b: any) => b.startedAt.localeCompare(a.startedAt))
    .slice(0, 100)
    .map((log: any) => ({
      id: log.id,
      ruleName: log.ruleName,
      status: log.status,
      executedAt: log.startedAt,
      finishedAt: log.finishedAt,
      canUndo: log.status === 'SUCCESS'
    })));
  }

  private async _run(rule: AutomationRule, log: AutomationLog, input: any, dryRun: boolean): Promise<AutomationLog> {
    log.status = 'RUNNING';
    this.saveLog(log);
    logger.info((dryRun ? '[DRY RUN] ' : '') + 'Executing: ' + rule.name, { risk: rule.risk });
    eventBus.publish('automation.started', 'AutomationEngine', { logId: log.id, ruleName: rule.name, dryRun });

    try {
      log.result = dryRun
        ? { dryRun: true, message: 'Simulated — no real action taken', input }
        : await rule.action(input);
      log.status = 'SUCCESS';
      log.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      this.saveLog(log);
      logger.info('Success: ' + rule.name);
      eventBus.publish('automation.success', 'AutomationEngine', { logId: log.id, ruleName: rule.name });
    } catch (error: any) {
      log.status = 'FAILED';
      log.error = error.message;
      log.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      this.saveLog(log);
      logger.error('Failed: ' + rule.name, { error: error.message });
      eventBus.publish('automation.failed', 'AutomationEngine', { logId: log.id, error: error.message });
    }

    return log;
  }

  getLogs(): any[] {
    const store = getStore('automation_history');
    return (store.filter(() => true)
      .sort((a: any, b: any) => b.startedAt.localeCompare(a.startedAt))
      .slice(0, 100));
  }

  getPendingApprovals(): any[] {
    const store = getStore('automation_history');
    return (store.filter((log: any) => log.status === 'WAITING_APPROVAL')
      .sort((a: any, b: any) => b.startedAt.localeCompare(a.startedAt)));
  }

  getRules() {
    return Array.from(this.rules.values()).map(r => ({
      id: r.id, name: r.name, description: r.description,
      enabled: r.enabled, risk: r.risk, canUndo: !!r.undo
    }));
  }

  disableRule(id: string) { const r = this.rules.get(id); if (r) r.enabled = false; }
  enableRule(id: string)  { const r = this.rules.get(id); if (r) r.enabled = true; }
}

export const automationEngine = new UBEAutomationEngine();

--- FILE: src/core/database.ts ---
import { createClient } from '@libsql/client';

const turso = createClient({
  url: process.env.TURSO_URL || 'file:/app/data/ube.db',
  authToken: process.env.TURSO_TOKEN,
});

let initialized = false;

async function ensureInit() {
  if (initialized) return;
  await turso.batch([
    `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ube_store (
      namespace TEXT NOT NULL,
      key TEXT NOT NULL,
      value TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER DEFAULT (unixepoch()),
      PRIMARY KEY (namespace, key)
    )`,
    `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_namespace ON ube_store(namespace)`,
    `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_updated ON ube_store(updated_at)`,
  ], 'write');
  initialized = true;
  console.log('[UBE-DB] Turso initialized');
}

class TursoStore {
  private cache = new Map<string, any>();
  private loaded = false;

  constructor(private ns: string) {
    this.loadFromTurso();
  }

  private async loadFromTurso() {
    try {
      await ensureInit();
      const r = await turso.execute({
        sql: `SELECT key, value FROM ube_store WHERE namespace=?`,
        args: [this.ns],
      });
      for (const row of r.rows) {
        this.cache.set(row.key as string, JSON.parse(row.value as string));
      }
      this.loaded = true;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(`[DB] load error for ${this.ns}:`, e);
    }
  }

  get(key: string): any {
    return this.cache.get(key) ?? null;
  }

  set(key: string, value: any): void {
    this.cache.set(key, value);
    turso.execute({
      sql: `INSERT INTO ube_store (namespace, key, value, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, unixepoch())
            ON CONFLICT(namespace, key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value, updated_at=excluded.updated_at`,
      args: [this.ns, key, JSON.stringify(value)],
    }).catch(e => console.error('[DB] set error:', e));
  }

  delete(key: string): void {
    this.cache.delete(key);
    turso.execute({
      sql: `DELETE FROM ube_store WHERE namespace=? AND key=?`,
      args: [this.ns, key],
    }).catch(e => console.error('[DB] delete error:', e));
  }

  filter(predicate?: (val: any) => boolean): any[] {
    return [...this.cache.values()].filter(predicate);
  }

  has(key: string): boolean {
    return this.cache.has(key);
  }

  keys(): string[] {
    return [...this.cache.keys()];
  }

  size(): number {
    return this.cache.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.cache.clear();
    turso.execute({
      sql: `DELETE FROM ube_store WHERE namespace=?`,
      args: [this.ns],
    }).catch(e => console.error('[DB] clear error:', e));
  }

  async waitForLoad(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.loaded) return;
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
  }
}

const stores = new Map<string, TursoStore>();

export function getStore(name: string): TursoStore {
  if (!stores.has(name)) {
    stores.set(name, new TursoStore(name));
    ensureInit().catch(e => console.error('[DB] init error:', e));
  }
  return stores.get(name)!;
}

export function getDB(): any {
  return { store: getStore };
}

export { turso, ensureInit };

--- FILE: src/core/scheduler.ts ---
import { createLogger } from './logger';
import { eventBus } from './eventBus';
import { automationEngine } from './automationEngine';
import { getStore } from './database';
import { startWatcher, stopWatcher, WatchAnalysis } from '../modules/fileModule';

const logger = createLogger('Scheduler');

export interface ActivityNote {
  id: string;
  type: 'info' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'success' | 'critical';
  icon: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  module: string;
  risk: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL';
  action: string;
  timestamp: string;
  read: boolean;
}

class UBEScheduler {
  private timers: NodeJS.Timeout[] = [];
  private running = false;

  // ─── NOTE SYSTEM ───────────────────────────────────────

  addNote(note: Omit<ActivityNote, 'id' | 'timestamp' | 'read'>): void {
    const store = getStore('activity_notes');
    const id = 'note_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 6);
    const full: ActivityNote = {
      ...note,
      id,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      read: false
    };
    store.set(id, full);
    eventBus.publish('scheduler.note.added', 'Scheduler', { id, title: note.title, risk: note.risk });
    logger.info(`[${note.risk}] ${note.title}`);
  }

  getNotes(limit: number = 50): ActivityNote[] {
    const store = getStore('activity_notes');
    return (store.filter(() => true) as ActivityNote[])
      .sort((a: any, b: any) => b.timestamp.localeCompare(a.timestamp))
      .slice(0, limit);
  }

  getNotesByRisk(risk: string): ActivityNote[] {
    const store = getStore('activity_notes');
    return (store.filter((n: any) => n.risk === risk) as ActivityNote[])
      .sort((a: any, b: any) => b.timestamp.localeCompare(a.timestamp));
  }

  markRead(id: string): void {
    const store = getStore('activity_notes');
    const note = store.get(id) as ActivityNote | null;
    if (note) { note.read = true; store.set(id, note); }
  }

  markAllRead(): void {
    const store = getStore('activity_notes');
    store.filter((n: any) => !n.read).forEach((n: any) => {
      n.read = true; store.set(n.id, n);
    });
  }

  getUnreadCount(): number {
    const store = getStore('activity_notes');
    return store.filter((n: any) => !n.read).length;
  }

  getStats(): any {
    const store = getStore('activity_notes');
    const all = store.filter(() => true);
    return {
      total: all.length,
      unread: all.filter((n: any) => !n.read).length,
      byRisk: {
        LOW:      all.filter((n: any) => n.risk === 'LOW').length,
        MEDIUM:   all.filter((n: any) => n.risk === 'MEDIUM').length,
        HIGH:     all.filter((n: any) => n.risk === 'HIGH').length,
        CRITICAL: all.filter((n: any) => n.risk === 'CRITICAL').length
      }
    };
  }

  // ─── RISK ENGINE ───────────────────────────────────────
  // LOW      → auto execute silently    → info note
  // MEDIUM   → auto execute             → warning note
  // HIGH     → auto execute             → danger note
  // CRITICAL → hold for approval        → critical note

  private async runWithRisk(
    triggerId: string,
    input: any,
    context: {
      module: string;
      risk: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL';
      successNote: (result: any) => { icon: string; title: string; message: string; type: ActivityNote['type'] };
      failNote?: (err: string) => { icon: string; title: string; message: string };
    }
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const log = await automationEngine.execute(triggerId, input, false);

      if (log.status === 'WAITING_APPROVAL') {
        this.addNote({
          type: 'critical',
          icon: '🔐',
          title: 'Approval Required',
          message: `CRITICAL action "${log.ruleName}" is waiting your approval. Log ID: ${log.id}`,
          module: context.module,
          risk: 'CRITICAL',
          action: `POST /automation/approve with logId: ${log.id}`
        });
        return;
      }

      if (log.status === 'SUCCESS' && log.result) {
        const note = context.successNote(log.result);
        this.addNote({
          ...note,
          module: context.module,
          risk: context.risk,
          action: context.risk === 'LOW'      ? 'Executed automatically — no action needed'
                : context.risk === 'MEDIUM'   ? 'Executed automatically — review if needed'
                : context.risk === 'HIGH'     ? 'Executed automatically — please review'
                : 'Waiting approval'
        });
      }

    } catch (e: any) {
      if (context.failNote) {
        const note = context.failNote(e.message);
        this.addNote({
          type: 'warning',
          icon: note.icon,
          title: note.title,
          message: note.message,
          module: context.module,
          risk: context.risk,
          action: 'Engine handled automatically'
        });
      }
      logger.warn(`[${context.risk}] ${context.module} error: ` + e.message);
    }
  }

  // ─── FILE WATCHER ──────────────────────────────────────

  private startFileWatcher(): void {
    startWatcher(async (analysis: WatchAnalysis, risk: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL') => {
      const riskMap: Record<string, { type: ActivityNote['type']; icon: string }> = {
        LOW:      { type: 'info',     icon: '📄' },
        MEDIUM:   { type: 'warning',  icon: '📋' },
        HIGH:     { type: 'danger',   icon: '📁' },
        CRITICAL: { type: 'critical', icon: '🚨' },
      };
      const r = riskMap[risk] ?? riskMap['LOW'];
      this.addNote({
        type: r.type, icon: r.icon,
        title: `File Detected [${risk}]`,
        message: `${analysis.name} — ${analysis.wordCount} words, ${(analysis.size/1024).toFixed(1)}KB` +
          (!analysis.clean ? ' ⚠️ THREATS: ' + analysis.threats.join(',') : ''),
        module: 'FileWatcher', risk,
        action: risk === 'CRITICAL' ? 'File quarantined automatically' : 'File moved to uploads',
      });
      logger.info(`[WATCHER] ${risk} — ${analysis.name}`);
    });
    logger.info('[AUTO] File watcher active — drop files into ~/UBE_watch');
  }


  // ─── WATCHERS ──────────────────────────────────────────

  private startCryptoStableWatch(): void {
    const timer = setInterval(async () => {
      await this.runWithRisk(
        'finance.crypto.drop',
        { coin: 'bitcoin' },
        {
          module: 'Finance',
          risk: 'MEDIUM',
          successNote: (result) => result.isDrop
            ? { type: 'danger',  icon: '🔴', title: 'Crypto Drop Detected', message: result.alert }
            : { type: 'success', icon: '🟢', title: 'Crypto Stable',        message: result.alert }
        }
      );
    }, 60000);
    this.timers.push(timer);
    logger.info('[MEDIUM] Crypto watcher — every 60s');
  }

  private startRatesWatch(): void {
    const timer = setInterval(async () => {
      await this.runWithRisk(
        'finance.currency.alert',
        { base: 'USD', currency: 'INR', rate: true, threshold: 80 },
        {
          module: 'Finance',
          risk: 'LOW',
          successNote: (result) => result.triggered
            ? { type: 'warning', icon: '💱', title: 'Exchange Rate Alert',  message: result.alert }
            : { type: 'info',    icon: '💱', title: 'Exchange Rate Normal', message: result.alert }
        }
      );
    }, 60000);
    this.timers.push(timer);
    logger.info('[LOW] Rates watcher — every 60s');
  }

  private startHealthWatch(): void {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      const uptime = process.uptime();
      const mem = process.memoryUsage();
      const memMB = Math.round(mem.heapUsed / 1024 / 1024);
      const uptimeMin = Math.round(uptime / 60);

      if (memMB > 200) {
        this.addNote({
          type: 'warning',
          icon: '⚠️',
          title: 'High Memory Usage',
          message: `Engine using ${memMB}MB — auto monitoring activated`,
          module: 'Core',
          risk: 'MEDIUM',
          action: 'Engine self-monitoring — no action needed'
        });
      } else {
        this.addNote({
          type: 'success',
          icon: '✅',
          title: 'Engine Healthy',
          message: `Uptime: ${uptimeMin}min | Memory: ${memMB}MB | All 9 modules running`,
          module: 'Core',
          risk: 'LOW',
          action: 'No action needed'
        });
      }
    }, 60000);
    this.timers.push(timer);
    logger.info('[LOW] Health watcher — every 60s');
  }

  private startLargeConversionWatch(): void {
    const timer = setInterval(async () => {
      await this.runWithRisk(
        'finance.large.conversion',
        { amount: 15000, from: 'USD', to: 'INR' },
        {
          module: 'Finance',
          risk: 'HIGH',
          successNote: (result) => ({
            type: 'danger',
            icon: '💰',
            title: 'Large Conversion Executed',
            message: `Converted ${result.amount} ${result.from} → ${result.to} at rate ${result.rate}`
          })
        }
      );
    }, 300000); // every 5 minutes
    this.timers.push(timer);
    logger.info('[HIGH] Large conversion watcher — every 5min');
  }

  // ─── PUBLIC TRIGGERS ───────────────────────────────────

  async triggerLow(triggerId: string, input: any, module: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.runWithRisk(triggerId, input, {
      module, risk: 'LOW',
      successNote: (result) => ({
        type: 'info', icon: '⚙️',
        title: 'Auto Action Completed [LOW]',
        message: JSON.stringify(result).slice(0, 150)
      })
    });
  }

  async triggerMedium(triggerId: string, input: any, module: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.runWithRisk(triggerId, input, {
      module, risk: 'MEDIUM',
      successNote: (result) => ({
        type: 'warning', icon: '⚠️',
        title: 'Auto Action Completed [MEDIUM]',
        message: JSON.stringify(result).slice(0, 150)
      })
    });
  }

  async triggerHigh(triggerId: string, input: any, module: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.runWithRisk(triggerId, input, {
      module, risk: 'HIGH',
      successNote: (result) => ({
        type: 'danger', icon: '🔴',
        title: 'Auto Action Completed [HIGH]',
        message: JSON.stringify(result).slice(0, 150)
      })
    });
  }

  // ─── START / STOP ───────────────────────────────────────

  start(): void {
    if (this.running) return;
    this.running = true;

    this.addNote({
      type: 'success',
      icon: '🚀',
      title: 'UBE Engine Started',
      message: 'All 9 modules loaded. Risk-based automation active. Watching crypto, finance, files, health.',
      module: 'Core',
      risk: 'LOW',
      action: 'No action needed — engine is running'
    });

    this.startFileWatcher();
    this.startCryptoStableWatch();
    this.startRatesWatch();
    this.startHealthWatch();
    this.startLargeConversionWatch();

    logger.info('Scheduler started — 5 watchers active (FILE/CRYPTO/RATES/HEALTH/CONVERSION)');
    eventBus.publish('scheduler.started', 'Scheduler', { watchers: 5 });
  }

  stop(): void {
    this.timers.forEach(t => clearInterval(t));
    this.timers = [];
    this.running = false;
    logger.info('Scheduler stopped');
  }

  isRunning(): boolean { return this.running; }
}

export const scheduler = new UBEScheduler();

export type AuditSeverity = 'INFO' | 'WARN' | 'ERROR' | 'CRITICAL';

export interface AuditEntry {
  id: string;
  ts: number;
  tenantId: string;
  userId: string;
  action: string;
  module: string;
  input: unknown;
  result: unknown;
  severity: AuditSeverity;
  ip?: string;
  durationMs?: number;
}

const MAX_ENTRIES = 100_000;
const _log: AuditEntry[] = [];

function genId(): string {
  return 'aud_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
}

export async function auditLog(entry: Omit<AuditEntry, 'id' | 'ts'>): Promise<void> {
  const record: AuditEntry = { id: genId(), ts: Date.now(), ...entry };
  _log.push(record);
  if (_log.length > MAX_ENTRIES) _log.splice(0, _log.length - MAX_ENTRIES);
  process.stdout.write(
    '[AUDIT] ' + record.severity + ' | ' + record.module + '.' + record.action +
    ' | tenant=' + record.tenantId + ' user=' + record.userId + '\n'
  );
}

export function queryAudit(filter: {
  tenantId?: string; userId?: string; module?: string;
  action?: string; severity?: AuditSeverity; since?: number; until?: number;
} = {}): AuditEntry[] {
  return _log.filter(e => {
    if (filter.tenantId && e.tenantId !== filter.tenantId) return false;
    if (filter.userId   && e.userId   !== filter.userId)   return false;
    if (filter.module   && e.module   !== filter.module)   return false;
    if (filter.action   && e.action   !== filter.action)   return false;
    if (filter.severity && e.severity !== filter.severity) return false;
    if (filter.since    && e.ts < filter.since)            return false;
    if (filter.until    && e.ts > filter.until)            return false;
    return true;
  });
}

export function getAuditStats(tenantId: string) {
  const entries = queryAudit({ tenantId });
  const bySeverity = { INFO: 0, WARN: 0, ERROR: 0, CRITICAL: 0 };
  for (const e of entries) bySeverity[e.severity]++;
  return { total: entries.length, bySeverity };
}

--- FILE: src/core/idempotency.ts ---
const TTL_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 24h

interface IdempRecord {
  result: unknown;
  ts: number;
  status: 'PENDING' | 'DONE' | 'ERROR';
}

const store = new Map<string, IdempRecord>();

function makeKey(tenantId: string, clientId: string, requestId: string): string {
  return `${tenantId}:${clientId}:${requestId}`;
}

function prune(): void {
  const now = Date.now();
  for (const [k, v] of store.entries()) {
    if (now - v.ts > TTL_MS) store.delete(k);
  }
}

export async function idempotentExec<T>(
  tenantId: string,
  clientId: string,
  requestId: string,
  fn: () => Promise<T>
): Promise<{ result: T; fromCache: boolean }> {
  prune();
  const key = makeKey(tenantId, clientId, requestId);
  const existing = store.get(key) as any;

  if (existing) {
    if (existing.status === 'PENDING') {
      throw new Error(`IDMP_IN_FLIGHT: request ${requestId} already processing`);
    }
    if (existing.status === 'DONE') {
      return { result: existing.result as T, fromCache: true };
    }
    if (existing.status === 'ERROR') {
      throw new Error(`IDMP_PREV_FAILED: prior attempt failed for ${requestId}`);
    }
  }

  store.set(key, { result: null, ts: Date.now(), status: 'PENDING' });

  try {
    const result = await fn();
    store.set(key, { result, ts: Date.now(), status: 'DONE' });
    return { result, fromCache: false };
  } catch (err) {
    store.set(key, { result: null, ts: Date.now(), status: 'ERROR' });
    throw err;
  }
}

export function getIdempRecord(tenantId: string, clientId: string, requestId: string): IdempRecord | null {
  return store.get(makeKey(tenantId, clientId, requestId)) ?? null;
}

export function clearIdempRecord(tenantId: string, clientId: string, requestId: string): void {
  store.delete(makeKey(tenantId, clientId, requestId));
}

--- FILE: src/core/rateLimiter.ts ---
export type Tier = 'FREE' | 'PRO' | 'ENTERPRISE';

interface Window {
  count: number;
  windowStart: number;
}

interface LimitConfig {
  maxReq: number;   // per minute
  burstMax: number; // short burst allowance
}

const TIER_LIMITS: Record<Tier, LimitConfig> = {
  FREE:       { maxReq: 100,   burstMax: 120   },
  PRO:        { maxReq: 1000,  burstMax: 1200  },
  ENTERPRISE: { maxReq: 10000, burstMax: 12000 },
};

const WINDOW_MS = 60_000;
const windows = new Map<string, Window>();

function getKey(tenantId: string, userId: string): string {
  return `${tenantId}:${userId}`;
}

export interface RateLimitResult {
  allowed: boolean;
  remaining: number;
  resetAt: number;
  tier: Tier;
}

export function checkRateLimit(
  tenantId: string,
  userId: string,
  tier: Tier,
  weight = 1
): RateLimitResult {
  const key = getKey(tenantId, userId);
  const cfg = TIER_LIMITS[tier];
  const now = Date.now();
  let win = windows.get(key);

  if (!win || now - win.windowStart >= WINDOW_MS) {
    win = { count: 0, windowStart: now };
  }

  const remaining = Math.max(0, cfg.maxReq - win.count);
  const resetAt = win.windowStart + WINDOW_MS;

  if (win.count + weight > cfg.burstMax) {
    windows.set(key, win);
    return { allowed: false, remaining: 0, resetAt, tier };
  }

  win.count += weight;
  windows.set(key, win);

  return {
    allowed: win.count <= cfg.maxReq,
    remaining: Math.max(0, cfg.maxReq - win.count),
    resetAt,
    tier,
  };
}

export function getRateLimitStats(tenantId: string, userId: string, tier: Tier) {
  const key = getKey(tenantId, userId);
  const cfg = TIER_LIMITS[tier];
  const win = windows.get(key);
  if (!win) return { used: 0, max: cfg.maxReq, remaining: cfg.maxReq };
  const used = win.count;
  return { used, max: cfg.maxReq, remaining: Math.max(0, cfg.maxReq - used) };
}

export function resetRateLimit(tenantId: string, userId: string): void {
  windows.delete(getKey(tenantId, userId));
}

--- FILE: src/core/adaptiveThrottler.ts ---
import { Tier } from './rateLimiter';

type BehaviorTag = 'NORMAL' | 'HEAVY_TRADER' | 'BOT_PATTERN' | 'NEW_USER' | 'SUSPICIOUS';

interface Profile {
  userId: string;
  tenantId: string;
  reqTimestamps: number[];
  tag: BehaviorTag;
  multiplier: number;       // applied to rate limit
  lastEval: number;
}

const EVAL_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000;
const WINDOW_MS        = 60_000;
const profiles         = new Map<string, Profile>();

function key(tenantId: string, userId: string): string {
  return `${tenantId}:${userId}`;
}

function evaluate(p: Profile): void {
  const now = Date.now();
  const recentReqs = p.reqTimestamps.filter(t => now - t < WINDOW_MS);
  p.reqTimestamps  = recentReqs;

  const rpm      = recentReqs.length;
  const gaps     = recentReqs.slice(1).map((t, i) => t - recentReqs[i]);
  const avgGap   = gaps.length ? gaps.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / gaps.length : 9999;
  const stdDev   = gaps.length
    ? Math.sqrt(gaps.map(g => Math.pow(g - avgGap, 2)).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / gaps.length)
    : 0;

  // Bot = very regular intervals (low std dev) at high rate
  if (rpm > 80 && stdDev < 50) {
    p.tag        = 'BOT_PATTERN';
    p.multiplier = 0.2;
  } else if (rpm > 200) {
    p.tag        = 'HEAVY_TRADER';
    p.multiplier = 1.5;
  } else if (rpm < 5) {
    p.tag        = 'NEW_USER';
    p.multiplier = 0.8;
  } else {
    p.tag        = 'NORMAL';
    p.multiplier = 1.0;
  }

  p.lastEval = now;
}

export function recordRequest(tenantId: string, userId: string): void {
  const k   = key(tenantId, userId);
  let p     = profiles.get(k);
  if (!p) {
    p = { userId, tenantId, reqTimestamps: [], tag: 'NEW_USER', multiplier: 0.8, lastEval: 0 };
    profiles.set(k, p);
  }
  p.reqTimestamps.push(Date.now());
  if (Date.now() - p.lastEval > EVAL_INTERVAL_MS) evaluate(p);
}

export function getMultiplier(tenantId: string, userId: string): number {
  return profiles.get(key(tenantId, userId))?.multiplier ?? 1.0;
}

export function getBehaviorTag(tenantId: string, userId: string): BehaviorTag {
  return profiles.get(key(tenantId, userId))?.tag ?? 'NEW_USER';
}

export function getAdaptedLimit(baseLimitPerMin: number, tenantId: string, userId: string): number {
  const m = getMultiplier(tenantId, userId);
  return Math.floor(baseLimitPerMin * m);
}

export function getAllProfiles(tenantId: string): Profile[] {
  return [...profiles.values()].filter(p => p.tenantId === tenantId);
}

--- FILE: src/core/circuitBreaker.ts ---
type CBState = 'CLOSED' | 'OPEN' | 'HALF_OPEN';

interface CircuitConfig {
  failureThreshold: number;   // failures before OPEN
  successThreshold: number;   // successes in HALF_OPEN to CLOSE
  recoveryMs: number;         // ms before retry (HALF_OPEN)
}

interface CircuitState {
  state: CBState;
  failures: number;
  successes: number;
  lastFailureAt: number;
  lastStateChange: number;
  totalCalls: number;
  totalFailures: number;
}

const DEFAULT_CFG: CircuitConfig = {
  failureThreshold: 3,
  successThreshold: 2,
  recoveryMs: 30_000,
};

const circuits = new Map<string, CircuitState>();

function getCircuit(name: string): CircuitState {
  if (!circuits.has(name)) {
    circuits.set(name, {
      state: 'CLOSED', failures: 0, successes: 0,
      lastFailureAt: 0, lastStateChange: Date.now(),
      totalCalls: 0, totalFailures: 0,
    });
  }
  return circuits.get(name)!;
}

export async function callWithBreaker<T>(
  name: string,
  fn: () => Promise<T>,
  fallback?: () => Promise<T>,
  cfg: Partial<CircuitConfig> = {}
): Promise<T> {
  const config = { ...DEFAULT_CFG, ...cfg };
  const c = getCircuit(name);
  c.totalCalls++;

  if (c.state === 'OPEN') {
    if (Date.now() - c.lastFailureAt >= config.recoveryMs) {
      c.state = 'HALF_OPEN';
      c.successes = 0;
      c.lastStateChange = Date.now();
      console.log(`[CB] ${name} → HALF_OPEN`);
    } else {
      if (fallback) return fallback();
      throw new Error(`CB_OPEN: circuit '${name}' is open`);
    }
  }

  try {
    const result = await fn();
    if (c.state === 'HALF_OPEN') {
      c.successes++;
      if (c.successes >= config.successThreshold) {
        c.state    = 'CLOSED';
        c.failures = 0;
        c.lastStateChange = Date.now();
        console.log(`[CB] ${name} → CLOSED (recovered)`);
      }
    } else {
      c.failures = 0; // reset on success
    }
    return result;
  } catch (err) {
    c.failures++;
    c.totalFailures++;
    c.lastFailureAt = Date.now();
    if (c.failures >= config.failureThreshold) {
      c.state = 'OPEN';
      c.lastStateChange = Date.now();
      console.error(`[CB] ${name} → OPEN after ${c.failures} failures`);
    }
    if (fallback) return fallback();
    throw err;
  }
}

export function getBreakerState(name: string): CBState {
  return getCircuit(name).state;
}

export function resetBreaker(name: string): void {
  const c = getCircuit(name);
  c.state    = 'CLOSED';
  c.failures = 0;
  c.successes = 0;
  c.lastStateChange = Date.now();
}

export function getBreakerStats(name: string) {
  const c = getCircuit(name);
  return { name, state: c.state, totalCalls: c.totalCalls, totalFailures: c.totalFailures };
}

export function getAllBreakers() {
  return [...circuits.entries()].map(([name, c]) => getBreakerStats(name));
}

import { Tier } from './rateLimiter';
import { getStore } from './database';

export type TenantTier = 'STARTUP' | 'BUSINESS' | 'ENTERPRISE';

export interface Tenant {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  tier: TenantTier;
  rateLimitTier: Tier;
  createdAt: number;
  active: boolean;
  config: Record<string, unknown>;
}

const TIER_MAP: Record<TenantTier, Tier> = {
  STARTUP:    'FREE',
  BUSINESS:   'PRO',
  ENTERPRISE: 'ENTERPRISE',
};

export function createTenant(id: string, name: string, tier: TenantTier = 'STARTUP', config: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Tenant {
  const store = getStore('ube_tenants');
  if (store.get(id)) throw new Error(`TENANT_EXISTS: ${id}`);
  const t: Tenant = { id, name, tier, rateLimitTier: TIER_MAP[tier], createdAt: Date.now(), active: true, config };
  store.set(id, t);
  return t;
}

export function getTenant(id: string): Tenant {
  const store = getStore('ube_tenants');
  const t = store.get(id) as Tenant | undefined;
  if (!t) throw new Error(`TENANT_NOT_FOUND: ${id}`);
  if (!t.active) throw new Error(`TENANT_INACTIVE: ${id}`);
  return t;
}

export function assertTenantAccess(requestTenantId: string, resourceTenantId: string): void {
  if (requestTenantId !== resourceTenantId) {
    throw new Error(`TENANT_ISOLATION_VIOLATION: ${requestTenantId} cannot access ${resourceTenantId}`);
  }
}

export function deactivateTenant(id: string): void {
  const store = getStore('ube_tenants');
  const t = store.get(id) as Tenant | undefined;
  if (t) store.set(id, { ...t, active: false });
}

export function updateTenantTier(id: string, tier: TenantTier): void {
  const store = getStore('ube_tenants');
  const t = getTenant(id);
  store.set(id, { ...t, tier, rateLimitTier: TIER_MAP[tier] });
}

export function listTenants(): Tenant[] {
  const store = getStore('ube_tenants');
  return (store.filter(() => true) as Tenant[]);
}

--- FILE: src/core/realtimePush.ts ---
import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

export type PushChannel = 'finance' | 'cyber' | 'file' | 'system' | 'broadcast' | 'gatekeeper' | 'cloud' | 'backup' | 'analytics' | 'pipeline' | 'intelligence' | 'environment' | 'global' | 'automation' | 'scheduler';

export interface PushMessage {
  channel: PushChannel;
  event: string;
  tenantId: string;
  userId?: string;
  payload: unknown;
  ts: number;
}

interface Subscriber {
  id: string;
  tenantId: string;
  userId?: string;
  channels: Set<PushChannel>;
  handler: (msg: PushMessage) => void;
}

class RealtimePushBus extends EventEmitter {
  private subscribers = new Map<string, Subscriber>();
  private messageHistory: PushMessage[] = [];
  private readonly MAX_HISTORY = 1000;

  subscribe(
    id: string,
    tenantId: string,
    channels: PushChannel[],
    handler: (msg: PushMessage) => void,
    userId?: string
  ): void {
    this.subscribers.set(id, {
      id, tenantId, userId,
      channels: new Set(channels),
      handler,
    });
  }

  unsubscribe(id: string): void {
    this.subscribers.delete(id);
  }

  push(msg: Omit<PushMessage, 'ts'>): void {
    const full: PushMessage = { ...msg, ts: Date.now() };
    this.messageHistory.push(full);
    if (this.messageHistory.length > this.MAX_HISTORY) {
      this.messageHistory.shift();
    }

    for (const sub of this.subscribers.values()) {
      // Tenant isolation: only deliver to matching tenant
      if (sub.tenantId !== full.tenantId && full.channel !== 'broadcast') continue;
      // Channel filter
      if (!sub.channels.has(full.channel) && !sub.channels.has('broadcast')) continue;
      // User filter (optional)
      if (full.userId && sub.userId && full.userId !== sub.userId) continue;
      try {
        sub.handler(full);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(`[PUSH] handler error for sub ${sub.id}:`, e);
      }
    }

    this.emit('message', full);
  }

  broadcast(event: string, payload: unknown): void {
    this.push({ channel: 'broadcast', event, tenantId: '*', payload });
  }

  getRecentMessages(tenantId: string, channel?: PushChannel, limit = 50): PushMessage[] {
    return this.messageHistory
      .filter(m => m.tenantId === tenantId || m.channel === 'broadcast')
      .filter(m => !channel || m.channel === channel)
      .slice(-limit);
  }

  getSubscriberCount(tenantId?: string): number {
    if (!tenantId) return this.subscribers.size;
    return [...this.subscribers.values()].filter(s => s.tenantId === tenantId).length;
  }
}

export const pushBus = new RealtimePushBus();

export function pushAlert(tenantId: string, channel: PushChannel, event: string, payload: unknown, userId?: string): void {
  pushBus.push({ channel, event, tenantId, userId, payload });
}

--- FILE: src/core/eventTimeline.ts ---
import { eventBus } from './eventBus';

export interface TimelineEvent {
  id: string;
  ts: number;
  tenantId: string;
  entityType: string;   // 'IP' | 'USER' | 'ASSET' | 'FILE'
  entityId: string;
  action: string;
  module: string;
  before: unknown;
  after: unknown;
  meta: Record<string, unknown>;
}

const timeline: TimelineEvent[] = [];
const MAX_EVENTS = 50_000;

function genId(): string {
  return `evt_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
}

export function recordEvent(e: Omit<TimelineEvent, 'id' | 'ts'>): TimelineEvent {
  const event: TimelineEvent = { id: genId(), ts: Date.now(), ...e };
  timeline.push(event);
  if (timeline.length > MAX_EVENTS) timeline.splice(0, timeline.length - MAX_EVENTS);
  return event;
}

export function queryTimeline(filter: {
  tenantId: string;
  entityType?: string;
  entityId?: string;
  module?: string;
  action?: string;
  since?: number;
  until?: number;
  limit?: number;
}): TimelineEvent[] {
  const limit = filter.limit ?? 100;
  return timeline
    .filter(e => {
      if (e.tenantId !== filter.tenantId)                      return false;
      if (filter.entityType && e.entityType !== filter.entityType) return false;
      if (filter.entityId   && e.entityId   !== filter.entityId)   return false;
      if (filter.module     && e.module     !== filter.module)     return false;
      if (filter.action     && e.action     !== filter.action)     return false;
      if (filter.since      && e.ts < filter.since)               return false;
      if (filter.until      && e.ts > filter.until)               return false;
      return true;
    })
    .slice(-limit);
}

export function replayEntity(
  tenantId: string,
  entityType: string,
  entityId: string
): TimelineEvent[] {
  return queryTimeline({ tenantId, entityType, entityId, limit: 10_000 });
}

export function getEntityLastState(
  tenantId: string,
  entityType: string,
  entityId: string
): unknown {
  const events = replayEntity(tenantId, entityType, entityId);
  return events.length ? events[events.length - 1].after : null;
}

export function getTimelineStats(tenantId: string) {
  const events = timeline.filter(e => e.tenantId === tenantId);
  const byModule: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const e of events) byModule[e.module] = (byModule[e.module] ?? 0) + 1;
  return { total: events.length, byModule };
}

--- FILE: src/core/persistence.ts ---
// Persistence abstraction: SQLite (Termux) → PostgreSQL (VPS)
// Zero code change at migration. Swap DB_DRIVER env var.

export type DBDriver = 'MEMORY' | 'SQLITE' | 'POSTGRES';

export interface QueryResult<T = unknown> {
  rows: T[];
  rowCount: number;
  durationMs: number;
}

interface Migration {
  version: number;
  name: string;
  sql: string;
}

// ── In-memory store (Termux dev / testing) ──────────────────
const memStore = new Map<string, unknown[]>();

class MemoryDriver {
  private tables = new Map<string, Map<string, unknown>>();

  async exec(sql: string): Promise<void> { /* no-op in memory */ }

  async query<T>(table: string, filter: Partial<T> = {}): Promise<QueryResult<T>> {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const tbl = this.tables.get(table);
    if (!tbl) return { rows: [], rowCount: 0, durationMs: Date.now() - t0 };
    const rows = [...tbl.values()].filter(row => {
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(filter as object)) {
        if ((row as any)[k] !== v) return false;
      }
      return true;
    }) as T[];
    return { rows, rowCount: rows.length, durationMs: Date.now() - t0 };
  }

  async insert<T extends { id: string }>(table: string, row: T): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.tables.has(table)) this.tables.set(table, new Map());
    this.tables.get(table)!.set(row.id, row);
  }

  async upsert<T extends { id: string }>(table: string, row: T): Promise<void> {
    return this.insert(table, row);
  }

  async delete(table: string, id: string): Promise<void> {
    this.tables.get(table)?.delete(id);
  }

  async count(table: string): Promise<number> {
    return this.tables.get(table)?.size ?? 0;
  }

  async transaction<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    // Memory driver: no real transactions, just run
    return fn();
  }
}

// ── Driver singleton ─────────────────────────────────────────
const DRIVER: DBDriver = (process.env.DB_DRIVER as DBDriver) ?? 'MEMORY';
let _driver: MemoryDriver | null = null;

function getDriver(): MemoryDriver {
  if (!_driver) {
    if (DRIVER === 'MEMORY') {
      _driver = new MemoryDriver();
      console.log('[PERSISTENCE] Using in-memory driver (dev mode)');
    } else {
      // Future: load SQLite or Postgres driver here
      // Same interface contract — hot-swap with zero module changes
      _driver = new MemoryDriver();
      console.warn(`[PERSISTENCE] Driver '${DRIVER}' not yet wired, falling back to memory`);
    }
  }
  return _driver;
}

// ── Public API ───────────────────────────────────────────────
export async function dbInsert<T extends { id: string }>(table: string, row: T): Promise<void> {
  return getDriver().insert(table, row);
}

export async function dbUpsert<T extends { id: string }>(table: string, row: T): Promise<void> {
  return getDriver().upsert(table, row);
}

export async function dbQuery<T>(table: string, filter: Partial<T> = {}): Promise<T[]> {
  const r = await getDriver().query<T>(table, filter);
  return r.rows;
}

export async function dbDelete(table: string, id: string): Promise<void> {
  return getDriver().delete(table, id);
}

export async function dbCount(table: string): Promise<number> {
  return getDriver().count(table);
}

export async function dbTransaction<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  return getDriver().transaction(fn);
}

export function getDBDriver(): DBDriver { return DRIVER; }

--- FILE: src/core/healthMonitor.ts ---
import { pushAlert } from './realtimePush';

export type HealthStatus = 'ALIVE' | 'DEGRADED' | 'DEAD';

export interface ModuleHealth {
  module: string;
  status: HealthStatus;
  lastCheck: number;
  lastAlive: number;
  errorCount: number;
  message?: string;
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

type CheckFn = () => Promise<{ status: HealthStatus; message?: string; meta?: Record<string, unknown> }>;

const registry   = new Map<string, ModuleHealth>();
const checkFns   = new Map<string, CheckFn>();
const autoRestart = new Map<string, () => Promise<void>>();

const CHECK_INTERVAL_MS  = parseInt(process.env.HEALTH_INTERVAL_MS ?? '30000');
const DEAD_THRESHOLD     = 3; // consecutive errors before DEAD

let checkLoop: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

export function registerModule(
  name: string,
  checkFn: CheckFn,
  restartFn?: () => Promise<void>
): void {
  registry.set(name, {
    module: name, status: 'ALIVE',
    lastCheck: 0, lastAlive: Date.now(),
    errorCount: 0,
  });
  checkFns.set(name, checkFn);
  if (restartFn) autoRestart.set(name, restartFn);
  console.log(`[HEALTH] Registered module: ${name}`);
}

export async function checkModule(name: string): Promise<ModuleHealth> {
  const h = registry.get(name);
  if (!h) throw new Error(`HEALTH_NOT_FOUND: ${name}`);
  const fn = checkFns.get(name)!;

  try {
    const result = await Promise.race([
      fn(),
      new Promise<never>((_, rej) => setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('TIMEOUT')), 5000)),
    ]);
    h.status     = result.status;
    h.message    = result.message;
    h.meta       = result.meta;
    h.errorCount = result.status === 'ALIVE' ? 0 : h.errorCount + 1;
    if (result.status === 'ALIVE') h.lastAlive = Date.now();
  } catch (err: any) {
    h.errorCount++;
    h.message = err.message;
    h.status  = h.errorCount >= DEAD_THRESHOLD ? 'DEAD' : 'DEGRADED';
  }

  h.lastCheck = Date.now();
  registry.set(name, h);

  // Auto-restart DEAD modules
  if (h.status === 'DEAD' && autoRestart.has(name)) {
    console.error(`[HEALTH] Module DEAD: ${name} — attempting restart`);
    pushAlert('system', 'system', 'MODULE_DEAD', { module: name, status: 'DEAD' });
    try {
      await autoRestart.get(name)!();
      h.errorCount = 0;
      h.status     = 'DEGRADED';
      console.log(`[HEALTH] Restart attempted for ${name}`);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(`[HEALTH] Restart failed for ${name}:`, e);
    }
  }

  return h;
}

export async function checkAll(): Promise<ModuleHealth[]> {
  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    [...registry.keys()].map(name => checkModule(name))
  );
  return results.map(r => r.status === 'fulfilled' ? r.value : null).filter(Boolean) as ModuleHealth[];
}

export function getHealth(name: string): ModuleHealth | null {
  return registry.get(name) ?? null;
}

export function getSystemHealth(): { overall: HealthStatus; modules: ModuleHealth[] } {
  const modules = [...registry.values()];
  const overall: HealthStatus =
    modules.some(m => m.status === 'DEAD')     ? 'DEAD'     :
    modules.some(m => m.status === 'DEGRADED') ? 'DEGRADED' :
    'ALIVE';
  return { overall, modules };
}

export function startHealthMonitor(): void {
  if (checkLoop) return;
  checkLoop = setInterval(async () => {
    const results = await checkAll();
    const dead = results.filter(r => r.status === 'DEAD');
    if (dead.length) {
      console.error(`[HEALTH] DEAD modules: ${dead.map(d => d.module).join(', ')}`);
      dead.forEach(d => pushAlert('system', 'system', 'MODULE_DEAD_DETECTED', { module: d.module, errorCount: d.errorCount }));
    }
  }, CHECK_INTERVAL_MS);
  console.log(`[HEALTH] Monitor started (interval: ${CHECK_INTERVAL_MS}ms)`);
}

export function stopHealthMonitor(): void {
  if (checkLoop) { clearInterval(checkLoop); checkLoop = null; }
}

--- FILE: src/core/userStore.ts ---
import crypto from 'crypto';
import { getStore } from './database';
import { auditLog } from './auditLog';
import { issueApiKey } from '../interface/api';
import { createTenant } from './tenantManager';

export interface UserRecord {
  userId: string; username: string; passwordHash: string;
  tenantId: string; apiKeyHash: string; createdAt: string; lastLogin?: string;
}

function hashPassword(p: string, salt: string) {
  return crypto.pbkdf2Sync(p, salt, 100_000, 64, 'sha512').toString('hex');
}
function sha256(s: string) {
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex');
}
const SALT = process.env.UBE_PASSWORD_SALT ?? 'ube-salt-CHANGE-IN-PROD';

export function registerUser(username: string, password: string): { ok: true; tenantId: string } | { ok: false; error: string } {
  const store = getStore('ube_users');
  if (store.get(username.toLowerCase())) return { ok: false, error: 'USERNAME_TAKEN' };
  if (username.length < 3) return { ok: false, error: 'USERNAME_TOO_SHORT' };
  if (password.length < 6) return { ok: false, error: 'PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT' };
  if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-@.]+$/.test(username)) return { ok: false, error: 'USERNAME_INVALID_CHARS' };
  const userId = 'u_' + crypto.randomUUID();
  const tenantId = 'tenant_' + username.toLowerCase();
  try { createTenant(tenantId, username, 'STARTUP'); } catch (_) {}
  const apiKey = issueApiKey(tenantId, 'user-default');
  const rec: UserRecord = {
    userId, username,
    passwordHash: hashPassword(password, SALT + username),
    tenantId, apiKeyHash: sha256(apiKey),
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };
  store.set(username.toLowerCase(), rec);
  getStore('ube_user_by_key').set(sha256(apiKey), username.toLowerCase());
  auditLog({ action: 'USER_REGISTERED', tenantId, userId, module: 'userStore', input: { username }, result: 'ok', severity: 'INFO' });
  return { ok: true, tenantId };
}

export function loginUser(username: string, password: string): { ok: true; tenantId: string; apiKey: string } | { ok: false; error: string } {
  const store = getStore('ube_users');
  const rec = store.get(username.toLowerCase() as any) as UserRecord | undefined;
  if (!rec) return { ok: false, error: 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS' };
  if (hashPassword(password, SALT + username) !== rec.passwordHash) return { ok: false, error: 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS' };
  const apiKey = issueApiKey(rec.tenantId, 'user-session');
  store.set(username.toLowerCase(), { ...rec, apiKeyHash: sha256(apiKey), lastLogin: new Date().toISOString() });
  getStore('ube_user_by_key').set(sha256(apiKey), username.toLowerCase());
  auditLog({ action: 'USER_LOGIN', tenantId: rec.tenantId, userId: rec.userId, module: 'userStore', input: { username }, result: 'ok', severity: 'INFO' });
  return { ok: true, tenantId: rec.tenantId, apiKey };
}

import { automationEngine } from './automationEngine';
import { financeModule } from '../modules/financeModule';
import { auditLog } from './auditLog';

// ── FINANCE RULES ─────────────────────────────────────

automationEngine.registerRule({
  id: 'finance.crypto.drop',
  name: 'Crypto Drop Detector',
  description: 'Detects >5% BTC drop in 24h and alerts',
  enabled: true,
  risk: 'MEDIUM',
  requiresApproval: false,
  trigger: { type: 'scheduled', condition: () => true },
  action: async (input: any) => {
    const prices = await financeModule.getCryptoPrices('system', [input.coin ?? 'bitcoin']);
    const coin   = prices[0];
    if (!coin) throw new Error('No price data for ' + (input.coin ?? 'bitcoin'));
    const isDrop = coin.price_change_percentage_24h < -5;
    const alert  = isDrop
      ? `⚠️ ${coin.name} dropped ${coin.price_change_percentage_24h.toFixed(2)}% — now $${coin.current_price.toLocaleString()}`
      : `✅ ${coin.name} stable at $${coin.current_price.toLocaleString()} (${coin.price_change_percentage_24h.toFixed(2)}%)`;
    return { isDrop, alert, coin: coin.name, price: coin.current_price, change: coin.price_change_percentage_24h };
  },
});

automationEngine.registerRule({
  id: 'finance.currency.alert',
  name: 'Exchange Rate Monitor',
  description: 'Alerts when USD/INR exceeds threshold',
  enabled: true,
  risk: 'LOW',
  requiresApproval: false,
  trigger: { type: 'scheduled', condition: () => true },
  action: async (input: any) => {
    const base      = input.base ?? 'USD';
    const currency  = input.currency ?? 'INR';
    const threshold = input.threshold ?? 80;
    const rates     = await financeModule.getExchangeRates('system', base);
    const rate      = rates.rates[currency];
    if (!rate) throw new Error('Rate not found: ' + currency);
    const triggered = rate > threshold;
    const alert = triggered
      ? `⚠️ ${base}/${currency} = ${rate.toFixed(2)} — exceeds threshold ${threshold}`
      : `✅ ${base}/${currency} = ${rate.toFixed(2)} — within normal range`;
    return { triggered, rate, base, currency, threshold, alert };
  },
});

// ============================================================
//  UBE — API Cache Layer
//  Protects all APIs from being hammered on every request
//  Serves cached data when API is down or limit hit
// ============================================================

export interface CacheEntry<T> {
  data: T;
  ts: number;
  source: 'LIVE' | 'CACHE' | 'STALE';
  hits: number;
}

export interface CacheConfig {
  ttlMs: number;
  staleTtlMs: number;
  maxEntries: number;
}

export const CACHE_PRESETS: Record<string, CacheConfig> = {
  crypto:       { ttlMs: 5 * 60_000,  staleTtlMs: 60 * 60_000,      maxEntries: 500  },
  exchangeRate: { ttlMs: 15 * 60_000, staleTtlMs: 24 * 60_000 * 60, maxEntries: 200  },
  news:         { ttlMs: 10 * 60_000, staleTtlMs: 6 * 60_000 * 60,  maxEntries: 1000 },
  ipReputation: { ttlMs: 60 * 60_000, staleTtlMs: 24 * 60_000 * 60, maxEntries: 5000 },
  aiResponse:   { ttlMs: 30 * 60_000, staleTtlMs: 2 * 60_000 * 60,  maxEntries: 200  },
};

class APICache {
  private store = new Map<string, CacheEntry<unknown>>();
  private configs = new Map<string, CacheConfig>();
  private stats = { hits: 0, misses: 0, staleServed: 0, evictions: 0 };

  configure(namespace: string, config: CacheConfig): void {
    this.configs.set(namespace, config);
  }

  private getConfig(namespace: string): CacheConfig {
    return this.configs.get(namespace) ?? { ttlMs: 5 * 60_000, staleTtlMs: 60 * 60_000, maxEntries: 1000 };
  }

  private makeKey(namespace: string, key: string): string {
    return `${namespace}:${key}`;
  }

  get<T>(namespace: string, key: string): CacheEntry<T> | null {
    const cfg = this.getConfig(namespace);
    const fullKey = this.makeKey(namespace, key);
    const entry = this.store.get(fullKey) as CacheEntry<T> | undefined;
    if (!entry) { this.stats.misses++; return null; }
    const age = Date.now() - entry.ts;
    if (age < cfg.ttlMs) { entry.hits++; entry.source = 'CACHE'; this.stats.hits++; return entry; }
    if (age < cfg.staleTtlMs) { entry.hits++; entry.source = 'STALE'; this.stats.staleServed++; return entry; }
    this.store.delete(fullKey); this.stats.misses++; return null;
  }

  set<T>(namespace: string, key: string, data: T): void {
    const cfg = this.getConfig(namespace);
    const fullKey = this.makeKey(namespace, key);
    if (this.store.size >= cfg.maxEntries) this.evictOldest(namespace, cfg);
    this.store.set(fullKey, { data, ts: Date.now(), source: 'LIVE', hits: 0 });
  }

  async wrap<T>(namespace: string, key: string, fetcher: () => Promise<T>, forceRefresh = false): Promise<{ data: T; source: 'LIVE' | 'CACHE' | 'STALE' }> {
    if (!forceRefresh) {
      const cached = this.get<T>(namespace, key);
      if (cached) return { data: cached.data, source: cached.source };
    }
    try {
      const data = await fetcher();
      this.set(namespace, key, data);
      return { data, source: 'LIVE' };
    } catch (err) {
      const stale = this.store.get(this.makeKey(namespace, key)) as CacheEntry<T> | undefined;
      if (stale) return { data: stale.data, source: 'STALE' };
      throw err;
    }
  }

  private evictOldest(namespace: string, cfg: CacheConfig): void {
    const prefix = `${namespace}:`;
    const entries = [...this.store.entries()].filter(([k]) => k.startsWith(prefix)).sort((a, b) => (a[1].ts as number) - (b[1].ts as number));
    const toRemove = Math.ceil(cfg.maxEntries * 0.2);
    for (let i = 0; i < toRemove && i < entries.length; i++) { this.store.delete(entries[i][0]); this.stats.evictions++; }
  }

  invalidate(namespace: string, key?: string): void {
    if (key) { this.store.delete(this.makeKey(namespace, key)); }
    else { const prefix = `${namespace}:`; for (const k of this.store.keys()) if (k.startsWith(prefix)) this.store.delete(k); }
  }

  getStats() {
    const hitRate = this.stats.hits + this.stats.misses > 0 ? ((this.stats.hits / (this.stats.hits + this.stats.misses)) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0';
    return { ...this.stats, hitRate: `${hitRate}%`, totalEntries: this.store.size };
  }
}

export const apiCache = new APICache();
for (const [ns, cfg] of Object.entries(CACHE_PRESETS)) apiCache.configure(ns, cfg);
console.log('[CACHE] API Cache Layer initialized ✅');

// ============================================================
//  UBE — Spend Guard
//  Hard limits on API costs. Auto cutoff before bill shock.
// ============================================================

export interface SpendConfig {
  dailyLimitRs: number;
  alertAtRs: number;
  perCallCostRs: number;
}

interface SpendState {
  totalSpentRs: number;
  callCount: number;
  dayStart: number;
  alerted: boolean;
  cutoff: boolean;
}

const SPEND_CONFIGS: Record<string, SpendConfig> = {
  anthropic:    { dailyLimitRs: 500, alertAtRs: 200, perCallCostRs: 0.5 },
  coingecko:    { dailyLimitRs: 0,   alertAtRs: 0,   perCallCostRs: 0   },
  exchangeRate: { dailyLimitRs: 0,   alertAtRs: 0,   perCallCostRs: 0   },
  newsapi:      { dailyLimitRs: 0,   alertAtRs: 0,   perCallCostRs: 0   },
  abuseipdb:    { dailyLimitRs: 0,   alertAtRs: 0,   perCallCostRs: 0   },
};

class SpendGuard {
  private states = new Map<string, SpendState>();
  private alertHandlers: ((module: string, spent: number, limit: number) => void)[] = [];
  private cutoffHandlers: ((module: string, spent: number) => void)[] = [];

  constructor() {
    for (const module of Object.keys(SPEND_CONFIGS)) this.resetState(module);
    setInterval(() => this.checkDayReset(), 60_000);
    console.log('[SPEND] Spend Guard initialized ✅');
  }

  private resetState(module: string): void {
    this.states.set(module, { totalSpentRs: 0, callCount: 0, dayStart: Date.now(), alerted: false, cutoff: false });
  }

  private checkDayReset(): void {
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const [module, state] of this.states) {
      if (now - state.dayStart >= 86_400_000) {
        console.log(`[SPEND] Daily reset: ${module}`);
        this.resetState(module);
      }
    }
  }

  canCall(module: string): { allowed: boolean; reason?: string; spent: number; limit: number } {
    const cfg = SPEND_CONFIGS[module];
    if (!cfg || cfg.dailyLimitRs === 0) return { allowed: true, spent: 0, limit: 0 };
    const state = this.states.get(module)!;
    if (state.cutoff) return { allowed: false, reason: `SPEND_CUTOFF: Daily limit ₹${cfg.dailyLimitRs} reached`, spent: state.totalSpentRs, limit: cfg.dailyLimitRs };
    if (state.totalSpentRs + cfg.perCallCostRs > cfg.dailyLimitRs) {
      state.cutoff = true;
      this.cutoffHandlers.forEach(h => h(module, state.totalSpentRs));
      return { allowed: false, reason: `SPEND_LIMIT_REACHED: ₹${state.totalSpentRs.toFixed(2)} / ₹${cfg.dailyLimitRs}`, spent: state.totalSpentRs, limit: cfg.dailyLimitRs };
    }
    return { allowed: true, spent: state.totalSpentRs, limit: cfg.dailyLimitRs };
  }

  recordCall(module: string, actualCostRs?: number): void {
    const cfg = SPEND_CONFIGS[module];
    if (!cfg || cfg.perCallCostRs === 0) return;
    const state = this.states.get(module)!;
    const cost = actualCostRs ?? cfg.perCallCostRs;
    state.totalSpentRs += cost;
    state.callCount++;
    if (!state.alerted && state.totalSpentRs >= cfg.alertAtRs && cfg.alertAtRs > 0) {
      state.alerted = true;
      console.warn(`[SPEND] ⚠️ ALERT: ${module} spent ₹${state.totalSpentRs.toFixed(2)}`);
      this.alertHandlers.forEach(h => h(module, state.totalSpentRs, cfg.dailyLimitRs));
    }
  }

  async guard<T>(module: string, fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const check = this.canCall(module);
    if (!check.allowed) throw new Error(check.reason);
    const result = await fn();
    this.recordCall(module);
    return result;
  }

  onAlert(handler: (module: string, spent: number, limit: number) => void): void {
    this.alertHandlers.push(handler);
  }

  onCutoff(handler: (module: string, spent: number) => void): void {
    this.cutoffHandlers.push(handler);
  }

  getReport() {
    const report: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const [module, state] of this.states) {
      const cfg = SPEND_CONFIGS[module];
      report[module] = {
        spentToday: `₹${state.totalSpentRs.toFixed(2)}`,
        dailyLimit: cfg?.dailyLimitRs ? `₹${cfg.dailyLimitRs}` : 'free',
        callCount: state.callCount,
        status: state.cutoff ? '🔴 CUTOFF' : state.alerted ? '🟡 ALERT' : '🟢 OK',
      };
    }
    return report;
  }

  setLimit(module: string, dailyLimitRs: number): void {
    if (SPEND_CONFIGS[module]) {
      SPEND_CONFIGS[module].dailyLimitRs = dailyLimitRs;
      SPEND_CONFIGS[module].alertAtRs = dailyLimitRs * 0.4;
      this.states.get(module)!.cutoff = false;
      console.log(`[SPEND] Limit updated: ${module} → ₹${dailyLimitRs}/day`);
    }
  }
}

export const spendGuard = new SpendGuard();
spendGuard.onAlert((m, s, l) => console.warn(`\n🟡 SPEND ALERT: ${m} → ₹${s.toFixed(2)} / ₹${l}\n`));
spendGuard.onCutoff((m, s) => console.error(`\n🚨 SPEND CUTOFF: ${m} → ₹${s.toFixed(2)} BLOCKED\n`));

// ============================================================
//  UBE — API Queue System
//  Lines up traffic spikes safely
// ============================================================

export type QueuePriority = 'HIGH' | 'MEDIUM' | 'LOW';

interface QueueJob<T> {
  id: string;
  fn: () => Promise<T>;
  resolve: (value: T) => void;
  reject: (reason: Error) => void;
  priority: QueuePriority;
  addedAt: number;
  timeoutMs: number;
}

interface QueueConfig {
  maxConcurrent: number;
  maxQueueSize: number;
  defaultTimeoutMs: number;
  ratePerSecond: number;
}

const PRIORITY_WEIGHT: Record<QueuePriority, number> = { HIGH: 3, MEDIUM: 2, LOW: 1 };

export class APIQueue {
  private name: string;
  private config: QueueConfig;
  private queue: QueueJob<any>[] = [];
  private running = 0;
  private processed = 0;
  private failed = 0;
  private lastRateTick = Date.now();
  private callsThisSecond = 0;
  private processing = false;

  constructor(name: string, config: Partial<QueueConfig> = {}) {
    this.name = name;
    this.config = { maxConcurrent: config.maxConcurrent ?? 5, maxQueueSize: config.maxQueueSize ?? 1000, defaultTimeoutMs: config.defaultTimeoutMs ?? 15_000, ratePerSecond: config.ratePerSecond ?? 10 };
    console.log(`[QUEUE] "${name}" ready`);
  }

  enqueue<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, priority: QueuePriority = 'MEDIUM', timeoutMs?: number): Promise<T> {
    return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
      if (this.queue.length >= this.config.maxQueueSize) { reject(new Error(`[QUEUE] "${this.name}" full`)); return; }
      const job: QueueJob<T> = { id: 'job_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7), fn, resolve, reject, priority, addedAt: Date.now(), timeoutMs: timeoutMs ?? this.config.defaultTimeoutMs };
      const insertAt = this.queue.findIndex(j => PRIORITY_WEIGHT[j.priority] < PRIORITY_WEIGHT[priority]);
      if (insertAt === -1) this.queue.push(job); else this.queue.splice(insertAt, 0, job);
      this.tick();
    });
  }

  private async tick(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing) return;
    this.processing = true;
    while (this.queue.length > 0 && this.running < this.config.maxConcurrent) {
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - this.lastRateTick >= 1000) { this.callsThisSecond = 0; this.lastRateTick = now; }
      if (this.callsThisSecond >= this.config.ratePerSecond) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000 - (now - this.lastRateTick))); continue; }
      const job = this.queue.shift()!;
      this.running++; this.callsThisSecond++;
      if (Date.now() - job.addedAt > job.timeoutMs) { job.reject(new Error(`QUEUE_TIMEOUT: ${job.id}`)); this.running--; this.failed++; continue; }
      this.executeJob(job).finally(() => { this.running--; this.tick(); });
    }
    this.processing = false;
  }

  private async executeJob<T>(job: QueueJob<T>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const result = await Promise.race([job.fn(), new Promise<never>((_, rej) => setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('JOB_TIMEOUT')), job.timeoutMs))]);
      job.resolve(result); this.processed++;
    } catch (err: any) { job.reject(err); this.failed++; }
  }

  getStats() { return { queue: this.name, waiting: this.queue.length, running: this.running, processed: this.processed, failed: this.failed }; }
}

export const queues = {
  finance: new APIQueue('finance', { maxConcurrent: 3, ratePerSecond: 5,  maxQueueSize: 500  }),
  cyber:   new APIQueue('cyber',   { maxConcurrent: 5, ratePerSecond: 10, maxQueueSize: 1000 }),
  ai:      new APIQueue('ai',      { maxConcurrent: 2, ratePerSecond: 2,  maxQueueSize: 100  }),
  news:    new APIQueue('news',    { maxConcurrent: 2, ratePerSecond: 3,  maxQueueSize: 200  }),
  general: new APIQueue('general', { maxConcurrent: 10,ratePerSecond: 20, maxQueueSize: 2000 }),
};

export function getAllQueueStats() { return Object.entries(queues).map(([name, q]) => ({ name, ...q.getStats() })); }
console.log('[QUEUE] All API queues initialized ✅');
