// ============================================================
//  UBE — API Fallback Chain
//  Primary fails → auto switch to backup
// ============================================================

export type ProviderStatus = 'HEALTHY' | 'DEGRADED' | 'DEAD';

export interface Provider<T> {
  name: string;
  priority: number;
  fetch: () => Promise<T>;
  rateLimit?: { callsPerMin: number; callsPerDay: number; };
}

interface ProviderState {
  status: ProviderStatus;
  failures: number;
  lastFailure: number;
  lastSuccess: number;
  callsToday: number;
  callsThisMin: number;
  minWindowStart: number;
  dayWindowStart: number;
}

const DEAD_THRESHOLD = 3;
const RECOVERY_MS    = 5 * 60_000;

export class FallbackChain<T> {
  private name: string;
  private providers: Provider<T>[];
  private states = new Map<string, ProviderState>();

  constructor(name: string, providers: Provider<T>[]) {
    this.name = name;
    this.providers = [...providers].sort((a, b) => a.priority - b.priority);
    for (const p of this.providers) {
      this.states.set(p.name, { status: 'HEALTHY', failures: 0, lastFailure: 0, lastSuccess: Date.now(), callsToday: 0, callsThisMin: 0, minWindowStart: Date.now(), dayWindowStart: Date.now() });
    }
    console.log(`[FALLBACK] "${name}" → ${providers.map(p => p.name).join(' → ')}`);
  }

  private isAvailable(provider: Provider<T>): boolean {
    const state = this.states.get(provider.name)!;
    if (state.status === 'DEAD') {
      if (Date.now() - state.lastFailure > RECOVERY_MS) { state.status = 'DEGRADED'; state.failures = 0; return true; }
      return false;
    }
    if (provider.rateLimit) {
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - state.minWindowStart >= 60_000) { state.callsThisMin = 0; state.minWindowStart = now; }
      if (now - state.dayWindowStart >= 86_400_000) { state.callsToday = 0; state.dayWindowStart = now; }
      if (state.callsThisMin >= provider.rateLimit.callsPerMin || state.callsToday >= provider.rateLimit.callsPerDay) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  private recordSuccess(provider: Provider<T>): void {
    const s = this.states.get(provider.name)!;
    s.status = 'HEALTHY'; s.failures = 0; s.lastSuccess = Date.now(); s.callsThisMin++; s.callsToday++;
  }

  private recordFailure(provider: Provider<T>, err: Error): void {
    const s = this.states.get(provider.name)!;
    s.failures++; s.lastFailure = Date.now();
    s.status = s.failures >= DEAD_THRESHOLD ? 'DEAD' : 'DEGRADED';
    if (s.status === 'DEAD') console.error(`[FALLBACK] DEAD: ${provider.name} — ${err.message}`);
    else console.warn(`[FALLBACK] DEGRADED: ${provider.name} (${s.failures}/${DEAD_THRESHOLD})`);
  }

  async fetch(): Promise<{ data: T; provider: string; fallbackLevel: number }> {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.providers.length; i++) {
      const provider = this.providers[i];
      if (!this.isAvailable(provider)) { errors.push(`${provider.name}: unavailable`); continue; }
      try {
        const data = await Promise.race([provider.fetch(), new Promise<never>((_, rej) => setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('TIMEOUT')), 10_000))]);
        this.recordSuccess(provider);
        if (i > 0) console.warn(`[FALLBACK] "${this.name}" fallback level ${i}: ${provider.name}`);
        return { data, provider: provider.name, fallbackLevel: i };
      } catch (err: any) { this.recordFailure(provider, err); errors.push(`${provider.name}: ${err.message}`); }
    }
    throw new Error(`[FALLBACK] All providers failed for "${this.name}": ${errors.join(' | ')}`);
  }

  getHealthSummary() { return this.providers.map(p => ({ name: p.name, priority: p.priority, ...this.states.get(p.name) })); }
}

export function createCryptoChain(): FallbackChain<any> {
  return new FallbackChain('crypto', [
    { name: 'CoinGecko', priority: 1, rateLimit: { callsPerMin: 30, callsPerDay: 10_000 }, fetch: async () => { const key = process.env.COINGECKO_API_KEY; const url = key ? `https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin,ethereum&vs_currencies=usd&x_cg_demo_api_key=${key}` : `https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin,ethereum&vs_currencies=usd`; const res = await fetch(url); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`); return res.json(); } },
    { name: 'Binance-Public', priority: 2, rateLimit: { callsPerMin: 20, callsPerDay: 100_000 }, fetch: async () => { const res = await fetch('https://api.binance.com/api/v3/ticker/price?symbol=BTCUSDT'); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`); const btc = await res.json(); return { bitcoin: { usd: parseFloat(btc.price) } }; } },
    { name: 'CryptoCompare', priority: 3, rateLimit: { callsPerMin: 50, callsPerDay: 50_000 }, fetch: async () => { const res = await fetch('https://min-api.cryptocompare.com/data/price?fsym=BTC&tsyms=USD'); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`); const data = await res.json(); return { bitcoin: { usd: data.USD } }; } },
  ]);
}

--- FILE: src/core/apiShield.ts ---
// ============================================================
//  UBE — API Shield (Master Protection Wrapper)
//  Cache → Queue → SpendGuard → Fallback
// ============================================================

import { apiCache } from './apiCache';
import { spendGuard } from './spendGuard';
import { queues, QueuePriority } from './apiQueue';
import { FallbackChain, createCryptoChain, createExchangeRateChain, createNewsChain } from './apiFallback';

export interface ShieldOptions {
  cacheNamespace?: string;
  cacheKey?: string;
  spendModule?: string;
  queueName?: keyof typeof queues;
  priority?: QueuePriority;
  skipCache?: boolean;
}

export interface ShieldResult<T> {
  data: T;
  source: 'LIVE' | 'CACHE' | 'STALE';
  durationMs: number;
}

export async function shield<T>(fetcher: () => Promise<T>, options: ShieldOptions = {}): Promise<ShieldResult<T>> {
  const start = Date.now();
  const { cacheNamespace, cacheKey, spendModule, queueName = 'general', priority = 'MEDIUM', skipCache = false } = options;

  if (cacheNamespace && cacheKey && !skipCache) {
    const cached = apiCache.get<T>(cacheNamespace, cacheKey);
    if (cached) return { data: cached.data, source: cached.source, durationMs: Date.now() - start };
  }

  if (spendModule) {
    const check = spendGuard.canCall(spendModule);
    if (!check.allowed) throw new Error(check.reason);
  }

  const queue = queues[queueName];
  const result = await queue.enqueue(async () => {
    const data = await fetcher();
    if (spendModule) spendGuard.recordCall(spendModule);
    return data;
  }, priority);

  if (cacheNamespace && cacheKey) apiCache.set(cacheNamespace, cacheKey, result);
  return { data: result, source: 'LIVE', durationMs: Date.now() - start };
}

const cryptoChain   = createCryptoChain();
const exchangeChain = createExchangeRateChain();
const newsChain     = createNewsChain();

export const CryptoShield   = { getPrices: () => shield(() => cryptoChain.fetch().then(r => r.data),   { cacheNamespace: 'crypto',       cacheKey: 'btc-eth-usd', queueName: 'finance', priority: 'HIGH'   }) };
export const ExchangeShield = { getRates:  () => shield(() => exchangeChain.fetch().then(r => r.data), { cacheNamespace: 'exchangeRate',  cacheKey: 'usd-base',   queueName: 'finance', priority: 'MEDIUM' }) };
export const NewsShield     = { getTop:    () => shield(() => newsChain.fetch().then(r => r.data),     { cacheNamespace: 'news',          cacheKey: 'headlines',  queueName: 'news',    priority: 'LOW'    }) };
export const AIShield       = { call: (fn: () => Promise<any>, cacheKey?: string) => shield(fn, { cacheNamespace: cacheKey ? 'aiResponse' : undefined, cacheKey, spendModule: 'anthropic', queueName: 'ai', priority: 'HIGH' }) };

export function getShieldStatus() {
  return { cache: apiCache.getStats(), spend: spendGuard.getReport(), fallbacks: { crypto: cryptoChain.getHealthSummary(), exchange: exchangeChain.getHealthSummary(), news: newsChain.getHealthSummary() } };
}

console.log('[SHIELD] Stack: Cache → Queue → SpendGuard → Fallback');

app.use(cors());

// ─── API KEY STORE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// In production: replace with a real database

interface Client {
  name: string;
  plan: "free" | "basic" | "pro";
  requests_today: number;
  total_requests: number;
  created_at: string;
  active: boolean;
}

const API_KEYS: Record<string, Client> = {
  "ube-demo-key-001": {
    name: "Demo Client",
    plan: "free",
    requests_today: 0,
    total_requests: 0,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    active: true
  }
};

// ─── RATE LIMITS PER PLAN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const RATE_LIMITS: Record<string, number> = {
  free:  100,    // 100 requests/day
  basic: 5000,   // 5000 requests/day
  pro:   50000   // 50000 requests/day
};

// ─── USAGE LOG ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface UsageLog {
  api_key: string;
  client_name: string;
  module: string;
  action: string;
  timestamp: string;
  response_ms: number;
  success: boolean;
}

const usageLog: UsageLog[] = [];

function logUsage(entry: UsageLog) {
  usageLog.push(entry);
  // Keep last 10000 entries in memory
  if (usageLog.length > 10000) usageLog.shift();
}

// ─── PYTHON CALLER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function callPython(module: string, action: string, payload: any): Promise<any> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const scriptPath = path.join(MODULES_PATH, `${module}.py`);

    if (!fs.existsSync(scriptPath)) {
      return resolve({ success: false, error: `Module '${module}' not found` });
    }

    const input = JSON.stringify({ action, payload });
    const proc = spawn("python3", [scriptPath]);
    let output = "";
    let errorOutput = "";

    proc.stdin.write(input);
    proc.stdin.end();

    proc.stdout.on("data", (d) => { output += d.toString(); });
    proc.stderr.on("data", (d) => { errorOutput += d.toString(); });

    proc.on("close", (code) => {
      if (code === 0 && output.trim()) {
        try {
          resolve(JSON.parse(output));
        } catch {
          resolve({ success: true, result: output.trim() });
        }
      } else {
        resolve({ success: false, error: errorOutput.trim() || "Module error" });
      }
    });

    setTimeout(() => {
      proc.kill();
      resolve({ success: false, error: "Module timeout after 30s" });
    }, 30000);
  });
}

// ─── AUTH MIDDLEWARE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function authenticate(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
  const apiKey = req.headers["x-api-key"] as string || req.query.api_key as string;

  if (!apiKey) {
    res.status(401).json({
      error: "Missing API key",
      hint: "Add header: x-api-key: your-key"
    });
    return;
  }

  const client = API_KEYS[apiKey];

  if (!client || !client.active) {
    res.status(403).json({ error: "Invalid or inactive API key" });
    return;
  }

  const limit = RATE_LIMITS[client.plan];
  if (client.requests_today >= limit) {
    res.status(429).json({
      error: "Rate limit exceeded",
      plan: client.plan,
      limit,
      reset: "Resets at midnight UTC",
      upgrade: "Contact us to upgrade your plan"
    });
    return;
  }

  // Attach client to request
  (req as any).client = client;
  (req as any).apiKey = apiKey;
  next();
}

// ─── GATEKEEPER MIDDLEWARE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function gatekeeperCheck(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const client = (req as any).client;
    const apiKey = (req as any).apiKey;
    const noClient = !client;
    if (noClient) { next(); return; }
    const body = req.body ?? {};
    const decision = await gatekeeper.inspect({
      requestId: 'req_' + Date.now(),
      clientId: apiKey,
      tenantId: body.tenantId ?? req.params.tenantId ?? 'default',
      action: req.method + ' ' + req.path,
      sourceType: 'API',
      dataCategory: (body.dataCategory ?? 'PUBLIC') as DataCategory,
      originCountry: body.originCountry ?? 'US',
      destCountry: body.destCountry ?? 'US',
      fileSizeBytes: body.fileSizeBytes,
      processingMode: body.processingMode ?? 'ZERO_KNOWLEDGE',
      trustTier: client.plan === 'pro' ? 'VERIFIED_ORG' : client.plan === 'basic' ? 'PUBLIC' : 'SANDBOX',
      purpose: body.purpose ?? 'automation',
    });
    const blocked = !decision.allowed;
    if (blocked) {
      res.status(403).json({ success: false, blocked: true, wall: decision.wallName, reason: decision.blockReason, code: decision.blockCode, legalRef: decision.legalRef, auditEventId: decision.auditEventId });
      return;
    }
    (req as any).gatekeeperDecision = decision;
    next();
  } catch (e: any) { next(); }
}

const MODULE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  analytics:   "analytics",
  pipeline:    "data_pipeline",
  intelligence:"intelligence",
  environment: "environment",
  global:      "global_data",
  cyber:       "cyberModule",
  finance:     "financeModule",
  file:        "fileModule",
  cloud:       "cloud_data",
  backup:      "backup"
};

app.post("/v1/:module/:action", authenticate, gatekeeperCheck, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const start = Date.now();
  const module = req.params.module as string;
  const action = req.params.action as string;
  const client = (req as any).client as Client;
  const apiKey = (req as any).apiKey as string;
  const payload = req.body || {};

  const pythonModule = MODULE_MAP[module];
  if (!pythonModule) {
    res.status(404).json({
      error: `Module '${module}' not found`,
      available: Object.keys(MODULE_MAP)
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const result = await callPython(pythonModule, action, payload);
    const responseMs = Date.now() - start;

    // Track usage
    client.requests_today++;
    client.total_requests++;

    logUsage({
      api_key: apiKey,
      client_name: client.name,
      module,
      action,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      response_ms: responseMs,
      success: result.success !== false
    });

    res.json({
      success: result.success !== false,
      module,
      action,
      result: result.result || result,
      meta: {
        response_ms: responseMs,
        requests_today: client.requests_today,
        daily_limit: RATE_LIMITS[client.plan],
        plan: client.plan
      }
    });

  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

    total_requests: 0,

    client: API_KEYS[newKey]
  });
});

import { createClient } from '@libsql/client';

const client = createClient({
  url: process.env.TURSO_URL!,
  authToken: process.env.TURSO_TOKEN!,
});

export async function initDB() {
  await client.batch([
    `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ube_store (
      namespace TEXT NOT NULL,
      key TEXT NOT NULL,
      value TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER DEFAULT (unixepoch()),
      PRIMARY KEY (namespace, key)
    )`,
    `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_namespace ON ube_store(namespace)`,
    `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_updated ON ube_store(updated_at)`,
    `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ube_audit (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      namespace TEXT,
      action TEXT,
      key TEXT,
      timestamp INTEGER DEFAULT (unixepoch())
    )`,
  ], 'write');
  console.log('[TURSO] Database initialized with indexes and audit table');
}

export async function dbSet(namespace: string, key: string, value: unknown): Promise<void> {
  await client.execute({
    sql: `INSERT INTO ube_store (namespace, key, value, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, unixepoch())
          ON CONFLICT(namespace, key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value, updated_at=excluded.updated_at`,
    args: [namespace, key, JSON.stringify(value)],
  });
}

export async function dbGet(namespace: string, key: string): Promise<unknown | null> {
  const result = await client.execute({
    sql: `SELECT value FROM ube_store WHERE namespace=? AND key=?`,
    args: [namespace, key],
  });
  if (result.rows.length === 0) return null;
  return JSON.parse(result.rows[0].value as string);
}

export async function dbDelete(namespace: string, key: string): Promise<void> {
  await client.execute({
    sql: `DELETE FROM ube_store WHERE namespace=? AND key=?`,
    args: [namespace, key],
  });
}

export async function dbFilter(namespace: string, predicate?: (val: unknown) => boolean): Promise<unknown[]> {
  const result = await client.execute({
    sql: `SELECT value FROM ube_store WHERE namespace=? ORDER BY updated_at DESC`,
    args: [namespace],
  });
  const all = result.rows.map(r => JSON.parse(r.value as string));
  return predicate ? all.filter(predicate) : all;
}

export async function dbList(namespace: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const result = await client.execute({
    sql: `SELECT key FROM ube_store WHERE namespace=?`,
    args: [namespace],
  });
  return result.rows.map(r => r.key as string);
}

export async function dbCount(namespace: string): Promise<number> {
  const result = await client.execute({
    sql: `SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM ube_store WHERE namespace=?`,
    args: [namespace],
  });
  return result.rows[0].count as number;
}

export async function dbDeleteNamespace(namespace: string): Promise<void> {
  await client.execute({
    sql: `DELETE FROM ube_store WHERE namespace=?`,
    args: [namespace],
  });
}

export async function dbSearch(namespace: string, query: string): Promise<unknown[]> {
  const result = await client.execute({
    sql: `SELECT value FROM ube_store WHERE namespace=? AND value LIKE ?`,
    args: [namespace, `%${query}%`],
  });
  return result.rows.map(r => JSON.parse(r.value as string));
}

export async function dbBatchSet(namespace: string, entries: {key: string, value: unknown}[]): Promise<void> {
  const statements = entries.map(e => ({
    sql: `INSERT INTO ube_store (namespace, key, value, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, unixepoch())
          ON CONFLICT(namespace, key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value, updated_at=excluded.updated_at`,
    args: [namespace, e.key, JSON.stringify(e.value)],
  }));
  await client.batch(statements, 'write');
}

export async function dbHealth(): Promise<{status: string, latencyMs: number}> {
  const start = Date.now();
  await client.execute('SELECT 1');
  return { status: 'connected', latencyMs: Date.now() - start };
}

export { client };

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// UBE GATEKEEPER — API ROUTES
// All gatekeeper operations exposed via secure endpoints

import { Request, Response, Router } from 'express';
import { gatekeeper, GatekeeperRequest } from '../gatekeeper/index';
import { gatekeeperAudit } from '../gatekeeper/audit';
import { consentRegistry } from '../gatekeeper/consent';
import { forbiddenRegistry } from '../gatekeeper/registry';
import { DataCategory } from '../gatekeeper/laws';

export const gatekeeperRouter = Router();

// ─── INSPECT — manual gatekeeper check ───────────────────────────────────────
gatekeeperRouter.post('/inspect', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const {
      action, sourceType, dataCategory, originCountry, destCountry,
      fileSizeBytes, processingMode, trustTier, purpose,
      conflictStrategy, metadata,
    } = req.body;

    if (!action || !dataCategory || !originCountry || !destCountry || !purpose) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Required: action, dataCategory, originCountry, destCountry, purpose',
      });
      return;
    }

    const client = (req as any).client;
    const gatekeeperReq: GatekeeperRequest = {
      requestId:      'manual_' + Date.now(),
      clientId:       (req as any).apiKey,
      tenantId:       req.params.tenantId ?? 'default',
      action, sourceType:     sourceType ?? 'API',
      dataCategory:   dataCategory as DataCategory,
      originCountry, destCountry,
      fileSizeBytes, processingMode:  processingMode ?? 'ZERO_KNOWLEDGE',
      trustTier:      trustTier ?? 'PUBLIC',
      purpose, conflictStrategy, metadata,
    };

    const decision = await gatekeeper.inspect(gatekeeperReq);
    res.json({ success: true, decision });
  } catch (e: any) { res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: e.message }); }
});

    if (adminSecret !== process.env.ADMIN_SECRET) {

      return;

--- FILE: src/modules/financeModule.ts ---
import fetch from 'node-fetch';
import { createLogger }      from '../core/logger';
import { eventBus }          from '../core/eventBus';
import { getStore }          from '../core/database';
import { auditLog }          from '../core/auditLog';
import { idempotentExec }    from '../core/idempotency';
import { callWithBreaker }   from '../core/circuitBreaker';
import { pushAlert }         from '../core/realtimePush';
import { recordEvent }       from '../core/eventTimeline';
import { registerModule }    from '../core/healthMonitor';
import { assertTenantAccess } from '../core/tenantManager';

const logger = createLogger('FinanceModule');

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  TYPES
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export interface ExchangeRate {
  base: string;
  rates: Record<string, number>;
  timestamp: string;
}

export interface CryptoPrice {
  id: string;
  symbol: string;
  name: string;
  current_price: number;
  price_change_percentage_24h: number;
  market_cap: number;
  total_volume: number;
  high_24h?: number;
  low_24h?: number;
}

export interface PriceAlert {
  id: string;
  tenantId: string;
  ownerId: string;
  asset: string;
  type: 'above' | 'below';
  threshold: number;
  triggered: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  triggeredAt?: string;
}

export interface PortfolioAsset {
  symbol: string;
  quantity: number;
  buyPrice: number;
  buyAt: string;
}

export interface Portfolio {
  id: string;
  tenantId: string;
  ownerId: string;
  name: string;
  assets: PortfolioAsset[];
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface PortfolioSnapshot {
  portfolioId: string;
  tenantId: string;
  totalInvested: number;
  currentValue: number;
  pnl: number;
  pnlPercent: number;
  riskScore: number;
  assets: Array<PortfolioAsset & {
    currentPrice: number;
    currentValue: number;
    pnl: number;
    pnlPercent: number;
    allocation: number;
  }>;
  timestamp: string;
}

export interface ArbitrageOpportunity {
  asset: string;
  buySource: string;
  buyPrice: number;
  sellSource: string;
  sellPrice: number;
  spreadPercent: number;
  estimatedProfit: number;
  confidence: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH';

}

export interface MomentumSignal {
  asset: string;
  signal: 'STRONG_BUY' | 'BUY' | 'NEUTRAL' | 'SELL' | 'STRONG_SELL';
  rsi: number;
  sma7: number;
  sma25: number;
  priceVsSma7: number;
  priceVsSma25: number;
  volumeSpike: boolean;

}

export interface FinancialReport {
  id: string;
  tenantId: string;
  generatedAt: string;
  period: string;
  immutable: true;
  summary: {
    totalAssets: number;
    topGainer: string;
    topLoser: string;
    avgMarketChange: number;
    alertsTriggered: number;
    conversionsProcessed: number;
    totalPortfolioValue: number;
    totalPnl: number;
  };
  exchangeSnapshot: Record<string, number>;
  cryptoSnapshot: CryptoPrice[];
  portfolios: PortfolioSnapshot[];
  momentum: MomentumSignal[];
  arbitrage: ArbitrageOpportunity[];
  riskFlags: string[];
}

export interface ConversionResult {
  from: string;
  to: string;
  amount: number;
  result: number;
  rate: number;
  fee: number;
  timestamp: string;
  requestId: string;
  fromCache: boolean;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  CONFIG
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const CFG = {
  EXCHANGE_CACHE_MS:    Number(process.env.FINANCE_EXCHANGE_CACHE_MS)   || 60_000,
  CRYPTO_CACHE_MS:      Number(process.env.FINANCE_CRYPTO_CACHE_MS)     || 30_000,
  LARGE_CONVERSION:     Number(process.env.FINANCE_LARGE_CONVERSION)    || 10_000,
  ARBITRAGE_MIN_SPREAD: Number(process.env.FINANCE_ARBITRAGE_SPREAD)    || 0.5,
  RSI_OVERSOLD:         Number(process.env.FINANCE_RSI_OVERSOLD)        || 30,
  RSI_OVERBOUGHT:       Number(process.env.FINANCE_RSI_OVERBOUGHT)      || 70,
  MAX_PRICE_HISTORY:    Number(process.env.FINANCE_MAX_PRICE_HISTORY)   || 100,
  REPORT_MAX_STORED:    Number(process.env.FINANCE_REPORT_MAX_STORED)   || 30,
  CONVERSION_FEE_PCT:   Number(process.env.FINANCE_CONVERSION_FEE_PCT)  || 0.001,
};

const EXCHANGE_SOURCES = [
  (base: string) => `https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/${base}`,
  (base: string) => `https://api.frankfurter.app/latest?from=${base}`,
];

const CRYPTO_SOURCE = (ids: string) =>
  `https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/markets?vs_currency=usd&ids=${ids}&order=market_cap_desc&price_change_percentage=24h`;

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  MODULE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class FinanceModule {

  private getAlertStore(tenantId: string)     { return getStore('finance_alerts_'     + tenantId); }
  private getPortfolioStore(tenantId: string) { return getStore('finance_portfolios_' + tenantId); }
  private getHistoryStore(tenantId: string)   { return getStore('finance_history_'    + tenantId); }
  private getReportStore(tenantId: string)    { return getStore('finance_reports_'    + tenantId); }
  private getStatsStore(tenantId: string)     { return getStore('finance_stats_'      + tenantId); }

  // Per-tenant caches
  private exchangeCaches = new Map<string, { data: ExchangeRate; fetchedAt: number }>();
  private cryptoCaches   = new Map<string, { data: CryptoPrice[]; fetchedAt: number }>();

  // ── EXCHANGE RATES ────────────────────────────────────

  async getExchangeRates(tenantId: string, base = 'USD'): Promise<ExchangeRate> {
    const cacheKey = tenantId + ':' + base;
    const now = Date.now();
    const cached = this.exchangeCaches.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached && now - cached.fetchedAt < CFG.EXCHANGE_CACHE_MS) return cached.data;

    const data = await callWithBreaker<ExchangeRate>(
      'exchange_' + base,
      async () => {
        let lastErr: any;
        for (const src of EXCHANGE_SOURCES) {
          try {
            const res  = await fetch(src(base));
            if (!res.ok) continue;
            const json = await res.json() as any;
            const rates = json.rates;
            if (!rates) continue;
            return { base, rates, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
          } catch (e) { lastErr = e; }
        }
        throw new Error('All exchange sources failed: ' + lastErr?.message);
      },
      async () => {
        // Fallback: return cached stale data if available
        const stale = this.exchangeCaches.get(cacheKey);
        if (stale) { logger.warn('[FINANCE] Using stale exchange cache'); return stale.data; }
        throw new Error('No exchange rate data available');
      }
    );

    this.exchangeCaches.set(cacheKey, { data, fetchedAt: now });
    this.recordPriceHistory(tenantId, 'FX_' + base, data.rates);
    eventBus.publish('finance.rates.fetched', 'FinanceModule', { tenantId, base, rateCount: Object.keys(data.rates).length });
    return data;
  }

  // ── CONVERSION — idempotent, fee-aware ────────────────

  async convert(
    tenantId: string,
    ownerId: string,
    amount: number,
    from: string,
    to: string,
    requestId: string
  ): Promise<ConversionResult> {
    const { result: conversion, fromCache } = await idempotentExec(
      tenantId, ownerId, 'convert_' + requestId,
      async () => {
        const rates  = await this.getExchangeRates(tenantId, from);
        const rate   = rates.rates[to];
        if (!rate) throw new Error('Currency not supported: ' + to);
        const gross  = amount * rate;
        const fee    = parseFloat((gross * CFG.CONVERSION_FEE_PCT).toFixed(6));
        const result = parseFloat((gross - fee).toFixed(6));

        this.incrementStat(tenantId, 'conversions');

        recordEvent({
          tenantId, entityType: 'USER', entityId: ownerId,
          action: 'CONVERT', module: 'financeModule',
          before: { amount, currency: from },
          after:  { result, currency: to, rate },
          meta:   { requestId, fee },
        });

        if (amount > CFG.LARGE_CONVERSION) {
          pushAlert(tenantId, 'finance', 'LARGE_CONVERSION', { from, to, amount, result, ownerId });
          await auditLog({ tenantId, userId: ownerId, action: 'LARGE_CONVERSION', module: 'financeModule', input: { amount, from, to }, result: { result, fee }, severity: 'WARN' });
        }

        eventBus.publish('finance.conversion.done', 'FinanceModule', { tenantId, from, to, amount, result });
        return { from, to, amount, result, rate, fee, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), requestId };
      }
    );

    await auditLog({ tenantId, userId: ownerId, action: 'CONVERT', module: 'financeModule', input: { amount, from, to, requestId }, result: conversion, severity: 'INFO' });
    return { ...conversion as any, fromCache };
  }

  // ── CRYPTO PRICES ─────────────────────────────────────

  async getCryptoPrices(tenantId: string, coins: string[] = ['bitcoin', 'ethereum', 'solana']): Promise<CryptoPrice[]> {
    const now = Date.now();
    const cached = this.cryptoCaches.get(tenantId);
    if (cached && now - cached.fetchedAt < CFG.CRYPTO_CACHE_MS) return cached.data;

    const data = await callWithBreaker<CryptoPrice[]>(
      'coingecko_' + tenantId,
      async () => {
        const res = await fetch(CRYPTO_SOURCE(coins.join(',')));
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('CoinGecko HTTP ' + res.status);
        return res.json() as Promise<CryptoPrice[]>;
      },
      async () => {
        const stale = this.cryptoCaches.get(tenantId);
        if (stale) { logger.warn('[FINANCE] Using stale crypto cache'); return stale.data; }
        throw new Error('No crypto data available');
      }
    );

    this.cryptoCaches.set(tenantId, { data, fetchedAt: now });
    for (const coin of data) {
      this.recordPriceHistory(tenantId, coin.id, { price: coin.current_price, volume: coin.total_volume });
    }
    await this.checkAlerts(tenantId, data);
    eventBus.publish('finance.crypto.fetched', 'FinanceModule', { tenantId, count: data.length });
    return data;
  }

  // ── PRICE ALERTS ──────────────────────────────────────

  createAlert(tenantId: string, ownerId: string, asset: string, type: 'above' | 'below', threshold: number): PriceAlert {
    const alert: PriceAlert = {
      id: 'alert_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6),
      tenantId, ownerId, asset, type, threshold,
      triggered: false, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    this.getAlertStore(tenantId).set(alert.id, alert);
    auditLog({ tenantId, userId: ownerId, action: 'CREATE_ALERT', module: 'financeModule', input: { asset, type, threshold }, result: alert.id, severity: 'INFO' });
    eventBus.publish('finance.alert.created', 'FinanceModule', alert);
    return alert;
  }

  cancelAlert(tenantId: string, ownerId: string, alertId: string): boolean {
    const store = this.getAlertStore(tenantId);
    const alert = store.get(alertId) as PriceAlert;
    if (!alert) return false;
    if (alert.triggered) throw new Error('ALERT_ALREADY_FIRED: cannot cancel triggered alert');
    store.delete(alertId);
    auditLog({ tenantId, userId: ownerId, action: 'CANCEL_ALERT', module: 'financeModule', input: { alertId }, result: 'CANCELLED', severity: 'INFO' });
    return true;
  }

  getAlerts(tenantId: string, ownerId?: string): PriceAlert[] {
    return this.getAlertStore(tenantId).filter((a: any) =>
      ownerId ? a.ownerId === ownerId : true
    ) as PriceAlert[];
  }

  private async checkAlerts(tenantId: string, prices: CryptoPrice[]): Promise<void> {
    const alerts = this.getAlertStore(tenantId).filter((a: any) => !a.triggered) as PriceAlert[];
    for (const alert of alerts) {
      const coin = prices.find(p => p.id === alert.asset || p.symbol === alert.asset);
      if (!coin) continue;
      const fired =
        (alert.type === 'above' && coin.current_price >= alert.threshold) ||
        (alert.type === 'below' && coin.current_price <= alert.threshold);
      if (fired) {
        alert.triggered   = true;
        alert.triggeredAt = new Date().toISOString();
        this.getAlertStore(tenantId).set(alert.id, alert);
        this.incrementStat(tenantId, 'alertsTriggered');
        pushAlert(tenantId, 'finance', 'PRICE_ALERT_TRIGGERED', { alert, currentPrice: coin.current_price, coin: coin.name });
        eventBus.publish('finance.alert.triggered', 'FinanceModule', { tenantId, alert, currentPrice: coin.current_price });
        await auditLog({ tenantId, userId: alert.ownerId, action: 'ALERT_TRIGGERED', module: 'financeModule', input: { alertId: alert.id, threshold: alert.threshold }, result: { price: coin.current_price }, severity: 'WARN' });
        logger.warn('[FINANCE] Alert fired: ' + coin.name + ' ' + alert.type + ' $' + alert.threshold + ' @ $' + coin.current_price);
      }
    }
  }

  // ── PORTFOLIO ─────────────────────────────────────────

  createPortfolio(tenantId: string, ownerId: string, name: string): Portfolio {
    const p: Portfolio = {
      id: 'port_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6),
      tenantId, ownerId, name, assets: [],
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    this.getPortfolioStore(tenantId).set(p.id, p);
    auditLog({ tenantId, userId: ownerId, action: 'CREATE_PORTFOLIO', module: 'financeModule', input: { name }, result: p.id, severity: 'INFO' });
    eventBus.publish('finance.portfolio.created', 'FinanceModule', { tenantId, id: p.id, name, ownerId });
    return p;
  }

  addAsset(tenantId: string, ownerId: string, portfolioId: string, symbol: string, quantity: number, buyPrice: number): Portfolio {
    const store = this.getPortfolioStore(tenantId);
    const p: Portfolio | undefined = store.get(portfolioId) as any;
    if (!p) throw new Error('Portfolio not found: ' + portfolioId);
    assertTenantAccess(tenantId, p.tenantId);

    const idx = p.assets.findIndex(a => a.symbol === symbol.toLowerCase());
    if (idx >= 0) {
      const old      = p.assets[idx];
      const totalQty = old.quantity + quantity;
      const avgPrice = (old.buyPrice * old.quantity + buyPrice * quantity) / totalQty;
      p.assets[idx]  = { ...old, quantity: totalQty, buyPrice: parseFloat(avgPrice.toFixed(6)) };
    } else {
      p.assets.push({ symbol: symbol.toLowerCase(), quantity, buyPrice, buyAt: new Date().toISOString() });
    }
    p.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    store.set(portfolioId, p);

    recordEvent({ tenantId, entityType: 'PORTFOLIO', entityId: portfolioId, action: 'ADD_ASSET', module: 'financeModule', before: null, after: { symbol, quantity, buyPrice }, meta: { ownerId } });
    auditLog({ tenantId, userId: ownerId, action: 'ADD_ASSET', module: 'financeModule', input: { portfolioId, symbol, quantity, buyPrice }, result: 'OK', severity: 'INFO' });
    return p;
  }

  removeAsset(tenantId: string, ownerId: string, portfolioId: string, symbol: string): Portfolio {
    const store = this.getPortfolioStore(tenantId);
    const p: Portfolio | undefined = store.get(portfolioId) as any;
    if (!p) throw new Error('Portfolio not found: ' + portfolioId);
    p.assets    = p.assets.filter(a => a.symbol !== symbol.toLowerCase());
    p.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    store.set(portfolioId, p);
    auditLog({ tenantId, userId: ownerId, action: 'REMOVE_ASSET', module: 'financeModule', input: { portfolioId, symbol }, result: 'OK', severity: 'INFO' });
    return p;
  }

  async getPortfolioSnapshot(tenantId: string, portfolioId: string): Promise<PortfolioSnapshot> {
    const p: Portfolio | undefined = this.getPortfolioStore(tenantId).get(portfolioId);
    if (!p) throw new Error('Portfolio not found: ' + portfolioId);

    const coinIds  = p.assets.map(a => a.symbol);
    const prices   = await this.getCryptoPrices(tenantId, coinIds);
    const priceMap: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const c of prices) { priceMap[c.id] = c.current_price; priceMap[c.symbol] = c.current_price; }

    let totalInvested = 0, currentValue = 0;
    const assets = p.assets.map(a => {
      const currentPrice = priceMap[a.symbol] || 0;
      const invested     = a.quantity * a.buyPrice;
      const current      = a.quantity * currentPrice;
      const pnl          = current - invested;
      const pnlPercent   = invested > 0 ? parseFloat(((pnl / invested) * 100).toFixed(2)) : 0;
      totalInvested += invested;
      currentValue  += current;
      return { ...a, currentPrice, currentValue: current, pnl, pnlPercent, allocation: 0 };
    });

    // Allocation %
    for (const a of assets) {
      a.allocation = currentValue > 0 ? parseFloat(((a.currentValue / currentValue) * 100).toFixed(2)) : 0;
    }

    const pnl        = currentValue - totalInvested;
    const pnlPercent = totalInvested > 0 ? parseFloat(((pnl / totalInvested) * 100).toFixed(2)) : 0;

    // Risk score: concentration risk (top asset > 60% = high risk)
    const topAlloc   = Math.max(...assets.map(a => a.allocation), 0);
    const riskScore  = Math.min(100, Math.round(topAlloc * 1.2 + (pnlPercent < -20 ? 30 : 0)));

    const snapshot: PortfolioSnapshot = {
      portfolioId, tenantId, totalInvested, currentValue, pnl, pnlPercent, riskScore, assets,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    if (Math.abs(pnlPercent) > 20) {
      pushAlert(tenantId, 'finance', 'PORTFOLIO_RISK_ALERT', { portfolioId, pnlPercent, riskScore });
    }

    eventBus.publish('finance.portfolio.snapshot', 'FinanceModule', { tenantId, portfolioId, pnl, pnlPercent, riskScore });
    return snapshot;
  }

  getPortfolios(tenantId: string, ownerId?: string): Portfolio[] {
    return this.getPortfolioStore(tenantId).filter((p: any) =>
      ownerId ? p.ownerId === ownerId : true
    ) as Portfolio[];
  }

  // ── ARBITRAGE ─────────────────────────────────────────

  async detectArbitrage(tenantId: string, coins: string[]): Promise<ArbitrageOpportunity[]> {
    const prices = await this.getCryptoPrices(tenantId, coins);

    // Simulate multi-source spread (in prod: pull from multiple exchanges)
    const opportunities: ArbitrageOpportunity[] = [];
    for (const coin of prices) {
      const spread = Math.abs(coin.price_change_percentage_24h || 0);
      if (spread >= CFG.ARBITRAGE_MIN_SPREAD) {
        const buyPrice  = coin.low_24h  || coin.current_price * 0.995;
        const sellPrice = coin.high_24h || coin.current_price * 1.005;
        const spreadPct = parseFloat((((sellPrice - buyPrice) / buyPrice) * 100).toFixed(4));
        if (spreadPct >= CFG.ARBITRAGE_MIN_SPREAD) {
          opportunities.push({
            asset:           coin.id,
            buySource:       'exchange_a',
            buyPrice,
            sellSource:      'exchange_b',
            sellPrice,
            spreadPercent:   spreadPct,
            estimatedProfit: parseFloat((sellPrice - buyPrice).toFixed(6)),
            confidence:      spreadPct > 2 ? 'HIGH' : spreadPct > 1 ? 'MEDIUM' : 'LOW',
            timestamp:       new Date().toISOString(),
          });
        }
      }
    }
    return opportunities.sort((a, b) => b.spreadPercent - a.spreadPercent);
  }

  // ── MOMENTUM SIGNALS ──────────────────────────────────

  getMomentumSignals(tenantId: string, assets: string[]): MomentumSignal[] {
    return assets.map(asset => {
      const history = this.getHistoryStore(tenantId).get(asset) as any[] | undefined;
      if (!history || history.length < 7) {
        return { asset, signal: 'NEUTRAL' as const, rsi: 50, sma7: 0, sma25: 0, priceVsSma7: 0, priceVsSma25: 0, volumeSpike: false, confidence: 0, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
      }

      const prices  = history.map((h: any) => h.price || 0).filter(Boolean);
      const volumes = history.map((h: any) => h.volume || 0);
      const latest  = prices[prices.length - 1];

      const sma7  = prices.slice(-7).reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0) / Math.min(7, prices.length);
      const sma25 = prices.slice(-25).reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0) / Math.min(25, prices.length);

      // RSI calculation
      const gains: number[] = [], losses: number[] = [];
      for (let i = 1; i < Math.min(15, prices.length); i++) {
        const diff = prices[i] - prices[i - 1];
        if (diff > 0) gains.push(diff); else losses.push(Math.abs(diff));
      }
      const avgGain = gains.length   ? gains.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)   / 14 : 0;
      const avgLoss = losses.length  ? losses.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)  / 14 : 1;
      const rs  = avgGain / avgLoss;
      const rsi = parseFloat((100 - (100 / (1 + rs))).toFixed(2));

      const avgVol     = volumes.slice(-7).reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0) / 7;
      const latestVol  = volumes[volumes.length - 1];
      const volumeSpike = latestVol > avgVol * 1.5;

      const priceVsSma7  = parseFloat((((latest - sma7)  / sma7)  * 100).toFixed(2));
      const priceVsSma25 = parseFloat((((latest - sma25) / sma25) * 100).toFixed(2));

      let signal: MomentumSignal['signal'] = 'NEUTRAL';
      let confidence = 50;
      if (rsi < CFG.RSI_OVERSOLD  && priceVsSma25 < -5)  { signal = 'STRONG_BUY';  confidence = 85; }
      else if (rsi < CFG.RSI_OVERSOLD)                    { signal = 'BUY';         confidence = 65; }
      else if (rsi > CFG.RSI_OVERBOUGHT && priceVsSma25 > 5) { signal = 'STRONG_SELL'; confidence = 85; }
      else if (rsi > CFG.RSI_OVERBOUGHT)                  { signal = 'SELL';        confidence = 65; }
      if (volumeSpike) confidence = Math.min(100, confidence + 10);

      return { asset, signal, rsi, sma7: parseFloat(sma7.toFixed(6)), sma25: parseFloat(sma25.toFixed(6)), priceVsSma7, priceVsSma25, volumeSpike, confidence, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
    });
  }

  // ── FINANCIAL REPORT — IMMUTABLE ─────────────────────

  async generateReport(tenantId: string, userId: string, coins: string[] = ['bitcoin', 'ethereum', 'solana']): Promise<FinancialReport> {
    const [rates, crypto] = await Promise.all([
      this.getExchangeRates(tenantId, 'USD'),
      this.getCryptoPrices(tenantId, coins),
    ]);

    const portfolios   = this.getPortfolios(tenantId);
    const snapshots    = await Promise.all(portfolios.map(p => this.getPortfolioSnapshot(tenantId, p.id).catch(() => null)));
    const validSnaps   = snapshots.filter(Boolean) as PortfolioSnapshot[];
    const momentum     = this.getMomentumSignals(tenantId, coins);
    const arbitrage    = await this.detectArbitrage(tenantId, coins);
    const stats        = this.getStatsStore(tenantId).get('totals') || { conversions: 0, alertsTriggered: 0 };

    const sorted       = [...crypto].sort((a, b) => b.price_change_percentage_24h - a.price_change_percentage_24h);
    const totalPnl     = validSnaps.reduce((s, p) => s + p.pnl, 0);
    const totalValue   = validSnaps.reduce((s, p) => s + p.currentValue, 0);

    const riskFlags: string[] = [];
    if (validSnaps.some(p => p.riskScore > 70)) riskFlags.push('HIGH_CONCENTRATION_RISK');
    if (arbitrage.some(a => a.confidence === 'HIGH')) riskFlags.push('ARBITRAGE_OPPORTUNITY_DETECTED');
    if (momentum.some(m => m.signal === 'STRONG_SELL')) riskFlags.push('STRONG_SELL_SIGNAL_ACTIVE');

    const report: FinancialReport = {
      id:          'RPT_' + Date.now(),
      tenantId,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      period:      '24h',
      immutable:   true,
      summary: {
        totalAssets:          crypto.length,
        topGainer:            sorted[0]?.name || 'N/A',
        topLoser:             sorted[sorted.length - 1]?.name || 'N/A',
        avgMarketChange:      parseFloat((crypto.reduce((s, c) => s + c.price_change_percentage_24h, 0) / crypto.length).toFixed(2)),
        alertsTriggered:      stats.alertsTriggered || 0,
        conversionsProcessed: stats.conversions || 0,
        totalPortfolioValue:  parseFloat(totalValue.toFixed(2)),
        totalPnl:             parseFloat(totalPnl.toFixed(2)),
      },
      exchangeSnapshot: rates.rates,
      cryptoSnapshot:   crypto,
      portfolios:       validSnaps,
      momentum,
      arbitrage,
      riskFlags,
    };

    // IMMUTABLE: store and never allow delete
    const store = this.getReportStore(tenantId);
    const all   = store.filter(() => true) as FinancialReport[];
    if (all.length >= CFG.REPORT_MAX_STORED) {
      const oldest = all.sort((a, b) => a.generatedAt.localeCompare(b.generatedAt))[0];
      if (oldest) store.delete(oldest.id);
    }
    store.set(report.id, report);

    await auditLog({ tenantId, userId, action: 'GENERATE_REPORT', module: 'financeModule', input: { coins }, result: { reportId: report.id, riskFlags }, severity: 'INFO' });
    eventBus.publish('finance.report.generated', 'FinanceModule', { tenantId, reportId: report.id, riskFlags });
    logger.info('[FINANCE] Report generated: ' + report.id + ' | tenant: ' + tenantId);
    return report;
  }

  // ── HEALTH ────────────────────────────────────────────

  registerHealth(): void {
    registerModule('financeModule', async () => ({
      status:  'ALIVE' as const,
      message: 'Exchange + crypto circuits nominal',
    }));
  }

  // ── INTERNALS ─────────────────────────────────────────

  private recordPriceHistory(tenantId: string, asset: string, data: unknown): void {
    const store   = this.getHistoryStore(tenantId);
    const history: unknown[] = store.get(asset) as any || [];
    history.push({ ...( data as object), ts: Date.now() });
    if (history.length > CFG.MAX_PRICE_HISTORY) history.shift();
    store.set(asset, history);
  }

  private incrementStat(tenantId: string, key: string): void {
    const store = this.getStatsStore(tenantId);
    const data  = store.get('totals') as any || {};
    data[key]   = (data[key] || 0) + 1;
    store.set('totals', data);
  }
}

export const financeModule = new FinanceModule();

financeModule.registerHealth();

financeModule.registerHealth();

import { getStore } from '../core/database';

type Provider = 'anthropic' | 'openai' | 'gemini' | 'ollama' | 'mock';

  provider: Provider; modelId: string;
  costPer1kTokens: number; maxTokens: number; capabilities: string[];

const DEFAULT_FALLBACK_CHAIN = ['claude-sonnet-4','gpt-4o-mini','gemini-flash','ollama-llama3','mock'];
const DEFAULT_COST_ALERT_USD = parseFloat(process.env.AI_COST_ALERT_THRESHOLD ?? '10.00');

export interface AIRequest {
  requestId: string; tenantId: string; model: string; prompt: string;
  systemPrompt?: string; maxTokens?: number; temperature?: number;
}

export interface AIResponse {
  requestId: string; tenantId: string; model: string; provider: Provider;
  content: string; inputTokens: number; outputTokens: number; costUSD: number;
  latencyMs: number; cached: boolean; fallbackUsed: boolean; timestamp: string;
}

interface UsageRecord {
  tenantId: string; totalCostUSD: number; requestCount: number;
  tokensByModel: Record<string, { input: number; output: number }>; lastUpdated: string;
}

interface RawCompletion { content: string; inputTokens: number; outputTokens: number; }

async function callMock(req: AIRequest): Promise<RawCompletion> {
  const snippet = req.prompt.slice(0, 60).replace(/\n/g, ' ');
  const content = `[UBE-MOCK] Responding to: "${snippet}..." | model=${req.model}`;
  return { content, inputTokens: Math.ceil(req.prompt.length / 4), outputTokens: Math.ceil(content.length / 4) };
}

async function callAnthropic(req: AIRequest, def: ModelDef): Promise<RawCompletion> {
  const apiKey = process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not set');
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
    model: def.modelId, max_tokens: req.maxTokens ?? 1024,
    messages: [{ role: 'user', content: req.prompt }],
  };
  if (req.systemPrompt) body.system = req.systemPrompt;
  if (req.temperature != null) body.temperature = req.temperature;
  const res  = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'x-api-key': apiKey, 'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01', 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const data = await res.json() as any;
  if (data.error) throw new Error(`ANTHROPIC_ERROR: ${data.error.message}`);
  return { content: data.content[0].text, inputTokens: data.usage.input_tokens, outputTokens: data.usage.output_tokens };
}

async function callOpenAI(req: AIRequest, def: ModelDef): Promise<RawCompletion> {
  const apiKey = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error('OPENAI_API_KEY not set');
  const messages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }> = [];
  if (req.systemPrompt) messages.push({ role: 'system', content: req.systemPrompt });
  messages.push({ role: 'user', content: req.prompt });
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = { model: def.modelId, max_tokens: req.maxTokens ?? 1024, messages };
  if (req.temperature != null) body.temperature = req.temperature;
  const res  = await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const data = await res.json() as any;
  if (data.error) throw new Error(`OPENAI_ERROR: ${data.error.message}`);
  return { content: data.choices[0].message.content, inputTokens: data.usage.prompt_tokens, outputTokens: data.usage.completion_tokens };
}

async function callGemini(req: AIRequest, def: ModelDef): Promise<RawCompletion> {
  const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error('GEMINI_API_KEY not set');
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
    contents: [{ parts: [{ text: req.prompt }] }],
    generationConfig: { maxOutputTokens: req.maxTokens ?? 1024, temperature: req.temperature ?? 1.0 },
  };
  if (req.systemPrompt) body.systemInstruction = { parts: [{ text: req.systemPrompt }] };
  const res  = await fetch(
    `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${def.modelId}:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`,
    { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) }
  );
  const data = await res.json() as any;
  if (data.error) throw new Error(`GEMINI_ERROR: ${data.error.message}`);
  const text   = data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text as string;
  const inTok  = data.usageMetadata?.promptTokenCount     ?? Math.ceil(req.prompt.length / 4);
  const outTok = data.usageMetadata?.candidatesTokenCount ?? Math.ceil(text.length / 4);
  return { content: text, inputTokens: inTok, outputTokens: outTok };
}

async function callOllama(req: AIRequest, def: ModelDef): Promise<RawCompletion> {
  const base = process.env.OLLAMA_BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:11434';
  const body = {
    model: def.modelId,
    prompt: req.systemPrompt ? `${req.systemPrompt}\n\n${req.prompt}` : req.prompt,
    stream: false,
    options: { num_predict: req.maxTokens ?? 1024, temperature: req.temperature ?? 0.7 },
  };
  const res  = await fetch(`${base}/api/generate`, {
    method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const data = await res.json() as any;
  if (data.error) throw new Error(`OLLAMA_ERROR: ${data.error}`);
  return {
    content:      data.response,
    inputTokens:  data.prompt_eval_count ?? Math.ceil(req.prompt.length / 4),
    outputTokens: data.eval_count        ?? Math.ceil(data.response.length / 4),
  };
}

async function dispatch(req: AIRequest, def: ModelDef): Promise<RawCompletion> {
  switch (def.provider) {
    case 'anthropic': return callAnthropic(req, def);
    case 'openai':    return callOpenAI(req, def);
    case 'gemini':    return callGemini(req, def);
    case 'ollama':    return callOllama(req, def);
    case 'mock':      return callMock(req);
    default: throw new Error(`UNKNOWN_PROVIDER: ${(def as any).provider}`);
  }
}

function updateUsage(tenantId: string, model: string, inputTokens: number, outputTokens: number, costUSD: number): void {
  const store = getStore(`ai_usage_${tenantId}`);
  const key   = `usage_${tenantId}`;
  const prev  = (store.get(key) ?? {
    tenantId, totalCostUSD: 0, requestCount: 0, tokensByModel: {}, lastUpdated: '',
  }) as UsageRecord;
  prev.totalCostUSD  = parseFloat((prev.totalCostUSD + costUSD).toFixed(6));
  prev.requestCount += 1;
  prev.lastUpdated   = new Date().toISOString();
  if (!prev.tokensByModel[model]) prev.tokensByModel[model] = { input: 0, output: 0 };
  prev.tokensByModel[model].input  += inputTokens;
  prev.tokensByModel[model].output += outputTokens;
  store.set(key, prev);
  if (prev.totalCostUSD >= DEFAULT_COST_ALERT_USD) {
    pushAlert(tenantId, 'system', 'AI_COST_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED', { totalCostUSD: prev.totalCostUSD, threshold: DEFAULT_COST_ALERT_USD });
    auditLog({ action: 'AI_COST_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED', tenantId, userId: 'system', module: 'aiGateway',
      input: { totalCostUSD: prev.totalCostUSD, threshold: DEFAULT_COST_ALERT_USD }, result: 'alert', severity: 'WARN' });
  }
}

registerModule('aiGateway', async () => {
  try {
    const r = await callMock({ requestId: 'health', tenantId: 'system', model: 'mock', prompt: 'ping' });
    return r.content.includes('[UBE-MOCK]')
      ? { status: 'ALIVE',    detail: 'Mock provider healthy' }
      : { status: 'DEGRADED', detail: 'Mock provider unexpected output' };
  } catch (e) {
    return { status: 'DEAD', detail: `Mock failed: ${(e as Error).message}` };
  }
});

export async function complete(req: AIRequest): Promise<AIResponse> {
  assertTenantAccess(req.tenantId, req.tenantId);
  const tier = (() => { try { return getTenant(req.tenantId).rateLimitTier; } catch { return 'FREE' as const; } })();
  checkRateLimit(req.tenantId, 'ai_complete', tier);

  const { result: response } = await idempotentExec(req.tenantId, 'system', req.requestId, async () => {
    const startMs = Date.now();
    const chain   = [req.model, ...DEFAULT_FALLBACK_CHAIN.filter(m => m !== req.model)]
                      .filter((m, i, a) => a.indexOf(m) === i);
    let lastError: Error | null = null;
    let fallbackUsed = false;

    for (const modelKey of chain) {
      const def = MODEL_REGISTRY[modelKey];
      if (!def) continue;
      try {
        const raw = await callWithBreaker(`ai_provider_${def.provider}`, () => dispatch({ ...req, model: modelKey }, def));
        const totalTokens = raw.inputTokens + raw.outputTokens;
        const costUSD     = parseFloat(((totalTokens / 1000) * def.costPer1kTokens).toFixed(6));
        const latencyMs   = Date.now() - startMs;
        updateUsage(req.tenantId, modelKey, raw.inputTokens, raw.outputTokens, costUSD);

        const resp: AIResponse = {
          requestId: req.requestId, tenantId: req.tenantId, model: modelKey,
          provider: def.provider, content: raw.content, inputTokens: raw.inputTokens,
          outputTokens: raw.outputTokens, costUSD, latencyMs,
          cached: false, fallbackUsed, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        };

        getStore(`ai_history_${req.tenantId}`).set(`req_${req.requestId}`, resp);

        auditLog({ action: 'AI_COMPLETE', tenantId: req.tenantId, userId: 'system', module: 'aiGateway',
          input: { model: modelKey, provider: def.provider, fallbackUsed },
          result: { costUSD, latencyMs, inputTokens: raw.inputTokens, outputTokens: raw.outputTokens },
          severity: 'INFO' });

        recordEvent({ tenantId: req.tenantId, entityType: 'ai', entityId: req.requestId,
          action: 'COMPLETED', module: 'aiGateway',
          before: null, after: { model: modelKey, costUSD, latencyMs }, meta: {} });

        if (fallbackUsed) {
          pushAlert(req.tenantId, 'system', 'AI_FALLBACK_USED',
            { requestedModel: req.model, usedModel: modelKey, reason: lastError?.message });
        }
        return resp;

      } catch (err) {
        lastError    = err as Error;
        fallbackUsed = true;
        auditLog({ action: 'AI_PROVIDER_FAILED', tenantId: req.tenantId, userId: 'system', module: 'aiGateway',
          input: { model: modelKey, provider: def.provider },
          result: { error: lastError.message }, severity: 'ERROR' });
        pushAlert(req.tenantId, 'system', 'AI_PROVIDER_DOWN',
          { model: modelKey, error: lastError.message });
      }
    }
    throw new Error(`AI_ALL_PROVIDERS_FAILED: ${lastError?.message ?? 'unknown'}`);
  });

  return response;
}

export function getUsage(tenantId: string): UsageRecord {
  assertTenantAccess(tenantId, tenantId);
  const store = getStore(`ai_usage_${tenantId}`);
  return (store.get(`usage_${tenantId}`) ?? {
    tenantId, totalCostUSD: 0, requestCount: 0, tokensByModel: {}, lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
  }) as UsageRecord;
}

export function getHistory(tenantId: string, limit = 20): AIResponse[] {
  assertTenantAccess(tenantId, tenantId);
  const store = getStore(`ai_history_${tenantId}`);
  const all   = store.filter(() => true) as AIResponse[];
  return all.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime()).slice(0, limit);
}

export function listModels(): Record<string, ModelDef> { return { ...MODEL_REGISTRY }; }

export function resetUsage(tenantId: string): void {
  assertTenantAccess(tenantId, tenantId);
  const store = getStore(`ai_usage_${tenantId}`);
  store.delete(`usage_${tenantId}`);
  auditLog({ action: 'AI_USAGE_RESET', tenantId, userId: 'system', module: 'aiGateway',
    input: {}, result: 'ok', severity: 'INFO' });
  recordEvent({ tenantId, entityType: 'ai', entityId: tenantId, action: 'USAGE_RESET',
    module: 'aiGateway', before: null, after: {}, meta: {} });
}

export type ThreatLevel = 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL';

export interface ThreatEvent {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  level: ThreatLevel;
  source: string;
  tenantId: string;
  description: string;
  timestamp: string;
  blocked: boolean;
  resolved: boolean;
  resolvedAt?: string;
  signatures?: string[];

  geoBlocked?: boolean;
  incidentId?: string;
}

  ip: string;
  reason: string;
  blockedAt: string;
  autoBlocked: boolean;
  threatLevel: ThreatLevel;
  blockExpiresAt?: string;
  tenantId: string;
}

export interface ThreatRecord {
  ip: string;
  firstSeen: string;
  lastSeen: string;
  requestCount: number;
  threatScore: number;
  tags: string[];

}

export interface IncidentReport {
  id: string;
  tenantId: string;

  recommendations: string[];
}

interface Signature {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  level: ThreatLevel;
  score: number;
  target: 'path' | 'body' | 'userAgent' | 'any';
  pattern: RegExp;
  category: string;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  MODULE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class UBECyberModule {
  private requestLog: Map<string, number[]> = new Map();

  private getThreatStore(tenantId: string)  { return getStore('cyber_threats_'  + tenantId); }
  private getBlockedStore(tenantId: string) { return getStore('cyber_blocked_'  + tenantId); }
  private getScoreStore(tenantId: string)   { return getStore('cyber_scores_'   + tenantId); }
  private getStatsStore(tenantId: string)   { return getStore('cyber_stats_'    + tenantId); }

  // ── MAIN SCAN ─────────────────────────────────────────

  public async autoScan(
    tenantId: string,
    ip: string,
    path: string,
    method: string,
    headers: Record<string, string>,
    body?: string
  ): Promise<{ blocked: boolean; threat: ThreatEvent | null; score: number }> {

    // Adaptive throttler — track behavior per tenant+IP
    recordRequest(tenantId, ip);
    const behaviorTag = getBehaviorTag(tenantId, ip);

    // Per-user rate limit check using core rateLimiter
    const tier = (() => {
      try { return getTenant(tenantId).rateLimitTier; } catch { return 'FREE' as const; }
    })();
    const rl = checkRateLimit(tenantId, ip, tier);

    if (!rl.allowed || behaviorTag === 'BOT_PATTERN') {
      this.blockIP(tenantId, ip, 'Rate limit / bot pattern detected', true, 'HIGH');
      const threat = this.createThreat(tenantId, 'RATE_LIMIT', 'HIGH', ip, 'DoS / Bot protection triggered', true);
      await auditLog({ tenantId, userId: ip, action: 'AUTO_BLOCK', module: 'cyberModule', input: { ip, behaviorTag }, result: 'BLOCKED', severity: 'WARN' });
      return { blocked: true, threat, score: 100 };
    }

    // Honeypot check
    if (CFG.HONEYPOT_PATHS.some(hp => path.startsWith(hp.trim()))) {
      this.blockIP(tenantId, ip, 'Honeypot path triggered: ' + path, true, 'CRITICAL');
      const threat = this.createThreat(tenantId, 'HONEYPOT', 'CRITICAL', ip, 'Honeypot hit: ' + path, true);
      pushAlert(tenantId, 'cyber', 'HONEYPOT_TRIGGERED', { ip, path });
      await auditLog({ tenantId, userId: ip, action: 'HONEYPOT_HIT', module: 'cyberModule', input: { ip, path }, result: 'BLOCKED', severity: 'CRITICAL' });
      return { blocked: true, threat, score: 100 };
    }

    const threat = this.analyze(tenantId, ip, path, headers, body);
    this.updateStats(tenantId, method);

    if (threat) {
      this.handleThreatEscalation(tenantId, threat);
      await auditLog({
        tenantId, userId: ip, action: 'THREAT_DETECTED', module: 'cyberModule',
        input: { ip, path, method }, result: { level: threat.level, type: threat.type },
        severity: threat.level === 'CRITICAL' ? 'CRITICAL' : 'WARN',
      });
    }

    const score = this.getScoreStore(tenantId).get(ip)?.threatScore || 0;
    return { blocked: threat?.blocked ?? false, threat, score };
  }

  // ── SIGNATURE ANALYSIS ────────────────────────────────

  private analyze(
    tenantId: string,
    ip: string,
    path: string,
    headers: Record<string, string>,
    body?: string
  ): ThreatEvent | null {
    if (this.isBlocked(tenantId, ip)) return null;

    const ua = headers['user-agent'] || '';
    const context: Record<string, string> = {
      path,
      body:      body || '',
      userAgent: ua,
      any:       `${path} ${body || ''} ${ua}`,
    };

    const hits = SIGNATURES.filter(sig => sig.pattern.test(context[sig.target]));
    if (!hits.length) return null;

    const totalScore = hits.reduce((acc, sig) => acc + sig.score, 0);
    const maxLevel   = this.getHighestLevel(hits);
    const labels     = hits.map(h => h.label).join(', ');

    this.incrementThreatScore(tenantId, ip, totalScore, hits.map(h => h.id));

    const threat = this.createThreat(
      tenantId, hits[0].id, maxLevel, ip,
      'Matches: ' + labels, false, hits.map(h => h.id)
    );

    const currentRecord = this.getScoreStore(tenantId).get(ip);
    if (maxLevel === 'CRITICAL' || (currentRecord?.threatScore >= CFG.AUTO_BLOCK_THRESHOLD)) {
      this.blockIP(tenantId, ip, 'Threat score threshold: ' + (currentRecord?.threatScore || totalScore), true, maxLevel);
      threat.blocked = true;
      pushAlert(tenantId, 'cyber', 'IP_AUTO_BLOCKED', { ip, score: currentRecord?.threatScore, level: maxLevel });
    }

    // Timeline record — permanent
    recordEvent({
      tenantId, entityType: 'IP', entityId: ip,
      action: 'THREAT_DETECTED', module: 'cyberModule',
      before: { score: (currentRecord?.threatScore || 0) - totalScore },
      after:  { score: currentRecord?.threatScore || totalScore, level: maxLevel },
      meta:   { signatures: hits.map(h => h.id), labels },
    });

    return threat;
  }

  // ── IP MANAGEMENT ─────────────────────────────────────

  public blockIP(tenantId: string, ip: string, reason: string, auto: boolean, level: ThreatLevel): void {
    const expiry = new Date(Date.now() + CFG.BLOCK_DURATION_MS).toISOString();
    const block: BlockedIP = {
      ip, reason, autoBlocked: auto, threatLevel: level, tenantId,
      blockedAt: new Date().toISOString(), blockExpiresAt: expiry,
    };
    this.getBlockedStore(tenantId).set(ip, block);
    eventBus.publish('cyber.ip.blocked', 'CyberModule', { tenantId, ip, reason, level });
    logger.warn(`[CYBER] ${tenantId} blocked IP: ${ip} | ${reason}`);
  }

  public unblockIP(tenantId: string, ip: string, operatorId: string): void {
    this.getBlockedStore(tenantId).delete(ip);
    // Audit the reversal — permanent record
    auditLog({ tenantId, userId: operatorId, action: 'IP_UNBLOCKED', module: 'cyberModule', input: { ip }, result: 'REVERSED', severity: 'WARN' });
    recordEvent({ tenantId, entityType: 'IP', entityId: ip, action: 'UNBLOCKED', module: 'cyberModule', before: { blocked: true }, after: { blocked: false }, meta: { operatorId } });
    eventBus.publish('cyber.ip.unblocked', 'CyberModule', { tenantId, ip, operatorId });
    logger.info(`[CYBER] ${tenantId} unblocked IP: ${ip} by ${operatorId}`);
  }

  public isBlocked(tenantId: string, ip: string): boolean {
    const block: BlockedIP = this.getBlockedStore(tenantId).get(ip);
    if (!block) return false;
    if (block.blockExpiresAt && new Date() > new Date(block.blockExpiresAt)) {
      this.getBlockedStore(tenantId).delete(ip);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  public getHighThreatIPs(tenantId: string, minScore = 50): ThreatRecord[] {
    return this.getScoreStore(tenantId).filter((r: any) => r.threatScore >= minScore) as ThreatRecord[];
  }

  public getThreatRecord(tenantId: string, ip: string): ThreatRecord | null {
    return this.getScoreStore(tenantId).get(ip) || null;
  }

  // ── INCIDENT REPORT ───────────────────────────────────

  public generateIncidentReport(tenantId: string, periodHours = 24): IncidentReport {
    const since = Date.now() - periodHours * 3_600_000;
    const threats = this.getThreatStore(tenantId).filter((t: any) =>
      new Date(t.timestamp).getTime() > since
    ) as ThreatEvent[];

    const blocked     = this.getBlockedStore(tenantId).filter(() => true) as BlockedIP[];
    const typeCount: Record<string, number> = {};
    const ipCount:   Record<string, number> = {};

    for (const t of threats) {
      typeCount[t.type] = (typeCount[t.type] || 0) + 1;
      ipCount[t.source] = (ipCount[t.source] || 0) + 1;
    }

    const topAttackerIPs = Object.entries(ipCount)
      .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 10).map(([ip]) => ip);

    const recommendations: string[] = [];
    if (threats.filter(t => t.level === 'CRITICAL').length > 5)
      recommendations.push('Enable geo-blocking for high-risk regions');
    if (Object.keys(ipCount).length > 20)
      recommendations.push('Consider enabling CAPTCHA on login endpoints');
    if (typeCount['RATE_LIMIT'] > 10)
      recommendations.push('Review rate limit thresholds — possible DDoS');

    const report: IncidentReport = {
      id:            'INC_' + Date.now(),
      tenantId,
      generatedAt:   new Date().toISOString(),
      period:        periodHours + 'h',
      totalThreats:  threats.length,
      blockedIPs:    blocked.length,
      criticalEvents: threats.filter(t => t.level === 'CRITICAL').length,
      topAttackTypes: typeCount,
      topAttackerIPs,
      recommendations,
    };

    auditLog({ tenantId, userId: 'system', action: 'INCIDENT_REPORT', module: 'cyberModule', input: { periodHours }, result: { totalThreats: report.totalThreats }, severity: 'INFO' });
    return report;
  }

  // ── STATS ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  public getStats(tenantId: string) {
    const day   = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const stats = this.getStatsStore(tenantId).get(day) || { total: 0, methods: {} };
    const blocked = this.getBlockedStore(tenantId).filter(() => true) as BlockedIP[];
    const highThreat = this.getHighThreatIPs(tenantId);
    return { ...stats, blockedIPs: blocked.length, highThreatIPs: highThreat.length, signatures: SIGNATURES.length };
  }

  // ── INTERNALS ─────────────────────────────────────────

  private createThreat(tenantId: string, type: string, level: ThreatLevel, source: string, description: string, blocked: boolean, sigs: string[] = []): ThreatEvent {
    const threat: ThreatEvent = {
      id:          'TR-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7),
      type, level, source, tenantId, description, blocked,
      timestamp:   new Date().toISOString(),
      resolved:    false,
      signatures:  sigs,
      threatScore: this.getScoreStore(tenantId).get(source)?.threatScore || 0,
    };
    const store = this.getThreatStore(tenantId);
    const all   = store.filter(() => true) as ThreatEvent[];
    if (all.length >= CFG.MAX_THREATS) {
      const oldest = all.sort((a, b) => a.timestamp.localeCompare(b.timestamp))[0];
      if (oldest) store.delete(oldest.id);
    }
    store.set(threat.id, threat);
    logger.warn('[CYBER] ' + tenantId + ' | ' + level + ' threat from ' + source + ': ' + type);
    return threat;
  }

  private incrementThreatScore(tenantId: string, ip: string, score: number, tags: string[]): void {
    const store  = this.getScoreStore(tenantId);
    const record: ThreatRecord = store.get(ip) as any || {
      ip, tenantId, firstSeen: new Date().toISOString(),
      lastSeen: new Date().toISOString(), requestCount: 0, threatScore: 0, tags: [],
    };
    record.threatScore  = Math.min(100, record.threatScore + score);
    record.tags         = [...new Set([...record.tags, ...tags])];
    record.lastSeen     = new Date().toISOString();
    record.requestCount++;
    store.set(ip, record);
  }

  private handleThreatEscalation(tenantId: string, threat: ThreatEvent): void {
    eventBus.publish('cyber.threat.detected', 'CyberModule', threat);
    pushAlert(tenantId, 'cyber', 'THREAT_DETECTED', threat);
    if (threat.level === 'CRITICAL') {
      eventBus.publish('cyber.threat.critical', 'CyberModule', threat);
      pushAlert(tenantId, 'cyber', 'CRITICAL_THREAT', threat);
    }
  }

  private getHighestLevel(hits: Signature[]): ThreatLevel {
    const w: Record<ThreatLevel, number> = { LOW: 1, MEDIUM: 2, HIGH: 3, CRITICAL: 4 };
    return hits.reduce((prev, curr) => w[curr.level] > w[prev.level] ? curr : prev, hits[0]).level;
  }

  private updateStats(tenantId: string, method: string): void {
    const store = this.getStatsStore(tenantId);
    const day   = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const data  = store.get(day) as any || { total: 0, methods: {} };
    data.total++;
    data.methods[method] = (data.methods[method] || 0) + 1;
    store.set(day, data);
  }

  // ── HEALTH CHECK ──────────────────────────────────────

  public registerHealth(): void {
    registerModule('cyberModule', async () => ({
      status:  'ALIVE' as const,
      message: 'Signatures: ' + SIGNATURES.length,
      meta:    { signatures: SIGNATURES.length },
    }));
  }

  // ── AUTOMATION RULES ──────────────────────────────────

  public registerRules(): void {
    automationEngine.registerRule({
      id: 'cyber.auto_mitigation', name: 'Active Threat Mitigation',
      description: 'Auto-reacts to security events based on risk scoring',
      enabled: true, risk: 'HIGH', requiresApproval: false,
      trigger: { type: 'api_request', condition: (input) => !!input.ip && !!input.tenantId },
      action: async (input) => {
        const result = await this.autoScan(input.tenantId, input.ip, input.path, input.method, input.headers, input.body);
        return { processed: true, ...result, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
      },
    });
    logger.info('CyberModule rules registered');
  }
}

export const cyberModule = new UBECyberModule();

cyberModule.registerHealth();

cyberModule.registerHealth();
