import path from 'path';
import fs from 'fs';
import crypto from 'crypto';
import os from 'os';
import { getStore } from '../core/database';
import { checkRateLimit } from '../core/rateLimiter';
import { idempotentExec } from '../core/idempotency';
import { pushAlert } from '../core/realtimePush';
import { recordEvent } from '../core/eventTimeline';
import { auditLog } from '../core/auditLog';
import { assertTenantAccess } from '../core/tenantManager';
import { registerModule } from '../core/healthMonitor';

const IS_TERMUX  = !!process.env.TERMUX_VERSION || fs.existsSync('/data/data/com.termux');
const IS_DOCKER  = fs.existsSync('/.dockerenv');
const IS_WINDOWS = os.platform() === 'win32';

function getBaseDir(): string {
  if (process.env.UBE_STORAGE_ROOT) return process.env.UBE_STORAGE_ROOT;
  if (IS_DOCKER && fs.existsSync('/data')) return '/data/UBE_storage';
  return path.join(os.homedir(), 'UBE_storage');
}

const BASE_DIR        = getBaseDir();
const UPLOAD_ROOT     = path.join(BASE_DIR, 'uploads');
const QUARANTINE_ROOT = path.join(BASE_DIR, 'quarantine');
const MAX_FILE_SIZE        = parseInt(process.env.UBE_MAX_FILE_MB   ?? '100') * 1024 * 1024;
const LARGE_FILE_THRESHOLD = parseInt(process.env.UBE_LARGE_FILE_MB ?? '50')  * 1024 * 1024;

const FORBIDDEN_ROOTS = IS_WINDOWS
  ? ['C:\\Windows','C:\\System32','C:\\Program Files']
  : ['/etc','/proc','/sys','/dev','/bin','/sbin','/usr/bin','/usr/sbin','/boot','/root','/var'];

const BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS = new Set([
  '.exe','.sh','.bat','.cmd','.com','.msi','.vbs','.ps1',
  '.dll','.so','.dylib','.bin','.run','.app','.jar','.war',
  '.py','.rb','.pl','.php','.cgi','.htaccess','.pif','.scr',
]);

const SIGNATURES: Array<{ name: string; pattern: string }> = [
  { name: 'EICAR_TEST',      pattern: 'X5O!P%@AP[4\\PZX54(P^)7CC)7}$EICAR' },
  { name: 'PHP_WEBSHELL',    pattern: '<?php system(' },
  { name: 'PHP_EVAL_SHELL',  pattern: '<?php eval(' },
  { name: 'PHP_EXEC_SHELL',  pattern: '<?php exec(' },
  { name: 'REVERSE_SHELL',   pattern: '/bin/bash -i >& /dev/tcp/' },
  { name: 'PYTHON_BIND',     pattern: 'import socket,subprocess,os' },
  { name: 'POWERSHELL_ENC',  pattern: 'powershell -enc' },
  { name: 'MSFVENOM_MARKER', pattern: 'msfvenom' },
];

export interface FileRecord {
  id: string; tenantId: string; originalName: string; storedName: string;
  path: string; size: number; mimeType: string; extension: string;
  checksum: string; status: 'active' | 'quarantined' | 'deleted';
  uploadedAt: string; deletedAt?: string; scanResult?: ScanResult; requestId?: string;
  platform?: string;
}

export interface ScanResult {
  clean: boolean; threats: string[]; scannedAt: string; engine: string;
}

export interface AnalyzeResult {
  fileId: string; checksum: string; size: number; extension: string;
  mimeType: string; scanResult: ScanResult; quarantined: boolean;
}

export interface StorageStats {
  totalFiles: number; activeCount: number; activeBytes: number;
  quarantinedCount: number; deletedCount: number; storageRoot: string;
}

function assertSandboxed(filePath: string): void {
  const resolved = path.resolve(filePath);
  for (const forbidden of FORBIDDEN_ROOTS) {
    if (resolved === forbidden || resolved.startsWith(forbidden + path.sep))
      throw new Error(`SANDBOX_VIOLATION: access to "${forbidden}" is forbidden`);
  }
  const inUploads    = resolved.startsWith(UPLOAD_ROOT + path.sep)    || resolved === UPLOAD_ROOT;
  const inQuarantine = resolved.startsWith(QUARANTINE_ROOT + path.sep) || resolved === QUARANTINE_ROOT;
  if (!inUploads && !inQuarantine)
    throw new Error(`SANDBOX_VIOLATION: path must be within UBE managed directories`);
}

const tenantUploadDir     = (t: string) => path.join(UPLOAD_ROOT,     t);
const tenantQuarantineDir = (t: string) => path.join(QUARANTINE_ROOT, t);

function ensureDir(dir: string): void {
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
}

function computeChecksum(buf: Buffer): string {
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buf).digest('hex');
}

function detectMime(buf: Buffer, ext: string): string {
  const h = buf.slice(0, 8);
  if (h[0] === 0xFF && h[1] === 0xD8) return 'image/jpeg';
  if (h.slice(0,4).toString('hex') === '89504e47') return 'image/png';
  if (h.slice(0,4).toString('ascii') === '%PDF') return 'application/pdf';
  if (h[0] === 0x50 && h[1] === 0x4B) return 'application/zip';
  if (h[0] === 0x7F && h.slice(1,4).toString() === 'ELF') return 'application/x-elf';
  if (h[0] === 0x4D && h[1] === 0x5A) return 'application/x-msdownload';
  const map: Record<string,string> = {
    '.txt':'text/plain','.json':'application/json','.csv':'text/csv',
    '.xml':'application/xml','.md':'text/markdown','.html':'text/html',
  };
  return map[ext] ?? 'application/octet-stream';
}

function scanBuffer(buf: Buffer, filename: string): ScanResult {
  const threats: string[] = [];
  const ext  = path.extname(filename).toLowerCase();
  const head = buf.toString('utf8', 0, Math.min(buf.length, 8192));
  if (BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)) threats.push(`BLOCKED_EXTENSION:${ext}`);
  for (const sig of SIGNATURES) {
    if (head.includes(sig.pattern)) threats.push(sig.name);
  }
  if (buf[0] === 0x7F && buf[1] === 0x45) threats.push('ELF_BINARY_HEADER');
  if (buf[0] === 0x4D && buf[1] === 0x5A) threats.push('MZ_BINARY_HEADER');
  return { clean: threats.length === 0, threats, scannedAt: new Date().toISOString(), engine: 'UBE-AV-v1' };
}

const storeKey = (tenantId: string, fileId: string) => `file_${tenantId}_${fileId}`;

registerModule('fileModule', async () => {
  const uploadsOk    = fs.existsSync(UPLOAD_ROOT);
  const quarantineOk = fs.existsSync(QUARANTINE_ROOT);
  if (uploadsOk && quarantineOk) return { status: 'ALIVE',    detail: `Storage OK: ${BASE_DIR}` };
  if (!uploadsOk)                return { status: 'DEGRADED', detail: `Upload dir missing: ${UPLOAD_ROOT}` };
  return { status: 'DEGRADED', detail: `Quarantine dir missing: ${QUARANTINE_ROOT}` };
});

ensureDir(UPLOAD_ROOT);
ensureDir(QUARANTINE_ROOT);
recordEvent({ tenantId: 'system', entityType: 'fileModule', entityId: 'init', action: 'INITIALIZED', module: 'fileModule', before: null, after: { platform: os.platform(), baseDir: BASE_DIR, isTermux: IS_TERMUX, isDocker: IS_DOCKER }, meta: {} });

export async function uploadFile(
  tenantId: string, filename: string, buffer: Buffer, requestId: string,
): Promise<FileRecord> {
  assertTenantAccess(tenantId, tenantId);
  return (await idempotentExec(tenantId, 'system', requestId, async () => {
    if (buffer.length > MAX_FILE_SIZE)
      throw new Error(`FILE_TOO_LARGE: max ${MAX_FILE_SIZE / 1024 / 1024} MB`);
    const ext      = path.extname(filename).toLowerCase();
    const checksum = computeChecksum(buffer);
    const store    = getStore(`file_meta_${tenantId}`);
    const dupes    = store.filter((r: FileRecord) => r.checksum === checksum && r.status === 'active');
    if (dupes.length > 0) {
      auditLog({ action: 'FILE_UPLOAD_DEDUP', tenantId, userId: 'system', module: 'fileModule', input: { checksum, filename }, result: 'ok', severity: 'INFO' });
      recordEvent({ tenantId, entityType: 'file', entityId: dupes[0].id, action: 'DEDUP_SKIPPED', module: 'fileModule', before: null, after: { filename, checksum }, meta: {} });
      return dupes[0] as FileRecord;
    }
    const fileId     = crypto.randomUUID();
    const storedName = `${fileId}${ext}`;
    const scanResult = scanBuffer(buffer, filename);
    const platform   = `${os.platform()}/${IS_TERMUX ? 'termux' : IS_DOCKER ? 'docker' : 'native'}`;
    if (!scanResult.clean) {
      const qDir  = tenantQuarantineDir(tenantId);
      const qPath = path.join(qDir, storedName);
      ensureDir(qDir);
      assertSandboxed(qPath);
      fs.writeFileSync(qPath, buffer, { mode: 0o600 });
      const record: FileRecord = {
        id: fileId, tenantId, originalName: filename, storedName, path: qPath,
        size: buffer.length, mimeType: detectMime(buffer, ext), extension: ext,
        checksum, status: 'quarantined', uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        scanResult, requestId, platform,
      };
      store.set(storeKey(tenantId, fileId), record);
      auditLog({ action: 'FILE_QUARANTINED', tenantId, userId: 'system', module: 'fileModule', input: { fileId, filename, threats: scanResult.threats, platform }, result: 'ok', severity: 'ERROR' });
      recordEvent({ tenantId, entityType: 'file', entityId: fileId, action: 'QUARANTINED', module: 'fileModule', before: null, after: { threats: scanResult.threats, platform }, meta: {} });
      pushAlert(tenantId, 'file', 'FILE_QUARANTINED', { fileId, filename, threats: scanResult.threats, severity: 'ERROR' });
      return record;
    }
    const upDir  = tenantUploadDir(tenantId);
    const upPath = path.join(upDir, storedName);
    ensureDir(upDir);
    assertSandboxed(upPath);
    fs.writeFileSync(upPath, buffer, { mode: 0o600 });
    if (buffer.length > LARGE_FILE_THRESHOLD) {
      const mb = (buffer.length / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2);
      pushAlert(tenantId, 'file', 'LARGE_FILE_UPLOADED', { fileId, filename, sizeMB: mb });
      auditLog({ action: 'FILE_LARGE_UPLOAD', tenantId, userId: 'system', module: 'fileModule', input: { fileId, filename, size: buffer.length }, result: 'ok', severity: 'WARN' });
    }
    const record: FileRecord = {
      id: fileId, tenantId, originalName: filename, storedName, path: upPath,
      size: buffer.length, mimeType: detectMime(buffer, ext), extension: ext,
      checksum, status: 'active', uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      scanResult, requestId, platform,
    };
    store.set(storeKey(tenantId, fileId), record);
    auditLog({ action: 'FILE_UPLOADED', tenantId, userId: 'system', module: 'fileModule', input: { fileId, filename, size: buffer.length, checksum, platform }, result: 'ok', severity: 'INFO' });
    recordEvent({ tenantId, entityType: 'file', entityId: fileId, action: 'UPLOADED', module: 'fileModule', before: null, after: { filename, size: buffer.length, platform }, meta: {} });
    return record;
  })).result as FileRecord;
}

export function getFile(tenantId: string, fileId: string): FileRecord {
  assertTenantAccess(tenantId, tenantId);
  const store  = getStore(`file_meta_${tenantId}`);
  const record = store.get(storeKey(tenantId, fileId) as any) as FileRecord | undefined;
  if (!record) throw new Error(`FILE_NOT_FOUND: ${fileId}`);
  return record;
}

export function readFile(tenantId: string, fileId: string): Buffer {
  assertTenantAccess(tenantId, tenantId);
  const record = getFile(tenantId, fileId);
  if (record.status !== 'active') throw new Error(`FILE_NOT_READABLE: status=${record.status}`);
  assertSandboxed(record.path);
  auditLog({ action: 'FILE_READ', tenantId, userId: 'system', module: 'fileModule', input: { fileId, filename: record.originalName }, result: 'ok', severity: 'INFO' });
  recordEvent({ tenantId, entityType: 'file', entityId: fileId, action: 'READ', module: 'fileModule', before: null, after: { filename: record.originalName }, meta: {} });
  return fs.readFileSync(record.path);
}

export function listFiles(tenantId: string, statusFilter?: FileRecord['status']): FileRecord[] {
  assertTenantAccess(tenantId, tenantId);
  const store = getStore(`file_meta_${tenantId}`);
  const all   = store.filter((r: FileRecord) => r.tenantId === tenantId) as FileRecord[];
  return statusFilter ? all.filter(r => r.status === statusFilter) : all;
}

export function deleteFile(tenantId: string, fileId: string): void {
  assertTenantAccess(tenantId, tenantId);
  const store  = getStore(`file_meta_${tenantId}`);
  const record = store.get(storeKey(tenantId, fileId) as any) as FileRecord | undefined;
  if (!record)                     throw new Error(`FILE_NOT_FOUND: ${fileId}`);
  if (record.status === 'deleted') throw new Error(`FILE_ALREADY_DELETED: ${fileId}`);
  if (fs.existsSync(record.path)) { assertSandboxed(record.path); fs.unlinkSync(record.path); }
  store.set(storeKey(tenantId, fileId), { ...record, status: 'deleted', deletedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
  auditLog({ action: 'FILE_DELETED', tenantId, userId: 'system', module: 'fileModule', input: { fileId, filename: record.originalName }, result: 'ok', severity: 'INFO' });
  recordEvent({ tenantId, entityType: 'file', entityId: fileId, action: 'DELETED', module: 'fileModule', before: null, after: { filename: record.originalName }, meta: {} });
}

export function analyzeFile(tenantId: string, fileId: string): AnalyzeResult {
  assertTenantAccess(tenantId, tenantId);
  const store  = getStore(`file_meta_${tenantId}`);
  const record = store.get(storeKey(tenantId, fileId) as any) as FileRecord | undefined;
  if (!record)                     throw new Error(`FILE_NOT_FOUND: ${fileId}`);
  if (record.status === 'deleted') throw new Error(`FILE_DELETED: ${fileId}`);
  assertSandboxed(record.path);
  const buffer     = fs.readFileSync(record.path);
  const scanResult = scanBuffer(buffer, record.originalName);
  if (!scanResult.clean && record.status === 'active') {
    const qDir  = tenantQuarantineDir(tenantId);
    const qPath = path.join(qDir, record.storedName);
    ensureDir(qDir);
    assertSandboxed(qPath);
    fs.renameSync(record.path, qPath);
    store.set(storeKey(tenantId, fileId), { ...record, status: 'quarantined', path: qPath, scanResult });
    auditLog({ action: 'FILE_QUARANTINED_ON_RESCAN', tenantId, userId: 'system', module: 'fileModule', input: { fileId, threats: scanResult.threats }, result: 'ok', severity: 'ERROR' });
    pushAlert(tenantId, 'file', 'FILE_QUARANTINED', { fileId, threats: scanResult.threats, severity: 'ERROR', trigger: 'RESCAN' });
  } else {
    store.set(storeKey(tenantId, fileId), { ...record, scanResult });
  }
  auditLog({ action: 'FILE_ANALYZED', tenantId, userId: 'system', module: 'fileModule', input: { fileId, clean: scanResult.clean, threats: scanResult.threats }, result: 'ok', severity: 'INFO' });
  recordEvent({ tenantId, entityType: 'file', entityId: fileId, action: 'ANALYZED', module: 'fileModule', before: null, after: { clean: scanResult.clean }, meta: {} });
  return {
    fileId, checksum: record.checksum, size: record.size, extension: record.extension,
    mimeType: record.mimeType, scanResult, quarantined: record.status === 'quarantined',
  };
}

export function releaseFromQuarantine(tenantId: string, fileId: string): FileRecord {
  assertTenantAccess(tenantId, tenantId);
  const store  = getStore(`file_meta_${tenantId}`);
  const record = store.get(storeKey(tenantId, fileId) as any) as FileRecord | undefined;
  if (!record) throw new Error(`FILE_NOT_FOUND: ${fileId}`);
  if (record.status !== 'quarantined') throw new Error(`FILE_NOT_QUARANTINED: ${fileId}`);
  const upDir  = tenantUploadDir(tenantId);
  const upPath = path.join(upDir, record.storedName);
  ensureDir(upDir);
  assertSandboxed(upPath);
  fs.renameSync(record.path, upPath);
  const updated = { ...record, status: 'active' as const, path: upPath };
  store.set(storeKey(tenantId, fileId), updated);
  auditLog({ action: 'FILE_RELEASED', tenantId, userId: 'system', module: 'fileModule', input: { fileId }, result: 'ok', severity: 'INFO' });
  recordEvent({ tenantId, entityType: 'file', entityId: fileId, action: 'RELEASED', module: 'fileModule', before: null, after: { path: upPath }, meta: {} });
  return updated;
}

export function storageStats(tenantId: string): StorageStats {
  assertTenantAccess(tenantId, tenantId);
  const store = getStore(`file_meta_${tenantId}`);
  const all   = store.filter((r: FileRecord) => r.tenantId === tenantId) as FileRecord[];
  const active      = all.filter(r => r.status === 'active');
  const quarantined = all.filter(r => r.status === 'quarantined');
  const deleted     = all.filter(r => r.status === 'deleted');
  return {
    totalFiles: all.length, activeCount: active.length,
    activeBytes: active.reduce((s, r) => s + r.size, 0),
    quarantinedCount: quarantined.length, deletedCount: deleted.length,
    storageRoot: BASE_DIR,
  };
}

// ── FILE WATCHER ─────────────────────────────────────
let _watcher: any = null;
import os2 = require('os');
const WATCH_DIR = process.env.UBE_WATCH_DIR ?? require('path').join(os2.homedir(), 'UBE_watch');

export interface WatchAnalysis {
  name: string; size: number; ext: string;
  wordCount: number; lineCount: number; topWords: string[];
  type: string; threats: string[]; clean: boolean;
}

export function startWatcher(
  callback: (analysis: WatchAnalysis, risk: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL') => Promise<void>
): void {
  ensureDir(WATCH_DIR);
  if (_watcher) return;
  _watcher = fs.watch(WATCH_DIR, async (event: string, filename: string | null) => {
    if (!filename || event !== 'rename') return;
    const filePath = path.join(WATCH_DIR, filename);
    setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return;
        const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
        if (!stat.isFile()) return;
        const buffer = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
        const ext    = path.extname(filename).toLowerCase();
        const scan   = scanBuffer(buffer, filename);
        const words  = buffer.toString('utf8').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        const lines  = buffer.toString('utf8').split('\n');
        const freq   = new Map<string, number>();
        for (const w of words) freq.set(w, (freq.get(w) ?? 0) + 1);
        const topWords = [...freq.entries()].sort((a,b) => b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,10).map(e => e[0]);
        const analysis: WatchAnalysis = {
          name: filename, size: stat.size, ext,
          wordCount: words.length, lineCount: lines.length,
          topWords, type: detectMime(buffer, ext),
          threats: scan.threats, clean: scan.clean,
        };
        const risk: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL' =
          !scan.clean            ? 'CRITICAL' :
          stat.size > 10_000_000 ? 'HIGH'     :
          stat.size > 1_000_000  ? 'MEDIUM'   : 'LOW';
        await callback(analysis, risk);
        const dest = path.join(UPLOAD_ROOT, 'watched');
        ensureDir(dest);
        try { fs.renameSync(filePath, path.join(dest, filename)); } catch(_) {}
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('[WATCHER] Error processing', filename, e);
      }
    }, 500);
  });
  console.log('[WATCHER] Watching:', WATCH_DIR);
}

export function stopWatcher(): void {
  if (_watcher) { _watcher.close(); _watcher = null; }
  console.log('[WATCHER] Stopped');
}

TIMEZONE_MAP = {
    "UTC":0,"GMT":0,"Europe/London":0,"Europe/Paris":1,
    "Europe/Berlin":1,"Europe/Moscow":3,"Asia/Kolkata":5.5,
    "Asia/Dubai":4,"Asia/Singapore":8,"Asia/Tokyo":9,
    "Asia/Shanghai":8,"Asia/Seoul":9,"Asia/Bangkok":7,
    "Asia/Karachi":5,"Asia/Dhaka":6,"Asia/Colombo":5.5,
    "Asia/Kathmandu":5.75,"Asia/Kabul":4.5,"Africa/Cairo":2,

    "America/New_York":-5,"America/Chicago":-6,"America/Denver":-7,
    "America/Los_Angeles":-8,"America/Toronto":-5,"America/Vancouver":-8,
    "America/Sao_Paulo":-3,"America/Mexico_City":-6,
    "America/Buenos_Aires":-3,"America/Bogota":-5,
    "Australia/Sydney":10,"Australia/Melbourne":10,
    "Australia/Perth":8,"Pacific/Auckland":12,"Pacific/Honolulu":-10,
}

COUNTRY_TIMEZONE = {
    "IN":"Asia/Kolkata","US":"America/New_York","GB":"Europe/London",
    "DE":"Europe/Berlin","FR":"Europe/Paris","RU":"Europe/Moscow",
    "CN":"Asia/Shanghai","JP":"Asia/Tokyo","AU":"Australia/Sydney",
    "CA":"America/Toronto","BR":"America/Sao_Paulo","AE":"Asia/Dubai",
    "SG":"Asia/Singapore","KR":"Asia/Seoul","TH":"Asia/Bangkok",
    "PK":"Asia/Karachi","BD":"Asia/Dhaka","LK":"Asia/Colombo",
    "NP":"Asia/Kathmandu","ZA":"Africa/Johannesburg","EG":"Africa/Cairo",
    "NG":"Africa/Lagos","KE":"Africa/Nairobi","NZ":"Pacific/Auckland",
    "MX":"America/Mexico_City","AR":"America/Buenos_Aires","CO":"America/Bogota",
}

class TimezoneEngine:
    def __init__(self,use_live_api=True):
        self.use_live_api=use_live_api
        self._api_base="http://worldtimeapi.org/api"

    def now(self,timezone="UTC"):
        if self.use_live_api:
            try:
                r=requests.get(f"{self._api_base}/timezone/{timezone}",timeout=5)
                if r.status_code==200:
                    d=r.json()
                    return {"success":True,"timezone":timezone,"datetime":d.get("datetime"),
                            "utc_offset":d.get("utc_offset"),"source":"live"}
            except:pass
        offset=TIMEZONE_MAP.get(timezone,0)
        t=datetime.datetime.utcnow()+datetime.timedelta(hours=offset)
        return {"success":True,"timezone":timezone,"datetime":t.isoformat(),
                "utc_offset":offset,"source":"calculated"}

    def convert(self,datetime_str,from_tz,to_tz):
        try:
            dt=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(datetime_str)
            diff=datetime.timedelta(hours=(TIMEZONE_MAP.get(to_tz,0)-TIMEZONE_MAP.get(from_tz,0)))
            return {"success":True,"original":datetime_str,"from_timezone":from_tz,
                    "to_timezone":to_tz,"converted":(dt+diff).isoformat()}
        except Exception as e:return{"success":False,"error":str(e)}

    def from_country(self,code):
        tz=COUNTRY_TIMEZONE.get(code.upper())
        if not tz:return{"success":False,"error":f"Unknown:{code}"}
        return{"success":True,"country":code.upper(),"timezone":tz,**self.now(tz)}

    def difference(self,tz1,tz2):
        diff=TIMEZONE_MAP.get(tz2,0)-TIMEZONE_MAP.get(tz1,0)
        return{"success":True,"from":tz1,"to":tz2,"difference_hours":diff,
               "description":f"{tz2} is {'ahead' if diff>0 else 'behind'} {tz1} by {abs(diff)}h"}

    def list_all(self):
        return{"success":True,"timezones":list(TIMEZONE_MAP.keys()),"count":len(TIMEZONE_MAP)}

class CurrencyEngine:
    def __init__(self):
        self._api="https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest"
        self._cache={}

    def _fetch_rates(self,base="USD"):
        base=base.upper()
        if base in self._cache:return self._cache[base]
        try:
            r=requests.get(f"{self._api}/{base}",timeout=6)
            if r.status_code==200:
                d=r.json()
                if d.get("result")=="success":
                    self._cache[base]=d["rates"];return d["rates"]
        except:pass
        if base=="USD":return FALLBACK_RATES_USD
        b=FALLBACK_RATES_USD.get(base,1.0)
        return{k:round(v/b,6) for k,v in FALLBACK_RATES_USD.items()}

    def convert(self,amount,from_c,to_c):
        from_c=from_c.upper();to_c=to_c.upper()
        rates=self._fetch_rates(from_c)
        if to_c not in rates:return{"success":False,"error":f"Unknown:{to_c}"}
        rate=rates[to_c];result=round(amount*rate,4)
        sym=CURRENCY_META.get(to_c,{}).get("symbol",to_c)
        return{"success":True,"from":from_c,"to":to_c,"amount":amount,
               "rate":rate,"converted":result,"formatted":f"{sym}{result:,.2f}"}

    def convert_to_many(self,amount,from_c,to_list):
        return{"success":True,"from":from_c.upper(),"amount":amount,
               "conversions":{c:self.convert(amount,from_c,c).get("converted") for c in to_list}}

    def rates(self,base="USD"):
        r=self._fetch_rates(base.upper())
        return{"success":True,"base":base.upper(),"rates":r,"count":len(r)}

    def info(self,code):
        code=code.upper();m=CURRENCY_META.get(code)
        if not m:return{"success":False,"error":f"Unknown:{code}"}
        return{"success":True,"code":code,**m}

    def format(self,amount,code):
        sym=CURRENCY_META.get(code.upper(),{}).get("symbol",code)
        return f"{sym}{amount:,.2f}"

    def list_all(self):
        return{"success":True,"count":len(CURRENCY_META),
               "currencies":[{"code":k,**v} for k,v in CURRENCY_META.items()]}

class CountryEngine:
    def __init__(self,use_live_api=True):
        self.use_live_api=use_live_api
        self._api="https://restcountries.com/v3.1"

    def get(self,code):
        code=code.upper()
        d=COUNTRIES.get(code)
        if not d:
            if self.use_live_api:return self._live(f"alpha/{code}")
            return{"success":False,"error":f"Unknown:{code}"}
        return{"success":True,"code":code,**d}

    def search(self,name):
        n=name.lower()
        r=[{"code":k,**v} for k,v in COUNTRIES.items() if n in v["name"].lower()]
        return{"success":True,"results":r,"count":len(r)}

    def by_continent(self,continent):
        r=[{"code":k,**v} for k,v in COUNTRIES.items() if v["continent"].lower()==continent.lower()]
        return{"success":True,"continent":continent,"countries":r,"count":len(r)}

    def by_region(self,region):
        r=[{"code":k,**v} for k,v in COUNTRIES.items() if region.lower() in v["region"].lower()]
        return{"success":True,"region":region,"countries":r,"count":len(r)}

    def by_currency(self,currency):
        r=[{"code":k,**v} for k,v in COUNTRIES.items() if v["currency"]==currency.upper()]
        return{"success":True,"currency":currency.upper(),"countries":r,"count":len(r)}

    def neighbours(self,code):
        c=COUNTRIES.get(code.upper())
        if not c:return{"success":False,"error":f"Unknown:{code}"}
        b=[{"code":b,"name":COUNTRIES[b]["name"],"flag":COUNTRIES[b]["flag"]}
           for b in c.get("borders",[]) if b in COUNTRIES]
        return{"success":True,"country":c["name"],"borders":b,"count":len(b)}

    def list_all(self):
        return{"success":True,"count":len(COUNTRIES),
               "countries":[{"code":k,"name":v["name"],"flag":v["flag"],
                             "continent":v["continent"]} for k,v in COUNTRIES.items()]}

    def _live(self,endpoint):
        try:
            r=requests.get(f"{self._api}/{endpoint}",timeout=6)
            if r.status_code==200:
                d=r.json()
                if isinstance(d,list) and d:
                    c=d[0]
                    return{"success":True,"name":c.get("name",{}).get("common"),
                           "capital":c.get("capital",[""])[0],"region":c.get("region"),
                           "population":c.get("population"),"source":"live"}
        except Exception as e:return{"success":False,"error":str(e)}
        return{"success":False,"error":"Not found"}

class LanguageEngine:
    def info(self,code):
        d=LANGUAGES.get(code.lower())
        if not d:return{"success":False,"error":f"Unknown:{code}"}
        return{"success":True,"code":code.lower(),**d}

    def detect(self,text):
        if not text:return{"success":False,"error":"Empty"}
        for char in text[:50]:
            cp=ord(char)
            for (lo,hi),lang in SCRIPT_HINTS.items():
                if lo<=cp<=hi:
                    return{"success":True,"detected":lang,
                           "language":LANGUAGES.get(lang,{}).get("name",lang),
                           "confidence":"script-based"}
        return{"success":True,"detected":"en","language":"English","confidence":"fallback"}

    def top_by_speakers(self,limit=10):
        s=sorted(LANGUAGES.items(),key=lambda x:x[1]["speakers"],reverse=True)
        return{"success":True,"top":[{"code":k,"name":v["name"],"speakers":v["speakers"]}
                                      for k,v in s[:limit]]}

    def list_all(self):
        return{"success":True,"count":len(LANGUAGES),
               "languages":[{"code":k,"name":v["name"],"native":v["native"],
                             "speakers":v["speakers"]} for k,v in LANGUAGES.items()]}

--- FILE: src/modules/global_data/geo.py ---
import requests,math

class GeoEngine:
    def __init__(self):
        self._ip_api="http://ip-api.com/json"
        self._geo_api="https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search"
        self._rev_api="https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse"

    def from_ip(self,ip=""):
        try:
            url=f"{self._ip_api}/{ip}" if ip else self._ip_api
            r=requests.get(url,timeout=5)
            if r.status_code==200:
                d=r.json()
                if d.get("status")=="success":
                    return{"success":True,"ip":d.get("query"),"country":d.get("country"),
                           "country_code":d.get("countryCode"),"region":d.get("regionName"),
                           "city":d.get("city"),"lat":d.get("lat"),"lon":d.get("lon"),
                           "timezone":d.get("timezone"),"isp":d.get("isp")}
        except Exception as e:return{"success":False,"error":str(e)}
        return{"success":False,"error":"IP lookup failed"}

    def geocode(self,location):
        try:
            r=requests.get(self._geo_api,
                params={"q":location,"format":"json","limit":1},
                headers={"User-Agent":"GlobalDataEngine/1.0"},timeout=6)
            if r.status_code==200 and r.json():
                d=r.json()[0]
                return{"success":True,"location":location,
                       "display_name":d.get("display_name"),
                       "lat":float(d.get("lat",0)),"lon":float(d.get("lon",0))}
        except Exception as e:return{"success":False,"error":str(e)}
        return{"success":False,"error":"Not found"}

    def reverse_geocode(self,lat,lon):
        try:
            r=requests.get(self._rev_api,
                params={"lat":lat,"lon":lon,"format":"json"},
                headers={"User-Agent":"GlobalDataEngine/1.0"},timeout=6)
            if r.status_code==200:
                d=r.json();a=d.get("address",{})
                return{"success":True,"lat":lat,"lon":lon,
                       "display_name":d.get("display_name"),
                       "city":a.get("city") or a.get("town") or a.get("village"),
                       "country":a.get("country"),"country_code":a.get("country_code","").upper()}
        except Exception as e:return{"success":False,"error":str(e)}
        return{"success":False,"error":"Failed"}

    def distance(self,lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2,unit="km"):
        R=6371.0
        dlat=math.radians(lat2-lat1);dlon=math.radians(lon2-lon1)
        a=(math.sin(dlat/2)**2+math.cos(math.radians(lat1))*
           math.cos(math.radians(lat2))*math.sin(dlon/2)**2)
        km=R*2*math.atan2(math.sqrt(a),math.sqrt(1-a))
        return{"success":True,"distance_km":round(km,2),
               "distance_miles":round(km*0.621371,2),"unit":unit}

    def distance_between(self,city1,city2):
        g1=self.geocode(city1);g2=self.geocode(city2)
        if not g1["success"]:return{"success":False,"error":f"Cannot find:{city1}"}
        if not g2["success"]:return{"success":False,"error":f"Cannot find:{city2}"}
        r=self.distance(g1["lat"],g1["lon"],g2["lat"],g2["lon"])
        return{**r,"city1":city1,"city2":city2}

from .timezone import TimezoneEngine
from .currency import CurrencyEngine
from .country  import CountryEngine
from .language import LanguageEngine
from .geo      import GeoEngine

class GlobalDataRouter:
    def __init__(self,use_live_api=True):
        self.timezone=TimezoneEngine(use_live_api)
        self.currency=CurrencyEngine()
        self.country=CountryEngine(use_live_api)
        self.language=LanguageEngine()
        self.geo=GeoEngine()
        self._version="1.0.0"

    def health(self):
        return{"module":"Global Data","version":self._version,"status":"online",
               "engines":{"timezone":"ready","currency":"ready","country":"ready",
                          "language":"ready","geo":"ready"}}

    def full_country_profile(self,code):
        c=self.country.get(code)
        if not c["success"]:return c
        tz=self.timezone.from_country(code).get("timezone","UTC")
        curr=c.get("currency")
        return{"success":True,"country":c,"current_time":self.timezone.now(tz),
               "currency_rates":self.currency.rates(curr) if curr else {},
               "neighbours":self.country.neighbours(code).get("borders",[])}

    def ip_profile(self,ip=""):
        geo=self.geo.from_ip(ip)
        if not geo["success"]:return geo
        cc=geo.get("country_code","")
        c=self.country.get(cc) if cc else {}
        tz=geo.get("timezone","UTC")
        curr=c.get("currency")
        rate=self.currency.convert(1,"USD",curr).get("converted") if curr else None
        return{"success":True,"ip":geo.get("ip"),
               "location":{"city":geo.get("city"),"country":geo.get("country"),
                           "lat":geo.get("lat"),"lon":geo.get("lon")},
               "timezone":tz,"current_time":self.timezone.now(tz).get("datetime"),
               "currency":curr,"1_usd_equals":f"{rate} {curr}" if rate else None,
               "flag":c.get("flag"),"isp":geo.get("isp")}

# ============================================================
#  AIR QUALITY ENGINE
#  AQI, pollution levels, UV index, pollen
#  Uses Open-Meteo Air Quality API (free, no key)
# ============================================================

import requests


# AQI level classification
def _aqi_level(aqi: float) -> dict:
    if aqi <= 50:
        return {"level":"Good","color":"green","advice":"Air quality is satisfactory."}
    elif aqi <= 100:
        return {"level":"Moderate","color":"yellow","advice":"Acceptable. Sensitive people should limit outdoor activity."}
    elif aqi <= 150:
        return {"level":"Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups","color":"orange","advice":"Sensitive groups should reduce outdoor activity."}
    elif aqi <= 200:
        return {"level":"Unhealthy","color":"red","advice":"Everyone should reduce prolonged outdoor activity."}
    elif aqi <= 300:
        return {"level":"Very Unhealthy","color":"purple","advice":"Avoid outdoor activity. Health alert."}
    else:
        return {"level":"Hazardous","color":"maroon","advice":"Emergency conditions. Everyone should avoid outdoor activity."}

# UV index classification
def _uv_level(uv: float) -> str:
    if uv < 3:  return "Low"
    if uv < 6:  return "Moderate"
    if uv < 8:  return "High"
    if uv < 11: return "Very High"
    return "Extreme"


class AirQualityEngine:
    """
    Air quality and environmental health data.
    AQI, pollutants, UV index for any location.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self._api     = "https://air-quality-api.open-meteo.com/v1/air-quality"
        self._geo_api = "https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search"

    def _city_coords(self, city: str) -> dict:
        try:
            r = requests.get(self._geo_api,
                params={"name": city, "count": 1},
                timeout=5)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res = r.json().get("results", [])
                if res:
                    return {"success": True, "lat": res[0]["latitude"],
                            "lon": res[0]["longitude"],
                            "name": res[0].get("name"),
                            "country": res[0].get("country")}
        except Exception as e:
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}
        return {"success": False, "error": f"Not found: {city}"}

    # ── Current air quality ──────────────────────────────────
    def current(self, city: str = None,
                lat: float = None, lon: float = None) -> dict:
        """Get current air quality data."""
        if city:
            coords = self._city_coords(city)
            if not coords["success"]: return coords
            lat, lon = coords["lat"], coords["lon"]
            loc = f"{coords.get('name')}, {coords.get('country')}"
        else:
            if lat is None or lon is None:
                return {"success": False, "error": "Provide city or lat/lon"}
            loc = f"{lat},{lon}"
        try:
            r = requests.get(self._api, params={
                "latitude":  lat,
                "longitude": lon,
                "current":   ",".join([
                    "pm10","pm2_5","carbon_monoxide",
                    "nitrogen_dioxide","sulphur_dioxide","ozone",
                    "aerosol_optical_depth","dust",
                    "uv_index","uv_index_clear_sky",
                    "european_aqi","us_aqi",
                ]),
                "timezone": "auto",
            }, timeout=6)

            if r.status_code != 200:
                return {"success": False, "error": f"API error {r.status_code}"}

            data = r.json()
            cur  = data.get("current", {})
            eu_aqi = cur.get("european_aqi", 0) or 0
            us_aqi = cur.get("us_aqi", 0) or 0
            uv     = cur.get("uv_index", 0) or 0

            return {
                "success":      True,
                "location":     loc,
                "lat":          lat,
                "lon":          lon,
                "timestamp":    cur.get("time"),
                "european_aqi": eu_aqi,
                "us_aqi":       us_aqi,
                "aqi_level":    _aqi_level(us_aqi),
                "uv_index":     uv,
                "uv_level":     _uv_level(uv),
                "pollutants": {
                    "pm10_ug_m3":           cur.get("pm10"),
                    "pm2_5_ug_m3":          cur.get("pm2_5"),
                    "carbon_monoxide_ug_m3":cur.get("carbon_monoxide"),
                    "nitrogen_dioxide_ug_m3":cur.get("nitrogen_dioxide"),
                    "sulphur_dioxide_ug_m3":cur.get("sulphur_dioxide"),
                    "ozone_ug_m3":          cur.get("ozone"),
                    "dust_ug_m3":           cur.get("dust"),
                },
                "safe_outdoors": us_aqi <= 100,
                "advice":        _aqi_level(us_aqi)["advice"],
            }
        except Exception as e:
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    # ── UV index only ────────────────────────────────────────
    def uv_index(self, city: str = None,
                 lat: float = None, lon: float = None) -> dict:
        """Get current UV index and safety advice."""
        result = self.current(city=city, lat=lat, lon=lon)
        if not result["success"]: return result
        uv = result.get("uv_index", 0)
        minutes_to_burn = {
            "Low": 60, "Moderate": 45, "High": 25,
            "Very High": 15, "Extreme": 10
        }
        level = _uv_level(uv)
        return {
            "success":          True,
            "location":         result.get("location"),
            "uv_index":         uv,
            "uv_level":         level,
            "minutes_to_burn":  minutes_to_burn.get(level, 10),
            "advice":           f"UV is {level}. " + (
                "No protection needed." if uv < 3 else
                "Wear sunscreen SPF 15+." if uv < 6 else
                "Wear SPF 30+, hat and sunglasses." if uv < 8 else
                "Avoid midday sun. SPF 50+ essential." if uv < 11 else
                "Stay indoors during midday. Extreme danger."
            ),
        }

# ============================================================
#  ASTRONOMY ENGINE
#  Sunrise, sunset, moon phases, day length
#  Pure Python — no external API needed
# ============================================================

import math
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta


class AstronomyEngine:
    """
    Astronomical calculations for any point on Earth.
    Sunrise, sunset, moon phases, day length.
    Pure Python — works fully offline.
    """

    # ── Sunrise and sunset ───────────────────────────────────
    def sun_times(self, lat: float, lon: float,
                  target_date: str = None) -> dict:
        """Calculate sunrise and sunset for any location and date."""
        if target_date:
            d = datetime.strptime(target_date, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        else:
            d = date.today()

        day_of_year = d.timetuple().tm_yday

        # Solar declination
        declination = math.radians(
            -23.45 * math.cos(math.radians(360/365 * (day_of_year + 10))))

        # Hour angle at sunrise/sunset
        lat_rad = math.radians(lat)
        cos_ha  = (math.cos(math.radians(90.833)) /
                   (math.cos(lat_rad) * math.cos(declination)) -
                   math.tan(lat_rad) * math.tan(declination))

        # Handle polar day/night
        if cos_ha > 1:
            return {"success": True, "date": str(d),
                    "polar_night": True, "day_length_hours": 0}
        if cos_ha < -1:
            return {"success": True, "date": str(d),
                    "polar_day": True, "day_length_hours": 24}

        ha_degrees = math.degrees(math.acos(cos_ha))

        # Solar noon (UTC)
        solar_noon_utc = 12 - lon / 15

        sunrise_utc = solar_noon_utc - ha_degrees / 15
        sunset_utc  = solar_noon_utc + ha_degrees / 15
        day_length  = sunset_utc - sunrise_utc

        def _fmt(h: float) -> str:
            h    = h % 24
            hh   = int(h)
            mm   = int((h - hh) * 60)
            return f"{hh:02d}:{mm:02d} UTC"

        def _to_dt(h: float) -> str:
            base = datetime(d.year, d.month, d.day)
            dt   = base + timedelta(hours=h % 24)
            return dt.strftime("%H:%M")

        return {
            "success":         True,
            "date":            str(d),
            "lat":             lat,
            "lon":             lon,
            "sunrise_utc":     _fmt(sunrise_utc),
            "sunset_utc":      _fmt(sunset_utc),
            "sunrise_local":   _to_dt(sunrise_utc + lon/15),
            "sunset_local":    _to_dt(sunset_utc  + lon/15),
            "day_length_hours":round(day_length, 2),
            "day_length_fmt":  f"{int(day_length)}h {int((day_length % 1)*60)}m",
            "solar_noon_utc":  _fmt(solar_noon_utc),
            "is_polar_day":    False,
            "is_polar_night":  False,
        }

    # ── Moon phase ───────────────────────────────────────────
    def moon_phase(self, target_date: str = None) -> dict:
        """Calculate moon phase for any date."""
        if target_date:
            d = datetime.strptime(target_date, "%Y-%m-%d")
        else:
            d = datetime.now()

        # Known new moon: Jan 6 2000
        known_new_moon = datetime(2000, 1, 6, 18, 14)
        lunar_cycle    = 29.53058867

        days_since = (d - known_new_moon).total_seconds() / 86400
        phase_days = days_since % lunar_cycle
        phase_pct  = phase_days / lunar_cycle

        if   phase_pct < 0.0625: phase_name = "New Moon"
        elif phase_pct < 0.1875: phase_name = "Waxing Crescent"
        elif phase_pct < 0.3125: phase_name = "First Quarter"
        elif phase_pct < 0.4375: phase_name = "Waxing Gibbous"
        elif phase_pct < 0.5625: phase_name = "Full Moon"
        elif phase_pct < 0.6875: phase_name = "Waning Gibbous"
        elif phase_pct < 0.8125: phase_name = "Last Quarter"
        elif phase_pct < 0.9375: phase_name = "Waning Crescent"
        else:                     phase_name = "New Moon"

        emojis = {
            "New Moon":"🌑","Waxing Crescent":"🌒","First Quarter":"🌓",
            "Waxing Gibbous":"🌔","Full Moon":"🌕","Waning Gibbous":"🌖",
            "Last Quarter":"🌗","Waning Crescent":"🌘",
        }

        # Days to next full moon
        if phase_pct < 0.5:
            days_to_full = (0.5 - phase_pct) * lunar_cycle
        else:
            days_to_full = (1.5 - phase_pct) * lunar_cycle

        # Days to next new moon
        days_to_new = (1.0 - phase_pct) * lunar_cycle

        return {
            "success":          True,
            "date":             str(d.date()),
            "phase":            phase_name,
            "emoji":            emojis.get(phase_name, "🌙"),
            "illumination_pct": round(
                (1 - abs(phase_pct * 2 - 1)) * 100, 1),
            "phase_day":        round(phase_days, 1),
            "days_to_full":     round(days_to_full, 1),
            "days_to_new":      round(days_to_new, 1),
            "lunar_cycle_days": lunar_cycle,
        }

    # ── Season ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    def season(self, lat: float,
               target_date: str = None) -> dict:
        """Determine current season for northern or southern hemisphere."""
        if target_date:
            d = datetime.strptime(target_date, "%Y-%m-%d")
        else:
            d = datetime.now()
        month = d.month
        if lat >= 0:
            if   month in (12, 1, 2): s = "Winter"
            elif month in (3, 4, 5):  s = "Spring"
            elif month in (6, 7, 8):  s = "Summer"
            else:                      s = "Autumn"
        else:
            if   month in (12, 1, 2): s = "Summer"
            elif month in (3, 4, 5):  s = "Autumn"
            elif month in (6, 7, 8):  s = "Winter"
            else:                      s = "Spring"
        return {
            "success":     True,
            "date":        str(d.date()),
            "season":      s,
            "hemisphere":  "Northern" if lat >= 0 else "Southern",
            "lat":         lat,
        }

    # ── Golden hour ──────────────────────────────────────────
    def golden_hour(self, lat: float, lon: float,
                    target_date: str = None) -> dict:
        """Calculate golden hour times for photography."""
        sun = self.sun_times(lat, lon, target_date)
        if not sun["success"]: return sun
        return {
            "success":        True,
            "date":           sun["date"],
            "morning_golden": f"~{sun['sunrise_local']} to 1h after",
            "evening_golden": f"~1h before {sun['sunset_local']}",
            "sunrise":        sun["sunrise_local"],
            "sunset":         sun["sunset_local"],
        }

import requests

# Carbon emissions kg CO2 per capita per year (World Bank 2022 data)
CARBON_EMISSIONS = {

    "IT":5.24, "ES":5.14, "NL":8.75, "CH":4.16, "AT":7.11,

# Köppen climate classification by lat/lon rough zones
def _koppen_zone(lat: float, lon: float) -> str:
    abs_lat = abs(lat)
    if abs_lat < 10:  return "Tropical (Af/Am/Aw)"
    if abs_lat < 25:  return "Subtropical (BSh/BWh/Cfa)"
    if abs_lat < 40:  return "Mediterranean/Temperate (Csa/Csb/Cfa)"
    if abs_lat < 55:  return "Continental (Dfb/Dfa/Cfb)"
    if abs_lat < 66:  return "Subarctic (Dfc/Dfd)"
    return "Polar (ET/EF)"


class ClimateEngine:
    """
    Historical climate data and carbon emissions.
    Averages, trends, country-level carbon data.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self._api = "https://climate-api.open-meteo.com/v1/climate"

    # ── Historical climate averages ──────────────────────────
    def historical_averages(self, lat: float, lon: float,
                            start_year: int = 1990,
                            end_year:   int = 2020) -> dict:
        """Get historical climate averages for a location."""
        try:
            r = requests.get(self._api, params={
                "latitude":   lat,
                "longitude":  lon,
                "start_date": f"{start_year}-01-01",
                "end_date":   f"{end_year}-12-31",
                "models":     "EC_Earth3P_HR",
                "daily":      ",".join([
                    "temperature_2m_mean",
                    "temperature_2m_max",
                    "temperature_2m_min",
                    "precipitation_sum",
                    "wind_speed_10m_mean",
                ]),
            }, timeout=10)

            if r.status_code != 200:
                return {"success": False, "error": f"API error {r.status_code}"}

            data  = r.json()
            daily = data.get("daily", {})
            temps = [t for t in daily.get("temperature_2m_mean",[]) if t is not None]
            maxts = [t for t in daily.get("temperature_2m_max",[])  if t is not None]
            mints = [t for t in daily.get("temperature_2m_min",[])  if t is not None]
            precs = [p for p in daily.get("precipitation_sum",[])   if p is not None]

            avg_temp  = round(sum(temps)/len(temps), 2) if temps else None
            avg_max   = round(sum(maxts)/len(maxts), 2) if maxts else None
            avg_min   = round(sum(mints)/len(mints), 2) if mints else None
            avg_prec  = round(sum(precs)/len(precs), 4) if precs else None
            total_prec= round(sum(precs), 1) if precs else None

            return {
                "success":          True,
                "lat":              lat,
                "lon":              lon,
                "period":           f"{start_year}–{end_year}",
                "climate_zone":     _koppen_zone(lat, lon),
                "avg_temp_c":       avg_temp,
                "avg_max_temp_c":   avg_max,
                "avg_min_temp_c":   avg_min,
                "avg_daily_precip_mm": avg_prec,
                "total_precip_period_mm": total_prec,
                "data_points":      len(temps),
            }
        except Exception as e:
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    # ── Carbon emissions by country ──────────────────────────
    def carbon_by_country(self, country_code: str) -> dict:
        """Get carbon emission data for a country."""
        code      = country_code.upper()
        emissions = CARBON_EMISSIONS.get(code)
        if not emissions:
            return {"success": False, "error": f"No data for: {code}"}
        world_avg = 4.47
        return {
            "success":          True,
            "country_code":     code,
            "kg_co2_per_capita_year": emissions,
            "tonnes_per_capita_year": round(emissions / 1000, 3),
            "vs_world_average": round(emissions / world_avg, 2),
            "rating":           (
                "Very Low"  if emissions < 2 else
                "Low"       if emissions < 4 else
                "Average"   if emissions < 7 else
                "High"      if emissions < 12 else
                "Very High"
            ),
            "world_average_kg": world_avg,
        }

    # ── Climate zone ─────────────────────────────────────────
    def climate_zone(self, lat: float, lon: float) -> dict:
        """Get Köppen climate classification for coordinates."""
        return {
            "success":     True,
            "lat":         lat,
            "lon":         lon,
            "zone":        _koppen_zone(lat, lon),
            "hemisphere":  "Northern" if lat >= 0 else "Southern",
        }

    # ── Compare two locations ────────────────────────────────
    def compare(self, lat1: float, lon1: float,
                lat2: float, lon2: float) -> dict:
        """Compare climate zones of two locations."""
        return {
            "success":    True,
            "location_1": {"lat": lat1, "lon": lon1,
                           "zone": _koppen_zone(lat1, lon1)},
            "location_2": {"lat": lat2, "lon": lon2,
                           "zone": _koppen_zone(lat2, lon2)},
        }

# ============================================================

# Tectonic plate boundaries — major earthquake zones
EARTHQUAKE_ZONES = [
    {"name":"Ring of Fire - Pacific",         "lat_min":-60,"lat_max":60, "lon_min":120,"lon_max":180,  "risk":"CRITICAL"},
    {"name":"Ring of Fire - Americas",        "lat_min":-60,"lat_max":60, "lon_min":-180,"lon_max":-60, "risk":"CRITICAL"},
    {"name":"Alpide Belt",                    "lat_min":20, "lat_max":50, "lon_min":-15, "lon_max":140, "risk":"HIGH"},
    {"name":"Mid-Atlantic Ridge",             "lat_min":-60,"lat_max":70, "lon_min":-45, "lon_max":-10, "risk":"MEDIUM"},
    {"name":"East African Rift",              "lat_min":-15,"lat_max":15, "lon_min":28,  "lon_max":42,  "risk":"MEDIUM"},

# Active/high-risk volcano zones
VOLCANO_ZONES = [
    {"name":"Indonesia Volcanic Arc",  "lat_min":-10,"lat_max":5,  "lon_min":95, "lon_max":141,"risk":"CRITICAL"},
    {"name":"Japan Volcanic Zone",     "lat_min":24, "lat_max":45, "lon_min":129,"lon_max":146,"risk":"CRITICAL"},

class DisasterEngine:
    """
    Natural disaster risk profiling for any location.
    Earthquake, cyclone, volcano, flood, wildfire risk
    based on geographic position and known hazard zones.
    """

    def _in_zone(self, lat: float, lon: float, zone: dict) -> bool:
        return (zone["lat_min"] <= lat <= zone["lat_max"] and
                zone["lon_min"] <= lon <= zone["lon_max"])

    # ── Full disaster risk profile ───────────────────────────
    def risk_profile(self, lat: float, lon: float) -> dict:
        """Complete disaster risk profile for a location."""
        risks  = {}
        alerts = []

        # Earthquake risk
        eq_risk = "LOW"
        eq_zone = None
        for z in EARTHQUAKE_ZONES:
            if self._in_zone(lat, lon, z):
                eq_risk = z["risk"]
                eq_zone = z["name"]
                if z["risk"] in ("CRITICAL","HIGH"):
                    alerts.append({"type":"EARTHQUAKE","severity":z["risk"],
                                  "zone": z["name"]})
                break
        risks["earthquake"] = {"risk": eq_risk, "zone": eq_zone}

        # Cyclone risk
        cy_risk = "LOW"
        cy_zones = []
        for z in CYCLONE_ZONES:
            if self._in_zone(lat, lon, z):
                cy_risk = "HIGH"
                cy_zones.append({"name": z["name"], "season": z["season"]})
                alerts.append({"type":"CYCLONE","severity":"HIGH",
                               "zone": z["name"],"season": z["season"]})
        risks["cyclone"] = {"risk": cy_risk, "zones": cy_zones}

        # Volcano risk
        vol_risk = "LOW"
        vol_zone = None
        for z in VOLCANO_ZONES:
            if self._in_zone(lat, lon, z):
                vol_risk = z["risk"]
                vol_zone = z["name"]
                if z["risk"] in ("CRITICAL","HIGH"):
                    alerts.append({"type":"VOLCANO","severity":z["risk"],
                                  "zone": z["name"]})
                break
        risks["volcano"] = {"risk": vol_risk, "zone": vol_zone}

        # Flood risk (rough — tropical + coastal + low elevation estimate)
        flood_risk = "LOW"
        if abs(lat) < 23.5:
            flood_risk = "MEDIUM"
        if abs(lat) < 15:
            flood_risk = "HIGH"
        risks["flood"] = {"risk": flood_risk,
                          "note": "Tropical zones have higher seasonal flood risk"}

        # Wildfire risk
        fire_risk = "LOW"
        if 30 <= abs(lat) <= 50:
            fire_risk = "MEDIUM"
            if 200 <= lon <= 360 or -130 <= lon <= -60:
                fire_risk = "HIGH"
        risks["wildfire"] = {"risk": fire_risk}

        # Overall risk level
        levels   = {"LOW":0,"MEDIUM":1,"HIGH":2,"CRITICAL":3}
        all_risks= [r.get("risk","LOW") for r in risks.values()]
        worst    = max(all_risks, key=lambda x: levels.get(x,0))

        return {
            "success":       True,
            "lat":           lat,
            "lon":           lon,
            "overall_risk":  worst,
            "alert_count":   len(alerts),
            "active_alerts": alerts,
            "risks":         risks,
            "safe_location": worst in ("LOW","MEDIUM"),
        }

    # ── Earthquake risk only ─────────────────────────────────
    def earthquake_risk(self, lat: float, lon: float) -> dict:
        for z in EARTHQUAKE_ZONES:
            if self._in_zone(lat, lon, z):
                return {"success":True,"risk":z["risk"],"zone":z["name"],
                        "lat":lat,"lon":lon}
        return {"success":True,"risk":"LOW","zone":None,"lat":lat,"lon":lon}

    # ── Cyclone season check ─────────────────────────────────
    def cyclone_risk(self, lat: float, lon: float) -> dict:
        zones = [z for z in CYCLONE_ZONES if self._in_zone(lat, lon, z)]
        return {
            "success": True,
            "risk":    "HIGH" if zones else "LOW",
            "zones":   zones,
            "lat":     lat,
            "lon":     lon,
        }

# ============================================================
#  ENVIRONMENT ROUTER
#  Single entry point for entire Environment module
#  Connects: weather, air, astronomy, climate, disaster
# ============================================================

from .weather     import WeatherEngine
from .air_quality import AirQualityEngine
from .astronomy   import AstronomyEngine
from .climate     import ClimateEngine
from .disaster    import DisasterEngine


class EnvironmentRouter:
    """
    Master router for Environment Module.
    One object — all environmental data for Earth.

    Usage:
        env = EnvironmentRouter()
        env.weather.current("Chennai")
        env.air.current("Delhi")
        env.astronomy.moon_phase()
        env.climate.carbon_by_country("IN")
        env.disaster.risk_profile(13.08, 80.27)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.weather   = WeatherEngine()
        self.air       = AirQualityEngine()
        self.astronomy = AstronomyEngine()
        self.climate   = ClimateEngine()
        self.disaster  = DisasterEngine()

    def health(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "module":  "Environment",
            "version": "1.0.0",
            "status":  "online",
            "engines": {
                "weather":   "ready",
                "air":       "ready",
                "astronomy": "ready (offline)",
                "climate":   "ready",
                "disaster":  "ready (offline)",
            },
            "apis_used": [
                "open-meteo.com (free, no key)",
                "air-quality-api.open-meteo.com (free, no key)",
                "climate-api.open-meteo.com (free, no key)",
                "geocoding-api.open-meteo.com (free, no key)",
            ],
        }

    # ── Full location profile ────────────────────────────────
    def full_profile(self, city: str = None,
                     lat: float = None, lon: float = None) -> dict:
        """
        One call — everything about a location's environment.
        Weather + Air Quality + Moon + Season + Disaster Risk
        """
        weather = self.weather.current(city=city, lat=lat, lon=lon)
        if not weather["success"]: return weather

        # Use coordinates from weather result
        lat = weather.get("lat", lat)
        lon = weather.get("lon", lon)

        return {
            "success":   True,
            "location":  weather.get("location"),
            "weather":   weather,
            "air":       self.air.current(lat=lat, lon=lon),
            "moon":      self.astronomy.moon_phase(),
            "sun":       self.astronomy.sun_times(lat, lon),
            "season":    self.astronomy.season(lat),
            "disaster":  self.disaster.risk_profile(lat, lon),
            "climate_zone": self.climate.climate_zone(lat, lon),
        }

    # ── Severe check ─────────────────────────────────────────
    def is_safe(self, city: str = None,
                lat: float = None, lon: float = None) -> dict:
        """Quick safety check — weather + disaster combined."""
        weather  = self.weather.severe_check(city=city, lat=lat, lon=lon)
        lat      = weather.get("current",{}).get("lat", lat)
        lon      = weather.get("current",{}).get("lon", lon)
        disaster = self.disaster.risk_profile(lat, lon) if lat and lon else {}

        w_alerts = weather.get("alerts", [])
        d_alerts = disaster.get("active_alerts", [])
        all_alerts = w_alerts + d_alerts

        return {
            "success":     True,
            "location":    weather.get("location"),
            "is_safe":     len(all_alerts) == 0,
            "alert_count": len(all_alerts),
            "alerts":      all_alerts,
        }

# ============================================================
#  WEATHER ENGINE
#  Real-time weather, forecasts, severe alerts
#  Free APIs — no key needed for basic tier
#  Offline fallback built in
# ============================================================

import requests
from datetime import datetime


# Weather condition codes → human description
WMO_CODES = {
    0:"Clear sky",1:"Mainly clear",2:"Partly cloudy",3:"Overcast",
    45:"Fog",48:"Icy fog",51:"Light drizzle",53:"Moderate drizzle",
    55:"Dense drizzle",61:"Slight rain",63:"Moderate rain",65:"Heavy rain",
    71:"Slight snow",73:"Moderate snow",75:"Heavy snow",77:"Snow grains",
    80:"Slight showers",81:"Moderate showers",82:"Violent showers",
    85:"Slight snow showers",86:"Heavy snow showers",
    95:"Thunderstorm",96:"Thunderstorm with hail",99:"Thunderstorm with heavy hail",
}

# Wind direction degrees to compass
def _wind_dir(degrees: float) -> str:
    dirs = ["N","NE","E","SE","S","SW","W","NW"]
    return dirs[round(degrees / 45) % 8]

# Beaufort scale from km/h
def _beaufort(kmh: float) -> str:
    if kmh < 1:   return "Calm"
    if kmh < 6:   return "Light air"
    if kmh < 12:  return "Light breeze"
    if kmh < 20:  return "Gentle breeze"
    if kmh < 29:  return "Moderate breeze"
    if kmh < 39:  return "Fresh breeze"
    if kmh < 50:  return "Strong breeze"
    if kmh < 62:  return "Near gale"
    if kmh < 75:  return "Gale"
    if kmh < 89:  return "Strong gale"
    if kmh < 103: return "Storm"
    if kmh < 118: return "Violent storm"
    return "Hurricane"

# Heat index from temp (C) and humidity (%)
def _heat_index(temp: float, humidity: float) -> float:
    if temp < 27: return temp
    t = temp * 9/5 + 32  # to Fahrenheit
    hi = (-42.379 + 2.04901523*t + 10.14333127*humidity
          - 0.22475541*t*humidity - 0.00683783*t*t
          - 0.05481717*humidity*humidity + 0.00122874*t*t*humidity
          + 0.00085282*t*humidity*humidity - 0.00000199*t*t*humidity*humidity)
    return round((hi - 32) * 5/9, 1)


class WeatherEngine:
    """
    Real-time weather automation.
    Current conditions, forecasts, severe alerts
    for any city or coordinates on Earth.
    Uses Open-Meteo API (free, no key needed).
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self._api      = "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast"
        self._geo_api  = "https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search"
        self._cache    = {}

    # ── Geocode city name → coordinates ─────────────────────
    def _city_coords(self, city: str) -> dict:
        try:
            r = requests.get(self._geo_api,
                params={"name": city, "count": 1, "language": "en"},
                timeout=5)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                results = r.json().get("results", [])
                if results:
                    loc = results[0]
                    return {
                        "success":  True,
                        "lat":      loc["latitude"],
                        "lon":      loc["longitude"],
                        "name":     loc.get("name"),
                        "country":  loc.get("country"),
                        "timezone": loc.get("timezone"),
                    }
        except Exception as e:
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}
        return {"success": False, "error": f"City not found: {city}"}

    # ── Current weather ──────────────────────────────────────
    def current(self, city: str = None,
                lat: float = None, lon: float = None) -> dict:
        """Get current weather for a city or coordinates."""
        if city:
            coords = self._city_coords(city)
            if not coords["success"]: return coords
            lat, lon = coords["lat"], coords["lon"]
            location_name = f"{coords.get('name')}, {coords.get('country')}"
        else:
            if lat is None or lon is None:
                return {"success": False, "error": "Provide city or lat/lon"}
            location_name = f"{lat},{lon}"

        try:
            r = requests.get(self._api, params={
                "latitude":  lat,
                "longitude": lon,
                "current":   ",".join([
                    "temperature_2m","relative_humidity_2m",
                    "apparent_temperature","is_day",
                    "precipitation","rain","showers","snowfall",
                    "weather_code","cloud_cover",
                    "wind_speed_10m","wind_direction_10m","wind_gusts_10m",
                    "surface_pressure","visibility",
                ]),
                "wind_speed_unit": "kmh",
                "timezone": "auto",
            }, timeout=6)

            if r.status_code != 200:
                return {"success": False, "error": f"API error: {r.status_code}"}

            data = r.json()
            cur  = data.get("current", {})
            code = cur.get("weather_code", 0)
            temp = cur.get("temperature_2m", 0)
            hum  = cur.get("relative_humidity_2m", 0)
            wind = cur.get("wind_speed_10m", 0)
            wdir = cur.get("wind_direction_10m", 0)

            return {
                "success":          True,
                "location":         location_name,
                "lat":              lat,
                "lon":              lon,
                "timezone":         data.get("timezone"),
                "timestamp":        cur.get("time"),
                "condition":        WMO_CODES.get(code, "Unknown"),
                "condition_code":   code,
                "is_day":           bool(cur.get("is_day", 1)),
                "temperature_c":    temp,
                "temperature_f":    round(temp * 9/5 + 32, 1),
                "feels_like_c":     cur.get("apparent_temperature"),
                "heat_index_c":     _heat_index(temp, hum),
                "humidity_pct":     hum,
                "cloud_cover_pct":  cur.get("cloud_cover"),
                "visibility_m":     cur.get("visibility"),
                "precipitation_mm": cur.get("precipitation"),
                "rain_mm":          cur.get("rain"),
                "snowfall_cm":      cur.get("snowfall"),
                "wind": {
                    "speed_kmh":    wind,
                    "speed_mph":    round(wind * 0.621371, 1),
                    "direction_deg":wdir,
                    "direction":    _wind_dir(wdir),
                    "gusts_kmh":    cur.get("wind_gusts_10m"),
                    "beaufort":     _beaufort(wind),
                },
                "pressure_hpa":     cur.get("surface_pressure"),
            }
        except Exception as e:
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    # ── 7-day forecast ───────────────────────────────────────
    def forecast(self, city: str = None,
                 lat: float = None, lon: float = None,
                 days: int = 7) -> dict:
        """Get daily weather forecast up to 16 days."""
        if city:
            coords = self._city_coords(city)
            if not coords["success"]: return coords
            lat, lon = coords["lat"], coords["lon"]
            location_name = f"{coords.get('name')}, {coords.get('country')}"
        else:
            if lat is None or lon is None:
                return {"success": False, "error": "Provide city or lat/lon"}
            location_name = f"{lat},{lon}"

        try:
            r = requests.get(self._api, params={
                "latitude":   lat,
                "longitude":  lon,
                "daily":      ",".join([
                    "weather_code",
                    "temperature_2m_max","temperature_2m_min",
                    "apparent_temperature_max","apparent_temperature_min",
                    "precipitation_sum","rain_sum","snowfall_sum",
                    "precipitation_probability_max",
                    "wind_speed_10m_max","wind_gusts_10m_max",
                    "wind_direction_10m_dominant",
                    "uv_index_max","sunrise","sunset",
                ]),
                "forecast_days": min(days, 16),
                "timezone": "auto",
                "wind_speed_unit": "kmh",
            }, timeout=6)

            if r.status_code != 200:
                return {"success": False, "error": f"API error: {r.status_code}"}

            data  = r.json()
            daily = data.get("daily", {})
            dates = daily.get("time", [])

            forecast_days = []
            for i, date in enumerate(dates):
                code     = daily.get("weather_code",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("weather_code",[])) else 0
                max_temp = daily.get("temperature_2m_max",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("temperature_2m_max",[])) else 0
                min_temp = daily.get("temperature_2m_min",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("temperature_2m_min",[])) else 0
                forecast_days.append({
                    "date":             date,
                    "condition":        WMO_CODES.get(code, "Unknown"),
                    "condition_code":   code,
                    "temp_max_c":       max_temp,
                    "temp_min_c":       min_temp,
                    "temp_max_f":       round(max_temp * 9/5 + 32, 1),
                    "temp_min_f":       round(min_temp * 9/5 + 32, 1),
                    "feels_max_c":      daily.get("apparent_temperature_max",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("apparent_temperature_max",[])) else None,
                    "feels_min_c":      daily.get("apparent_temperature_min",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("apparent_temperature_min",[])) else None,
                    "precipitation_mm": daily.get("precipitation_sum",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("precipitation_sum",[])) else 0,
                    "rain_mm":          daily.get("rain_sum",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("rain_sum",[])) else 0,
                    "snow_cm":          daily.get("snowfall_sum",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("snowfall_sum",[])) else 0,
                    "rain_probability": daily.get("precipitation_probability_max",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("precipitation_probability_max",[])) else 0,
                    "wind_max_kmh":     daily.get("wind_speed_10m_max",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("wind_speed_10m_max",[])) else 0,
                    "wind_gusts_kmh":   daily.get("wind_gusts_10m_max",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("wind_gusts_10m_max",[])) else 0,
                    "wind_direction":   _wind_dir(daily.get("wind_direction_10m_dominant",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("wind_direction_10m_dominant",[])) else 0),
                    "uv_index_max":     daily.get("uv_index_max",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("uv_index_max",[])) else 0,
                    "sunrise":          daily.get("sunrise",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("sunrise",[])) else None,
                    "sunset":           daily.get("sunset",[])[i] if i < len(daily.get("sunset",[])) else None,
                })

            return {
                "success":  True,
                "location": location_name,
                "lat":      lat,
                "lon":      lon,
                "days":     len(forecast_days),
                "forecast": forecast_days,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    # ── Hourly forecast ──────────────────────────────────────
    def hourly(self, city: str = None,
               lat: float = None, lon: float = None,
               hours: int = 24) -> dict:
        """Get hourly forecast."""
        if city:
            coords = self._city_coords(city)
            if not coords["success"]: return coords
            lat, lon = coords["lat"], coords["lon"]
        else:
            if lat is None or lon is None:
                return {"success": False, "error": "Provide city or lat/lon"}
        try:
            r = requests.get(self._api, params={
                "latitude":  lat,
                "longitude": lon,
                "hourly":    ",".join([
                    "temperature_2m","relative_humidity_2m",
                    "precipitation_probability","precipitation",
                    "weather_code","wind_speed_10m",
                    "wind_direction_10m","uv_index","is_day",
                ]),
                "forecast_days": max(1, hours // 24 + 1),
                "timezone": "auto",
            }, timeout=6)

            if r.status_code != 200:
                return {"success": False, "error": f"API error {r.status_code}"}

            data   = r.json()
            hourly = data.get("hourly", {})
            times  = hourly.get("time", [])[:hours]
            result = []

            for i, t in enumerate(times):
                code = hourly.get("weather_code",[])[i] if i < len(hourly.get("weather_code",[])) else 0
                temp = hourly.get("temperature_2m",[])[i] if i < len(hourly.get("temperature_2m",[])) else 0
                result.append({
                    "time":           t,
                    "condition":      WMO_CODES.get(code, "Unknown"),
                    "temp_c":         temp,
                    "temp_f":         round(temp * 9/5 + 32, 1),
                    "humidity_pct":   hourly.get("relative_humidity_2m",[])[i] if i < len(hourly.get("relative_humidity_2m",[])) else 0,
                    "rain_prob_pct":  hourly.get("precipitation_probability",[])[i] if i < len(hourly.get("precipitation_probability",[])) else 0,
                    "precip_mm":      hourly.get("precipitation",[])[i] if i < len(hourly.get("precipitation",[])) else 0,
                    "wind_kmh":       hourly.get("wind_speed_10m",[])[i] if i < len(hourly.get("wind_speed_10m",[])) else 0,
                    "wind_dir":       _wind_dir(hourly.get("wind_direction_10m",[])[i] if i < len(hourly.get("wind_direction_10m",[])) else 0),
                    "uv_index":       hourly.get("uv_index",[])[i] if i < len(hourly.get("uv_index",[])) else 0,
                    "is_day":         bool(hourly.get("is_day",[])[i] if i < len(hourly.get("is_day",[])) else 1),
                })
            return {"success": True, "lat": lat, "lon": lon,
                    "hours": len(result), "hourly": result}
        except Exception as e:
            return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}

    # ── Severe weather check ─────────────────────────────────
    def severe_check(self, city: str = None,
                     lat: float = None, lon: float = None) -> dict:
        """Check for severe weather conditions."""
        current = self.current(city=city, lat=lat, lon=lon)
        if not current["success"]: return current

        alerts  = []
        code    = current.get("condition_code", 0)
        wind    = current.get("wind", {}).get("speed_kmh", 0)
        gusts   = current.get("wind", {}).get("gusts_kmh", 0)
        temp    = current.get("temperature_c", 0)
        precip  = current.get("precipitation_mm", 0)

        if code >= 95:
            alerts.append({"type": "THUNDERSTORM", "severity": "CRITICAL",
                           "message": current.get("condition")})
        if code in (71, 73, 75, 77, 85, 86):
            alerts.append({"type": "SNOWFALL", "severity": "HIGH",
                           "message": current.get("condition")})
        if wind > 90 or gusts > 120:
            alerts.append({"type": "EXTREME_WIND", "severity": "CRITICAL",
                           "message": f"Wind {wind}km/h gusts {gusts}km/h"})
        elif wind > 60:
            alerts.append({"type": "STRONG_WIND", "severity": "HIGH",
                           "message": f"Wind {wind}km/h"})
        if temp > 42:
            alerts.append({"type": "EXTREME_HEAT", "severity": "CRITICAL",
                           "message": f"Temperature {temp}°C"})
        elif temp > 35:
            alerts.append({"type": "HEAT_WARNING", "severity": "HIGH",
                           "message": f"Temperature {temp}°C"})
        if temp < -20:
            alerts.append({"type": "EXTREME_COLD", "severity": "CRITICAL",
                           "message": f"Temperature {temp}°C"})
        if precip > 50:
            alerts.append({"type": "HEAVY_RAIN", "severity": "HIGH",
                           "message": f"Precipitation {precip}mm"})

        return {
            "success":  True,
            "location": current.get("location"),
            "has_alerts": len(alerts) > 0,
            "alert_count": len(alerts),
            "alerts":   alerts,
            "current":  current,
        }
