// ============================================================
// RING POLYNOMIAL ARITHMETIC
// ============================================================

export class RingPolynomial {
  readonly coefficients: bigint[];
  readonly modulus: bigint;
  readonly degree: number;

  constructor(coefficients: bigint[], modulus: bigint, degree: number) {
    this.degree = degree;
    this.modulus = modulus;
    this.coefficients = Array.from({ length: degree }, (_, i) =>
      ((coefficients[i] ?? 0n) % modulus + modulus) % modulus
    );
  }

  static zero(modulus: bigint, degree: number): RingPolynomial {
    return new RingPolynomial(new Array(degree).fill(0n), modulus, degree);
  }

  static random(modulus: bigint, degree: number): RingPolynomial {
    const coeffs = Array.from({ length: degree }, () => {
      const bytes = crypto.randomBytes(8);
      return BigInt('0x' + bytes.toString('hex')) % modulus;
    });
    return new RingPolynomial(coeffs, modulus, degree);
  }

  static ternary(degree: number, modulus: bigint): RingPolynomial {
    const coeffs = Array.from({ length: degree }, () => {
      const r = crypto.randomBytes(1)[0]! % 3;
      return BigInt(r === 2 ? -1 : r);
    });
    return new RingPolynomial(coeffs, modulus, degree);
  }

  add(other: RingPolynomial): RingPolynomial {
    const result = this.coefficients.map((c, i) =>
      (c + (other.coefficients[i] ?? 0n)) % this.modulus
    );
    return new RingPolynomial(result, this.modulus, this.degree);
  }

  sub(other: RingPolynomial): RingPolynomial {
    const result = this.coefficients.map((c, i) =>
      ((c - (other.coefficients[i] ?? 0n)) % this.modulus + this.modulus) % this.modulus
    );
    return new RingPolynomial(result, this.modulus, this.degree);
  }

  mul(other: RingPolynomial): RingPolynomial {
    const result = new Array(this.degree).fill(0n);
    for (let i = 0; i < this.degree; i++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < this.degree; j++) {
        const idx = (i + j) % this.degree;
        const sign = i + j >= this.degree ? -1n : 1n;
        result[idx] = (result[idx] + sign * this.coefficients[i]! * (other.coefficients[j] ?? 0n)) % this.modulus;
      }
    }
    return new RingPolynomial(result.map(c => ((c % this.modulus) + this.modulus) % this.modulus), this.modulus, this.degree);
  }

  mulScalar(scalar: bigint): RingPolynomial {
    return new RingPolynomial(
      this.coefficients.map(c => (c * scalar) % this.modulus),
      this.modulus, this.degree
    );
  }

  negate(): RingPolynomial {
    return new RingPolynomial(
      this.coefficients.map(c => (this.modulus - c) % this.modulus),
      this.modulus, this.degree
    );
  }

  modSwitch(newModulus: bigint): RingPolynomial {
    const scale = newModulus;
    return new RingPolynomial(
      this.coefficients.map(c => (c * scale / this.modulus) % newModulus),
      newModulus, this.degree
    );
  }

  noise(): number {
    const maxCoeff = this.coefficients.reduce((max, c) => {
      const centered = c > this.modulus / 2n ? this.modulus - c : c;
      return centered > max ? centered : max;
    }, 0n);
    return Number(maxCoeff);
  }

  innerProduct(other: RingPolynomial): bigint {
    return this.coefficients.reduce((acc, c, i) =>
      (acc + c * (other.coefficients[i] ?? 0n)) % this.modulus, 0n
    );
  }

  toBuffer(): Buffer {
    const parts = this.coefficients.map(c => {
      const hex = c.toString(16).padStart(16, '0');
      return Buffer.from(hex, 'hex');
    });
    return Buffer.concat(parts);
  }

  clone(): RingPolynomial {
    return new RingPolynomial([...this.coefficients], this.modulus, this.degree);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// BFV SCHEME (Integer operations)
// ============================================================

export class BFVScheme {
  private readonly params: HEParams;
  private readonly q: bigint;
  private readonly t: bigint;
  private readonly n: number;
  private readonly delta: bigint;

  constructor(params: HEParams) {
    this.params = params;
    this.n = params.polyModulusDegree;
    this.q = params.coeffModulus.reduce((acc, v) => acc * v, 1n);
    this.t = params.plainModulus || 1024n;
    this.delta = this.q / this.t;
  }

  generateKeySet(): HEKeySet {
    const s = RingPolynomial.ternary(this.n, this.q);
    const a = RingPolynomial.random(this.q, this.n);
    const e = this.sampleError();
    const pk0 = a.mul(s).negate().add(e);
    const pk1 = a;
    const publicKey: HEPublicKey = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      data: [pk0.coefficients, pk1.coefficients],
      scheme: HEScheme.BFV,
      size: 2 * this.n,
    };
    const secretKey: HESecretKey = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      data: s.coefficients,
      scheme: HEScheme.BFV,
      size: this.n,
    };
    const relinKey = this.generateRelinKey(s);
    return {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      scheme: HEScheme.BFV,
      publicKey,
      secretKey,
      relinKey,
      createdAt: new Date(),
      params: this.params,
    };
  }

  encrypt(plaintext: bigint[], keySet: HEKeySet): HECiphertext {
    const { publicKey } = keySet;
    const pk0 = new RingPolynomial(publicKey.data[0]!, this.q, this.n);
    const pk1 = new RingPolynomial(publicKey.data[1]!, this.q, this.n);
    const m = new RingPolynomial(plaintext.map(v => v % this.t), this.q, this.n);
    const u = RingPolynomial.ternary(this.n, this.q);
    const e1 = this.sampleError();
    const e2 = this.sampleError();
    const mScaled = m.mulScalar(this.delta);
    const ct0 = pk0.mul(u).add(e1).add(mScaled);
    const ct1 = pk1.mul(u).add(e2);
    return {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      scheme: HEScheme.BFV,
      poly0: ct0.coefficients,
      poly1: ct1.coefficients,
      level: this.params.depth,
      noiseLevel: NoiseLevel.LOW,
      dataType: HEDataType.INTEGER,
      slotCount: this.n,
      encryptedAt: new Date(),
      keyId: keySet.id,
      operationHistory: [],
    };
  }

  decrypt(ciphertext: HECiphertext, keySet: HEKeySet): bigint[] {
    const { secretKey } = keySet;
    const s = new RingPolynomial(secretKey.data, this.q, this.n);
    const ct0 = new RingPolynomial(ciphertext.poly0, this.q, this.n);
    const ct1 = new RingPolynomial(ciphertext.poly1, this.q, this.n);
    const phase = ct0.add(ct1.mul(s));
    return phase.coefficients.map(c => {
      const centered = c > this.q / 2n ? c - this.q : c;
      return ((centered * this.t + this.q / 2n) / this.q % this.t + this.t) % this.t;
    });
  }

  add(ct1: HECiphertext, ct2: HECiphertext): HECiphertext {
    const p0_1 = new RingPolynomial(ct1.poly0, this.q, this.n);
    const p1_1 = new RingPolynomial(ct1.poly1, this.q, this.n);
    const p0_2 = new RingPolynomial(ct2.poly0, this.q, this.n);
    const p1_2 = new RingPolynomial(ct2.poly1, this.q, this.n);
    return this.buildCiphertext(p0_1.add(p0_2), p1_1.add(p1_2), ct1, HEOperation.ADD);
  }

  addPlain(ct: HECiphertext, plaintext: bigint[]): HECiphertext {
    const p0 = new RingPolynomial(ct.poly0, this.q, this.n);
    const m = new RingPolynomial(plaintext.map(v => v % this.t), this.q, this.n);
    const mScaled = m.mulScalar(this.delta);
    return this.buildCiphertext(p0.add(mScaled), new RingPolynomial(ct.poly1, this.q, this.n), ct, HEOperation.ADD);
  }

  sub(ct1: HECiphertext, ct2: HECiphertext): HECiphertext {
    const p0_1 = new RingPolynomial(ct1.poly0, this.q, this.n);
    const p1_1 = new RingPolynomial(ct1.poly1, this.q, this.n);
    const p0_2 = new RingPolynomial(ct2.poly0, this.q, this.n);
    const p1_2 = new RingPolynomial(ct2.poly1, this.q, this.n);
    return this.buildCiphertext(p0_1.sub(p0_2), p1_1.sub(p1_2), ct1, HEOperation.SUB);
  }

  mul(ct1: HECiphertext, ct2: HECiphertext): HECiphertext {
    const c0_1 = new RingPolynomial(ct1.poly0, this.q, this.n);
    const c1_1 = new RingPolynomial(ct1.poly1, this.q, this.n);
    const c0_2 = new RingPolynomial(ct2.poly0, this.q, this.n);
    const c1_2 = new RingPolynomial(ct2.poly1, this.q, this.n);
    const d0 = c0_1.mul(c0_2);
    const d1 = c0_1.mul(c1_2).add(c1_1.mul(c0_2));
    const d2 = c1_1.mul(c1_2);
    const t = this.t;
    const scaled0 = d0.mulScalar(t).modSwitch(this.q);
    const scaled1 = d1.mulScalar(t).modSwitch(this.q);
    return {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      scheme: HEScheme.BFV,
      poly0: scaled0.coefficients,
      poly1: scaled1.coefficients,
      poly2: d2.coefficients,
      level: ct1.level - 1,
      noiseLevel: Math.min(ct1.noiseLevel + 1, NoiseLevel.EXHAUSTED) as NoiseLevel,
      dataType: HEDataType.INTEGER,
      slotCount: this.n,
      encryptedAt: new Date(),
      keyId: ct1.keyId,
      operationHistory: [...ct1.operationHistory, this.opRecord(HEOperation.MUL, [ct1.id, ct2.id])],
    };
  }

  relinearize(ct: HECiphertext, relinKey: HERelinKey): HECiphertext {
    const c2 = ct.poly2 ? new RingPolynomial(ct.poly2, this.q, this.n) : RingPolynomial.zero(this.q, this.n);
    const rl0 = new RingPolynomial(relinKey.data[0]?.[0] || new Array(this.n).fill(0n), this.q, this.n);
    const correction = c2.mul(rl0);
    const p0 = new RingPolynomial(ct.poly0, this.q, this.n).add(correction);
    const p1 = new RingPolynomial(ct.poly1, this.q, this.n);
    const result = this.buildCiphertext(p0, p1, ct, HEOperation.RELINEARIZE);
    delete (result as Partial<HECiphertext>).poly2;
    return result;
  }

  mulPlain(ct: HECiphertext, plaintext: bigint[]): HECiphertext {
    const p0 = new RingPolynomial(ct.poly0, this.q, this.n);
    const p1 = new RingPolynomial(ct.poly1, this.q, this.n);
    const m = new RingPolynomial(plaintext.map(v => v % this.t), this.q, this.n);
    return this.buildCiphertext(p0.mul(m), p1.mul(m), ct, HEOperation.MUL);
  }

  negate(ct: HECiphertext): HECiphertext {
    const p0 = new RingPolynomial(ct.poly0, this.q, this.n).negate();
    const p1 = new RingPolynomial(ct.poly1, this.q, this.n).negate();
    return this.buildCiphertext(p0, p1, ct, HEOperation.NEG);
  }

  private sampleError(): RingPolynomial {
    const coeffs = Array.from({ length: this.n }, () => {
      const r = crypto.randomBytes(1)[0]! % 3;
      return BigInt(r === 2 ? -1 : r);
    });
    return new RingPolynomial(coeffs, this.q, this.n);
  }

  private generateRelinKey(s: RingPolynomial): HERelinKey {
    const a = RingPolynomial.random(this.q, this.n);
    const e = this.sampleError();
    const s2 = s.mul(s);
    const rl0 = s2.negate().add(a.mul(s).add(e));
    const rl1 = a;
    return {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      data: [[rl0.coefficients, rl1.coefficients]],
      decompositionBase: 2,
    };
  }

  private buildCiphertext(p0: RingPolynomial, p1: RingPolynomial, source: HECiphertext, op: HEOperation): HECiphertext {
    return {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      scheme: HEScheme.BFV,
      poly0: p0.coefficients,
      poly1: p1.coefficients,
      level: source.level,
      noiseLevel: source.noiseLevel,
      dataType: source.dataType,
      slotCount: source.slotCount,
      encryptedAt: new Date(),
      keyId: source.keyId,
      operationHistory: [...source.operationHistory, this.opRecord(op, [source.id])],
    };
  }

  private opRecord(op: HEOperation, inputIds: string[]): HEOperationRecord {
    return {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      operation: op,
      timestamp: new Date(),
      inputIds,
      outputId: crypto.randomUUID(),
      durationMs: 0,
      noiseGrowth: op === HEOperation.MUL ? 2 : 1,
    };
  }
}

// ============================================================
// CKKS SCHEME (Approximate floating point)
// ============================================================

export class CKKSScheme {
  private readonly params: HEParams;
  private readonly n: number;
  private readonly q: bigint;
  private readonly scale: bigint;

  constructor(params: HEParams) {
    this.params = params;
    this.n = params.polyModulusDegree;
    this.q = params.coeffModulus.reduce((acc, v) => acc * v, 1n);
    this.scale = BigInt(Math.pow(2, params.scaleBits || 40));
  }

  encodeFloat(values: number[]): HEPlaintext {
    const scaled = values.map(v => BigInt(Math.round(v * Number(this.scale))));
    const coefficients = new Array(this.n).fill(0n);
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(values.length, this.n / 2); i++) {
      coefficients[i] = scaled[i] ?? 0n;
      coefficients[this.n / 2 + i] = scaled[i] ?? 0n;
    }
    return {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      data: coefficients,
      dataType: HEDataType.FLOAT,
      scale: Number(this.scale),
      originalValues: values,
      encoding: 'ckks',
    };
  }

  decodeFloat(plaintext: HEPlaintext): number[] {
    const scale = BigInt(plaintext.scale || Number(this.scale));
    return plaintext.data.slice(0, this.n / 2).map(c => {
      const centered = c > this.q / 2n ? c - this.q : c;
      return Number(centered) / Number(scale);
    });
  }

  encryptFloat(values: number[], keySet: HEKeySet): HECiphertext {
    const plain = this.encodeFloat(values);
    const bfv = new BFVScheme(this.params);
    const ct = bfv.encrypt(plain.data, keySet);
    ct.scale = Number(this.scale);
    ct.dataType = HEDataType.FLOAT;
    return ct;
  }

  decryptFloat(ct: HECiphertext, keySet: HEKeySet): number[] {
    const bfv = new BFVScheme(this.params);
    const plain = bfv.decrypt(ct, keySet);
    const scale = BigInt(ct.scale || Number(this.scale));
    return plain.slice(0, this.n / 2).map(c => {
      const centered = c > this.q / 2n ? c - this.q : c;
      return Number(centered) / Number(scale);
    });
  }

  addFloat(ct1: HECiphertext, ct2: HECiphertext): HECiphertext {
    const bfv = new BFVScheme(this.params);
    return bfv.add(ct1, ct2);
  }

  mulFloat(ct1: HECiphertext, ct2: HECiphertext, relinKey: HERelinKey): HECiphertext {
    const bfv = new BFVScheme(this.params);
    const product = bfv.mul(ct1, ct2);
    const relinearized = bfv.relinearize(product, relinKey);
    if (relinearized.scale) relinearized.scale = Math.sqrt(relinearized.scale);
    return relinearized;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// ENCRYPTED ANALYTICS
// ============================================================

export class EncryptedAnalytics {
  private readonly bfv: BFVScheme;

  constructor(params: HEParams) {
    this.bfv = new BFVScheme(params);
  }

  encryptedSum(ciphertexts: HECiphertext[]): HECiphertext {
    if (ciphertexts.length === 0) throw new Error('Empty array');
    return ciphertexts.slice(1).reduce((acc, ct) => this.bfv.add(acc, ct), ciphertexts[0]!);
  }

  encryptedDotProduct(a: HECiphertext[], b: HECiphertext[], relinKey: HERelinKey): HECiphertext {
    if (a.length !== b.length) throw new Error('Length mismatch');
    const products = a.map((ai, i) => this.bfv.relinearize(this.bfv.mul(ai, b[i]!), relinKey));
    return this.encryptedSum(products);
  }

  encryptedSort(ciphertexts: HECiphertext[], ascending = true): HECiphertext[] {
    const n = ciphertexts.length;
    const result = [...ciphertexts];
    for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < n - i - 1; j++) {
        if (result[j]!.noiseLevel > result[j + 1]!.noiseLevel) {
          const temp = result[j]!;
          result[j] = result[j + 1]!;
          result[j + 1] = temp;
        }
      }
    }
    return ascending ? result : result.reverse();
  }

  encryptedAverage(ciphertexts: HECiphertext[], n: bigint): HECiphertext {
    const sum = this.encryptedSum(ciphertexts);
    const nInv = [1n, 0n].map(() => 1n);
    return this.bfv.mulPlain(sum, nInv);
  }

  encryptedInnerProduct(a: HECiphertext, b: HECiphertext, relinKey: HERelinKey): HECiphertext {
    const product = this.bfv.mul(a, b);
    return this.bfv.relinearize(product, relinKey);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// ENCRYPTED ML INFERENCE
// ============================================================

export class EncryptedMLInference {
  private readonly ckks: CKKSScheme;
  private readonly params: HEParams;

  constructor(params: HEParams) {
    this.params = params;
    this.ckks = new CKKSScheme(params);
  }

  encryptWeights(weights: number[][], keySet: HEKeySet): HECiphertext[] {
    return weights.map(layer => this.ckks.encryptFloat(layer, keySet));
  }

  linearLayer(input: HECiphertext, weightsCt: HECiphertext, bias: HECiphertext, relinKey: HERelinKey): HECiphertext {
    const bfv = new BFVScheme(this.params);
    const product = this.ckks.mulFloat(input, weightsCt, relinKey);
    return bfv.add(product, bias);
  }

  reluApprox(ct: HECiphertext, _relinKey: HERelinKey): HECiphertext {
    const bfv = new BFVScheme(this.params);
    const square = bfv.mul(ct, ct);
    const squareScaled = bfv.mulPlain(square, new Array(ct.slotCount).fill(1n));
    const halfCt = bfv.mulPlain(ct, new Array(ct.slotCount).fill(1n));
    return bfv.add(squareScaled, halfCt);
  }

  sigmoidApprox(ct: HECiphertext, _relinKey: HERelinKey): HECiphertext {
    const bfv = new BFVScheme(this.params);
    const half = bfv.mulPlain(ct, new Array(ct.slotCount).fill(1n));
    return bfv.addPlain(half, new Array(ct.slotCount).fill(1n));
  }

  inference(input: number[], model: HEMLModel, keySet: HEKeySet): HECiphertext {
    let current = this.ckks.encryptFloat(input, keySet);
    const relinKey = { id: 'dummy', data: [], decompositionBase: 2 } as HERelinKey;
    for (let i = 0; i < model.layers; i++) {
      const weight = model.weights[i];
      const bias = model.biases[i];
      if (weight && bias) {
        current = this.linearLayer(current, weight, bias, relinKey);
      }
      if (model.activationFunction === 'relu_approx') {
        current = this.reluApprox(current, relinKey);
      } else if (model.activationFunction === 'sigmoid_approx') {
        current = this.sigmoidApprox(current, relinKey);
      }
    }
    return current;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// MAIN HOMOMORPHIC ENGINE
// ============================================================

export class HomomorphicEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly keySets: Map<string, HEKeySet> = new Map();
  private readonly ciphertexts: Map<string, HECiphertext> = new Map();
  private readonly circuits: Map<string, HECircuit> = new Map();
  private readonly config: HEEngineConfig;
  private readonly defaultParams: HEParams;
  private bfv?: BFVScheme;
  private ckks?: CKKSScheme;
  private analytics?: EncryptedAnalytics;
  private mlInference?: EncryptedMLInference;

  constructor(config: HEEngineConfig = {}) {
    super();
    this.config = {
      defaultScheme: HEScheme.BFV,
      enableBootstrapping: false,
      enableBatching: true,
      enableParallelism: false,
      maxCiphertexts: 10000,
      autoRescale: true,
      noiseThreshold: NoiseLevel.HIGH,
      ...config,
    };
    this.defaultParams = {
      scheme: this.config.defaultScheme!,
      polyModulusDegree: 4096,
      coeffModulus: [
        576460752303423489n,
        576460752303423233n,
      ],
      plainModulus: 1032193n,
      scaleBits: 40,
      securityLevel: 128,
      depth: 10,
      batchSize: 4096,
      ...config.defaultParams,
    };
    this.initializeSchemes();
  }

  private initializeSchemes(): void {
    this.bfv = new BFVScheme(this.defaultParams);
    this.ckks = new CKKSScheme(this.defaultParams);
    this.analytics = new EncryptedAnalytics(this.defaultParams);
    this.mlInference = new EncryptedMLInference(this.defaultParams);
  }

  generateKeySet(scheme?: HEScheme): HEKeySet {
    const params = { ...this.defaultParams, scheme: scheme || this.config.defaultScheme! };
    const bfv = new BFVScheme(params);
    const keySet = bfv.generateKeySet();
    this.keySets.set(keySet.id, keySet);
    this.emit('keyset:created', { id: keySet.id, scheme });
    return keySet;
  }

  encryptInt(values: bigint[], keySetId: string): HECiphertext {
    const keySet = this.getKeySet(keySetId);
    const ct = this.bfv!.encrypt(values, keySet);
    this.store(ct);
    return ct;
  }

  decryptInt(ctId: string, keySetId: string): bigint[] {
    const ct = this.getCiphertext(ctId);
    const keySet = this.getKeySet(keySetId);
    return this.bfv!.decrypt(ct, keySet);
  }

  encryptFloat(values: number[], keySetId: string): HECiphertext {
    const keySet = this.getKeySet(keySetId);
    const ct = this.ckks!.encryptFloat(values, keySet);
    this.store(ct);
    return ct;
  }

  decryptFloat(ctId: string, keySetId: string): number[] {
    const ct = this.getCiphertext(ctId);
    const keySet = this.getKeySet(keySetId);
    return this.ckks!.decryptFloat(ct, keySet);
  }

  add(ctId1: string, ctId2: string): HECiphertext {
    const ct1 = this.getCiphertext(ctId1);
    const ct2 = this.getCiphertext(ctId2);
    const result = this.bfv!.add(ct1, ct2);
    this.store(result);
    this.emit('operation', { op: HEOperation.ADD, inputs: [ctId1, ctId2], output: result.id });
    return result;
  }

  sub(ctId1: string, ctId2: string): HECiphertext {
    const ct1 = this.getCiphertext(ctId1);
    const ct2 = this.getCiphertext(ctId2);
    const result = this.bfv!.sub(ct1, ct2);
    this.store(result);
    return result;
  }

  mul(ctId1: string, ctId2: string, keySetId: string): HECiphertext {
    const ct1 = this.getCiphertext(ctId1);
    const ct2 = this.getCiphertext(ctId2);
    const keySet = this.getKeySet(keySetId);
    const product = this.bfv!.mul(ct1, ct2);
    const result = this.bfv!.relinearize(product, keySet.relinKey!);
    this.store(result);
    this.emit('operation', { op: HEOperation.MUL, inputs: [ctId1, ctId2], output: result.id });
    return result;
  }

  mulPlain(ctId: string, plaintext: bigint[]): HECiphertext {
    const ct = this.getCiphertext(ctId);
    const result = this.bfv!.mulPlain(ct, plaintext);
    this.store(result);
    return result;
  }

  addPlain(ctId: string, plaintext: bigint[]): HECiphertext {
    const ct = this.getCiphertext(ctId);
    const result = this.bfv!.addPlain(ct, plaintext);
    this.store(result);
    return result;
  }

  negate(ctId: string): HECiphertext {
    const ct = this.getCiphertext(ctId);
    const result = this.bfv!.negate(ct);
    this.store(result);
    return result;
  }

  sum(ctIds: string[]): HECiphertext {
    const cts = ctIds.map(id => this.getCiphertext(id));
    const result = this.analytics!.encryptedSum(cts);
    this.store(result);
    return result;
  }

  dotProduct(ctIds1: string[], ctIds2: string[], keySetId: string): HECiphertext {
    const cts1 = ctIds1.map(id => this.getCiphertext(id));
    const cts2 = ctIds2.map(id => this.getCiphertext(id));
    const keySet = this.getKeySet(keySetId);
    const result = this.analytics!.encryptedDotProduct(cts1, cts2, keySet.relinKey!);
    this.store(result);
    return result;
  }

  encryptedMLInference(input: number[], model: HEMLModel, keySetId: string): HECiphertext {
    const keySet = this.getKeySet(keySetId);
    const result = this.mlInference!.inference(input, model, keySet);
    this.store(result);
    return result;
  }

  estimateNoise(ctId: string): NoiseLevel {
    const ct = this.getCiphertext(ctId);
    return ct.noiseLevel;
  }

  needsBootstrap(ctId: string): boolean {
    const ct = this.getCiphertext(ctId);
    return ct.noiseLevel >= (this.config.noiseThreshold || NoiseLevel.HIGH);
  }

  getCiphertext(id: string): HECiphertext {
    const ct = this.ciphertexts.get(id);
    if (!ct) throw new Error(`Ciphertext ${id} not found`);
    return ct;
  }

  getKeySet(id: string): HEKeySet {
    const ks = this.keySets.get(id);
    if (!ks) throw new Error(`KeySet ${id} not found`);
    return ks;
  }

  private store(ct: HECiphertext): void {
    if (this.ciphertexts.size >= (this.config.maxCiphertexts || 10000)) {
      const oldest = Array.from(this.ciphertexts.entries()).sort((a, b) =>
        a[1].encryptedAt.getTime() - b[1].encryptedAt.getTime()
      )[0];
      if (oldest) this.ciphertexts.delete(oldest[0]);
    }
    this.ciphertexts.set(ct.id, ct);
  }

  getStats() {
    return {
      activeCiphertexts: this.ciphertexts.size,
      activeKeySets: this.keySets.size,
      registeredCircuits: this.circuits.size,
    };
  }
}

// ============================================================
// FACTORY
// ============================================================

export function createHomomorphicEngine(config?: HEEngineConfig): HomomorphicEngine {
  return new HomomorphicEngine(config);
}

export const defaultHEEngine = createHomomorphicEngine();
export default HomomorphicEngine;

// ─── Circuit Breaker ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class CircuitBreaker {
  private states = new Map<string, { state: CircuitState; failures: number; successes: number; lastFailureAt?: number; openedAt?: number }>();

  getState(connectorId: string): CircuitState {
    return this.states.get(connectorId)?.state ?? 'CLOSED';
  }

  canExecute(connectorId: string, policy: CircuitBreakerPolicy): boolean {
    if (!policy.enabled) return true;
    const cb = this.states.get(connectorId) ?? { state: 'CLOSED' as CircuitState, failures: 0, successes: 0 };
    if (cb.state === 'CLOSED') return true;
    if (cb.state === 'OPEN') {
      const now = Date.now();
      if (cb.openedAt && now - cb.openedAt >= policy.timeoutMs) {
        cb.state = 'HALF_OPEN';
        cb.successes = 0;
        this.states.set(connectorId, cb);
        console.log(`[CircuitBreaker] ${connectorId} → HALF_OPEN`);
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    return true; // HALF_OPEN allows limited calls
  }

  recordSuccess(connectorId: string, policy: CircuitBreakerPolicy): void {
    const cb = this.states.get(connectorId) ?? { state: 'CLOSED' as CircuitState, failures: 0, successes: 0 };
    cb.successes++;
    if (cb.state === 'HALF_OPEN' && cb.successes >= policy.successThreshold) {
      cb.state = 'CLOSED';
      cb.failures = 0;
      console.log(`[CircuitBreaker] ${connectorId} → CLOSED (recovered)`);
    }
    this.states.set(connectorId, cb);
  }

  recordFailure(connectorId: string, policy: CircuitBreakerPolicy): CircuitState {
    const cb = this.states.get(connectorId) ?? { state: 'CLOSED' as CircuitState, failures: 0, successes: 0 };
    cb.failures++;
    cb.lastFailureAt = Date.now();
    if (cb.failures >= policy.failureThreshold || cb.state === 'HALF_OPEN') {
      cb.state = 'OPEN';
      cb.openedAt = Date.now();
      console.error(`[CircuitBreaker] ${connectorId} → OPEN (failures: ${cb.failures})`);
    }
    this.states.set(connectorId, cb);
    return cb.state;
  }

  reset(connectorId: string): void {
    this.states.delete(connectorId);
  }
}

// ─── Dead Letter Queue ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class DeadLetterQueue {
  private records = new Map<string, DeadLetterRecord>();
  private maxSize = 100000;

  enqueue(connectorId: string, tenantId: string, data: unknown, reason: string, encryptFn?: (d: unknown) => string): DeadLetterRecord {
    const id = `dlq_${Date.now()}_${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
    const record: DeadLetterRecord = {
      id, connectorId, tenantId,
      failedAt: new Date(),
      reason,
      retryCount: 0,
      data: encryptFn ? null : data,
      encryptedData: encryptFn ? encryptFn(data) : undefined,
      resolved: false,
      nextRetryAt: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000),
    };
    if (this.records.size >= this.maxSize) {
      const oldest = Array.from(this.records.keys())[0];
      this.records.delete(oldest);
    }
    this.records.set(id, record);
    console.warn(`[DLQ] Enqueued: ${id} — ${reason}`);
    return record;
  }

  getByConnector(connectorId: string): DeadLetterRecord[] {
    return Array.from(this.records.values()).filter(r => r.connectorId === connectorId && !r.resolved);
  }

  getByTenant(tenantId: string): DeadLetterRecord[] {
    return Array.from(this.records.values()).filter(r => r.tenantId === tenantId && !r.resolved);
  }

  markResolved(id: string): void {
    const r = this.records.get(id);
    if (r) { r.resolved = true; r.nextRetryAt = undefined; }
  }

  getRetryable(): DeadLetterRecord[] {
    const now = Date.now();
    return Array.from(this.records.values()).filter(r => !r.resolved && r.nextRetryAt && r.nextRetryAt.getTime() <= now && r.retryCount < 5);
  }

  incrementRetry(id: string): void {
    const r = this.records.get(id);
    if (!r) return;
    r.retryCount++;
    r.lastRetryAt = new Date();
    const backoff = Math.min(5 * 60 * 1000 * Math.pow(2, r.retryCount), 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    r.nextRetryAt = new Date(Date.now() + backoff);
    if (r.retryCount >= 5) { r.resolved = true; console.error(`[DLQ] Max retries reached: ${id} — marking resolved`); }
  }

  size(): number { return Array.from(this.records.values()).filter(r => !r.resolved).length; }
}

// ─── Data Lineage Tracker ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class DataLineageTracker {
  private events: LineageEvent[] = [];
  private maxEvents = 1000000;

  record(event: Omit<LineageEvent, 'eventId' | 'timestamp'>): LineageEvent {
    const full: LineageEvent = {
      ...event,
      eventId: `lin_${Date.now()}_${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`,
      timestamp: new Date(),
    };
    if (this.events.length >= this.maxEvents) this.events.shift();
    this.events.push(full);
    return full;
  }

  getByConnector(connectorId: string): LineageEvent[] {
    return this.events.filter(e => e.connectorId === connectorId);
  }

  getByTenant(tenantId: string): LineageEvent[] {
    return this.events.filter(e => e.tenantId === tenantId);
  }

  getByRecord(recordId: string): LineageEvent[] {
    return this.events.filter(e => e.recordId === recordId);
  }

  buildLineageGraph(recordId: string): LineageEvent[] {
    return this.getByRecord(recordId).sort((a, b) => a.timestamp.getTime() - b.timestamp.getTime());
  }
}

// ─── Tenant Manager ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TenantManager {
  private quotas = new Map<string, TenantQuota>();
  private pullCounts = new Map<string, { hour: number; day: number; hourStart: number; dayStart: number }>();

  setQuota(quota: TenantQuota): void {
    this.quotas.set(quota.tenantId, quota);
  }

  canPull(tenantId: string): { allowed: boolean; reason?: string } {
    const quota = this.quotas.get(tenantId);
    if (!quota) return { allowed: true };
    const counts = this.getOrInitCounts(tenantId);
    if (counts.hour >= quota.maxPullsPerHour) return { allowed: false, reason: `Hourly pull quota exceeded (${quota.maxPullsPerHour}/hr)` };
    return { allowed: true };
  }

  recordPull(tenantId: string, bytes: number): void {
    const counts = this.getOrInitCounts(tenantId);
    counts.hour++;
    counts.day++;
    const quota = this.quotas.get(tenantId);
    if (quota) {
      quota.pullsThisHour = counts.hour;
      quota.bytesThisDay += bytes;
    }
  }

  private getOrInitCounts(tenantId: string) {
    const now = Date.now();
    let counts = this.pullCounts.get(tenantId);
    if (!counts) { counts = { hour: 0, day: 0, hourStart: now, dayStart: now }; this.pullCounts.set(tenantId, counts); }
    if (now - counts.hourStart > 3600000) { counts.hour = 0; counts.hourStart = now; }
    if (now - counts.dayStart > 86400000) { counts.day = 0; counts.dayStart = now; }
    return counts;
  }

  getQuota(tenantId: string): TenantQuota | undefined { return this.quotas.get(tenantId); }
}

// ─── Backpressure Manager ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class BackpressureManager {
  private states = new Map<string, BackpressureState>();

  check(connectorId: string, policy: BackpressurePolicy, incomingBytes: number): { proceed: boolean; action: string } {
    if (!policy.enabled) return { proceed: true, action: 'pass' };
    const state = this.getOrInit(connectorId);
    state.memoryBytes += incomingBytes;
    if (state.queueSize >= policy.maxQueueSize || state.memoryBytes >= policy.maxMemoryBytes) {
      state.isThrottled = true;
      switch (policy.strategy) {
        case 'drop': state.droppedCount++; return { proceed: false, action: 'dropped' };
        case 'sample':
          if (Math.random() > (policy.sampleRate ?? 0.1)) { state.sampledCount++; return { proceed: false, action: 'sampled_out' }; }
          return { proceed: true, action: 'sampled_in' };
        case 'block': return { proceed: false, action: 'blocked' };
        case 'buffer': return { proceed: true, action: 'buffered' };
      }
    }
    state.isThrottled = false;
    return { proceed: true, action: 'pass' };
  }

  increment(connectorId: string): void {
    const s = this.getOrInit(connectorId);
    s.queueSize++;
  }

  decrement(connectorId: string): void {
    const s = this.getOrInit(connectorId);
    s.queueSize = Math.max(0, s.queueSize - 1);
  }

  getState(connectorId: string): BackpressureState { return this.getOrInit(connectorId); }

  private getOrInit(connectorId: string): BackpressureState {
    let s = this.states.get(connectorId);
    if (!s) { s = { connectorId, queueSize: 0, memoryBytes: 0, isThrottled: false, droppedCount: 0, sampledCount: 0 }; this.states.set(connectorId, s); }
    return s;
  }
}

// ─── Encryption Manager ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class EncryptionManager {
  private keys = new Map<string, { key: Buffer; createdAt: Date }>();

  getOrCreateKey(connectorId: string): Buffer {
    let entry = this.keys.get(connectorId);
    if (!entry) { entry = { key: crypto.randomBytes(32), createdAt: new Date() }; this.keys.set(connectorId, entry); }
    return entry.key;
  }

  encrypt(data: unknown, connectorId: string): string {
    const key = this.getOrCreateKey(connectorId);
    const iv = crypto.randomBytes(16);
    const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
    const plaintext = JSON.stringify(data);
    const encrypted = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(plaintext, 'utf8'), cipher.final()]);
    const tag = cipher.getAuthTag();
    return Buffer.concat([iv, tag, encrypted]).toString('base64');
  }

  decrypt(encryptedBase64: string, connectorId: string): unknown {
    const key = this.getOrCreateKey(connectorId);
    const buf = Buffer.from(encryptedBase64, 'base64');
    const iv = buf.slice(0, 16);
    const tag = buf.slice(16, 32);
    const encrypted = buf.slice(32);
    const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
    decipher.setAuthTag(tag);
    const decrypted = Buffer.concat([decipher.update(encrypted), decipher.final()]);
    return JSON.parse(decrypted.toString('utf8'));
  }

  rotateKey(connectorId: string): void {
    this.keys.set(connectorId, { key: crypto.randomBytes(32), createdAt: new Date() });
    console.log(`[Encryption] Key rotated for connector: ${connectorId}`);
  }
}

// ─── Prometheus Metrics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class PrometheusExporter {
  private metrics: PrometheusMetric[] = [];

  record(metric: PrometheusMetric): void {
    const existing = this.metrics.findIndex(m => m.name === metric.name && JSON.stringify(m.labels) === JSON.stringify(metric.labels));
    if (existing >= 0) this.metrics[existing] = metric;
    else this.metrics.push(metric);
  }

  export(): string {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const grouped = new Map<string, PrometheusMetric[]>();
    for (const m of this.metrics) {
      const group = grouped.get(m.name) ?? [];
      group.push(m);
      grouped.set(m.name, group);
    }
    for (const [name, metrics] of grouped.entries()) {
      const first = metrics[0];
      lines.push(`# HELP ${name} ${first.help}`);
      lines.push(`# TYPE ${name} ${first.type}`);
      for (const m of metrics) {
        const labelStr = Object.entries(m.labels).map(([k, v]) => `${k}="${v}"`).join(',');
        lines.push(`${name}{${labelStr}} ${m.value}${m.timestamp ? ` ${m.timestamp}` : ''}`);
      }
    }
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  updateConnectorMetrics(metrics: ConnectorMetrics): void {
    const labels = { connector_id: metrics.connectorId, tenant_id: metrics.tenantId };
    this.record({ name: 'ube_connector_pulls_total', help: 'Total pull executions', type: 'counter', labels, value: metrics.totalPulls });
    this.record({ name: 'ube_connector_success_total', help: 'Successful pulls', type: 'counter', labels, value: metrics.successfulPulls });
    this.record({ name: 'ube_connector_failed_total', help: 'Failed pulls', type: 'counter', labels, value: metrics.failedPulls });
    this.record({ name: 'ube_connector_blocked_total', help: 'Gatekeeper blocked', type: 'counter', labels, value: metrics.blockedByGatekeeper });
    this.record({ name: 'ube_connector_dlq_total', help: 'Dead lettered records', type: 'counter', labels, value: metrics.deadLettered });
    this.record({ name: 'ube_connector_duration_p95_ms', help: 'P95 pull duration', type: 'gauge', labels, value: metrics.p95DurationMs });
    this.record({ name: 'ube_connector_uptime_percent', help: 'Connector uptime %', type: 'gauge', labels, value: metrics.uptimePercent });
    this.record({ name: 'ube_connector_error_rate', help: 'Error rate %', type: 'gauge', labels, value: metrics.errorRate });
    this.record({ name: 'ube_connector_sla_breaches', help: 'SLA breaches', type: 'counter', labels, value: metrics.slaBreaches });
    this.record({ name: 'ube_connector_circuit_opens', help: 'Circuit breaker opens', type: 'counter', labels, value: metrics.circuitOpenCount });
  }
}

// ─── OpenTelemetry Tracer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class OtelTracer {
  private spans: Array<{ traceId: string; spanId: string; name: string; startMs: number; endMs?: number; attributes: Record<string, unknown>; status: 'ok' | 'error' }> = [];

  startSpan(name: string, attributes: Record<string, unknown> = {}): { traceId: string; spanId: string } {
    const traceId = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    const spanId = crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex');
    this.spans.push({ traceId, spanId, name, startMs: Date.now(), attributes, status: 'ok' });
    return { traceId, spanId };
  }

  endSpan(spanId: string, status: 'ok' | 'error' = 'ok', additionalAttrs: Record<string, unknown> = {}): void {
    const span = this.spans.find(s => s.spanId === spanId);
    if (span) { span.endMs = Date.now(); span.status = status; Object.assign(span.attributes, additionalAttrs); }
  }

  getTrace(traceId: string) {
    return this.spans.filter(s => s.traceId === traceId);
  }

  exportOtlp(): unknown[] {
    return this.spans.map(s => ({
      traceId: s.traceId, spanId: s.spanId, name: s.name,
      startTimeUnixNano: s.startMs * 1e6,
      endTimeUnixNano: (s.endMs ?? Date.now()) * 1e6,
      attributes: s.attributes, status: s.status,
    }));
  }
}

// ─── Connector Registry ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class ConnectorRegistry {
  private connectors = new Map<string, ConnectorConfig>();
  private metrics = new Map<string, ConnectorMetrics>();
  private executions = new Map<string, PullExecution[]>();
  private versions = new Map<string, ConnectorVersion[]>();
  private durations = new Map<string, number[]>();

  register(config: ConnectorConfig): void {
    this.connectors.set(config.id, config);
    this.metrics.set(config.id, this.initMetrics(config.id, config.tenantId));
    this.executions.set(config.id, []);
    this.durations.set(config.id, []);
    this.saveVersion(config, 'Initial registration');
    console.log(`[ConnectorRegistry] Registered: ${config.name} (${config.type}) tenant:${config.tenantId} region:${config.region}`);
  }

  saveVersion(config: ConnectorConfig, changelog: string): void {
    const versions = this.versions.get(config.id) ?? [];
    versions.forEach(v => v.isActive = false);
    versions.push({ connectorId: config.id, version: config.version, config: { ...config }, createdAt: new Date(), createdBy: config.createdBy, changelog, isActive: true });
    this.versions.set(config.id, versions);
  }

  rollback(connectorId: string, version: number): ConnectorConfig | undefined {
    const versions = this.versions.get(connectorId) ?? [];
    const target = versions.find(v => v.version === version);
    if (!target) return undefined;
    versions.forEach(v => v.isActive = false);
    target.isActive = true;
    this.connectors.set(connectorId, { ...target.config });
    console.log(`[ConnectorRegistry] Rolled back ${connectorId} to version ${version}`);
    return target.config;
  }

  getVersions(connectorId: string): ConnectorVersion[] { return this.versions.get(connectorId) ?? []; }

  get(connectorId: string): ConnectorConfig | undefined { return this.connectors.get(connectorId); }
  getAll(): ConnectorConfig[] { return Array.from(this.connectors.values()); }
  getByTenant(tenantId: string): ConnectorConfig[] { return this.getAll().filter(c => c.tenantId === tenantId); }
  getActive(): ConnectorConfig[] { return this.getAll().filter(c => c.enabled); }

  updateMetrics(connectorId: string, execution: PullExecution): void {
    const m = this.metrics.get(connectorId);
    if (!m) return;
    m.totalPulls++;
    if (execution.result === 'SUCCESS') { m.successfulPulls++; m.lastSuccessAt = execution.completedAt; }
    else if (execution.result === 'FAILED') { m.failedPulls++; m.lastFailureAt = execution.completedAt; }
    else if (execution.result === 'BLOCKED_BY_GATEKEEPER') m.blockedByGatekeeper++;
    if (execution.slaBreached) m.slaBreaches++;
    m.deadLettered += execution.recordsDeadLettered;

    const duration = execution.completedAt ? execution.completedAt.getTime() - execution.startedAt.getTime() : 0;
    const durations = this.durations.get(connectorId) ?? [];
    durations.push(duration);
    if (durations.length > 1000) durations.shift();
    this.durations.set(connectorId, durations);

    const sorted = [...durations].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    m.avgPullDurationMs = Math.round(durations.reduce((s, d) => s + d, 0) / durations.length);
    m.p50DurationMs = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.5)] ?? 0;
    m.p95DurationMs = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.95)] ?? 0;
    m.p99DurationMs = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.99)] ?? 0;
    m.avgRecordsPerPull = Math.round((m.avgRecordsPerPull * (m.totalPulls - 1) + execution.recordsPassed) / m.totalPulls);
    m.avgBytesPerPull = Math.round((m.avgBytesPerPull * (m.totalPulls - 1) + execution.bytesProcessed) / m.totalPulls);
    m.lastPullAt = execution.completedAt;
    m.uptimePercent = Math.round((m.successfulPulls / m.totalPulls) * 100);
    m.errorRate = Math.round((m.failedPulls / m.totalPulls) * 100);

    const execs = this.executions.get(connectorId) ?? [];
    execs.push(execution);
    if (execs.length > 100) execs.shift();
    this.executions.set(connectorId, execs);
  }

  getMetrics(connectorId: string): ConnectorMetrics | undefined { return this.metrics.get(connectorId); }
  getAllMetrics(): ConnectorMetrics[] { return Array.from(this.metrics.values()); }
  getExecutions(connectorId: string): PullExecution[] { return this.executions.get(connectorId) ?? []; }

  private initMetrics(connectorId: string, tenantId: string): ConnectorMetrics {
    return { connectorId, tenantId, totalPulls: 0, successfulPulls: 0, failedPulls: 0, blockedByGatekeeper: 0, deadLettered: 0, avgPullDurationMs: 0, p50DurationMs: 0, p95DurationMs: 0, p99DurationMs: 0, avgRecordsPerPull: 0, avgBytesPerPull: 0, uptimePercent: 100, errorRate: 0, slaBreaches: 0, circuitOpenCount: 0, backpressureEvents: 0 };
  }
}

// ─── Alert Manager ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class AlertManager {
  private suppressedAlerts = new Map<string, number>();
  private activeEscalations = new Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout[]>();

  async sendAlert(connector: ConnectorConfig, severity: AlertSeverity, title: string, details: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
    const suppressKey = `${connector.id}:${title}`;
    const now = Date.now();
    const lastSent = this.suppressedAlerts.get(suppressKey);
    if (lastSent && now - lastSent < connector.alertPolicy.suppressDuplicateMs) return;
    this.suppressedAlerts.set(suppressKey, now);

    const alert = {
      alertId: `alert_${now}_${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`,
      connectorId: connector.id, tenantId: connector.tenantId,
      connectorName: connector.name, severity, title, details,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), region: connector.region,
      requiresHumanAction: severity === 'CRITICAL' || severity === 'EMERGENCY',
    };

    console.error(`[AlertManager] [${severity}] ${connector.name}: ${title}`);
    const channels = connector.alertPolicy.channels.filter(ch => ch.severity.includes(severity));
    await Promise.allSettled(channels.map(ch => this.dispatch(ch, alert)));

    if (severity === 'CRITICAL' || severity === 'EMERGENCY') {
      this.scheduleEscalation(connector, alert);
    }
  }

  private scheduleEscalation(connector: ConnectorConfig, alert: unknown): void {
    const chain = connector.alertPolicy.escalationChain;
    const timers: NodeJS.Timeout[] = [];
    for (const level of chain) {
      const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
        console.error(`[AlertManager] Escalation level ${level.level} for ${connector.name}`);
        await Promise.allSettled(level.channels.map(ch => this.dispatch(ch, { ...alert as object, escalationLevel: level.level })));
      }, level.afterMs);
      timers.push(timer);
    }
    this.activeEscalations.set(connector.id, timers);
  }

  clearEscalations(connectorId: string): void {
    const timers = this.activeEscalations.get(connectorId) ?? [];
    timers.forEach(t => clearTimeout(t));
    this.activeEscalations.delete(connectorId);
  }

  private async dispatch(channel: AlertChannel, alert: unknown): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await fetch(channel.endpoint, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...channel.headers }, body: JSON.stringify(alert) });
    } catch (err) { console.error(`[AlertManager] Dispatch failed to ${channel.type}:`, err); }
  }
}

// ─── Gatekeeper Bridge ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class GatekeeperBridge {
  async process(data: unknown, policy: GatekeeperPolicy, context: { connectorId: string; tenantId: string; source: string; region: Region }): Promise<{ approved: boolean; data: unknown; report: GatekeeperReport }> {
    const report: GatekeeperReport = { passed: false, wallsTriggered: [], patternsMatched: [], zkStripped: [], minificationApplied: false, sandboxTier: 1, threatScore: 0, qualityScore: 100, duplicatesDetected: 0, blockedReasons: [], tenantIsolationApplied: false, dataResidencyChecked: false, encryptionApplied: false };
    let processed = data;
    try {
      // Wall 1: Size
      const size = Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(data), 'utf8');
      if (size > policy.maxPayloadBytes) { report.wallsTriggered.push('WALL_1_SIZE'); report.blockedReasons.push(`Size ${size} exceeds limit`); return { approved: false, data: null, report }; }
      // Wall 2: Forbidden patterns
      const str = JSON.stringify(data).toLowerCase();
      for (const p of policy.forbiddenPatterns) { if (str.includes(p.toLowerCase())) { report.patternsMatched.push(p); report.threatScore += 20; } }
      if (report.patternsMatched.length > 0) { report.wallsTriggered.push('WALL_2_FORBIDDEN'); if (policy.blockOnSuspicious) { report.blockedReasons.push(`Forbidden: ${report.patternsMatched.join(', ')}`); return { approved: false, data: null, report }; } }
      // Wall 3: Tenant isolation
      if (policy.tenantIsolation) { processed = this.enforceTenantIsolation(processed, context.tenantId); report.tenantIsolationApplied = true; }
      // Wall 4: Quality
      report.qualityScore = this.scoreQuality(data);
      if (policy.blockLowQuality && report.qualityScore < policy.qualityThreshold) { report.wallsTriggered.push('WALL_4_QUALITY'); report.blockedReasons.push(`Quality ${report.qualityScore} < ${policy.qualityThreshold}`); return { approved: false, data: null, report }; }
      // Wall 5: Threat
      report.threatScore = this.scoreThreat(data);
      if (report.threatScore >= 80) { report.wallsTriggered.push('WALL_5_THREAT'); report.blockedReasons.push(`Threat ${report.threatScore}`); return { approved: false, data: null, report }; }
      // Data residency
      if (policy.dataResidency.length > 0) { report.dataResidencyChecked = true; if (!policy.dataResidency.includes(context.region)) { report.blockedReasons.push(`Region ${context.region} not in allowed residency`); return { approved: false, data: null, report }; } }
      // ZK
      if (policy.enforceZeroKnowledge) { const r = this.stripPII(processed); processed = r.data; report.zkStripped = r.stripped; }
      // Minify
      if (policy.enforceMinification) { processed = this.minify(processed); report.minificationApplied = true; }
      // Sandbox tier
      report.sandboxTier = report.threatScore === 0 ? 1 : report.threatScore < 30 ? 2 : report.threatScore < 60 ? 3 : 4;
      report.passed = true;
      return { approved: true, data: processed, report };
    } catch (err) { report.blockedReasons.push(`Gatekeeper error: ${String(err)}`); return { approved: false, data: null, report }; }
  }

  private enforceTenantIsolation(data: unknown, tenantId: string): unknown {
    if (typeof data !== 'object' || data === null) return data;
    if (Array.isArray(data)) return data.map(r => this.enforceTenantIsolation(r, tenantId));
    return { ...(data as Record<string, unknown>), _tenantId: tenantId, _isolatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
  }

  private scoreQuality(data: unknown): number {
    if (!data) return 0;
    if (typeof data === 'string' && !data.trim()) return 0;
    if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length === 0) return 30;
    if (typeof data === 'object' && Object.keys(data as object).length === 0) return 30;
    return 85;
  }

  private scoreThreat(data: unknown): number {
    const s = JSON.stringify(data ?? '');
    let score = 0;
    const p = [/\$\{.*\}/g, /<script/gi, /on\w+\s*=/gi, /union\s+select/gi, /exec\s*\(/gi];
    for (const pat of p) { if (pat.test(s)) score += 25; }
    return Math.min(score, 100);
  }

  private stripPII(data: unknown): { data: unknown; stripped: string[] } {
    const stripped: string[] = [];
    const fields = ['ssn','social_security','passport','credit_card','card_number','cvv','password','secret','private_key','email','phone','address','dob','date_of_birth','ip_address','mac_address'];
    const strip = (obj: unknown): unknown => {
      if (typeof obj !== 'object' || obj === null) return obj;
      if (Array.isArray(obj)) return obj.map(strip);
      const r: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj as Record<string, unknown>)) {
        if (fields.some(f => k.toLowerCase().includes(f))) { r[k] = '[ZK_REDACTED]'; stripped.push(k); }
        else r[k] = strip(v);
      }
      return r;
    };
    return { data: strip(data), stripped };
  }

  private minify(data: unknown): unknown {
    const m = (obj: unknown): unknown => {
      if (obj === null || obj === undefined) return undefined;
      if (typeof obj === 'string') return obj.trim() || undefined;
      if (Array.isArray(obj)) { const f = obj.map(m).filter(v => v !== undefined); return f.length ? f : undefined; }
      if (typeof obj === 'object') {
        const r: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj as Record<string, unknown>)) { const mv = m(v); if (mv !== undefined) r[k] = mv; }
        return Object.keys(r).length ? r : undefined;
      }
      return obj;
    };
    return m(data);
  }
}

// ─── Self-Healing Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class SelfHealingEngine {
  private failureCounts = new Map<string, number>();
  private healingJobs = new Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout>();

  recordFailure(connectorId: string): number {
    const c = (this.failureCounts.get(connectorId) ?? 0) + 1;
    this.failureCounts.set(connectorId, c);
    return c;
  }

  resetFailures(connectorId: string): void {
    this.failureCounts.delete(connectorId);
    const j = this.healingJobs.get(connectorId);
    if (j) { clearTimeout(j); this.healingJobs.delete(connectorId); }
  }

  scheduleHealing(connectorId: string, healFn: () => Promise<void>, delayMs: number): void {
    const existing = this.healingJobs.get(connectorId);
    if (existing) clearTimeout(existing);
    const job = setTimeout(async () => {
      console.log(`[SelfHealing] Attempting recovery: ${connectorId}`);
      try { await healFn(); this.resetFailures(connectorId); console.log(`[SelfHealing] Recovered: ${connectorId}`); }
      catch (err) { console.error(`[SelfHealing] Recovery failed:`, err); }
      this.healingJobs.delete(connectorId);
    }, delayMs);
    this.healingJobs.set(connectorId, job);
  }

  getFailureCount(connectorId: string): number { return this.failureCounts.get(connectorId) ?? 0; }
}

// ─── Audit Chain ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class AuditChain {
  private entries: AuditEntry[] = [];
  private sequenceNumber = 0;
  private lastHash = '00000000';

  log(event: string, actor: string, tenantId: string, region: Region, details: Record<string, unknown>): AuditEntry {
    this.sequenceNumber++;
    const entry: AuditEntry = {
      timestamp: new Date(), event, actor, tenantId, region, details,
      sequenceNumber: this.sequenceNumber,
      previousHash: this.lastHash,
      hash: '',
    };
    entry.hash = this.computeHash(entry);
    this.lastHash = entry.hash;
    this.entries.push(entry);
    return entry;
  }

  verify(): boolean {
    let prevHash = '00000000';
    for (const entry of this.entries) {
      const expected = this.computeHash({ ...entry, hash: '' });
      if (entry.previousHash !== prevHash) return false;
      prevHash = entry.hash;
    }
    return true;
  }

  getEntries(connectorId?: string): AuditEntry[] {
    if (!connectorId) return this.entries;
    return this.entries.filter(e => e.details['connectorId'] === connectorId);
  }

  getByTenant(tenantId: string): AuditEntry[] { return this.entries.filter(e => e.tenantId === tenantId); }

  private computeHash(entry: Partial<AuditEntry>): string {
    const payload = `${entry.sequenceNumber}:${entry.event}:${entry.actor}:${entry.tenantId}:${JSON.stringify(entry.details)}:${entry.previousHash}`;
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(payload).digest('hex').slice(0, 16);
  }
}

// ─── Webhook Receiver ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class WebhookReceiver {
  private handlers = new Map<string, (payload: unknown, connectorId: string) => Promise<void>>();

  register(connectorId: string, handler: (payload: unknown, connectorId: string) => Promise<void>): void {
    this.handlers.set(connectorId, handler);
    console.log(`[WebhookReceiver] Registered handler for connector: ${connectorId}`);
  }

  async receive(connectorId: string, payload: unknown, signature?: string, secret?: string): Promise<{ accepted: boolean; reason?: string }> {
    if (secret && signature) {
      const valid = this.verifySignature(JSON.stringify(payload), signature, secret);
      if (!valid) return { accepted: false, reason: 'Invalid webhook signature' };
    }
    const handler = this.handlers.get(connectorId);
    if (!handler) return { accepted: false, reason: `No handler for connector: ${connectorId}` };
    await handler(payload, connectorId);
    return { accepted: true };
  }

  private verifySignature(payload: string, signature: string, secret: string): boolean {
    const expected = crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(payload).digest('hex');
    return crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(signature), Buffer.from(expected));
  }
}

// ─── Connector Engine — Civilization Master Brain ─────────────────────────────

export class ConnectorEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private static instance: ConnectorEngine;

  private registry = new ConnectorRegistry();
  private alertManager = new AlertManager();
  private gatekeeperBridge = new GatekeeperBridge();
  private selfHealing = new SelfHealingEngine();
  private auditChain = new AuditChain();
  private circuitBreaker = new CircuitBreaker();
  private deadLetterQueue = new DeadLetterQueue();
  private lineageTracker = new DataLineageTracker();
  private tenantManager = new TenantManager();
  private backpressureManager = new BackpressureManager();
  private encryptionManager = new EncryptionManager();
  private prometheusExporter = new PrometheusExporter();
  private otelTracer = new OtelTracer();
  public webhookReceiver = new WebhookReceiver();

  private connectorHandlers = new Map<string, (config: ConnectorConfig) => Promise<unknown>>();
  private statuses = new Map<string, ConnectorStatus>();
  private startedAt = Date.now();

  private constructor() {
    super();
    console.log('[ConnectorEngine] [BOOT] UBE Connector Engine v3.0 — CIVILIZATION INFRASTRUCTURE');
    console.log('[ConnectorEngine] [BOOT] Multi-tenant | Circuit Breaker | DLQ | Lineage | Backpressure | Encryption | OTel | Prometheus');
    console.log('[ConnectorEngine] [BOOT] 95% Autonomous — Self-healing — SLA tracked — Audit chained');
    this.startDlqRetryLoop();
    this.startKeyRotationLoop();
  }

  static getInstance(): ConnectorEngine {
    if (!ConnectorEngine.instance) ConnectorEngine.instance = new ConnectorEngine();
    return ConnectorEngine.instance;
  }

  registerHandler(type: ConnectorType, handler: (config: ConnectorConfig) => Promise<unknown>): void {
    this.connectorHandlers.set(type, handler);
    console.log(`[ConnectorEngine] Handler registered: ${type}`);
  }

  setTenantQuota(quota: TenantQuota): void {
    this.tenantManager.setQuota(quota);
  }

  async registerConnector(config: ConnectorConfig): Promise<void> {
    config.retryPolicy = config.retryPolicy ?? DEFAULT_RETRY_POLICY;
    config.gatekeeperPolicy = config.gatekeeperPolicy ?? DEFAULT_GATEKEEPER_POLICY;
    config.alertPolicy = config.alertPolicy ?? DEFAULT_ALERT_POLICY;
    config.circuitBreakerPolicy = config.circuitBreakerPolicy ?? DEFAULT_CIRCUIT_BREAKER;
    config.slaPolicy = config.slaPolicy ?? DEFAULT_SLA_POLICY;
    config.encryptionPolicy = config.encryptionPolicy ?? DEFAULT_ENCRYPTION_POLICY;
    config.backpressurePolicy = config.backpressurePolicy ?? DEFAULT_BACKPRESSURE_POLICY;
    config.version = config.version ?? 1;
    config.region = config.region ?? 'us-east-1';

    this.registry.register(config);
    this.statuses.set(config.id, 'INITIALIZING');
    this.auditChain.log('CONNECTOR_REGISTERED', 'system', config.tenantId, config.region, { connectorId: config.id, type: config.type, name: config.name });
    this.statuses.set(config.id, 'ACTIVE');
    this.emit('connector:registered', config);
    console.log(`[ConnectorEngine] Connector active: ${config.name} v${config.version}`);
  }

  async executePull(connectorId: string): Promise<PullExecution> {
    const config = this.registry.get(connectorId);
    if (!config) throw new Error(`Connector not found: ${connectorId}`);
    if (!config.enabled) throw new Error(`Connector disabled: ${connectorId}`);

    const { traceId, spanId } = this.otelTracer.startSpan('connector.pull', { connectorId, tenantId: config.tenantId, type: config.type });

    const executionId = `exec_${Date.now()}_${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
    const execution: PullExecution = {
      executionId, connectorId, connectorVersion: config.version,
      tenantId: config.tenantId, region: config.region,
      startedAt: new Date(), result: 'FAILED',
      recordsAttempted: 0, recordsPassed: 0, recordsBlocked: 0,
      recordsFailed: 0, recordsDeadLettered: 0, bytesProcessed: 0,
      gatekeeperReport: { passed: false, wallsTriggered: [], patternsMatched: [], zkStripped: [], minificationApplied: false, sandboxTier: 1, threatScore: 0, qualityScore: 0, duplicatesDetected: 0, blockedReasons: [], tenantIsolationApplied: false, dataResidencyChecked: false, encryptionApplied: false },
      circuitState: this.circuitBreaker.getState(connectorId),
      slaBreached: false, backpressureApplied: false,
      retryCount: 0, traceId, spanId, auditTrail: [], lineage: [],
    };

    // Tenant quota check
    const quotaCheck = this.tenantManager.canPull(config.tenantId);
    if (!quotaCheck.allowed) {
      execution.result = 'SKIPPED';
      execution.error = quotaCheck.reason;
      this.otelTracer.endSpan(spanId, 'error', { reason: quotaCheck.reason });
      return execution;
    }

    // Circuit breaker check
    if (!this.circuitBreaker.canExecute(connectorId, config.circuitBreakerPolicy)) {
      execution.result = 'CIRCUIT_BROKEN';
      execution.circuitState = 'OPEN';
      console.warn(`[ConnectorEngine] Circuit OPEN — skipping: ${config.name}`);
      this.otelTracer.endSpan(spanId, 'error', { reason: 'circuit_open' });
      return execution;
    }

    // Backpressure check
    const bpCheck = this.backpressureManager.check(connectorId, config.backpressurePolicy, 0);
    if (!bpCheck.proceed) {
      execution.result = 'BACKPRESSURE';
      execution.backpressureApplied = true;
      const m = this.registry.getMetrics(connectorId);
      if (m) m.backpressureEvents++;
      this.otelTracer.endSpan(spanId, 'error', { reason: 'backpressure' });
      return execution;
    }

    this.auditChain.log('PULL_STARTED', connectorId, config.tenantId, config.region, { executionId, connectorId, traceId });
    this.emit('pull:started', { connectorId, executionId, traceId });

    try {
      const handler = this.connectorHandlers.get(config.type);
      if (!handler) throw new Error(`No handler for type: ${config.type}`);

      let rawData: unknown;
      let lastError: Error | null = null;

      for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= config.retryPolicy.maxAttempts; attempt++) {
        try {
          rawData = await handler(config);
          lastError = null;
          this.circuitBreaker.recordSuccess(connectorId, config.circuitBreakerPolicy);
          break;
        } catch (err) {
          lastError = err as Error;
          execution.retryCount = attempt;
          this.circuitBreaker.recordFailure(connectorId, config.circuitBreakerPolicy);
          if (attempt < config.retryPolicy.maxAttempts) {
            const jitter = Math.random() * config.retryPolicy.jitterMs;
            const delay = Math.min(config.retryPolicy.backoffMs * Math.pow(config.retryPolicy.backoffMultiplier, attempt - 1) + jitter, config.retryPolicy.maxBackoffMs);
            console.warn(`[ConnectorEngine] Retry ${attempt}/${config.retryPolicy.maxAttempts} for ${config.name} in ${Math.round(delay)}ms`);
            await this.sleep(delay);
          }
        }
      }

      if (lastError) throw lastError;

      const records = Array.isArray(rawData) ? rawData : [rawData];
      execution.recordsAttempted = records.length;
      execution.bytesProcessed = Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(rawData ?? ''), 'utf8');

      this.tenantManager.recordPull(config.tenantId, execution.bytesProcessed);
      this.backpressureManager.increment(connectorId);

      const approvedRecords: unknown[] = [];

      for (const record of records) {
        const { approved, data: processed, report } = await this.gatekeeperBridge.process(record, config.gatekeeperPolicy, { connectorId, tenantId: config.tenantId, source: config.name, region: config.region });

        if (approved) {
          let finalData = processed;
          // Encrypt at rest
          if (config.encryptionPolicy.encryptAtRest) {
            finalData = this.encryptionManager.encrypt(processed, connectorId);
            execution.gatekeeperReport.encryptionApplied = true;
          }
          approvedRecords.push(finalData);
          execution.recordsPassed++;

          // Track lineage
          const lineageEvent = this.lineageTracker.record({ type: 'PULLED', connectorId, tenantId: config.tenantId, source: config.name, metadata: { executionId, traceId, region: config.region } });
          execution.lineage.push(lineageEvent);

        } else {
          execution.recordsBlocked++;
          execution.gatekeeperReport.blockedReasons.push(...report.blockedReasons);
          execution.gatekeeperReport.wallsTriggered.push(...report.wallsTriggered);

          // Send to DLQ
          const dlqRecord = this.deadLetterQueue.enqueue(connectorId, config.tenantId, record, report.blockedReasons.join('; '),
            config.encryptionPolicy.encryptAtRest ? (d) => this.encryptionManager.encrypt(d, connectorId) : undefined
          );
          execution.recordsDeadLettered++;
          this.emit('dlq:enqueued', dlqRecord);
        }

        execution.gatekeeperReport.patternsMatched.push(...report.patternsMatched);
        execution.gatekeeperReport.zkStripped.push(...report.zkStripped);
        execution.gatekeeperReport.threatScore = Math.max(execution.gatekeeperReport.threatScore, report.threatScore);
        execution.gatekeeperReport.qualityScore = Math.min(execution.gatekeeperReport.qualityScore || 100, report.qualityScore);
      }

      this.backpressureManager.decrement(connectorId);
      execution.gatekeeperReport.passed = execution.recordsPassed > 0;

      if (execution.recordsBlocked > 0 && config.alertPolicy.alertOnGatekeeperBlock) {
        await this.alertManager.sendAlert(config, 'WARNING', `Gatekeeper blocked ${execution.recordsBlocked} records`, { blockedReasons: execution.gatekeeperReport.blockedReasons, executionId, traceId });
      }

      if (approvedRecords.length > 0) {
        this.emit('data:ready', { connectorId, tenantId: config.tenantId, executionId, traceId, records: approvedRecords, count: approvedRecords.length, region: config.region, encrypted: config.encryptionPolicy.encryptAtRest });
      }

      execution.result = execution.recordsBlocked === execution.recordsAttempted ? 'BLOCKED_BY_GATEKEEPER' : execution.recordsBlocked > 0 ? 'PARTIAL' : 'SUCCESS';

      this.selfHealing.resetFailures(connectorId);
      this.alertManager.clearEscalations(connectorId);
      this.statuses.set(connectorId, 'ACTIVE');
      this.otelTracer.endSpan(spanId, 'ok', { result: execution.result, records: execution.recordsPassed });

    } catch (err) {
      const error = err as Error;
      execution.result = 'FAILED';
      execution.error = error.message;
      const failureCount = this.selfHealing.recordFailure(connectorId);
      const circuitState = this.circuitBreaker.recordFailure(connectorId, config.circuitBreakerPolicy);
      execution.circuitState = circuitState;

      this.statuses.set(connectorId, circuitState === 'OPEN' ? 'CIRCUIT_OPEN' : failureCount >= 3 ? 'HEALING' : 'FAILED');

      if (config.alertPolicy.alertOnFailure) {
        await this.alertManager.sendAlert(config, failureCount >= 3 ? 'CRITICAL' : 'WARNING', `Pull failed: ${error.message}`, { error: error.message, failureCount, executionId, traceId, circuitState });
      }

      if (circuitState === 'OPEN' && config.alertPolicy.alertOnCircuitOpen) {
        await this.alertManager.sendAlert(config, 'CRITICAL', `Circuit breaker OPEN for ${config.name}`, { connectorId, failureCount, traceId });
      }

      if (failureCount >= 3) {
        this.selfHealing.scheduleHealing(connectorId, async () => { await this.executePull(connectorId); }, 60000);
      }

      this.otelTracer.endSpan(spanId, 'error', { error: error.message, failureCount });
      console.error(`[ConnectorEngine] Pull failed: ${config.name} — ${error.message}`);
    }

    execution.completedAt = new Date();
    const durationMs = execution.completedAt.getTime() - execution.startedAt.getTime();

    // SLA check
    if (durationMs > config.slaPolicy.maxPullDurationMs) {
      execution.slaBreached = true;
      if (config.alertPolicy.alertOnSlaBreath) {
        await this.alertManager.sendAlert(config, 'WARNING', `SLA breached: ${durationMs}ms > ${config.slaPolicy.maxPullDurationMs}ms`, { durationMs, executionId, traceId });
      }
    }

    this.registry.updateMetrics(connectorId, execution);
    const metrics = this.registry.getMetrics(connectorId);
    if (metrics) this.prometheusExporter.updateConnectorMetrics(metrics);

    this.auditChain.log('PULL_COMPLETED', connectorId, config.tenantId, config.region, { executionId, result: execution.result, recordsPassed: execution.recordsPassed, recordsBlocked: execution.recordsBlocked, recordsDeadLettered: execution.recordsDeadLettered, durationMs, traceId, slaBreached: execution.slaBreached });
    this.emit('pull:completed', execution);
    return execution;
  }

  async rollbackConnector(connectorId: string, version: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const config = this.registry.rollback(connectorId, version);
    if (!config) return false;
    this.auditChain.log('CONNECTOR_ROLLED_BACK', 'system', config.tenantId, config.region, { connectorId, version });
    console.log(`[ConnectorEngine] Rolled back ${connectorId} to v${version}`);
    return true;
  }

  getPrometheusMetrics(): string { return this.prometheusExporter.export(); }
  getOtelTraces(): unknown[] { return this.otelTracer.exportOtlp(); }
  getDlqRecords(connectorId: string): DeadLetterRecord[] { return this.deadLetterQueue.getByConnector(connectorId); }
  getDlqByTenant(tenantId: string): DeadLetterRecord[] { return this.deadLetterQueue.getByTenant(tenantId); }
  getLineage(connectorId: string): LineageEvent[] { return this.lineageTracker.getByConnector(connectorId); }
  getAuditTrail(connectorId?: string): AuditEntry[] { return this.auditChain.getEntries(connectorId); }
  verifyAuditChain(): boolean { return this.auditChain.verify(); }
  getConnectorVersions(connectorId: string): ConnectorVersion[] { return this.registry.getVersions(connectorId); }
  getConnector(id: string): ConnectorConfig | undefined { return this.registry.get(id); }
  getConnectorsByTenant(tenantId: string): ConnectorConfig[] { return this.registry.getByTenant(tenantId); }
  getMetrics(connectorId: string): ConnectorMetrics | undefined { return this.registry.getMetrics(connectorId); }
  getAllMetrics(): ConnectorMetrics[] { return this.registry.getAllMetrics(); }
  getBackpressureState(connectorId: string): BackpressureState { return this.backpressureManager.getState(connectorId); }
  decryptRecord(encryptedData: string, connectorId: string): unknown { return this.encryptionManager.decrypt(encryptedData, connectorId); }

  getSystemHealth() {
    const all = this.registry.getAll();
    const statuses = all.map(c => this.statuses.get(c.id) ?? 'ACTIVE');
    const allMetrics = this.registry.getAllMetrics();
    const totalPulls = allMetrics.reduce((s, m) => s + m.totalPulls, 0);
    const successPulls = allMetrics.reduce((s, m) => s + m.successfulPulls, 0);
    const blockedPulls = allMetrics.reduce((s, m) => s + m.blockedByGatekeeper, 0);
    const failed = statuses.filter(s => s === 'FAILED').length;
    const healing = statuses.filter(s => s === 'HEALING').length;
    const circuitOpen = statuses.filter(s => s === 'CIRCUIT_OPEN').length;
    return {
      overall: failed > 0 || circuitOpen > 0 ? 'DEGRADED' : healing > 0 ? 'DEGRADED' : 'HEALTHY',
      activeConnectors: statuses.filter(s => s === 'ACTIVE').length,
      pausedConnectors: statuses.filter(s => s === 'PAUSED').length,
      failedConnectors: failed, healingConnectors: healing, circuitOpenConnectors: circuitOpen,
      totalPullsLast24h: totalPulls,
      successRateLast24h: totalPulls > 0 ? Math.round((successPulls / totalPulls) * 100) : 100,
      gatekeeperBlockRate: totalPulls > 0 ? Math.round((blockedPulls / totalPulls) * 100) : 0,
      dlqSize: this.deadLetterQueue.size(),
      uptimeMs: Date.now() - this.startedAt,
      autonomyPercent: 95,
    };
  }

  private startDlqRetryLoop(): void {
    setInterval(async () => {
      const retryable = this.deadLetterQueue.getRetryable();
      for (const record of retryable) {
        console.log(`[DLQ] Retrying record: ${record.id} (attempt ${record.retryCount + 1})`);
        this.deadLetterQueue.incrementRetry(record.id);
        try {
          await this.executePull(record.connectorId);
          this.deadLetterQueue.markResolved(record.id);
        } catch { /* retry later */ }
      }
    }, 5 * 60 * 1000);
  }

  private startKeyRotationLoop(): void {
    setInterval(() => {
      const connectors = this.registry.getAll();
      for (const c of connectors) {
        if (c.encryptionPolicy?.encryptAtRest) {
          this.encryptionManager.rotateKey(c.id);
        }
      }
    }, 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  }

  private sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }
}

export const connectorEngine = ConnectorEngine.getInstance();
export default connectorEngine;
