// ─── Response Cache ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class ResponseCache {
  private cache = new Map<string, { data: unknown; cachedAt: number; etag?: string; lastModified?: string }>();

  buildKey(url: string, config: CacheConfig, queryParams?: Record<string, string>): string {
    let key = url;
    if (config.varyByQueryParams && queryParams) {
      const sorted = Object.entries(queryParams).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b));
      key += '?' + sorted.map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`).join('&');
    }
    return crypto.createHash('md5').update(key).digest('hex');
  }

  get(key: string, config: CacheConfig): { data: unknown; stale: boolean } | null {
    const entry = this.cache.get(key);
    if (!entry) return null;
    const age = Date.now() - entry.cachedAt;
    if (age <= config.ttlMs) return { data: entry.data, stale: false };
    if (config.staleWhileRevalidate && age <= config.ttlMs * 2) return { data: entry.data, stale: true };
    if (!config.staleWhileRevalidate) { this.cache.delete(key); return null; }
    return null;
  }

  set(key: string, data: unknown, etag?: string, lastModified?: string): void {
    if (this.cache.size >= 10000) {
      const oldest = Array.from(this.cache.entries()).sort((a, b) => a[1].cachedAt - b[1].cachedAt)[0];
      if (oldest) this.cache.delete(oldest[0]);
    }
    this.cache.set(key, { data, cachedAt: Date.now(), etag, lastModified });
  }

  getEtag(key: string): string | undefined { return this.cache.get(key)?.etag; }
  getLastModified(key: string): string | undefined { return this.cache.get(key)?.lastModified; }
  invalidate(key: string): void { this.cache.delete(key); }
  size(): number { return this.cache.size; }
}

// ─── Rate Limiter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class RateLimiter {
  private windows = new Map<string, number[]>();
  private tokenBuckets = new Map<string, { tokens: number; lastRefill: number }>();

  async throttle(connectorId: string, config: RateLimitConfig): Promise<void> {
    switch (config.strategy) {
      case 'fixed_window': return this.fixedWindow(connectorId, config);
      case 'sliding_window': return this.slidingWindow(connectorId, config);
      case 'token_bucket': return this.tokenBucket(connectorId, config);
      default: return this.slidingWindow(connectorId, config);
    }
  }

  private async fixedWindow(connectorId: string, config: RateLimitConfig): Promise<void> {
    const limit = config.requestsPerSecond ?? config.requestsPerMinute ?? config.requestsPerHour ?? 60;
    const windowMs = config.requestsPerSecond ? 1000 : config.requestsPerMinute ? 60000 : 3600000;
    const now = Date.now();
    const reqs = this.windows.get(connectorId) ?? [];
    const windowStart = Math.floor(now / windowMs) * windowMs;
    const windowReqs = reqs.filter(t => t >= windowStart);
    if (windowReqs.length >= limit) {
      const waitMs = windowMs - (now - windowStart) + 50;
      console.log(`[HttpConnector] Rate limit (fixed window) — waiting ${waitMs}ms`);
      await this.sleep(waitMs);
    }
    windowReqs.push(Date.now());
    this.windows.set(connectorId, windowReqs);
  }

  private async slidingWindow(connectorId: string, config: RateLimitConfig): Promise<void> {
    const limit = config.requestsPerSecond ?? config.requestsPerMinute ?? config.requestsPerHour ?? 60;
    const windowMs = config.requestsPerSecond ? 1000 : config.requestsPerMinute ? 60000 : 3600000;
    const now = Date.now();
    let reqs = (this.windows.get(connectorId) ?? []).filter(t => now - t < windowMs);
    if (reqs.length >= limit) {
      const waitMs = windowMs - (now - reqs[0]) + 50;
      console.log(`[HttpConnector] Rate limit (sliding window) — waiting ${waitMs}ms`);
      await this.sleep(waitMs);
      reqs = reqs.filter(t => Date.now() - t < windowMs);
    }
    reqs.push(Date.now());
    this.windows.set(connectorId, reqs);
  }

  private async tokenBucket(connectorId: string, config: RateLimitConfig): Promise<void> {
    const rate = config.requestsPerSecond ?? 1;
    const burst = config.burstAllowed ?? rate;
    const now = Date.now();
    let bucket = this.tokenBuckets.get(connectorId) ?? { tokens: burst, lastRefill: now };
    const elapsed = (now - bucket.lastRefill) / 1000;
    bucket.tokens = Math.min(burst, bucket.tokens + elapsed * rate);
    bucket.lastRefill = now;
    if (bucket.tokens < 1) {
      const waitMs = Math.ceil((1 - bucket.tokens) / rate * 1000);
      console.log(`[HttpConnector] Token bucket empty — waiting ${waitMs}ms`);
      await this.sleep(waitMs);
      bucket.tokens = 1;
    }
    bucket.tokens--;
    this.tokenBuckets.set(connectorId, bucket);
  }

  private sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }
}

// ─── Auth Manager ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class AuthManager {
  private tokenCache = new Map<string, { token: string; expiresAt: number; tokenType?: string }>();

  async buildHeaders(auth: AuthConfig, connectorId: string, method: string, url: string, body?: unknown): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
    switch (auth.type) {
      case 'api_key':
        if (auth.apiKey) headers[auth.apiKey.header] = auth.apiKey.value;
        break;
      case 'bearer': {
        if (!auth.bearer) break;
        const token = await this.getOrRefreshBearer(connectorId, auth.bearer);
        headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
        break;
      }
      case 'basic':
        if (auth.basic) headers['Authorization'] = `Basic ${Buffer.from(`${auth.basic.username}:${auth.basic.password}`).toString('base64')}`;
        break;
      case 'oauth2':
        if (auth.oauth2) { const t = await this.getOAuth2Token(connectorId, auth.oauth2); headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${t}`; }
        break;
      case 'hmac':
        if (auth.hmac) Object.assign(headers, this.buildHmacHeaders(auth.hmac, method, url, body));
        break;
      case 'aws_sigv4':
        if (auth.awsSigV4) Object.assign(headers, this.buildAwsSigV4Headers(auth.awsSigV4, method, url, body));
        break;
      case 'custom':
        if (auth.custom) Object.assign(headers, auth.custom.headers);
        break;
    }
    return headers;
  }

  private async getOrRefreshBearer(connectorId: string, bearer: NonNullable<AuthConfig['bearer']>): Promise<string> {
    const cached = this.tokenCache.get(connectorId);
    if (cached && Date.now() < cached.expiresAt - 60000) return cached.token;
    if (!bearer.refreshUrl || !bearer.refreshToken) return bearer.token;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(bearer.refreshUrl, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ refresh_token: bearer.refreshToken }) });
      const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
      const token = String(data['access_token'] ?? bearer.token);
      const expiresIn = Number(data['expires_in'] ?? 3600);
      this.tokenCache.set(connectorId, { token, expiresAt: Date.now() + expiresIn * 1000 });
      return token;
    } catch { return bearer.token; }
  }

  private async getOAuth2Token(connectorId: string, oauth2: OAuth2Config): Promise<string> {
    const cacheKey = `oauth2:${connectorId}`;
    const cached = this.tokenCache.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached && Date.now() < cached.expiresAt - 60000) return cached.token;
    const body = new URLSearchParams({ grant_type: oauth2.grantType, client_id: oauth2.clientId, client_secret: oauth2.clientSecret, scope: oauth2.scope.join(' ') });
    if (oauth2.refreshToken) body.set('refresh_token', oauth2.refreshToken);
    if (oauth2.audience) body.set('audience', oauth2.audience);
    const res = await fetch(oauth2.tokenUrl, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: body.toString() });
    const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
    const token = String(data['access_token'] ?? '');
    const expiresIn = Number(data['expires_in'] ?? 3600);
    this.tokenCache.set(cacheKey, { token, expiresAt: Date.now() + expiresIn * 1000, tokenType: String(data['token_type'] ?? 'Bearer') });
    return token;
  }

  private buildHmacHeaders(hmac: HmacConfig, method: string, url: string, body?: unknown): Record<string, string> {
    const timestamp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString();
    const payload = hmac.signBody && body ? `${method}\n${url}\n${timestamp}\n${JSON.stringify(body)}` : `${method}\n${url}\n${timestamp}`;
    const sig = crypto.createHmac(hmac.algorithm, hmac.secret).update(payload).digest('hex');
    const headers: Record<string, string> = { [hmac.headerName]: sig };
    if (hmac.includeTimestamp && hmac.timestampHeader) headers[hmac.timestampHeader] = timestamp;
    return headers;
  }

  private buildAwsSigV4Headers(config: AwsSigV4Config, method: string, url: string, body?: unknown): Record<string, string> {
    const now = new Date();
    const dateStr = now.toISOString().replace(/[:-]|\.\d{3}/g, '').slice(0, 8);
    const datetimeStr = now.toISOString().replace(/[:-]|\.\d{3}/g, '');
    const parsedUrl = new URL(url);
    const bodyStr = body ? JSON.stringify(body) : '';
    const bodyHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bodyStr).digest('hex');
    const canonicalHeaders = `host:${parsedUrl.host}\nx-amz-date:${datetimeStr}\n`;
    const signedHeaders = 'host;x-amz-date';
    const canonicalRequest = [method, parsedUrl.pathname, parsedUrl.search.slice(1), canonicalHeaders, signedHeaders, bodyHash].join('\n');
    const credentialScope = `${dateStr}/${config.region}/${config.service}/aws4_request`;
    const stringToSign = `AWS4-HMAC-SHA256\n${datetimeStr}\n${credentialScope}\n${crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalRequest).digest('hex')}`;
    const signingKey = this.deriveSigningKey(config.secretAccessKey, dateStr, config.region, config.service);
    const signature = crypto.createHmac('sha256', signingKey).update(stringToSign).digest('hex');
    const authHeader = `AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=${config.accessKeyId}/${credentialScope}, SignedHeaders=${signedHeaders}, Signature=${signature}`;
    const headers: Record<string, string> = { 'Authorization': authHeader, 'x-amz-date': datetimeStr, 'x-amz-content-sha256': bodyHash };
    if (config.sessionToken) headers['x-amz-security-token'] = config.sessionToken;
    return headers;
  }

  private deriveSigningKey(secret: string, date: string, region: string, service: string): Buffer {
    const kDate = crypto.createHmac('sha256', `AWS4${secret}`).update(date).digest();
    const kRegion = crypto.createHmac('sha256', kDate).update(region).digest();
    const kService = crypto.createHmac('sha256', kRegion).update(service).digest();
    return crypto.createHmac('sha256', kService).update('aws4_request').digest();
  }
}

// ─── Idempotency Manager ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class IdempotencyManager {
  private keys = new Map<string, { key: string; createdAt: number }>();

  getOrCreate(connectorId: string, config: IdempotencyConfig, body?: unknown): string {
    const existing = this.keys.get(connectorId);
    if (existing && Date.now() - existing.createdAt < config.ttlMs) return existing.key;
    let key: string;
    switch (config.keyStrategy) {
      case 'uuid': key = crypto.randomUUID(); break;
      case 'hash_body': key = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(body ?? '')).digest('hex').slice(0, 32); break;
      case 'timestamp': key = `${connectorId}-${Date.now()}`; break;
      default: key = crypto.randomUUID();
    }
    this.keys.set(connectorId, { key, createdAt: Date.now() });
    return key;
  }

  clear(connectorId: string): void { this.keys.delete(connectorId); }
}

// ─── Diff Detector ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class DiffDetector {
  private hashes = new Map<string, string>();

  hasChanged(connectorId: string, records: unknown[], config: DiffDetectionConfig): unknown[] {
    if (!config.onlyProcessChanged) return records;
    const changed: unknown[] = [];
    for (const record of records) {
      const hash = this.computeHash(record, config);
      const key = this.getRecordKey(record, config);
      const fullKey = `${connectorId}:${key}`;
      const prev = this.hashes.get(fullKey);
      if (prev !== hash) { changed.push(record); this.hashes.set(fullKey, hash); }
    }
    return changed;
  }

  private computeHash(record: unknown, config: DiffDetectionConfig): string {
    if (config.hashField && typeof record === 'object' && record !== null) {
      const val = (record as Record<string, unknown>)[config.hashField];
      return String(val ?? '');
    }
    const data = config.compareFields && typeof record === 'object' && record !== null
      ? Object.fromEntries(config.compareFields.map(f => [f, (record as Record<string, unknown>)[f]]))
      : record;
    return crypto.createHash('md5').update(JSON.stringify(data)).digest('hex');
  }

  private getRecordKey(record: unknown, config: DiffDetectionConfig): string {
    if (config.hashField && typeof record === 'object' && record !== null) {
      return String((record as Record<string, unknown>)[config.hashField] ?? Math.random());
    }
    return crypto.createHash('md5').update(JSON.stringify(record)).digest('hex').slice(0, 8);
  }
}

// ─── Schema Detector ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class SchemaDetector {
  private knownSchemas = new Map<string, Record<string, string>>();

  detect(connectorId: string, records: unknown[]): Record<string, string> {
    if (!records.length) return {};
    const sample = records[0];
    if (typeof sample !== 'object' || sample === null) return {};
    const schema: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(sample as Record<string, unknown>)) schema[key] = this.inferType(val);
    const prev = this.knownSchemas.get(connectorId);
    if (prev) {
      const changed = Object.keys(schema).filter(k => prev[k] && prev[k] !== schema[k]);
      if (changed.length > 0) console.warn(`[HttpConnector] Schema changed for ${connectorId}: ${changed.join(', ')}`);
    }
    this.knownSchemas.set(connectorId, schema);
    return schema;
  }

  private inferType(val: unknown): string {
    if (val === null) return 'null';
    if (typeof val === 'boolean') return 'boolean';
    if (typeof val === 'number') return Number.isInteger(val) ? 'integer' : 'float';
    if (typeof val === 'string') {
      if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(val)) return 'datetime';
      if (/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/i.test(val)) return 'uuid';
      if (/^https?:\/\//.test(val)) return 'url';
      if (/^[\w.-]+@[\w.-]+\.\w+$/.test(val)) return 'email';
      if (/^-?\d+\.?\d*$/.test(val)) return 'numeric_string';
      return 'string';
    }
    if (Array.isArray(val)) return 'array';
    if (typeof val === 'object') return 'object';
    return 'unknown';
  }
}

// ─── Anomaly Detector ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class AnomalyDetector {
  private baselines = new Map<string, { mean: number; stdDev: number; count: number; min: number; max: number }>();

  detect(connectorId: string, recordCount: number, durationMs: number): string[] {
    const anomalies: string[] = [];
    const key = connectorId;
    const b = this.baselines.get(key);
    if (!b) { this.baselines.set(key, { mean: recordCount, stdDev: 0, count: 1, min: recordCount, max: recordCount }); return anomalies; }
    const n = b.count + 1;
    const newMean = (b.mean * b.count + recordCount) / n;
    const newStdDev = Math.sqrt((Math.pow(b.stdDev, 2) * b.count + Math.pow(recordCount - newMean, 2)) / n);
    this.baselines.set(key, { mean: newMean, stdDev: newStdDev, count: n, min: Math.min(b.min, recordCount), max: Math.max(b.max, recordCount) });
    if (newStdDev > 0 && Math.abs(recordCount - b.mean) > 3 * newStdDev) anomalies.push(`Record count anomaly: ${recordCount} vs avg ${Math.round(b.mean)}`);
    if (recordCount === 0) anomalies.push('Empty response — API may have changed or source is down');
    if (durationMs > 30000) anomalies.push(`Slow response: ${durationMs}ms`);
    return anomalies;
  }
}

// ─── Response Transformer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class ResponseTransformer {
  extract(data: unknown, path?: string): unknown[] {
    if (!path) return Array.isArray(data) ? data : [data];
    const parts = path.split('.');
    let current: unknown = data;
    for (const part of parts) {
      if (typeof current !== 'object' || current === null) return [];
      current = (current as Record<string, unknown>)[part];
    }
    return Array.isArray(current) ? current : current !== undefined ? [current] : [];
  }

  transform(records: unknown[], mapping: ResponseMappingConfig): unknown[] {
    return records.map(record => {
      if (typeof record !== 'object' || record === null) return record;
      let r = { ...(record as Record<string, unknown>) };
      if (mapping.includeFields?.length) {
        const inc: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        for (const f of mapping.includeFields) { if (f in r) inc[f] = r[f]; }
        r = inc;
      }
      if (mapping.excludeFields?.length) { for (const f of mapping.excludeFields) delete r[f]; }
      if (mapping.transformations) {
        for (const t of mapping.transformations) {
          if (!(t.field in r)) continue;
          const val = r[t.field];
          const target = t.targetField ?? t.field;
          switch (t.transform) {
            case 'lowercase': r[target] = String(val).toLowerCase(); break;
            case 'uppercase': r[target] = String(val).toUpperCase(); break;
            case 'trim': r[target] = String(val).trim(); break;
            case 'parse_date': r[target] = new Date(String(val)).toISOString(); break;
            case 'parse_number': r[target] = parseFloat(String(val)); break;
            case 'stringify': r[target] = JSON.stringify(val); break;
            case 'parse_json': try { r[target] = JSON.parse(String(val)); } catch { r[target] = val; } break;
            case 'base64_decode': r[target] = Buffer.from(String(val), 'base64').toString('utf8'); break;
            case 'url_decode': r[target] = decodeURIComponent(String(val)); break;
          }
        }
      }
      if (mapping.flattenNested) r = this.flatten(r) as Record<string, unknown>;
      return r;
    });
  }

  private flatten(obj: Record<string, unknown>, prefix = ''): Record<string, unknown> {
    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(obj)) {
      const k = prefix ? `${prefix}_${key}` : key;
      if (typeof val === 'object' && val !== null && !Array.isArray(val)) Object.assign(result, this.flatten(val as Record<string, unknown>, k));
      else result[k] = val;
    }
    return result;
  }
}

// ─── GraphQL Engine ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class GraphqlEngine {
  async execute(baseUrl: string, path: string, config: GraphqlConfig, headers: Record<string, string>): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const body = { query: config.query, variables: config.variables ?? {}, operationName: config.operationName };
    const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}${path}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { ...headers, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GraphQL HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const json = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (json['errors']) { const errs = json['errors'] as unknown[]; throw new Error(`GraphQL errors: ${JSON.stringify(errs)}`); }
    const data = json['data'] as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (!data) return [];
    const values = Object.values(data);
    const first = values[0];
    if (Array.isArray(first)) return first;
    if (typeof first === 'object' && first !== null && config.paginationField) {
      const nodes = (first as Record<string, unknown>)[config.paginationField];
      return Array.isArray(nodes) ? nodes : [first];
    }
    return Array.isArray(first) ? first : [first];
  }

  async executePaginated(baseUrl: string, path: string, config: GraphqlConfig, headers: Record<string, string>): Promise<unknown[]> {
    let allRecords: unknown[] = [];
    let cursor: string | undefined;
    let hasNext = true;
    let page = 0;
    const maxPages = 100;

    while (hasNext && page < maxPages) {
      const variables = { ...config.variables, after: cursor, first: 100 };
      const body = { query: config.query, variables, operationName: config.operationName };
      const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}${path}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { ...headers, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GraphQL HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const json = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (json['errors']) break;
      const data = json['data'] as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (!data) break;
      const connection = Object.values(data)[0] as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (!connection) break;
      const nodes = config.paginationField ? (connection[config.paginationField] as unknown[]) : [];
      if (nodes) allRecords = allRecords.concat(nodes);
      const pageInfo = config.pageInfoPath ? this.extractPath(connection, config.pageInfoPath) as Record<string, unknown> : null;
      hasNext = pageInfo && config.hasNextPagePath ? Boolean(this.extractPath(pageInfo, config.hasNextPagePath)) : false;
      cursor = pageInfo && config.endCursorPath ? String(this.extractPath(pageInfo, config.endCursorPath) ?? '') : undefined;
      if (!cursor) hasNext = false;
      page++;
    }

    return allRecords;
  }

  private extractPath(obj: unknown, path: string): unknown {
    const parts = path.split('.');
    let current = obj;
    for (const p of parts) {
      if (typeof current !== 'object' || current === null) return undefined;
      current = (current as Record<string, unknown>)[p];
    }
    return current;
  }
}

// ─── SOAP Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class SoapEngine {
  async execute(baseUrl: string, path: string, config: SoapConfig, headers: Record<string, string>): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const contentType = config.soapVersion === '1.2' ? 'application/soap+xml' : 'text/xml';
    const soapAction = config.soapVersion === '1.1' ? config.action : undefined;
    const envelope = this.buildEnvelope(config);
    const reqHeaders: Record<string, string> = { ...headers, 'Content-Type': `${contentType}; charset=utf-8` };
    if (soapAction) reqHeaders['SOAPAction'] = soapAction;
    const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}${path}`, { method: 'POST', headers: reqHeaders, body: envelope });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`SOAP HTTP ${res.status}: ${res.statusText}`);
    const xml = await res.text();
    return this.parseResponse(xml, config.responsePath);
  }

  private buildEnvelope(config: SoapConfig): string {
    const ns = config.namespace;
    const secHeader = config.usernameToken ? `<wsse:Security><wsse:UsernameToken><wsse:Username>${config.usernameToken.username}</wsse:Username><wsse:Password>${config.usernameToken.password}</wsse:Password></wsse:UsernameToken></wsse:Security>` : '';
    return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><soap:Envelope xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:ns="${ns}"><soap:Header>${secHeader}</soap:Header><soap:Body>${config.envelope}</soap:Body></soap:Envelope>`;
  }

  private parseResponse(xml: string, responsePath: string): unknown[] {
    const records: unknown[] = [];
    const tagRegex = new RegExp(`<${responsePath}[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/${responsePath}>`, 'g');
    let match;
    while ((match = tagRegex.exec(xml)) !== null) {
      const record: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      const fieldRegex = /<(\w+)[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/\1>/g;
      let fm;
      while ((fm = fieldRegex.exec(match[1])) !== null) record[fm[1]] = fm[2].trim();
      if (Object.keys(record).length > 0) records.push(record);
    }
    return records;
  }
}

// ─── API Version Detector ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class ApiVersionDetector {
  private knownVersions = new Map<string, string>();

  check(connectorId: string, response: Response, config: ApiVersionConfig): void {
    if (!config.detect) return;
    let version: string | undefined;
    if (config.versionHeader) version = response.headers.get(config.versionHeader) ?? undefined;
    if (!version) return;
    const known = this.knownVersions.get(connectorId);
    if (known && known !== version) {
      console.warn(`[HttpConnector] API version changed for ${connectorId}: ${known} → ${version}`);
      if (config.alertOnChange) console.error(`[HttpConnector] ALERT: API version change detected — review connector config`);
    }
    this.knownVersions.set(connectorId, version);
  }
}

// ─── HTTP Connector ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class HttpConnector {
  private rateLimiter = new RateLimiter();
  private authManager = new AuthManager();
  private schemaDetector = new SchemaDetector();
  private anomalyDetector = new AnomalyDetector();
  private transformer = new ResponseTransformer();
  private cache = new ResponseCache();
  private idempotency = new IdempotencyManager();
  private diffDetector = new DiffDetector();
  private graphql = new GraphqlEngine();
  private soap = new SoapEngine();
  private versionDetector = new ApiVersionDetector();

  constructor() {
    connectorEngine.registerHandler('http', async (config: ConnectorConfig) => {
      return this.pull(config as HttpConnectorConfig);
    });
    console.log('[HttpConnector] [BOOT] HTTP Connector v3.0 loaded');
    console.log('[HttpConnector] Protocols: REST, GraphQL, SOAP, WebSocket, SSE');
    console.log('[HttpConnector] Auth: API Key, Bearer, Basic, OAuth2, HMAC, AWS SigV4, mTLS');
    console.log('[HttpConnector] Features: Cache, Diff Detection, Rate Limiting, Proxy, Cert Pinning, Idempotency');
  }

  async pull(config: HttpConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { http } = config;
    const startTime = Date.now();

    // Route by protocol
    switch (http.protocol) {
      case 'graphql': return this.pullGraphql(config);
      case 'soap':    return this.pullSoap(config);
      case 'websocket': return this.pullWebSocket(config);
      case 'sse':     return this.pullSse(config);
      default:        return this.pullRest(config, startTime);
    }
  }

  private async pullRest(config: HttpConnectorConfig, startTime: number): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { http } = config;
    let allRecords: unknown[] = [];
    let page = 1;
    let cursor: string | undefined;
    let nextUrl: string | undefined;
    const maxPages = http.pagination.maxPages ?? 100;

    const authHeaders = await this.authManager.buildHeaders(http.auth, config.id, http.method, `${http.baseUrl}${http.path}`, http.body);
    const baseHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Accept': 'application/json',
      'Accept-Encoding': http.compressionConfig?.acceptEncoding ?? 'gzip, deflate, br',
      'User-Agent': 'UBE-ConnectorEngine/3.0',
      ...http.headers,
      ...authHeaders,
    };

    // Idempotency key for non-GET requests
    if (http.idempotencyConfig?.enabled && http.method !== 'GET') {
      const ikey = this.idempotency.getOrCreate(config.id, http.idempotencyConfig, http.body);
      baseHeaders[http.idempotencyConfig.headerName] = ikey;
    }

    // mTLS agent setup
    let agent: https.Agent | undefined;
    if (http.mtlsConfig) {
      agent = new https.Agent({ cert: http.mtlsConfig.certPem, key: http.mtlsConfig.keyPem, ca: http.mtlsConfig.caPem, rejectUnauthorized: http.mtlsConfig.rejectUnauthorized, servername: http.mtlsConfig.serverName });
    }

    console.log(`[HttpConnector] Pull: ${config.name} → ${http.baseUrl}${http.path} [${http.method}]`);

    do {
      await this.rateLimiter.throttle(config.id, http.rateLimit);

      const targetUrl = nextUrl ?? `${http.baseUrl}${http.path}`;
      const url = new URL(targetUrl);
      const params = { ...http.queryParams };

      switch (http.pagination.type) {
        case 'page': params[http.pagination.pageParam ?? 'page'] = String(page); params[http.pagination.pageSizeParam ?? 'per_page'] = String(http.pagination.pageSize ?? 100); break;
        case 'offset': params[http.pagination.offsetParam ?? 'offset'] = String((page - 1) * (http.pagination.pageSize ?? 100)); params[http.pagination.pageSizeParam ?? 'limit'] = String(http.pagination.pageSize ?? 100); break;
        case 'cursor': if (cursor) params[http.pagination.cursorParam ?? 'cursor'] = cursor; if (http.pagination.pageSize) params[http.pagination.pageSizeParam ?? 'limit'] = String(http.pagination.pageSize); break;
      }

      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) url.searchParams.set(k, v);

      // Cache check
      const cacheKey = this.cache.buildKey(url.toString(), http.cacheConfig, params);
      if (http.cacheConfig?.enabled && http.method === 'GET') {
        const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey, http.cacheConfig);
        if (cached && !cached.stale) { allRecords = allRecords.concat(Array.isArray(cached.data) ? cached.data : [cached.data]); page = maxPages + 1; break; }
        const etag = this.cache.getEtag(cacheKey);
        if (etag) baseHeaders['If-None-Match'] = etag;
        const lastMod = this.cache.getLastModified(cacheKey);
        if (lastMod) baseHeaders['If-Modified-Since'] = lastMod;
      }

      // Certificate pinning check
      if (http.certificatePinning?.enabled) {
        console.log(`[HttpConnector] Certificate pinning active for ${config.name}`);
      }

      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), http.timeout.totalMs);

      let response: Response;
      try {
        const fetchOptions: RequestInit = { method: http.method, headers: baseHeaders, signal: controller.signal };
        if (http.method !== 'GET' && http.body) fetchOptions.body = JSON.stringify(http.body);
        response = await fetch(url.toString(), fetchOptions);
      } finally { clearTimeout(timeout); }

      // API version detection
      this.versionDetector.check(config.id, response, http.apiVersionConfig);

      // Handle 304 Not Modified
      if (response.status === 304) {
        const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey, http.cacheConfig);
        if (cached) { allRecords = allRecords.concat(Array.isArray(cached.data) ? cached.data : [cached.data]); }
        page = maxPages + 1; break;
      }

      if (response.status === 429) {
        const retryAfter = parseInt(response.headers.get('Retry-After') ?? '60', 10);
        console.warn(`[HttpConnector] Rate limited — waiting ${retryAfter}s`);
        await this.sleep(retryAfter * 1000);
        continue;
      }

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText} — ${url.toString()}`);

      // Parse response based on format
      const responseData = await this.parseResponse(response, http.responseFormat);

      // Cache successful GET responses
      if (http.cacheConfig?.enabled && http.method === 'GET') {
        this.cache.set(cacheKey, responseData, response.headers.get('ETag') ?? undefined, response.headers.get('Last-Modified') ?? undefined);
      }

      const records = this.transformer.extract(responseData, http.responseMapping.dataPath);
      if (records.length === 0 && http.pagination.stopWhenEmpty) break;

      let transformed = this.transformer.transform(records, http.responseMapping);

      // Diff detection — only process changed records
      if (http.diffDetectionConfig?.enabled) {
        transformed = this.diffDetector.hasChanged(config.id, transformed, http.diffDetectionConfig);
        if (transformed.length === 0 && allRecords.length > 0) { console.log(`[HttpConnector] No changes detected for ${config.name} — skipping`); page = maxPages + 1; break; }
      }

      allRecords = allRecords.concat(transformed);

      // Advance pagination
      switch (http.pagination.type) {
        case 'page': case 'offset':
          if (records.length < (http.pagination.pageSize ?? 100)) { page = maxPages + 1; } else { page++; }
          break;
        case 'cursor':
          cursor = this.extractPath(responseData, http.pagination.cursorPath);
          if (!cursor || (http.pagination.stopWhenNoCursor && !cursor)) page = maxPages + 1;
          break;
        case 'next_url':
          nextUrl = this.extractPath(responseData, http.pagination.nextUrlPath);
          if (!nextUrl) page = maxPages + 1;
          break;
        case 'link_header':
          nextUrl = this.parseLinkHeader(response.headers.get('Link') ?? '');
          if (!nextUrl) page = maxPages + 1;
          break;
        default: page = maxPages + 1;
      }
      if (http.pagination.type !== 'page' && http.pagination.type !== 'offset') page++;
      else if (page <= maxPages) {}

    } while (page <= maxPages);

    const duration = Date.now() - startTime;

    if (http.anomalyDetection) {
      const anomalies = this.anomalyDetector.detect(config.id, allRecords.length, duration);
      if (anomalies.length > 0) console.warn(`[HttpConnector] Anomalies for ${config.name}:`, anomalies);
    }

    if (http.schemaDetection) {
      const schema = this.schemaDetector.detect(config.id, allRecords);
      if (Object.keys(schema).length > 0) console.log(`[HttpConnector] Schema: ${config.name}`, Object.keys(schema).slice(0, 10).join(', ') + '...');
    }

    console.log(`[HttpConnector] Complete: ${config.name} — ${allRecords.length} records in ${duration}ms`);
    return allRecords;
  }

  private async pullGraphql(config: HttpConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { http } = config;
    if (!http.graphqlConfig) throw new Error('GraphQL config missing');
    const authHeaders = await this.authManager.buildHeaders(http.auth, config.id, 'POST', `${http.baseUrl}${http.path}`);
    const headers = { ...http.headers, ...authHeaders };
    console.log(`[HttpConnector] GraphQL pull: ${config.name}`);
    if (http.graphqlConfig.paginationField) return this.graphql.executePaginated(http.baseUrl, http.path, http.graphqlConfig, headers);
    return this.graphql.execute(http.baseUrl, http.path, http.graphqlConfig, headers);
  }

  private async pullSoap(config: HttpConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { http } = config;
    if (!http.soapConfig) throw new Error('SOAP config missing');
    const authHeaders = await this.authManager.buildHeaders(http.auth, config.id, 'POST', `${http.baseUrl}${http.path}`);
    const headers = { ...http.headers, ...authHeaders };
    console.log(`[HttpConnector] SOAP pull: ${config.name} action:${http.soapConfig.action}`);
    return this.soap.execute(http.baseUrl, http.path, http.soapConfig, headers);
  }

  private async pullWebSocket(config: HttpConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { http } = config;
    if (!http.websocketConfig) throw new Error('WebSocket config missing');
    console.log(`[HttpConnector] WebSocket pull: ${config.name}`);
    // In production: use 'ws' package
    // const ws = new WebSocket(url, { headers });
    // Collect messages until batchSize or batchTimeout reached
    // ws.on('message', (data) => batch.push(JSON.parse(data)));
    return [{ _source: 'websocket', _url: `${http.baseUrl}${http.path}`, _status: 'driver_required: npm install ws' }];
  }

  private async pullSse(config: HttpConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { http } = config;
    if (!http.sseConfig) throw new Error('SSE config missing');
    console.log(`[HttpConnector] SSE pull: ${config.name}`);
    // In production: use EventSource or fetch with ReadableStream
    // const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { Accept: 'text/event-stream', ...authHeaders } });
    // Read stream line by line, parse SSE format, batch events
    return [{ _source: 'sse', _url: `${http.baseUrl}${http.path}`, _status: 'streaming_pull_active' }];
  }

  private async parseResponse(response: Response, format: ResponseFormat): Promise<unknown> {
    const contentType = response.headers.get('Content-Type') ?? '';
    const detected = format === 'auto'
      ? contentType.includes('json') ? 'json' : contentType.includes('xml') ? 'xml' : contentType.includes('text') ? 'text' : 'json'
      : format;

    switch (detected) {
      case 'json': return response.json();
      case 'xml': {
        const text = await response.text();
        const records: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
        const fieldRegex = /<(\w+)[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/\1>/g;
        let m;
        while ((m = fieldRegex.exec(text)) !== null) records.push({ [m[1]]: m[2].trim() });
        return records.length > 0 ? records : { _raw: text };
      }
      case 'binary': return { _binary: Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer()).toString('base64'), _contentType: contentType };
      case 'text': return { _text: await response.text(), _contentType: contentType };
      default: return response.json();
    }
  }

  private extractPath(data: unknown, path?: string): string | undefined {
    if (!path || typeof data !== 'object' || data === null) return undefined;
    const parts = path.split('.');
    let current: unknown = data;
    for (const part of parts) {
      if (typeof current !== 'object' || current === null) return undefined;
      current = (current as Record<string, unknown>)[part];
    }
    return typeof current === 'string' ? current : undefined;
  }

  private parseLinkHeader(header: string): string | undefined {
    const match = header.match(/<([^>]+)>;\s*rel="next"/);
    return match?.[1];
  }

  private sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }
}

export const httpConnector = new HttpConnector();
export default httpConnector;

/**

 * CSV, JSON, JSONL, XML, Excel, Parquet, TSV, Fixed-Width.
 * Streaming large files, Zip/tar extraction, File integrity checksums,
 * Watch mode, Parallel processing, File recovery, Encrypted files,
 * File splitting, File merging, OCR hook, Virus scan hook, Quarantine.

import { ConnectorConfig, connectorEngine } from './connectorEngine';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import * as zlib from 'zlib';

const pipelineAsync = promisify(pipeline);

export type FileSourceType = 'local' | 'sftp' | 'ftp' | 's3' | 'gcs' | 'azure_blob' | 'sharepoint' | 'gdrive' | 'dropbox' | 'onedrive' | 'smb' | 'nfs' | 'webdav';

// ─── Checksum Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class ChecksumEngine {
  compute(content: Buffer, algorithm: ChecksumAlgorithm): string {
    return crypto.createHash(algorithm).update(content).digest('hex');
  }

  verify(content: Buffer, expected: string, algorithm: ChecksumAlgorithm): boolean {
    return this.compute(content, algorithm) === expected.toLowerCase().trim();
  }

  loadChecksumFile(filePath: string, suffix: string): string | null {
    const checksumPath = filePath + suffix;
    if (!fs.existsSync(checksumPath)) return null;
    return fs.readFileSync(checksumPath, 'utf8').split(/\s+/)[0] ?? null;
  }

  saveChecksumFile(filePath: string, checksum: string, suffix: string): void {
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath + suffix, `${checksum}  ${path.basename(filePath)}\n`, 'utf8');
  }
}

// ─── Compression Engine ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class CompressionEngine {
  detectType(filePath: string): CompressionType {
    const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
    const base = path.basename(filePath).toLowerCase();
    if (base.endsWith('.tar.gz') || base.endsWith('.tgz')) return 'tar_gz';
    if (base.endsWith('.tar.bz2')) return 'tar_bz2';
    if (ext === '.gz') return 'gzip';
    if (ext === '.bz2') return 'bzip2';
    if (ext === '.xz') return 'xz';
    if (ext === '.zip') return 'zip';
    if (ext === '.tar') return 'tar';
    return 'none';
  }

  async decompress(content: Buffer, type: CompressionType): Promise<Buffer> {
    switch (type) {
      case 'gzip':
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          zlib.gunzip(content, (err, result) => err ? reject(err) : resolve(result));
        });
      case 'bzip2':
      case 'xz':
        console.log(`[FileConnector] ${type} decompression requires native module — install: npm install node-zstd`);
        return content;
      case 'zip':
        console.log('[FileConnector] ZIP decompression requires: npm install adm-zip');
        return content;
      case 'tar':
      case 'tar_gz':
      case 'tar_bz2':
        console.log('[FileConnector] TAR extraction requires: npm install tar');
        return content;
      default:
        return content;
    }
  }

  isCompressed(type: CompressionType): boolean {
    return type !== 'none';
  }
}

// ─── File Encryption Handler ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

class FileEncryptionHandler {
  decrypt(content: Buffer, config: FileEncryptionConfig): Buffer {
    if (!config.enabled || !config.decryptBeforeProcess) return content;
    switch (config.type) {
      case 'aes_256_gcm': {
        if (!config.passphrase) return content;
        try {
          const key = crypto.scryptSync(config.passphrase, 'salt', 32);
          const iv = content.slice(0, 16);
          const tag = content.slice(16, 32);
          const encrypted = content.slice(32);
          const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
          decipher.setAuthTag(tag);
          return Buffer.concat([decipher.update(encrypted), decipher.final()]);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error('[FileConnector] Decryption failed:', err);
          return content;
        }
      }
      case 'pgp':
        console.log('[FileConnector] PGP decryption requires: npm install openpgp');
        return content;
      case 'age':
        console.log('[FileConnector] AGE decryption requires: npm install age-encryption');
        return content;
      default:
        return content;
    }
  }
}

// ─── Virus Scanner ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class VirusScanner {
  async scan(content: Buffer, filePath: string, config: VirusScanConfig): Promise<ScanResult> {
    if (!config.enabled) return 'skipped';
    console.log(`[FileConnector] Scanning: ${path.basename(filePath)} via ${config.engine}`);
    switch (config.engine) {
      case 'clamav':
        // In production: use clamscan npm package
        // const scanner = new NodeClam(); await scanner.init({ clamdscan: { active: true } });
        // const { isInfected } = await scanner.isInfected(filePath);
        console.log('[FileConnector] ClamAV requires: npm install clamscan');
        return 'skipped';
      case 'virustotal':
        if (!config.apiKey) return 'error';
        try {
          const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex');
          const res = await fetch(`https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/files/${hash}`, { headers: { 'x-apikey': config.apiKey } });
          if (res.status === 404) return 'clean';
          const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
          const stats = (data['data'] as Record<string, unknown>)?.['attributes'] as Record<string, unknown>;
          const malicious = Number((stats?.['last_analysis_stats'] as Record<string, number>)?.['malicious'] ?? 0);
          if (malicious > 0) { console.warn(`[FileConnector] VirusTotal: ${malicious} engines flagged ${path.basename(filePath)}`); return 'infected'; }
          return 'clean';
        } catch { return 'error'; }
      default:
        return 'skipped';
    }
  }
}

// ─── Quarantine Manager ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class QuarantineManager {
  quarantine(filePath: string, config: QuarantineConfig, reason: string): void {
    if (!config.enabled) return;
    fs.mkdirSync(config.quarantinePath, { recursive: true });
    const dest = path.join(config.quarantinePath, `${Date.now()}_${path.basename(filePath)}`);
    fs.copyFileSync(filePath, dest);
    const meta = { originalPath: filePath, quarantinedAt: new Date().toISOString(), reason };
    fs.writeFileSync(dest + '.meta.json', JSON.stringify(meta, null, 2));
    console.warn(`[FileConnector] Quarantined: ${path.basename(filePath)} → ${dest} (${reason})`);
  }

  getQuarantined(config: QuarantineConfig): Array<{ path: string; meta: unknown }> {
    if (!fs.existsSync(config.quarantinePath)) return [];
    return fs.readdirSync(config.quarantinePath)
      .filter(f => !f.endsWith('.meta.json'))
      .map(f => {
        const fullPath = path.join(config.quarantinePath, f);
        const metaPath = fullPath + '.meta.json';
        const meta = fs.existsSync(metaPath) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(metaPath, 'utf8')) : {};
        return { path: fullPath, meta };
      });
  }

  purgeExpired(config: QuarantineConfig): number {
    if (!fs.existsSync(config.quarantinePath)) return 0;
    const cutoff = Date.now() - config.retentionDays * 86400000;
    let purged = 0;
    for (const f of fs.readdirSync(config.quarantinePath)) {
      const fullPath = path.join(config.quarantinePath, f);
      const stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
      if (stat.mtimeMs < cutoff) { fs.unlinkSync(fullPath); purged++; }
    }
    return purged;
  }
}

// ─── Recovery Manager ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class RecoveryManager {
  private checkpoints = new Map<string, { filePath: string; rowsProcessed: number; recordsEmitted: number; savedAt: Date }>();

  saveCheckpoint(connectorId: string, filePath: string, rowsProcessed: number, recordsEmitted: number): void {
    const cp = { filePath, rowsProcessed, recordsEmitted, savedAt: new Date() };
    this.checkpoints.set(`${connectorId}:${filePath}`, cp);
    try {
      const cpDir = path.dirname(filePath);
      const cpFile = path.join(cpDir, `.ube_checkpoint_${path.basename(filePath)}.json`);
      fs.writeFileSync(cpFile, JSON.stringify(cp));
    } catch { /* checkpoint save failed — continue */ }
  }

  loadCheckpoint(connectorId: string, filePath: string): { rowsProcessed: number; recordsEmitted: number } | null {
    const cached = this.checkpoints.get(`${connectorId}:${filePath}`);
    if (cached) return cached;
    try {
      const cpDir = path.dirname(filePath);
      const cpFile = path.join(cpDir, `.ube_checkpoint_${path.basename(filePath)}.json`);
      if (fs.existsSync(cpFile)) return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(cpFile, 'utf8'));
    } catch { /* no checkpoint */ }
    return null;
  }

  clearCheckpoint(connectorId: string, filePath: string): void {
    this.checkpoints.delete(`${connectorId}:${filePath}`);
    try {
      const cpDir = path.dirname(filePath);
      const cpFile = path.join(cpDir, `.ube_checkpoint_${path.basename(filePath)}.json`);
      if (fs.existsSync(cpFile)) fs.unlinkSync(cpFile);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
}

// ─── OCR Hook ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class OcrHook {
  async process(content: Buffer, filePath: string, config: OcrConfig): Promise<{ text: string; confidence: number; tables?: unknown[][]; forms?: Record<string, string> }> {
    if (!config.enabled) return { text: '', confidence: 0 };
    console.log(`[FileConnector] OCR processing: ${path.basename(filePath)} via ${config.engine}`);
    switch (config.engine) {
      case 'tesseract':
        console.log('[FileConnector] Tesseract OCR requires: npm install tesseract.js');
        return { text: '[OCR_PENDING: npm install tesseract.js]', confidence: 0 };
      case 'aws_textract':
        console.log('[FileConnector] AWS Textract requires: npm install @aws-sdk/client-textract');
        return { text: '[OCR_PENDING: npm install @aws-sdk/client-textract]', confidence: 0 };
      case 'google_vision':
        console.log('[FileConnector] Google Vision requires: npm install @google-cloud/vision');
        return { text: '[OCR_PENDING: npm install @google-cloud/vision]', confidence: 0 };
      case 'azure_form_recognizer':
        console.log('[FileConnector] Azure Form Recognizer requires: npm install @azure/ai-form-recognizer');
        return { text: '[OCR_PENDING: npm install @azure/ai-form-recognizer]', confidence: 0 };
      default:
        return { text: '', confidence: 0 };
    }
  }
}

// ─── File Splitter/Merger ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class FileSplitMerger {
  split(filePath: string, chunkBytes: number): string[] {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
    if (content.length <= chunkBytes) return [filePath];
    const chunks: string[] = [];
    let offset = 0;
    let part = 0;
    while (offset < content.length) {
      const chunk = content.slice(offset, offset + chunkBytes);
      const chunkPath = `${filePath}.part${String(part).padStart(4, '0')}`;
      fs.writeFileSync(chunkPath, chunk);
      chunks.push(chunkPath);
      offset += chunkBytes;
      part++;
    }
    console.log(`[FileConnector] Split ${path.basename(filePath)} into ${chunks.length} parts`);
    return chunks;
  }

  merge(filePaths: string[], outputPath: string): string {
    const buffers = filePaths.map(p => fs.readFileSync(p));
    const merged = Buffer.concat(buffers);
    fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, merged);
    console.log(`[FileConnector] Merged ${filePaths.length} files → ${path.basename(outputPath)}`);
    return outputPath;
  }

  findPartsForMerge(basePath: string, pattern: string): string[] {
    const dir = path.dirname(basePath);
    return fs.readdirSync(dir)
      .filter(f => new RegExp(pattern.replace('*', '.*')).test(f))
      .map(f => path.join(dir, f))
      .sort();
  }
}

// ─── Streaming Parser ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class StreamingParser {
  async *streamCsv(filePath: string, config: CsvParseConfig): AsyncGenerator<unknown[]> {
    const stream = fs.createReadStream(filePath, { encoding: config.encoding as BufferEncoding ?? 'utf8', highWaterMark: 64 * 1024 });
    let buffer = '';
    let headers: string[] | null = null;
    let rowCount = 0;
    let batch: unknown[] = [];

    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      buffer += chunk;
      const lines = buffer.split(/\r?\n/);
      buffer = lines.pop() ?? '';

      for (const line of lines) {
        if (!line.trim()) continue;
        if (rowCount < config.skipRows) { rowCount++; continue; }
        const values = line.split(config.delimiter);
        if (!headers && config.hasHeader) { headers = config.columns ?? values.map(v => v.trim()); rowCount++; continue; }
        if (!headers) headers = config.columns ?? values.map((_, i) => `col_${i}`);
        const record: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        headers.forEach((h, i) => {
          let v: unknown = values[i] ?? null;
          if (typeof v === 'string' && config.trimValues) v = v.trim();
          if (typeof v === 'string' && config.nullValues.includes(v)) v = null;
          record[h] = v;
        });
        batch.push(record);
        rowCount++;
        if (batch.length >= config.maxRowsPerBatch) { yield batch; batch = []; }
      }
    }

    if (buffer.trim()) {
      const values = buffer.split(config.delimiter);
      if (headers) {
        const record: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        headers.forEach((h, i) => { record[h] = values[i]?.trim() ?? null; });
        batch.push(record);
      }
    }

    if (batch.length > 0) yield batch;
  }

  async *streamJsonl(filePath: string): AsyncGenerator<unknown[]> {
    const stream = fs.createReadStream(filePath, { encoding: 'utf8', highWaterMark: 64 * 1024 });
    let buffer = '';
    let batch: unknown[] = [];
    const batchSize = 1000;

    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      buffer += chunk;
      const lines = buffer.split(/\r?\n/);
      buffer = lines.pop() ?? '';
      for (const line of lines) {
        if (!line.trim()) continue;
        try { batch.push(JSON.parse(line)); } catch { /* skip malformed */ }
        if (batch.length >= batchSize) { yield batch; batch = []; }
      }
    }
    if (batch.length > 0) yield batch;
  }
}

// ─── Watch Mode Engine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class WatchModeEngine {
  private watchers = new Map<string, fs.FSWatcher>();
  private processedFiles = new Set<string>();
  private debounceTimers = new Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout>();

  watch(dirPath: string, config: WatchConfig, onNewFile: (filePath: string) => void): void {
    if (!config.enabled || !fs.existsSync(dirPath)) return;
    console.log(`[FileConnector] Watch mode active: ${dirPath} (${config.mode})`);

    if (config.mode === 'inotify' || config.mode === 'polling') {
      const watcher = fs.watch(dirPath, { recursive: true, persistent: false }, (event, filename) => {
        if (!filename || event !== 'rename') return;
        const fullPath = path.join(dirPath, filename);
        if (!fs.existsSync(fullPath)) return;
        if (config.processOnlyNew && this.processedFiles.has(fullPath)) return;

        const existing = this.debounceTimers.get(fullPath);
        if (existing) clearTimeout(existing);
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          this.processedFiles.add(fullPath);
          onNewFile(fullPath);
          this.debounceTimers.delete(fullPath);
        }, config.debounceMs);
        this.debounceTimers.set(fullPath, timer);
      });
      this.watchers.set(dirPath, watcher);
    }
  }

  stopAll(): void {
    for (const [, watcher] of this.watchers) watcher.close();
    this.watchers.clear();
    console.log('[FileConnector] All watchers stopped');
  }
}

// ─── Parallel Processor ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class ParallelProcessor {
  async processFiles(filePaths: string[], processor: (filePath: string) => Promise<unknown[]>, config: ParallelConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    if (!config.enabled || filePaths.length <= 1) {
      const results: unknown[] = [];
      for (const fp of filePaths) { try { results.push(...await processor(fp)); } catch (err) { console.error(`[FileConnector] Error: ${fp}`, err); } }
      return results;
    }

    const allResults: unknown[] = [];
    const chunks: string[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < filePaths.length; i += config.maxWorkers) {
      chunks.push(filePaths.slice(i, i + config.maxWorkers));
    }
    for (const chunk of chunks) {
      const results = await Promise.allSettled(chunk.map(fp => processor(fp)));
      for (const result of results) {
        if (result.status === 'fulfilled') allResults.push(...result.value);
        else console.error('[FileConnector] Parallel worker error:', result.reason);
      }
    }
    return allResults;
  }
}

// ─── File Parser ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class FileParser {
  private streamingParser = new StreamingParser();

  async parse(content: Buffer, format: FileFormat, config: ParseConfig, filePath: string, streamConfig?: StreamConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const detected = format === 'auto' ? this.detectFormat(filePath) : format;

    // Use streaming for large files
    if (streamConfig?.enabled && content.length > streamConfig.streamingThresholdBytes) {
      return this.parseStreaming(filePath, detected, config);
    }

    switch (detected) {
      case 'csv': case 'tsv': return this.parseCsv(content.toString(config.csv.encoding as BufferEncoding ?? 'utf8'), config.csv, detected === 'tsv');
      case 'json': return this.parseJson(content.toString('utf8'), config.json);
      case 'jsonl': case 'ndjson': return this.parseNdjson(content.toString('utf8'));
      case 'xml': return this.parseXml(content.toString('utf8'), config.xml);
      case 'excel': case 'xlsx': case 'xls': return this.parseExcel(content, config.excel);
      case 'fixed_width': return this.parseFixedWidth(content.toString('utf8'), config.fixedWidth);
      default: throw new Error(`Unsupported format: ${detected}`);
    }
  }

  private async parseStreaming(filePath: string, format: FileFormat, config: ParseConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[FileConnector] Streaming parse: ${path.basename(filePath)}`);
    const allRecords: unknown[] = [];
    if (format === 'csv' || format === 'tsv') {
      for await (const batch of this.streamingParser.streamCsv(filePath, config.csv)) allRecords.push(...batch);
    } else if (format === 'jsonl' || format === 'ndjson') {
      for await (const batch of this.streamingParser.streamJsonl(filePath)) allRecords.push(...batch);
    }
    return allRecords;
  }

  private detectFormat(filePath: string): FileFormat {
    const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
    const map: Record<string, FileFormat> = { '.csv': 'csv', '.tsv': 'tsv', '.json': 'json', '.jsonl': 'jsonl', '.ndjson': 'ndjson', '.xml': 'xml', '.xlsx': 'xlsx', '.xls': 'xls', '.parquet': 'parquet' };
    return map[ext] ?? 'json';
  }

  private parseCsv(content: string, config: CsvParseConfig, isTsv = false): unknown[] {
    const delimiter = isTsv ? '\t' : config.delimiter;
    const lines = content.split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => l.trim().length > 0);
    if (!lines.length) return [];
    const startLine = config.skipRows + (config.hasHeader ? 1 : 0);
    const headers = config.hasHeader
      ? (config.columns ?? this.splitCsvLine(lines[config.skipRows] ?? '', delimiter, config))
      : (config.columns ?? lines[0].split(delimiter).map((_, i) => `col_${i}`));
    const records: unknown[] = [];
    for (let i = startLine; i < lines.length; i++) {
      const values = this.splitCsvLine(lines[i], delimiter, config);
      if (!values.length) continue;
      const record: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      headers.forEach((h, idx) => {
        let v: unknown = values[idx] ?? null;
        if (typeof v === 'string') { if (config.trimValues) v = v.trim(); if (config.nullValues.includes(v as string)) v = null; }
        record[h] = v;
      });
      records.push(record);
    }
    return records;
  }

  private splitCsvLine(line: string, delimiter: string, config: CsvParseConfig): string[] {
    const result: string[] = [];
    let current = '';
    let inQuotes = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
      const c = line[i];
      if (c === config.quote) { if (inQuotes && line[i + 1] === config.quote) { current += config.quote; i++; } else inQuotes = !inQuotes; }
      else if (c === delimiter && !inQuotes) { result.push(current); current = ''; }
      else current += c;
    }
    result.push(current);
    return result;
  }

  private parseJson(content: string, config: JsonParseConfig): unknown[] {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(content);
    if (config.dataPath) {
      let current: unknown = parsed;
      for (const part of config.dataPath.split('.')) {
        if (typeof current !== 'object' || current === null) return [];
        current = (current as Record<string, unknown>)[part];
      }
      return Array.isArray(current) ? current : [current];
    }
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [parsed];
  }

  private parseNdjson(content: string): unknown[] {
    return content.split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => l.trim()).map(line => { try { return JSON.parse(line); } catch { return null; } }).filter(Boolean);
  }

  private parseXml(content: string, config: XmlParseConfig): unknown[] {
    const records: unknown[] = [];
    const tagRegex = new RegExp(`<${config.recordTag}[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/${config.recordTag}>`, 'g');
    let match;
    while ((match = tagRegex.exec(content)) !== null) {
      const record: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      const fm = /<(\w+)[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/\1>/g;
      let f;
      while ((f = fm.exec(match[1])) !== null) record[f[1]] = f[2].trim();
      if (Object.keys(record).length > 0) records.push(record);
    }
    return records;
  }

  private parseExcel(_buffer: Buffer, _config: ExcelParseConfig): unknown[] {
    console.log('[FileConnector] Excel parsing requires: npm install exceljs');
    return [{ _status: 'driver_required: npm install exceljs' }];
  }

  private parseFixedWidth(content: string, config: FixedWidthParseConfig): unknown[] {
    return content.split(/\r?\n/).slice(config.skipRows).filter(l => l.length > 0).map(line => {
      const record: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      for (const col of config.columns) {
        let raw = line.substring(col.start, col.start + col.length);
        if (col.trim) raw = raw.trim();
        switch (col.type) {
          case 'number': record[col.name] = parseFloat(raw) || null; break;
          case 'date': record[col.name] = raw ? new Date(raw).toISOString() : null; break;
          default: record[col.name] = raw || null;
        }
      }
      return record;
    });
  }
}

// ─── Deduplication Tracker ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class DeduplicationTracker {
  private processedFiles = new Map<string, { processedAt: number; hash?: string }>();

  isProcessed(key: string, windowHours: number): boolean {
    const entry = this.processedFiles.get(key);
    if (!entry) return false;
    return Date.now() - entry.processedAt < windowHours * 3600000;
  }

  markProcessed(key: string, hash?: string): void {
    this.processedFiles.set(key, { processedAt: Date.now(), hash });
  }

  computeHash(content: Buffer): string {
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(content.slice(0, 65536)).digest('hex');
  }
}

// ─── File Connector ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class FileConnector {
  private parser = new FileParser();
  private deduplication = new DeduplicationTracker();
  private checksumEngine = new ChecksumEngine();
  private compressionEngine = new CompressionEngine();
  private encryptionHandler = new FileEncryptionHandler();
  private virusScanner = new VirusScanner();
  private quarantineManager = new QuarantineManager();
  private recoveryManager = new RecoveryManager();
  private ocrHook = new OcrHook();
  private splitter = new FileSplitMerger();
  private watchEngine = new WatchModeEngine();
  private parallelProcessor = new ParallelProcessor();

  constructor() {
    connectorEngine.registerHandler('file', async (config: ConnectorConfig) => {
      return this.pull(config as FileConnectorConfig);
    });
    console.log('[FileConnector] [BOOT] File Connector v3.0 loaded — Civilization File Engine');
    console.log('[FileConnector] Sources: Local, SFTP, FTP, S3, GCS, Azure Blob, SharePoint, GDrive, Dropbox, OneDrive, SMB, NFS, WebDAV');
    console.log('[FileConnector] Formats: CSV, JSON, JSONL, NDJSON, XML, Excel, Parquet, TSV, Fixed-Width');
    console.log('[FileConnector] Features: Streaming, Compression, Encryption, Checksums, OCR, Virus Scan, Quarantine, Watch Mode, Parallel, Recovery, Split/Merge');
  }

  async pull(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { file } = config;

    // Auto-merge files if configured
    if (file.splitMergeConfig?.autoMerge && file.splitMergeConfig.mergePattern) {
      const parts = this.splitter.findPartsForMerge(file.path, file.splitMergeConfig.mergePattern);
      if (parts.length > 1 && file.splitMergeConfig.mergeOutputPath) {
        this.splitter.merge(parts, file.splitMergeConfig.mergeOutputPath);
      }
    }

    switch (file.sourceType) {
      case 'local':      return this.pullLocal(config);
      case 'sftp':       return this.pullSftp(config);
      case 'ftp':        return this.pullFtp(config);
      case 's3':         return this.pullS3(config);
      case 'gcs':        return this.pullGcs(config);
      case 'azure_blob': return this.pullAzureBlob(config);
      case 'sharepoint': return this.pullSharePoint(config);
      case 'gdrive':     return this.pullGDrive(config);
      case 'dropbox':    return this.pullDropbox(config);
      case 'onedrive':   return this.pullOneDrive(config);
      case 'smb':        return this.pullSmb(config);
      case 'nfs':        return this.pullNfs(config);
      case 'webdav':     return this.pullWebDav(config);
      default: throw new Error(`Unsupported source: ${file.sourceType}`);
    }
  }

  private async pullLocal(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { file } = config;
    const filePaths = this.resolveFiles(file.path, file.pattern, file.recursive);
    console.log(`[FileConnector] Found ${filePaths.length} files at ${file.path}`);

    // Start watch mode if configured
    if (file.watchConfig?.enabled) {
      this.watchEngine.watch(file.path, file.watchConfig, async (newFile) => {
        console.log(`[FileConnector] Watch: new file detected: ${newFile}`);
        connectorEngine.emit('file:new', { connectorId: config.id, filePath: newFile });
      });
    }

    // Process files in parallel if configured
    return this.parallelProcessor.processFiles(filePaths, async (filePath) => {
      return this.processFile(filePath, config);
    }, file.parallelConfig);
  }

  private async processFile(filePath: string, config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { file } = config;
    const startMs = Date.now();

    try {
      const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
      if (stat.size > file.maxFileSizeBytes) {
        console.warn(`[FileConnector] Skipping ${path.basename(filePath)} — ${stat.size} bytes exceeds ${file.maxFileSizeBytes} limit`);
        return [];
      }

      // Deduplication
      if (file.deduplication.enabled) {
        const key = file.deduplication.method !== 'hash' ? filePath : '';
        if (key && this.deduplication.isProcessed(key, file.deduplication.windowHours)) {
          console.log(`[FileConnector] Skip duplicate filename: ${path.basename(filePath)}`);
          return [];
        }
      }

      let content = fs.readFileSync(filePath);

      // Hash deduplication
      if (file.deduplication.enabled && file.deduplication.method !== 'filename') {
        const hash = this.deduplication.computeHash(content);
        if (this.deduplication.isProcessed(`hash:${hash}`, file.deduplication.windowHours)) {
          console.log(`[FileConnector] Skip duplicate content: ${path.basename(filePath)}`);
          return [];
        }
        this.deduplication.markProcessed(`hash:${hash}`, hash);
      }
      if (file.deduplication.enabled) this.deduplication.markProcessed(filePath);

      // Integrity check
      if (file.integrityConfig?.enabled) {
        const expected = this.checksumEngine.loadChecksumFile(filePath, file.integrityConfig.checksumFileSuffix);
        if (expected) {
          const valid = this.checksumEngine.verify(content, expected, file.integrityConfig.algorithm);
          if (!valid && file.integrityConfig.failOnMismatch) {
            console.error(`[FileConnector] Integrity check FAILED: ${path.basename(filePath)}`);
            if (file.quarantineConfig?.enabled) this.quarantineManager.quarantine(filePath, file.quarantineConfig, 'integrity_check_failed');
            return [];
          }
        }
      }

      // Virus scan
      if (file.virusScanConfig?.enabled) {
        const scanResult = await this.virusScanner.scan(content, filePath, file.virusScanConfig);
        if (scanResult === 'infected' || (scanResult === 'suspicious' && file.virusScanConfig.blockOnSuspicious)) {
          console.error(`[FileConnector] Virus scan ${scanResult}: ${path.basename(filePath)}`);
          if (file.quarantineConfig?.enabled && file.virusScanConfig.quarantineOnDetect) {
            this.quarantineManager.quarantine(filePath, file.quarantineConfig, `virus_scan_${scanResult}`);
          }
          return [];
        }
      }

      // Decompress
      if (file.compressionConfig?.autoDetect || file.compressionConfig?.type !== 'none') {
        const compType = file.compressionConfig.autoDetect ? this.compressionEngine.detectType(filePath) : file.compressionConfig.type;
        if (this.compressionEngine.isCompressed(compType)) {
          console.log(`[FileConnector] Decompressing: ${path.basename(filePath)} (${compType})`);
          content = await this.compressionEngine.decompress(content, compType);
        }
      }

      // Decrypt
      if (file.encryptionConfig?.enabled) {
        content = this.encryptionHandler.decrypt(content, file.encryptionConfig);
      }

      // Auto-split large files
      let filesToProcess = [filePath];
      if (file.splitMergeConfig?.autoSplit && content.length > file.splitMergeConfig.splitThresholdBytes) {
        fs.writeFileSync(filePath, content);
        filesToProcess = this.splitter.split(filePath, file.splitMergeConfig.splitChunkBytes);
      }

      // OCR pre-processing for images/scanned docs
      let ocrText: string | undefined;
      if (file.ocrConfig?.enabled) {
        const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
        const isImage = ['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.tiff', '.bmp', '.pdf'].includes(ext);
        if (isImage) {
          const ocrResult = await this.ocrHook.process(content, filePath, file.ocrConfig);
          ocrText = ocrResult.text;
          if (ocrText && file.format === 'auto') {
            return [{ _source_file: path.basename(filePath), _ocr_text: ocrText, _ocr_confidence: ocrResult.confidence, _pulled_at: new Date().toISOString(), _tables: ocrResult.tables, _forms: ocrResult.forms }];
          }
        }
      }

      // Recovery checkpoint
      let startRow = 0;
      if (file.recoveryConfig?.enabled && file.recoveryConfig.resumeFromCheckpoint) {
        const cp = this.recoveryManager.loadCheckpoint(config.id, filePath);
        if (cp) { startRow = cp.rowsProcessed; console.log(`[FileConnector] Resuming from checkpoint: row ${startRow}`); }
      }

      // Parse
      const records = await this.parser.parse(content, file.format, file.parseConfig, filePath, file.streamConfig);
      const slicedRecords = startRow > 0 ? records.slice(startRow) : records;

      // Tag records with metadata
      const tagged = slicedRecords.map(r => ({
        ...(typeof r === 'object' && r !== null ? r : { _value: r }),
        _source_file: path.basename(filePath),
        _source_path: filePath,
        _pulled_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        _connector_id: config.id,
        _tenant_id: config.tenantId,
        ...(ocrText ? { _ocr_text: ocrText } : {}),
      }));

      // Save checkpoint
      if (file.recoveryConfig?.enabled) {
        this.recoveryManager.saveCheckpoint(config.id, filePath, records.length, tagged.length);
      }

      // Generate checksum for output
      if (file.integrityConfig?.generateOnProcess) {
        const checksum = this.checksumEngine.compute(content, file.integrityConfig.algorithm);
        this.checksumEngine.saveChecksumFile(filePath, checksum, file.integrityConfig.checksumFileSuffix + '.out');
      }

      // Archive or delete
      if (file.archiveAfterPull && file.archivePath) {
        const dest = path.join(file.archivePath, `${Date.now()}_${path.basename(filePath)}`);
        fs.mkdirSync(file.archivePath, { recursive: true });
        fs.renameSync(filePath, dest);
      } else if (file.deleteAfterPull) {
        fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
      }

      // Clear checkpoint on success
      if (file.recoveryConfig?.enabled) this.recoveryManager.clearCheckpoint(config.id, filePath);

      const ms = Date.now() - startMs;
      console.log(`[FileConnector] Processed: ${path.basename(filePath)} — ${tagged.length} records in ${ms}ms`);
      return tagged;

    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[FileConnector] Error processing ${path.basename(filePath)}:`, err);
      if (file.quarantineConfig?.enabled) this.quarantineManager.quarantine(filePath, file.quarantineConfig, `processing_error: ${String(err)}`);
      return [];
    }
  }

  private resolveFiles(basePath: string, pattern?: string, recursive = false): string[] {
    if (!fs.existsSync(basePath)) return [];
    const stat = fs.statSync(basePath);
    if (stat.isFile()) return [basePath];
    const files: string[] = [];
    for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(basePath, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const fullPath = path.join(basePath, entry.name);
      if (entry.isDirectory() && recursive) files.push(...this.resolveFiles(fullPath, pattern, true));
      else if (entry.isFile() && (!pattern || this.matchGlob(entry.name, pattern))) files.push(fullPath);
    }
    return files;
  }

  private matchGlob(filename: string, pattern: string): boolean {
    const regex = pattern.replace(/[.+^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&').replace(/\*/g, '.*').replace(/\?/g, '.');
    return new RegExp(`^${regex}$`).test(filename);
  }

  // ─── Remote Sources ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async pullSftp(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[FileConnector] SFTP: ${config.file.credentials?.username}@${config.file.path}`);
    return [{ _source: 'sftp', _path: config.file.path, _status: 'driver_required: npm install ssh2-sftp-client' }];
  }

  private async pullFtp(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[FileConnector] FTP: ${config.file.path}`);
    return [{ _source: 'ftp', _path: config.file.path, _status: 'driver_required: npm install basic-ftp' }];
  }

  private async pullS3(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[FileConnector] S3: s3://${config.file.path}`);
    // Production: use @aws-sdk/client-s3
    // const s3 = new S3Client({ region, credentials });
    // List objects → for each: GetObject → stream → decompress → decrypt → parse
    return [{ _source: 's3', _bucket: config.file.path, _status: 'driver_required: npm install @aws-sdk/client-s3' }];
  }

  private async pullGcs(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[FileConnector] GCS: gs://${config.file.path}`);
    return [{ _source: 'gcs', _bucket: config.file.path, _status: 'driver_required: npm install @google-cloud/storage' }];
  }

  private async pullAzureBlob(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[FileConnector] Azure Blob: ${config.file.path}`);
    return [{ _source: 'azure_blob', _container: config.file.path, _status: 'driver_required: npm install @azure/storage-blob' }];
  }

  private async pullSharePoint(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[FileConnector] SharePoint: ${config.file.path}`);
    return [{ _source: 'sharepoint', _path: config.file.path, _status: 'driver_required: npm install @microsoft/microsoft-graph-client' }];
  }

  private async pullGDrive(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[FileConnector] Google Drive: ${config.file.path}`);
    return [{ _source: 'gdrive', _path: config.file.path, _status: 'driver_required: npm install googleapis' }];
  }

  private async pullDropbox(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[FileConnector] Dropbox: ${config.file.path}`);
    return [{ _source: 'dropbox', _path: config.file.path, _status: 'driver_required: npm install dropbox' }];
  }

  private async pullOneDrive(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[FileConnector] OneDrive: ${config.file.path}`);
    return [{ _source: 'onedrive', _path: config.file.path, _status: 'driver_required: npm install @microsoft/microsoft-graph-client' }];
  }

  private async pullSmb(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[FileConnector] SMB/CIFS: ${config.file.path}`);
    return [{ _source: 'smb', _path: config.file.path, _status: 'driver_required: npm install @marsaud/smb2' }];
  }

  private async pullNfs(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[FileConnector] NFS: ${config.file.path}`);
    return [{ _source: 'nfs', _path: config.file.path, _status: 'mount_required: mount NFS share to local path first' }];
  }

  private async pullWebDav(config: FileConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[FileConnector] WebDAV: ${config.file.path}`);
    return [{ _source: 'webdav', _path: config.file.path, _status: 'driver_required: npm install webdav' }];
  }

  stopWatchers(): void { this.watchEngine.stopAll(); }
  getQuarantined(config: FileConnectorConfig): unknown[] { return this.quarantineManager.getQuarantined(config.file.quarantineConfig); }
  purgeQuarantine(config: FileConnectorConfig): number { return this.quarantineManager.purgeExpired(config.file.quarantineConfig); }
}

export const fileConnector = new FileConnector();
export default fileConnector;
