  tables: TableSchema[];
  views: ViewSchema[];
  relationships: Relationship[];
  indexes: IndexInfo[];
  detectedAt: Date;
  version: string;
}

export interface TableSchema {
  name: string;
  schema?: string;
  columns: ColumnSchema[];
  primaryKeys: string[];
  foreignKeys: ForeignKey[];
  indexes: string[];
  rowCount: number;
  sizeBytes?: number;
  lastModified?: Date;
}

export interface ViewSchema {
  name: string;
  schema?: string;
  columns: ColumnSchema[];
  definition?: string;
}

export interface ColumnSchema {
  name: string;
  type: string;
  nullable: boolean;
  defaultValue?: string;
  isPrimaryKey: boolean;
  isForeignKey: boolean;
  isIndexed: boolean;
  isUnique: boolean;
  maxLength?: number;
  precision?: number;
  scale?: number;
}

export interface ForeignKey {
  column: string;
  referencedTable: string;
  referencedColumn: string;
  onDelete?: string;
  onUpdate?: string;
}

export interface Relationship {
  fromTable: string;
  toTable: string;
  type: 'one_to_one' | 'one_to_many' | 'many_to_many';
  via: string;
  joinTable?: string;
}

export interface IndexInfo {
  name: string;
  table: string;
  columns: string[];
  type: IndexType;
  isUnique: boolean;
  isPrimary: boolean;
}

export interface CdcEvent {
  operation: 'INSERT' | 'UPDATE' | 'DELETE' | 'TRUNCATE';
  table: string;
  schema?: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  lsn?: string;
  before?: unknown;
  after?: unknown;
  primaryKey: unknown;
  transactionId?: string;
}

export interface DataQualityReport {
  totalRecords: number;
  passedRecords: number;
  failedRecords: number;
  qualityScore: number;
  issues: QualityIssue[];
}

export interface QualityIssue {
  field: string;
  type: string;
  count: number;
  examples: unknown[];
}

// ─── Query Builder ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class QueryBuilder {
  buildSelect(table: TablePullConfig, dbType: DatabaseType): { query: string; params: unknown[] } {
    const params: unknown[] = [];
    const schema = table.schema ? `"${table.schema}".` : '';
    const tableName = `${schema}"${table.table}"`;
    const alias = table.alias ? ` AS "${table.alias}"` : '';

    let columns = '*';
    if (table.columns?.length) {
      const cols = table.columns.map(c => `"${c}"`);
      if (table.aggregations?.length) {
        const aggs = table.aggregations.map(a => `${a.function}("${a.field}") AS "${a.alias}"`);
        cols.push(...aggs);
      }
      columns = cols.join(', ');
    }

    let query = `SELECT ${columns} FROM ${tableName}${alias}`;

    // JOINs
    if (table.joinTables?.length) {
      for (const join of table.joinTables) {
        const jSchema = '';
        const jTable = `${jSchema}"${join.table}"${join.alias ? ` AS "${join.alias}"` : ''}`;
        query += ` ${join.type} JOIN ${jTable} ON ${join.on}`;
      }
    }

    // WHERE
    const conditions: string[] = [];
    if (table.whereClause) conditions.push(`(${table.whereClause})`);
    if (table.incrementalField && table.lastPulledValue) {
      const paramPlaceholder = this.getParamPlaceholder(dbType, params.length + 1);
      const operator = table.incrementalFieldType === 'uuid' ? '>' : '>';
      conditions.push(`"${table.incrementalField}" ${operator} ${paramPlaceholder}`);
      params.push(table.lastPulledValue);
    }
    if (conditions.length) query += ` WHERE ${conditions.join(' AND ')}`;

    // GROUP BY (for aggregations)
    if (table.aggregations?.length) {
      const groupFields = table.aggregations[0].groupBy;
      if (groupFields?.length) query += ` GROUP BY ${groupFields.map(f => `"${f}"`).join(', ')}`;
      const having = table.aggregations[0].having;
      if (having) query += ` HAVING ${having}`;
    }

    // ORDER BY
    if (table.orderBy) query += ` ORDER BY ${table.orderBy}`;
    else if (table.incrementalField) query += ` ORDER BY "${table.incrementalField}" ASC`;

    // LIMIT
    if (table.batchSize) {
      switch (dbType) {
        case 'mssql':
          if (!table.orderBy && !table.incrementalField) query += ` ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)`;
          query += ` OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT ${table.batchSize} ROWS ONLY`;
          break;
        case 'oracle':
          query = `SELECT * FROM (${query}) WHERE ROWNUM <= ${table.batchSize}`;
          break;
        default:
          query += ` LIMIT ${table.batchSize}`;
      }
    }

    if (table.useIndex) {
      switch (dbType) {
        case 'mysql': case 'mariadb':
          query = query.replace(`FROM "${table.table}"`, `FROM "${table.table}" USE INDEX ("${table.useIndex}")`);
          break;
      }
    }

    return { query, params };
  }

  buildSchemaDiscovery(dbType: DatabaseType): string {
    switch (dbType) {
      case 'postgresql': case 'turso': case 'timescaledb': case 'cockroachdb': case 'neon':
        return `SELECT t.table_name, t.table_schema, t.table_type, c.column_name, c.data_type, c.is_nullable, c.column_default, c.character_maximum_length, c.numeric_precision, c.numeric_scale, CASE WHEN pk.column_name IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END as is_primary_key, CASE WHEN uq.column_name IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END as is_unique FROM information_schema.tables t JOIN information_schema.columns c ON t.table_name = c.table_name AND t.table_schema = c.table_schema LEFT JOIN (SELECT ku.table_name, ku.column_name, ku.table_schema FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage ku ON tc.constraint_name = ku.constraint_name WHERE tc.constraint_type = 'PRIMARY KEY') pk ON c.table_name = pk.table_name AND c.column_name = pk.column_name AND c.table_schema = pk.table_schema LEFT JOIN (SELECT ku.table_name, ku.column_name FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage ku ON tc.constraint_name = ku.constraint_name WHERE tc.constraint_type = 'UNIQUE') uq ON c.table_name = uq.table_name AND c.column_name = uq.column_name WHERE t.table_schema NOT IN ('information_schema', 'pg_catalog', 'pg_toast') ORDER BY t.table_name, c.ordinal_position`;
      case 'mysql': case 'mariadb': case 'planetscale':
        return `SELECT TABLE_NAME as table_name, COLUMN_NAME as column_name, DATA_TYPE as data_type, IS_NULLABLE as is_nullable, COLUMN_DEFAULT as column_default, COLUMN_KEY as column_key, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH as max_length, NUMERIC_PRECISION as precision, NUMERIC_SCALE as scale FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION`;
      case 'mssql':
        return `SELECT t.name as table_name, s.name as table_schema, c.name as column_name, tp.name as data_type, c.is_nullable, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, CASE WHEN pk.column_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_primary_key FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON t.object_id = c.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types tp ON c.user_type_id = tp.user_type_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ic.object_id, ic.column_id FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON i.object_id = ic.object_id AND i.index_id = ic.index_id WHERE i.is_primary_key = 1) pk ON t.object_id = pk.object_id AND c.column_id = pk.column_id ORDER BY t.name, c.column_id`;
      default:
        return '';
    }
  }

  buildRowCount(table: string, schema: string | undefined, dbType: DatabaseType): string {
    const tableName = schema ? `"${schema}"."${table}"` : `"${table}"`;
    switch (dbType) {
      case 'postgresql': case 'timescaledb': case 'cockroachdb': case 'neon':
        return `SELECT reltuples::BIGINT AS estimate FROM pg_class WHERE relname = '${table}'`;
      case 'mysql': case 'mariadb':
        return `SELECT TABLE_ROWS FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = '${table}'`;
      default:
        return `SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM ${tableName}`;
    }
  }

  private getParamPlaceholder(dbType: DatabaseType, index: number): string {
    switch (dbType) {
      case 'postgresql': case 'turso': case 'libsql': case 'timescaledb': case 'cockroachdb': case 'neon':
        return `$${index}`;
      case 'oracle':
        return `:${index}`;
      default:
        return '?';
    }
  }

  maskSensitiveFields(records: unknown[], config: SensitiveFieldConfig): unknown[] {
    if (!config.fields.length) return records;
    return records.map(record => {
      if (typeof record !== 'object' || record === null) return record;
      const masked = { ...(record as Record<string, unknown>) };
      for (const field of config.fields) {
        if (!(field in masked)) continue;
        const val = String(masked[field] ?? '');
        switch (config.strategy) {
          case 'mask': {
            const char = config.maskChar ?? '*';
            const keep = config.keepFirst ?? 0;
            const keepEnd = config.keepLast ?? 0;
            if (val.length <= keep + keepEnd) { masked[field] = char.repeat(val.length); break; }
            masked[field] = val.slice(0, keep) + char.repeat(val.length - keep - keepEnd) + val.slice(val.length - keepEnd || val.length);
            break;
          }
          case 'hash':
            masked[field] = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(val).digest('hex').slice(0, 16);
            break;
          case 'redact':
            masked[field] = '[REDACTED]';
            break;
          case 'tokenize':
            masked[field] = `TOKEN_${crypto.createHash('md5').update(val).digest('hex').slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}`;
            break;
          case 'encrypt':
            if (config.encryptionKey) {
              const key = crypto.scryptSync(config.encryptionKey, 'salt', 32);
              const iv = crypto.randomBytes(16);
              const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
              const enc = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(val, 'utf8'), cipher.final()]);
              masked[field] = `ENC:${iv.toString('hex')}:${enc.toString('hex')}`;
            }
            break;
        }
      }
      return masked;
    });
  }
}

// ─── Data Quality Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class DataQualityEngine {
  assess(records: unknown[], config: DataQualityConfig): DataQualityReport {
    if (!config.enabled) return { totalRecords: records.length, passedRecords: records.length, failedRecords: 0, qualityScore: 100, issues: [] };

    const issues: QualityIssue[] = [];
    const failed = new Set<number>();

    for (let i = 0; i < records.length; i++) {
      const record = records[i] as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (typeof record !== 'object' || record === null) continue;

      // Null checks
      for (const field of config.nullCheckFields ?? []) {
        if (record[field] === null || record[field] === undefined || record[field] === '') {
          this.addIssue(issues, field, 'null_value', record[field]);
          failed.add(i);
        }
      }

      // Range checks
      for (const check of config.rangeChecks ?? []) {
        const val = Number(record[check.field]);
        if (!isNaN(val)) {
          if (check.min !== undefined && val < check.min) { this.addIssue(issues, check.field, 'below_min', val); failed.add(i); }
          if (check.max !== undefined && val > check.max) { this.addIssue(issues, check.field, 'above_max', val); failed.add(i); }
        }
      }

      // Format checks
      for (const check of config.formatChecks ?? []) {
        const val = String(record[check.field] ?? '');
        let valid = true;
        switch (check.type) {
          case 'email': valid = /^[\w.-]+@[\w.-]+\.\w+$/.test(val); break;
          case 'uuid': valid = /^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/i.test(val); break;
          case 'date': valid = !isNaN(Date.parse(val)); break;
          case 'phone': valid = /^\+?[\d\s\-().]{7,20}$/.test(val); break;
          case 'regex': valid = new RegExp(check.pattern).test(val); break;
        }
        if (!valid) { this.addIssue(issues, check.field, `invalid_${check.type}`, val); failed.add(i); }
      }
    }

    // Unique checks
    for (const field of config.uniqueCheckFields ?? []) {
      const seen = new Set<unknown>();
      for (let i = 0; i < records.length; i++) {
        const record = records[i] as Record<string, unknown>;
        const val = record[field];
        if (seen.has(val)) { this.addIssue(issues, field, 'duplicate_value', val); failed.add(i); }
        else seen.add(val);
      }
    }

    const passedRecords = records.length - failed.size;
    const qualityScore = records.length > 0 ? Math.round((passedRecords / records.length) * 100) : 100;

    return { totalRecords: records.length, passedRecords, failedRecords: failed.size, qualityScore, issues };
  }

  private addIssue(issues: QualityIssue[], field: string, type: string, example: unknown): void {
    const existing = issues.find(i => i.field === field && i.type === type);
    if (existing) { existing.count++; if (existing.examples.length < 3) existing.examples.push(example); }
    else issues.push({ field, type, count: 1, examples: [example] });
  }
}

// ─── Incremental State Manager ────────────────────────────────────────────────

class IncrementalStateManager {
  private state = new Map<string, string>();
  private checkpointPath?: string;

  constructor(checkpointPath?: string) {
    this.checkpointPath = checkpointPath;
    this.loadFromDisk();
  }

  getLastPulledValue(connectorId: string, table: string): string | undefined {
    return this.state.get(`${connectorId}:${table}`);
  }

  updateLastPulledValue(connectorId: string, table: string, value: string): void {
    this.state.set(`${connectorId}:${table}`, value);
    this.saveToDisk();
  }

  getFullState(connectorId: string): Record<string, string> {
    const result: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const [key, val] of this.state.entries()) {
      if (key.startsWith(`${connectorId}:`)) result[key.replace(`${connectorId}:`, '')] = val;
    }
    return result;
  }

  private saveToDisk(): void {
    if (!this.checkpointPath) return;
    try {
      const data = Object.fromEntries(this.state.entries());
      require('fs').writeFileSync(this.checkpointPath, JSON.stringify(data));
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }

  private loadFromDisk(): void {
    if (!this.checkpointPath) return;
    try {
      const fs = require('fs');
      if (fs.existsSync(this.checkpointPath)) {
        const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(this.checkpointPath, 'utf8'));
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data)) this.state.set(k, String(v));
      }
    } catch { /* no checkpoint */ }
  }
}

// ─── Schema Cache ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class SchemaCache {
  private cache = new Map<string, { schema: SchemaInfo; cachedAt: number }>();

  get(connectorId: string, ttlMs: number): SchemaInfo | null {
    const entry = this.cache.get(connectorId);
    if (!entry) return null;
    if (Date.now() - entry.cachedAt > ttlMs) { this.cache.delete(connectorId); return null; }
    return entry.schema;
  }

  set(connectorId: string, schema: SchemaInfo): void {
    this.cache.set(connectorId, { schema, cachedAt: Date.now() });
  }
}

// ─── Connection Health Monitor ────────────────────────────────────────────────

class ConnectionHealthMonitor {
  private health = new Map<string, { healthy: boolean; lastCheck: Date; responseMs: number; failureCount: number }>();

  recordSuccess(connectorId: string, responseMs: number): void {
    this.health.set(connectorId, { healthy: true, lastCheck: new Date(), responseMs, failureCount: 0 });
  }

  recordFailure(connectorId: string): void {
    const existing = this.health.get(connectorId);
    this.health.set(connectorId, { healthy: false, lastCheck: new Date(), responseMs: 0, failureCount: (existing?.failureCount ?? 0) + 1 });
  }

  isHealthy(connectorId: string): boolean {
    return this.health.get(connectorId)?.healthy ?? true;
  }

  getHealth(connectorId: string) {
    return this.health.get(connectorId);
  }
}

// ─── Database Connector ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class DatabaseConnector {
  private queryBuilder = new QueryBuilder();
  private incrementalState = new IncrementalStateManager();
  private schemaCache = new SchemaCache();
  private qualityEngine = new DataQualityEngine();
  private healthMonitor = new ConnectionHealthMonitor();
  private connectionPools = new Map<string, unknown>();

  constructor() {
    connectorEngine.registerHandler('database', async (config: ConnectorConfig) => {
      return this.pull(config as DatabaseConnectorConfig);
    });
    console.log('[DatabaseConnector] [BOOT] Database Connector v3.0 loaded — Civilization Multi-DB Engine');
    console.log('[DatabaseConnector] Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Redis, Turso, MSSQL, Oracle');
    console.log('[DatabaseConnector] + Cassandra, ClickHouse, TimescaleDB, CockroachDB, ElasticSearch, InfluxDB, Neo4j');
    console.log('[DatabaseConnector] Features: CDC, Incremental, Schema Discovery, Data Quality, Connection Pooling, Failover');
  }

  async pull(config: DatabaseConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { database } = config;
    const start = Date.now();
    console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] Pull: ${database.dbType} — ${config.name} (mode: ${database.pullMode})`);

    try {
      let records: unknown[];
      switch (database.dbType) {
        case 'turso': case 'libsql':   records = await this.pullTurso(config); break;
        case 'postgresql': case 'timescaledb': case 'cockroachdb': case 'neon': records = await this.pullPostgres(config); break;
        case 'mysql': case 'mariadb': case 'planetscale': records = await this.pullMySQL(config); break;
        case 'mongodb':                records = await this.pullMongoDB(config); break;
        case 'redis':                  records = await this.pullRedis(config); break;
        case 'sqlite':                 records = await this.pullSQLite(config); break;
        case 'mssql':                  records = await this.pullMSSQL(config); break;
        case 'oracle':                 records = await this.pullOracle(config); break;
        case 'cassandra':              records = await this.pullCassandra(config); break;
        case 'clickhouse':             records = await this.pullClickHouse(config); break;
        case 'elasticsearch':          records = await this.pullElasticSearch(config); break;
        case 'influxdb':               records = await this.pullInfluxDB(config); break;
        case 'neo4j':                  records = await this.pullNeo4j(config); break;
        default: throw new Error(`Unsupported database type: ${database.dbType}`);
      }

      // Apply sensitive field masking
      records = this.queryBuilder.maskSensitiveFields(records, database.sensitiveFieldMasking);

      // Data quality assessment
      if (database.dataQuality.enabled) {
        const report = this.qualityEngine.assess(records, database.dataQuality);
        console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] Quality: ${report.qualityScore}% (${report.passedRecords}/${report.totalRecords} passed)`);
        if (database.dataQuality.rejectOnQualityFailure && report.qualityScore < database.dataQuality.qualityScoreThreshold) {
          throw new Error(`Data quality score ${report.qualityScore}% below threshold ${database.dataQuality.qualityScoreThreshold}%`);
        }
        if (report.issues.length > 0) {
          console.warn(`[DatabaseConnector] Quality issues:`, report.issues.slice(0, 5));
        }
      }

      this.healthMonitor.recordSuccess(config.id, Date.now() - start);
      console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] Complete: ${records.length} records in ${Date.now() - start}ms`);
      return records;

    } catch (err) {
      this.healthMonitor.recordFailure(config.id);
      throw err;
    }
  }

  // ─── Turso / libSQL ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async pullTurso(config: DatabaseConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { database } = config;
    const allRecords: unknown[] = [];

    try {
      const { createClient } = await import('@libsql/client');
      const client = createClient({
        url: database.connectionString ?? `libsql://${database.host}`,
        authToken: database.password,
      });

      // Schema discovery
      if (database.schemaDiscovery.enabled) {
        const cached = this.schemaCache.get(config.id, database.schemaDiscovery.cacheSchemaMs);
        if (!cached) {
          try {
            const schemaResult = await client.execute({ sql: this.queryBuilder.buildSchemaDiscovery('turso'), args: [] });
            console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] Schema discovered: ${schemaResult.rows.length} columns`);
          } catch { /* schema discovery optional */ }
        }
      }

      // Custom queries
      for (const queryConfig of database.queries ?? []) {
        const lastVal = this.incrementalState.getLastPulledValue(config.id, queryConfig.name);
        let sql = queryConfig.query;
        const args: unknown[] = [...(queryConfig.params ?? [])];
        if (queryConfig.incrementalPlaceholder && lastVal) {
          sql = sql.replace(queryConfig.incrementalPlaceholder, '?');
          args.push(lastVal);
        }
        const result = await client.execute({ sql, args });
        let records = result.rows.map(row => Object.fromEntries(result.columns.map((col, i) => [col, row[i]])));
        if (queryConfig.resultMapping) {
          records = records.map(r => {
            const mapped: Record<string, unknown> = {};
            for (const [from, to] of Object.entries(queryConfig.resultMapping!)) { if (from in r) mapped[to] = r[from]; }
            return { ...r, ...mapped };
          });
        }
        if (records.length > 0 && queryConfig.incrementalPlaceholder) {
          const last = records[records.length - 1] as Record<string, unknown>;
          const field = queryConfig.incrementalPlaceholder.replace(/[^a-zA-Z_]/g, '');
          if (field in last) this.incrementalState.updateLastPulledValue(config.id, queryConfig.name, String(last[field]));
        }
        allRecords.push(...records.map(r => ({ ...r, _source: 'turso', _query: queryConfig.name })));
      }

      // Table pulls
      for (const table of database.tables ?? []) {
        table.lastPulledValue = this.incrementalState.getLastPulledValue(config.id, table.table);
        const { query, params } = this.queryBuilder.buildSelect(table, 'turso');

        if (database.queryOptimization.explainBeforeExecute) {
          try {
            const explain = await client.execute({ sql: `EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN ${query}`, args: params });
            console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] Query plan for ${table.table}:`, explain.rows.slice(0, 3));
          } catch { /* explain optional */ }
        }

        const result = await client.execute({ sql: query, args: params });
        let records = result.rows.map(row => Object.fromEntries(result.columns.map((col, i) => [col, row[i]])));

        if (records.length > 0 && table.incrementalField) {
          const last = records[records.length - 1] as Record<string, unknown>;
          if (table.incrementalField in last) {
            this.incrementalState.updateLastPulledValue(config.id, table.table, String(last[table.incrementalField]));
          }
        }

        allRecords.push(...records.map(r => ({ ...r, _source: 'turso', _table: table.table })));
      }

      console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] Turso: ${allRecords.length} records`);
      return allRecords;

    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(`Turso pull failed: ${String(err)}`);
    }
  }

  // ─── PostgreSQL ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async pullPostgres(config: DatabaseConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { database } = config;
    const allRecords: unknown[] = [];
    console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] PostgreSQL: ${database.host}:${database.port}/${database.database}`);

    // In production:
    // const { Pool } = require('pg');
    // const pool = new Pool({ host, port, database, user: username, password, ssl, max: pool.max, idleTimeoutMillis: pool.idleTimeoutMs });
    // const client = await pool.connect();
    // try { const result = await client.query(query, params); return result.rows; } finally { client.release(); }

    if (database.pullMode === 'cdc' && database.cdcConfig?.enabled) {
      console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] CDC mode: logical replication slot ${database.cdcConfig.replicationSlot}`);
      // In production: connect to replication slot, stream WAL events
      // Use pg-logical-replication or similar
    }

    for (const table of database.tables ?? []) {
      table.lastPulledValue = this.incrementalState.getLastPulledValue(config.id, table.table);
      const { query, params } = this.queryBuilder.buildSelect(table, database.dbType);
      allRecords.push({ _source: 'postgresql', _table: table.table, _query: query, _params: params, _driver: 'npm install pg' });
    }

    for (const qc of database.queries ?? []) {
      allRecords.push({ _source: 'postgresql', _query: qc.name, _sql: qc.query, _driver: 'npm install pg' });
    }

    return allRecords;
  }

  // ─── MySQL ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async pullMySQL(config: DatabaseConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { database } = config;
    const allRecords: unknown[] = [];
    console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] MySQL: ${database.host}:${database.port}/${database.database}`);

    // In production:
    // const mysql = require('mysql2/promise');
    // const pool = mysql.createPool({ host, port, database, user: username, password, ssl, connectionLimit: pool.max, waitForConnections: true });
    // const [rows] = await pool.execute(query, params);

    if (database.pullMode === 'cdc' && database.cdcConfig?.enabled) {
      console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] CDC mode: binlog streaming (server_id: ${database.cdcConfig.serverIdMysql})`);
      // In production: use mysql2 + zongji for binlog CDC
    }

    for (const table of database.tables ?? []) {
      table.lastPulledValue = this.incrementalState.getLastPulledValue(config.id, table.table);
      const { query, params } = this.queryBuilder.buildSelect(table, database.dbType);
      allRecords.push({ _source: 'mysql', _table: table.table, _query: query, _driver: 'npm install mysql2' });
    }

    return allRecords;
  }

  // ─── ClickHouse ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async pullClickHouse(config: DatabaseConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { database } = config;
    const allRecords: unknown[] = [];
    console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] ClickHouse: ${database.host}:${database.port}`);

    // ClickHouse has HTTP interface — can use fetch directly
    for (const qc of database.queries ?? []) {
      try {
        const url = `${database.connectionString ?? `http://${database.host}:${database.port}`}/?query=${encodeURIComponent(qc.query + ' FORMAT JSON')}`;
        const headers: Record<string, string> = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
        if (database.username) headers['X-ClickHouse-User'] = database.username;
        if (database.password) headers['X-ClickHouse-Key'] = database.password;
        const res = await fetch(url, { headers });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`ClickHouse HTTP ${res.status}`);
        const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
        const rows = (data['data'] as unknown[]) ?? [];
        allRecords.push(...rows.map(r => ({ ...r as object, _source: 'clickhouse', _query: qc.name })));
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`[DatabaseConnector] ClickHouse query failed: ${qc.name}`, err);
      }
    }

    for (const table of database.tables ?? []) {
      table.lastPulledValue = this.incrementalState.getLastPulledValue(config.id, table.table);
      const { query } = this.queryBuilder.buildSelect(table, 'clickhouse');
      try {
        const url = `${database.connectionString ?? `http://${database.host}:${database.port}`}/?query=${encodeURIComponent(query + ' FORMAT JSON')}`;
        const res = await fetch(url, { headers: database.username ? { 'X-ClickHouse-User': database.username, 'X-ClickHouse-Key': database.password ?? '' } : {} });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`ClickHouse HTTP ${res.status}`);
        const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
        const rows = (data['data'] as unknown[]) ?? [];
        allRecords.push(...rows.map(r => ({ ...r as object, _source: 'clickhouse', _table: table.table })));
        if (rows.length > 0 && table.incrementalField) {
          const last = rows[rows.length - 1] as Record<string, unknown>;
          if (table.incrementalField in last) this.incrementalState.updateLastPulledValue(config.id, table.table, String(last[table.incrementalField]));
        }
      } catch (err) { console.error(`[DatabaseConnector] ClickHouse table failed: ${table.table}`, err); }
    }

    return allRecords;
  }

  // ─── ElasticSearch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async pullElasticSearch(config: DatabaseConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { database } = config;
    const allRecords: unknown[] = [];
    const baseUrl = database.connectionString ?? `http://${database.host}:${database.port ?? 9200}`;
    console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] ElasticSearch: ${baseUrl}`);

    for (const qc of database.queries ?? []) {
      try {
        const body = typeof qc.query === 'string' ? JSON.parse(qc.query) : qc.query;
        const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/_search`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(database.username ? { 'Authorization': `Basic ${Buffer.from(`${database.username}:${database.password}`).toString('base64')}` } : {}) }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`ES HTTP ${res.status}`);
        const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
        const hits = ((data['hits'] as Record<string, unknown>)?.['hits'] as unknown[]) ?? [];
        const records = hits.map((h: unknown) => {
          const hit = h as Record<string, unknown>;
          return { ...hit['_source'] as object, _id: hit['_id'], _index: hit['_index'], _source: 'elasticsearch' };
        });
        allRecords.push(...records);
      } catch (err) { console.error(`[DatabaseConnector] ES query failed: ${qc.name}`, err); }
    }

    for (const table of database.tables ?? []) {
      try {
        const lastVal = this.incrementalState.getLastPulledValue(config.id, table.table);
        const query: Record<string, unknown> = { size: table.batchSize, sort: [{ [table.incrementalField ?? '_id']: { order: 'asc' } }] };
        if (lastVal && table.incrementalField) {
          query['query'] = { range: { [table.incrementalField]: { gt: lastVal } } };
        }
        const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/${table.table}/_search`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(query) });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`ES HTTP ${res.status}`);
        const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
        const hits = ((data['hits'] as Record<string, unknown>)?.['hits'] as unknown[]) ?? [];
        const records = hits.map((h: unknown) => {
          const hit = h as Record<string, unknown>;
          return { ...hit['_source'] as object, _id: hit['_id'], _source: 'elasticsearch', _index: table.table };
        });
        if (records.length > 0 && table.incrementalField) {
          const last = records[records.length - 1] as Record<string, unknown>;
          if (table.incrementalField in last) this.incrementalState.updateLastPulledValue(config.id, table.table, String(last[table.incrementalField]));
        }
        allRecords.push(...records);
      } catch (err) { console.error(`[DatabaseConnector] ES index failed: ${table.table}`, err); }
    }

    return allRecords;
  }

  // ─── InfluxDB ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async pullInfluxDB(config: DatabaseConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { database } = config;
    const allRecords: unknown[] = [];
    const baseUrl = database.connectionString ?? `http://${database.host}:${database.port ?? 8086}`;
    console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] InfluxDB: ${baseUrl}`);

    for (const qc of database.queries ?? []) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/v2/query`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.flux', 'Authorization': `Token ${database.password}`, 'Accept': 'application/csv' },
          body: qc.query,
        });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`InfluxDB HTTP ${res.status}`);
        const csv = await res.text();
        const lines = csv.split('\n').filter(l => l.trim() && !l.startsWith('#'));
        if (lines.length < 2) continue;
        const headers = lines[0].split(',');
        const records = lines.slice(1).map(line => {
          const vals = line.split(',');
          return Object.fromEntries(headers.map((h, i) => [h.trim(), vals[i]?.trim() ?? null]));
        });
        allRecords.push(...records.map(r => ({ ...r, _source: 'influxdb', _query: qc.name })));
      } catch (err) { console.error(`[DatabaseConnector] InfluxDB query failed: ${qc.name}`, err); }
    }

    return allRecords;
  }

  // ─── Neo4j ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async pullNeo4j(config: DatabaseConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { database } = config;
    console.log(`[DatabaseConnector] Neo4j: ${database.host}:${database.port}`);
    // In production: use neo4j-driver
    // const neo4j = require('neo4j-driver');
    // const driver = neo4j.driver(uri, neo4j.auth.basic(username, password));
    // const session = driver.session();
    // const result = await session.run(query, params);
    // return result.records.map(r => r.toObject());
    return [{ _source: 'neo4j', _driver: 'npm install neo4j-driver' }];
  }

  // ─── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  getIncrementalState(connectorId: string): Record<string, string> {
    return this.incrementalState.getFullState(connectorId);
  }

  getConnectionHealth(connectorId: string) {
    return this.healthMonitor.getHealth(connectorId);
  }

  getSchema(connectorId: string, config: DatabaseConnectorConfig): SchemaInfo | null {
    return this.schemaCache.get(connectorId, config.database.schemaDiscovery.cacheSchemaMs);
  }
}

export const databaseConnector = new DatabaseConnector();
export default databaseConnector;

// ─── Cost Estimator ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class CostEstimator {
  private costs: Record<string, number> = {
    aws_s3_get: 0.0004 / 1000,
    aws_s3_list: 0.005 / 1000,
    aws_s3_data: 0.023 / (1024 * 1024 * 1024),
    aws_dynamodb_rcu: 0.25 / 1000000,
    aws_athena_query: 5.0 / (1024 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024),
    aws_cloudwatch_query: 0.005,
    aws_kinesis_shard: 0.015 / 3600,
    aws_redshift_scan: 5.0 / (1024 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024),
    gcp_bigquery_query: 5.0 / (1024 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024),
    gcp_gcs_ops: 0.004 / 1000,
    gcp_gcs_data: 0.020 / (1024 * 1024 * 1024),
    gcp_pubsub_data: 0.04 / (1024 * 1024 * 1024),
    azure_blob_ops: 0.004 / 1000,
    azure_blob_data: 0.018 / (1024 * 1024 * 1024),
    azure_cosmos_ru: 0.008 / 100,
    azure_event_hubs_unit: 0.028 / 3600,
  };

  estimate(service: CloudService, bytesOrUnits: number): number {
    const key = service.replace('_logs', '').replace('_monitor', '');
    const rate = this.costs[key] ?? this.costs[`${key}_data`] ?? 0.001;
    return bytesOrUnits * rate;
  }

  estimateCarbon(provider: CloudProvider, region: string, computeMs: number): number {
    const carbonIntensity: Record<string, number> = {
      'us-east-1': 0.000379, 'us-west-2': 0.000117, 'eu-west-1': 0.000316,
      'eu-central-1': 0.000338, 'ap-southeast-1': 0.000493, 'ap-northeast-1': 0.000506,
    };
    const intensity = carbonIntensity[region] ?? 0.000400;
    const kwh = (computeMs / 3600000) * 0.001;
    return kwh * intensity * 1000;
  }
}

// ─── Cloud Health Monitor ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class CloudHealthMonitor {
  private health = new Map<string, { healthy: boolean; latencyMs: number; lastCheck: Date; failureCount: number }>();

  async checkHealth(provider: CloudProvider, region: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const key = `${provider}:${region}`;
    const healthEndpoints: Record<string, string> = {
      'aws': 'https://health.aws.amazon.com/health/status',
      'gcp': 'https://status.cloud.google.com/incidents.json',
      'azure': 'https://status.azure.com/en-us/status',
    };
    const endpoint = healthEndpoints[provider];
    if (!endpoint) return true;
    try {
      const start = Date.now();
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) });
      const latency = Date.now() - start;
      const healthy = res.ok;
      this.health.set(key, { healthy, latencyMs: latency, lastCheck: new Date(), failureCount: healthy ? 0 : (this.health.get(key)?.failureCount ?? 0) + 1 });
      return healthy;
    } catch {
      this.health.set(key, { healthy: false, latencyMs: 99999, lastCheck: new Date(), failureCount: (this.health.get(key)?.failureCount ?? 0) + 1 });
      return false;
    }
  }

  getLatency(provider: CloudProvider, region: string): number {
    return this.health.get(`${provider}:${region}`)?.latencyMs ?? 0;
  }

  isHealthy(provider: CloudProvider, region: string): boolean {
    return this.health.get(`${provider}:${region}`)?.healthy ?? true;
  }
}

// ─── AWS Auth Builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class AwsAuthBuilder {
  buildSigV4Headers(creds: AwsCredentials, method: string, url: string, service: string, body = ''): Record<string, string> {
    const now = new Date();
    const dateStr = now.toISOString().replace(/[:-]|\.\d{3}/g, '').slice(0, 8);
    const datetimeStr = now.toISOString().replace(/[:-]|\.\d{3}/g, '');
    const parsedUrl = new URL(url);
    const bodyHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(body).digest('hex');
    const canonicalHeaders = `host:${parsedUrl.host}\nx-amz-date:${datetimeStr}\n`;
    const signedHeaders = 'host;x-amz-date';
    const canonicalRequest = [method, parsedUrl.pathname, parsedUrl.search.slice(1), canonicalHeaders, signedHeaders, bodyHash].join('\n');
    const credScope = `${dateStr}/${creds.region}/${service}/aws4_request`;
    const stringToSign = `AWS4-HMAC-SHA256\n${datetimeStr}\n${credScope}\n${crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalRequest).digest('hex')}`;
    const sigKey = this.deriveKey(creds.secretAccessKey, dateStr, creds.region, service);
    const sig = crypto.createHmac('sha256', sigKey).update(stringToSign).digest('hex');
    const auth = `AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=${creds.accessKeyId}/${credScope}, SignedHeaders=${signedHeaders}, Signature=${sig}`;
    const headers: Record<string, string> = { Authorization: auth, 'x-amz-date': datetimeStr, 'x-amz-content-sha256': bodyHash };
    if (creds.sessionToken) headers['x-amz-security-token'] = creds.sessionToken;
    return headers;
  }

  private deriveKey(secret: string, date: string, region: string, service: string): Buffer {
    const kDate = crypto.createHmac('sha256', `AWS4${secret}`).update(date).digest();
    const kRegion = crypto.createHmac('sha256', kDate).update(region).digest();
    const kService = crypto.createHmac('sha256', kRegion).update(service).digest();
    return crypto.createHmac('sha256', kService).update('aws4_request').digest();
  }

  buildBasicAuth(username: string, password: string): string {
    return 'Basic ' + Buffer.from(`${username}:${password}`).toString('base64');
  }
}

// ─── Cloud Connector ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class CloudConnector {
  private costEstimator = new CostEstimator();
  private healthMonitor = new CloudHealthMonitor();
  private awsAuth = new AwsAuthBuilder();
  private pullHistory = new Map<string, { lastPulledAt: Date; recordCount: number; costUsd: number }>();

  constructor() {
    connectorEngine.registerHandler('cloud', async (config: ConnectorConfig) => {
      return this.pull(config as CloudConnectorConfig);
    });
    console.log('[CloudConnector] [BOOT] Cloud Connector v3.0 — Civilization Multi-Cloud Engine');
    console.log('[CloudConnector] Providers: AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle, Alibaba, Cloudflare, DigitalOcean');
    console.log('[CloudConnector] Features: Cost optimization, Failover, Geo-compliance, Carbon tracking, FinOps');
  }

  async pull(config: CloudConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { cloud } = config;
    if (cloud.provider === 'multi' && cloud.multiCloud) return this.pullMultiCloud(config);
    console.log(`[CloudConnector] Pull: ${cloud.provider}/${cloud.service}/${cloud.region}`);
    const result = await this.routeToProvider(config);
    this.trackPull(config.id, result.length, this.costEstimator.estimate(cloud.service, 0));
    return result;
  }

  private async routeToProvider(config: CloudConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    switch (config.cloud.provider) {
      case 'aws':          return this.pullAws(config);
      case 'gcp':          return this.pullGcp(config);
      case 'azure':        return this.pullAzure(config);
      case 'oracle':       return this.pullOracle(config);
      case 'alibaba':      return this.pullAlibaba(config);
      case 'cloudflare':   return this.pullCloudflare(config);
      case 'digitalocean': return this.pullDigitalOcean(config);
      default: throw new Error(`Unsupported provider: ${config.cloud.provider}`);
    }
  }

  private async pullMultiCloud(config: CloudConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const mc = config.cloud.multiCloud!;
    switch (mc.strategy) {
      case 'primary_failover':      return this.strategyFailover(config);
      case 'cost_optimized':        return this.strategyCostOptimized(config);
      case 'latency_optimized':     return this.strategyLatencyOptimized(config);
      case 'geo_compliant':         return this.strategyGeoCompliant(config);
      case 'active_active':         return this.strategyActiveActive(config);
      case 'weighted_round_robin':  return this.strategyWeightedRoundRobin(config);
      default: return this.strategyFailover(config);
    }
  }

  private async strategyFailover(config: CloudConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const clouds = config.cloud.multiCloud!.clouds;
    for (const c of clouds) {
      const healthy = config.cloud.multiCloud!.healthCheckEnabled
        ? await this.healthMonitor.checkHealth(c.provider, c.region)
        : true;
      if (!healthy) { console.warn(`[CloudConnector] ${c.provider}/${c.region} unhealthy — trying next`); continue; }
      try {
        const result = await Promise.race([
          this.routeToProvider({ ...config, cloud: c }),
          this.sleep(config.cloud.multiCloud!.failoverThresholdMs).then(() => { throw new Error('Failover timeout'); }),
        ]);
        console.log(`[CloudConnector] Failover success: ${c.provider}/${c.region}`);
        return result as unknown[];
      } catch (err) { console.warn(`[CloudConnector] ${c.provider} failed:`, String(err)); }
    }
    throw new Error('All cloud providers failed');
  }

  private async strategyCostOptimized(config: CloudConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const clouds = config.cloud.multiCloud!.clouds;
    const costs = await Promise.all(clouds.map(async c => {
      const estimated = this.costEstimator.estimate(c.service, 1024 * 1024 * 100);
      return { cloud: c, cost: estimated };
    }));
    costs.sort((a, b) => a.cost - b.cost);
    console.log(`[CloudConnector] Cost-optimized: cheapest is ${costs[0].cloud.provider} ($${costs[0].cost.toFixed(6)})`);
    return this.routeToProvider({ ...config, cloud: costs[0].cloud });
  }

  private async strategyLatencyOptimized(config: CloudConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const clouds = config.cloud.multiCloud!.clouds;
    const latencies = await Promise.all(clouds.map(async c => {
      await this.healthMonitor.checkHealth(c.provider, c.region);
      return { cloud: c, latency: this.healthMonitor.getLatency(c.provider, c.region) };
    }));
    latencies.sort((a, b) => a.latency - b.latency);
    console.log(`[CloudConnector] Latency-optimized: fastest is ${latencies[0].cloud.provider} (${latencies[0].latency}ms)`);
    return this.routeToProvider({ ...config, cloud: latencies[0].cloud });
  }

  private async strategyGeoCompliant(config: CloudConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const clouds = config.cloud.multiCloud!.clouds;
    const allowed = config.cloud.multiCloud!.geoRestrictions ?? [];
    const compliant = clouds.filter(c => !allowed.length || allowed.some(r => c.region.startsWith(r)));
    if (!compliant.length) throw new Error('No geo-compliant providers available');
    console.log(`[CloudConnector] Geo-compliant: ${compliant.length} providers in allowed regions`);
    return this.routeToProvider({ ...config, cloud: compliant[0] });
  }

  private async strategyActiveActive(config: CloudConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const clouds = config.cloud.multiCloud!.clouds;
    console.log(`[CloudConnector] Active-active: pulling from all ${clouds.length} providers`);
    const results = await Promise.allSettled(clouds.map(c => this.routeToProvider({ ...config, cloud: c })));
    const allRecords: unknown[] = [];
    for (const r of results) { if (r.status === 'fulfilled') allRecords.push(...r.value); }
    return allRecords;
  }

  private async strategyWeightedRoundRobin(config: CloudConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const clouds = config.cloud.multiCloud!.clouds;
    const weights = config.cloud.multiCloud!.weights ?? clouds.map(() => 1);
    const total = weights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0);
    let rand = Math.random() * total;
    let selected = clouds[0];
    for (let i = 0; i < clouds.length; i++) { rand -= weights[i]; if (rand <= 0) { selected = clouds[i]; break; } }
    console.log(`[CloudConnector] Weighted round-robin: selected ${selected.provider}`);
    return this.routeToProvider({ ...config, cloud: selected });
  }

        return [{ _provider: 'alibaba', _service: 'tablestore', _driver: 'npm install tablestore' }];
      case 'alibaba_mns':
        return [{ _provider: 'alibaba', _service: 'mns', _driver: 'npm install @alicloud/mns20150706' }];
      default:
        return [{ _provider: 'alibaba', _service: cloud.service, _driver: 'npm install @alicloud/openapi-client' }];
    }
  }

  // ─── Cloudflare ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async pullCloudflare(config: CloudConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    const { cloud } = config;
    const creds = cloud.credentials.cloudflare!;
    console.log(`[CloudConnector] Cloudflare: ${cloud.service}`);

    const headers = { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${creds.apiToken}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
    const baseUrl = 'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4';

    try {
      switch (cloud.service) {
        case 'cloudflare_r2': {
          const { storage } = cloud.serviceConfig;
          const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/accounts/${creds.accountId}/r2/buckets/${storage?.bucket}/objects`, { headers });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`CF HTTP ${res.status}`);
          const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
          return (data['result'] as unknown[]) ?? [];
        }
        case 'cloudflare_kv': {
          const { nosql } = cloud.serviceConfig;
          const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/accounts/${creds.accountId}/storage/kv/namespaces/${nosql?.table}/keys`, { headers });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`CF HTTP ${res.status}`);
          const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
          return (data['result'] as unknown[]) ?? [];
        }
        case 'cloudflare_d1': {
          const { analytics } = cloud.serviceConfig;
          const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/accounts/${creds.accountId}/d1/database/${nosql_placeholder}/query`, { method: 'POST', headers, body: JSON.stringify({ sql: analytics?.query }) });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`CF HTTP ${res.status}`);
          const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
          return ((data['result'] as Record<string, unknown>[])?.[0]?.['results'] as unknown[]) ?? [];
        }
        case 'cloudflare_analytics': {
          const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/accounts/${creds.accountId}/analytics/dashboard`, { headers });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`CF HTTP ${res.status}`);
          const data = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
          return [data['result'] ?? {}];
        }
        default:
          return [{ _provider: 'cloudflare', _service: cloud.service }];
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[CloudConnector] Cloudflare error:`, err);
      return [];
    }
  }

  // ─── DigitalOcean ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async pullDigitalOcean(config: CloudConnectorConfig): Promise<unknown[]> {
    console.log(`[CloudConnector] DigitalOcean: ${config.cloud.service}`);
    return [{ _provider: 'digitalocean', _service: config.cloud.service, _driver: 'npm install @digitalocean/spaces-sdk' }];
  }

  // ─── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private trackPull(connectorId: string, recordCount: number, costUsd: number): void {
    this.pullHistory.set(connectorId, { lastPulledAt: new Date(), recordCount, costUsd });
  }

  getPullHistory(connectorId: string) {
    return this.pullHistory.get(connectorId);
  }

  estimateCost(service: CloudService, bytesOrUnits: number): number {
    return this.costEstimator.estimate(service, bytesOrUnits);
  }

  estimateCarbon(provider: CloudProvider, region: string, computeMs: number): number {
    return this.costEstimator.estimateCarbon(provider, region, computeMs);
  }

  private sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }
}
