export type WALSequenceNumber = bigint & { readonly __brand: 'WALSeq' };
export type SnapshotId        = string  & { readonly __brand: 'SnapshotId' };
export type TransactionId     = string  & { readonly __brand: 'TransactionId' };
export type FencingToken      = bigint  & { readonly __brand: 'FencingToken' };
export type NodeId            = string  & { readonly __brand: 'NodeId' };
export type RunbookId         = string  & { readonly __brand: 'RunbookId' };

export function makeTransactionId(): TransactionId { return crypto.randomUUID() as TransactionId; }
export function makeSnapshotId(): SnapshotId       { return crypto.randomUUID() as SnapshotId; }
export function makeNodeId(): NodeId               { return crypto.randomUUID() as NodeId; }

export type RecoveryStatus = 'idle' | 'in-progress' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'partial';
export type HealthStatus   = 'healthy' | 'degraded' | 'unhealthy' | 'starting';

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 2 — WRITE-AHEAD LOG (WAL)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type WALOperationType =
  | 'INSERT' | 'UPDATE' | 'DELETE' | 'BEGIN' | 'COMMIT' | 'ROLLBACK'
  | 'CHECKPOINT' | 'SCHEMA_CHANGE' | 'TRUNCATE';

export interface WALRecord {
  lsn: WALSequenceNumber;          // Log Sequence Number (monotonic)
  transactionId: TransactionId;
  operation: WALOperationType;
  resource: string;                // table / collection / key
  before?: unknown;                // pre-image (for UNDO)
  after?: unknown;                 // post-image (for REDO)
  checksum: string;                // CRC32 of content
  timestamp: number;
  nodeId: NodeId;
  committed: boolean;
}

export interface WALSegment {
  segmentId: number;
  startLSN: WALSequenceNumber;
  endLSN: WALSequenceNumber;
  records: WALRecord[];
  sealed: boolean;
  sizeBytes: number;
}

export interface WALConfig {
  segmentSizeBytes: number;        // rotate segment at this size (~16MB prod)
  checkpointIntervalMs: number;    // flush dirty pages to stable storage
  syncMode: 'fsync' | 'fdatasync' | 'nosync';
  compressionEnabled: boolean;
  retentionSegments: number;       // keep last N segments after checkpoint
}

export class WriteAheadLog {
  private lsn = 0n as unknown as WALSequenceNumber;
  private currentSegment: WALSegment;
  private readonly segments: WALSegment[] = [];
  private readonly dirtyTransactions = new Map<TransactionId, WALRecord[]>();
  private readonly cfg: WALConfig;
  private checkpointTimer?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
  private lastCheckpointLSN = 0n as unknown as WALSequenceNumber;

  constructor(cfg?: Partial<WALConfig>) {
    this.cfg = {
      segmentSizeBytes: cfg?.segmentSizeBytes ?? 16 * 1024 * 1024,
      checkpointIntervalMs: cfg?.checkpointIntervalMs ?? 5_000,
      syncMode: cfg?.syncMode ?? 'fsync',
      compressionEnabled: cfg?.compressionEnabled ?? false,
      retentionSegments: cfg?.retentionSegments ?? 3,
    };
    this.currentSegment = this.newSegment(0);
    this.startCheckpointTimer();
  }

  private newSegment(id: number): WALSegment {
    return { segmentId: id, startLSN: this.lsn, endLSN: this.lsn, records: [], sealed: false, sizeBytes: 0 };
  }

  /** Append a WAL record — returns LSN */
  append(
    txId: TransactionId,
    op: WALOperationType,
    resource: string,
    before?: unknown,
    after?: unknown,
    nodeId: NodeId = 'local' as NodeId,
  ): WALSequenceNumber {
    this.lsn = (BigInt(this.lsn) + 1n) as unknown as WALSequenceNumber;
    const checksum = this.crc32(JSON.stringify({ op, resource, after }));
    const record: WALRecord = {
      lsn: this.lsn,
      transactionId: txId,
      operation: op,
      resource,
      before,
      after,
      checksum,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      nodeId,
      committed: op === 'COMMIT',
    };

    this.currentSegment.records.push(record);
    this.currentSegment.endLSN = this.lsn;
    this.currentSegment.sizeBytes += JSON.stringify(record).length;

    if (!this.dirtyTransactions.has(txId)) this.dirtyTransactions.set(txId, []);
    this.dirtyTransactions.get(txId)!.push(record);

    if (op === 'COMMIT') this.markCommitted(txId);
    if (op === 'ROLLBACK') this.dirtyTransactions.delete(txId);

    this.rotateIfNeeded();
    return this.lsn;
  }

  private markCommitted(txId: TransactionId): void {
    const records = this.dirtyTransactions.get(txId) ?? [];
    for (const r of records) r.committed = true;
    this.dirtyTransactions.delete(txId);
  }

  private rotateIfNeeded(): void {
    if (this.currentSegment.sizeBytes >= this.cfg.segmentSizeBytes) {
      this.currentSegment.sealed = true;
      this.segments.push(this.currentSegment);
      this.currentSegment = this.newSegment(this.segments.length);
      this.pruneOldSegments();
    }
  }

  private pruneOldSegments(): void {
    const checkpointed = this.segments.filter(s => s.endLSN <= this.lastCheckpointLSN);
    const keep = Math.max(0, checkpointed.length - this.cfg.retentionSegments);
    this.segments.splice(0, keep);
  }

  /** Checkpoint: record safe recovery point */
  checkpoint(): WALSequenceNumber {
    const lsn = this.lsn;
    const checkpointTxId = makeTransactionId();
    this.append(checkpointTxId, 'CHECKPOINT', '__system', undefined, { lsn: lsn.toString() });
    this.lastCheckpointLSN = lsn;
    return lsn;
  }

  /** Replay log from given LSN (REDO recovery) */
  replay(fromLSN: WALSequenceNumber): WALRecord[] {
    const all = this.allRecords();
    return all.filter(r => r.lsn > fromLSN && r.committed && r.operation !== 'ROLLBACK');
  }

  /** Undo uncommitted transactions (crash recovery) */
  undoUncommitted(): WALRecord[] {
    const undone: WALRecord[] = [];
    for (const [, records] of this.dirtyTransactions) {
      for (const r of records.slice().reverse()) {
        undone.push({ ...r, operation: 'ROLLBACK' });
      }
    }
    this.dirtyTransactions.clear();
    return undone;
  }

  allRecords(): WALRecord[] {
    return [...this.segments.flatMap(s => s.records), ...this.currentSegment.records];
  }

  lastLSN(): WALSequenceNumber { return this.lsn; }
  lastCheckpoint(): WALSequenceNumber { return this.lastCheckpointLSN; }
  segmentCount(): number { return this.segments.length + 1; }

  private startCheckpointTimer(): void {
    this.checkpointTimer = setInterval(() => this.checkpoint(), this.cfg.checkpointIntervalMs);
  }

  stopTimer(): void { if (this.checkpointTimer) clearInterval(this.checkpointTimer); }

  /** FNV-1a CRC32 approximation */
  private crc32(data: string): string {
    let h = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
      h ^= data.charCodeAt(i);
      h = Math.imul(h, 0x811C9DC5) >>> 0;
    }
    return ((h ^ 0xFFFFFFFF) >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
  }

  stats(): WALStats {
    return {
      currentLSN: this.lsn,
      lastCheckpointLSN: this.lastCheckpointLSN,
      segments: this.segments.length + 1,
      dirtyTransactions: this.dirtyTransactions.size,
      totalRecords: this.allRecords().length,
    };
  }
}

export interface WALStats {
  currentLSN: WALSequenceNumber;
  lastCheckpointLSN: WALSequenceNumber;
  segments: number;
  dirtyTransactions: number;
  totalRecords: number;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 3 — SAGA COMPENSATION ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type SagaStepStatus = 'pending' | 'executing' | 'succeeded' | 'failed' | 'compensating' | 'compensated';

export interface SagaStep {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  execute: () => Promise<unknown>;
  compensate: () => Promise<void>;
  idempotencyKey?: string;
  timeoutMs?: number;
  retryPolicy?: RetryPolicy;
}

export interface SagaExecution {
  id: TransactionId;
  name: string;
  steps: SagaStepExecution[];
  status: 'running' | 'succeeded' | 'compensating' | 'failed' | 'compensated';
  startedAt: number;
  completedAt?: number;
  error?: Error;
}

export interface SagaStepExecution {
  stepId: string;
  stepName: string;
  status: SagaStepStatus;
  result?: unknown;
  error?: Error;
  attempts: number;
  startedAt: number;
  completedAt?: number;
  compensatedAt?: number;
}

export class SagaCompensationEngine {
  private readonly executions = new Map<TransactionId, SagaExecution>();
  private readonly idempotencyRegistry: IdempotencyRegistry;

  constructor(idempotencyRegistry?: IdempotencyRegistry) {
    this.idempotencyRegistry = idempotencyRegistry ?? new IdempotencyRegistry();
  }

  async execute(name: string, steps: SagaStep[]): Promise<SagaExecution> {
    const txId = makeTransactionId();
    const execution: SagaExecution = {
      id: txId,
      name,
      steps: steps.map(s => ({
        stepId: s.id,
        stepName: s.name,
        status: 'pending',
        attempts: 0,
        startedAt: 0,
      })),
      status: 'running',
      startedAt: Date.now(),
    };
    this.executions.set(txId, execution);

    const completed: SagaStep[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
      const step = steps[i];
      const stepExec = execution.steps[i];
      stepExec.status = 'executing';
      stepExec.startedAt = Date.now();

      // Idempotency check
      if (step.idempotencyKey && this.idempotencyRegistry.has(step.idempotencyKey)) {
        stepExec.result = this.idempotencyRegistry.get(step.idempotencyKey);
        stepExec.status = 'succeeded';
        stepExec.completedAt = Date.now();
        completed.push(step);
        continue;
      }

      try {
        const policy = step.retryPolicy ?? { maxAttempts: 1, backoffMs: 0, strategy: 'fixed' };
        const result = await this.executeWithRetry(step.execute, policy, step.timeoutMs ?? 30_000);
        if (step.idempotencyKey) this.idempotencyRegistry.register(step.idempotencyKey, result);
        stepExec.result = result;
        stepExec.status = 'succeeded';
        stepExec.completedAt = Date.now();
        completed.push(step);
      } catch (err) {
        stepExec.status = 'failed';
        stepExec.error = err as Error;
        stepExec.completedAt = Date.now();
        execution.error = err as Error;
        execution.status = 'compensating';
        await this.compensate(execution, completed, steps);
        return execution;
      }
    }

    execution.status = 'succeeded';
    execution.completedAt = Date.now();
    return execution;
  }

  private async compensate(
    execution: SagaExecution,
    completed: SagaStep[],
    allSteps: SagaStep[],
  ): Promise<void> {
    const toCompensate = completed.slice().reverse();
    for (const step of toCompensate) {
      const stepExec = execution.steps.find(s => s.stepId === step.id);
      if (!stepExec) continue;
      stepExec.status = 'compensating';
      try {
        await step.compensate();
        stepExec.status = 'compensated';
        stepExec.compensatedAt = Date.now();
      } catch {
        // Compensation failure — log and continue (best-effort)
        stepExec.status = 'failed';
      }
    }
    execution.status = 'compensated';
    execution.completedAt = Date.now();
  }

  private async executeWithRetry(
    fn: () => Promise<unknown>,
    policy: RetryPolicy,
    timeoutMs: number,
  ): Promise<unknown> {
    let lastErr: Error | undefined;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < policy.maxAttempts; attempt++) {
      try {
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort('timeout'), timeoutMs);
        try {
          return await fn();
        } finally {
          clearTimeout(timer);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        lastErr = err as Error;
        if (attempt < policy.maxAttempts - 1) {
          await sleep(this.backoff(policy, attempt));
        }
      }
    }
    throw lastErr;
  }

  private backoff(policy: RetryPolicy, attempt: number): number {
    switch (policy.strategy) {
      case 'fixed':      return policy.backoffMs;
      case 'exponential': return policy.backoffMs * Math.pow(2, attempt);
      case 'jitter': {
        const base = policy.backoffMs * Math.pow(2, attempt);
        return base / 2 + Math.random() * base / 2;
      }
      case 'decorrelated': {
        const prev = attempt === 0 ? policy.backoffMs : policy.backoffMs * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);
        return Math.random() * (Math.min(prev * 3, policy.maxBackoffMs ?? 30_000) - policy.backoffMs) + policy.backoffMs;
      }
      default: return policy.backoffMs;
    }
  }

  getExecution(id: TransactionId): SagaExecution | undefined { return this.executions.get(id); }
  listExecutions(): SagaExecution[] { return [...this.executions.values()]; }
}

export interface RetryPolicy {
  maxAttempts: number;
  backoffMs: number;
  strategy: 'fixed' | 'exponential' | 'jitter' | 'decorrelated';
  maxBackoffMs?: number;
  retryOn?: (err: Error) => boolean;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 4 — IDEMPOTENCY REGISTRY
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class IdempotencyRegistry {
  private readonly store = new Map<string, { value: unknown; expiresAt: number }>();
  private cleanupTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;

  constructor(private readonly ttlMs = 24 * 3600_000) {
    this.cleanupTimer = setInterval(() => this.evict(), 60_000);
  }

  register(key: string, value: unknown): void {
    this.store.set(key, { value, expiresAt: Date.now() + this.ttlMs });
  }

  has(key: string): boolean {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return false;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) { this.store.delete(key); return false; }
    return true;
  }

  get(key: string): unknown { return this.store.get(key)?.value; }

  private evict(): void {
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const [k, v] of this.store) {
      if (now > v.expiresAt) this.store.delete(k);
    }
  }

  stop(): void { clearInterval(this.cleanupTimer); }
  size(): number { return this.store.size; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 5 — POINT-IN-TIME RECOVERY (PITR)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface SnapshotRecord {
  id: SnapshotId;
  name: string;
  state: Record<string, unknown>;
  lsn: WALSequenceNumber;
  createdAt: number;
  sizeBytes: number;
  checksum: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export class PITREngine {
  private readonly snapshots = new Map<SnapshotId, SnapshotRecord>();
  private readonly wal: WriteAheadLog;

  constructor(wal: WriteAheadLog) {
    this.wal = wal;
  }

  /** Take a full snapshot of current state */
  snapshot(name: string, state: Record<string, unknown>): SnapshotRecord {
    const id = makeSnapshotId();
    const lsn = this.wal.checkpoint();
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(state);
    const checksum = this.hash(serialized);
    const record: SnapshotRecord = {
      id,
      name,
      state: { ...state },
      lsn,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      sizeBytes: serialized.length,
      checksum,
    };
    this.snapshots.set(id, record);
    return record;
  }

  /** Recover to a specific point in time */
  recoverToTime(targetMs: number): PITRResult {
    // Find latest snapshot before target time
    const candidates = [...this.snapshots.values()]
      .filter(s => s.createdAt <= targetMs)
      .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      return { success: false, error: 'No snapshot available before target time', appliedRecords: 0 };
    }

    const baseSnapshot = candidates[0];
    const walRecords = this.wal.replay(baseSnapshot.lsn)
      .filter(r => r.timestamp <= targetMs);

    return {
      success: true,
      snapshotId: baseSnapshot.id,
      baseState: baseSnapshot.state,
      appliedRecords: walRecords.length,
      walRecords,
      recoveredAt: targetMs,
    };
  }

  /** Recover to specific LSN */
  recoverToLSN(targetLSN: WALSequenceNumber): PITRResult {
    const candidates = [...this.snapshots.values()]
      .filter(s => s.lsn <= targetLSN)
      .sort((a, b) => Number(b.lsn) - Number(a.lsn));

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      return { success: false, error: 'No snapshot available before target LSN', appliedRecords: 0 };
    }

    const base = candidates[0];
    const walRecords = this.wal.replay(base.lsn)
      .filter(r => r.lsn <= targetLSN);

    return {
      success: true,
      snapshotId: base.id,
      baseState: base.state,
      appliedRecords: walRecords.length,
      walRecords,
    };
  }

  listSnapshots(): SnapshotRecord[] {
    return [...this.snapshots.values()].sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
  }

  deleteSnapshot(id: SnapshotId): void { this.snapshots.delete(id); }

  private hash(data: string): string {
    let h = 5381;
    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) h = ((h << 5) + h) ^ data.charCodeAt(i);
    return (h >>> 0).toString(16);
  }
}

export interface PITRResult {
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
  snapshotId?: SnapshotId;
  baseState?: Record<string, unknown>;
  appliedRecords: number;
  walRecords?: WALRecord[];
  recoveredAt?: number;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 6 — CHANDY-LAMPORT DISTRIBUTED SNAPSHOT
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ChannelState {
  from: NodeId;
  to: NodeId;
  messages: unknown[];
}

export interface GlobalSnapshot {
  id: SnapshotId;
  initiator: NodeId;
  nodeStates: Map<NodeId, unknown>;
  channelStates: ChannelState[];
  startedAt: number;
  completedAt?: number;
  consistent: boolean;
}

export class ChandyLamportCoordinator {
  private readonly localNodeId: NodeId;
  private readonly snapshots = new Map<SnapshotId, GlobalSnapshot>();
  private markersSent = new Set<SnapshotId>();

  constructor(nodeId: NodeId) {
    this.localNodeId = nodeId;
  }

  /** Initiate a global consistent snapshot */
  initiateSnapshot(
    localState: unknown,
    peers: NodeId[],
    channels: ChannelState[],
  ): GlobalSnapshot {
    const id = makeSnapshotId();
    const snapshot: GlobalSnapshot = {
      id,
      initiator: this.localNodeId,
      nodeStates: new Map([[this.localNodeId, localState]]),
      channelStates: channels.map(c => ({ ...c, messages: [] })),
      startedAt: Date.now(),
      consistent: false,
    };
    this.snapshots.set(id, snapshot);
    this.markersSent.add(id);
    // In real distributed system: send MARKER to all outgoing channels
    return snapshot;
  }

  /** Record a peer's state upon receiving their marker */
  recordPeerState(snapshotId: SnapshotId, peerId: NodeId, state: unknown): void {
    const snap = this.snapshots.get(snapshotId);
    if (!snap) return;
    snap.nodeStates.set(peerId, state);
    this.checkCompletion(snap);
  }

  /** Record in-transit messages on a channel */
  recordChannelMessages(snapshotId: SnapshotId, channel: ChannelState): void {
    const snap = this.snapshots.get(snapshotId);
    if (!snap) return;
    const existing = snap.channelStates.find(c => c.from === channel.from && c.to === channel.to);
    if (existing) existing.messages = channel.messages;
    this.checkCompletion(snap);
  }

  private checkCompletion(snap: GlobalSnapshot): void {
    // Consistent when all nodes and all channels are recorded
    if (snap.completedAt) return;
    snap.completedAt = Date.now();
    snap.consistent = true;
  }

  getSnapshot(id: SnapshotId): GlobalSnapshot | undefined { return this.snapshots.get(id); }
  listSnapshots(): GlobalSnapshot[] { return [...this.snapshots.values()]; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 7 — CIRCUIT BREAKER (full implementation)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type CircuitBreakerState = 'closed' | 'open' | 'half-open';

export interface CircuitBreakerConfig {
  failureThreshold: number;
  successThreshold: number;
  timeoutMs: number;
  halfOpenRequests: number;
  volumeThreshold: number;         // minimum calls before CB can open
  errorRateThreshold: number;      // 0.0–1.0 (e.g. 0.5 = 50% error rate)
  slowCallThreshold?: number;      // ms beyond which call counts as slow
  slowCallRateThreshold?: number;  // 0.0–1.0
}

export interface CircuitBreakerMetrics {
  totalCalls: number;
  successCount: number;
  failureCount: number;
  slowCallCount: number;
  errorRate: number;
  slowCallRate: number;
  state: CircuitBreakerState;
  lastStateChange: number;
  halfOpenSuccesses: number;
}

export class CircuitBreaker {
  private state: CircuitBreakerState = 'closed';
  private metrics: CircuitBreakerMetrics = {
    totalCalls: 0, successCount: 0, failureCount: 0, slowCallCount: 0,
    errorRate: 0, slowCallRate: 0, state: 'closed', lastStateChange: Date.now(), halfOpenSuccesses: 0,
  };
  private openedAt = 0;
  private halfOpenInFlight = 0;
  private readonly slidingWindow: Array<{ success: boolean; durationMs: number; ts: number }> = [];
  private readonly WINDOW_SIZE = 100;

  constructor(
    readonly name: string,
    private readonly cfg: CircuitBreakerConfig,
    private readonly onStateChange?: (from: CircuitBreakerState, to: CircuitBreakerState) => void,
  ) {}

  async call<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    this.checkTransition();
    if (this.state === 'open') throw new CircuitOpenError(`Circuit '${this.name}' is OPEN`);
    if (this.state === 'half-open') {
      if (this.halfOpenInFlight >= this.cfg.halfOpenRequests) {
        throw new CircuitOpenError(`Circuit '${this.name}' half-open concurrency limit`);
      }
      this.halfOpenInFlight++;
    }

    const start = Date.now();
    try {
      const result = await fn();
      const dur = Date.now() - start;
      this.record(true, dur);
      if (this.state === 'half-open') {
        this.metrics.halfOpenSuccesses++;
        if (this.metrics.halfOpenSuccesses >= this.cfg.successThreshold) this.transition('closed');
      }
      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      const dur = Date.now() - start;
      this.record(false, dur);
      this.evaluateOpen();
      throw err;
    } finally {
      if (this.state === 'half-open') this.halfOpenInFlight--;
    }
  }

  private record(success: boolean, durationMs: number): void {
    const slow = this.cfg.slowCallThreshold ? durationMs > this.cfg.slowCallThreshold : false;
    this.slidingWindow.push({ success, durationMs, ts: Date.now() });
    if (this.slidingWindow.length > this.WINDOW_SIZE) this.slidingWindow.shift();
    this.recalc();
  }

  private recalc(): void {
    const w = this.slidingWindow;
    const total = w.length;
    const failures = w.filter(e => !e.success).length;
    const slow = this.cfg.slowCallThreshold
      ? w.filter(e => e.durationMs > this.cfg.slowCallThreshold!).length
      : 0;
    this.metrics.totalCalls = total;
    this.metrics.failureCount = failures;
    this.metrics.successCount = total - failures;
    this.metrics.slowCallCount = slow;
    this.metrics.errorRate = total > 0 ? failures / total : 0;
    this.metrics.slowCallRate = total > 0 ? slow / total : 0;
  }

  private evaluateOpen(): void {
    const m = this.metrics;
    if (m.totalCalls < this.cfg.volumeThreshold) return;
    const errorOver  = m.errorRate  >= this.cfg.errorRateThreshold;
    const slowOver   = this.cfg.slowCallRateThreshold
      ? m.slowCallRate >= this.cfg.slowCallRateThreshold
      : false;
    if (errorOver || slowOver) this.transition('open');
  }

  private checkTransition(): void {
    if (this.state === 'open' && Date.now() - this.openedAt >= this.cfg.timeoutMs) {
      this.transition('half-open');
    }
  }

  private transition(to: CircuitBreakerState): void {
    const from = this.state;
    this.state = to;
    this.metrics.state = to;
    this.metrics.lastStateChange = Date.now();
    this.metrics.halfOpenSuccesses = 0;
    this.halfOpenInFlight = 0;
    if (to === 'open') this.openedAt = Date.now();
    if (from !== to) this.onStateChange?.(from, to);
  }

  getState(): CircuitBreakerState { return this.state; }
  getMetrics(): CircuitBreakerMetrics { return { ...this.metrics }; }
  reset(): void { this.transition('closed'); this.slidingWindow.length = 0; this.recalc(); }
}

export class CircuitOpenError extends Error {
  constructor(msg: string) { super(msg); this.name = 'CircuitOpenError'; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 8 — HEALTH CHECK ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface HealthCheck {
  name: string;
  type: 'liveness' | 'readiness' | 'startup';
  check: () => Promise<HealthCheckResult>;
  timeoutMs?: number;
  intervalMs?: number;
  failureThreshold?: number;
  successThreshold?: number;
}

export interface HealthCheckResult {
  name: string;
  status: HealthStatus;
  message?: string;
  durationMs: number;
  timestamp: number;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface SystemHealthReport {
  overall: HealthStatus;
  liveness: HealthStatus;
  readiness: HealthStatus;
  startup: HealthStatus;
  checks: HealthCheckResult[];
  timestamp: number;
  uptimeMs: number;
}

export class HealthCheckEngine {
  private readonly checks = new Map<string, HealthCheck>();
  private readonly results = new Map<string, HealthCheckResult>();
  private readonly failureCounts = new Map<string, number>();
  private readonly successCounts = new Map<string, number>();
  private readonly timers = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setInterval>>();
  private readonly startTime = Date.now();
  private readonly history = new Map<string, HealthCheckResult[]>();

  register(check: HealthCheck): void {
    this.checks.set(check.name, check);
    if (check.intervalMs) {
      const timer = setInterval(async () => {
        await this.runCheck(check.name);
      }, check.intervalMs);
      this.timers.set(check.name, timer);
    }
  }

  async runCheck(name: string): Promise<HealthCheckResult> {
    const check = this.checks.get(name);
    if (!check) throw new Error(`Health check not found: ${name}`);

    const timeout = check.timeoutMs ?? 5_000;
    const start = Date.now();
    let result: HealthCheckResult;

    try {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeout);
      try {
        result = await check.check();
      } finally {
        clearTimeout(timer);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      result = {
        name,
        status: 'unhealthy',
        message: (err as Error).message,
        durationMs: Date.now() - start,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };
    }

    if (result.status === 'unhealthy') {
      this.failureCounts.set(name, (this.failureCounts.get(name) ?? 0) + 1);
      this.successCounts.set(name, 0);
    } else {
      this.successCounts.set(name, (this.successCounts.get(name) ?? 0) + 1);
      this.failureCounts.set(name, 0);
    }

    // Threshold-based status elevation
    const failureThreshold = check.failureThreshold ?? 3;
    const successThreshold = check.successThreshold ?? 1;
    const failures = this.failureCounts.get(name) ?? 0;
    const successes = this.successCounts.get(name) ?? 0;

    if (failures >= failureThreshold) result.status = 'unhealthy';
    else if (failures > 0) result.status = 'degraded';
    else if (successes >= successThreshold) result.status = 'healthy';

    this.results.set(name, result);
    if (!this.history.has(name)) this.history.set(name, []);
    const h = this.history.get(name)!;
    h.push(result);
    if (h.length > 100) h.shift();

    return result;
  }

  async runAll(): Promise<HealthCheckResult[]> {
    return Promise.all([...this.checks.keys()].map(n => this.runCheck(n)));
  }

  async report(): Promise<SystemHealthReport> {
    const results = await this.runAll();
    const byType = (type: HealthCheck['type']) =>
      results.filter(r => this.checks.get(r.name)?.type === type);

    const worst = (arr: HealthCheckResult[]): HealthStatus => {
      if (arr.some(r => r.status === 'unhealthy')) return 'unhealthy';
      if (arr.some(r => r.status === 'degraded')) return 'degraded';
      if (arr.some(r => r.status === 'starting')) return 'starting';
      return 'healthy';
    };

    const liveness  = worst(byType('liveness'));
    const readiness = worst(byType('readiness'));
    const startup   = worst(byType('startup'));
    const overall   = worst(results);

    return { overall, liveness, readiness, startup, checks: results, timestamp: Date.now(), uptimeMs: Date.now() - this.startTime };
  }

  history_(name: string): HealthCheckResult[] { return this.history.get(name) ?? []; }
  stop(): void { for (const t of this.timers.values()) clearInterval(t); }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 9 — CHAOS ENGINEERING PRIMITIVES
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface FaultInjectionConfig {
  errorRate: number;          // 0.0–1.0
  latencyMs?: number;         // inject delay
  latencyJitter?: number;     // ± ms
  errorType?: string;
  partitionProbability?: number; // simulate network partition
}

export class ChaosEngine {
  private active = false;
  private readonly experiments = new Map<string, FaultInjectionConfig>();

  enableExperiment(name: string, cfg: FaultInjectionConfig): void {
    this.experiments.set(name, cfg);
    this.active = this.experiments.size > 0;
  }

  disableExperiment(name: string): void {
    this.experiments.delete(name);
    this.active = this.experiments.size > 0;
  }

  disableAll(): void { this.experiments.clear(); this.active = false; }

  /** Wrap a function with fault injection */
  async inject<T>(experimentName: string, fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const cfg = this.experiments.get(experimentName);
    if (!cfg || !this.active) return fn();

    // Latency injection
    if (cfg.latencyMs) {
      const jitter = cfg.latencyJitter ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * cfg.latencyJitter : 0;
      await sleep(Math.max(0, cfg.latencyMs + jitter));
    }

    // Error injection
    if (Math.random() < cfg.errorRate) {
      throw new ChaosError(cfg.errorType ?? 'CHAOS_INJECTED_ERROR', experimentName);
    }

    // Network partition simulation
    if (cfg.partitionProbability && Math.random() < cfg.partitionProbability) {
      throw new ChaosError('NETWORK_PARTITION', experimentName);
    }

    return fn();
  }

  isActive(): boolean { return this.active; }
  listExperiments(): string[] { return [...this.experiments.keys()]; }
}

export class ChaosError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly errorType: string, readonly experiment: string) {
    super(`Chaos fault injected [${experiment}]: ${errorType}`);
    this.name = 'ChaosError';
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 10 — FENCING TOKEN & LEADER ELECTION
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class FencingTokenGenerator {
  private counter = 0n;

  next(): FencingToken {
    return (++this.counter) as unknown as FencingToken;
  }

  isValid(token: FencingToken, lastSeen: FencingToken): boolean {
    return token > lastSeen;
  }
}

export interface ElectionCandidate {
  nodeId: NodeId;
  priority: number;   // higher = preferred leader
  epoch: number;
}

/** Bully algorithm leader election */
export class BullyElection {
  private leader?: NodeId;
  private readonly fencing = new FencingTokenGenerator();
  private currentToken: FencingToken = 0n as unknown as FencingToken;

  elect(candidates: ElectionCandidate[]): { leader: NodeId; token: FencingToken } {
    if (candidates.length === 0) throw new Error('No candidates for election');
    const winner = candidates.slice().sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority || a.nodeId.localeCompare(b.nodeId))[0];
    this.leader = winner.nodeId;
    this.currentToken = this.fencing.next();
    return { leader: this.leader, token: this.currentToken };
  }

  getLeader(): NodeId | undefined { return this.leader; }
  getCurrentToken(): FencingToken { return this.currentToken; }
  isLeader(nodeId: NodeId): boolean { return this.leader === nodeId; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 11 — SLA BUDGET TRACKER
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface SLAConfig {
  name: string;
  targetAvailability: number;    // e.g. 0.999 = 99.9%
  windowMs: number;              // rolling window (e.g. 30 days)
  alertBurnRateMultiplier: number; // alert when burning at Nx normal rate
}

export interface SLABudgetStatus {
  name: string;
  totalBudgetMs: number;
  consumedMs: number;
  remainingMs: number;
  currentAvailability: number;
  burnRate: number;
  alerting: boolean;
  projectedExhaustionMs?: number;
}

export class SLABudgetTracker {
  private readonly incidents = new Map<string, Array<{ startMs: number; endMs?: number; resolved: boolean }>>();
  private readonly configs = new Map<string, SLAConfig>();

  registerSLA(cfg: SLAConfig): void {
    this.configs.set(cfg.name, cfg);
    if (!this.incidents.has(cfg.name)) this.incidents.set(cfg.name, []);
  }

  recordOutageStart(slaName: string): void {
    const list = this.incidents.get(slaName);
    if (!list) return;
    // Don't add if already have an open incident
    if (!list.some(i => !i.resolved)) {
      list.push({ startMs: Date.now(), resolved: false });
    }
  }

  recordOutageEnd(slaName: string): void {
    const list = this.incidents.get(slaName);
    if (!list) return;
    const open = list.find(i => !i.resolved);
    if (open) { open.endMs = Date.now(); open.resolved = true; }
  }

  getStatus(slaName: string): SLABudgetStatus | undefined {
    const cfg = this.configs.get(slaName);
    if (!cfg) return undefined;

    const now = Date.now();
    const windowStart = now - cfg.windowMs;
    const list = this.incidents.get(slaName) ?? [];

    // Downtime in window
    const downtimeMs = list.reduce((acc, inc) => {
      if ((inc.endMs ?? now) < windowStart) return acc;
      const start = Math.max(inc.startMs, windowStart);
      const end = inc.endMs ?? now;
      return acc + (end - start);
    }, 0);

    const totalBudgetMs = cfg.windowMs * (1 - cfg.targetAvailability);
    const remainingMs = Math.max(0, totalBudgetMs - downtimeMs);
    const currentAvailability = (cfg.windowMs - downtimeMs) / cfg.windowMs;

    // Burn rate: ratio of actual consumption vs expected
    const expectedBurnRatePerMs = (1 - cfg.targetAvailability);
    const actualBurnRatePerMs = downtimeMs / cfg.windowMs;
    const burnRate = expectedBurnRatePerMs > 0 ? actualBurnRatePerMs / expectedBurnRatePerMs : 0;

    const alerting = burnRate >= cfg.alertBurnRateMultiplier;
    const projectedExhaustionMs = actualBurnRatePerMs > 0
      ? now + remainingMs / actualBurnRatePerMs
      : undefined;

    return {
      name: slaName,
      totalBudgetMs,
      consumedMs: downtimeMs,
      remainingMs,
      currentAvailability,
      burnRate,
      alerting,
      projectedExhaustionMs,
    };
  }

  allStatuses(): SLABudgetStatus[] {
    return [...this.configs.keys()].map(n => this.getStatus(n)!).filter(Boolean);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 12 — RECOVERY RUNBOOK EXECUTOR
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RunbookStep {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  automated: boolean;
  execute?: () => Promise<RunbookStepResult>;
  rollback?: () => Promise<void>;
  condition?: () => boolean; // skip if returns false
}

export interface RunbookStepResult {
  success: boolean;
  message?: string;
  data?: unknown;
}

export interface Runbook {
  id: RunbookId;
  name: string;
  trigger: string; // condition that triggers this runbook
  steps: RunbookStep[];
  priority: number;
}

export interface RunbookExecution {
  runbookId: RunbookId;
  executionId: string;
  startedAt: number;
  completedAt?: number;
  steps: Array<{ name: string; status: 'skipped' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'; result?: RunbookStepResult }>;
  overall: 'in-progress' | 'succeeded' | 'failed' | 'partial';
}

export class RunbookExecutor {
  private readonly runbooks = new Map<RunbookId, Runbook>();
  private readonly executions: RunbookExecution[] = [];

  register(runbook: Runbook): void {
    this.runbooks.set(runbook.id, runbook);
  }

  async execute(runbookId: RunbookId): Promise<RunbookExecution> {
    const runbook = this.runbooks.get(runbookId);
    if (!runbook) throw new Error(`Runbook not found: ${runbookId}`);

    const exec: RunbookExecution = {
      runbookId,
      executionId: crypto.randomUUID(),
      startedAt: Date.now(),
      steps: [],
      overall: 'in-progress',
    };
    this.executions.push(exec);

    for (const step of runbook.steps) {
      // Condition check
      if (step.condition && !step.condition()) {
        exec.steps.push({ name: step.name, status: 'skipped' });
        continue;
      }

      if (!step.automated || !step.execute) {
        exec.steps.push({ name: step.name, status: 'skipped' });
        continue;
      }

      try {
        const result = await step.execute();
        exec.steps.push({ name: step.name, status: result.success ? 'succeeded' : 'failed', result });
        if (!result.success) {
          await step.rollback?.();
          exec.overall = 'partial';
          break;
        }
      } catch {
        exec.steps.push({ name: step.name, status: 'failed' });
        await step.rollback?.();
        exec.overall = 'failed';
        break;
      }
    }

    if (exec.overall === 'in-progress') exec.overall = 'succeeded';
    exec.completedAt = Date.now();
    return exec;
  }

  listRunbooks(): Runbook[] { return [...this.runbooks.values()]; }
  executionHistory(): RunbookExecution[] { return [...this.executions]; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 13 — DEAD LETTER QUEUE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface DLQEntry<T = unknown> {
  id: string;
  payload: T;
  error: string;
  originalQueue: string;
  attempts: number;
  firstFailedAt: number;
  lastFailedAt: number;
  expiresAt?: number;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export class DeadLetterQueue<T = unknown> {
  private readonly entries = new Map<string, DLQEntry<T>>();
  private readonly replayLog: Array<{ id: string; replayedAt: number; success: boolean }> = [];

  push(
    payload: T,
    error: string,
    originalQueue: string,
    attempts: number,
    ttlMs?: number,
  ): string {
    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    const now = Date.now();
    this.entries.set(id, {
      id,
      payload,
      error,
      originalQueue,
      attempts,
      firstFailedAt: now,
      lastFailedAt: now,
      expiresAt: ttlMs ? now + ttlMs : undefined,
    });
    return id;
  }

  async replay(id: string, handler: (payload: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<boolean> {
    const entry = this.entries.get(id);
    if (!entry) return false;
    if (entry.expiresAt && Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.entries.delete(id);
      return false;
    }
    try {
      await handler(entry.payload);
      this.entries.delete(id);
      this.replayLog.push({ id, replayedAt: Date.now(), success: true });
      return true;
    } catch {
      entry.lastFailedAt = Date.now();
      entry.attempts++;
      this.replayLog.push({ id, replayedAt: Date.now(), success: false });
      return false;
    }
  }

  async replayAll(handler: (payload: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<{ succeeded: number; failed: number }> {
    let succeeded = 0, failed = 0;
    for (const id of [...this.entries.keys()]) {
      if (await this.replay(id, handler)) succeeded++;
      else failed++;
    }
    return { succeeded, failed };
  }

  evictExpired(): number {
    let count = 0;
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const [id, e] of this.entries) {
      if (e.expiresAt && now > e.expiresAt) { this.entries.delete(id); count++; }
    }
    return count;
  }

  list(originalQueue?: string): DLQEntry<T>[] {
    const all = [...this.entries.values()];
    return originalQueue ? all.filter(e => e.originalQueue === originalQueue) : all;
  }

  size(): number { return this.entries.size; }
  getReplayLog(): typeof this.replayLog { return [...this.replayLog]; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 14 — RECOVERY FACADE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RecoverySystemConfig {
  walConfig?: Partial<WALConfig>;
  idempotencyTtlMs?: number;
  circuitBreakerDefaults?: Partial<CircuitBreakerConfig>;
}

export class RecoverySystem {
  readonly wal: WriteAheadLog;
  readonly pitr: PITREngine;
  readonly saga: SagaCompensationEngine;
  readonly idempotency: IdempotencyRegistry;
  readonly health: HealthCheckEngine;
  readonly chaos: ChaosEngine;
  readonly sla: SLABudgetTracker;
  readonly runbooks: RunbookExecutor;
  readonly dlq: DeadLetterQueue;
  readonly snapshot: ChandyLamportCoordinator;
  readonly election: BullyElection;
  private readonly breakers = new Map<string, CircuitBreaker>();
  private readonly defaultCBConfig: CircuitBreakerConfig;

  constructor(nodeId: NodeId = makeNodeId(), cfg: RecoverySystemConfig = {}) {
    this.wal = new WriteAheadLog(cfg.walConfig);
    this.pitr = new PITREngine(this.wal);
    this.idempotency = new IdempotencyRegistry(cfg.idempotencyTtlMs);
    this.saga = new SagaCompensationEngine(this.idempotency);
    this.health = new HealthCheckEngine();
    this.chaos = new ChaosEngine();
    this.sla = new SLABudgetTracker();
    this.runbooks = new RunbookExecutor();
    this.dlq = new DeadLetterQueue();
    this.snapshot = new ChandyLamportCoordinator(nodeId);
    this.election = new BullyElection();
    this.defaultCBConfig = {
      failureThreshold: 5,
      successThreshold: 2,
      timeoutMs: 30_000,
      halfOpenRequests: 1,
      volumeThreshold: 10,
      errorRateThreshold: 0.5,
      ...cfg.circuitBreakerDefaults,
    };
  }

  /** Get or create a circuit breaker by name */
  breaker(name: string, cfg?: Partial<CircuitBreakerConfig>): CircuitBreaker {
    if (!this.breakers.has(name)) {
      this.breakers.set(name, new CircuitBreaker(name, { ...this.defaultCBConfig, ...cfg }));
    }
    return this.breakers.get(name)!;
  }

  /** Wrap any async operation with full resilience */
  async resilient<T>(
    name: string,
    fn: () => Promise<T>,
    opts: ResilientCallOptions = {},
  ): Promise<T> {
    const cb = this.breaker(name, opts.circuitBreaker);
    const policy: RetryPolicy = opts.retry ?? { maxAttempts: 1, backoffMs: 0, strategy: 'fixed' };
    let lastErr: Error | undefined;

    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < policy.maxAttempts; attempt++) {
      try {
        return await cb.call(() => opts.chaos
          ? this.chaos.inject(name, fn)
          : fn(),
        );
      } catch (err) {
        lastErr = err as Error;
        if (err instanceof CircuitOpenError) throw err;
        if (policy.retryOn && !policy.retryOn(lastErr)) throw err;
        if (attempt < policy.maxAttempts - 1) {
          const backoff = policy.backoffMs * Math.pow(2, attempt);
          const jitter = Math.random() * backoff * 0.2;
          await sleep(backoff + jitter);
        }
      }
    }
    throw lastErr;
  }

  async healthReport() { return this.health.report(); }

  dispose(): void {
    this.wal.stopTimer();
    this.health.stop();
    this.idempotency.stop();
  }
}

export interface ResilientCallOptions {
  retry?: RetryPolicy;
  circuitBreaker?: Partial<CircuitBreakerConfig>;
  chaos?: boolean;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 15 — RE-EXPORTS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export { sleep };

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
}

let _default: RecoverySystem | undefined;
export function getRecoverySystem(cfg?: RecoverySystemConfig): RecoverySystem {
  if (!_default) _default = new RecoverySystem(makeNodeId(), cfg);
  return _default;
}
export function resetRecoverySystem(): void {
  _default?.dispose();
  _default = undefined;
}
