// SECTION 2 — WELFORD ONLINE STATISTICS (variance, mean, stddev)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class WelfordStats {
  private n = 0;
  private mean_ = 0;
  private M2 = 0;
  private min_ = Infinity;
  private max_ = -Infinity;

  update(x: number): void {
    this.n++;
    const delta = x - this.mean_;
    this.mean_ += delta / this.n;
    const delta2 = x - this.mean_;
    this.M2 += delta * delta2;
    if (x < this.min_) this.min_ = x;
    if (x > this.max_) this.max_ = x;
  }

  mean(): number   { return this.mean_; }
  variance(): number { return this.n < 2 ? 0 : this.M2 / (this.n - 1); }
  stddev(): number { return Math.sqrt(this.variance()); }
  min(): number    { return this.min_; }
  max(): number    { return this.max_; }
  count(): number  { return this.n; }
  cv(): number     { return this.mean_ !== 0 ? this.stddev() / Math.abs(this.mean_) : 0; }

  zScore(x: number): number {
    const sd = this.stddev();
    return sd > 0 ? (x - this.mean_) / sd : 0;
  }

  isAnomaly(x: number, threshold = 3.0): boolean {
    return Math.abs(this.zScore(x)) > threshold;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 3 — CUSUM CONTROL CHART (change detection)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class CUSUMDetector {
  private sHigh = 0;
  private sLow  = 0;
  private readonly k: number;
  private readonly h: number;
  private alarms: number[] = [];

  constructor(
    private readonly targetMean: number,
    private readonly sigma: number,
    k = 0.5,   // allowance (k * sigma)
    h = 5.0,   // decision interval (h * sigma)
  ) {
    this.k = k * sigma;
    this.h = h * sigma;
  }

  update(x: number): CUSUMResult {
    this.sHigh = Math.max(0, this.sHigh + x - this.targetMean - this.k);
    this.sLow  = Math.max(0, this.sLow  - x + this.targetMean - this.k);
    const alarm = this.sHigh > this.h || this.sLow > this.h;
    if (alarm) {
      this.alarms.push(Date.now());
      this.sHigh = 0;
      this.sLow  = 0;
    }
    return { sHigh: this.sHigh, sLow: this.sLow, alarm, alarmCount: this.alarms.length };
  }

  reset(): void { this.sHigh = 0; this.sLow = 0; }
  alarmCount(): number { return this.alarms.length; }
}

export interface CUSUMResult {
  sHigh: number;
  sLow: number;
  alarm: boolean;
  alarmCount: number;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 4 — HOLT-WINTERS TRIPLE EXPONENTIAL SMOOTHING
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class HoltWintersForecaster {
  private level: number;
  private trend: number;
  private seasonal: number[];
  private fitted: number[] = [];
  private readonly m: number;

  constructor(
    initialSeries: number[],
    private readonly alpha = 0.3,  // level smoothing
    private readonly beta  = 0.1,  // trend smoothing
    private readonly gamma = 0.2,  // seasonal smoothing
    seasonPeriod = 24,              // e.g. 24 hours
  ) {
    this.m = seasonPeriod;
    this.seasonal = new Array(seasonPeriod).fill(0);
    this.level = initialSeries.slice(0, seasonPeriod).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / seasonPeriod;
    this.trend = 0;
    if (initialSeries.length >= 2 * seasonPeriod) {
      const avg1 = initialSeries.slice(0, seasonPeriod).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / seasonPeriod;
      const avg2 = initialSeries.slice(seasonPeriod, 2 * seasonPeriod).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / seasonPeriod;
      this.trend = (avg2 - avg1) / seasonPeriod;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < seasonPeriod && i < initialSeries.length; i++) {
      this.seasonal[i] = this.level > 0 ? initialSeries[i] / this.level : 0;
    }
    for (const v of initialSeries) this.update(v);
  }

  update(actual: number): number {
    const t = this.fitted.length;
    const s = this.seasonal[t % this.m];
    const prevLevel = this.level;
    this.level = this.alpha * (actual / (s || 1)) + (1 - this.alpha) * (this.level + this.trend);
    this.trend = this.beta * (this.level - prevLevel) + (1 - this.beta) * this.trend;
    this.seasonal[t % this.m] = this.gamma * (actual / (this.level || 1)) + (1 - this.gamma) * s;
    const forecast = (this.level + this.trend) * (this.seasonal[t % this.m] || 1);
    this.fitted.push(forecast);
    return forecast;
  }

  forecast(steps = 1): number[] {
    const result: number[] = [];
    let l = this.level, t = this.trend;
    for (let h = 1; h <= steps; h++) {
      const s = this.seasonal[(this.fitted.length + h) % this.m] || 1;
      result.push((l + h * t) * s);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /** Detect if current value is an anomaly vs forecast */
  anomalyScore(actual: number, forecast: number, tolerance = 2.0): number {
    const error = Math.abs(actual - forecast);
    const recentErrors = this.fitted.slice(-20).map((f, i) => {
      const idx = this.fitted.length - 20 + i;
      return 0; // placeholder: in prod compare to actual series
    });
    return error / (Math.max(forecast * 0.1, 1));
  }

  lastForecast(): number { return this.fitted[this.fitted.length - 1] ?? this.level; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 5 — ISOLATION FOREST (anomaly detection)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface ITreeNode {
  feature?: number;
  threshold?: number;
  left?: ITreeNode;
  right?: ITreeNode;
  size?: number;
  isLeaf: boolean;
}

export class IsolationForest {
  private readonly trees: ITreeNode[] = [];
  private readonly sampleSize: number;

  constructor(
    private readonly numTrees = 100,
    sampleSize = 256,
    private readonly maxDepth = 8,
  ) {
    this.sampleSize = sampleSize;
  }

  fit(data: number[][]): void {
    this.trees.length = 0;
    for (let t = 0; t < this.numTrees; t++) {
      const sample = this.randomSample(data, this.sampleSize);
      this.trees.push(this.buildTree(sample, 0));
    }
  }

  score(point: number[]): number {
    if (this.trees.length === 0) return 0;
    const avgDepth = this.trees.reduce((sum, tree) => sum + this.pathLength(point, tree, 0), 0) / this.trees.length;
    const c = this.avgPathLength(this.sampleSize);
    return Math.pow(2, -avgDepth / c);
  }

  isAnomaly(point: number[], threshold = 0.6): boolean {
    return this.score(point) > threshold;
  }

  private buildTree(data: number[][], depth: number): ITreeNode {
    if (data.length <= 1 || depth >= this.maxDepth) {
      return { isLeaf: true, size: data.length };
    }
    const nFeatures = data[0].length;
    const feature = Math.floor(Math.random() * nFeatures);
    const vals = data.map(d => d[feature]);
    const min = Math.min(...vals);
    const max = Math.max(...vals);
    if (min === max) return { isLeaf: true, size: data.length };
    const threshold = min + Math.random() * (max - min);
    const left  = data.filter(d => d[feature] < threshold);
    const right = data.filter(d => d[feature] >= threshold);
    return {
      isLeaf: false,
      feature,
      threshold,
      left: this.buildTree(left, depth + 1),
      right: this.buildTree(right, depth + 1),
    };
  }

  private pathLength(point: number[], node: ITreeNode, depth: number): number {
    if (node.isLeaf) return depth + this.avgPathLength(node.size ?? 1);
    const f = node.feature!;
    if (point[f] < node.threshold!) return this.pathLength(point, node.left!, depth + 1);
    return this.pathLength(point, node.right!, depth + 1);
  }

  private avgPathLength(n: number): number {
    if (n <= 1) return 0;
    return 2 * (Math.log(n - 1) + 0.5772156649) - 2 * (n - 1) / n;
  }

  private randomSample<T>(arr: T[], n: number): T[] {
    const result: T[] = [];
    const a = arr.slice();
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(n, a.length); i++) {
      const j = i + Math.floor(Math.random() * (a.length - i));
      [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
      result.push(a[i]);
    }
    return result;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 6 — MULTI-ARMED BANDIT (UCB1) — config auto-tuning
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface BanditArm {
  id: string;
  config: Record<string, unknown>;
  pulls: number;
  totalReward: number;
  meanReward: number;
}

export class UCB1Bandit {
  private readonly arms: Map<string, BanditArm> = new Map();
  private totalPulls = 0;

  addArm(id: string, config: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.arms.set(id, { id, config, pulls: 0, totalReward: 0, meanReward: 0 });
  }

  /** Select arm with highest UCB1 score */
  select(): BanditArm {
    // Explore unexplored arms first
    for (const arm of this.arms.values()) {
      if (arm.pulls === 0) return arm;
    }

    let bestArm: BanditArm | undefined;
    let bestScore = -Infinity;

    for (const arm of this.arms.values()) {
      // UCB1: mean + sqrt(2 * ln(N) / n_i)
      const exploration = Math.sqrt(2 * Math.log(this.totalPulls) / arm.pulls);
      const score = arm.meanReward + exploration;
      if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; bestArm = arm; }
    }

    return bestArm ?? [...this.arms.values()][0];
  }

  update(armId: string, reward: number): void {
    const arm = this.arms.get(armId);
    if (!arm) return;
    arm.pulls++;
    arm.totalReward += reward;
    arm.meanReward = arm.totalReward / arm.pulls;
    this.totalPulls++;
  }

  bestArm(): BanditArm | undefined {
    let best: BanditArm | undefined;
    for (const arm of this.arms.values()) {
      if (!best || arm.meanReward > best.meanReward) best = arm;
    }
    return best;
  }

  rankings(): BanditArm[] {
    return [...this.arms.values()].sort((a, b) => b.meanReward - a.meanReward);
  }

  totalPulls_(): number { return this.totalPulls; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 7 — Q-LEARNING AGENT (tabular, ε-greedy)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class QLearningAgent {
  private readonly Q: Map<string, Map<string, number>> = new Map();
  private epsilon: number;
  private readonly epsilonDecay: number;
  private readonly minEpsilon: number;
  private readonly alpha: number;
  private readonly gamma: number;
  private steps = 0;

  constructor(
    private readonly actions: string[],
    opts: {
      alpha?: number;      // learning rate
      gamma?: number;      // discount factor
      epsilon?: number;    // exploration rate
      epsilonDecay?: number;
      minEpsilon?: number;
    } = {},
  ) {
    this.alpha = opts.alpha ?? 0.1;
    this.gamma = opts.gamma ?? 0.95;
    this.epsilon = opts.epsilon ?? 1.0;
    this.epsilonDecay = opts.epsilonDecay ?? 0.995;
    this.minEpsilon = opts.minEpsilon ?? 0.01;
  }

  private stateKey(state: Record<string, unknown>): string {
    return JSON.stringify(Object.entries(state).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)));
  }

  private getQ(state: string, action: string): number {
    return this.Q.get(state)?.get(action) ?? 0;
  }

  private setQ(state: string, action: string, value: number): void {
    if (!this.Q.has(state)) this.Q.set(state, new Map());
    this.Q.get(state)!.set(action, value);
  }

  /** Choose action given current state */
  act(state: Record<string, unknown>): string {
    const sk = this.stateKey(state);
    if (Math.random() < this.epsilon) {
      return this.actions[Math.floor(Math.random() * this.actions.length)];
    }
    let bestAction = this.actions[0];
    let bestQ = -Infinity;
    for (const a of this.actions) {
      const q = this.getQ(sk, a);
      if (q > bestQ) { bestQ = q; bestAction = a; }
    }
    return bestAction;
  }

  /** Update Q-table: Q(s,a) ← Q(s,a) + α[r + γ max Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)] */
  learn(
    state: Record<string, unknown>,
    action: string,
    reward: number,
    nextState: Record<string, unknown>,
  ): void {
    const sk = this.stateKey(state);
    const nsk = this.stateKey(nextState);
    const maxNextQ = Math.max(...this.actions.map(a => this.getQ(nsk, a)));
    const currentQ = this.getQ(sk, action);
    const newQ = currentQ + this.alpha * (reward + this.gamma * maxNextQ - currentQ);
    this.setQ(sk, action, newQ);
    this.epsilon = Math.max(this.minEpsilon, this.epsilon * this.epsilonDecay);
    this.steps++;
  }

  /** Explain why the agent chose an action */
  explain(state: Record<string, unknown>): ActionExplanation[] {
    const sk = this.stateKey(state);
    return this.actions.map(a => ({
      action: a,
      qValue: this.getQ(sk, a),
      rank: 0,
    })).sort((a, b) => b.qValue - a.qValue).map((e, i) => ({ ...e, rank: i + 1 }));
  }

  stats(): QLearningStats {
    return { steps: this.steps, epsilon: this.epsilon, states: this.Q.size };
  }
}

export interface ActionExplanation {
  action: string;
  qValue: number;
  rank: number;
}

export interface QLearningStats {
  steps: number;
  epsilon: number;
  states: number;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 8 — SEMANTIC MEMORY (episodic log + cosine retrieval)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface MemoryEntry {
  id: string;
  timestamp: number;
  moduleId: string;
  type: string;
  content: Record<string, unknown>;
  embedding: number[];     // feature vector for similarity search
  importance: number;      // 0.0–1.0 — decays over time
  tags: string[];
}

export class SemanticMemory {
  private readonly entries: MemoryEntry[] = [];
  private readonly maxEntries: number;
  private readonly decayRate: number;

  constructor(maxEntries = 10_000, decayRate = 0.99) {
    this.maxEntries = maxEntries;
    this.decayRate = decayRate;
  }

  store(entry: Omit<MemoryEntry, 'id'>): string {
    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    this.entries.push({ id, ...entry });
    if (this.entries.length > this.maxEntries) {
      // Evict least important
      this.entries.sort((a, b) => a.importance - b.importance);
      this.entries.splice(0, Math.floor(this.maxEntries * 0.1));
    }
    return id;
  }

  /** Cosine similarity retrieval */
  retrieve(queryEmbedding: number[], topK = 5, moduleFilter?: string): MemoryEntry[] {
    let candidates = this.entries;
    if (moduleFilter) candidates = candidates.filter(e => e.moduleId === moduleFilter);

    // Decay importance
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const e of this.entries) {
      const age = (now - e.timestamp) / 3600_000;
      e.importance *= Math.pow(this.decayRate, age);
    }

    return candidates
      .map(e => ({ entry: e, score: this.cosineSim(queryEmbedding, e.embedding) * e.importance }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
      .slice(0, topK)
      .map(r => r.entry);
  }

  private cosineSim(a: number[], b: number[]): number {
    if (a.length !== b.length) return 0;
    let dot = 0, magA = 0, magB = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      dot += a[i] * b[i];
      magA += a[i] * a[i];
      magB += b[i] * b[i];
    }
    const denom = Math.sqrt(magA) * Math.sqrt(magB);
    return denom > 0 ? dot / denom : 0;
  }

  /** Simple bag-of-words embedding for structured data */
  static embed(content: Record<string, unknown>): number[] {
    const keys = Object.keys(content).sort();
    const vec = new Array(64).fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      const h = keys[i].split('').reduce((acc, c) => (acc * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0, 0);
      vec[h % 64] += 1;
      const val = content[keys[i]];
      if (typeof val === 'number') vec[(h + 1) % 64] += val % 1;
    }
    const mag = Math.sqrt(vec.reduce((a, v) => a + v * v, 0));
    return mag > 0 ? vec.map(v => v / mag) : vec;
  }

  size(): number { return this.entries.length; }
  clear(): void { this.entries.length = 0; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 9 — ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface FaultEvent {
  id: string;
  timestamp: number;
  moduleId: string;
  severity: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'critical';
  type: string;
  message: string;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface FaultTreeNode {
  event: string;
  probability: number;
  children: FaultTreeNode[];
  gate: 'AND' | 'OR' | 'leaf';
}

export interface RCAResult {
  primaryCause: string;
  contributingCauses: string[];
  affectedModules: string[];
  confidence: number;
  timeline: FaultEvent[];
  recommendations: string[];
  faultTree: FaultTreeNode;
}

export class RootCauseAnalyzer {
  private readonly eventLog: FaultEvent[] = [];
  private readonly correlationMatrix = new Map<string, Map<string, number>>();
  private readonly knownPatterns: Array<{ pattern: string[]; cause: string; confidence: number }> = [];

  ingest(event: FaultEvent): void {
    this.eventLog.push(event);
    this.updateCorrelations(event);
    if (this.eventLog.length > 10_000) this.eventLog.shift();
  }

  analyze(windowMs = 60_000): RCAResult {
    const now = Date.now();
    const recentEvents = this.eventLog.filter(e => now - e.timestamp < windowMs);
    const errors = recentEvents.filter(e => e.severity === 'error' || e.severity === 'critical');

    if (errors.length === 0) {
      return {
        primaryCause: 'none',
        contributingCauses: [],
        affectedModules: [],
        confidence: 0,
        timeline: [],
        recommendations: [],
        faultTree: { event: 'healthy', probability: 0, children: [], gate: 'leaf' },
      };
    }

    // Find earliest event in causal chain
    const sortedErrors = errors.sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp);
    const primaryCause = sortedErrors[0];
    const affectedModules = [...new Set(errors.map(e => e.moduleId))];

    // Pattern matching
    const eventTypes = errors.map(e => e.type);
    let matchedPattern = this.knownPatterns.find(p =>
      p.pattern.every(t => eventTypes.includes(t)),
    );

    const recommendations = this.generateRecommendations(errors, primaryCause);
    const faultTree = this.buildFaultTree(errors);

    return {
      primaryCause: matchedPattern?.cause ?? `${primaryCause.moduleId}.${primaryCause.type}`,
      contributingCauses: sortedErrors.slice(1, 5).map(e => `${e.moduleId}.${e.type}`),
      affectedModules,
      confidence: matchedPattern?.confidence ?? this.estimateConfidence(errors),
      timeline: sortedErrors,
      recommendations,
      faultTree,
    };
  }

  registerPattern(pattern: string[], cause: string, confidence = 0.8): void {
    this.knownPatterns.push({ pattern, cause, confidence });
  }

  private updateCorrelations(event: FaultEvent): void {
    const recent = this.eventLog.slice(-100).filter(e => Date.now() - e.timestamp < 10_000);
    for (const e of recent) {
      if (e.id === event.id) continue;
      const key = `${e.type}:${event.type}`;
      if (!this.correlationMatrix.has(e.type)) this.correlationMatrix.set(e.type, new Map());
      const m = this.correlationMatrix.get(e.type)!;
      m.set(event.type, (m.get(event.type) ?? 0) + 1);
    }
  }

  private buildFaultTree(errors: FaultEvent[]): FaultTreeNode {
    const root: FaultTreeNode = {
      event: 'System Failure',
      probability: 1.0,
      gate: 'OR',
      children: errors.slice(0, 5).map(e => ({
        event: `${e.moduleId}: ${e.type}`,
        probability: e.severity === 'critical' ? 0.9 : 0.6,
        children: [],
        gate: 'leaf' as const,
      })),
    };
    return root;
  }

  private generateRecommendations(errors: FaultEvent[], primary: FaultEvent): string[] {
    const recs: string[] = [];
    const types = new Set(errors.map(e => e.type));

    if (types.has('timeout'))    recs.push('Increase timeout thresholds or add circuit breaker');
    if (types.has('rate_limit')) recs.push('Scale horizontally or increase rate limit capacity');
    if (types.has('oom'))        recs.push('Increase memory allocation or reduce batch sizes');
    if (types.has('connection')) recs.push('Check network connectivity and retry policies');
    if (types.has('auth'))       recs.push('Rotate credentials and verify identity configuration');
    if (errors.length > 10)      recs.push('Consider enabling chaos engineering to validate resilience');

    recs.push(`Primary module ${primary.moduleId} should be investigated first`);
    return recs;
  }

  private estimateConfidence(errors: FaultEvent[]): number {
    const ratio = errors.filter(e => e.severity === 'critical').length / errors.length;
    return Math.min(0.95, 0.5 + ratio * 0.5);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 10 — SELF-HEALING STATE MACHINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type HealingState =
  | 'healthy'
  | 'detecting'
  | 'diagnosing'
  | 'remediating'
  | 'verifying'
  | 'failed_healing'
  | 'escalated';

export interface HealingAction {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  automated: boolean;
  execute: () => Promise<HealingActionResult>;
  verify: () => Promise<boolean>;
}

export interface HealingActionResult {
  success: boolean;
  message: string;
  metrics?: Record<string, number>;
}

export interface HealingEpisode {
  id: EpisodeId;
  moduleId: string;
  startedAt: number;
  completedAt?: number;
  state: HealingState;
  faultDescription: string;
  actionsAttempted: Array<{ name: string; success: boolean; at: number }>;
  resolved: boolean;
  escalated: boolean;
}

export class SelfHealingEngine {
  private readonly state = new Map<string, HealingState>();
  private readonly episodes: HealingEpisode[] = [];
  private readonly playbooks = new Map<string, HealingAction[]>();
  private readonly rcaEngine: RootCauseAnalyzer;
  private readonly memory: SemanticMemory;

  constructor(rcaEngine: RootCauseAnalyzer, memory: SemanticMemory) {
    this.rcaEngine = rcaEngine;
    this.memory = memory;
  }

  registerPlaybook(faultType: string, actions: HealingAction[]): void {
    this.playbooks.set(faultType, actions);
  }

  async heal(moduleId: string, faultEvents: FaultEvent[]): Promise<HealingEpisode> {
    const episode: HealingEpisode = {
      id: makeEpisodeId(),
      moduleId,
      startedAt: Date.now(),
      state: 'detecting',
      faultDescription: '',
      actionsAttempted: [],
      resolved: false,
      escalated: false,
    };
    this.episodes.push(episode);
    this.state.set(moduleId, 'detecting');

    // 1. Detect & Diagnose
    episode.state = 'diagnosing';
    this.state.set(moduleId, 'diagnosing');
    const rca = this.rcaEngine.analyze();
    episode.faultDescription = rca.primaryCause;

    // 2. Retrieve similar past episodes from memory
    const embedding = SemanticMemory.embed({ cause: rca.primaryCause, module: moduleId });
    const similar = this.memory.retrieve(embedding, 3, moduleId);

    // 3. Remediate
    episode.state = 'remediating';
    this.state.set(moduleId, 'remediating');
    const playbook = this.playbooks.get(rca.primaryCause) ?? this.playbooks.get('default') ?? [];

    for (const action of playbook) {
      if (!action.automated) continue;
      try {
        const result = await action.execute();
        episode.actionsAttempted.push({ name: action.name, success: result.success, at: Date.now() });
        if (!result.success) continue;

        // 4. Verify
        episode.state = 'verifying';
        this.state.set(moduleId, 'verifying');
        const verified = await action.verify();
        if (verified) {
          episode.state = 'healthy';
          episode.resolved = true;
          this.state.set(moduleId, 'healthy');

          // Store successful healing in memory
          this.memory.store({
            timestamp: Date.now(),
            moduleId,
            type: 'healing_success',
            content: { cause: rca.primaryCause, action: action.name, faultEvents: faultEvents.length },
            embedding,
            importance: 0.9,
            tags: ['healing', 'success', moduleId],
          });

          break;
        }
      } catch { episode.actionsAttempted.push({ name: action.name, success: false, at: Date.now() }); }
    }

    if (!episode.resolved) {
      episode.state = 'escalated';
      episode.escalated = true;
      this.state.set(moduleId, 'escalated');
    }

    episode.completedAt = Date.now();
    return episode;
  }

  getState(moduleId: string): HealingState { return this.state.get(moduleId) ?? 'healthy'; }
  getEpisodes(moduleId?: string): HealingEpisode[] {
    return moduleId ? this.episodes.filter(e => e.moduleId === moduleId) : this.episodes.slice();
  }
  successRate(): number {
    if (this.episodes.length === 0) return 1;
    return this.episodes.filter(e => e.resolved).length / this.episodes.length;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 11 — AUTONOMOUS POLICY ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface IntelligencePolicy {
  id: PolicyId;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  priority: number;
  condition: (ctx: PolicyContext) => boolean;
  action: (ctx: PolicyContext) => Action;
  cooldownMs?: number;
  lastFired?: number;
  fireCount: number;
  source: 'learned' | 'rule';
}

export interface PolicyContext {
  moduleId: string;
  metrics: Record<string, number>;
  anomalies: string[];
  forecast: Record<string, number>;
  state: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export class PolicyEngine {
  private readonly policies = new Map<PolicyId, IntelligencePolicy>();
  private readonly actionLog: Array<{ policyId: PolicyId; action: Action; context: PolicyContext; at: number }> = [];
  private readonly bandit: UCB1Bandit;

  constructor() {
    this.bandit = new UCB1Bandit();
  }

  register(policy: IntelligencePolicy): void {
    this.policies.set(policy.id, policy);
    this.bandit.addArm(policy.id, { policyId: policy.id });
  }

  evaluate(ctx: PolicyContext): Action[] {
    const now = Date.now();
    const fired: Action[] = [];

    const sorted = [...this.policies.values()].sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority);

    for (const policy of sorted) {
      // Cooldown check
      if (policy.cooldownMs && policy.lastFired && now - policy.lastFired < policy.cooldownMs) continue;

      if (policy.condition(ctx)) {
        const action = policy.action(ctx);
        policy.lastFired = now;
        policy.fireCount++;
        this.actionLog.push({ policyId: policy.id, action, context: ctx, at: now });
        fired.push(action);
      }
    }

    return fired;
  }

  /** Reward a policy based on outcome */
  reward(policyId: PolicyId, reward: number): void {
    this.bandit.update(policyId, reward);
  }

  /** Learn a new policy from observed (state, action, reward) tuples */
  learnPolicy(
    name: string,
    condition: (ctx: PolicyContext) => boolean,
    action: (ctx: PolicyContext) => Action,
    opts: { priority?: number; cooldownMs?: number } = {},
  ): PolicyId {
    const id = makePolicyId();
    this.register({
      id,
      name,
      description: `Learned policy: ${name}`,
      priority: opts.priority ?? 50,
      condition,
      action,
      cooldownMs: opts.cooldownMs,
      fireCount: 0,
      source: 'learned',
    });
    return id;
  }

  actionHistory(limit = 100): typeof this.actionLog {
    return this.actionLog.slice(-limit);
  }

  stats(): PolicyStats {
    return {
      policies: this.policies.size,
      totalActions: this.actionLog.length,
      topPolicy: [...this.policies.values()].sort((a, b) => b.fireCount - a.fireCount)[0]?.name,
    };
  }
}

export interface PolicyStats {
  policies: number;
  totalActions: number;
  topPolicy?: string;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 12 — PREDICTIVE AUTO-SCALER
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ScalingDecision {
  moduleId: string;
  currentConcurrency: number;
  recommendedConcurrency: number;
  reason: string;
  confidence: number;
  forecastedLoad: number;
  timestamp: number;
}

export class PredictiveAutoScaler {
  private readonly forecasters = new Map<string, HoltWintersForecaster>();
  private readonly statsMap = new Map<string, WelfordStats>();
  private readonly decisions: ScalingDecision[] = [];

  recordLoad(moduleId: string, load: number, timestamp = Date.now()): void {
    if (!this.statsMap.has(moduleId)) this.statsMap.set(moduleId, new WelfordStats());
    this.statsMap.get(moduleId)!.update(load);

    if (!this.forecasters.has(moduleId)) {
      this.forecasters.set(moduleId, new HoltWintersForecaster([load], 0.3, 0.1, 0.2, 24));
    }
    this.forecasters.get(moduleId)!.update(load);
  }

  recommend(moduleId: string, currentConcurrency: number, maxConcurrency = 64): ScalingDecision {
    const forecaster = this.forecasters.get(moduleId);
    const stats = this.statsMap.get(moduleId);
    const forecastedLoad = forecaster?.forecast(1)[0] ?? stats?.mean() ?? currentConcurrency;

    // Target utilization = 70%
    const targetUtil = 0.7;
    const recommended = Math.ceil(forecastedLoad / targetUtil);
    const clamped = Math.max(1, Math.min(maxConcurrency, recommended));

    const decision: ScalingDecision = {
      moduleId,
      currentConcurrency,
      recommendedConcurrency: clamped,
      reason: clamped > currentConcurrency ? 'scale-out: forecast exceeds target utilization'
            : clamped < currentConcurrency ? 'scale-in: forecast below target utilization'
            : 'no-change',
      confidence: forecaster ? 0.85 : 0.5,
      forecastedLoad,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    };

    this.decisions.push(decision);
    return decision;
  }

  history(moduleId?: string): ScalingDecision[] {
    return moduleId ? this.decisions.filter(d => d.moduleId === moduleId) : this.decisions.slice();
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 13 — MODULE INTELLIGENCE WRAPPER (decorator)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ModuleIntelligenceConfig {
  moduleId: string;
  anomalyZThreshold?: number;
  isolationForestThreshold?: number;
  enableSelfHealing?: boolean;
  enableAutoTuning?: boolean;
  enablePredictiveScaling?: boolean;
  enableRCA?: boolean;
  banditArms?: Array<{ id: string; config: Record<string, unknown> }>;
}

export interface IntelligenceReport {
  moduleId: string;
  timestamp: number;
  anomalyDetected: boolean;
  anomalyScore: number;
  anomalyDetails: string[];
  forecast: Record<string, number>;
  currentConfig: Record<string, unknown>;
  recommendedConfig: Record<string, unknown>;
  scalingDecision?: ScalingDecision;
  healingState: HealingState;
  activePolicies: string[];
  insights: string[];
  confidence: number;
}

export class ModuleIntelligence {
  readonly moduleId: string;
  private readonly stats = new Map<string, WelfordStats>();
  private readonly cusums = new Map<string, CUSUMDetector>();
  private readonly forecastersMap = new Map<string, HoltWintersForecaster>();
  private readonly iForest: IsolationForest;
  private readonly bandit: UCB1Bandit;
  private readonly agent: QLearningAgent;
  private readonly scaler: PredictiveAutoScaler;
  private readonly policyEngine: PolicyEngine;
  private readonly memory: SemanticMemory;
  private readonly rca: RootCauseAnalyzer;
  private readonly healer: SelfHealingEngine;
  private currentConfig: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  private readonly faultBuffer: FaultEvent[] = [];
  private observationCount = 0;
  private readonly iForestBuffer: number[][] = [];

  constructor(private readonly cfg: ModuleIntelligenceConfig) {
    this.moduleId = cfg.moduleId;
    this.iForest = new IsolationForest(50, 128, 8);
    this.bandit = new UCB1Bandit();
    this.scaler = new PredictiveAutoScaler();
    this.policyEngine = new PolicyEngine();
    this.memory = new SemanticMemory(5_000);
    this.rca = new RootCauseAnalyzer();
    this.healer = new SelfHealingEngine(this.rca, this.memory);
    this.agent = new QLearningAgent(
      ['scale_up', 'scale_down', 'increase_timeout', 'decrease_timeout', 'enable_circuit_breaker', 'noop'],
    );

    for (const arm of cfg.banditArms ?? []) this.bandit.addArm(arm.id, arm.config);
    this.registerDefaultPolicies();
  }

  /** Observe a metric snapshot from the module */
  observe(metrics: Record<string, number>, context: Record<string, unknown> = {}): IntelligenceReport {
    this.observationCount++;

    // Update stats per metric
    const anomalyDetails: string[] = [];
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(metrics)) {
      if (!this.stats.has(key)) this.stats.set(key, new WelfordStats());
      const s = this.stats.get(key)!;
      s.update(val);

      if (s.count() > 30 && s.isAnomaly(val, this.cfg.anomalyZThreshold ?? 3.0)) {
        anomalyDetails.push(`${key}: z=${s.zScore(val).toFixed(2)} (value=${val}, mean=${s.mean().toFixed(2)})`);
      }

      // CUSUM
      if (!this.cusums.has(key)) this.cusums.set(key, new CUSUMDetector(s.mean(), s.stddev() || 1));
      const cusum = this.cusums.get(key)!.update(val);
      if (cusum.alarm) anomalyDetails.push(`${key}: CUSUM alarm (change point detected)`);

      // Forecaster
      if (!this.forecastersMap.has(key)) {
        this.forecastersMap.set(key, new HoltWintersForecaster([val]));
      }
      this.forecastersMap.get(key)!.update(val);
    }

    // Isolation Forest
    const featureVec = Object.values(metrics);
    this.iForestBuffer.push(featureVec);
    if (this.iForestBuffer.length > 256) this.iForestBuffer.shift();
    if (this.iForestBuffer.length >= 50 && this.observationCount % 50 === 0) {
      this.iForest.fit(this.iForestBuffer);
    }
    const iScore = this.iForestBuffer.length >= 50 ? this.iForest.score(featureVec) : 0;
    const anomalyDetected = anomalyDetails.length > 0 || iScore > (this.cfg.isolationForestThreshold ?? 0.65);

    // Forecasts
    const forecast: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const [key, f] of this.forecastersMap) {
      forecast[key] = f.forecast(1)[0];
    }

    // Policy evaluation
    const ctx: PolicyContext = {
      moduleId: this.moduleId,
      metrics,
      anomalies: anomalyDetails,
      forecast,
      state: context,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    };
    const actions = this.policyEngine.evaluate(ctx);

    // Auto-tuning via bandit
    let recommendedConfig = { ...this.currentConfig };
    if (this.cfg.enableAutoTuning && this.bandit.totalPulls_() > 0) {
      const bestArm = this.bandit.bestArm();
      if (bestArm) recommendedConfig = { ...this.currentConfig, ...bestArm.config };
    }

    // Predictive scaling
    let scalingDecision: ScalingDecision | undefined;
    if (this.cfg.enablePredictiveScaling && metrics['concurrency']) {
      this.scaler.recordLoad(this.moduleId, metrics['load'] ?? metrics['concurrency']);
      scalingDecision = this.scaler.recommend(this.moduleId, metrics['concurrency']);
    }

    // Store in memory
    if (anomalyDetected) {
      this.memory.store({
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        moduleId: this.moduleId,
        type: 'anomaly',
        content: { metrics, anomalyDetails, iScore },
        embedding: SemanticMemory.embed({ ...metrics }),
        importance: Math.min(1.0, 0.5 + iScore),
        tags: ['anomaly', this.moduleId],
      });
    }

    // Ingest into RCA if error
    if (metrics['errorRate'] && metrics['errorRate'] > 0.1) {
      this.rca.ingest({
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        moduleId: this.moduleId,
        severity: metrics['errorRate'] > 0.5 ? 'critical' : 'error',
        type: 'high_error_rate',
        message: `Error rate ${(metrics['errorRate'] * 100).toFixed(1)}%`,
        metadata: metrics,
      });
    }

    // Insights
    const insights: string[] = actions.map(a => a.explanation);
    if (scalingDecision && scalingDecision.recommendedConcurrency !== scalingDecision.currentConcurrency) {
      insights.push(`Scaling recommendation: ${scalingDecision.reason} (${scalingDecision.currentConcurrency}→${scalingDecision.recommendedConcurrency})`);
    }
    if (anomalyDetected) insights.push(`Anomaly detected (isolation score: ${iScore.toFixed(3)})`);

    return {
      moduleId: this.moduleId,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      anomalyDetected,
      anomalyScore: iScore,
      anomalyDetails,
      forecast,
      currentConfig: this.currentConfig,
      recommendedConfig,
      scalingDecision,
      healingState: this.healer.getState(this.moduleId),
      activePolicies: actions.map(a => a.type),
      insights,
      confidence: this.observationCount > 100 ? 0.9 : this.observationCount / 100,
    };
  }

  /** Wrap any module method with intelligence: observe, act, learn */
  async wrap<TArgs extends unknown[], TReturn>(
    fn: (...args: TArgs) => Promise<TReturn>,
    args: TArgs,
    metricsExtractor?: (result: TReturn, durationMs: number) => Record<string, number>,
  ): Promise<{ result: TReturn; report: IntelligenceReport }> {
    const start = Date.now();
    let result: TReturn;
    let errorCode: string | undefined;

    try {
      result = await fn(...args);
    } catch (err) {
      errorCode = (err as Error).name;
      throw err;
    } finally {
      const durationMs = Date.now() - start;
      const baseMetrics: Record<string, number> = {
        latencyMs: durationMs,
        errorRate: errorCode ? 1 : 0,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };
      const extraMetrics = result! && metricsExtractor ? metricsExtractor(result!, durationMs) : {};
      const report = this.observe({ ...baseMetrics, ...extraMetrics });

      // RL: choose action and learn
      const state = { latency: durationMs / 1000, errorRate: errorCode ? 1 : 0 };
      const action = this.agent.act(state);
      const reward = errorCode ? -1 : Math.max(-1, 1 - durationMs / 1000);
      this.agent.learn(state, action, reward, { latency: 0, errorRate: 0 });

      if (this.cfg.enableSelfHealing && report.anomalyDetected && this.faultBuffer.length > 3) {
        void this.healer.heal(this.moduleId, this.faultBuffer.splice(0));
      }

      return { result: result!, report };
    }
  }

  applyConfig(config: Record<string, unknown>): void { this.currentConfig = { ...config }; }

  explain(state?: Record<string, unknown>): ActionExplanation[] {
    return this.agent.explain(state ?? {});
  }

  getMemory(): SemanticMemory { return this.memory; }
  getRCA(): RootCauseAnalyzer { return this.rca; }
  getHealer(): SelfHealingEngine { return this.healer; }
  getPolicies(): PolicyEngine { return this.policyEngine; }
  getBandit(): UCB1Bandit { return this.bandit; }
  getAgent(): QLearningAgent { return this.agent; }
  getScaler(): PredictiveAutoScaler { return this.scaler; }

  private registerDefaultPolicies(): void {
    this.policyEngine.register({
      id: makePolicyId(),
      name: 'high_error_rate_circuit_break',
      description: 'Enable circuit breaker when error rate > 50%',
      priority: 100,
      condition: ctx => (ctx.metrics['errorRate'] ?? 0) > 0.5,
      action: ctx => ({
        type: 'enable_circuit_breaker',
        params: { moduleId: ctx.moduleId },
        confidence: 0.95,
        source: 'rule',
        explanation: `Error rate ${((ctx.metrics['errorRate'] ?? 0) * 100).toFixed(0)}% > 50%: enabling circuit breaker`,
      }),
      cooldownMs: 30_000,
      fireCount: 0,
      source: 'rule',
    });

    this.policyEngine.register({
      id: makePolicyId(),
      name: 'latency_spike_scale_out',
      description: 'Recommend scale-out when p99 latency > 2s',
      priority: 80,
      condition: ctx => (ctx.metrics['p99LatencyMs'] ?? 0) > 2_000,
      action: ctx => ({
        type: 'scale_up',
        params: { moduleId: ctx.moduleId, factor: 1.5 },
        confidence: 0.8,
        source: 'rule',
        explanation: `p99 latency ${ctx.metrics['p99LatencyMs']}ms > 2000ms: recommend scale-out`,
      }),
      cooldownMs: 60_000,
      fireCount: 0,
      source: 'rule',
    });
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 14 — INTELLIGENCE HUB (cross-module correlation)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface CrossModuleAnomaly {
  affectedModules: string[];
  correlatedMetrics: string[];
  startTime: number;
  severity: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
  description: string;
  rootCause?: string;
}

export class IntelligenceHub {
  private readonly modules = new Map<string, ModuleIntelligence>();
  private readonly reports: Map<string, IntelligenceReport[]> = new Map();
  private readonly crossModuleRCA = new RootCauseAnalyzer();
  private readonly globalMemory = new SemanticMemory(50_000);

  registerModule(intelligence: ModuleIntelligence): void {
    this.modules.set(intelligence.moduleId, intelligence);
    this.reports.set(intelligence.moduleId, []);
  }

  ingestReport(report: IntelligenceReport): void {
    if (!this.reports.has(report.moduleId)) this.reports.set(report.moduleId, []);
    const history = this.reports.get(report.moduleId)!;
    history.push(report);
    if (history.length > 1000) history.shift();

    if (report.anomalyDetected) {
      this.crossModuleRCA.ingest({
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        timestamp: report.timestamp,
        moduleId: report.moduleId,
        severity: report.anomalyScore > 0.8 ? 'critical' : 'error',
        type: 'anomaly',
        message: report.anomalyDetails.join('; '),
        metadata: { anomalyScore: report.anomalyScore },
      });
    }
  }

  /** Detect cascading failures across modules */
  detectCascades(windowMs = 30_000): CrossModuleAnomaly[] {
    const now = Date.now();
    const cascades: CrossModuleAnomaly[] = [];
    const recentAnomalies: Array<{ moduleId: string; report: IntelligenceReport }> = [];

    for (const [moduleId, history] of this.reports) {
      const recent = history.filter(r => now - r.timestamp < windowMs && r.anomalyDetected);
      for (const r of recent) recentAnomalies.push({ moduleId, report: r });
    }

    if (recentAnomalies.length >= 2) {
      const affectedModules = [...new Set(recentAnomalies.map(a => a.moduleId))];
      const rca = this.crossModuleRCA.analyze(windowMs);
      cascades.push({
        affectedModules,
        correlatedMetrics: [],
        startTime: Math.min(...recentAnomalies.map(a => a.report.timestamp)),
        severity: affectedModules.length >= 3 ? 'critical' : affectedModules.length >= 2 ? 'high' : 'medium',
        description: `Cascading anomaly across ${affectedModules.join(', ')}`,
        rootCause: rca.primaryCause,
      });
    }

    return cascades;
  }

  /** Global intelligence summary */
  summary(): HubSummary {
    const allReports = [...this.reports.values()].flat();
    const recentReports = allReports.filter(r => Date.now() - r.timestamp < 300_000);
    const anomalous = recentReports.filter(r => r.anomalyDetected);

    return {
      modules: this.modules.size,
      totalObservations: allReports.length,
      recentAnomalies: anomalous.length,
      healthyModules: this.modules.size - new Set(anomalous.map(r => r.moduleId)).size,
      avgConfidence: recentReports.length > 0
        ? recentReports.reduce((s, r) => s + r.confidence, 0) / recentReports.length
        : 0,
      cascades: this.detectCascades().length,
      topInsights: recentReports.flatMap(r => r.insights).slice(0, 10),
    };
  }
}

export interface HubSummary {
  modules: number;
  totalObservations: number;
  recentAnomalies: number;
  healthyModules: number;
  avgConfidence: number;
  cascades: number;
  topInsights: string[];
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 15 — INTELLIGENCE SYSTEM (facade)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class IntelligenceSystem {
  readonly hub: IntelligenceHub;
  private readonly moduleMap = new Map<string, ModuleIntelligence>();

  constructor() {
    this.hub = new IntelligenceHub();
  }

  /** Attach intelligence to any UBE module */
  attach(moduleId: string, cfg?: Partial<ModuleIntelligenceConfig>): ModuleIntelligence {
    const intel = new ModuleIntelligence({
      moduleId,
      anomalyZThreshold: 3.0,
      isolationForestThreshold: 0.65,
      enableSelfHealing: true,
      enableAutoTuning: true,
      enablePredictiveScaling: true,
      enableRCA: true,
      ...cfg,
    });
    this.moduleMap.set(moduleId, intel);
    this.hub.registerModule(intel);
    return intel;
  }

  get(moduleId: string): ModuleIntelligence | undefined {
    return this.moduleMap.get(moduleId);
  }

  getOrCreate(moduleId: string): ModuleIntelligence {
    return this.moduleMap.get(moduleId) ?? this.attach(moduleId);
  }

  /** Wrap any async function with intelligence for a given module */
  async intelligentCall<TArgs extends unknown[], TReturn>(
    moduleId: string,
    fn: (...args: TArgs) => Promise<TReturn>,
    args: TArgs,
  ): Promise<TReturn> {
    const intel = this.getOrCreate(moduleId);
    const { result, report } = await intel.wrap(fn, args);
    this.hub.ingestReport(report);
    return result;
  }

  summary(): HubSummary { return this.hub.summary(); }
  allModules(): string[] { return [...this.moduleMap.keys()]; }
}

  if (!_defaultIntelligence) _defaultIntelligence = new IntelligenceSystem();
  return _defaultIntelligence;
}

export function resetIntelligenceSystem(): void {
  _defaultIntelligence = undefined;
}

import crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  AuthMethod, AuthToken, APIKeyInfo, OAuth2Config,
  UBEConfig, RateLimitInfo, UBETier
} from './types';
import { UBEAuthError, UBEErrorCode, UBENetworkError } from './errors';

export interface AuthHeaders {
  Authorization?: string;
  'X-API-Key'?: string;
  'X-Tenant-ID'?: string;

// ============================================================
// TOKEN STORE
// ============================================================

export class TokenStore {
  private tokens: Map<string, AuthToken> = new Map();
  private readonly maxSize: number;

  constructor(maxSize: number = 100) {
    this.maxSize = maxSize;
  }

  set(key: string, token: AuthToken): void {
    if (this.tokens.size >= this.maxSize) {
      const oldest = this.tokens.keys().next().value;
      if (oldest) this.tokens.delete(oldest);
    }
    this.tokens.set(key, token);
  }

  get(key: string): AuthToken | undefined {
    const token = this.tokens.get(key);
    if (!token) return undefined;
    if (token.expiresAt <= new Date()) {
      this.tokens.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    return token;
  }

  isExpired(key: string): boolean {
    const token = this.tokens.get(key);
    if (!token) return true;
    return token.expiresAt <= new Date(Date.now() + 60000);
  }

  clear(key?: string): void {
    if (key) this.tokens.delete(key);
    else this.tokens.clear();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// HMAC SIGNER
// ============================================================

export class HMACSigner {
  private readonly secret: string;
  private readonly algorithm: string;

  constructor(secret: string, algorithm: string = 'sha256') {
    this.secret = secret;
    this.algorithm = algorithm;
  }

  sign(method: string, path: string, body: string, timestamp: string, nonce: string): string {
    const payload = [method.toUpperCase(), path, body, timestamp, nonce].join('\n');
    return crypto
      .createHmac(this.algorithm, this.secret)
      .update(payload)
      .digest('hex');
  }

  verify(signature: string, method: string, path: string, body: string, timestamp: string, nonce: string): boolean {
    const expected = this.sign(method, path, body, timestamp, nonce);
    try {
      return crypto.timingSafeEqual(
        Buffer.from(signature, 'hex'),
        Buffer.from(expected, 'hex')
      );
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  generateNonce(): string {
    return crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
  }
}

// ============================================================
// SOVEREIGN KEY MANAGER
// ============================================================

export class SovereignKeyManager {
  private readonly key: string;
  private readonly tenantId: string;

  constructor(key: string, tenantId: string) {
    this.key = key;
    this.tenantId = tenantId;
  }

  generateToken(expiryMs: number = 3600000): AuthToken {
    const now = new Date();
    const payload = {
      tenantId: this.tenantId,
      issuedAt: now.toISOString(),
      nonce: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
    };
    const signature = crypto
      .createHmac('sha512', this.key)
      .update(JSON.stringify(payload))
      .digest('hex');

    const accessToken = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ ...payload, signature })).toString('base64');

    return {
      accessToken,
      tokenType: 'Sovereign',
      expiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + expiryMs),
      tenantId: this.tenantId,
      scope: ['*'],
    };
  }

  verify(token: string): boolean {
    try {
      const decoded = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token, 'base64').toString('utf8'));
      const { signature, ...payload } = decoded;
      const expected = crypto
        .createHmac('sha512', this.key)
        .update(JSON.stringify(payload))
        .digest('hex');
      return crypto.timingSafeEqual(
        Buffer.from(signature, 'hex'),
        Buffer.from(expected, 'hex')
      );
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================
// OAUTH2 CLIENT
// ============================================================

export class OAuth2Client {
  private readonly config: OAuth2Config;
  private readonly tokenStore: TokenStore;
  private readonly cacheKey: string;

  constructor(config: OAuth2Config) {
    this.config = config;
    this.tokenStore = new TokenStore();
    this.cacheKey = `oauth2:${config.clientId}`;
  }

  async getToken(): Promise<AuthToken> {
    const cached = this.tokenStore.get(this.cacheKey);
    if (cached && !this.tokenStore.isExpired(this.cacheKey)) return cached;
    return this.fetchToken();
  }

  private async fetchToken(): Promise<AuthToken> {
    const body = new URLSearchParams({
      grant_type: this.config.grantType || 'client_credentials',
      client_id: this.config.clientId,
      client_secret: this.config.clientSecret,
      scope: (this.config.scope || ['*']).join(' '),
    });

    try {
      const res = await fetch(this.config.tokenEndpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
        body: body.toString(),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new UBEAuthError(`OAuth2 token fetch failed: ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);
      }

      const data = await res.json() as {
        access_token: string;
        token_type: string;
        expires_in?: number;
        refresh_token?: string;
        scope?: string;
      };

      const token: AuthToken = {
        accessToken: data.access_token,
        tokenType: 'Bearer',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + (data.expires_in || 3600) * 1000),
        refreshToken: data.refresh_token,
        scope: data.scope?.split(' '),
      };

      this.tokenStore.set(this.cacheKey, token);
      return token;
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof UBEAuthError) throw err;
      throw new UBENetworkError(`OAuth2 request failed: ${String(err)}`);
    }
  }

  async refreshToken(refreshToken: string): Promise<AuthToken> {
    const body = new URLSearchParams({
      grant_type: 'refresh_token',
      refresh_token: refreshToken,
      client_id: this.config.clientId,
      client_secret: this.config.clientSecret,
    });

    const res = await fetch(this.config.tokenEndpoint, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: body.toString(),
    });

    if (!res.ok) throw new UBEAuthError('Token refresh failed');
    const data = await res.json() as { access_token: string; expires_in?: number; refresh_token?: string };

    const token: AuthToken = {
      accessToken: data.access_token,
      tokenType: 'Bearer',
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + (data.expires_in || 3600) * 1000),
      refreshToken: data.refresh_token || refreshToken,
    };

    this.tokenStore.set(this.cacheKey, token);
    return token;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// API KEY VALIDATOR
// ============================================================

export class APIKeyValidator {
  private readonly cache: Map<string, APIKeyInfo> = new Map();
  private readonly endpoint: string;

  constructor(endpoint: string) {
    this.endpoint = endpoint;
  }

  async validate(apiKey: string): Promise<APIKeyInfo> {
    const cacheKey = this.hash(apiKey);
    const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached && new Date() < (cached.expiresAt || new Date('9999-12-31'))) {
      return cached;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${this.endpoint}/auth/validate`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'X-API-Key': apiKey,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ apiKey }),
      });

      if (res.status === 401) throw new UBEAuthError('Invalid API key', UBEErrorCode.AUTH_INVALID_KEY);
      if (!res.ok) throw new UBEAuthError(`API key validation failed: ${res.status}`);

      const info = await res.json() as APIKeyInfo;
      this.cache.set(cacheKey, info);
      return info;
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof UBEAuthError) throw err;
      throw new UBENetworkError(`Validation request failed: ${String(err)}`);
    }
  }

  private hash(key: string): string {
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(key).digest('hex').substring(0, 16);
  }

  clearCache(): void {
    this.cache.clear();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// MAIN AUTH MANAGER
// ============================================================

export class AuthManager {
  private state: AuthState;
  private readonly tokenStore: TokenStore;
  private hmacSigner?: HMACSigner;
  private oauth2Client?: OAuth2Client;
  private sovereignKeyManager?: SovereignKeyManager;
  private refreshTimer?: NodeJS.Timeout;
  private readonly config: UBEConfig;
  private readonly endpoint: string;

  constructor(config: UBEConfig, endpoint: string) {
    this.config = config;
    this.endpoint = endpoint;
    this.tokenStore = new TokenStore();
    this.state = {
      method: config.authMethod || (config.apiKey ? AuthMethod.API_KEY : AuthMethod.JWT),
      apiKey: config.apiKey,
      tenantId: config.tenantId,
      refreshCount: 0,
    };

    this.initializeMethod();
  }

  private initializeMethod(): void {
    switch (this.state.method) {
      case AuthMethod.HMAC:
        if (this.config.apiKey) {
          this.hmacSigner = new HMACSigner(this.config.apiKey);
        }
        break;
      case AuthMethod.SOVEREIGN_KEY:
        if (this.config.sovereignKey && this.config.tenantId) {
          this.sovereignKeyManager = new SovereignKeyManager(
            this.config.sovereignKey,
            this.config.tenantId
          );
        }
        break;
    }
  }

  async getHeaders(method: string = 'GET', path: string = '/', body: string = ''): Promise<AuthHeaders> {
    const headers: AuthHeaders = {};

    if (this.config.tenantId) {
      headers['X-Tenant-ID'] = this.config.tenantId;
    }

    switch (this.state.method) {
      case AuthMethod.API_KEY:
        if (!this.state.apiKey) throw new UBEAuthError('API key not configured');
        headers['X-API-Key'] = this.state.apiKey;
        break;

      case AuthMethod.JWT: {
        const token = await this.getValidToken();
        headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token.accessToken}`;
        break;
      }

      case AuthMethod.OAUTH2: {
        const token = await this.getValidToken();
        headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token.accessToken}`;
        break;
      }

      case AuthMethod.HMAC: {
        if (!this.hmacSigner || !this.state.apiKey) {
          throw new UBEAuthError('HMAC signer not initialized');
        }
        const timestamp = Date.now().toString();
        const nonce = this.hmacSigner.generateNonce();
        const signature = this.hmacSigner.sign(method, path, body, timestamp, nonce);
        headers['X-API-Key'] = this.state.apiKey;
        headers['X-HMAC-Signature'] = signature;
        headers['X-HMAC-Timestamp'] = timestamp;
        headers['X-HMAC-Nonce'] = nonce;
        break;
      }

      case AuthMethod.SOVEREIGN_KEY: {
        if (!this.sovereignKeyManager) throw new UBEAuthError('Sovereign key not configured');
        const token = this.sovereignKeyManager.generateToken();
        headers['X-Sovereign-Key'] = token.accessToken;
        if (this.config.tenantId) headers['X-Tenant-ID'] = this.config.tenantId;
        break;
      }

      case AuthMethod.MTLS:
        break;
    }

    return headers;
  }

  private async getValidToken(): Promise<AuthToken> {
    const cacheKey = `token:${this.state.tenantId || 'default'}`;
    const cached = this.tokenStore.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached && !this.tokenStore.isExpired(cacheKey)) return cached;

    const fresh = await this.fetchToken();
    this.tokenStore.set(cacheKey, fresh);
    this.state.token = fresh;
    this.state.lastRefresh = new Date();
    this.state.refreshCount++;
    this.scheduleRefresh(fresh);
    return fresh;
  }

  private async fetchToken(): Promise<AuthToken> {
    if (this.oauth2Client) return this.oauth2Client.getToken();
    if (this.state.apiKey) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${this.endpoint}/auth/token`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-API-Key': this.state.apiKey,
          },
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json() as { accessToken: string; expiresAt: string };
          return {
            accessToken: data.accessToken,
            tokenType: 'Bearer',
            expiresAt: new Date(data.expiresAt),
          };
        }
      } catch {
        // Fall through to API key auth
      }
    }
    return {
      accessToken: this.state.apiKey || '',
      tokenType: 'Bearer',
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
    };
  }

  private scheduleRefresh(token: AuthToken): void {
    if (this.refreshTimer) clearTimeout(this.refreshTimer);
    const refreshIn = token.expiresAt.getTime() - Date.now() - 300000;
    if (refreshIn > 0) {
      this.refreshTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.tokenStore.clear(`token:${this.state.tenantId || 'default'}`);
      }, refreshIn);
    }
  }

  isAuthenticated(): boolean {
    return !!(this.state.apiKey || this.state.token?.accessToken);
  }

  getState(): AuthState {
    return { ...this.state };
  }

  setTenantId(tenantId: string): void {
    this.state.tenantId = tenantId;
  }

  clearTokens(): void {
    this.tokenStore.clear();
    this.state.token = undefined;
  }

  destroy(): void {
    if (this.refreshTimer) clearTimeout(this.refreshTimer);
    this.clearTokens();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// AUTOMATION BUILDER IMPLEMENTATION
// ============================================================

class AutomationBuilderImpl implements AutomationBuilder {
  private request: AutomationRequest = { steps: [] };

  name(name: string): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.name = name;
    return this;
  }

  description(desc: string): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.description = desc;
    return this;
  }

  step(step: AutomationStep): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.steps.push(step);
    return this;
  }

  httpStep(name: string, url: string, method: string = 'GET', body?: unknown): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'CONNECTOR' as any,
      connector: 'http',
      action: method.toLowerCase(),
      input: { url, method, body },
    });
  }

  transformStep(name: string, transform: TransformConfig): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'TRANSFORM' as any,
      action: 'transform',
      input: { transform },
    });
  }

  conditionStep(name: string, expression: string, onTrue?: string, onFalse?: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'CONDITION' as any,
      action: 'evaluate',
      conditions: [{ expression, onTrue: onTrue || 'continue', onFalse }],
    });
  }

  encryptStep(name: string, keyId?: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'ENCRYPT' as any,
      action: 'encrypt',
      input: { keyId },
      encrypt: true,
    });
  }

  storeStep(name: string, key: string, value?: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'STORE' as any,
      action: 'store',
      input: { key, value },
    });
  }

  notifyStep(name: string, channel: string, message: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'NOTIFY' as any,
      action: 'send',
      input: { channel, message },
    });
  }

  trigger(trigger: AutomationTrigger): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.trigger = trigger;
    return this;
  }

  onSchedule(cron: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.trigger({ type: WorkflowTriggerType.SCHEDULE, schedule: cron });
  }

  onWebhook(url: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.trigger({ type: WorkflowTriggerType.WEBHOOK, webhookUrl: url });
  }

  withOptions(options: AutomationOptions): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.options = { ...this.request.options, ...options };
    return this;
  }

  withEncryption(mode: EncryptionMode): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.withOptions({ encryptionMode: mode });
  }

  withRetry(policy: SDKRetryPolicy): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.withOptions({ retryPolicy: policy } as any);
  }

  withTag(...tags: string[]): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.tags = [...(this.request.tags || []), ...tags];
    return this;
  }

  build(): AutomationRequest {
    if (!this.request.steps.length) {
      throw new UBEValidationError('Automation must have at least one step', [
        { field: 'steps', message: 'At least one step is required' },
      ]);
    }
    return { ...this.request };
  }
}

// ============================================================
// AUTOMATION SDK CLASS
// ============================================================

export class AutomationSDK {
  private readonly http: UBEHttpClient;

  constructor(http: UBEHttpClient) {
    this.http = http;
  }

  // ── Run ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async run(request: AutomationRequest, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const res = await this.http.post<AutomationResult>('/automations/run', request, options);
    if (!res.success || !res.data) {
      throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Automation run failed');
    }
    return res.data;
  }

  async runAndWait(
    request: AutomationRequest,
    pollIntervalMs: number = 1000,
    timeoutMs: number = 300000,
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const result = await this.run(request, options);
    if (result.status === AutomationStatus.COMPLETED || result.status === AutomationStatus.FAILED) {
      return result;
    }
    return this.waitForCompletion(result.id, pollIntervalMs, timeoutMs, options);
  }

  async runBatch(
    batch: BatchRequest<AutomationRequest>,
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<BatchResult<AutomationResult>> {
    const res = await this.http.post<BatchResult<AutomationResult>>(
      '/automations/batch',
      batch,
      options
    );
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Batch run failed');
    return res.data;
  }

  // ── Status & Polling ─────────────────────────────────────

  async get(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const res = await this.http.get<AutomationResult>(`/automations/${automationId}`, options);
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.API_NOT_FOUND, `Automation ${automationId} not found`);
    return res.data;
  }

  async waitForCompletion(
    automationId: string,
    pollIntervalMs: number = 1000,
    timeoutMs: number = 300000,
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
    while (Date.now() < deadline) {
      const result = await this.get(automationId, options);
      if (
        result.status === AutomationStatus.COMPLETED ||
        result.status === AutomationStatus.FAILED ||
        result.status === AutomationStatus.CANCELLED
      ) {
        return result;
      }
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, pollIntervalMs));
    }
    throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_TIMEOUT, `Automation ${automationId} timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
  }

  async list(filter?: AutomationFilter, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<PaginatedResponse<AutomationListItem>> {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (filter?.status) params.set('status', filter.status.join(','));
    if (filter?.tags) params.set('tags', filter.tags.join(','));
    if (filter?.page) params.set('page', filter.page.toString());
    if (filter?.pageSize) params.set('pageSize', filter.pageSize.toString());
    if (filter?.sortBy) params.set('sortBy', filter.sortBy);
    if (filter?.sortOrder) params.set('sortOrder', filter.sortOrder);

    const res = await this.http.get<PaginatedResponse<AutomationListItem>>(
      `/automations?${params}`,
      options
    );
    return res.data || { items: [], total: 0, page: 1, pageSize: 20, hasMore: false };
  }

  // ── Control ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  async cancel(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/automations/${automationId}/cancel`, {}, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  async pause(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/automations/${automationId}/pause`, {}, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  async resume(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/automations/${automationId}/resume`, {}, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  async retry(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const res = await this.http.post<AutomationResult>(
      `/automations/${automationId}/retry`,
      {},
      options
    );
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Retry failed');
    return res.data;
  }

  async delete(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.delete(`/automations/${automationId}`, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  // ── Scheduling ────────────────────────────────────────────

  async schedule(
    request: AutomationRequest,
    cron: string,
    timezone: string = 'UTC',
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<ScheduledAutomation> {
    const res = await this.http.post<ScheduledAutomation>(
      '/automations/schedule',
      { request, schedule: cron, timezone },
      options
    );
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Schedule failed');
    return res.data;
  }

  async listScheduled(options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<ScheduledAutomation[]> {
    const res = await this.http.get<{ schedules: ScheduledAutomation[] }>('/automations/schedules', options);
    return res.data?.schedules || [];
  }

  async cancelSchedule(scheduleId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.delete(`/automations/schedules/${scheduleId}`, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  async pauseSchedule(scheduleId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/automations/schedules/${scheduleId}/pause`, {}, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  // ── Templates ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  async listTemplates(category?: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationTemplate[]> {
    const params = category ? `?category=${category}` : '';
    const res = await this.http.get<{ templates: AutomationTemplate[] }>(
      `/automations/templates${params}`,
      options
    );
    return res.data?.templates || [];
  }

  async getTemplate(templateId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationTemplate> {
    const res = await this.http.get<AutomationTemplate>(`/automations/templates/${templateId}`, options);
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.API_NOT_FOUND, `Template ${templateId} not found`);
    return res.data;
  }

  async runTemplate(
    templateId: string,
    variables: Record<string, unknown>,
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const res = await this.http.post<AutomationResult>(
      `/automations/templates/${templateId}/run`,
      { variables },
      options
    );
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Template run failed');
    return res.data;
  }

  // ── Metrics ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  async getMetrics(
    period: { start: Date; end: Date },
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<AutomationMetrics> {
    const res = await this.http.post<AutomationMetrics>('/automations/metrics', { period }, options);
    return res.data || {
      total: 0, byStatus: {} as any, averageDurationMs: 0,
      successRate: 0, totalDataProcessed: 0, topConnectors: [],
      period,
    };
  }

  // ── Dry Run ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  async dryRun(request: AutomationRequest, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<{
    valid: boolean;
    estimatedDurationMs: number;
    stepCount: number;
    warnings: string[];
    errors: string[];
  }> {
    const res = await this.http.post(
      '/automations/dry-run',
      { ...request, options: { ...request.options, dryRun: true } },
      options
    );
    return res.data as any || { valid: false, estimatedDurationMs: 0, stepCount: 0, warnings: [], errors: ['Dry run failed'] };
  }

  // ── Builder ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  builder(): AutomationBuilder {
    return new AutomationBuilderImpl();
  }

  // ── Quick shortcuts ───────────────────────────────────────

  async runHTTP(url: string, method: string = 'GET', body?: unknown): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    return this.run(
      this.builder()
        .name(`HTTP ${method} ${url}`)
        .httpStep('request', url, method, body)
        .build()
    );
  }

  async runTransform(data: unknown, transform: TransformConfig): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    return this.run(
      this.builder()
        .name('Transform')
        .step({ name: 'input', type: 'STORE' as any, action: 'store', input: { key: 'data', value: data } })
        .transformStep('transform', transform)
        .build()
    );
  }

  async runChain(steps: AutomationStep[], options?: AutomationOptions): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    return this.run(
      this.builder()
        .name('Chain')
        .withOptions(options || {})
        .build()
    );
  }
}

export { AutomationBuilderImpl };

/**
 * UBE SDK — sdk/src/base-module.ts
 * Abstract base class all community modules must extend.
 * Provides: validation, throttling, auth, lifecycle, metrics, health.
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

export type ModuleStatus    = 'uninitialized'|'initializing'|'ready'|'degraded'|'stopping'|'stopped'|'error';
export type ModuleCategory  = 'connector'|'processor'|'analyzer'|'exporter'|'transformer'|'gateway'|'security'|'compliance';
