// ─── Utility Functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function rotl8(x: number, n: number): number {
  return ((x << n) | (x >> (8 - n))) & 0xff;
}

function rotl32(x: number, n: number): number {
  return ((x << n) | (x >>> (32 - n))) >>> 0;
}

function bitRev7(n: number): number {
  let r = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) { r = (r << 1) | (n & 1); n >>= 1; }
  return r;
}

function bytesToU32LE(b: Bytes, offset: number): number {
  return (b[offset] | (b[offset+1]<<8) | (b[offset+2]<<16) | (b[offset+3]<<24)) >>> 0;
}

function u32ToBytes4LE(v: number): Bytes {
  return new Uint8Array([v&0xff,(v>>8)&0xff,(v>>16)&0xff,(v>>24)&0xff]);
}

function xorBytes(a: Bytes, b: Bytes): Bytes {
  const out = new Uint8Array(a.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) out[i] = a[i] ^ b[i];
  return out;
}

function concatBytes(...arrays: Bytes[]): Bytes {
  const total = arrays.reduce((s, a) => s + a.length, 0);
  const out = new Uint8Array(total);
  let offset = 0;
  for (const a of arrays) { out.set(a, offset); offset += a.length; }
  return out;
}

function constantTimeEqual(a: Bytes, b: Bytes): boolean {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) diff |= a[i] ^ b[i];
  return diff === 0;
}

function bytesToHex(b: Bytes): Hex {
  return Array.from(b).map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}

function hexToBytes(h: Hex): Bytes {
  if (h.length % 2 !== 0) throw new Error('Invalid hex string');
  const out = new Uint8Array(h.length / 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++)
    out[i] = parseInt(h.slice(i*2, i*2+2), 16);
  return out;
}

function randomBytes(n: number): Bytes {
  if (typeof globalThis.crypto !== 'undefined')
    return globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(n));
  // Node.js fallback
  const { randomBytes: nodeRandom } = require('crypto');
  return new Uint8Array(nodeRandom(n));
}

/** Barrett modular reduction: a mod q, q < 2^26 */
function barrettReduce(a: number, q: number): number {
  return ((a % q) + q) % q;
}

/** Modular multiplication with BigInt for safety */
function mulmod(a: bigint, b: bigint, m: bigint): bigint {
  return ((a * b) % m + m) % m;
}

/** Extended Euclidean algorithm for modular inverse */
function modInverse(a: bigint, m: bigint): bigint {
  let [old_r, r] = [a, m];
  let [old_s, s] = [1n, 0n];
  while (r !== 0n) {
    const q = old_r / r;
    [old_r, r] = [r, old_r - q * r];
    [old_s, s] = [s, old_s - q * s];
  }
  return ((old_s % m) + m) % m;
}

// ─── BLAKE3 Hash Engine ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class BLAKE3Engine {
  private static readonly BLOCK_LEN = 64;
  private static readonly CHUNK_LEN = 1024;
  private static readonly OUT_LEN   = 32;

  // Flags
  private static readonly CHUNK_START      = 1 << 0;
  private static readonly CHUNK_END        = 1 << 1;
  private static readonly PARENT           = 1 << 2;
  private static readonly ROOT             = 1 << 3;
  private static readonly KEYED_HASH       = 1 << 4;
  private static readonly DERIVE_KEY_CTX   = 1 << 5;
  private static readonly DERIVE_KEY_MAT   = 1 << 6;

  private static g(
    state: Uint32Array, a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number,
    mx: number, my: number
  ): void {
    state[a] = (state[a] + state[b] + mx) >>> 0;
    state[d] = rotl32(state[d] ^ state[a], 16);
    state[c] = (state[c] + state[d]) >>> 0;
    state[b] = rotl32(state[b] ^ state[c], 12);
    state[a] = (state[a] + state[b] + my) >>> 0;
    state[d] = rotl32(state[d] ^ state[a], 8);
    state[c] = (state[c] + state[d]) >>> 0;
    state[b] = rotl32(state[b] ^ state[c], 7);
  }

  private static round(state: Uint32Array, m: Uint32Array, schedule: readonly number[]): void {
    BLAKE3Engine.g(state,0,4, 8,12, m[schedule[0]],  m[schedule[1]]);
    BLAKE3Engine.g(state,1,5, 9,13, m[schedule[2]],  m[schedule[3]]);
    BLAKE3Engine.g(state,2,6,10,14, m[schedule[4]],  m[schedule[5]]);
    BLAKE3Engine.g(state,3,7,11,15, m[schedule[6]],  m[schedule[7]]);
    BLAKE3Engine.g(state,0,5,10,15, m[schedule[8]],  m[schedule[9]]);
    BLAKE3Engine.g(state,1,6,11,12, m[schedule[10]], m[schedule[11]]);
    BLAKE3Engine.g(state,2,7, 8,13, m[schedule[12]], m[schedule[13]]);
    BLAKE3Engine.g(state,3,4, 9,14, m[schedule[14]], m[schedule[15]]);
  }

  private static compress(
    chaining: Uint32Array, blockWords: Uint32Array,
    counter: bigint, blockLen: number, flags: number
  ): Uint32Array {
    const state = new Uint32Array(16);
    state.set(chaining, 0);
    state.set(BLAKE3_IV, 8);
    state[12] = Number(counter & 0xFFFFFFFFn);
    state[13] = Number((counter >> 32n) & 0xFFFFFFFFn);
    state[14] = blockLen;
    state[15] = flags;

    for (const sigma of BLAKE3_SIGMA)
      BLAKE3Engine.round(state, blockWords, sigma);

    const out = new Uint32Array(8);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) out[i] = (state[i] ^ state[i+8]) >>> 0;
    return out;
  }

  /** Hash input bytes, return 32-byte digest */
  static hash(input: Bytes): Bytes {
    const chunks = BLAKE3Engine.splitChunks(input);
    let cvStack: Uint32Array[] = [];

    for (let ci = 0; ci < chunks.length; ci++) {
      const chunk = chunks[ci];
      let cv = new Uint32Array(BLAKE3_IV);
      const numBlocks = Math.ceil(chunk.length / BLAKE3Engine.BLOCK_LEN) || 1;

      for (let bi = 0; bi < numBlocks; bi++) {
        const blockStart = bi * BLAKE3Engine.BLOCK_LEN;
        const blockData  = chunk.slice(blockStart, blockStart + BLAKE3Engine.BLOCK_LEN);
        const padded = new Uint8Array(BLAKE3Engine.BLOCK_LEN);
        padded.set(blockData);
        const words = new Uint32Array(16);
        for (let w = 0; w < 16; w++) words[w] = bytesToU32LE(padded, w*4);

        const isFirst = bi === 0;
        const isLast  = bi === numBlocks - 1;
        let flags = 0;
        if (isFirst) flags |= BLAKE3Engine.CHUNK_START;
        if (isLast)  flags |= BLAKE3Engine.CHUNK_END;
        if (ci === chunks.length - 1 && isLast) flags |= BLAKE3Engine.ROOT;

        cv = BLAKE3Engine.compress(cv, words, BigInt(ci), blockData.length, flags);
      }
      cvStack.push(cv);
    }

    // Merge parent nodes
    while (cvStack.length > 1) {
      const merged: Uint32Array[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i + 1 < cvStack.length; i += 2) {
        const left  = cvStack[i];
        const right = cvStack[i+1];
        const combined = new Uint32Array(16);
        combined.set(left,  0);
        combined.set(right, 8);
        merged.push(BLAKE3Engine.compress(
          new Uint32Array(BLAKE3_IV), combined, 0n,
          BLAKE3Engine.BLOCK_LEN, BLAKE3Engine.PARENT | BLAKE3Engine.ROOT
        ));
      }
      if (cvStack.length % 2 === 1) merged.push(cvStack[cvStack.length-1]);
      cvStack = merged;
    }

    const finalCV = cvStack[0] ?? new Uint32Array(BLAKE3_IV);
    const out = new Uint8Array(32);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const b = u32ToBytes4LE(finalCV[i]);
      out.set(b, i*4);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Keyed hash — 32-byte key + input → 32-byte MAC */
  static keyedHash(key: Bytes, input: Bytes): Bytes {
    if (key.length !== 32) throw new Error('BLAKE3 keyed hash requires 32-byte key');
    const keyWords = new Uint32Array(8);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) keyWords[i] = bytesToU32LE(key, i*4);
    // Mix key into IV
    const keyedIV = new Uint32Array(8);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) keyedIV[i] = (BLAKE3_IV[i] ^ keyWords[i]) >>> 0;
    // Re-run hash with keyed IV (simplified keyed mode)
    const base = BLAKE3Engine.hash(concatBytes(key, input));
    return BLAKE3Engine.hash(concatBytes(base, key));
  }

  /** XOF: variable-length output */
  static xof(input: Bytes, outputLength: number): Bytes {
    const seed = BLAKE3Engine.hash(input);
    const blocks = Math.ceil(outputLength / 32);
    const parts: Bytes[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < blocks; i++) {
      const counter = new Uint8Array(4);
      new DataView(counter.buffer).setUint32(0, i, true);
      parts.push(BLAKE3Engine.hash(concatBytes(seed, counter)));
    }
    return concatBytes(...parts).slice(0, outputLength);
  }

  private static splitChunks(input: Bytes): Bytes[] {
    if (input.length === 0) return [new Uint8Array(0)];
    const chunks: Bytes[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i += BLAKE3Engine.CHUNK_LEN)
      chunks.push(input.slice(i, i + BLAKE3Engine.CHUNK_LEN));
    return chunks;
  }
}

// ─── AES-256-GCM Engine ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class AES256GCMEngine {
  private readonly roundKeys: Uint8Array[];

  constructor(key: Bytes) {
    if (key.length !== 32) throw new Error('AES-256 requires 32-byte key');
    this.roundKeys = this.expandKey(key);
  }

  /** GF(2^8) multiplication mod 0x11b */
  private static gmul(a: number, b: number): number {
    let p = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      if (b & 1) p ^= a;
      const hiBit = a & 0x80;
      a = (a << 1) & 0xff;
      if (hiBit) a ^= 0x1b;
      b >>= 1;
    }
    return p;
  }

  private static subBytes(state: Uint8Array): void {
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) state[i] = AES_SBOX[state[i]];
  }

  private static shiftRows(state: Uint8Array): void {
    // Row 1: shift left 1
    let t = state[1]; state[1]=state[5]; state[5]=state[9]; state[9]=state[13]; state[13]=t;
    // Row 2: shift left 2
    t=state[2]; state[2]=state[10]; state[10]=t;
    t=state[6]; state[6]=state[14]; state[14]=t;
    // Row 3: shift left 3
    t=state[15]; state[15]=state[11]; state[11]=state[7]; state[7]=state[3]; state[3]=t;
  }

  private static mixColumns(state: Uint8Array): void {
    for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
      const s0=state[c],s1=state[c+4],s2=state[c+8],s3=state[c+12];
      const g = AES256GCMEngine.gmul;
      state[c]    = g(2,s0)^g(3,s1)^s2^s3;
      state[c+4]  = s0^g(2,s1)^g(3,s2)^s3;
      state[c+8]  = s0^s1^g(2,s2)^g(3,s3);
      state[c+12] = g(3,s0)^s1^s2^g(2,s3);
    }
  }

  private static addRoundKey(state: Uint8Array, roundKey: Uint8Array): void {
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) state[i] ^= roundKey[i];
  }

  private expandKey(key: Bytes): Uint8Array[] {
    const w: Uint8Array[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const word = new Uint8Array(4);
      word.set(key.slice(i*4, i*4+4));
      w.push(word);
    }
    for (let i = 8; i < 60; i++) {
      let temp = new Uint8Array(w[i-1]);
      if (i % 8 === 0) {
        // RotWord + SubWord + RCON
        const rotated = new Uint8Array([temp[1],temp[2],temp[3],temp[0]]);
        for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) rotated[j] = AES_SBOX[rotated[j]];
        rotated[0] ^= RCON[i/8 - 1];
        temp = rotated;
      } else if (i % 8 === 4) {
        for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) temp[j] = AES_SBOX[temp[j]];
      }
      const word = new Uint8Array(4);
      for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) word[j] = w[i-8][j] ^ temp[j];
      w.push(word);
    }
    const roundKeys: Uint8Array[] = [];
    for (let r = 0; r <= 14; r++) {
      const rk = new Uint8Array(16);
      for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) rk.set(w[r*4+c], c*4);
      roundKeys.push(rk);
    }
    return roundKeys;
  }

  private encryptBlock(block: Bytes): Bytes {
    const state = new Uint8Array(block);
    AES256GCMEngine.addRoundKey(state, this.roundKeys[0]);
    for (let r = 1; r < 14; r++) {
      AES256GCMEngine.subBytes(state);
      AES256GCMEngine.shiftRows(state);
      AES256GCMEngine.mixColumns(state);
      AES256GCMEngine.addRoundKey(state, this.roundKeys[r]);
    }
    AES256GCMEngine.subBytes(state);
    AES256GCMEngine.shiftRows(state);
    AES256GCMEngine.addRoundKey(state, this.roundKeys[14]);
    return state;
  }

  /** GHASH over GF(2^128) mod x^128 + x^7 + x^2 + x + 1 */
  private static ghash(H: Bytes, data: Bytes): Bytes {
    const Y = new Uint8Array(16);
    const padded = new Uint8Array(Math.ceil(data.length / 16) * 16);
    padded.set(data);
    for (let i = 0; i < padded.length; i += 16) {
      const block = padded.slice(i, i+16);
      for (let j = 0; j < 16; j++) Y[j] ^= block[j];
      // GF(2^128) multiply Y by H
      AES256GCMEngine.gfMul128(Y, H);
    }
    return Y;
  }

  private static gfMul128(X: Uint8Array, Y: Bytes): void {
    const Z = new Uint8Array(16);
    const V = new Uint8Array(Y);
    for (let i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
      if ((X[Math.floor(i/8)] >> (7 - i%8)) & 1) {
        for (let k = 0; k < 16; k++) Z[k] ^= V[k];
      }
      const lsb = V[15] & 1;
      // Right shift V by 1
      for (let k = 15; k > 0; k--) V[k] = ((V[k] >> 1) | ((V[k-1] & 1) << 7)) & 0xff;
      V[0] >>= 1;
      if (lsb) V[0] ^= 0xe1; // reduction polynomial
    }
    X.set(Z);
  }

  /** Encrypt plaintext using AES-256-GCM. Returns { iv, ciphertext, tag } */
  encrypt(plaintext: Bytes, aad: Bytes = new Uint8Array(0)): { iv: Bytes; ciphertext: Bytes; tag: Bytes } {
    const iv = randomBytes(12);

    // H = AES_K(0^128)
    const H = this.encryptBlock(new Uint8Array(16));

    // J0 — counter block for IV
    const J0 = new Uint8Array(16);
    J0.set(iv, 0);
    J0[15] = 1;

    // CTR encryption
    const ciphertext = new Uint8Array(plaintext.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i += 16) {
      const counter = new Uint8Array(J0);
      const blockIdx = Math.floor(i / 16) + 1;
      new DataView(counter.buffer).setUint32(12, blockIdx + 1, false);
      const keystream = this.encryptBlock(counter);
      for (let j = i; j < Math.min(i+16, plaintext.length); j++)
        ciphertext[j] = plaintext[j] ^ keystream[j-i];
    }

    // GHASH(H, AAD || ciphertext)
    const lenBlock = new Uint8Array(16);
    const dv = new DataView(lenBlock.buffer);
    dv.setUint32(4,  aad.length * 8, false);
    dv.setUint32(12, ciphertext.length * 8, false);
    const padAAD  = new Uint8Array(Math.ceil(aad.length / 16) * 16);  padAAD.set(aad);
    const padCT   = new Uint8Array(Math.ceil(ciphertext.length / 16) * 16); padCT.set(ciphertext);
    const authData = concatBytes(padAAD, padCT, lenBlock);
    const S = AES256GCMEngine.ghash(H, authData);

    // Tag = AES_K(J0) XOR S
    const EJ0 = this.encryptBlock(J0);
    const tag = xorBytes(EJ0, S);

    return { iv, ciphertext, tag };
  }

  /** Decrypt + verify AES-256-GCM. Throws on authentication failure. */
  decrypt(ciphertext: Bytes, iv: Bytes, tag: Bytes, aad: Bytes = new Uint8Array(0)): Bytes {
    const H  = this.encryptBlock(new Uint8Array(16));
    const J0 = new Uint8Array(16);
    J0.set(iv, 0);
    J0[15] = 1;

    // Verify tag first (constant-time)
    const lenBlock = new Uint8Array(16);
    const dv = new DataView(lenBlock.buffer);
    dv.setUint32(4,  aad.length * 8, false);
    dv.setUint32(12, ciphertext.length * 8, false);
    const padAAD = new Uint8Array(Math.ceil(aad.length / 16) * 16); padAAD.set(aad);
    const padCT  = new Uint8Array(Math.ceil(ciphertext.length / 16) * 16); padCT.set(ciphertext);
    const S = AES256GCMEngine.ghash(H, concatBytes(padAAD, padCT, lenBlock));
    const EJ0 = this.encryptBlock(J0);
    const expectedTag = xorBytes(EJ0, S);

    if (!constantTimeEqual(expectedTag.slice(0,16), tag.slice(0,16)))
      throw new Error('AES-256-GCM: Authentication tag mismatch — decryption rejected');

    // Decrypt
    const plaintext = new Uint8Array(ciphertext.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < ciphertext.length; i += 16) {
      const counter = new Uint8Array(J0);
      const blockIdx = Math.floor(i / 16) + 1;
      new DataView(counter.buffer).setUint32(12, blockIdx + 1, false);
      const keystream = this.encryptBlock(counter);
      for (let j = i; j < Math.min(i+16, ciphertext.length); j++)
        plaintext[j] = ciphertext[j] ^ keystream[j-i];
    }
    return plaintext;
  }
}

// ─── ChaCha20-Poly1305 Engine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

class ChaCha20Poly1305Engine {
  private readonly key: Bytes;

  constructor(key: Bytes) {
    if (key.length !== 32) throw new Error('ChaCha20 requires 32-byte key');
    this.key = key;
  }

  private static quarterRound(s: Uint32Array, a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number): void {
    s[a] = (s[a] + s[b]) >>> 0; s[d] = rotl32(s[d] ^ s[a], 16);
    s[c] = (s[c] + s[d]) >>> 0; s[b] = rotl32(s[b] ^ s[c], 12);
    s[a] = (s[a] + s[b]) >>> 0; s[d] = rotl32(s[d] ^ s[a],  8);
    s[c] = (s[c] + s[d]) >>> 0; s[b] = rotl32(s[b] ^ s[c],  7);
  }

  private block(nonce: Bytes, counter: number): Uint32Array {
    const constants = [0x61707865,0x3320646e,0x79622d32,0x6b206574];
    const key32 = new Uint32Array(8);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) key32[i] = bytesToU32LE(this.key, i*4);
    const nonce32 = new Uint32Array(3);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) nonce32[i] = bytesToU32LE(nonce, i*4);

    const s = new Uint32Array(16);
    s[0]=constants[0]; s[1]=constants[1]; s[2]=constants[2]; s[3]=constants[3];
    s.set(key32, 4);
    s[12]=counter>>>0;
    s[13]=nonce32[0]; s[14]=nonce32[1]; s[15]=nonce32[2];

    const working = new Uint32Array(s);
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      ChaCha20Poly1305Engine.quarterRound(working,0,4, 8,12);
      ChaCha20Poly1305Engine.quarterRound(working,1,5, 9,13);
      ChaCha20Poly1305Engine.quarterRound(working,2,6,10,14);
      ChaCha20Poly1305Engine.quarterRound(working,3,7,11,15);
      ChaCha20Poly1305Engine.quarterRound(working,0,5,10,15);
      ChaCha20Poly1305Engine.quarterRound(working,1,6,11,12);
      ChaCha20Poly1305Engine.quarterRound(working,2,7, 8,13);
      ChaCha20Poly1305Engine.quarterRound(working,3,4, 9,14);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) working[i] = (working[i] + s[i]) >>> 0;
    return working;
  }

  /** Poly1305 MAC over GF(2^130 - 5) */
  private static poly1305(key: Bytes, msg: Bytes): Bytes {
    const P = (1n << 130n) - 5n;
    // Clamp r
    const rBytes = new Uint8Array(key.slice(0,16));
    rBytes[3]  &= 0x0f; rBytes[7]  &= 0x0f;
    rBytes[11] &= 0x0f; rBytes[15] &= 0x0f;
    rBytes[4]  &= 0xfc; rBytes[8]  &= 0xfc;
    rBytes[12] &= 0xfc;

    let r = 0n;
    for (let i = 15; i >= 0; i--) r = (r << 8n) | BigInt(rBytes[i]);
    let s = 0n;
    for (let i = 31; i >= 16; i--) s = (s << 8n) | BigInt(key[i]);

    let acc = 0n;
    for (let i = 0; i < msg.length; i += 16) {
      const chunk = msg.slice(i, i+16);
      let n = 0n;
      for (let j = chunk.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) n = (n << 8n) | BigInt(chunk[j]);
      n |= (1n << BigInt(chunk.length * 8));
      acc = ((acc + n) * r) % P;
    }
    acc = (acc + s) & ((1n << 128n) - 1n);
    const tag = new Uint8Array(16);
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { tag[i] = Number(acc & 0xffn); acc >>= 8n; }
    return tag;
  }

  encrypt(plaintext: Bytes, aad: Bytes = new Uint8Array(0)): { nonce: Bytes; ciphertext: Bytes; tag: Bytes } {
    const nonce = randomBytes(12);
    // Derive one-time Poly1305 key from block 0
    const keyBlock = this.block(nonce, 0);
    const otk = new Uint8Array(32);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const b = u32ToBytes4LE(keyBlock[i]);
      otk.set(b, i*4);
    }

    const ciphertext = new Uint8Array(plaintext.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < plaintext.length; i += 64) {
      const blockWords = this.block(nonce, Math.floor(i/64) + 1);
      const keystream = new Uint8Array(64);
      for (let w = 0; w < 16; w++) {
        const b = u32ToBytes4LE(blockWords[w]);
        keystream.set(b, w*4);
      }
      for (let j = 0; j < 64 && i+j < plaintext.length; j++)
        ciphertext[i+j] = plaintext[i+j] ^ keystream[j];
    }

    // MAC: aad || pad || ciphertext || pad || len(aad) || len(ciphertext)
    const pad16 = (n: number) => new Uint8Array((16 - n % 16) % 16);
    const lenBuf = new Uint8Array(16);
    new DataView(lenBuf.buffer).setBigUint64(0, BigInt(aad.length), true);
    new DataView(lenBuf.buffer).setBigUint64(8, BigInt(ciphertext.length), true);
    const macData = concatBytes(aad, pad16(aad.length), ciphertext, pad16(ciphertext.length), lenBuf);
    const tag = ChaCha20Poly1305Engine.poly1305(otk, macData);

    return { nonce, ciphertext, tag };
  }

  decrypt(ciphertext: Bytes, nonce: Bytes, tag: Bytes, aad: Bytes = new Uint8Array(0)): Bytes {
    const keyBlock = this.block(nonce, 0);
    const otk = new Uint8Array(32);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const b = u32ToBytes4LE(keyBlock[i]); otk.set(b, i*4); }

    const pad16 = (n: number) => new Uint8Array((16 - n % 16) % 16);
    const lenBuf = new Uint8Array(16);
    new DataView(lenBuf.buffer).setBigUint64(0, BigInt(aad.length), true);
    new DataView(lenBuf.buffer).setBigUint64(8, BigInt(ciphertext.length), true);
    const macData = concatBytes(aad, pad16(aad.length), ciphertext, pad16(ciphertext.length), lenBuf);
    const expectedTag = ChaCha20Poly1305Engine.poly1305(otk, macData);

    if (!constantTimeEqual(expectedTag, tag.slice(0,16)))
      throw new Error('ChaCha20-Poly1305: Authentication failed — decryption rejected');

    const plaintext = new Uint8Array(ciphertext.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < ciphertext.length; i += 64) {
      const blockWords = this.block(nonce, Math.floor(i/64) + 1);
      const keystream = new Uint8Array(64);
      for (let w = 0; w < 16; w++) { const b = u32ToBytes4LE(blockWords[w]); keystream.set(b, w*4); }
      for (let j = 0; j < 64 && i+j < ciphertext.length; j++)
        plaintext[i+j] = ciphertext[i+j] ^ keystream[j];
    }
    return plaintext;
  }
}

// ─── Kyber-768 KEM Engine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class KyberEngine {
  private static readonly N   = KYBER.N;
  private static readonly Q   = KYBER.Q;
  private static readonly K   = KYBER.K;
  private static readonly ETA = KYBER.ETA1;

  /** Centered binomial distribution — CBD(η, bytes) → polynomial */
  private static cbd(bytes: Bytes, eta: number): Int16Array {
    const f = new Int16Array(KyberEngine.N);
    for (let i = 0; i < KyberEngine.N; i++) {
      let a = 0, b = 0;
      for (let j = 0; j < eta; j++) {
        const byteIdx = Math.floor((i * eta * 2 + j) / 8);
        const bitIdx  = (i * eta * 2 + j) % 8;
        a += (bytes[byteIdx] >> bitIdx) & 1;
      }
      for (let j = 0; j < eta; j++) {
        const byteIdx = Math.floor((i * eta * 2 + eta + j) / 8);
        const bitIdx  = (i * eta * 2 + eta + j) % 8;
        b += (bytes[byteIdx] >> bitIdx) & 1;
      }
      f[i] = a - b;
    }
    return f;
  }

  /** NTT — Number Theoretic Transform over Rq */
  private static ntt(f: Int16Array): Int16Array {
    const out = new Int16Array(f);
    const Q = KyberEngine.Q;
    let k = 1;
    for (let len = 128; len >= 2; len >>= 1) {
      for (let start = 0; start < 256; start += 2 * len) {
        const zeta = NTT_ZETA_TABLE[k++];
        for (let j = start; j < start + len; j++) {
          const t = (zeta * out[j + len]) % Q;
          out[j + len] = barrettReduce(out[j] - t, Q);
          out[j]       = barrettReduce(out[j] + t, Q);
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Inverse NTT */
  private static invNtt(f: Int16Array): Int16Array {
    const out = new Int16Array(f);
    const Q = KyberEngine.Q;
    const inv128 = 3303; // 128^{-1} mod 3329
    let k = 127;
    for (let len = 2; len <= 128; len <<= 1) {
      for (let start = 0; start < 256; start += 2 * len) {
        const zeta = NTT_ZETA_TABLE[k--];
        for (let j = start; j < start + len; j++) {
          const t    = out[j];
          out[j]     = barrettReduce(t + out[j + len], Q);
          out[j+len] = (zeta * barrettReduce(out[j+len] - t, Q)) % Q;
        }
      }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) out[i] = (out[i] * inv128) % Q;
    return out;
  }

  /** Polynomial multiplication in NTT domain (coefficient-wise) */
  private static polyMulNtt(a: Int16Array, b: Int16Array): Int16Array {
    const out = new Int16Array(256);
    const Q = KyberEngine.Q;
    for (let i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
      const j = 2 * i;
      const zeta = NTT_ZETA_TABLE[64 + i];
      // Degree-2 polynomial multiplication: (a0 + a1*X)(b0 + b1*X) mod (X^2 - zeta)
      out[j]   = ((a[j]*b[j]   + zeta * a[j+1] * b[j+1]) % Q + Q) % Q;
      out[j+1] = ((a[j]*b[j+1] + a[j+1] * b[j]) % Q + Q) % Q;
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Encode polynomial to bytes (12-bit coefficients) */
  private static polyToBytes(f: Int16Array): Bytes {
    const out = new Uint8Array(384);
    for (let i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
      const t0 = barrettReduce(f[2*i],   KYBER.Q);
      const t1 = barrettReduce(f[2*i+1], KYBER.Q);
      out[3*i]   = t0 & 0xff;
      out[3*i+1] = ((t0 >> 8) | (t1 << 4)) & 0xff;
      out[3*i+2] = t1 >> 4;
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Decode bytes to polynomial */
  private static polyFromBytes(b: Bytes): Int16Array {
    const f = new Int16Array(256);
    for (let i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
      f[2*i]   = ((b[3*i] | ((b[3*i+1] & 0x0f) << 8))) & 0x0fff;
      f[2*i+1] = ((b[3*i+1] >> 4) | (b[3*i+2] << 4)) & 0x0fff;
    }
    return f;
  }

  /** Compress polynomial: R_q → Z_{2^d} */
  private static polyCompress(f: Int16Array, d: number): Bytes {
    const out = new Uint8Array((256 * d) / 8);
    const step = 1 << d;
    for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
      const t = Math.round((f[i] * step) / KYBER.Q) & (step - 1);
      // Pack bits
      const bit  = i * d;
      const byte = Math.floor(bit / 8);
      const shift = bit % 8;
      out[byte] |= (t << shift) & 0xff;
      if (shift + d > 8 && byte + 1 < out.length)
        out[byte+1] |= (t >> (8 - shift)) & 0xff;
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Decompress: Z_{2^d} → R_q */
  private static polyDecompress(b: Bytes, d: number): Int16Array {
    const f = new Int16Array(256);
    const step = 1 << d;
    for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
      const bit  = i * d;
      const byte = Math.floor(bit / 8);
      const shift = bit % 8;
      let t = (b[byte] >> shift) & (step - 1);
      if (shift + d > 8 && byte + 1 < b.length)
        t |= ((b[byte+1] << (8 - shift)) & (step - 1));
      f[i] = Math.round((t * KYBER.Q) / step);
    }
    return f;
  }

  /** XOF seeded PRNG for matrix generation */
  private static xofMatrix(seed: Bytes, i: number, j: number): Int16Array {
    const input = concatBytes(seed, new Uint8Array([i, j]));
    const stream = BLAKE3Engine.xof(input, 512);
    const poly = new Int16Array(256);
    let pos = 0, filled = 0;
    while (filled < 256 && pos + 2 < stream.length) {
      const d1 = stream[pos] + 256 * (stream[pos+1] & 0x0f);
      const d2 = Math.floor(stream[pos+1] / 16) + 16 * stream[pos+2];
      if (d1 < KYBER.Q) poly[filled++] = d1;
      if (d2 < KYBER.Q && filled < 256) poly[filled++] = d2;
      pos += 3;
    }
    return poly;
  }

  /** Key generation: returns (pk, sk) */
  static generateKeyPair(): KyberKeyPair {
    const seed = randomBytes(64);
    const rhoSigma = BLAKE3Engine.xof(seed, 64);
    const rho    = rhoSigma.slice(0, 32);
    const sigma  = rhoSigma.slice(32, 64);
    const K = KyberEngine.K;

    // Generate matrix A in NTT domain
    const A: Int16Array[][] = Array.from({length: K}, (_,i) =>
      Array.from({length: K}, (_,j) => KyberEngine.xofMatrix(rho, i, j))
    );

    // Sample secret s and error e
    const sBytes = BLAKE3Engine.xof(concatBytes(sigma, new Uint8Array([0])), K * 64 * 4);
    const eBytes = BLAKE3Engine.xof(concatBytes(sigma, new Uint8Array([1])), K * 64 * 4);
    const s: Int16Array[] = Array.from({length: K}, (_,i) =>
      KyberEngine.ntt(KyberEngine.cbd(sBytes.slice(i*128, (i+1)*128), KyberEngine.ETA))
    );
    const e: Int16Array[] = Array.from({length: K}, (_,i) =>
      KyberEngine.ntt(KyberEngine.cbd(eBytes.slice(i*128, (i+1)*128), KyberEngine.ETA))
    );

    // t = A·s + e
    const t: Int16Array[] = Array.from({length: K}, (_, i) => {
      const sum = new Int16Array(256);
      for (let j = 0; j < K; j++) {
        const prod = KyberEngine.polyMulNtt(A[i][j], s[j]);
        for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++)
          sum[n] = barrettReduce(sum[n] + prod[n], KYBER.Q);
      }
      for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++)
        sum[n] = barrettReduce(sum[n] + e[i][n], KYBER.Q);
      return sum;
    });

    // Serialize public key: t_bytes || rho
    const pkBytes = concatBytes(
      ...t.map(p => KyberEngine.polyToBytes(p)),
      rho
    );
    // Serialize private key: s_bytes || pk_bytes || H(pk) || z
    const pkHash = BLAKE3Engine.hash(pkBytes);
    const z = randomBytes(32);
    const skBytes = concatBytes(
      ...s.map(p => KyberEngine.polyToBytes(p)),
      pkBytes, pkHash, z
    );

    return {
      publicKey:  { bytes: pkBytes,  serialized: bytesToHex(pkBytes)  },
      privateKey: { bytes: skBytes,  serialized: bytesToHex(skBytes)  },
    };
  }

  /** Encapsulate: pk → (shared_secret, ciphertext) */
  static encapsulate(publicKeyBytes: Bytes): { sharedSecret: KyberSharedSecret; ciphertext: KyberCiphertext } {
    const K = KyberEngine.K;
    const rho = publicKeyBytes.slice(K * 384, K * 384 + 32);
    const t: Int16Array[] = Array.from({length: K}, (_,i) =>
      KyberEngine.polyFromBytes(publicKeyBytes.slice(i*384, (i+1)*384))
    );

    const m = randomBytes(32);
    const mHash = BLAKE3Engine.hash(concatBytes(m, BLAKE3Engine.hash(publicKeyBytes)));
    const r     = mHash.slice(0, 32);
    const noise = mHash.slice(32, 64);

    const A: Int16Array[][] = Array.from({length: K}, (_,i) =>
      Array.from({length: K}, (_,j) => KyberEngine.xofMatrix(rho, i, j))
    );
    const rVecs: Int16Array[] = Array.from({length: K}, (_,i) =>
      KyberEngine.ntt(KyberEngine.cbd(
        BLAKE3Engine.xof(concatBytes(r, new Uint8Array([i])), 128), KyberEngine.ETA
      ))
    );
    const e1: Int16Array[] = Array.from({length: K}, (_,i) =>
      KyberEngine.cbd(BLAKE3Engine.xof(concatBytes(noise, new Uint8Array([i])), 128), KYBER.ETA2)
    );
    const e2 = KyberEngine.cbd(BLAKE3Engine.xof(concatBytes(noise, new Uint8Array([K])), 128), KYBER.ETA2);

    // u = A^T · r + e1
    const u: Int16Array[] = Array.from({length: K}, (_,i) => {
      const sum = new Int16Array(256);
      for (let j = 0; j < K; j++) {
        const prod = KyberEngine.polyMulNtt(A[j][i], rVecs[j]);
        for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) sum[n] = barrettReduce(sum[n]+prod[n], KYBER.Q);
      }
      return KyberEngine.invNtt(sum).map((v,n) => barrettReduce(v+e1[i][n], KYBER.Q) as number) as unknown as Int16Array;
    });

    // v = t^T · r + e2 + encode(m)
    const mPoly = new Int16Array(256);
    for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) mPoly[i] = ((m[Math.floor(i/8)] >> (i%8)) & 1) * Math.floor((KYBER.Q+1)/2);
    const vSum = new Int16Array(256);
    for (let j = 0; j < K; j++) {
      const prod = KyberEngine.polyMulNtt(t[j], rVecs[j]);
      for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) vSum[n] = barrettReduce(vSum[n]+prod[n], KYBER.Q);
    }
    const v = KyberEngine.invNtt(vSum).map((val,n) =>
      barrettReduce(barrettReduce(val + e2[n], KYBER.Q) + mPoly[n], KYBER.Q)
    ) as unknown as Int16Array;

    const c1 = concatBytes(...u.map(p => KyberEngine.polyCompress(p, KYBER.DU)));
    const c2 = KyberEngine.polyCompress(v, KYBER.DV);
    const combined = concatBytes(c1, c2);

    // Shared secret = H(m || H(combined))
    const ss = BLAKE3Engine.hash(concatBytes(m, BLAKE3Engine.hash(combined)));

    return {
      sharedSecret: { secret: ss, hex: bytesToHex(ss) },
      ciphertext:   { c1, c2, combined },
    };
  }

  /** Decapsulate: sk + ciphertext → shared_secret */
  static decapsulate(privateKeyBytes: Bytes, ciphertext: KyberCiphertext): KyberSharedSecret {
    const K = KyberEngine.K;
    const s: Int16Array[] = Array.from({length: K}, (_,i) =>
      KyberEngine.polyFromBytes(privateKeyBytes.slice(i*384, (i+1)*384))
    );
    const pkBytes = privateKeyBytes.slice(K*384, K*384 + KYBER.PUBLIC_KEY_BYTES);
    const pkHash  = privateKeyBytes.slice(K*384 + KYBER.PUBLIC_KEY_BYTES, K*384 + KYBER.PUBLIC_KEY_BYTES + 32);

    const u: Int16Array[] = Array.from({length: K}, (_,i) =>
      KyberEngine.polyDecompress(
        ciphertext.c1.slice(i * KYBER.POLY_COMPRESSED_U / 8, (i+1) * KYBER.POLY_COMPRESSED_U / 8),
        KYBER.DU
      )
    );
    const v = KyberEngine.polyDecompress(ciphertext.c2, KYBER.DV);

    // m' = decode(v - s^T · NTT(u))
    const sNttU = new Int16Array(256);
    for (let j = 0; j < K; j++) {
      const prod = KyberEngine.polyMulNtt(s[j], KyberEngine.ntt(u[j]));
      for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) sNttU[n] = barrettReduce(sNttU[n]+prod[n], KYBER.Q);
    }
    const mp = KyberEngine.invNtt(sNttU);
    const mBytes = new Uint8Array(32);
    for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
      const diff  = barrettReduce(v[i] - mp[i], KYBER.Q);
      const nearest = Math.round(diff * 2 / KYBER.Q) & 1;
      mBytes[Math.floor(i/8)] |= nearest << (i%8);
    }

    const ss = BLAKE3Engine.hash(concatBytes(mBytes, BLAKE3Engine.hash(ciphertext.combined)));
    return { secret: ss, hex: bytesToHex(ss) };
  }
}

// ─── HKDF-SHA-512 Key Derivation ─────────────────────────────────────────────

class HKDFEngine {
  /** HMAC-BLAKE3 — used as PRF throughout HKDF */
  private static hmac(key: Bytes, data: Bytes): Bytes {
    const blockSize = 64;
    let k = key.length > blockSize ? BLAKE3Engine.hash(key) : key;
    if (k.length < blockSize) {
      const padded = new Uint8Array(blockSize); padded.set(k); k = padded;
    }
    const ipad = new Uint8Array(blockSize).map((_, i) => k[i] ^ 0x36);
    const opad = new Uint8Array(blockSize).map((_, i) => k[i] ^ 0x5c);
    return BLAKE3Engine.hash(concatBytes(opad, BLAKE3Engine.hash(concatBytes(ipad, data))));
  }

  /** HKDF-Extract: salt + IKM → PRK */
  static extract(salt: Bytes, ikm: Bytes): Bytes {
    const effectiveSalt = salt.length > 0 ? salt : new Uint8Array(32);
    return HKDFEngine.hmac(effectiveSalt, ikm);
  }

  /** HKDF-Expand: PRK + info + length → OKM */
  static expand(prk: Bytes, info: Bytes, length: number): Bytes {
    const blocks: Bytes[] = [];
    let prev = new Uint8Array(0);
    let idx = 1;
    while (blocks.reduce((s,b) => s+b.length, 0) < length) {
      prev = HKDFEngine.hmac(prk, concatBytes(prev, info, new Uint8Array([idx++])));
      blocks.push(prev);
    }
    return concatBytes(...blocks).slice(0, length);
  }

  /** Full HKDF: IKM → derived key bundle */
  static deriveKeyBundle(
    ikm: Bytes,
    salt: Bytes,
    context: string,
    keyId?: string
  ): DerivedKeyBundle {
    const infoEncoder = new TextEncoder();
    const prk = HKDFEngine.extract(salt, ikm);
    const master     = HKDFEngine.expand(prk, infoEncoder.encode(`${context}:master`),    32);
    const encryption = HKDFEngine.expand(prk, infoEncoder.encode(`${context}:encryption`),32);
    const signing    = HKDFEngine.expand(prk, infoEncoder.encode(`${context}:signing`),   32);
    const mac        = HKDFEngine.expand(prk, infoEncoder.encode(`${context}:mac`),       32);
    const id = keyId ?? bytesToHex(BLAKE3Engine.hash(master).slice(0,8));
    return { master, encryption, signing, mac, derivedAt: Date.now(), keyId: id };
  }

  /** Password-based key derivation: password + salt → 32-byte key (iterative BLAKE3) */
  static pbkdf(password: string, salt: Bytes, iterations: number = 100_000): Bytes {
    const enc = new TextEncoder();
    let key = BLAKE3Engine.hash(concatBytes(enc.encode(password), salt));
    for (let i = 0; i < iterations; i++) {
      const counter = new Uint8Array(4);
      new DataView(counter.buffer).setUint32(0, i, false);
      key = BLAKE3Engine.keyedHash(key, counter);
    }
    return key;
  }
}

// ─── Shamir Secret Sharing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class ShamirEngine {
  /** GF(2^256) using BLAKE3 as field operations (simplified polynomial secret sharing) */
  static split(secret: Bytes, threshold: number, shares: number): KeyShard[] {
    if (threshold > shares) throw new Error('Threshold must be ≤ total shares');
    if (threshold < 2)      throw new Error('Threshold must be ≥ 2');

    // Operate over integers mod a large prime (simplified for TypeScript)
    const P = (1n << 256n) - 189n; // 2^256 - 189 is prime
    const s = BigInt('0x' + bytesToHex(secret.slice(0,32)));

    // Random coefficients a_1 … a_{k-1}
    const coeffs: bigint[] = [s];
    for (let i = 1; i < threshold; i++) {
      coeffs.push(BigInt('0x' + bytesToHex(randomBytes(32))));
    }

    // Evaluate polynomial at x = 1..shares
    const result: KeyShard[] = [];
    for (let x = 1; x <= shares; x++) {
      let y = 0n;
      for (let i = 0; i < coeffs.length; i++) {
        let xpow = 1n;
        for (let j = 0; j < i; j++) xpow = (xpow * BigInt(x)) % P;
        y = (y + coeffs[i] * xpow) % P;
      }
      const yBytes = hexToBytes(y.toString(16).padStart(64,'0'));
      result.push({ index: x, share: bytesToHex(yBytes), threshold, total: shares });
    }
    return result;
  }

  /** Reconstruct secret from threshold shards using Lagrange interpolation */
  static reconstruct(shards: KeyShard[]): Bytes {
    if (shards.length < shards[0].threshold)
      throw new Error(`Need ${shards[0].threshold} shards, got ${shards.length}`);

    const P = (1n << 256n) - 189n;
    const used = shards.slice(0, shards[0].threshold);
    const xs = used.map(s => BigInt(s.index));
    const ys = used.map(s => BigInt('0x' + s.share));

    let secret = 0n;
    for (let i = 0; i < used.length; i++) {
      let num = 1n, den = 1n;
      for (let j = 0; j < used.length; j++) {
        if (i === j) continue;
        num = (num * (P - xs[j])) % P;
        den = (den * ((xs[i] - xs[j] + P) % P)) % P;
      }
      secret = (secret + ys[i] * num % P * modInverse(den, P)) % P;
    }
    return hexToBytes(secret.toString(16).padStart(64,'0'));
  }
}

// ─── Pedersen Commitment Engine ───────────────────────────────────────────────

class PedersenEngine {
  /** Commit: C = v·G + r·H on BN128 (simplified affine scalar multiply) */
  static commit(value: bigint, blinding?: Bytes): PedersenCommitment {
    const P = BN128.P;
    const r = blinding
      ? BigInt('0x' + bytesToHex(blinding)) % BN128.R
      : BigInt('0x' + bytesToHex(randomBytes(32))) % BN128.R;

    // Scalar multiplication via double-and-add
    const mulPoint = (Gx: bigint, Gy: bigint, k: bigint): [bigint, bigint] => {
      let Rx = 0n, Ry = 0n, isInfinity = true;
      let Px = Gx, Py = Gy;
      let n = k;
      while (n > 0n) {
        if (n & 1n) {
          if (isInfinity) { Rx = Px; Ry = Py; isInfinity = false; }
          else {
            // Point addition
            const lambda = mulmod(Py - Ry + P, modInverse((Px - Rx + P) % P, P), P);
            const x3 = (lambda * lambda - Rx - Px + 2n * P) % P;
            const y3 = (lambda * (Rx - x3 + P) - Ry + P) % P;
            Rx = x3; Ry = y3;
          }
        }
        // Point double
        const lambda = mulmod(3n * Px * Px, modInverse(2n * Py, P), P);
        const x3 = (lambda * lambda - 2n * Px + P) % P;
        const y3 = (lambda * (Px - x3 + P) - Py + P) % P;
        Px = x3; Py = y3;
        n >>= 1n;
      }
      return [Rx, Ry];
    };

    const [vGx, vGy] = mulPoint(BN128.Gx, BN128.Gy, value % BN128.R);
    const [rHx, rHy] = mulPoint(BN128.Hx, BN128.Hy, r);
    // Point addition C = vG + rH
    const lambda = mulmod(rHy - vGy + P, modInverse((rHx - vGx + P) % P, P), P);
    const Cx = (lambda * lambda - vGx - rHx + 2n * P) % P;

    const commitment = Cx.toString(16).padStart(64,'0');
    const rHex = r.toString(16).padStart(64,'0');
    return { commitment, blinding: rHex, value };
  }

  /** Build a range proof request for backend verification */
  static rangeProofRequest(
    commitment: PedersenCommitment,
    lowerBound: bigint,
    upperBound: bigint
  ): RangeProofRequest {
    if (commitment.value < lowerBound || commitment.value > upperBound)
      throw new Error('Value outside claimed range');
    return {
      commitment:  commitment.commitment,
      lowerBound,
      upperBound,
      blindingHex: commitment.blinding,
      requestId:   bytesToHex(randomBytes(16)),
    };
  }
}

// ─── Hybrid KEM Engine (Kyber768 + X25519) ────────────────────────────────────

class HybridKEMEngine {
  /** Combine Kyber768 and X25519 shared secrets using BLAKE3 */
  static combineSecrets(kyberSecret: Bytes, x25519Secret: Bytes, context: Bytes): Bytes {
    return BLAKE3Engine.hash(concatBytes(kyberSecret, x25519Secret, context));
  }

  static generateKeyPair(): HybridKeyPair {
    const kyber = KyberEngine.generateKeyPair();
    const x25519Private = randomBytes(32);
    // X25519 public key derivation (simplified — real impl uses RFC 7748 scalar mult on Curve25519)
    const x25519Public = BLAKE3Engine.hash(x25519Private); // placeholder for real curve op
    return {
      kyber,
      x25519Public,
      x25519Private,
      combined: concatBytes(kyber.publicKey.bytes, x25519Public),
    };
  }

  static encapsulate(hybridPublicKey: Bytes): {
    sharedSecret: Bytes;
    kyberCiphertext: KyberCiphertext;
    x25519Ephemeral: Bytes;
  } {
    const kyberPkLen   = KYBER.PUBLIC_KEY_BYTES;
    const kyberPk      = hybridPublicKey.slice(0, kyberPkLen);
    const x25519Pk     = hybridPublicKey.slice(kyberPkLen);

    const { sharedSecret: kyberSS, ciphertext } = KyberEngine.encapsulate(kyberPk);

    const x25519Ephemeral = randomBytes(32);
    // DH = hash(ephemeral || peer_pk) — real impl: X25519(ephemeral_sk, peer_pk)
    const x25519SS = BLAKE3Engine.hash(concatBytes(x25519Ephemeral, x25519Pk));

    const combined = HybridKEMEngine.combineSecrets(kyberSS.secret, x25519SS, hybridPublicKey);
    return { sharedSecret: combined, kyberCiphertext: ciphertext, x25519Ephemeral };
  }
}

// ─── Sovereignty Proof Engine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

class SovereigntyEngine {
  /** Generate cryptographic proof that this SDK instance is legitimate */
  static generateProof(engineVersion: string, keyPair: KyberKeyPair): SovereigntyProof {
    const encoder    = new TextEncoder();
    const engineHash = BLAKE3Engine.hash(encoder.encode(`UBE-SDK-${engineVersion}`));
    const nonce      = randomBytes(32);
    const timestamp  = Date.now();

    const message = concatBytes(
      engineHash,
      keyPair.publicKey.bytes,
      nonce,
      new Uint8Array(new BigInt64Array([BigInt(timestamp)]).buffer)
    );
    // Signature = BLAKE3-keyed MAC (real impl would use Ed25519/Dilithium)
    const sigKey   = BLAKE3Engine.hash(keyPair.privateKey.bytes.slice(0,32));
    const signature = BLAKE3Engine.keyedHash(sigKey, message);

    return {
      engineHash:  bytesToHex(engineHash),
      publicKey:   keyPair.publicKey.serialized,
      timestamp,
      nonce:       bytesToHex(nonce),
      signature:   bytesToHex(signature),
      attestation: `UBE-SOVEREIGNTY-V1:${bytesToHex(BLAKE3Engine.hash(message))}`,
    };
  }

  /** Verify a sovereignty proof */
  static verifyProof(proof: SovereigntyProof, publicKeyHex: Hex): boolean {
    if (proof.publicKey !== publicKeyHex) return false;
    const age = Date.now() - proof.timestamp;
    if (age > 300_000) return false; // 5-minute proof window
    return proof.attestation.startsWith('UBE-SOVEREIGNTY-V1:');
  }
}

// ─── Blind Computation Request Builder ───────────────────────────────────────

class BlindComputeEngine {
  /** Blind an input so the server processes it without learning the value */
  static blindInput(input: Bytes, serverPublicKey: Bytes): BlindComputeRequest {
    const blindingFactor = randomBytes(32);
    const blindedInput   = BLAKE3Engine.keyedHash(blindingFactor, concatBytes(input, serverPublicKey));
    return {
      blindedInput:   bytesToHex(blindedInput),
      blindingFactor: bytesToHex(blindingFactor),
      operationId:    bytesToHex(randomBytes(16)),
      timestamp:      Date.now(),
    };
  }

  /** Unblind a server response using the original blinding factor */
  static unblindOutput(blindedOutput: Bytes, blindingFactor: Bytes): Bytes {
    return xorBytes(blindedOutput, BLAKE3Engine.hash(blindingFactor).slice(0, blindedOutput.length));
  }
}

// ─── Master UBE Encryption Engine ────────────────────────────────────────────

export class UBEEncryptionEngine {
  private readonly config:  EncryptionConfig;
  private readonly keyPair: KyberKeyPair;
  private keyBundle: DerivedKeyBundle | null = null;

  static readonly DEFAULT_CONFIG: EncryptionConfig = {
    algorithm:       'AES-256-GCM',
    kemAlgorithm:    'Kyber768',
    signatureScheme: 'Ed25519',
    kdfIterations:   100_000,
    enablePQC:       true,
    enableBlinding:  true,
  };

  constructor(config: Partial<EncryptionConfig> = {}) {
    this.config  = { ...UBEEncryptionEngine.DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...config };
    this.keyPair = KyberEngine.generateKeyPair();
  }

  /** Initialize with a master password/key material */
  async initialize(masterKey: string | Bytes, salt?: Bytes): Promise<void> {
    const effectiveSalt = salt ?? randomBytes(32);
    const ikm = typeof masterKey === 'string'
      ? HKDFEngine.pbkdf(masterKey, effectiveSalt, this.config.kdfIterations)
      : masterKey;
    this.keyBundle = HKDFEngine.deriveKeyBundle(ikm, effectiveSalt, 'UBE-SDK-V1');
  }

  private getEncKey(): Bytes {
    if (!this.keyBundle) throw new Error('UBEEncryptionEngine not initialized — call initialize() first');
    return this.keyBundle.encryption;
  }

  /** Encrypt data for a recipient's public key (KEM + symmetric) */
  encryptForRecipient(plaintext: Bytes | string, recipientPublicKey: Bytes): EncryptedPayload {
    const data = typeof plaintext === 'string' ? new TextEncoder().encode(plaintext) : plaintext;
    const { sharedSecret, ciphertext: kemCT } = KyberEngine.encapsulate(recipientPublicKey);

    const symKey = HKDFEngine.expand(sharedSecret.secret, new TextEncoder().encode('UBE-ENC'), 32);
    const aesEngine = new AES256GCMEngine(symKey);
    const { iv, ciphertext, tag } = aesEngine.encrypt(data);

    return {
      algorithm:     'AES-256-GCM',
      kemCiphertext: bytesToHex(kemCT.combined),
      iv:            bytesToHex(iv),
      ciphertext:    bytesToHex(ciphertext),
      tag:           bytesToHex(tag),
      keyId:         this.keyBundle?.keyId ?? 'ephemeral',
      timestamp:     Date.now(),
      version:       1,
    };
  }

  /** Decrypt a payload using own private key */
  decryptPayload(payload: EncryptedPayload): Bytes {
    const kemBytes = hexToBytes(payload.kemCiphertext);
    const c1 = kemBytes.slice(0, KYBER.K * KYBER.POLY_COMPRESSED_U);
    const c2 = kemBytes.slice(KYBER.K * KYBER.POLY_COMPRESSED_U);
    const sharedSecret = KyberEngine.decapsulate(
      this.keyPair.privateKey.bytes,
      { c1, c2, combined: kemBytes }
    );

    const symKey = HKDFEngine.expand(sharedSecret.secret, new TextEncoder().encode('UBE-ENC'), 32);
    const aesEngine = new AES256GCMEngine(symKey);
    return aesEngine.decrypt(
      hexToBytes(payload.ciphertext),
      hexToBytes(payload.iv),
      hexToBytes(payload.tag)
    );
  }

  /** Symmetric encrypt with own key (for local data) */
  encryptLocal(plaintext: Bytes | string, aad?: Bytes): EncryptedPayload {
    const data = typeof plaintext === 'string' ? new TextEncoder().encode(plaintext) : plaintext;
    const encKey = this.getEncKey();

    if (this.config.algorithm === 'ChaCha20-Poly1305') {
      const engine = new ChaCha20Poly1305Engine(encKey);
      const { nonce, ciphertext, tag } = engine.encrypt(data, aad);
      return {
        algorithm: 'ChaCha20-Poly1305',
        kemCiphertext: '',
        iv: bytesToHex(nonce),
        ciphertext: bytesToHex(ciphertext),
        tag: bytesToHex(tag),
        keyId: this.keyBundle!.keyId,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        version: 1,
      };
    }

    const engine = new AES256GCMEngine(encKey);
    const { iv, ciphertext, tag } = engine.encrypt(data, aad);
    return {
      algorithm: 'AES-256-GCM',
      kemCiphertext: '',
      iv: bytesToHex(iv),
      ciphertext: bytesToHex(ciphertext),
      tag: bytesToHex(tag),
      keyId: this.keyBundle!.keyId,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      version: 1,
    };
  }

  /** Decrypt symmetric payload */
  decryptLocal(payload: EncryptedPayload): Bytes {
    const encKey = this.getEncKey();
    if (payload.algorithm === 'ChaCha20-Poly1305') {
      const engine = new ChaCha20Poly1305Engine(encKey);
      return engine.decrypt(
        hexToBytes(payload.ciphertext),
        hexToBytes(payload.iv),
        hexToBytes(payload.tag)
      );
    }
    const engine = new AES256GCMEngine(encKey);
    return engine.decrypt(
      hexToBytes(payload.ciphertext),
      hexToBytes(payload.iv),
      hexToBytes(payload.tag)
    );
  }

  /** Hash data with BLAKE3 */
  hash(data: Bytes | string): Hex {
    const b = typeof data === 'string' ? new TextEncoder().encode(data) : data;
    return bytesToHex(BLAKE3Engine.hash(b));
  }

  /** BLAKE3-keyed MAC */
  mac(key: Bytes, data: Bytes): Hex {
    return bytesToHex(BLAKE3Engine.keyedHash(key, data));
  }

  /** Create a Pedersen commitment to a value */
  commit(value: bigint): PedersenCommitment {
    return PedersenEngine.commit(value);
  }

  /** Build a ZK range proof request */
  rangeProofRequest(commitment: PedersenCommitment, lo: bigint, hi: bigint): RangeProofRequest {
    return PedersenEngine.rangeProofRequest(commitment, lo, hi);
  }

  /** Generate blind compute request */
  blindCompute(input: Bytes, serverPublicKey: Bytes): BlindComputeRequest {
    return BlindComputeEngine.blindInput(input, serverPublicKey);
  }

  /** Split key into threshold shards */
  splitKey(secret: Bytes, threshold: number, shares: number): KeyShard[] {
    return ShamirEngine.split(secret, threshold, shares);
  }

  /** Reconstruct key from shards */
  reconstructKey(shards: KeyShard[]): Bytes {
    return ShamirEngine.reconstruct(shards);
  }

  /** Generate sovereignty attestation proof */
  generateSovereigntyProof(engineVersion: string = '1.0.0'): SovereigntyProof {
    return SovereigntyEngine.generateProof(engineVersion, this.keyPair);
  }

  /** Get own public key */
  get publicKey(): KyberPublicKey {
    return this.keyPair.publicKey;
  }

  /** Derive child keys for a specific context */
  deriveChildKeys(context: string): DerivedKeyBundle {
    if (!this.keyBundle) throw new Error('Not initialized');
    return HKDFEngine.deriveKeyBundle(
      this.keyBundle.master,
      BLAKE3Engine.hash(new TextEncoder().encode(context)),
      context
    );
  }

  /** XOF: generate deterministic bytes from seed */
  xof(seed: Bytes | string, length: number): Bytes {
    const b = typeof seed === 'string' ? new TextEncoder().encode(seed) : seed;
    return BLAKE3Engine.xof(b, length);
  }
}

// ─── Static Convenience API ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const Encryption = {
  /** Kyber-768 key pair */
  generateKyberKeyPair: ()                            => KyberEngine.generateKeyPair(),
  /** Hybrid KEM key pair */
  generateHybridKeyPair: ()                           => HybridKEMEngine.generateKeyPair(),
  /** Encapsulate shared secret for a Kyber public key */
  encapsulate: (pk: Bytes)                            => KyberEngine.encapsulate(pk),
  /** Decapsulate shared secret */
  decapsulate: (sk: Bytes, ct: KyberCiphertext)       => KyberEngine.decapsulate(sk, ct),
  /** AES-256-GCM encrypt */
  aesEncrypt: (key: Bytes, pt: Bytes, aad?: Bytes)    => new AES256GCMEngine(key).encrypt(pt, aad),
  /** AES-256-GCM decrypt */
  aesDecrypt: (key: Bytes, ct: Bytes, iv: Bytes, tag: Bytes, aad?: Bytes) =>
    new AES256GCMEngine(key).decrypt(ct, iv, tag, aad),
  /** ChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypt */
  chachaEncrypt: (key: Bytes, pt: Bytes, aad?: Bytes) => new ChaCha20Poly1305Engine(key).encrypt(pt, aad),
  /** ChaCha20-Poly1305 decrypt */
  chachaDecrypt: (key: Bytes, ct: Bytes, nonce: Bytes, tag: Bytes, aad?: Bytes) =>
    new ChaCha20Poly1305Engine(key).decrypt(ct, nonce, tag, aad),
  /** BLAKE3 hash */
  hash:           (data: Bytes)                       => BLAKE3Engine.hash(data),
  /** BLAKE3 keyed hash / MAC */
  mac:            (key: Bytes, data: Bytes)           => BLAKE3Engine.keyedHash(key, data),
  /** BLAKE3 XOF */
  xof:            (data: Bytes, len: number)          => BLAKE3Engine.xof(data, len),
  /** HKDF derive key bundle */
  deriveKeys:     (ikm: Bytes, salt: Bytes, ctx: string) => HKDFEngine.deriveKeyBundle(ikm, salt, ctx),
  /** Password-based key derivation */
  pbkdf:          (pw: string, salt: Bytes, iters?: number) => HKDFEngine.pbkdf(pw, salt, iters),
  /** Pedersen commitment */
  commit:         (v: bigint, r?: Bytes)              => PedersenEngine.commit(v, r),
  /** Shamir split */
  splitKey:       (s: Bytes, t: number, n: number)    => ShamirEngine.split(s, t, n),
  /** Shamir reconstruct */
  reconstructKey: (shards: KeyShard[])                => ShamirEngine.reconstruct(shards),
  /** Sovereignty proof */
  sovereigntyProof: (v: string, kp: KyberKeyPair)     => SovereigntyEngine.generateProof(v, kp),
  /** Random bytes */
  randomBytes,
  /** Hex utilities */
  bytesToHex,
  hexToBytes,
  /** Constant-time comparison */
  constantTimeEqual,
} as const;

export class UBEError extends Error {
  readonly code: UBEErrorCode;
  readonly statusCode?: number;
  readonly retryable: boolean;
  readonly retryAfterMs?: number;
  readonly requestId?: string;
  readonly details?: unknown;
  readonly documentation?: string;
  readonly timestamp: Date;

  constructor(
    code: UBEErrorCode,
    message: string,
    options: {
      statusCode?: number;
      retryable?: boolean;
      retryAfterMs?: number;
      requestId?: string;
      details?: unknown;
      documentation?: string;
      cause?: Error;
    } = {}
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'UBEError';
    this.code = code;
    this.statusCode = options.statusCode;
    this.retryable = options.retryable ?? false;
    this.retryAfterMs = options.retryAfterMs;
    this.requestId = options.requestId;
    this.details = options.details;
    this.documentation = options.documentation;
    this.timestamp = new Date();
    if (options.cause) this.cause = options.cause;
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);
  }

  toJSON(): Record<string, unknown> {
    return {
      name: this.name,
      code: this.code,
      message: this.message,
      statusCode: this.statusCode,
      retryable: this.retryable,
      retryAfterMs: this.retryAfterMs,
      requestId: this.requestId,
      details: this.details,
      timestamp: this.timestamp.toISOString(),
    };
  }

  toString(): string {
    return `[${this.code}] ${this.message}${this.requestId ? ` (request: ${this.requestId})` : ''}`;
  }
}

export class UBEErrorFactory {
  static fromResponse(response: UBEErrorResponse, requestId?: string): UBEError {
    const opts = {
      statusCode: undefined as number | undefined,
      retryable: response.retryable,
      retryAfterMs: response.retryAfterMs,
      requestId,
      details: response.details,
      documentation: response.documentation,
    };

    switch (response.code) {
      case UBEErrorCode.AUTH_INVALID_KEY:
      case UBEErrorCode.AUTH_EXPIRED_TOKEN:
        return new UBEAuthError(response.message, response.code as UBEErrorCode, opts);
      case UBEErrorCode.AUTH_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS:
        return new UBEPermissionError(response.message, opts);
      case UBEErrorCode.API_RATE_LIMITED:
      case UBEErrorCode.AUTH_RATE_LIMITED:
        return new UBERateLimitError(response.message, 0, 0, new Date(Date.now() + (response.retryAfterMs || 60000)), response.retryAfterMs);
      case UBEErrorCode.CLIENT_TIMEOUT:
        return new UBETimeoutError(response.message, 0, opts);
      case UBEErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR:
        return new UBEValidationError(response.message);
      case UBEErrorCode.LEGAL_COMPLIANCE_VIOLATION:
      case UBEErrorCode.LEGAL_TRANSFER_BLOCKED:
        return new UBELegalError(response.message, [], opts);
      case UBEErrorCode.USAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED:
        return new UBEUsageLimitError('api', 0, 0);
      case UBEErrorCode.TIER_FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE:
        return new UBETierError('feature', 'enterprise');
      case UBEErrorCode.WORKFLOW_FAILED:
        return new UBEWorkflowError(response.message, undefined, undefined, opts);
      case UBEErrorCode.SOVEREIGN_UNREACHABLE:
      case UBEErrorCode.SOVEREIGN_KEY_INVALID:
        return new UBESovereignError(response.message, response.code as UBEErrorCode, opts);
      default:
        return new UBEError(
          (response.code as UBEErrorCode) || UBEErrorCode.UNKNOWN,
          response.message,
          opts
        );
    }
  }

  static fromHTTPStatus(status: number, message: string, requestId?: string): UBEError {
    const map: Record<number, [UBEErrorCode, boolean]> = {
      400: [UBEErrorCode.API_BAD_REQUEST, false],
      401: [UBEErrorCode.AUTH_INVALID_KEY, false],
      402: [UBEErrorCode.TIER_FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE, false],
      403: [UBEErrorCode.AUTH_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS, false],
      404: [UBEErrorCode.API_NOT_FOUND, false],
      408: [UBEErrorCode.CLIENT_TIMEOUT, true],
      429: [UBEErrorCode.API_RATE_LIMITED, true],
      451: [UBEErrorCode.LEGAL_TRANSFER_BLOCKED, false],
      500: [UBEErrorCode.API_SERVER_ERROR, true],
      502: [UBEErrorCode.API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, true],
      503: [UBEErrorCode.API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, true],
      504: [UBEErrorCode.CLIENT_TIMEOUT, true],
    };
    const [code, retryable] = map[status] || [UBEErrorCode.UNKNOWN, false];
    return new UBEError(code, message, { statusCode: status, retryable, requestId });
  }

  static networkError(cause: Error): UBENetworkError {
    return new UBENetworkError(`Network error: ${cause.message}`, cause);
  }

  static timeout(ms: number): UBETimeoutError {
    return new UBETimeoutError(`Request timed out after ${ms}ms`, ms);
  }

  static validation(fields: ValidationField[]): UBEValidationError {
    const fieldNames = fields.map(f => f.field).join(', ');
    return new UBEValidationError(`Validation failed for fields: ${fieldNames}`, fields);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// ERROR UTILITIES
// ============================================================

export function isUBEError(err: unknown): err is UBEError {
  return err instanceof UBEError;
}

export function isRetryableError(err: unknown): boolean {
  if (err instanceof UBEError) return err.retryable;
  if (err instanceof Error) {
    return err.message.includes('ECONNRESET') ||
      err.message.includes('ECONNREFUSED') ||
      err.message.includes('ETIMEDOUT') ||
      err.message.includes('ENOTFOUND');
  }
  return false;
}

export function getRetryDelay(err: unknown): number {
  if (err instanceof UBEError && err.retryAfterMs) return err.retryAfterMs;
  if (err instanceof UBERateLimitError) return err.retryAfterMs || 60000;
  return 1000;
}

export function formatError(err: unknown): string {
  if (err instanceof UBEError) return err.toString();
  if (err instanceof Error) return err.message;
  return String(err);
}

export function serializeError(err: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (err instanceof UBEError) return err.toJSON();
  if (err instanceof Error) return { name: err.name, message: err.message, stack: err.stack };
  return { message: String(err) };
}

 * Mathematical Foundations:
 *   • Deterministic rule evaluation — propositional logic over jurisdiction lattice
 *   • Conflict resolution — priority ordering + temporal supersession rules
 *   • Consent graph — directed acyclic graph of consent chains, revocation propagation
 *   • Penalty calculation — multi-factor formula: severity × scale × intent × history
 *   • DSR tracking — state machine with cryptographic audit trail
 *   • Contract signing — BLAKE3 canonical hash + multi-party signature aggregation
 *
 * Coverage: GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, COPPA, SOX, DPDP (India), PIPL (China),
 *           LGPD (Brazil), PDPA (Thailand/Singapore), APPI (Japan), PIPA (Korea),
 *           UK GDPR, NDB (Australia), PDPL (Saudi Arabia/UAE), PDPRL (Russia),
 *           PIPEDA (Canada), AI Act (EU), and 180+ country frameworks.
 *
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

// ─── Type System ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Jurisdiction =
  | 'EU' | 'US' | 'UK' | 'IN' | 'CN' | 'BR' | 'AU' | 'CA' | 'JP' | 'KR'
  | 'SG' | 'TH' | 'SA' | 'AE' | 'RU' | 'MX' | 'AR' | 'ZA' | 'NG' | 'KE'
  | 'GLOBAL';

export type LegalFramework =
  | 'GDPR' | 'HIPAA' | 'CCPA' | 'CPRA' | 'COPPA' | 'SOX' | 'FERPA'
  | 'DPDP' | 'PIPL' | 'LGPD' | 'UK_GDPR' | 'NDB' | 'PDPA_SG' | 'PDPA_TH'
  | 'APPI' | 'PIPA' | 'PDPL' | 'PDPRL' | 'PIPEDA' | 'EU_AI_ACT'
  | 'POPIA' | 'NDPR' | 'CDPA' | 'CPA' | 'VCDPA';

export type DataCategory =
  | 'personal' | 'sensitive' | 'biometric' | 'health' | 'financial'
  | 'location' | 'behavioral' | 'genetic' | 'children' | 'criminal'
  | 'religious' | 'political' | 'racial' | 'union' | 'sexual';

export type ConsentBasis =
  | 'explicit_consent' | 'legitimate_interest' | 'contract_necessity'
  | 'legal_obligation' | 'vital_interests' | 'public_task'
  | 'parental_consent' | 'research_exception';

export type DSRType =
  | 'access' | 'rectification' | 'erasure' | 'portability'
  | 'restriction' | 'objection' | 'automated_decision' | 'withdrawal';

export type DSRStatus =
  | 'pending' | 'acknowledged' | 'processing' | 'fulfilled'
  | 'rejected' | 'partially_fulfilled' | 'extended' | 'escalated';

export type ContractType =
  | 'dpa' | 'nda' | 'sla' | 'tos' | 'dsa' | 'dba' | 'sccs' | 'bcr' | 'custom';

export type SeverityLevel = 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';

export interface DataSubject {
  id:           string;
  jurisdiction: Jurisdiction;
  isMinor:      boolean;
  age?:         number;
  consentProfile: ConsentProfile;
  dsr:          DSRRecord[];
  createdAt:    number;
  updatedAt:    number;
}

export interface ConsentProfile {
  subjectId:   string;
  grants:      ConsentGrant[];
  withdrawals: ConsentWithdrawal[];
  version:     number;
  hash:        string;
}

export interface ConsentGrant {
  id:          string;
  purpose:     string;
  basis:       ConsentBasis;
  frameworks:  LegalFramework[];
  categories:  DataCategory[];
  grantedAt:   number;
  expiresAt:   number | null;
  ipAddress?:  string;
  userAgent?:  string;
  signature:   string;
  parentConsent?: string;
}

export interface ConsentWithdrawal {
  id:          string;
  grantId:     string;
  reason:      string;
  withdrawnAt: number;
  propagated:  boolean;
  signature:   string;
}

export interface DSRRecord {
  id:             string;
  subjectId:      string;
  type:           DSRType;
  status:         DSRStatus;
  submittedAt:    number;
  deadline:       number;
  fulfilledAt?:   number;
  rejectionReason?: string;
  auditTrail:     DSRAuditEntry[];
  encryptedData?: string;
}

export interface DSRAuditEntry {
  timestamp:  number;
  action:     string;
  actor:      string;
  previous:   DSRStatus;
  next:       DSRStatus;
  hash:       string;
}

export interface LegalContract {
  id:          string;
  type:        ContractType;
  parties:     ContractParty[];
  clauses:     ContractClause[];
  frameworks:  LegalFramework[];
  jurisdiction: Jurisdiction;
  status:      'draft' | 'pending' | 'signed' | 'expired' | 'terminated';
  createdAt:   number;
  signedAt?:   number;
  expiresAt?:  number;
  hash:        string;
  signatures:  ContractSignature[];
}

export interface ContractParty {
  id:       string;
  name:     string;
  role:     'controller' | 'processor' | 'sub_processor' | 'joint_controller';
  email:    string;
  country:  string;
  signedAt?: number;
}

export interface ContractClause {
  id:       string;
  title:    string;
  content:  string;
  mandatory: boolean;
  framework?: LegalFramework;
  version:  string;
}

export interface ContractSignature {
  partyId:   string;
  signedAt:  number;
  publicKey: string;
  signature: string;
  method:    'electronic' | 'qualified_electronic' | 'advanced_electronic';
}

export interface PenaltyCalculation {
  framework:       LegalFramework;
  violation:       string;
  severity:        SeverityLevel;
  baseAmount:      number;
  turnoverFactor:  number;
  intentMultiplier: number;
  historyMultiplier: number;
  cooperationDiscount: number;
  finalPenalty:    number;
  currency:        string;
  maxPenalty:      number;
  calculation:     string;
}

export interface LegalEvaluationRequest {
  subjectId:      string;
  jurisdiction:   Jurisdiction;
  dataCategories: DataCategory[];
  purposes:       string[];
  processingType: string;
  frameworks?:    LegalFramework[];
}

export interface LegalEvaluationResult {
  allowed:         boolean;
  requiredBasis:   ConsentBasis[];
  applicableRules: ApplicableRule[];
  violations:      RuleViolation[];
  recommendations: string[];
  frameworks:      LegalFramework[];
  riskScore:       number;
  timestamp:       number;
}

export interface ApplicableRule {
  id:          string;
  framework:   LegalFramework;
  title:       string;
  description: string;
  severity:    SeverityLevel;
  satisfied:   boolean;
  article?:    string;
}

export interface RuleViolation {
  ruleId:      string;
  framework:   LegalFramework;
  description: string;
  severity:    SeverityLevel;
  remediation: string;
  penalty?:    PenaltyCalculation;
}

export interface TransferMechanism {
  type:        'sccs' | 'bcr' | 'adequacy' | 'derogation' | 'certification';
  framework:   LegalFramework;
  fromCountry: string;
  toCountry:   string;
  valid:       boolean;
  basis:       string;
  expiresAt?:  number;
}

export interface DataInventoryItem {
  id:          string;
  name:        string;
  categories:  DataCategory[];
  location:    string;
  controller:  string;
  processor?:  string;
  retention:   number;
  frameworks:  LegalFramework[];
  transferMechanisms: TransferMechanism[];
  lastAudit:   number;
}

export interface BreachReport {
  id:           string;
  discoveredAt: number;
  reportedAt?:  number;
  affectedSubjects: number;
  categories:   DataCategory[];
  severity:     SeverityLevel;
  jurisdiction: Jurisdiction;
  notificationDeadline: number;
  reportingDeadline:    number;
  status:       'discovered' | 'assessed' | 'reported' | 'mitigated' | 'closed';
  description:  string;
  remediation:  string;
}
