// ─── Helper Functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function generateId(prefix: string): string {
  const rand = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10).toUpperCase();
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now()}-${rand}`;
}

function canonicalHash(data: unknown): string {
  const json = JSON.stringify(data, Object.keys(data as object).sort());
  // Simple deterministic hash (real impl uses BLAKE3 from encryption.ts)
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let i = 0; i < json.length; i++) {
    h ^= json.charCodeAt(i);
    h = (h * 0x01000193) >>> 0;
  }
  return h.toString(16).padStart(8,'0') + Date.now().toString(16);
}

function daysFromNow(days: number): number {
  return Date.now() + days * 86_400_000;
}

// ─── Consent Engine ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ConsentEngine {
  private subjects: Map<string, DataSubject> = new Map();

  /** Grant consent for a data subject */
  grantConsent(
    subjectId: string,
    purpose:   string,
    basis:     ConsentBasis,
    categories: DataCategory[],
    frameworks: LegalFramework[],
    options: { expiresInDays?: number; parentConsent?: string; ipAddress?: string } = {}
  ): ConsentGrant {
    const grant: ConsentGrant = {
      id:          generateId('CGT'),
      purpose,
      basis,
      frameworks,
      categories,
      grantedAt:   Date.now(),
      expiresAt:   options.expiresInDays ? daysFromNow(options.expiresInDays) : null,
      ipAddress:   options.ipAddress,
      parentConsent: options.parentConsent,
      signature:   canonicalHash({ subjectId, purpose, basis, grantedAt: Date.now() }),
    };

    const subject = this.getOrCreateSubject(subjectId);
    subject.consentProfile.grants.push(grant);
    subject.consentProfile.version++;
    subject.consentProfile.hash = canonicalHash(subject.consentProfile);
    subject.updatedAt = Date.now();
    this.subjects.set(subjectId, subject);
    return grant;
  }

  /** Withdraw consent — propagates to all child consents */
  withdrawConsent(subjectId: string, grantId: string, reason: string): ConsentWithdrawal {
    const subject = this.subjects.get(subjectId);
    if (!subject) throw new Error(`Subject ${subjectId} not found`);

    const grant = subject.consentProfile.grants.find(g => g.id === grantId);
    if (!grant) throw new Error(`Grant ${grantId} not found`);

    const withdrawal: ConsentWithdrawal = {
      id:          generateId('CWT'),
      grantId,
      reason,
      withdrawnAt: Date.now(),
      propagated:  true,
      signature:   canonicalHash({ subjectId, grantId, reason, withdrawnAt: Date.now() }),
    };

    subject.consentProfile.withdrawals.push(withdrawal);
    subject.consentProfile.version++;
    subject.consentProfile.hash = canonicalHash(subject.consentProfile);
    this.subjects.set(subjectId, subject);
    return withdrawal;
  }

  /** Check if consent is currently valid for a purpose */
  checkConsent(subjectId: string, purpose: string, category: DataCategory): boolean {
    const subject = this.subjects.get(subjectId);
    if (!subject) return false;

    const profile = subject.consentProfile;
    const withdrawnIds = new Set(profile.withdrawals.map(w => w.grantId));

    return profile.grants.some(g => {
      if (withdrawnIds.has(g.id)) return false;
      if (g.expiresAt && Date.now() > g.expiresAt) return false;
      if (!g.categories.includes(category)) return false;
      return g.purpose === purpose || g.purpose === '*';
    });
  }

  /** Get full consent profile for a subject */
  getConsentProfile(subjectId: string): ConsentProfile | null {
    return this.subjects.get(subjectId)?.consentProfile ?? null;
  }

  private getOrCreateSubject(subjectId: string): DataSubject {
    if (this.subjects.has(subjectId)) return this.subjects.get(subjectId)!;
    const subject: DataSubject = {
      id: subjectId,
      jurisdiction: 'EU',
      isMinor: false,
      consentProfile: { subjectId, grants: [], withdrawals: [], version: 0, hash: '' },
      dsr: [],
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    };
    this.subjects.set(subjectId, subject);
    return subject;
  }
}

// ─── DSR Engine ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class DSREngine {
  private records: Map<string, DSRRecord> = new Map();

  /** Submit a Data Subject Request */
  submit(subjectId: string, type: DSRType, framework: LegalFramework): DSRRecord {
    const deadlineDays = DSR_DEADLINES[framework]?.[type] ?? 30;
    const record: DSRRecord = {
      id:          generateId('DSR'),
      subjectId,
      type,
      status:      'pending',
      submittedAt: Date.now(),
      deadline:    daysFromNow(deadlineDays),
      auditTrail:  [{
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        action:    'submitted',
        actor:     subjectId,
        previous:  'pending',
        next:      'pending',
        hash:      canonicalHash({ subjectId, type, framework }),
      }],
    };
    this.records.set(record.id, record);
    return record;
  }

  /** Advance DSR status through state machine */
  advance(dsrId: string, newStatus: DSRStatus, actor: string, note?: string): DSRRecord {
    const record = this.records.get(dsrId);
    if (!record) throw new Error(`DSR ${dsrId} not found`);

    const validTransitions: Record<DSRStatus, DSRStatus[]> = {
      pending:            ['acknowledged', 'rejected'],
      acknowledged:       ['processing',   'rejected'],
      processing:         ['fulfilled',    'partially_fulfilled', 'extended', 'rejected'],
      extended:           ['fulfilled',    'partially_fulfilled', 'rejected'],
      fulfilled:          [],
      rejected:           [],
      partially_fulfilled:['fulfilled'],
      escalated:          ['processing',   'rejected'],
    };

    if (!validTransitions[record.status].includes(newStatus))
      throw new Error(`Invalid DSR transition: ${record.status} → ${newStatus}`);

    const entry: DSRAuditEntry = {
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      action:    note ?? `status_changed_to_${newStatus}`,
      actor,
      previous:  record.status,
      next:      newStatus,
      hash:      canonicalHash({ dsrId, newStatus, actor, timestamp: Date.now() }),
    };

    record.auditTrail.push(entry);
    record.status = newStatus;
    if (newStatus === 'fulfilled' || newStatus === 'partially_fulfilled')
      record.fulfilledAt = Date.now();
    if (newStatus === 'rejected')
      record.rejectionReason = note;

    this.records.set(dsrId, record);
    return record;
  }

  /** Check for overdue DSRs */
  getOverdue(): DSRRecord[] {
    const now = Date.now();
    return Array.from(this.records.values()).filter(r =>
      !['fulfilled','rejected','partially_fulfilled'].includes(r.status) &&
      now > r.deadline
    );
  }

  /** Get all DSRs for a subject */
  getBySubject(subjectId: string): DSRRecord[] {
    return Array.from(this.records.values()).filter(r => r.subjectId === subjectId);
  }

  getDSR(id: string): DSRRecord | null {
    return this.records.get(id) ?? null;
  }
}

// ─── Legal Evaluation Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class LegalEvaluationEngine {
  /** Evaluate whether a processing activity is legally permissible */
  evaluate(request: LegalEvaluationRequest, consentProfile?: ConsentProfile): LegalEvaluationResult {
    const frameworks = request.frameworks
      ?? JURISDICTION_FRAMEWORKS[request.jurisdiction]
      ?? JURISDICTION_FRAMEWORKS.GLOBAL;

    const allRules: ApplicableRule[] = [];
    const violations: RuleViolation[] = [];
    const recommendations: string[] = [];

    for (const fw of frameworks) {
      const rules = (FRAMEWORK_RULES[fw] ?? []).map(r => ({ ...r }));

      for (const rule of rules) {
        rule.satisfied = this.evaluateRule(rule, request, consentProfile);
        allRules.push(rule);

        if (!rule.satisfied) {
          const penalty = this.calculatePenalty(fw, rule, 0);
          violations.push({
            ruleId:      rule.id,
            framework:   fw,
            description: rule.description,
            severity:    rule.severity,
            remediation: this.getRemediation(rule.id),
            penalty,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Special: minor data check
    if (request.dataCategories.includes('children')) {
      recommendations.push('Ensure verifiable parental consent mechanism is implemented');
      recommendations.push('Restrict data collection to minimum necessary for service provision');
      recommendations.push('Implement age verification before data collection');
    }
    if (request.dataCategories.some(c => ['biometric','genetic','health','criminal'].includes(c))) {
      recommendations.push('Conduct DPIA before processing special category data');
      recommendations.push('Appoint Data Protection Officer if not already designated');
    }
    if (request.dataCategories.includes('location')) {
      recommendations.push('Implement granular location consent — precise vs approximate');
    }

    const riskScore = this.calculateRiskScore(violations, request.dataCategories);

    return {
      allowed:          violations.filter(v => v.severity === 'critical').length === 0,
      requiredBasis:    this.determineRequiredBasis(request.dataCategories, frameworks),
      applicableRules:  allRules,
      violations,
      recommendations,
      frameworks,
      riskScore,
      timestamp:        Date.now(),
    };
  }

  private evaluateRule(
    rule: ApplicableRule,
    request: LegalEvaluationRequest,
    consent?: ConsentProfile
  ): boolean {
    // Rule evaluation logic — deterministic propositional evaluation
    const hasConsent = consent && consent.grants.length > 0 &&
      consent.withdrawals.length < consent.grants.length;

    if (rule.id.includes('lawful') || rule.id.includes('basis') || rule.id.includes('consent')) {
      return !!hasConsent;
    }
    if (rule.id.includes('child') || rule.id.includes('minor')) {
      return !request.dataCategories.includes('children');
    }
    if (rule.id.includes('sensitive') || rule.id.includes('special')) {
      const sensitiveCategories: DataCategory[] = ['biometric','health','genetic','criminal','religious','political','racial','union','sexual'];
      return !request.dataCategories.some(c => sensitiveCategories.includes(c)) || !!hasConsent;
    }
    if (rule.id.includes('transfer')) {
      return request.jurisdiction !== 'CN'; // PIPL requires security assessment
    }
    // Default: rules requiring organizational measures assumed present
    return ['transparency','notice','security','audit'].some(k => rule.id.includes(k));
  }

  private getRemediation(ruleId: string): string {
    const remediations: Record<string, string> = {
      'gdpr-6':    'Identify and document lawful basis. Update privacy notice.',
      'gdpr-7':    'Implement granular consent UI with purpose-specific checkboxes.',
      'gdpr-8':    'Implement age-gate and parental consent verification workflow.',
      'gdpr-9':    'Add explicit consent for each sensitive data category.',
      'gdpr-17':   'Implement automated erasure pipeline with downstream propagation.',
      'gdpr-28':   'Execute DPA with all processors before commencing processing.',
      'gdpr-33':   'Deploy breach detection and 72-hour regulatory notification system.',
      'gdpr-35':   'Complete DPIA template and obtain DPO sign-off.',
      'gdpr-44':   'Implement SCCs or obtain adequacy confirmation before transfer.',
      'hipaa-baa': 'Execute Business Associate Agreement with all BA entities.',
      'hipaa-breach': 'Implement HIPAA breach assessment and 60-day notification workflow.',
      'ccpa-1798.120': 'Add "Do Not Sell My Personal Information" link to all pages.',
      'coppa-consent': 'Implement COPPA-compliant VPC mechanism before data collection.',
      'dpdp-4':    'Obtain explicit consent per DPDP before processing.',
      'pipl-38':   'Complete CAC security assessment for cross-border transfers.',
      'pdprl-localization': 'Deploy data localization infrastructure within Russian territory.',
    };
    return remediations[ruleId] ?? 'Review applicable compliance requirements and implement technical controls.';
  }

  private calculateRiskScore(violations: RuleViolation[], categories: DataCategory[]): number {
    let score = 0;
    for (const v of violations) {
      score += { low:1, medium:3, high:7, critical:15 }[v.severity] ?? 0;
    }
    // Data category multipliers
    const categoryWeights: Record<DataCategory, number> = {
      personal:1, sensitive:3, biometric:5, health:5, financial:4,
      location:2, behavioral:2, genetic:6, children:6, criminal:5,
      religious:3, political:3, racial:3, union:2, sexual:4,
    };
    for (const c of categories) score += categoryWeights[c] ?? 0;
    return Math.min(100, score);
  }

  private determineRequiredBasis(categories: DataCategory[], frameworks: LegalFramework[]): ConsentBasis[] {
    const bases: ConsentBasis[] = ['explicit_consent'];
    const sensitiveCategories: DataCategory[] = ['biometric','health','genetic','criminal','children'];
    if (!categories.some(c => sensitiveCategories.includes(c)))
      bases.push('legitimate_interest', 'contract_necessity');
    if (categories.includes('children'))
      bases.push('parental_consent');
    return bases;
  }

  calculatePenalty(
    framework: LegalFramework,
    rule: ApplicableRule,
    annualTurnover: number
  ): PenaltyCalculation {
    const params = PENALTY_PARAMS[framework];
    if (!params) throw new Error(`No penalty parameters for ${framework}`);

    const severityBase = { low:0.01, medium:0.05, high:0.20, critical:1.0 }[rule.severity] ?? 0.1;
    const baseAmount = params.max * severityBase;
    const turnoverFactor = annualTurnover > 0 ? Math.min(annualTurnover * params.turnoverPct, params.max) : baseAmount;
    const intentMultiplier = 1.5;    // assume negligence (not willful)
    const historyMultiplier = 1.0;   // no prior violations
    const cooperationDiscount = 0.9; // 10% reduction for cooperation

    const finalPenalty = Math.min(
      Math.max(baseAmount, turnoverFactor) * intentMultiplier * historyMultiplier * cooperationDiscount,
      params.max
    );

    return {
      framework,
      violation:           rule.title,
      severity:            rule.severity,
      baseAmount,
      turnoverFactor,
      intentMultiplier,
      historyMultiplier,
      cooperationDiscount,
      finalPenalty:        Math.round(finalPenalty),
      currency:            params.currency,
      maxPenalty:          params.max,
      calculation:         `max(${baseAmount.toFixed(0)}, ${turnoverFactor.toFixed(0)}) × ${intentMultiplier} × ${historyMultiplier} × ${cooperationDiscount} = ${Math.round(finalPenalty).toLocaleString()} ${params.currency}`,
    };
  }
}

// ─── Contract Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ContractEngine {
  private contracts: Map<string, LegalContract> = new Map();

  /** Create a new legal contract */
  create(
    type:         ContractType,
    parties:      Omit<ContractParty, 'signedAt'>[],
    jurisdiction: Jurisdiction,
    frameworks:   LegalFramework[],
    customClauses: ContractClause[] = []
  ): LegalContract {
    const standardClauses = STANDARD_CLAUSES[type] ?? [];
    const allClauses = [...standardClauses, ...customClauses];

    const contract: LegalContract = {
      id:          generateId('CTR'),
      type,
      parties:     parties.map(p => ({ ...p })),
      clauses:     allClauses,
      frameworks,
      jurisdiction,
      status:      'draft',
      createdAt:   Date.now(),
      hash:        canonicalHash({ type, parties, clauses: allClauses, jurisdiction }),
      signatures:  [],
    };
    this.contracts.set(contract.id, contract);
    return contract;
  }

  /** Sign a contract as a party */
  sign(
    contractId: string,
    partyId:    string,
    publicKey:  string,
    method:     ContractSignature['method'] = 'electronic'
  ): ContractSignature {
    const contract = this.contracts.get(contractId);
    if (!contract) throw new Error(`Contract ${contractId} not found`);
    if (contract.status === 'signed') throw new Error('Contract already fully signed');
    if (!contract.parties.find(p => p.id === partyId))
      throw new Error(`Party ${partyId} not in contract`);

    const sig: ContractSignature = {
      partyId,
      signedAt:  Date.now(),
      publicKey,
      signature: canonicalHash({ contractId, partyId, publicKey, hash: contract.hash }),
      method,
    };
    contract.signatures.push(sig);

    // Update party signed status
    const party = contract.parties.find(p => p.id === partyId)!;
    party.signedAt = sig.signedAt;

    // Check if all parties signed
    if (contract.parties.every(p => p.signedAt)) {
      contract.status   = 'signed';
      contract.signedAt = Date.now();
    } else {
      contract.status = 'pending';
    }
    this.contracts.set(contractId, contract);
    return sig;
  }

  /** Get contract by ID */
  getContract(id: string): LegalContract | null {
    return this.contracts.get(id) ?? null;
  }

  /** Get all contracts for a party */
  getByParty(partyId: string): LegalContract[] {
    return Array.from(this.contracts.values()).filter(c =>
      c.parties.some(p => p.id === partyId)
    );
  }

  /** Generate DPA automatically between controller and processor */
  generateDPA(controllerId: string, processorId: string, jurisdiction: Jurisdiction = 'EU'): LegalContract {
    return this.create(
      'dpa',
      [
        { id: controllerId, name: `Controller-${controllerId}`, role: 'controller',  email: '', country: jurisdiction },
        { id: processorId,  name: `Processor-${processorId}`,  role: 'processor',   email: '', country: jurisdiction },
      ],
      jurisdiction,
      JURISDICTION_FRAMEWORKS[jurisdiction] ?? ['GDPR']
    );
  }
}

// ─── Breach Management Engine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class BreachEngine {
  private breaches: Map<string, BreachReport> = new Map();

  report(
    categories:       DataCategory[],
    affectedSubjects: number,
    severity:         SeverityLevel,
    jurisdiction:     Jurisdiction,
    description:      string
  ): BreachReport {
    // Calculate notification and reporting deadlines per jurisdiction
    const notificationHours: Record<Jurisdiction, number> = {
      EU:72, UK:72, IN:72, CN:24, BR:72, AU:72, CA:72, JP:72, KR:24,
      SG:72, TH:72, SA:72, AE:72, RU:72, MX:72, AR:72, ZA:72, NG:72, KE:72,
      US:72, GLOBAL:72,
    };
    const hours = notificationHours[jurisdiction] ?? 72;

    const breach: BreachReport = {
      id:              generateId('BRH'),
      discoveredAt:    Date.now(),
      affectedSubjects,
      categories,
      severity,
      jurisdiction,
      notificationDeadline: Date.now() + hours * 3_600_000,
      reportingDeadline:    daysFromNow(30),
      status:          'discovered',
      description,
      remediation:     '',
    };
    this.breaches.set(breach.id, breach);
    return breach;
  }

  /** Get breaches approaching notification deadline */
  getUrgent(withinHours: number = 24): BreachReport[] {
    const threshold = Date.now() + withinHours * 3_600_000;
    return Array.from(this.breaches.values()).filter(b =>
      b.status === 'discovered' && b.notificationDeadline <= threshold
    );
  }

  getBreach(id: string): BreachReport | null {
    return this.breaches.get(id) ?? null;
  }
}

// ─── Transfer Mechanism Engine ────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class TransferEngine {
  private static readonly ADEQUATE_COUNTRIES = new Set([
    'AD','AR','CA','FO','GG','IL','IM','JP','JE','NZ','CH','UY','UK',
    'KR','AE', // recent adequacy decisions
  ]);

  /** Determine valid transfer mechanism for a given route */
  determineTransferMechanism(fromCountry: string, toCountry: string, framework: LegalFramework): TransferMechanism {
    const isAdequate = TransferEngine.ADEQUATE_COUNTRIES.has(toCountry);

    if (isAdequate) {
      return { type:'adequacy', framework, fromCountry, toCountry, valid:true, basis:`Adequacy decision for ${toCountry}` };
    }
    if (toCountry === 'RU') {
      return { type:'sccs', framework, fromCountry, toCountry, valid:false, basis:'Russia data localization may prohibit transfers', expiresAt: daysFromNow(365) };
    }
    if (toCountry === 'CN') {
      return { type:'certification', framework, fromCountry, toCountry, valid:false, basis:'CAC security assessment required for transfers to China' };
    }
    // Default: SCCs
    return { type:'sccs', framework, fromCountry, toCountry, valid:true, basis:'EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Module 2)', expiresAt: daysFromNow(365) };
  }
}

// ─── Master Legal Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class UBELegalEngine {
  readonly consent:    ConsentEngine;
  readonly dsr:        DSREngine;
  readonly evaluation: LegalEvaluationEngine;
  readonly contracts:  ContractEngine;
  readonly breach:     BreachEngine;
  readonly transfers:  TransferEngine;

  constructor() {
    this.consent    = new ConsentEngine();
    this.dsr        = new DSREngine();
    this.evaluation = new LegalEvaluationEngine();
    this.contracts  = new ContractEngine();
    this.breach     = new BreachEngine();
    this.transfers  = new TransferEngine();
  }

  /** Full legal check: can we process this data for this subject? */
  canProcess(
    subjectId:      string,
    jurisdiction:   Jurisdiction,
    dataCategories: DataCategory[],
    purpose:        string
  ): { allowed: boolean; reason: string; riskScore: number } {
    const profile = this.consent.getConsentProfile(subjectId);
    const result  = this.evaluation.evaluate(
      { subjectId, jurisdiction, dataCategories, purposes: [purpose], processingType: 'automated' },
      profile ?? undefined
    );

    const reason = result.allowed
      ? 'Processing permitted under applicable legal framework'
      : `Blocked: ${result.violations.map(v => v.description).join('; ')}`;

    return { allowed: result.allowed, reason, riskScore: result.riskScore };
  }

  /** Generate full compliance report for a data processing activity */
  complianceReport(
    jurisdiction:   Jurisdiction,
    dataCategories: DataCategory[],
    annualRevenue:  number = 0
  ): { frameworks: LegalFramework[]; topRisks: RuleViolation[]; estimatedMaxPenalty: number; summary: string } {
    const result = this.evaluation.evaluate({
      subjectId: 'audit', jurisdiction, dataCategories,
      purposes: ['analytics'], processingType: 'automated',
    });

    const estimatedMaxPenalty = result.violations.reduce((sum, v) => {
      const p = v.penalty;
      return sum + (p?.finalPenalty ?? 0);
    }, 0);

    const topRisks = result.violations
      .sort((a,b) => ({ critical:3, high:2, medium:1, low:0 }[b.severity] - { critical:3, high:2, medium:1, low:0 }[a.severity]))
      .slice(0, 5);

    return {
      frameworks:             result.frameworks,
      topRisks,
      estimatedMaxPenalty,
      summary: `${result.violations.length} violations found. Risk score: ${result.riskScore}/100. Estimated maximum penalty: ${estimatedMaxPenalty.toLocaleString()}.`,
    };
  }

  /** Get applicable frameworks for a jurisdiction */
  frameworksFor(jurisdiction: Jurisdiction): LegalFramework[] {
    return JURISDICTION_FRAMEWORKS[jurisdiction] ?? JURISDICTION_FRAMEWORKS.GLOBAL;
  }

  /** DSR deadline in days for a framework + request type */
  dsrDeadline(framework: LegalFramework, type: DSRType): number {
    return DSR_DEADLINES[framework]?.[type] ?? 30;
  }
}

export default UBELegalEngine;

/**
 * UBE SDK — sdk/src/pipeline.ts
 * Data pipeline builder: transform chains, branching, merging, schema evolution, backpressure.
 * Mathematical: Functor composition, monad bind (>>=), category theory pipeline laws.
 * f ∘ g ≡ compose(f, g), identity law: id ∘ f = f ∘ id = f
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

export type PipelineStatus  = 'idle'|'running'|'paused'|'completed'|'failed'|'cancelled';
export type StageType       = 'map'|'filter'|'flatMap'|'reduce'|'branch'|'merge'|'split'|'buffer'|'window'|'aggregate'|'validate'|'enrich'|'deduplicate'|'sort'|'join'|'sink';
export type BackpressureMode = 'drop'|'buffer'|'pause'|'error';

export interface PipelineStage<I = unknown, O = unknown> {
  id:       string;
  name:     string;
  type:     StageType;
  fn:       (input: I, ctx: PipelineContext) => Promise<O | O[] | null | undefined>;
  options:  StageOptions;
}

export interface StageOptions {
  concurrency:  number;
  timeout:      number;
  retries:      number;
  backpressure: BackpressureMode;
  bufferSize:   number;
  dropOnError:  boolean;
  schema?:      unknown;
  windowMs?:    number;
  windowSize?:  number;
  keyFn?:       (item: unknown) => string;
}

export interface PipelineContext {
  pipelineId: string;
  stageId:    string;
  tenantId:   string;
  batchIndex: number;
  itemIndex:  number;
  metadata:   Record<string, unknown>;
  emit:       (event: string, data: unknown) => void;
  checkpoint: (key: string, value: unknown) => void;
  getCheckpoint: (key: string) => unknown;
}

export interface PipelineResult<T> {
  output:   T[];
  errors:   PipelineError[];
  dropped:  number;
  duration: number;
  stages:   StageMetrics[];
}

export interface PipelineError {
  stageId: string;
  item:    unknown;
  error:   string;
  index:   number;
}

export interface StageMetrics {
  stageId:       string;
  name:          string;
  inputCount:    number;
  outputCount:   number;
  errorCount:    number;
  droppedCount:  number;
  avgLatencyMs:  number;
  totalMs:       number;
}

// ─── Pipeline Builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class Pipeline<T = unknown> {
  private stages: PipelineStage[] = [];
  private checkpoints: Map<string, unknown> = new Map();
  private listeners: Map<string, ((d: unknown) => void)[]> = new Map();

  private constructor(private readonly id: string, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  static create<T>(id?: string, tenantId = 'default'): Pipeline<T> {
    return new Pipeline<T>(id ?? `pipe-${Date.now()}`, tenantId);
  }

  map<O>(name: string, fn: (item: T, ctx: PipelineContext) => Promise<O> | O, opts: Partial<StageOptions> = {}): Pipeline<O> {
    this.stages.push({ id: this.uid(), name, type: 'map', fn: fn as PipelineStage['fn'], options: this.mergeOpts(opts) });
    return this as unknown as Pipeline<O>;
  }

  filter(name: string, fn: (item: T, ctx: PipelineContext) => Promise<boolean> | boolean, opts: Partial<StageOptions> = {}): Pipeline<T> {
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'filter',
      fn: async (item, ctx) => { const keep = await fn(item as T, ctx); return keep ? item : null; },
      options: this.mergeOpts(opts),
    });
    return this;
  }

  flatMap<O>(name: string, fn: (item: T, ctx: PipelineContext) => Promise<O[]> | O[], opts: Partial<StageOptions> = {}): Pipeline<O> {
    this.stages.push({ id: this.uid(), name, type: 'flatMap', fn: fn as PipelineStage['fn'], options: this.mergeOpts(opts) });
    return this as unknown as Pipeline<O>;
  }

  validate(name: string, fn: (item: T) => boolean | Promise<boolean>, onFail: 'drop'|'throw' = 'drop'): Pipeline<T> {
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'validate',
      fn: async (item, ctx) => {
        const valid = await fn(item as T);
        if (!valid && onFail === 'throw') throw new Error(`Validation failed at stage "${name}"`);
        return valid ? item : null;
      },
      options: this.mergeOpts({ dropOnError: onFail === 'drop' }),
    });
    return this;
  }

  enrich<O>(name: string, fn: (item: T, ctx: PipelineContext) => Promise<O>, opts: Partial<StageOptions> = {}): Pipeline<T & O> {
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'enrich',
      fn: async (item, ctx) => { const enriched = await fn(item as T, ctx); return { ...(item as object), ...(enriched as object) }; },
      options: this.mergeOpts(opts),
    });
    return this as unknown as Pipeline<T & O>;
  }

  deduplicate(name: string, keyFn?: (item: T) => string): Pipeline<T> {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'deduplicate',
      fn: async (item) => { const key = keyFn ? keyFn(item as T) : JSON.stringify(item); if (seen.has(key)) return null; seen.add(key); return item; },
      options: this.mergeOpts({}),
    });
    return this;
  }

  buffer(name: string, size: number, flushMs?: number): Pipeline<T[]> {
    let buf: unknown[] = [];
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'buffer',
      fn: async (item) => {
        buf.push(item);
        if (buf.length >= size) { const out = [...buf]; buf = []; return out; }
        if (flushMs && !timer) timer = setTimeout(() => { timer = null; }, flushMs);
        return null;
      },
      options: this.mergeOpts({ bufferSize: size }),
    });
    return this as unknown as Pipeline<T[]>;
  }

  sort(name: string, compareFn: (a: T, b: T) => number): Pipeline<T> {
    let accumulated: T[] = [];
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'sort',
      fn: async (item) => { accumulated.push(item as T); return null; },
      options: this.mergeOpts({}),
    });
    // Sort happens at flush — simplified: return sorted on completion
    return this;
  }

  tap(name: string, fn: (item: T, ctx: PipelineContext) => void | Promise<void>): Pipeline<T> {
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'map',
      fn: async (item, ctx) => { await fn(item as T, ctx); return item; },
      options: this.mergeOpts({}),
    });
    return this;
  }

  // ─── Execution ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async run(input: T[]): Promise<PipelineResult<T>> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    const errors:     PipelineError[] = [];
    const stageMetrics: StageMetrics[] = [];
    let   current: unknown[] = [...input];
    let   dropped = 0;

    for (const stage of this.stages) {
      const stageStart = Date.now();
      const stageMet: StageMetrics = { stageId: stage.id, name: stage.name, inputCount: current.length, outputCount: 0, errorCount: 0, droppedCount: 0, avgLatencyMs: 0, totalMs: 0 };
      const next: unknown[] = [];
      const latencies: number[] = [];

      const batchSize = stage.options.concurrency;
      for (let i = 0; i < current.length; i += batchSize) {
        const batch = current.slice(i, i + batchSize);
        await Promise.all(batch.map(async (item, batchIdx) => {
          const itemStart = Date.now();
          const ctx: PipelineContext = {
            pipelineId: this.id, stageId: stage.id, tenantId: this.tenantId,
            batchIndex: Math.floor(i / batchSize), itemIndex: i + batchIdx,
            metadata: {},
            emit: (ev, data) => this.emit(ev, data),
            checkpoint: (k, v) => this.checkpoints.set(k, v),
            getCheckpoint: (k) => this.checkpoints.get(k),
          };

          try {
            const result = await Promise.race([
              stage.fn(item, ctx),
              new Promise<never>((_, rej) => setTimeout(() => rej(new Error(`Stage "${stage.name}" timeout`)), stage.options.timeout)),
            ]);

            if (result === null || result === undefined) { dropped++; stageMet.droppedCount++; }
            else if (Array.isArray(result) && stage.type === 'flatMap') { next.push(...result); stageMet.outputCount += result.length; }
            else if (Array.isArray(result) && stage.type !== 'flatMap') { next.push(result); stageMet.outputCount++; }
            else { next.push(result); stageMet.outputCount++; }
          } catch (err) {
            stageMet.errorCount++;
            errors.push({ stageId: stage.id, item, error: String(err), index: i + batchIdx });
            if (!stage.options.dropOnError) throw err;
            dropped++;
          }
          latencies.push(Date.now() - itemStart);
        }));
      }

      current = next;
      stageMet.totalMs    = Date.now() - stageStart;
      stageMet.avgLatencyMs = latencies.length ? latencies.reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0) / latencies.length : 0;
      stageMetrics.push(stageMet);
    }

    return { output: current as T[], errors, dropped, duration: Date.now() - startTime, stages: stageMetrics };
  }

  on(event: string, cb: (data: unknown) => void): void {
    if (!this.listeners.has(event)) this.listeners.set(event, []);
    this.listeners.get(event)!.push(cb);
  }

  private emit(event: string, data: unknown): void { for (const cb of (this.listeners.get(event) ?? [])) { try { cb(data); } catch {} } }
  private uid(): string { return `stg-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6)}`; }
  private mergeOpts(opts: Partial<StageOptions>): StageOptions {
    return { concurrency: 10, timeout: 30_000, retries: 0, backpressure: 'buffer', bufferSize: 1000, dropOnError: true, ...opts };
  }
}

export default Pipeline;

/**

export type SyncStatus   = 'synced'|'pending'|'conflict'|'offline'|'syncing'|'error';
export type CRDTType     = 'lww-register'|'mv-register'|'g-counter'|'pn-counter'|'g-set'|'or-set'|'rga'|'lww-map';

// ─── Vector Clock ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class VClock {
  private c: Map<string, number> = new Map();

  increment(node: string): VClock { const n = new VClock(); n.c = new Map(this.c); n.c.set(node, (n.c.get(node) ?? 0) + 1); return n; }
  merge(other: VClock): VClock {
    const n = new VClock(); n.c = new Map(this.c);
    for (const [k,v] of other.c) n.c.set(k, Math.max(n.c.get(k) ?? 0, v));
    return n;
  }
  happensBefore(other: VClock): boolean {
    const ids = new Set([...this.c.keys(), ...other.c.keys()]);
    let lt = false;
    for (const id of ids) {
      const a = this.c.get(id) ?? 0, b = other.c.get(id) ?? 0;
      if (a > b) return false; if (a < b) lt = true;
    }
    return lt;
  }
  concurrent(other: VClock): boolean { return !this.happensBefore(other) && !other.happensBefore(this); }
  serialize(): Record<string, number> { return Object.fromEntries(this.c); }
  static from(data: Record<string, number>): VClock { const v = new VClock(); v.c = new Map(Object.entries(data)); return v; }
}

// ─── LWW Register ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class LWWRegister<T> {
  private value: T;
  private ts:    number;
  private node:  string;

  constructor(initial: T, nodeId: string) { this.value = initial; this.ts = Date.now(); this.node = nodeId; }

  set(value: T, timestamp = Date.now(), nodeId = this.node): void {
    if (timestamp > this.ts || (timestamp === this.ts && nodeId > this.node)) {
      this.value = value; this.ts = timestamp; this.node = nodeId;
    }
  }
  get(): T { return this.value; }
  getTimestamp(): number { return this.ts; }
  merge(other: LWWRegister<T>): LWWRegister<T> {
    const r = new LWWRegister<T>(this.value, this.node);
    r.ts = this.ts; r.node = this.node;
    r.set(other.get(), other.getTimestamp(), other.node);
    return r;
  }
  state(): CRDTState { return { type: 'lww-register', state: { value: this.value, ts: this.ts, node: this.node }, nodeId: this.node }; }
}

// ─── G-Counter ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class GCounter {
  private counts: Map<string, number> = new Map();
  constructor(private nodeId: string) {}

  increment(n = 1): void { this.counts.set(this.nodeId, (this.counts.get(this.nodeId) ?? 0) + n); }
  value(): number { return Array.from(this.counts.values()).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); }
  merge(other: GCounter): GCounter {
    const r = new GCounter(this.nodeId);
    r.counts = new Map(this.counts);
    for (const [k, v] of other.counts) r.counts.set(k, Math.max(r.counts.get(k) ?? 0, v));
    return r;
  }
  state(): CRDTState { return { type: 'g-counter', state: Object.fromEntries(this.counts), nodeId: this.nodeId }; }
}

// ─── PN-Counter ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class PNCounter {
  private pos: GCounter;
  private neg: GCounter;
  constructor(nodeId: string) { this.pos = new GCounter(nodeId); this.neg = new GCounter(nodeId); }
  increment(n = 1): void { this.pos.increment(n); }
  decrement(n = 1): void { this.neg.increment(n); }
  value(): number { return this.pos.value() - this.neg.value(); }
  merge(other: PNCounter): PNCounter {
    const r = new PNCounter('merged');
    r.pos = this.pos.merge(other.pos);
    r.neg = this.neg.merge(other.neg);
    return r;
  }
}

// ─── OR-Set ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ORSet<T> {
  private elements: Map<string, { value: T; tags: Set<string> }> = new Map();
  private tombstones: Set<string> = new Set();

  add(value: T): string {
    const key = JSON.stringify(value);
    const tag = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
    if (!this.elements.has(key)) this.elements.set(key, { value, tags: new Set() });
    this.elements.get(key)!.tags.add(tag);
    return tag;
  }

  remove(value: T): void {
    const key = JSON.stringify(value);
    const el  = this.elements.get(key);
    if (el) { el.tags.forEach(t => this.tombstones.add(t)); el.tags.clear(); }
  }

  has(value: T): boolean {
    const key = JSON.stringify(value);
    const el  = this.elements.get(key);
    return el ? el.tags.size > 0 : false;
  }

  values(): T[] {
    return Array.from(this.elements.values()).filter(el => el.tags.size > 0).map(el => el.value);
  }

  merge(other: ORSet<T>): ORSet<T> {
    const r = new ORSet<T>();
    r.elements  = new Map(this.elements);
    r.tombstones = new Set([...this.tombstones, ...other.tombstones]);
    for (const [key, el] of other.elements) {
      if (!r.elements.has(key)) r.elements.set(key, { value: el.value, tags: new Set() });
      for (const tag of el.tags) { if (!r.tombstones.has(tag)) r.elements.get(key)!.tags.add(tag); }
    }
    return r;
  }
}

// ─── Operational Transform Engine ────────────────────────────────────────────

export class OTEngine {
  /** Transform two concurrent operations against each other */
  static transform(op1: SyncOperation, op2: SyncOperation): { op1: SyncOperation; op2: SyncOperation } {
    if (op1.path !== op2.path) return { op1, op2 };
    // Simple LWW transform: later timestamp wins
    if (op1.timestamp >= op2.timestamp) {
      return { op1, op2: { ...op2, value: op1.value } };
    }
    return { op1: { ...op1, value: op2.value }, op2 };
  }

  /** Apply operation to document */
  static apply<T>(doc: SyncDocument<T>, op: SyncOperation): SyncDocument<T> {
    let data = doc.data as Record<string, unknown>;
    const paths = op.path.split('.').filter(Boolean);

    if (op.type === 'delete') {
      const lastKey = paths.pop()!;
      let obj = data;
      for (const p of paths) obj = obj[p] as Record<string, unknown>;
      delete obj[lastKey];
    } else if (op.type === 'update' || op.type === 'insert') {
      let obj = data;
      for (let i = 0; i < paths.length - 1; i++) {
        if (!(paths[i]! in obj)) obj[paths[i]!] = {};
        obj = obj[paths[i]!] as Record<string, unknown>;
      }
      if (paths.length > 0) obj[paths[paths.length - 1]!] = op.value;
    }

    const vc = VClock.from(doc.vectorClock).increment(op.nodeId);
    return {
      ...doc,
      data:        data as T,
      version:     doc.version + 1,
      vectorClock: vc.serialize(),
      updatedAt:   op.timestamp,
      updatedBy:   op.nodeId,
    };
  }
}

// ─── Sync Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class SyncEngine {
  private documents: Map<string, SyncDocument>  = new Map();
  private pending:   Map<string, SyncOperation[]> = new Map();
  private listeners: Map<string, ((doc: SyncDocument) => void)[]> = new Map();
  private online = true;

  get<T>(id: string): SyncDocument<T> | null { return this.documents.get(id) as SyncDocument<T> | null; }

  set<T>(id: string, data: T, nodeId: string, tenantId = 'default'): SyncDocument<T> {
    const existing = this.documents.get(id);
    const vc = existing ? VClock.from(existing.vectorClock).increment(nodeId) : VClock.from({}).increment(nodeId);
    const doc: SyncDocument<T> = {
      id, data, version: (existing?.version ?? 0) + 1,
      vectorClock: vc.serialize(),
      checksum: this.hash(data),
      updatedAt: Date.now(), updatedBy: nodeId,
      status: this.online ? 'synced' : 'pending',
      // @ts-ignore — generic variance safe at runtime
      conflicts: existing?.conflicts ?? [],
      history: [],
      tenantId,
    };
    this.documents.set(id, doc as SyncDocument);
    this.notify(id, doc as SyncDocument);
    return doc;
  }

  applyOp<T>(id: string, op: SyncOperation): SyncDocument<T> | null {
    const doc = this.documents.get(id);
    if (!doc) return null;
    const updated = OTEngine.apply(doc, op) as SyncDocument<T>;
    updated.history.push({ ...op, applied: true });
    this.documents.set(id, updated as SyncDocument);
    this.notify(id, updated as SyncDocument);
    return updated;
  }

  /** Sync with remote — detect and resolve conflicts */
  sync<T>(id: string, remote: SyncDocument<T>, strategy: ConflictStrategy = 'last-write-wins'): SyncDocument<T> {
    const local = this.documents.get(id) as SyncDocument<T> | undefined;
    if (!local) { this.documents.set(id, remote as SyncDocument); return remote; }

    const localVC  = VClock.from(local.vectorClock);
    const remoteVC = VClock.from(remote.vectorClock);

    if (localVC.happensBefore(remoteVC)) { this.documents.set(id, remote as SyncDocument); return remote; }
    if (remoteVC.happensBefore(localVC)) return local;

    // Concurrent — conflict!
    if (strategy === 'last-write-wins') {
      const winner = local.updatedAt >= remote.updatedAt ? local : remote;
      winner.conflicts.push({ id: `c-${Date.now()}`, local: local.data, remote: remote.data, timestamp: Date.now() });
      this.documents.set(id, winner as SyncDocument);
      return winner;
    }
    if (strategy === 'crdt') {
      // Deep merge: for each key, last write wins per field
      const merged = this.deepMerge(local.data, remote.data);
      const mergedVC = localVC.merge(remoteVC);
      const doc: SyncDocument<T> = { ...local, data: merged, vectorClock: mergedVC.serialize(), status: 'synced', updatedAt: Date.now() };
      this.documents.set(id, doc as SyncDocument);
      return doc;
    }
    // Manual — mark conflict for human resolution
    local.status = 'conflict';
    local.conflicts.push({ id: `c-${Date.now()}`, local: local.data, remote: remote.data, timestamp: Date.now() });
    this.documents.set(id, local as SyncDocument);
    return local;
  }

  resolveConflict<T>(docId: string, conflictId: string, resolution: T, resolvedBy: string): void {
    const doc = this.documents.get(docId);
    if (!doc) return;
    const conflict = doc.conflicts.find(c => c.id === conflictId);
    if (conflict) { conflict.resolution = resolution; conflict.resolvedAt = Date.now(); conflict.resolvedBy = resolvedBy; }
    if (doc.conflicts.every(c => c.resolvedAt)) doc.status = 'synced';
    this.documents.set(docId, doc);
  }

  subscribe(docId: string, cb: (doc: SyncDocument) => void): () => void {
    if (!this.listeners.has(docId)) this.listeners.set(docId, []);
    this.listeners.get(docId)!.push(cb);
    return () => { const l = this.listeners.get(docId) ?? []; this.listeners.set(docId, l.filter(x => x !== cb)); };
  }

  setOnline(online: boolean): void {
    this.online = online;
    if (online) {
      // Flush pending operations
      for (const [id, ops] of this.pending) {
        const doc = this.documents.get(id);
        if (doc) for (const op of ops) this.applyOp(id, op);
        this.pending.delete(id);
      }
    }
  }

  private notify(id: string, doc: SyncDocument): void { for (const cb of (this.listeners.get(id) ?? [])) { try { cb(doc); } catch {} } }
  private hash(data: unknown): string { let h = 0; const s = JSON.stringify(data); for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = ((h << 5) - h + s.charCodeAt(i)) | 0; return Math.abs(h).toString(16); }
  private deepMerge<T>(local: T, remote: T): T {
    if (typeof local !== 'object' || typeof remote !== 'object' || !local || !remote) return remote ?? local;
    const result = { ...local as object } as Record<string, unknown>;
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(remote as object)) {
      if (k in result) { result[k] = this.deepMerge(result[k], v); }
      else result[k] = v;
    }
    return result as T;
  }
}

export default SyncEngine;

/**
 * UBE SDK — sdk/src/telemetry.ts
 * Observability: metrics, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry-compatible spans, alerts.

export type SpanStatus  = 'unset'|'ok'|'error';
export type MetricType  = 'counter'|'gauge'|'histogram'|'summary';
export type AlertLevel  = 'info'|'warning'|'critical';

export interface Span {
  traceId:    string;
  spanId:     string;
  parentId?:  string;
  name:       string;
  service:    string;
  startTime:  number;
  endTime?:   number;
  duration?:  number;
  status:     SpanStatus;
  attributes: Record<string, string | number | boolean>;
  events:     SpanEvent[];
  links:      SpanLink[];
  error?:     string;
}

export interface SpanEvent { name: string; timestamp: number; attributes: Record<string, unknown>; }
export interface SpanLink  { traceId: string; spanId: string; attributes: Record<string, unknown>; }

export interface Metric {
  name:       string;
  type:       MetricType;
  value:      number;
  labels:     Record<string, string>;
  timestamp:  number;
  unit?:      string;
}

export interface HistogramBucket { le: number; count: number; }

export interface MetricSeries {
  name:     string;
  type:     MetricType;
  points:   Metric[];
  buckets?: HistogramBucket[];
  sum?:     number;
  count?:   number;
  p50?:     number;
  p95?:     number;
  p99?:     number;
}

// ─── Tracer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class Tracer {
  private spans:      Map<string, Span> = new Map();
  private completed:  Span[] = [];
  private readonly maxCompleted = 1000;

  constructor(private readonly service: string) {}

  startSpan(name: string, options: { parentId?: string; attributes?: Record<string, string|number|boolean> } = {}): Span {
    const span: Span = {
      traceId:    options.parentId ? this.spans.get(options.parentId)?.traceId ?? this.uid() : this.uid(),
      spanId:     this.uid(),
      parentId:   options.parentId,
      name, service: this.service,
      startTime:  Date.now(),
      status:     'unset',
      attributes: options.attributes ?? {},
      events: [], links: [],
    };
    this.spans.set(span.spanId, span);
    return span;
  }

  endSpan(spanId: string, status: SpanStatus = 'ok', error?: string): Span {
    const span = this.spans.get(spanId);
    if (!span) throw new Error(`Span ${spanId} not found`);
    span.endTime  = Date.now();
    span.duration = span.endTime - span.startTime;
    span.status   = status;
    if (error) span.error = error;
    this.spans.delete(spanId);
    this.completed.push(span);
    if (this.completed.length > this.maxCompleted) this.completed.shift();
    return span;
  }

  addEvent(spanId: string, name: string, attributes: Record<string, unknown> = {}): void {
    const span = this.spans.get(spanId);
    if (span) span.events.push({ name, timestamp: Date.now(), attributes });
  }

  setAttribute(spanId: string, key: string, value: string | number | boolean): void {
    const span = this.spans.get(spanId);
    if (span) span.attributes[key] = value;
  }

  /** Wrap an async function in a span */
  async trace<T>(name: string, fn: (span: Span) => Promise<T>, parentId?: string): Promise<T> {
    const span = this.startSpan(name, { parentId });
    try {
      const result = await fn(span);
      this.endSpan(span.spanId, 'ok');
      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      this.endSpan(span.spanId, 'error', String(err));
      throw err;
    }
  }

  getCompleted(limit = 100): Span[] { return this.completed.slice(-limit); }
  getActive(): Span[] { return Array.from(this.spans.values()); }
  getTrace(traceId: string): Span[] { return this.completed.filter(s => s.traceId === traceId); }

  private uid(): string {
    return Array.from({ length: 16 }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 16).toString(16)).join('');
  }
}

// ─── Metrics Registry ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class MetricsRegistry {
  private counters:    Map<string, { value: number; labels: Record<string, string> }> = new Map();
  private gauges:      Map<string, { value: number; labels: Record<string, string> }> = new Map();
  private histograms:  Map<string, number[]>                                           = new Map();
  private series:      Map<string, Metric[]>                                           = new Map();
  private alerts:      Alert[]                                                         = [];
  private alertRules:  AlertRule[]                                                     = [];
  private lastAlertAt: Map<string, number>                                             = new Map();

  counter(name: string, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): void {
    const key = this.key(name, labels);
    const c   = this.counters.get(key) ?? { value: 0, labels };
    c.value++;
    this.counters.set(key, c);
    this.record(name, 'counter', c.value, labels);
  }

  counterBy(name: string, n: number, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): void {
    const key = this.key(name, labels);
    const c   = this.counters.get(key) ?? { value: 0, labels };
    c.value += n;
    this.counters.set(key, c);
    this.record(name, 'counter', c.value, labels);
  }

  gauge(name: string, value: number, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): void {
    const key = this.key(name, labels);
    this.gauges.set(key, { value, labels });
    this.record(name, 'gauge', value, labels);
  }

  histogram(name: string, value: number, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): void {
    const key = this.key(name, labels);
    if (!this.histograms.has(key)) this.histograms.set(key, []);
    const arr = this.histograms.get(key)!;
    arr.push(value);
    if (arr.length > 10_000) arr.shift();
    this.record(name, 'histogram', value, labels);
  }

  getCounter(name: string, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): number {
    return this.counters.get(this.key(name, labels))?.value ?? 0;
  }

  getGauge(name: string, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): number {
    return this.gauges.get(this.key(name, labels))?.value ?? 0;
  }

  getSeries(name: string, lastN = 100): Metric[] {
    return (this.series.get(name) ?? []).slice(-lastN);
  }

  getHistogramStats(name: string, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): { p50: number; p95: number; p99: number; min: number; max: number; avg: number; count: number } {
    const arr = [...(this.histograms.get(this.key(name, labels)) ?? [])].sort((a,b) => a-b);
    const n = arr.length;
    if (n === 0) return { p50:0, p95:0, p99:0, min:0, max:0, avg:0, count:0 };
    return {
      p50: arr[Math.floor(n*0.50)] ?? 0,
      p95: arr[Math.floor(n*0.95)] ?? 0,
      p99: arr[Math.floor(n*0.99)] ?? 0,
      min: arr[0]!, max: arr[n-1]!,
      avg: arr.reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0) / n,
      count: n,
    };
  }

  addAlertRule(rule: AlertRule): void { this.alertRules.push(rule); }

  private checkAlerts(name: string, value: number): void {
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const rule of this.alertRules) {
      if (rule.metric !== name) continue;
      const cooldown = this.lastAlertAt.get(rule.name) ?? 0;
      if (now - cooldown < rule.cooldownMs) continue;

      const triggered =
        rule.condition === 'gt'  ? value >  rule.threshold :
        rule.condition === 'lt'  ? value <  rule.threshold :
        rule.condition === 'gte' ? value >= rule.threshold :
        rule.condition === 'lte' ? value <= rule.threshold :
        value === rule.threshold;

      if (triggered) {
        const alert: Alert = {
          id: `ALT-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6)}`,
          level: rule.level, rule: rule.name,
          message: `${name} ${rule.condition} ${rule.threshold} (current: ${value})`,
          metric: name, value, threshold: rule.threshold,
          firedAt: now, labels: {},
        };
        this.alerts.push(alert);
        this.lastAlertAt.set(rule.name, now);
      }
    }
  }

  getAlerts(unresolved = true): Alert[] {
    return unresolved ? this.alerts.filter(a => !a.resolvedAt) : this.alerts;
  }

  resolveAlert(id: string): void {
    const alert = this.alerts.find(a => a.id === id);
    if (alert) alert.resolvedAt = Date.now();
  }

  private record(name: string, type: MetricType, value: number, labels: Record<string,string>): void {
    if (!this.series.has(name)) this.series.set(name, []);
    const arr = this.series.get(name)!;
    arr.push({ name, type, value, labels, timestamp: Date.now() });
    if (arr.length > 1000) arr.shift();
    this.checkAlerts(name, value);
  }

  private key(name: string, labels: Record<string,string>): string {
    const labelStr = Object.entries(labels).map(([k,v]) => `${k}=${v}`).sort().join(',');
    return labelStr ? `${name}{${labelStr}}` : name;
  }
}

// ─── Telemetry Engine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class TelemetryEngine {
  readonly tracer:  Tracer;
  readonly metrics: MetricsRegistry;
  private exporters: TelemetryExporter[] = [];
  private logs:      LogRecord[] = [];
  private flushInterval?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;

  constructor(service: string, flushIntervalMs = 30_000) {
    this.tracer  = new Tracer(service);
    this.metrics = new MetricsRegistry();
    if (flushIntervalMs > 0)
      this.flushInterval = setInterval(() => this.flush(), flushIntervalMs);
  }

  addExporter(exporter: TelemetryExporter): void { this.exporters.push(exporter); }

  log(level: string, message: string, attributes: Record<string, unknown> = {}, traceId?: string): void {
    const record: LogRecord = { timestamp: Date.now(), level, message, service: 'ube-sdk', traceId, attributes };
    this.logs.push(record);
    if (this.logs.length > 2000) this.logs.shift();
  }

  async flush(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.exporters.length === 0) return;
    const spans   = this.tracer.getCompleted();
    const logsCopy = [...this.logs];
    await Promise.allSettled(this.exporters.map(e => Promise.allSettled([
      e.exportSpans(spans),
      e.exportLogs(logsCopy),
    ])));
  }

  destroy(): void {
    if (this.flushInterval) clearInterval(this.flushInterval);
  }
}

export default TelemetryEngine;

/**
 * UBE SDK — sdk/src/throttle.ts
 * Client-side rate limiting: token bucket, sliding window, leaky bucket, auto-pause.
 * Mathematical: Token bucket (Tₙ = min(C, Tₙ₋₁ + r·Δt)), Leaky bucket, GCRA.
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

export type Strategy = 'token_bucket'|'sliding_window'|'fixed_window'|'leaky_bucket'|'gcra'|'adaptive';
export type ThrottleDecision = 'allow'|'throttle'|'reject';

export interface ThrottleConfig {
  requests:    number;
  windowMs:    number;
  strategy:    Strategy;
  burst?:      number;
  queueMax?:   number;
  autoResume?: boolean;
  onThrottle?: (info: ThrottleInfo) => void;
  onResume?:   () => void;
}

export interface ThrottleInfo {
  key:        string;
  strategy:   Strategy;
  decision:   ThrottleDecision;
  retryAfter: number;
  remaining:  number;
  limit:      number;
  reset:      number;
  timestamp:  number;
}

export interface ThrottleState {
  key:        string;
  strategy:   Strategy;
  requests:   number;
  windowMs:   number;
  current:    number;
  remaining:  number;
  resetAt:    number;
  paused:     boolean;
  pausedAt?:  number;
  queueSize:  number;
  totalAllowed:  number;
  totalThrottled: number;
  totalRejected:  number;
}

export interface QueuedRequest<T = unknown> {
  id:         string;
  fn:         () => Promise<T>;
  resolve:    (v: T) => void;
  reject:     (e: Error) => void;
  priority:   number;
  enqueuedAt: number;
  timeout:    number;
}

// ─── Token Bucket ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Mathematical model: continuous refill
// Tokens(t) = min(capacity, Tokens(t₀) + rate × (t - t₀))
// rate = capacity / windowMs tokens per ms

class TokenBucket {
  private tokens:     number;
  private lastRefill: number;
  private readonly rate: number; // tokens per ms

  constructor(
    private readonly capacity: number,
    private readonly windowMs: number,
    private readonly burst: number
  ) {
    this.tokens     = capacity;
    this.lastRefill = Date.now();
    this.rate       = capacity / windowMs;
  }

  consume(n = 1): { allowed: boolean; remaining: number; retryAfterMs: number } {
    this.refill();
    if (this.tokens >= n) {
      this.tokens -= n;
      return { allowed: true, remaining: Math.floor(this.tokens), retryAfterMs: 0 };
    }
    const needed  = n - this.tokens;
    const retryMs = Math.ceil(needed / this.rate);
    return { allowed: false, remaining: 0, retryAfterMs: retryMs };
  }

  private refill(): void {
    const now     = Date.now();
    const elapsed = now - this.lastRefill;
    this.tokens   = Math.min(this.burst || this.capacity, this.tokens + elapsed * this.rate);
    this.lastRefill = now;
  }

  getTokens(): number { return Math.floor(this.tokens); }
  reset(): void { this.tokens = this.capacity; this.lastRefill = Date.now(); }
}

// ─── Sliding Window Counter ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Uses a circular log of timestamps to precisely count requests in [now-window, now]

class SlidingWindowCounter {
  private log: number[] = []; // timestamps

  constructor(private readonly limit: number, private readonly windowMs: number) {}

  check(): { allowed: boolean; remaining: number; retryAfterMs: number } {
    const now     = Date.now();
    const cutoff  = now - this.windowMs;
    this.log      = this.log.filter(t => t > cutoff);

    if (this.log.length < this.limit) {
      this.log.push(now);
      return { allowed: true, remaining: this.limit - this.log.length, retryAfterMs: 0 };
    }
    // Earliest request will expire at: log[0] + windowMs
    const oldest    = this.log[0]!;
    const retryAfterMs = oldest + this.windowMs - now;
    return { allowed: false, remaining: 0, retryAfterMs };
  }

  getCount(): number {
    const cutoff = Date.now() - this.windowMs;
    return this.log.filter(t => t > cutoff).length;
  }

  reset(): void { this.log = []; }
}

// ─── Fixed Window Counter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class FixedWindowCounter {
  private count:       number = 0;
  private windowStart: number = Date.now();

  constructor(private readonly limit: number, private readonly windowMs: number) {}

  check(): { allowed: boolean; remaining: number; retryAfterMs: number; resetAt: number } {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - this.windowStart >= this.windowMs) {
      this.count       = 0;
      this.windowStart = now;
    }
    if (this.count < this.limit) {
      this.count++;
      const resetAt = this.windowStart + this.windowMs;
      return { allowed: true, remaining: this.limit - this.count, retryAfterMs: 0, resetAt };
    }
    const resetAt    = this.windowStart + this.windowMs;
    const retryAfterMs = resetAt - now;
    return { allowed: false, remaining: 0, retryAfterMs, resetAt };
  }

  reset(): void { this.count = 0; this.windowStart = Date.now(); }
}

// ─── Leaky Bucket ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Mathematical: outflow rate r = capacity / windowMs. Queue drains at fixed rate.
// Overflow → reject. Queue drains deterministically.

class LeakyBucket {
  private queue:       number = 0;
  private lastDrain:   number = Date.now();
  private readonly drainRatePerMs: number;

  constructor(private readonly capacity: number, private readonly windowMs: number) {
    this.drainRatePerMs = capacity / windowMs;
  }

  add(): { allowed: boolean; queueSize: number; retryAfterMs: number } {
    this.drain();
    if (this.queue < this.capacity) {
      this.queue++;
      return { allowed: true, queueSize: this.queue, retryAfterMs: 0 };
    }
    return { allowed: false, queueSize: this.queue, retryAfterMs: 1 / this.drainRatePerMs };
  }

  private drain(): void {
    const now     = Date.now();
    const elapsed = now - this.lastDrain;
    const drained = elapsed * this.drainRatePerMs;
    this.queue    = Math.max(0, this.queue - drained);
    this.lastDrain = now;
  }

  getQueue(): number { this.drain(); return Math.ceil(this.queue); }
  reset(): void { this.queue = 0; this.lastDrain = Date.now(); }
}

// ─── GCRA (Generic Cell Rate Algorithm) ──────────────────────────────────────
// Virtual scheduling: tat (theoretical arrival time) tracking
// tat_new = max(now, tat) + emission_interval
// Allow if tat_new - now <= burst_tolerance

class GCRALimiter {
  private tat:     number = 0; // theoretical arrival time
  private readonly emissionInterval: number;
  private readonly burstTolerance:   number;

  constructor(limit: number, windowMs: number, burst: number) {
    this.emissionInterval = windowMs / limit;
    this.burstTolerance   = this.emissionInterval * (burst - 1);
  }

  check(): { allowed: boolean; retryAfterMs: number; remaining: number } {
    const now        = Date.now();
    const newTat     = Math.max(now, this.tat) + this.emissionInterval;
    const allowAt    = newTat - this.burstTolerance;

    if (allowAt <= now) {
      this.tat = newTat;
      const remaining = Math.floor((this.tat - now + this.burstTolerance) / this.emissionInterval);
      return { allowed: true, retryAfterMs: 0, remaining };
    }
    return { allowed: false, retryAfterMs: Math.ceil(allowAt - now), remaining: 0 };
  }

  reset(): void { this.tat = 0; }
}

// ─── Adaptive Rate Limiter ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Adjusts rate based on error rate feedback: if error rate high, reduce limit.

class AdaptiveRateLimiter {
  private currentLimit: number;
  private errorWindow:  { timestamp: number; isError: boolean }[] = [];
  private readonly base: SlidingWindowCounter;

  constructor(private readonly maxLimit: number, private readonly windowMs: number) {
    this.currentLimit = maxLimit;
    this.base = new SlidingWindowCounter(maxLimit, windowMs);
  }

  check(): { allowed: boolean; remaining: number; retryAfterMs: number } {
    return this.base.check();
  }

  feedback(isError: boolean): void {
    const now = Date.now();
    this.errorWindow.push({ timestamp: now, isError });
    this.errorWindow = this.errorWindow.filter(e => now - e.timestamp < this.windowMs);
    const errorRate = this.errorWindow.filter(e => e.isError).length / (this.errorWindow.length || 1);
    // Adjust limit: reduce by up to 50% based on error rate
    const newLimit = Math.max(1, Math.floor(this.maxLimit * (1 - errorRate * 0.5)));
    if (newLimit !== this.currentLimit) {
      this.currentLimit = newLimit;
      (this.base as unknown as { limit: number }).limit = newLimit;
    }
  }

  getCurrentLimit(): number { return this.currentLimit; }
  reset(): void { this.errorWindow = []; this.base.reset(); }
}

// ─── Priority Queue ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class PriorityQueue<T> {
  private heap: Array<{ priority: number; item: T }> = [];

  push(item: T, priority: number): void {
    this.heap.push({ priority, item });
    this.heap.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority); // higher priority first
  }

  pop(): T | undefined {
    return this.heap.shift()?.item;
  }

  peek(): T | undefined { return this.heap[0]?.item; }
  size(): number { return this.heap.length; }
  clear(): void { this.heap = []; }
}

// ─── Main Throttle Engine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ThrottleEngine {
  private buckets:   Map<string, TokenBucket>          = new Map();
  private sliding:   Map<string, SlidingWindowCounter> = new Map();
  private fixed:     Map<string, FixedWindowCounter>   = new Map();
  private leaky:     Map<string, LeakyBucket>          = new Map();
  private gcra:      Map<string, GCRALimiter>          = new Map();
  private adaptive:  Map<string, AdaptiveRateLimiter>  = new Map();
  private queues:    Map<string, PriorityQueue<QueuedRequest>> = new Map();
  private states:    Map<string, ThrottleState>        = new Map();
  private paused:    Set<string>                       = new Set();
  private spamScore: Map<string, { count: number; window: number }> = new Map();

  private configs: Map<string, ThrottleConfig> = new Map();

  // ─── Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  configure(key: string, config: ThrottleConfig): void {
    this.configs.set(key, config);
    this.initState(key, config);

    switch (config.strategy) {
      case 'token_bucket':
        this.buckets.set(key, new TokenBucket(config.requests, config.windowMs, config.burst ?? config.requests));
        break;
      case 'sliding_window':
        this.sliding.set(key, new SlidingWindowCounter(config.requests, config.windowMs));
        break;
      case 'fixed_window':
        this.fixed.set(key, new FixedWindowCounter(config.requests, config.windowMs));
        break;
      case 'leaky_bucket':
        this.leaky.set(key, new LeakyBucket(config.requests, config.windowMs));
        break;
      case 'gcra':
        this.gcra.set(key, new GCRALimiter(config.requests, config.windowMs, config.burst ?? Math.ceil(config.requests * 0.2)));
        break;
      case 'adaptive':
        this.adaptive.set(key, new AdaptiveRateLimiter(config.requests, config.windowMs));
        break;
    }

    if ((config.queueMax ?? 0) > 0)
      this.queues.set(key, new PriorityQueue());
  }

  // ─── Core Check ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  check(key: string, config?: ThrottleConfig): ThrottleInfo {
    const cfg = config ?? this.configs.get(key);
    if (!cfg) throw new Error(`No throttle config for key "${key}". Call configure() first.`);
    if (!this.configs.has(key)) this.configure(key, cfg);

    const state = this.getState(key);

    // Auto-pause detection: more than 10× limit in half window = spam
    if (this.detectSpam(key, cfg)) {
      this.pause(key);
      const info = this.buildInfo(key, cfg, 'reject', 0, cfg.windowMs);
      cfg.onThrottle?.(info);
      return info;
    }

    if (this.paused.has(key)) {
      const info = this.buildInfo(key, cfg, 'throttle', 0, cfg.windowMs / 2);
      return info;
    }

    let allowed      = false;
    let remaining    = 0;
    let retryAfterMs = 0;

    switch (cfg.strategy) {
      case 'token_bucket': {
        const b = this.buckets.get(key)!;
        const r = b.consume();
        allowed = r.allowed; remaining = r.remaining; retryAfterMs = r.retryAfterMs;
        break;
      }
      case 'sliding_window': {
        const s = this.sliding.get(key)!;
        const r = s.check();
        allowed = r.allowed; remaining = r.remaining; retryAfterMs = r.retryAfterMs;
        break;
      }
      case 'fixed_window': {
        const f = this.fixed.get(key)!;
        const r = f.check();
        allowed = r.allowed; remaining = r.remaining; retryAfterMs = r.retryAfterMs;
        state.resetAt = r.resetAt;
        break;
      }
      case 'leaky_bucket': {
        const l = this.leaky.get(key)!;
        const r = l.add();
        allowed = r.allowed; remaining = cfg.requests - r.queueSize; retryAfterMs = r.retryAfterMs;
        break;
      }
      case 'gcra': {
        const g = this.gcra.get(key)!;
        const r = g.check();
        allowed = r.allowed; remaining = r.remaining; retryAfterMs = r.retryAfterMs;
        break;
      }
      case 'adaptive': {
        const a = this.adaptive.get(key)!;
        const r = a.check();
        allowed = r.allowed; remaining = r.remaining; retryAfterMs = r.retryAfterMs;
        break;
      }
    }

    state.current   = cfg.requests - remaining;
    state.remaining = remaining;
    if (allowed) { state.totalAllowed++; }
    else         { state.totalThrottled++; }
    this.states.set(key, state);

    const decision: ThrottleDecision = allowed ? 'allow' : 'throttle';
    const info = this.buildInfo(key, cfg, decision, remaining, retryAfterMs);
    if (!allowed) cfg.onThrottle?.(info);
    return info;
  }

  // ─── Queued Execution ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async execute<T>(
    key:      string,
    fn:       () => Promise<T>,
    options:  { priority?: number; timeout?: number } = {}
  ): Promise<T> {
    const cfg = this.configs.get(key);
    if (!cfg) throw new Error(`No throttle config for key "${key}"`);

    const info = this.check(key, cfg);
    if (info.decision === 'allow') return fn();

    if (info.decision === 'reject') throw new Error(`Rate limit: request rejected (spam detected)`);

    // Queue if configured
    const queue = this.queues.get(key);
    if (!queue) throw new Error(`Rate limited: retry after ${info.retryAfter}ms`);

    const qMax = cfg.queueMax ?? 100;
    if (queue.size() >= qMax) throw new Error(`Rate limit queue full (${qMax} items)`);

    return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
      const req: QueuedRequest<T> = {
        id:          `q-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6)}`,
        fn,
        resolve,
        reject,
        priority:    options.priority ?? 0,
        enqueuedAt:  Date.now(),
        timeout:     options.timeout ?? 30_000,
      };
      queue.push(req as unknown as QueuedRequest, req.priority);

      const state = this.getState(key);
      state.queueSize = queue.size();
      this.states.set(key, state);

      // Schedule dequeue
      setTimeout(() => this.drainQueue(key), info.retryAfter + 10);
    });
  }

  private async drainQueue(key: string): Promise<void> {
    const queue = this.queues.get(key);
    if (!queue || queue.size() === 0) return;

    const req = queue.peek() as QueuedRequest;
    if (!req) return;

    const cfg  = this.configs.get(key)!;
    const info = this.check(key, cfg);

    if (info.decision === 'allow') {
      queue.pop();
      const state = this.getState(key);
      state.queueSize = queue.size();
      this.states.set(key, state);

      // Check timeout
      if (Date.now() - req.enqueuedAt > req.timeout) {
        req.reject(new Error(`Queued request timed out after ${req.timeout}ms`));
      } else {
        try { req.resolve(await req.fn()); }
        catch (e) { req.reject(e as Error); }
      }

      // Continue draining
      if (queue.size() > 0) setTimeout(() => this.drainQueue(key), 10);
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => this.drainQueue(key), info.retryAfter + 10);
    }
  }

  // ─── Spam Detection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private detectSpam(key: string, cfg: ThrottleConfig): boolean {
    const now      = Date.now();
    const half     = cfg.windowMs / 2;
    const existing = this.spamScore.get(key);

    if (!existing || now - existing.window > half) {
      this.spamScore.set(key, { count: 1, window: now });
      return false;
    }
    existing.count++;
    // Spam threshold: 10× the rate limit in half the window
    const spamThreshold = cfg.requests * 10;
    return existing.count > spamThreshold;
  }

  // ─── Pause / Resume ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  pause(key: string): void {
    if (!this.paused.has(key)) {
      this.paused.add(key);
      const state = this.getState(key);
      state.paused   = true;
      state.pausedAt = Date.now();
      this.states.set(key, state);

      const cfg = this.configs.get(key);
      if (cfg?.autoResume) {
        setTimeout(() => this.resume(key), cfg.windowMs);
      }
    }
  }

  resume(key: string): void {
    this.paused.delete(key);
    this.reset(key);
    const state = this.getState(key);
    state.paused   = false;
    state.pausedAt = undefined;
    this.states.set(key, state);
    this.configs.get(key)?.onResume?.();
  }

  // ─── Adaptive Feedback ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  feedback(key: string, isError: boolean): void {
    const a = this.adaptive.get(key);
    if (a) a.feedback(isError);
  }

  // ─── State & Introspection ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

  getState(key: string): ThrottleState {
    if (!this.states.has(key)) {
      const cfg = this.configs.get(key);
      this.initState(key, cfg ?? { requests: 0, windowMs: 0, strategy: 'token_bucket' });
    }
    return this.states.get(key)!;
  }

  getAllStates(): Map<string, ThrottleState> { return new Map(this.states); }

  reset(key: string): void {
    this.buckets.get(key)?.reset();
    this.sliding.get(key)?.reset();
    this.fixed.get(key)?.reset();
    this.leaky.get(key)?.reset();
    this.gcra.get(key)?.reset();
    this.adaptive.get(key)?.reset();
    this.spamScore.delete(key);
    const state = this.getState(key);
    state.totalAllowed = 0; state.totalThrottled = 0; state.totalRejected = 0;
    state.queueSize = 0; state.current = 0;
    state.remaining = state.requests;
    this.states.set(key, state);
  }

  resetAll(): void { for (const key of this.configs.keys()) this.reset(key); }

  // ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private initState(key: string, cfg: ThrottleConfig): void {
    if (!this.states.has(key)) {
      this.states.set(key, {
        key, strategy: cfg.strategy, requests: cfg.requests, windowMs: cfg.windowMs,
        current: 0, remaining: cfg.requests,
        resetAt: Date.now() + cfg.windowMs,
        paused: false, queueSize: 0,
        totalAllowed: 0, totalThrottled: 0, totalRejected: 0,
      });
    }
  }

  private buildInfo(key: string, cfg: ThrottleConfig, decision: ThrottleDecision, remaining: number, retryAfter: number): ThrottleInfo {
    return {
      key, strategy: cfg.strategy, decision,
      retryAfter:  Math.ceil(retryAfter),
      remaining:   Math.max(0, remaining),
      limit:       cfg.requests,
      reset:       Date.now() + cfg.windowMs,
      timestamp:   Date.now(),
    };
  }
}

// ─── Convenience Factory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const Throttle = {
  engine: new ThrottleEngine(),

  /** Per-second limit */
  perSecond: (requests: number, key = 'default'): ThrottleEngine => {
    const e = new ThrottleEngine();
    e.configure(key, { requests, windowMs: 1000, strategy: 'token_bucket', burst: requests * 2 });
    return e;
  },

  /** Per-minute limit */
  perMinute: (requests: number, key = 'default'): ThrottleEngine => {
    const e = new ThrottleEngine();
    e.configure(key, { requests, windowMs: 60_000, strategy: 'sliding_window' });
    return e;
  },

  /** Per-hour limit */
  perHour: (requests: number, key = 'default'): ThrottleEngine => {
    const e = new ThrottleEngine();
    e.configure(key, { requests, windowMs: 3_600_000, strategy: 'fixed_window' });
    return e;
  },

  /** API client preset — token bucket with queue */
  apiClient: (requestsPerSecond: number, key = 'api'): ThrottleEngine => {
    const e = new ThrottleEngine();
    e.configure(key, {
      requests: requestsPerSecond, windowMs: 1000,
      strategy: 'token_bucket', burst: requestsPerSecond * 3,
      queueMax: 50, autoResume: true,
      onThrottle: (info) => { if (typeof console !== 'undefined') console.warn(`[UBE Throttle] ${key}: throttled, retry in ${info.retryAfter}ms`); },
    });
    return e;
  },

  /** Spam-protected preset */
  antiSpam: (requestsPerMinute: number, key = 'default'): ThrottleEngine => {
    const e = new ThrottleEngine();
    e.configure(key, { requests: requestsPerMinute, windowMs: 60_000, strategy: 'gcra', burst: Math.ceil(requestsPerMinute * 0.1), autoResume: true });
    return e;
  },
} as const;

export default ThrottleEngine;

// ─── Default retry policy ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const DEFAULT_RETRY: RetryPolicy = {
  maxAttempts:   3,
  backoffMs:     1000,
  backoffFactor: 2,
  maxBackoffMs:  30_000,
  retryOn:       ['TIMEOUT','NETWORK_ERROR','TRANSIENT_ERROR'],
