// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// NODE IDENTITY
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface NodeKeypair {
  publicKey: Buffer;       // 32-byte Ed25519 public key
  privateKey: Buffer;      // 64-byte Ed25519 private key (includes public)
}

export interface NodeIdentityDoc {
  nodeId: string;          // hex-encoded 20-byte ID
  publicKey: string;       // hex-encoded public key
  did: string;             // did:ube:<nodeId>
  createdAt: number;       // Unix timestamp
  capabilities: NodeCapability[];
  networkMagic: string;    // Network identifier (prevents cross-network attacks)
  signature: string;       // Self-signed identity document
}

export class NodeIdentity {
  public readonly nodeId: NodeId;
  public readonly keypair: NodeKeypair;
  public readonly did: string;
  private readonly capabilities: Set<NodeCapability>;

  constructor(keypair: NodeKeypair, capabilities: NodeCapability[] = []) {
    this.keypair = keypair;
    this.nodeId = NodeIdentity.deriveNodeId(keypair.publicKey);
    this.did = `did:ube:${this.nodeId.toString('hex')}`;
    this.capabilities = new Set(capabilities);
  }

  static generate(capabilities: NodeCapability[] = []): NodeIdentity {
    const { privateKey, publicKey } = crypto.generateKeyPairSync('ed25519', {
      privateKeyEncoding: { type: 'pkcs8', format: 'der' },
      publicKeyEncoding: { type: 'spki', format: 'der' },
    });

    // Extract raw 32-byte keys from DER wrappers
    const rawPublic = publicKey.slice(-32);
    const rawPrivate = Buffer.concat([privateKey.slice(-32), rawPublic]);

    return new NodeIdentity({ publicKey: rawPublic, privateKey: rawPrivate }, capabilities);
  }

  static fromSerialized(data: Buffer): NodeIdentity {
    const obj = JSON.parse(data.toString('utf8'));
    const keypair: NodeKeypair = {
      publicKey: Buffer.from(obj.publicKey, 'hex'),
      privateKey: Buffer.from(obj.privateKey, 'hex'),
    };
    return new NodeIdentity(keypair, obj.capabilities || []);
  }

  static deriveNodeId(publicKey: Buffer): NodeId {
    return crypto.createHash('sha1').update(publicKey).digest();
  }

  serialize(): Buffer {
    return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
      publicKey: this.keypair.publicKey.toString('hex'),
      privateKey: this.keypair.privateKey.toString('hex'),
      capabilities: Array.from(this.capabilities),
    }));
  }

  exportPublicDoc(): NodeIdentityDoc {
    const doc = {
      nodeId: this.nodeId.toString('hex'),
      publicKey: this.keypair.publicKey.toString('hex'),
      did: this.did,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      capabilities: Array.from(this.capabilities),
      networkMagic: NETWORK_MAGIC.toString('hex'),
      signature: '',
    };
    doc.signature = this.sign(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ ...doc, signature: '' }))).toString('hex');
    return doc;
  }

  sign(message: Buffer): Buffer {
    const key = crypto.createPrivateKey({
      key: Buffer.concat([Buffer.from('302e020100300506032b657004220420', 'hex'), this.keypair.privateKey.slice(0, 32)]),
      format: 'der',
      type: 'pkcs8',
    });
    return crypto.sign(null, message, key);
  }

  verify(message: Buffer, signature: Buffer, publicKey?: Buffer): boolean {
    try {
      const pubKeyBuffer = publicKey ?? this.keypair.publicKey;
      const key = crypto.createPublicKey({
        key: Buffer.concat([Buffer.from('302a300506032b6570032100', 'hex'), pubKeyBuffer]),
        format: 'der',
        type: 'spki',
      });
      return crypto.verify(null, message, key, signature);
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  hasCapability(cap: NodeCapability): boolean {
    return this.capabilities.has(cap);
  }

  addCapability(cap: NodeCapability): void {
    this.capabilities.add(cap);
  }

  getCapabilities(): NodeCapability[] {
    return Array.from(this.capabilities);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// PEER RECORD
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface TransportAddress {
  type: TransportType;
  host: string;
  port: number;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>; // LoRa channel, satellite beam, etc.
}

export interface PeerRecord {
  nodeId: NodeId;
  publicKey: Buffer;
  did: string;
  addresses: TransportAddress[];
  capabilities: NodeCapability[];
  lastSeen: number;         // Unix ms
  latencyMs: number;        // EWMA latency
  rttSamples: number[];     // Last 8 RTT samples
  failureCount: number;
  verified: boolean;        // Identity signature verified
  reachable: boolean;
}

export class PeerRecordManager {
  private records: Map<string, PeerRecord> = new Map(); // nodeId hex -> PeerRecord
  private readonly maxRecords: number;

  constructor(maxRecords = 10_000) {
    this.maxRecords = maxRecords;
  }

  upsert(record: PeerRecord): void {
    const key = record.nodeId.toString('hex');
    const existing = this.records.get(key);
    if (existing) {
      existing.lastSeen = record.lastSeen;
      existing.addresses = this.mergeAddresses(existing.addresses, record.addresses);
      existing.capabilities = record.capabilities;
      existing.reachable = record.reachable;
      if (record.latencyMs > 0) {
        this.updateLatency(existing, record.latencyMs);
      }
    } else {
      if (this.records.size >= this.maxRecords) {
        this.evictOldest();
      }
      this.records.set(key, { ...record, rttSamples: record.latencyMs > 0 ? [record.latencyMs] : [] });
    }
  }

  get(nodeId: NodeId): PeerRecord | undefined {
    return this.records.get(nodeId.toString('hex'));
  }

  has(nodeId: NodeId): boolean {
    return this.records.has(nodeId.toString('hex'));
  }

  remove(nodeId: NodeId): void {
    this.records.delete(nodeId.toString('hex'));
  }

  all(): PeerRecord[] {
    return Array.from(this.records.values());
  }

  reachable(): PeerRecord[] {
    return this.all().filter(p => p.reachable && Date.now() - p.lastSeen < PEER_TIMEOUT_MS);
  }

  byCapability(cap: NodeCapability): PeerRecord[] {
    return this.reachable().filter(p => p.capabilities.includes(cap));
  }

  closest(targetId: NodeId, count: number): PeerRecord[] {
    return this.all()
      .map(p => ({ peer: p, distance: xorDistance(p.nodeId, targetId) }))
      .sort((a, b) => compareBuffers(a.distance, b.distance))
      .slice(0, count)
      .map(x => x.peer);
  }

  private updateLatency(record: PeerRecord, sample: number): void {
    record.rttSamples.push(sample);
    if (record.rttSamples.length > 8) record.rttSamples.shift();
    // EWMA with alpha=0.25
    record.latencyMs = record.rttSamples.reduce((acc, v, i) => {
      const alpha = 0.25;
      return i === 0 ? v : acc * (1 - alpha) + v * alpha;
    }, 0);
  }

  private mergeAddresses(existing: TransportAddress[], incoming: TransportAddress[]): TransportAddress[] {
    const map = new Map(existing.map(a => [`${a.type}:${a.host}:${a.port}`, a]));
    for (const addr of incoming) {
      map.set(`${addr.type}:${addr.host}:${addr.port}`, addr);
    }
    return Array.from(map.values());
  }

  private evictOldest(): void {
    let oldestKey = '';
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, record] of this.records) {
      if (record.lastSeen < oldestTime) {
        oldestTime = record.lastSeen;
        oldestKey = key;
      }
    }
    if (oldestKey) this.records.delete(oldestKey);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// KADEMLIA DHT ROUTING TABLE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

function xorDistance(a: NodeId, b: NodeId): Buffer {
  const result = Buffer.allocUnsafe(Math.min(a.length, b.length));
  for (let i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
    result[i] = a[i] ^ b[i];
  }
  return result;
}

function compareBuffers(a: Buffer, b: Buffer): number {
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(a.length, b.length); i++) {
    if (a[i] !== b[i]) return a[i] - b[i];
  }
  return a.length - b.length;
}

function commonPrefixLength(a: NodeId, b: NodeId): number {
  let bits = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(a.length, b.length); i++) {
    const xor = a[i] ^ b[i];
    if (xor === 0) {
      bits += 8;
    } else {
      // Count leading zeros in xor byte
      let mask = 0x80;
      while (mask > 0 && (xor & mask) === 0) {
        bits++;
        mask >>= 1;
      }
      break;
    }
  }
  return bits;
}

interface KBucket {
  peers: PeerRecord[];
  lastChanged: number;
  replacementCache: PeerRecord[];
}

export class KademliaTable {
  private readonly localId: NodeId;
  private readonly buckets: KBucket[];

  constructor(localId: NodeId) {
    this.localId = localId;
    this.buckets = Array.from({ length: KADEMLIA_BUCKET_COUNT }, () => ({
      peers: [],
      lastChanged: Date.now(),
      replacementCache: [],
    }));
  }

  insert(peer: PeerRecord): 'inserted' | 'updated' | 'bucket_full' | 'self' {
    if (peer.nodeId.equals(this.localId)) return 'self';

    const bucketIdx = this.bucketIndex(peer.nodeId);
    const bucket = this.buckets[bucketIdx];

    // Check if already exists
    const existingIdx = bucket.peers.findIndex(p => p.nodeId.equals(peer.nodeId));
    if (existingIdx >= 0) {
      // Move to tail (most recently seen)
      bucket.peers.splice(existingIdx, 1);
      bucket.peers.push(peer);
      bucket.lastChanged = Date.now();
      return 'updated';
    }

    if (bucket.peers.length < KADEMLIA_K) {
      bucket.peers.push(peer);
      bucket.lastChanged = Date.now();
      return 'inserted';
    }

    // Bucket full: add to replacement cache
    const cacheIdx = bucket.replacementCache.findIndex(p => p.nodeId.equals(peer.nodeId));
    if (cacheIdx < 0) {
      bucket.replacementCache.push(peer);
      if (bucket.replacementCache.length > KADEMLIA_K) {
        bucket.replacementCache.shift(); // Evict oldest replacement
      }
    }
    return 'bucket_full';
  }

  remove(nodeId: NodeId): void {
    const bucketIdx = this.bucketIndex(nodeId);
    const bucket = this.buckets[bucketIdx];
    const idx = bucket.peers.findIndex(p => p.nodeId.equals(nodeId));
    if (idx >= 0) {
      bucket.peers.splice(idx, 1);
      // Promote from replacement cache if available
      if (bucket.replacementCache.length > 0) {
        const promoted = bucket.replacementCache.shift()!;
        bucket.peers.push(promoted);
      }
      bucket.lastChanged = Date.now();
    }
  }

  findClosest(targetId: NodeId, count: number = KADEMLIA_K): PeerRecord[] {
    const allPeers: Array<{ peer: PeerRecord; distance: Buffer }> = [];
    for (const bucket of this.buckets) {
      for (const peer of bucket.peers) {
        allPeers.push({ peer, distance: xorDistance(peer.nodeId, targetId) });
      }
    }
    allPeers.sort((a, b) => compareBuffers(a.distance, b.distance));
    return allPeers.slice(0, count).map(x => x.peer);
  }

  allPeers(): PeerRecord[] {
    return this.buckets.flatMap(b => b.peers);
  }

  size(): number {
    return this.buckets.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.peers.length, 0);
  }

  staleBuckets(maxAgeMs: number = 3_600_000): number[] {
    return this.buckets
      .map((b, i) => ({ b, i }))
      .filter(({ b }) => b.peers.length > 0 && Date.now() - b.lastChanged > maxAgeMs)
      .map(({ i }) => i);
  }

  // Get a random node from a specific bucket for refresh
  refreshTarget(bucketIdx: number): NodeId {
    // Generate a random ID in the subtree of this bucket
    const result = Buffer.from(this.localId);
    // Flip the bit at position bucketIdx
    const byteIdx = Math.floor(bucketIdx / 8);
    const bitIdx = 7 - (bucketIdx % 8);
    result[byteIdx] ^= (1 << bitIdx);
    // Randomize remaining bits
    for (let i = byteIdx; i < result.length; i++) {
      result[i] = i === byteIdx ? result[i] : Math.floor(Math.random() * 256);
    }
    return result;
  }

  private bucketIndex(nodeId: NodeId): number {
    const prefixLen = commonPrefixLength(this.localId, nodeId);
    return Math.min(prefixLen, KADEMLIA_BUCKET_COUNT - 1);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// MESH MESSAGE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface MeshMessage {
  id: string;             // UUID v4
  type: MessageType;
  version: string;
  senderId: string;       // hex nodeId
  senderPublicKey: string;
  recipientId?: string;   // hex nodeId, undefined = broadcast
  timestamp: number;
  ttl: number;
  hopCount: number;
  payload: Buffer;
  signature: string;      // hex Ed25519 signature over message minus signature field
  nonce: string;          // hex random nonce for replay prevention
}

export interface MessageEnvelope {
  message: MeshMessage;
  receivedAt: number;
  receivedFrom: string;   // hex nodeId
  transport: TransportType;
}

function serializeMessageForSigning(msg: Omit<MeshMessage, 'signature'>): Buffer {
  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
    id: msg.id,
    type: msg.type,
    version: msg.version,
    senderId: msg.senderId,
    senderPublicKey: msg.senderPublicKey,
    recipientId: msg.recipientId,
    timestamp: msg.timestamp,
    ttl: msg.ttl,
    hopCount: msg.hopCount,
    payload: msg.payload.toString('base64'),
    nonce: msg.nonce,
  }));
}

export function createMessage(
  type: MessageType,
  identity: NodeIdentity,
  payload: Buffer,
  recipientId?: string,
  ttl: number = GOSSIP_TTL,
): MeshMessage {
  const partial = {
    id: crypto.randomUUID(),
    type,
    version: PROTOCOL_VERSION,
    senderId: identity.nodeId.toString('hex'),
    senderPublicKey: identity.keypair.publicKey.toString('hex'),
    recipientId,
    timestamp: Date.now(),
    ttl,
    hopCount: 0,
    payload,
    nonce: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
  };
  const sigData = serializeMessageForSigning(partial);
  const signature = identity.sign(sigData).toString('hex');
  return { ...partial, signature };
}

export function verifyMessage(msg: MeshMessage): boolean {
  try {
    if (Date.now() - msg.timestamp > MESSAGE_DEDUP_WINDOW_MS * 2) return false;
    const publicKey = Buffer.from(msg.senderPublicKey, 'hex');
    const sigData = serializeMessageForSigning({ ...msg });
    const signature = Buffer.from(msg.signature, 'hex');
    const key = crypto.createPublicKey({
      key: Buffer.concat([Buffer.from('302a300506032b6570032100', 'hex'), publicKey]),
      format: 'der',
      type: 'spki',
    });
    return crypto.verify(null, sigData, key, signature);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// TRANSPORT ABSTRACTION
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface TransportSendResult {
  success: boolean;
  latencyMs?: number;
  error?: string;
}

export interface ITransport extends EventEmitter {
  readonly type: TransportType;
  start(): Promise<void>;
  stop(): Promise<void>;
  send(target: TransportAddress, data: Buffer): Promise<TransportSendResult>;
  localAddresses(): TransportAddress[];
}

export class TCPTransport extends EventEmitter implements ITransport {
  readonly type: TransportType = 'tcp';
  private server: net.Server | null = null;
  private readonly port: number;
  private readonly host: string;
  private connections: Map<string, net.Socket> = new Map();

  constructor(port: number, host: string = '0.0.0.0') {
    super();
    this.port = port;
    this.host = host;
  }

  async start(): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.server = net.createServer(socket => {
        const key = `${socket.remoteAddress}:${socket.remotePort}`;
        this.connections.set(key, socket);

        let buffer = Buffer.alloc(0);
        socket.on('data', chunk => {
          buffer = Buffer.concat([buffer, chunk]);
          // Frame protocol: 4-byte length prefix
          while (buffer.length >= 4) {
            const msgLen = buffer.readUInt32BE(0);
            if (buffer.length < 4 + msgLen) break;
            const payload = buffer.slice(4, 4 + msgLen);
            buffer = buffer.slice(4 + msgLen);
            this.emit('data', payload, { type: 'tcp', host: socket.remoteAddress ?? '', port: socket.remotePort ?? 0 });
          }
        });

        socket.on('close', () => this.connections.delete(key));
        socket.on('error', () => {
          this.connections.delete(key);
          socket.destroy();
        });
      });

      this.server.listen(this.port, this.host, () => resolve());
      this.server.once('error', reject);
    });
  }

  async stop(): Promise<void> {
    for (const socket of this.connections.values()) socket.destroy();
    this.connections.clear();
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      if (this.server) this.server.close(() => resolve());
      else resolve();
    });
  }

  async send(target: TransportAddress, data: Buffer): Promise<TransportSendResult> {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      const start = Date.now();
      const socket = new net.Socket();
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        socket.destroy();
        resolve({ success: false, error: 'TCP connect timeout' });
      }, 5_000);

      socket.connect(target.port, target.host, () => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        const frame = Buffer.allocUnsafe(4 + data.length);
        frame.writeUInt32BE(data.length, 0);
        data.copy(frame, 4);
        socket.write(frame, err => {
          socket.end();
          if (err) resolve({ success: false, error: err.message });
          else resolve({ success: true, latencyMs: Date.now() - start });
        });
      });

      socket.once('error', err => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        resolve({ success: false, error: err.message });
      });
    });
  }

  localAddresses(): TransportAddress[] {
    const interfaces = os.networkInterfaces();
    const addrs: TransportAddress[] = [];
    for (const iface of Object.values(interfaces)) {
      if (!iface) continue;
      for (const info of iface) {
        if (info.internal) continue;
        addrs.push({ type: 'tcp', host: info.address, port: this.port });
      }
    }
    return addrs;
  }
}

export class UDPTransport extends EventEmitter implements ITransport {
  readonly type: TransportType = 'udp';
  private socket: dgram.Socket | null = null;
  private readonly port: number;

  constructor(port: number) {
    super();
    this.port = port;
  }

  async start(): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.socket = dgram.createSocket('udp4');
      this.socket.on('message', (msg, rinfo) => {
        this.emit('data', msg, { type: 'udp', host: rinfo.address, port: rinfo.port });
      });
      this.socket.bind(this.port, () => resolve());
      this.socket.once('error', reject);
    });
  }

  async stop(): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      if (this.socket) this.socket.close(() => resolve());
      else resolve();
    });
  }

  async send(target: TransportAddress, data: Buffer): Promise<TransportSendResult> {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      if (!this.socket) return resolve({ success: false, error: 'UDP socket not started' });
      const start = Date.now();
      this.socket.send(data, target.port, target.host, err => {
        if (err) resolve({ success: false, error: err.message });
        else resolve({ success: true, latencyMs: Date.now() - start });
      });
    });
  }

  localAddresses(): TransportAddress[] {
    const interfaces = os.networkInterfaces();
    const addrs: TransportAddress[] = [];
    for (const iface of Object.values(interfaces)) {
      if (!iface) continue;
      for (const info of iface) {
        if (info.internal) continue;
        addrs.push({ type: 'udp', host: info.address, port: this.port });
      }
    }
    return addrs;
  }
}

export class TransportManager extends EventEmitter {
  private transports: Map<TransportType, ITransport> = new Map();
  private readonly preferenceOrder: TransportType[] = ['tcp', 'udp', 'lora', 'satellite'];

  register(transport: ITransport): void {
    this.transports.set(transport.type, transport);
    transport.on('data', (data: Buffer, source: TransportAddress) => {
      this.emit('data', data, source, transport.type);
    });
  }

  async startAll(): Promise<void> {
    await Promise.all(Array.from(this.transports.values()).map(t => t.start()));
  }

  async stopAll(): Promise<void> {
    await Promise.all(Array.from(this.transports.values()).map(t => t.stop()));
  }

  async send(target: TransportAddress, data: Buffer): Promise<TransportSendResult> {
    const transport = this.transports.get(target.type);
    if (!transport) return { success: false, error: `No transport registered for ${target.type}` };
    if (data.length > MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE_BYTES) {
      return { success: false, error: `Message size ${data.length} exceeds maximum ${MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE_BYTES}` };
    }
    return transport.send(target, data);
  }

  async sendBestEffort(peer: PeerRecord, data: Buffer): Promise<TransportSendResult> {
    // Try transports in preference order, return first success
    for (const type of this.preferenceOrder) {
      const addr = peer.addresses.find(a => a.type === type);
      if (!addr) continue;
      const result = await this.send(addr, data);
      if (result.success) return result;
    }
    return { success: false, error: 'All transports failed' };
  }

  allLocalAddresses(): TransportAddress[] {
    return Array.from(this.transports.values()).flatMap(t => t.localAddresses());
  }

  availableTypes(): TransportType[] {
    return Array.from(this.transports.keys());
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// GOSSIP PROTOCOL
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface GossipMessage {
  id: string;
  payload: Buffer;
  originId: string;
  topic: string;
  timestamp: number;
  ttl: number;
}

export class GossipProtocol extends EventEmitter {
  private seen: Map<string, number> = new Map(); // messageId -> timestamp
  private readonly fanout: number;

  constructor(fanout: number = GOSSIP_FANOUT) {
    super();
    this.fanout = fanout;
  }

  shouldForward(msgId: string): boolean {
    const now = Date.now();
    // Sweep expired entries
    for (const [id, ts] of this.seen) {
      if (now - ts > MESSAGE_DEDUP_WINDOW_MS) this.seen.delete(id);
    }
    if (this.seen.has(msgId)) return false;
    this.seen.set(msgId, now);
    return true;
  }

  selectForwardPeers(peers: PeerRecord[], exclude?: string): PeerRecord[] {
    const candidates = peers.filter(p => p.nodeId.toString('hex') !== exclude);
    // Fisher-Yates shuffle then take fanout
    for (let i = candidates.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [candidates[i], candidates[j]] = [candidates[j], candidates[i]];
    }
    return candidates.slice(0, this.fanout);
  }

  // Anti-entropy: periodically sync state digests with a random peer
  computeStateDigest(keys: string[]): Buffer {
    const sorted = [...keys].sort();
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(sorted.join('\n')).digest();
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// MESSAGE DEDUPLICATION
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class MessageDeduplicator {
  private seen: Map<string, number> = new Map(); // msgId -> expiry
  private readonly windowMs: number;

  constructor(windowMs: number = MESSAGE_DEDUP_WINDOW_MS) {
    this.windowMs = windowMs;
  }

  isDuplicate(msgId: string): boolean {
    const now = Date.now();
    this.sweep(now);
    if (this.seen.has(msgId)) return true;
    this.seen.set(msgId, now + this.windowMs);
    return false;
  }

  private sweep(now: number): void {
    for (const [id, expiry] of this.seen) {
      if (now > expiry) this.seen.delete(id);
    }
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// STORE AND FORWARD — for offline peers
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface StoredMessage {
  envelope: MessageEnvelope;
  storedAt: number;
  expiresAt: number;
  deliveryAttempts: number;
}

export class StoreAndForwardEngine {
  private store: Map<string, StoredMessage[]> = new Map(); // recipientId -> messages
  private readonly ttlHours: number;
  private readonly maxMessagesPerPeer: number;

  constructor(ttlHours: number = STORE_FORWARD_TTL_HOURS, maxMessagesPerPeer: number = 100) {
    this.ttlHours = ttlHours;
    this.maxMessagesPerPeer = maxMessagesPerPeer;
  }

  enqueue(envelope: MessageEnvelope): void {
    const recipientId = envelope.message.recipientId;
    if (!recipientId) return; // Don't store broadcasts

    if (!this.store.has(recipientId)) {
      this.store.set(recipientId, []);
    }

    const queue = this.store.get(recipientId)!;

    if (queue.length >= this.maxMessagesPerPeer) {
      queue.shift(); // Evict oldest
    }

    queue.push({
      envelope,
      storedAt: Date.now(),
      expiresAt: Date.now() + this.ttlHours * 3_600_000,
      deliveryAttempts: 0,
    });
  }

  drain(recipientId: string): StoredMessage[] {
    const now = Date.now();
    const messages = this.store.get(recipientId) ?? [];
    const valid = messages.filter(m => m.expiresAt > now);
    this.store.delete(recipientId);
    return valid;
  }

  pending(recipientId: string): number {
    return (this.store.get(recipientId) ?? []).length;
  }

  sweep(): number {
    const now = Date.now();
    let removed = 0;
    for (const [id, messages] of this.store) {
      const valid = messages.filter(m => m.expiresAt > now);
      removed += messages.length - valid.length;
      if (valid.length === 0) this.store.delete(id);
      else this.store.set(id, valid);
    }
    return removed;
  }

  totalStored(): number {
    return Array.from(this.store.values()).reduce((sum, q) => sum + q.length, 0);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// CAPABILITY REGISTRY
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface CapabilityAdvertisement {
  nodeId: string;
  capabilities: NodeCapability[];
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
  ttl: number;               // Seconds until advertisement expires
  signature: string;
}

export class CapabilityRegistry {
  private registry: Map<string, CapabilityAdvertisement> = new Map();

  publish(adv: CapabilityAdvertisement): void {
    this.registry.set(adv.nodeId, adv);
  }

  query(capability: NodeCapability): CapabilityAdvertisement[] {
    const now = Date.now();
    return Array.from(this.registry.values()).filter(adv => {
      const expired = now > adv.timestamp + adv.ttl * 1000;
      return !expired && adv.capabilities.includes(capability);
    });
  }

  get(nodeId: string): CapabilityAdvertisement | undefined {
    return this.registry.get(nodeId);
  }

  sweep(): void {
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const [id, adv] of this.registry) {
      if (now > adv.timestamp + adv.ttl * 1000) this.registry.delete(id);
    }
  }

  size(): number {
    return this.registry.size;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// NAT TRAVERSAL
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface STUNResult {
  publicHost: string;
  publicPort: number;
  natType: 'open' | 'full_cone' | 'restricted_cone' | 'port_restricted' | 'symmetric' | 'unknown';
}

export class NATTraversal {
  private readonly stunServers: string[];
  private cachedResult: STUNResult | null = null;
  private cacheExpiry: number = 0;

  constructor(stunServers: string[] = [
    'stun.l.google.com:19302',
    'stun1.l.google.com:19302',
    'stun.cloudflare.com:3478',
  ]) {
    this.stunServers = stunServers;
  }

  async discoverPublicAddress(localPort: number): Promise<STUNResult | null> {
    if (this.cachedResult && Date.now() < this.cacheExpiry) {
      return this.cachedResult;
    }

    // Attempt STUN with each server
    for (const serverAddr of this.stunServers) {
      const [host, portStr] = serverAddr.split(':');
      const port = parseInt(portStr ?? '3478', 10);
      const result = await this.stunQuery(host, port, localPort);
      if (result) {
        this.cachedResult = result;
        this.cacheExpiry = Date.now() + 300_000; // Cache 5 minutes
        return result;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  private async stunQuery(serverHost: string, serverPort: number, localPort: number): Promise<STUNResult | null> {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      const socket = dgram.createSocket('udp4');
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        socket.close();
        resolve(null);
      }, 3_000);

      // STUN Binding Request
      const txId = crypto.randomBytes(12);
      const request = Buffer.allocUnsafe(20);
      request.writeUInt16BE(0x0001, 0);  // Binding Request
      request.writeUInt16BE(0, 2);       // Message Length (no attributes)
      request.writeUInt32BE(0x2112A442, 4); // Magic Cookie
      txId.copy(request, 8);

      socket.bind(localPort, () => {
        socket.send(request, serverPort, serverHost, err => {
          if (err) {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            socket.close();
            resolve(null);
          }
        });
      });

      socket.on('message', (msg) => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        try {
          // Parse STUN response - look for XOR-MAPPED-ADDRESS attribute
          let offset = 20; // Skip header
          let publicHost = '';
          let publicPort = 0;

          while (offset + 4 <= msg.length) {
            const attrType = msg.readUInt16BE(offset);
            const attrLen = msg.readUInt16BE(offset + 2);
            offset += 4;

            if (attrType === 0x0020 && attrLen >= 8) { // XOR-MAPPED-ADDRESS (IPv4)
              const xPort = msg.readUInt16BE(offset + 2) ^ 0x2112;
              const xAddr = msg.readUInt32BE(offset + 4) ^ 0x2112A442;
              publicPort = xPort;
              publicHost = [
                (xAddr >>> 24) & 0xFF,
                (xAddr >>> 16) & 0xFF,
                (xAddr >>> 8) & 0xFF,
                xAddr & 0xFF,
              ].join('.');
            }
            offset += attrLen;
          }

          socket.close();
          if (publicHost) {
            resolve({ publicHost, publicPort, natType: 'unknown' });
          } else {
            resolve(null);
          }
        } catch {
          socket.close();
          resolve(null);
        }
      });

      socket.on('error', () => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        resolve(null);
      });
    });
  }

  // TCP hole-punching coordination
  async holePunch(
    localPort: number,
    remoteHost: string,
    remotePort: number,
    coordinationDelay: number = 500,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    // Both sides must punch simultaneously after coordination
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, coordinationDelay));

    return new Promise(resolve => {
      const socket = new net.Socket();
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        socket.destroy();
        resolve(false);
      }, 5_000);

      socket.connect({ port: remotePort, host: remoteHost, localPort }, () => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        socket.end();
        resolve(true);
      });
      socket.once('error', () => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        resolve(false);
      });
    });
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// ROUTE TABLE — direct + multi-hop
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RouteEntry {
  destination: string;    // hex nodeId
  nextHop: string;        // hex nodeId
  hopCount: number;
  latencyMs: number;
  transport: TransportType;
  expiresAt: number;
}

export class RouteTable {
  private routes: Map<string, RouteEntry> = new Map();

  set(destination: string, entry: RouteEntry): void {
    this.routes.set(destination, entry);
  }

  get(destination: string): RouteEntry | undefined {
    const route = this.routes.get(destination);
    if (route && Date.now() > route.expiresAt) {
      this.routes.delete(destination);
      return undefined;
    }
    return route;
  }

  remove(destination: string): void {
    this.routes.delete(destination);
  }

  sweep(): void {
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const [dest, route] of this.routes) {
      if (now > route.expiresAt) this.routes.delete(dest);
    }
  }

  allRoutes(): RouteEntry[] {
    return Array.from(this.routes.values());
  }

  size(): number {
    return this.routes.size;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// NODE STATISTICS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface NodeStats {
  messagesReceived: number;
  messagesSent: number;
  messagesForwarded: number;
  messagesDuplicate: number;
  messagesDroppedTTL: number;
  bytesReceived: number;
  bytesSent: number;
  peersDiscovered: number;
  peersLost: number;
  routeLookups: number;
  storeForwardEnqueued: number;
  storeForwardDelivered: number;
  gossipBroadcasts: number;
  uptimeMs: number;
  startedAt: number;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// MESH NODE — MAIN CLASS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface MeshNodeConfig {
  identity: NodeIdentity;
  tcpPort?: number;
  udpPort?: number;
  bootstrapPeers?: TransportAddress[];
  capabilities?: NodeCapability[];
  maxPeers?: number;
  enableNATTraversal?: boolean;
  gossipFanout?: number;
  dataDir?: string;
}

export interface NodeStatus {
  nodeId: string;
  did: string;
  addresses: TransportAddress[];
  peerCount: number;
  kademliaSize: number;
  storeForwardQueue: number;
  capabilityRegistry: number;
  routes: number;
  stats: NodeStats;
  uptime: number;
}

export class MeshNode extends EventEmitter {
  public readonly identity: NodeIdentity;
  private readonly config: Required<MeshNodeConfig>;

  // Core subsystems
  private readonly peerManager: PeerRecordManager;
  private readonly kademlia: KademliaTable;
  private readonly transportManager: TransportManager;
  private readonly gossip: GossipProtocol;
  private readonly deduplicator: MessageDeduplicator;
  private readonly storeForward: StoreAndForwardEngine;
  private readonly capabilityRegistry: CapabilityRegistry;
  private readonly routeTable: RouteTable;
  private readonly natTraversal: NATTraversal;

  // Timers
  private heartbeatTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private refreshTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private sweepTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private gossipTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

  // State
  private running: boolean = false;
  private stats: NodeStats;

  // Pending RPC callbacks
  private pendingRPCs: Map<string, {
    resolve: (msg: MeshMessage) => void;
    reject: (err: Error) => void;
    timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
  }> = new Map();

  constructor(config: MeshNodeConfig) {
    super();
    this.identity = config.identity;
    this.config = {
      tcpPort: config.tcpPort ?? 7770,
      udpPort: config.udpPort ?? 7771,
      bootstrapPeers: config.bootstrapPeers ?? [],
      capabilities: config.capabilities ?? [],
      maxPeers: config.maxPeers ?? 1000,
      enableNATTraversal: config.enableNATTraversal ?? true,
      gossipFanout: config.gossipFanout ?? GOSSIP_FANOUT,
      dataDir: config.dataDir ?? './ube-node-data',
      identity: this.identity,
    };

    // Apply capabilities to identity
    for (const cap of this.config.capabilities) {
      this.identity.addCapability(cap);
    }

    this.peerManager = new PeerRecordManager(this.config.maxPeers);
    this.kademlia = new KademliaTable(this.identity.nodeId);
    this.transportManager = new TransportManager();
    this.gossip = new GossipProtocol(this.config.gossipFanout);
    this.deduplicator = new MessageDeduplicator();
    this.storeForward = new StoreAndForwardEngine();
    this.capabilityRegistry = new CapabilityRegistry();
    this.routeTable = new RouteTable();
    this.natTraversal = new NATTraversal();

    this.stats = {
      messagesReceived: 0,
      messagesSent: 0,
      messagesForwarded: 0,
      messagesDuplicate: 0,
      messagesDroppedTTL: 0,
      bytesReceived: 0,
      bytesSent: 0,
      peersDiscovered: 0,
      peersLost: 0,
      routeLookups: 0,
      storeForwardEnqueued: 0,
      storeForwardDelivered: 0,
      gossipBroadcasts: 0,
      uptimeMs: 0,
      startedAt: 0,
    };

    this.setupTransports();
  }

  // ── LIFECYCLE ──────────────────────────────

  async start(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.running) throw new Error('MeshNode already running');
    this.running = true;
    this.stats.startedAt = Date.now();

    await this.transportManager.startAll();

    if (this.config.enableNATTraversal) {
      const stun = await this.natTraversal.discoverPublicAddress(this.config.udpPort);
      if (stun) {
        this.emit('nat:discovered', stun);
      }
    }

    this.transportManager.on('data', (data: Buffer, source: TransportAddress, transport: TransportType) => {
      this.handleRawData(data, source, transport);
    });

    // Start background tasks
    this.heartbeatTimer = setInterval(() => this.heartbeat(), HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS);
    this.refreshTimer = setInterval(() => this.refreshKademlia(), 3_600_000);
    this.sweepTimer = setInterval(() => this.sweep(), 60_000);
    this.gossipTimer = setInterval(() => this.gossipTick(), 1000 / GOSSIP_ROUNDS_PER_SECOND);

    // Bootstrap
    await this.bootstrap();

    // Publish own capabilities
    this.publishCapabilities();

    this.emit('started', { nodeId: this.identity.nodeId.toString('hex') });
  }

  async stop(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.running) return;
    this.running = false;

    // Send BYE to all peers
    const bye = createMessage('NODE_BYE', this.identity, Buffer.alloc(0), undefined, 1);
    await this.broadcast(bye);

    if (this.heartbeatTimer) clearInterval(this.heartbeatTimer);
    if (this.refreshTimer) clearInterval(this.refreshTimer);
    if (this.sweepTimer) clearInterval(this.sweepTimer);
    if (this.gossipTimer) clearInterval(this.gossipTimer);

    for (const rpc of this.pendingRPCs.values()) {
      clearTimeout(rpc.timer);
      rpc.reject(new Error('Node stopped'));
    }
    this.pendingRPCs.clear();

    await this.transportManager.stopAll();
    this.emit('stopped');
  }

  // ── BOOTSTRAP ─────────────────────────────

  private async bootstrap(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.config.bootstrapPeers.length === 0) return;

    const pingPromises = this.config.bootstrapPeers.map(addr => this.pingAddress(addr));
    const results = await Promise.allSettled(pingPromises);
    const contacted = results.filter(r => r.status === 'fulfilled').length;
    this.emit('bootstrap:complete', { contacted, total: this.config.bootstrapPeers.length });

    // Self-lookup to populate routing table
    if (contacted > 0) {
      await this.nodeLookup(this.identity.nodeId);
    }
  }

  private async pingAddress(addr: TransportAddress): Promise<void> {
    const ping = createMessage('PING', this.identity, Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
      addresses: this.transportManager.allLocalAddresses(),
      capabilities: this.identity.getCapabilities(),
    })), undefined, 1);

    const data = this.serializeMessage(ping);
    const result = await this.transportManager.send(addr, data);
    if (!result.success) throw new Error(`Ping failed: ${result.error}`);
  }

  // ── KADEMLIA NODE LOOKUP ───────────────────

  async nodeLookup(targetId: NodeId): Promise<PeerRecord[]> {
    this.stats.routeLookups++;

    const visited = new Set<string>();
    const closest = this.kademlia.findClosest(targetId, KADEMLIA_K);
    const queue: PeerRecord[] = [...closest];

    while (queue.length > 0) {
      const batch = queue.splice(0, KADEMLIA_ALPHA);
      const unvisited = batch.filter(p => !visited.has(p.nodeId.toString('hex')));
      if (unvisited.length === 0) break;

      const queries = unvisited.map(async peer => {
        visited.add(peer.nodeId.toString('hex'));
        const resp = await this.sendRPC(peer, 'FIND_NODE',
          Buffer.from(targetId.toString('hex')));
        if (!resp) return [];

        try {
          const found: PeerRecord[] = JSON.parse(resp.payload.toString('utf8'));
          return found;
        } catch {
          return [];
        }
      });

      const responses = await Promise.allSettled(queries);
      for (const resp of responses) {
        if (resp.status === 'fulfilled') {
          for (const peer of resp.value) {
            if (!visited.has(peer.nodeId.toString('hex'))) {
              this.kademlia.insert(peer);
              queue.push(peer);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return this.kademlia.findClosest(targetId, KADEMLIA_K);
  }

  // ── MESSAGE SENDING ────────────────────────

  async send(recipientId: string, type: MessageType, payload: Buffer): Promise<boolean> {
    const msg = createMessage(type, this.identity, payload, recipientId);

    // Check if we have a direct route
    const route = this.routeTable.get(recipientId);
    if (route) {
      const peer = this.peerManager.get(Buffer.from(route.nextHop, 'hex'));
      if (peer) {
        const result = await this.transportManager.sendBestEffort(peer, this.serializeMessage(msg));
        if (result.success) {
          this.stats.messagesSent++;
          this.stats.bytesSent += payload.length;
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    // Find closest peers and route through them
    const targetId = Buffer.from(recipientId, 'hex');
    const closest = this.kademlia.findClosest(targetId, KADEMLIA_ALPHA);

    for (const peer of closest) {
      if (peer.nodeId.toString('hex') === recipientId) {
        // Direct delivery
        const result = await this.transportManager.sendBestEffort(peer, this.serializeMessage(msg));
        if (result.success) {
          this.stats.messagesSent++;
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    // Target not reachable — store for delivery when they come online
    this.storeForward.enqueue({
      message: msg,
      receivedAt: Date.now(),
      receivedFrom: this.identity.nodeId.toString('hex'),
      transport: 'tcp',
    });
    this.stats.storeForwardEnqueued++;
    return false;
  }

  async broadcast(msg: MeshMessage): Promise<number> {
    const peers = this.peerManager.reachable();
    const targets = this.gossip.selectForwardPeers(peers);
    let delivered = 0;

    const sends = targets.map(async peer => {
      const result = await this.transportManager.sendBestEffort(peer, this.serializeMessage(msg));
      if (result.success) delivered++;
    });

    await Promise.allSettled(sends);
    this.stats.gossipBroadcasts++;
    return delivered;
  }

  // ── RPC ────────────────────────────────────

  private async sendRPC(
    peer: PeerRecord,
    type: MessageType,
    payload: Buffer,
    timeoutMs: number = 5_000,
  ): Promise<MeshMessage | null> {
    const msg = createMessage(type, this.identity, payload, peer.nodeId.toString('hex'), 1);
    const data = this.serializeMessage(msg);
    const result = await this.transportManager.sendBestEffort(peer, data);
    if (!result.success) return null;

    return new Promise(resolve => {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.pendingRPCs.delete(msg.id);
        resolve(null);
      }, timeoutMs);

      this.pendingRPCs.set(msg.id, {
        resolve: (resp) => {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          this.pendingRPCs.delete(msg.id);
          resolve(resp);
        },
        reject: () => {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          this.pendingRPCs.delete(msg.id);
          resolve(null);
        },
        timer,
      });
    });
  }

  // ── INCOMING MESSAGE HANDLING ──────────────

  private handleRawData(data: Buffer, source: TransportAddress, transport: TransportType): void {
    this.stats.bytesReceived += data.length;
    try {
      const msg = this.deserializeMessage(data);
      if (!msg) return;
      this.handleMessage(msg, source, transport);
    } catch (err) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'parse_error', source, err });
    }
  }

  private handleMessage(msg: MeshMessage, source: TransportAddress, transport: TransportType): void {
    // Network magic check
    if (msg.version !== PROTOCOL_VERSION) return;

    // Deduplication
    if (this.deduplicator.isDuplicate(msg.id)) {
      this.stats.messagesDuplicate++;
      return;
    }

    this.stats.messagesReceived++;

    // Signature verification
    if (!verifyMessage(msg)) {
      this.emit('security:invalid_signature', { msgId: msg.id, senderId: msg.senderId });
      return;
    }

    const envelope: MessageEnvelope = {
      message: msg,
      receivedAt: Date.now(),
      receivedFrom: msg.senderId,
      transport,
    };

    // Update peer record
    this.updatePeerFromMessage(msg, source, transport);

    // Handle RPC responses
    if (msg.recipientId === this.identity.nodeId.toString('hex')) {
      const rpcId = this.extractCorrelationId(msg);
      if (rpcId && this.pendingRPCs.has(rpcId)) {
        this.pendingRPCs.get(rpcId)!.resolve(msg);
        return;
      }
    }

    // Dispatch by type
    switch (msg.type) {
      case 'PING': this.handlePing(msg, source, transport); break;
      case 'PONG': this.handlePong(msg); break;
      case 'FIND_NODE': this.handleFindNode(msg, source, transport); break;
      case 'FOUND_NODE': break; // Handled by RPC callback
      case 'GOSSIP': this.handleGossip(msg, envelope); break;
      case 'CAPABILITY_ADV': this.handleCapabilityAdv(msg); break;
      case 'CAPABILITY_QUERY': this.handleCapabilityQuery(msg, source, transport); break;
      case 'DATA': this.handleData(msg, envelope); break;
      case 'NODE_BYE': this.handleNodeBye(msg); break;
      default:
        // Forward to application layer
        this.emit('message', envelope);
    }

    // Forward if TTL > 1 and not destined for us
    if (msg.ttl > 1 && msg.recipientId !== this.identity.nodeId.toString('hex')) {
      this.forwardMessage(msg, msg.senderId);
    }
  }

  private handlePing(msg: MeshMessage, source: TransportAddress, transport: TransportType): void {
    const pong = createMessage('PONG', this.identity, Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
      correlationId: msg.id,
      addresses: this.transportManager.allLocalAddresses(),
      capabilities: this.identity.getCapabilities(),
    })), msg.senderId, 1);
    this.transportManager.send(source, this.serializeMessage(pong));

    // Deliver any stored messages for this peer
    const stored = this.storeForward.drain(msg.senderId);
    if (stored.length > 0) {
      this.emit('store_forward:delivering', { recipientId: msg.senderId, count: stored.length });
      this.stats.storeForwardDelivered += stored.length;
      for (const sm of stored) {
        this.transportManager.send(source, this.serializeMessage(sm.envelope.message));
      }
    }
  }

  private handlePong(msg: MeshMessage): void {
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(msg.payload.toString('utf8'));
      const corrId = data.correlationId;
      if (corrId && this.pendingRPCs.has(corrId)) {
        this.pendingRPCs.get(corrId)!.resolve(msg);
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  private handleFindNode(msg: MeshMessage, source: TransportAddress, transport: TransportType): void {
    try {
      const targetHex = msg.payload.toString('utf8');
      const targetId = Buffer.from(targetHex, 'hex');
      const closest = this.kademlia.findClosest(targetId, KADEMLIA_K);
      const resp = createMessage('FOUND_NODE', this.identity,
        Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(closest)), msg.senderId, 1);
      // Embed correlation
      (resp as any)._correlationId = msg.id;
      this.transportManager.send(source, this.serializeMessage(resp));
    } catch {}
  }

  private handleGossip(msg: MeshMessage, envelope: MessageEnvelope): void {
    if (!this.gossip.shouldForward(msg.id)) return;

    // Deliver to application
    this.emit('gossip', envelope);

    // Forward to fanout peers (exclude sender)
    if (msg.ttl > 1) {
      const forwardMsg: MeshMessage = { ...msg, hopCount: msg.hopCount + 1, ttl: msg.ttl - 1 };
      const targets = this.gossip.selectForwardPeers(this.peerManager.reachable(), msg.senderId);
      for (const peer of targets) {
        this.transportManager.sendBestEffort(peer, this.serializeMessage(forwardMsg));
        this.stats.messagesForwarded++;
      }
    }
  }

  private handleCapabilityAdv(msg: MeshMessage): void {
    try {
      const adv: CapabilityAdvertisement = JSON.parse(msg.payload.toString('utf8'));
      this.capabilityRegistry.publish(adv);
      this.emit('capability:discovered', adv);
    } catch {}
  }

  private handleCapabilityQuery(msg: MeshMessage, source: TransportAddress, transport: TransportType): void {
    try {
      const { capability } = JSON.parse(msg.payload.toString('utf8'));
      const results = this.capabilityRegistry.query(capability as NodeCapability);
      const resp = createMessage('CAPABILITY_RESP', this.identity,
        Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(results)), msg.senderId, 1);
      this.transportManager.send(source, this.serializeMessage(resp));
    } catch {}
  }

  private handleData(msg: MeshMessage, envelope: MessageEnvelope): void {
    if (msg.recipientId === this.identity.nodeId.toString('hex')) {
      this.emit('data', envelope);
    } else if (msg.ttl > 1) {
      this.forwardMessage(msg, msg.senderId);
    } else {
      this.stats.messagesDroppedTTL++;
    }
  }

  private handleNodeBye(msg: MeshMessage): void {
    const nodeId = Buffer.from(msg.senderId, 'hex');
    this.kademlia.remove(nodeId);
    this.peerManager.remove(nodeId);
    this.routeTable.remove(msg.senderId);
    this.stats.peersLost++;
    this.emit('peer:left', { nodeId: msg.senderId });
  }

  private forwardMessage(msg: MeshMessage, excludeId: string): void {
    if (msg.ttl <= 1) {
      this.stats.messagesDroppedTTL++;
      return;
    }

    const forward: MeshMessage = { ...msg, ttl: msg.ttl - 1, hopCount: msg.hopCount + 1 };

    if (msg.recipientId) {
      // Unicast: route towards destination
      const targetId = Buffer.from(msg.recipientId, 'hex');
      const closest = this.kademlia.findClosest(targetId, 1);
      if (closest.length > 0 && closest[0].nodeId.toString('hex') !== excludeId) {
        this.transportManager.sendBestEffort(closest[0], this.serializeMessage(forward));
        this.stats.messagesForwarded++;
      }
    } else {
      // Broadcast: gossip forward
      const targets = this.gossip.selectForwardPeers(this.peerManager.reachable(), excludeId);
      for (const peer of targets) {
        this.transportManager.sendBestEffort(peer, this.serializeMessage(forward));
        this.stats.messagesForwarded++;
      }
    }
  }

  // ── BACKGROUND TASKS ───────────────────────

  private async heartbeat(): Promise<void> {
    const peers = this.peerManager.reachable();
    const now = Date.now();

    const checks = peers.map(async peer => {
      if (now - peer.lastSeen < HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS / 2) return;

      const ping = createMessage('PING', this.identity, Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
        addresses: this.transportManager.allLocalAddresses(),
        capabilities: this.identity.getCapabilities(),
      })), peer.nodeId.toString('hex'), 1);

      const result = await this.transportManager.sendBestEffort(peer, this.serializeMessage(ping));
      if (!result.success) {
        peer.failureCount++;
        if (peer.failureCount >= 3) {
          peer.reachable = false;
          this.emit('peer:unreachable', { nodeId: peer.nodeId.toString('hex') });
        }
      }
    });

    await Promise.allSettled(checks);
    this.stats.uptimeMs = Date.now() - this.stats.startedAt;
  }

  private async refreshKademlia(): Promise<void> {
    const staleBuckets = this.kademlia.staleBuckets();
    for (const bucketIdx of staleBuckets) {
      const refreshId = this.kademlia.refreshTarget(bucketIdx);
      await this.nodeLookup(refreshId);
    }
  }

  private sweep(): void {
    this.routeTable.sweep();
    this.capabilityRegistry.sweep();
    const removed = this.storeForward.sweep();
    if (removed > 0) {
      this.emit('store_forward:swept', { removed });
    }
  }

  private gossipTick(): void {
    // Anti-entropy: periodically gossip our state digest
    const peers = this.peerManager.allPeers().map(p => p.nodeId.toString('hex'));
    const digest = this.gossip.computeStateDigest(peers);
    const adv = createMessage('GOSSIP', this.identity, digest);
    this.broadcast(adv);
  }

  private publishCapabilities(): void {
    const adv: CapabilityAdvertisement = {
      nodeId: this.identity.nodeId.toString('hex'),
      capabilities: this.identity.getCapabilities(),
      metadata: {
        addresses: this.transportManager.allLocalAddresses(),
        version: PROTOCOL_VERSION,
      },
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      ttl: 3600,
      signature: this.identity.sign(
        Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ nodeId: this.identity.nodeId.toString('hex'), capabilities: this.identity.getCapabilities() }))
      ).toString('hex'),
    };
    this.capabilityRegistry.publish(adv);
    const msg = createMessage('CAPABILITY_ADV', this.identity, Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(adv)));
    this.broadcast(msg);
  }

  // ── PEER MANAGEMENT ────────────────────────

  private updatePeerFromMessage(msg: MeshMessage, source: TransportAddress, transport: TransportType): void {
    try {
      const nodeId = Buffer.from(msg.senderId, 'hex');
      const existing = this.peerManager.get(nodeId);

      let addresses: TransportAddress[] = [source];
      let capabilities: NodeCapability[] = [];

      if (msg.type === 'PING' || msg.type === 'PONG') {
        const data = JSON.parse(msg.payload.toString('utf8'));
        if (Array.isArray(data.addresses)) addresses = data.addresses;
        if (Array.isArray(data.capabilities)) capabilities = data.capabilities;
      }

      const record: PeerRecord = {
        nodeId,
        publicKey: Buffer.from(msg.senderPublicKey, 'hex'),
        did: `did:ube:${msg.senderId}`,
        addresses: existing ? [...existing.addresses, ...addresses] : addresses,
        capabilities,
        lastSeen: Date.now(),
        latencyMs: 0,
        rttSamples: [],
        failureCount: 0,
        verified: true,
        reachable: true,
      };

      const wasNew = !this.peerManager.has(nodeId);
      this.peerManager.upsert(record);
      this.kademlia.insert(record);

      if (wasNew) {
        this.stats.peersDiscovered++;
        this.emit('peer:discovered', { nodeId: msg.senderId, capabilities, transport });
      }

      // Update route table
      this.routeTable.set(msg.senderId, {
        destination: msg.senderId,
        nextHop: msg.senderId,
        hopCount: 1,
        latencyMs: 0,
        transport,
        expiresAt: Date.now() + ROUTE_CACHE_TTL_MS,
      });
    } catch {}
  }

  // ── SERIALIZATION ──────────────────────────

  private serializeMessage(msg: MeshMessage): Buffer {
    const json = JSON.stringify({
      ...msg,
      payload: msg.payload.toString('base64'),
    });
    return Buffer.from(json, 'utf8');
  }

  private deserializeMessage(data: Buffer): MeshMessage | null {
    try {
      const obj = JSON.parse(data.toString('utf8'));
      return {
        ...obj,
        payload: Buffer.from(obj.payload, 'base64'),
      } as MeshMessage;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  private extractCorrelationId(msg: MeshMessage): string | null {
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(msg.payload.toString('utf8'));
      return data.correlationId ?? null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  // ── SETUP ──────────────────────────────────

  private setupTransports(): void {
    this.transportManager.register(new TCPTransport(this.config.tcpPort));
    this.transportManager.register(new UDPTransport(this.config.udpPort));
  }

  // ── PUBLIC API ─────────────────────────────

  async queryCapability(capability: NodeCapability): Promise<CapabilityAdvertisement[]> {
    // First check local registry
    const local = this.capabilityRegistry.query(capability);
    if (local.length > 0) return local;

    // Broadcast query across mesh
    const queryMsg = createMessage('CAPABILITY_QUERY', this.identity,
      Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ capability })));
    await this.broadcast(queryMsg);

    // Wait briefly for responses
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2_000));
    return this.capabilityRegistry.query(capability);
  }

  async findGateway(): Promise<PeerRecord | null> {
    const gateways = this.peerManager.byCapability('GATEWAY');
    if (gateways.length > 0) {
      // Return gateway with lowest latency
      return gateways.sort((a, b) => a.latencyMs - b.latencyMs)[0];
    }
    return null;
  }

  async findRelayNodes(count: number = 3): Promise<PeerRecord[]> {
    return this.peerManager.byCapability('RELAY').slice(0, count);
  }

  status(): NodeStatus {
    return {
      nodeId: this.identity.nodeId.toString('hex'),
      did: this.identity.did,
      addresses: this.transportManager.allLocalAddresses(),
      peerCount: this.peerManager.reachable().length,
      kademliaSize: this.kademlia.size(),
      storeForwardQueue: this.storeForward.totalStored(),
      capabilityRegistry: this.capabilityRegistry.size(),
      routes: this.routeTable.size(),
      stats: { ...this.stats, uptimeMs: this.running ? Date.now() - this.stats.startedAt : this.stats.uptimeMs },
      uptime: Date.now() - this.stats.startedAt,
    };
  }

  isRunning(): boolean {
    return this.running;
  }

  getPeers(): PeerRecord[] {
    return this.peerManager.reachable();
  }

  getIdentity(): NodeIdentityDoc {
    return this.identity.exportPublicDoc();
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// MESH NODE FACTORY
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class MeshNodeFactory {
  static createGatewayNode(tcpPort: number = 7770, udpPort: number = 7771): MeshNode {
    const identity = NodeIdentity.generate(['GATEWAY', 'RELAY', 'CONSENSUS', 'STORAGE']);
    return new MeshNode({ identity, tcpPort, udpPort });
  }

  static createRelayNode(tcpPort: number = 7772, udpPort: number = 7773): MeshNode {
    const identity = NodeIdentity.generate(['RELAY', 'STORAGE']);
    return new MeshNode({ identity, tcpPort, udpPort });
  }

  static createComputeNode(tcpPort: number = 7774, udpPort: number = 7775): MeshNode {
    const identity = NodeIdentity.generate(['COMPUTE', 'AI']);
    return new MeshNode({ identity, tcpPort, udpPort });
  }

  static createEdgeNode(tcpPort: number = 7776, udpPort: number = 7777, bootstraps: TransportAddress[] = []): MeshNode {
    const identity = NodeIdentity.generate([]);
    return new MeshNode({ identity, tcpPort, udpPort, bootstrapPeers: bootstraps });
  }

  static fromIdentity(identity: NodeIdentity, config: Partial<MeshNodeConfig> = {}): MeshNode {
    return new MeshNode({ identity, ...config });
  }
}
