export interface SBDMessage {
  id: string;
  data: Buffer;
  momsn?: number;   // Mobile Originated Message Sequence Number
  mtmsn?: number;   // Mobile Terminated Message Sequence Number
  imei?: string;
  sessionStatus: number;
  rxCount: number;
  txCount: number;
}

export class IridiumSBDLink extends EventEmitter implements ISatelliteLink {
  readonly provider: SatelliteProvider = 'iridium';
  private state: LinkState = 'disconnected';
  private metrics: LinkMetrics;
  private readonly config: SatelliteConfig;
  private moQueue: Buffer[] = [];
  private mtBuffer: Buffer[] = [];
  private sessionInProgress: boolean = false;
  private signalStrength: number = 0;
  private momsn: number = 0;
  private mtmsn: number = 0;
  private checkTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private serialBuffer: string = '';

  constructor(config: SatelliteConfig) {
    super();
    this.config = config;
    this.metrics = this.emptyMetrics();
  }

  async connect(): Promise<boolean> {
    // In production: open serial port to Iridium modem
    // AT+SBDMTA=1 sets up message notifications
    // AT+CIER=1,1,1 enables signal strength reporting
    try {
      this.state = 'connecting';
      await this.atCommand('AT');           // Basic sanity check
      await this.atCommand('ATZ');          // Reset modem
      await this.atCommand('AT+SBDMTA=1'); // Enable MT alerts
      await this.atCommand('AT+CIER=1,1,1'); // Enable indicator events

      const signal = await this.checkSignal();
      this.signalStrength = signal;
      this.state = signal > 0 ? 'connected' : 'searching';
      this.startPolling();

      this.emit('state:change', { state: this.state, signal });
      return signal > 0;
    } catch (err) {
      this.state = 'disconnected';
      this.emit('error', { type: 'connect_failed', err });
      return false;
    }
  }

  async disconnect(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.checkTimer) clearInterval(this.checkTimer);
    await this.atCommand('AT+SBDMTA=0').catch(() => {});
    this.state = 'disconnected';
    this.emit('state:change', { state: this.state });
  }

  async send(data: Buffer, options: SendOptions = {}): Promise<SendResult> {
    if (data.length > IRIDIUM_SBD_MAX_MO) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `Iridium SBD max payload is ${IRIDIUM_SBD_MAX_MO} bytes, got ${data.length}`,
      };
    }

    this.moQueue.push(data);
    this.emit('queue:enqueued', { size: data.length, queueLength: this.moQueue.length });

    // Initiate session if signal available
    if (!this.sessionInProgress && this.signalStrength > 0) {
      return this.initiateSession();
    }

    return { success: true, messageId: crypto.randomUUID() };
  }

  getMetrics(): LinkMetrics {
    return { ...this.metrics };
  }

  isAvailable(): boolean {
    return this.state === 'connected' || (this.state === 'searching' && this.signalStrength > 0);
  }

  async healthCheck(): Promise<boolean> {
    const signal = await this.checkSignal();
    this.signalStrength = signal;
    this.state = signal > 0 ? 'connected' : 'searching';
    this.metrics.signalStrength = (signal / 5) * 100;
    this.metrics.state = this.state;
    return signal > 0;
  }

  private async initiateSession(): Promise<SendResult> {
    if (this.sessionInProgress) return { success: false, error: 'Session in progress' };
    this.sessionInProgress = true;

    try {
      // Load MO buffer
      if (this.moQueue.length > 0) {
        const message = this.moQueue[0];
        await this.loadMOBuffer(message);
      } else {
        await this.atCommand('AT+SBDWT='); // Clear MO buffer
      }

      // Initiate SBD session
      const sessionResult = await this.atCommand('AT+SBDIX', IRIDIUM_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS);
      const parsed = this.parseSBDIXResponse(sessionResult);

      if (parsed && parsed.moStatus <= 4) {
        // MO success
        if (this.moQueue.length > 0) {
          this.moQueue.shift();
          this.momsn = (this.momsn + 1) & 0xFFFF;
        }
        this.metrics.bytesUsedThisMonth += parsed.moLength ?? 0;
        this.metrics.lastSuccessful = Date.now();

        // Check for MT messages
        if (parsed.mtStatus === 1 && parsed.mtLength > 0) {
          const mtData = await this.readMTBuffer();
          if (mtData) {
            this.mtBuffer.push(mtData);
            this.emit('message:received', { data: mtData, mtmsn: this.mtmsn });
            this.mtmsn = (this.mtmsn + 1) & 0xFFFF;
          }
        }

        this.sessionInProgress = false;
        return { success: true, bytesUsed: parsed.moLength ?? 0 };
      } else {
        this.sessionInProgress = false;
        return { success: false, error: `SBD session failed with status ${parsed?.moStatus}`, retryAfterMs: 30_000 };
      }
    } catch (err) {
      this.sessionInProgress = false;
      return { success: false, error: String(err) };
    }
  }

  private async loadMOBuffer(data: Buffer): Promise<void> {
    const hex = data.toString('hex');
    await this.atCommand(`AT+SBDWB=${data.length}`);
    await this.writeRaw(data);
  }

  private async readMTBuffer(): Promise<Buffer | null> {
    const response = await this.atCommand('AT+SBDRB');
    // Response format: 2-byte length + data + 2-byte checksum
    if (!response || response.length < 4) return null;
    const len = response.readUInt16BE(0);
    if (response.length < 2 + len + 2) return null;
    const data = response.slice(2, 2 + len);
    const checksum = response.readUInt16BE(2 + len);
    const computed = data.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b, 0) & 0xFFFF;
    if (checksum !== computed) return null;
    return data;
  }

  private async checkSignal(): Promise<number> {
    const response = await this.atCommand('AT+CSQ').catch(() => '');
    const match = response.match(/\+CSQ:(\d)/);
    return match ? parseInt(match[1]) : 0;
  }

  private parseSBDIXResponse(response: string): {
    moStatus: number; momsn: number; mtStatus: number; mtmsn: number;
    mtLength: number; mtQueued: number; moLength?: number;
  } | null {
    const match = response.match(/\+SBDIX:\s*(\d+),\s*(\d+),\s*(\d+),\s*(\d+),\s*(\d+),\s*(\d+)/);
    if (!match) return null;
    return {
      moStatus: parseInt(match[1]),
      momsn: parseInt(match[2]),
      mtStatus: parseInt(match[3]),
      mtmsn: parseInt(match[4]),
      mtLength: parseInt(match[5]),
      mtQueued: parseInt(match[6]),
    };
  }

  private async atCommand(cmd: string, timeoutMs: number = 5_000): Promise<string> {
    // In production: write to serial port and wait for response
    // Simulation: return appropriate mock responses
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100));
    if (cmd === 'AT') return 'OK';
    if (cmd === 'ATZ') return 'OK';
    if (cmd.startsWith('AT+CSQ')) return '+CSQ:3\r\nOK';
    if (cmd.startsWith('AT+SBDIX')) return '+SBDIX: 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0\r\nOK';
    if (cmd.startsWith('AT+SBDWB=')) return 'READY';
    return 'OK';
  }

  private async writeRaw(data: Buffer): Promise<void> {
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50));
  }

  private startPolling(): void {
    this.checkTimer = setInterval(async () => {
      await this.healthCheck();

      if (this.moQueue.length > 0 && !this.sessionInProgress && this.signalStrength > 0) {
        this.initiateSession().catch(() => {});
      }
    }, 60_000);
  }

  private emptyMetrics(): LinkMetrics {
    return {
      provider: 'iridium', state: 'disconnected', latencyMs: LEO_RTT_MS_IRIDIUM,
      uplinkBpsEstimate: 2400, downlinkBpsEstimate: 2400, signalStrength: 0,
      packetLoss: 0.05, bytesUsedThisMonth: 0,
      bytesRemainingThisMonth: this.config?.monthlyBudgetBytes ?? 0,
      lastSuccessful: 0, obstructionPercent: 0,
      uplinkThroughputMbps: 0.0024, downlinkThroughputMbps: 0.0024,
    };
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// VSAT LINK (Generic GEO)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class VsatLink extends EventEmitter implements ISatelliteLink {
  readonly provider: SatelliteProvider = 'vsat';
  private state: LinkState = 'disconnected';
  private metrics: LinkMetrics;
  private readonly config: SatelliteConfig;
  private gatewayHost: string;
  private gatewayPort: number;

  constructor(config: SatelliteConfig) {
    super();
    this.config = config;
    const endpoint = config.apiEndpoint ?? 'localhost:1194';
    const [host, port] = endpoint.split(':');
    this.gatewayHost = host;
    this.gatewayPort = parseInt(port ?? '1194');
    this.metrics = this.emptyMetrics();
  }

  async connect(): Promise<boolean> {
    this.state = 'connecting';
    const ok = await this.healthCheck();
    this.state = ok ? 'connected' : 'disconnected';
    this.emit('state:change', { state: this.state });
    return ok;
  }

  async disconnect(): Promise<void> {
    this.state = 'disconnected';
    this.emit('state:change', { state: this.state });
  }

  async send(data: Buffer, options: SendOptions = {}): Promise<SendResult> {
    if (!this.isAvailable()) return { success: false, error: 'VSAT not connected' };
    const start = Date.now();

    return new Promise(resolve => {
      const socket = new net.Socket();
      socket.setTimeout(30_000);

      const frame = Buffer.allocUnsafe(4 + data.length);
      frame.writeUInt32BE(data.length, 0);
      data.copy(frame, 4);

      socket.connect(this.gatewayPort, this.gatewayHost, () => {
        socket.write(frame, err => {
          socket.end();
          if (err) resolve({ success: false, error: err.message });
          else resolve({ success: true, latencyMs: Date.now() - start, bytesUsed: data.length });
        });
      });
      socket.on('error', err => resolve({ success: false, error: err.message }));
      socket.on('timeout', () => { socket.destroy(); resolve({ success: false, error: 'Timeout' }); });
    });
  }

  getMetrics(): LinkMetrics { return { ...this.metrics }; }
  isAvailable(): boolean { return this.state === 'connected'; }

  async healthCheck(): Promise<boolean> {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      const socket = new net.Socket();
      socket.setTimeout(5_000);
      socket.connect(this.gatewayPort, this.gatewayHost, () => { socket.end(); resolve(true); });
      socket.on('error', () => resolve(false));
      socket.on('timeout', () => { socket.destroy(); resolve(false); });
    });
  }

  private emptyMetrics(): LinkMetrics {
    return {
      provider: 'vsat', state: 'disconnected', latencyMs: GEO_RTT_MS,
      uplinkBpsEstimate: 2_000_000, downlinkBpsEstimate: 20_000_000, signalStrength: 0,
      packetLoss: 0.001, bytesUsedThisMonth: 0,
      bytesRemainingThisMonth: this.config?.monthlyBudgetBytes ?? 0,
      lastSuccessful: 0, obstructionPercent: 0,
      uplinkThroughputMbps: 2, downlinkThroughputMbps: 20,
    };
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// TLE ORBITAL PREDICTOR
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface GroundStation {
  lat: number;    // Degrees
  lon: number;    // Degrees
  altKm: number;  // Altitude in km
  minElevation: number; // Minimum elevation for contact (degrees)
}

export class TLEPredictor {
  private tles: Map<string, TwoLineElement> = new Map();

  addTLE(tle: TwoLineElement): void {
    this.tles.set(tle.name, tle);
  }

  removeTLE(name: string): void {
    this.tles.delete(name);
  }

  // Simplified SGP4-like propagator
  // Note: Full SGP4 requires complex Brouwer theory — this is a simplified circular orbit approximation
  // suitable for UBE contact window estimation (±2 min accuracy)
  predictPasses(
    tleName: string,
    station: GroundStation,
    startTime: number,
    durationMs: number,
  ): OrbitalPass[] {
    const tle = this.tles.get(tleName);
    if (!tle) return [];

    const passes: OrbitalPass[] = [];
    const stepMs = 10_000; // 10-second steps
    const endTime = startTime + durationMs;

    let inPass = false;
    let passAos = 0;
    let maxElevation = 0;

    for (let t = startTime; t < endTime; t += stepMs) {
      const elevation = this.computeElevation(tle, station, t);
      if (elevation >= station.minElevation) {
        if (!inPass) {
          inPass = true;
          passAos = t;
          maxElevation = elevation;
        } else {
          maxElevation = Math.max(maxElevation, elevation);
        }
      } else if (inPass) {
        passes.push({
          aos: passAos,
          los: t,
          maxElevation,
          duration: t - passAos,
          visible: true,
        });
        inPass = false;
        maxElevation = 0;
      }
    }

    return passes;
  }

  nextPass(tleName: string, station: GroundStation): OrbitalPass | null {
    const passes = this.predictPasses(tleName, station, Date.now(), 24 * 3_600_000);
    return passes[0] ?? null;
  }

  // Simplified elevation calculation (circular orbit approximation)
  private computeElevation(tle: TwoLineElement, station: GroundStation, timeMs: number): number {
    const meanMotion = this.parseMeanMotion(tle.line2);
    const inclination = this.parseInclination(tle.line2);
    const raan = this.parseRAAN(tle.line2);     // Right Ascension of Ascending Node
    const epoch = this.parseTLEEpoch(tle.line1);

    const dt = (timeMs - epoch) / 1000; // Seconds since epoch
    const period = 86_400 / meanMotion; // Period in seconds
    const n = (2 * Math.PI) / period;   // Mean motion rad/s
    const M = n * dt;                   // Mean anomaly

    // Simplified circular orbit position
    const incRad = (inclination * Math.PI) / 180;
    const raanRad = (raan * Math.PI) / 180;
    const altKm = this.parseAltitude(tle.line2);
    const r = EARTH_RADIUS_KM + altKm;

    // Orbital position in ECI frame (simplified)
    const xOrb = r * Math.cos(M);
    const yOrb = r * Math.sin(M);

    // Rotate to ECI
    const xECI = xOrb * (Math.cos(raanRad) * Math.cos(0) - Math.sin(raanRad) * Math.sin(0) * Math.cos(incRad))
                + yOrb * (-Math.cos(raanRad) * Math.sin(0) - Math.sin(raanRad) * Math.cos(0) * Math.cos(incRad));
    const yECI = xOrb * (Math.sin(raanRad) * Math.cos(0) + Math.cos(raanRad) * Math.sin(0) * Math.cos(incRad))
                + yOrb * (-Math.sin(raanRad) * Math.sin(0) + Math.cos(raanRad) * Math.cos(0) * Math.cos(incRad));
    const zECI = xOrb * (Math.sin(0) * Math.sin(incRad)) + yOrb * (Math.cos(0) * Math.sin(incRad));

    // Ground station position in ECEF
    const lst = this.localSiderealTime(station.lon, timeMs);
    const stLat = (station.lat * Math.PI) / 180;
    const stR = EARTH_RADIUS_KM + station.altKm;
    const sxECEF = stR * Math.cos(stLat) * Math.cos(lst);
    const syECEF = stR * Math.cos(stLat) * Math.sin(lst);
    const szECEF = stR * Math.sin(stLat);

    // Range vector
    const dx = xECI - sxECEF;
    const dy = yECI - syECEF;
    const dz = zECI - szECEF;
    const range = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);

    // Elevation angle
    const dotProduct = dx * sxECEF + dy * syECEF + dz * szECEF;
    const sinElev = dotProduct / (range * stR);
    return (Math.asin(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, sinElev))) * 180) / Math.PI;
  }

  private parseMeanMotion(line2: string): number {
    return parseFloat(line2.slice(52, 63).trim());
  }

  private parseInclination(line2: string): number {
    return parseFloat(line2.slice(8, 16).trim());
  }

  private parseRAAN(line2: string): number {
    return parseFloat(line2.slice(17, 25).trim());
  }

  private parseAltitude(line2: string): number {
    const meanMotion = this.parseMeanMotion(line2);
    const period = 86_400 / meanMotion;
    const a = Math.pow((9.8 * EARTH_RADIUS_KM * EARTH_RADIUS_KM * period * period) / (4 * Math.PI * Math.PI), 1 / 3);
    return a - EARTH_RADIUS_KM;
  }

  private parseTLEEpoch(line1: string): number {
    const epochStr = line1.slice(18, 32).trim();
    const year = parseInt(epochStr.slice(0, 2));
    const day = parseFloat(epochStr.slice(2));
    const fullYear = year < 57 ? 2000 + year : 1900 + year;
    const jan1 = new Date(fullYear, 0, 1).getTime();
    return jan1 + (day - 1) * TLE_EPOCH_DAY_MS;
  }

  private localSiderealTime(lon: number, timeMs: number): number {
    const JD = timeMs / 86_400_000 + 2_440_587.5;
    const T = (JD - 2_451_545.0) / 36_525;
    const GMST = 280.46061837 + 360.98564736629 * (JD - 2_451_545) + T * T * 0.000387933;
    return ((GMST + lon) * Math.PI) / 180;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// BANDWIDTH BUDGET MANAGER
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface BandwidthAllocation {
  priority: Priority;
  maxBytesPerHour: number;
  usedThisHour: number;
  windowStart: number;
}

export class BandwidthBudget {
  private allocations: Map<Priority, BandwidthAllocation> = new Map();
  private monthlyUsed: number = 0;
  private readonly monthlyLimit: number;
  private readonly monthStart: number;

  constructor(monthlyLimitBytes: number) {
    this.monthlyLimit = monthlyLimitBytes;
    this.monthStart = Date.now();

    // Default allocations by priority
    const total = monthlyLimitBytes;
    this.setAllocation('critical', total * 0.30 / 720);   // 30% reserved for critical
    this.setAllocation('high', total * 0.25 / 720);
    this.setAllocation('normal', total * 0.25 / 720);
    this.setAllocation('low', total * 0.15 / 720);
    this.setAllocation('background', total * 0.05 / 720);
  }

  setAllocation(priority: Priority, bytesPerHour: number): void {
    this.allocations.set(priority, {
      priority,
      maxBytesPerHour: bytesPerHour,
      usedThisHour: 0,
      windowStart: Date.now(),
    });
  }

  canSend(bytes: number, priority: Priority): boolean {
    if (this.monthlyLimit > 0 && this.monthlyUsed + bytes > this.monthlyLimit) return false;
    const alloc = this.allocations.get(priority);
    if (!alloc) return true;
    this.refreshWindow(alloc);
    return alloc.usedThisHour + bytes <= alloc.maxBytesPerHour;
  }

  recordUsage(bytes: number, priority: Priority): void {
    this.monthlyUsed += bytes;
    const alloc = this.allocations.get(priority);
    if (alloc) {
      this.refreshWindow(alloc);
      alloc.usedThisHour += bytes;
    }
  }

  remainingMonthly(): number {
    return Math.max(0, this.monthlyLimit - this.monthlyUsed);
  }

  remainingHourly(priority: Priority): number {
    const alloc = this.allocations.get(priority);
    if (!alloc) return Infinity;
    this.refreshWindow(alloc);
    return Math.max(0, alloc.maxBytesPerHour - alloc.usedThisHour);
  }

  private refreshWindow(alloc: BandwidthAllocation): void {
    if (Date.now() - alloc.windowStart > 3_600_000) {
      alloc.usedThisHour = 0;
      alloc.windowStart = Date.now();
    }
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// LATENCY COMPENSATOR
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ProtocolAdaptation {
  maxWindowSize: number;       // TCP window size appropriate for delay-bandwidth product
  retransmitTimeoutMs: number;
  keepaliveIntervalMs: number;
  heartbeatIntervalMs: number;
  batchingWindowMs: number;    // Wait this long to batch small messages
  compressionEnabled: boolean;
  maxMessageSize: number;
}

export class LatencyCompensator {
  static adaptForLatency(latencyMs: number, uplinkBps: number, downlinkBps: number): ProtocolAdaptation {
    // Bandwidth-Delay Product determines optimal buffer size
    const bdpBytes = (latencyMs / 1000) * Math.min(uplinkBps, downlinkBps) / 8;

    return {
      maxWindowSize: Math.min(65_535, Math.max(4096, bdpBytes * 2)),
      retransmitTimeoutMs: Math.max(1_000, latencyMs * 4), // RFC 6298 initial RTO
      keepaliveIntervalMs: Math.max(30_000, latencyMs * 10),
      heartbeatIntervalMs: Math.max(60_000, latencyMs * 20),
      batchingWindowMs: latencyMs > 500 ? 1_000 : 100,   // Nagle-style batching for high-latency
      compressionEnabled: uplinkBps < 1_000_000,          // Compress when uplink is constrained
      maxMessageSize: latencyMs > 500 ? 4096 : 65_535,    // Smaller messages for reliable GEO delivery
    };
  }

  static shouldFragment(size: number, latencyMs: number): boolean {
    // Don't fragment for LEO — just send. For GEO, fragment large messages for reliability
    if (latencyMs < 100) return size > 65_535;
    return size > 4096;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// MESSAGE QUEUE — Priority + expiry
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class SatelliteMessageQueue {
  private queues: Map<Priority, QueuedMessage[]> = new Map();
  private readonly maxTotal: number;
  private total: number = 0;

  constructor(maxTotal: number = MAX_QUEUE_SIZE) {
    this.maxTotal = maxTotal;
    (['critical', 'high', 'normal', 'low', 'background'] as Priority[]).forEach(p => {
      this.queues.set(p, []);
    });
  }

  enqueue(msg: QueuedMessage): boolean {
    if (this.total >= this.maxTotal) {
      if (!this.evict()) return false;
    }
    this.queues.get(msg.priority)!.push(msg);
    this.total++;
    return true;
  }

  dequeue(): QueuedMessage | null {
    const now = Date.now();
    const priorityOrder: Priority[] = ['critical', 'high', 'normal', 'low', 'background'];

    for (const priority of priorityOrder) {
      const queue = this.queues.get(priority)!;
      while (queue.length > 0) {
        const msg = queue.shift()!;
        this.total--;
        if (msg.expiresAt > now) return msg;
        // Expired — discard and try next
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  peek(): QueuedMessage | null {
    const priorityOrder: Priority[] = ['critical', 'high', 'normal', 'low', 'background'];
    for (const priority of priorityOrder) {
      const queue = this.queues.get(priority)!;
      const now = Date.now();
      for (const msg of queue) {
        if (msg.expiresAt > now) return msg;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  size(): number { return this.total; }

  sweep(): number {
    const now = Date.now();
    let removed = 0;
    for (const queue of this.queues.values()) {
      const before = queue.length;
      const valid = queue.filter(m => m.expiresAt > now);
      removed += before - valid.length;
      queue.length = 0;
      valid.forEach(m => queue.push(m));
    }
    this.total -= removed;
    return removed;
  }

  private evict(): boolean {
    // Evict lowest priority non-expired message
    const priorityOrder: Priority[] = ['background', 'low', 'normal', 'high', 'critical'];
    for (const priority of priorityOrder) {
      const queue = this.queues.get(priority)!;
      if (queue.length > 0) {
        queue.pop();
        this.total--;
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// LINK SELECTOR
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class LinkSelector {
  private readonly links: ISatelliteLink[];

  constructor(links: ISatelliteLink[]) {
    this.links = links;
  }

  select(priority: Priority = 'normal'): ISatelliteLink | null {
    const available = this.links.filter(l => l.isAvailable());
    if (available.length === 0) return null;

    // For critical: pick lowest latency
    if (priority === 'critical') {
      return available.sort((a, b) => a.getMetrics().latencyMs - b.getMetrics().latencyMs)[0];
    }

    // Score: signal * bandwidth / latency
    const scored = available.map(link => {
      const m = link.getMetrics();
      const score = (m.signalStrength / 100) * m.downlinkBpsEstimate / Math.max(1, m.latencyMs);
      return { link, score };
    });

    return scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)[0]?.link ?? null;
  }

  all(): ISatelliteLink[] { return this.links; }
  available(): ISatelliteLink[] { return this.links.filter(l => l.isAvailable()); }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// SATELLITE ROUTER — Main orchestrator
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface SatelliteRouterConfig {
  links: SatelliteConfig[];
  groundStation?: GroundStation;
  enableTLEPrediction?: boolean;
}

export interface SatelliteRouterStats {
  totalSent: number;
  totalReceived: number;
  totalBytesSent: number;
  totalBytesReceived: number;
  totalFailed: number;
  queueDepth: number;
  activeLink: SatelliteProvider | null;
  linksAvailable: number;
  uptime: number;
  startedAt: number;
}

export class SatelliteRouter extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly links: ISatelliteLink[];
  private readonly selector: LinkSelector;
  private readonly queue: SatelliteMessageQueue;
  private readonly tlePredictor: TLEPredictor;
  private readonly groundStation: GroundStation | null;

  private running: boolean = false;
  private stats: SatelliteRouterStats;
  private processTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private healthTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private sweepTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

  constructor(config: SatelliteRouterConfig) {
    super();
    this.groundStation = config.groundStation ?? null;
    this.tlePredictor = new TLEPredictor();
    this.queue = new SatelliteMessageQueue();
    this.stats = {
      totalSent: 0, totalReceived: 0, totalBytesSent: 0, totalBytesReceived: 0,
      totalFailed: 0, queueDepth: 0, activeLink: null, linksAvailable: 0,
      uptime: 0, startedAt: 0,
    };

    // Instantiate links based on config
    this.links = config.links.filter(c => c.enabled).map(c => {
      switch (c.provider) {
        case 'starlink': return new StarlinkLink(c);
        case 'iridium': return new IridiumSBDLink(c);
        case 'vsat': return new VsatLink(c);
        default: return new VsatLink(c);
      }
    });

    this.selector = new LinkSelector(this.links);

    // Forward data events from all links
    for (const link of this.links) {
      link.on('message:received', (data: any) => {
        this.stats.totalReceived++;
        this.stats.totalBytesReceived += data.data?.length ?? 0;
        this.emit('data', data);
      });
      link.on('state:change', (state: any) => {
        this.emit('link:state', { provider: link.provider, ...state });
        this.updateStats();
      });
    }
  }

  async start(): Promise<void> {
    this.running = true;
    this.stats.startedAt = Date.now();

    // Connect all links in parallel
    const connects = this.links.map(l => l.connect().catch(() => false));
    await Promise.allSettled(connects);

    this.processTimer = setInterval(() => this.processQueue(), 5_000);
    this.healthTimer = setInterval(() => this.healthChecks(), LINK_HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS);
    this.sweepTimer = setInterval(() => { this.queue.sweep(); }, 60_000);

    this.updateStats();
    this.emit('started', { linksAvailable: this.selector.available().length });
  }

  async stop(): Promise<void> {
    this.running = false;
    if (this.processTimer) clearInterval(this.processTimer);
    if (this.healthTimer) clearInterval(this.healthTimer);
    if (this.sweepTimer) clearInterval(this.sweepTimer);
    await Promise.allSettled(this.links.map(l => l.disconnect()));
    this.emit('stopped');
  }

  async send(data: Buffer, options: SendOptions & { recipient?: string } = {}): Promise<SendResult> {
    const priority = options.priority ?? 'normal';
    const link = this.selector.select(priority);

    if (link) {
      // Direct send
      const result = await link.send(data, options);
      if (result.success) {
        this.stats.totalSent++;
        this.stats.totalBytesSent += data.length;
        this.stats.activeLink = link.provider;
        return result;
      }
    }

    // No link available — queue
    const msg: QueuedMessage = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      data,
      priority,
      recipient: options.recipient,
      queuedAt: Date.now(),
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (options.ttl ?? 86_400_000),
      attempts: 0,
      maxAttempts: 10,
    };

    const queued = this.queue.enqueue(msg);
    this.stats.queueDepth = this.queue.size();
    this.emit('message:queued', { id: msg.id, priority, queueDepth: this.stats.queueDepth });

    return queued
      ? { success: false, messageId: msg.id, error: 'Queued for later delivery', retryAfterMs: 30_000 }
      : { success: false, error: 'Queue full, message dropped' };
  }

  async broadcast(data: Buffer, priority: Priority = 'normal'): Promise<SendResult[]> {
    const available = this.selector.available();
    const results = await Promise.allSettled(available.map(l => l.send(data, { priority })));
    return results.map(r => r.status === 'fulfilled' ? r.value : { success: false, error: 'Link failed' });
  }

  predictNextWindow(provider: SatelliteProvider): OrbitalPass | null {
    if (!this.groundStation) return null;
    const tleName = provider === 'iridium' ? 'IRIDIUM' : 'STARLINK';
    return this.tlePredictor.nextPass(tleName, this.groundStation);
  }

  addTLE(tle: TwoLineElement): void {
    this.tlePredictor.addTLE(tle);
  }

  getStats(): SatelliteRouterStats {
    return { ...this.stats, uptime: Date.now() - this.stats.startedAt };
  }

  getLinkMetrics(): LinkMetrics[] {
    return this.links.map(l => l.getMetrics());
  }

  private async processQueue(): Promise<void> {
    while (this.queue.size() > 0) {
      const link = this.selector.select('normal');
      if (!link) break;

      const msg = this.queue.dequeue();
      if (!msg) break;

      const result = await link.send(msg.data, { priority: msg.priority });
      if (result.success) {
        this.stats.totalSent++;
        this.stats.totalBytesSent += msg.data.length;
        this.emit('message:delivered', { id: msg.id, latencyMs: Date.now() - msg.queuedAt });
      } else {
        msg.attempts++;
        if (msg.attempts < msg.maxAttempts && msg.expiresAt > Date.now()) {
          this.queue.enqueue(msg); // Re-queue
        } else {
          this.stats.totalFailed++;
          this.emit('message:dropped', { id: msg.id, attempts: msg.attempts });
        }
      }
    }
    this.stats.queueDepth = this.queue.size();
  }

  private async healthChecks(): Promise<void> {
    await Promise.allSettled(this.links.map(l => l.healthCheck()));
    this.updateStats();
  }

  private updateStats(): void {
    const available = this.selector.available();
    this.stats.linksAvailable = available.length;
    if (available.length > 0) {
      this.stats.activeLink = this.selector.select()?.provider ?? null;
    } else {
      this.stats.activeLink = null;
    }
  }
}

export default SatelliteRouter;

--- FILE: packages/sdk/src/phase11/powerSovereignty.ts ---
/**
 * UBE Phase 11 — powerSovereignty.ts
 * Energy Sovereignty: Solar MPPT, Battery SOC, Load Shedding, RF Harvesting
 *
 * A node that runs out of power ceases to exist. Power sovereignty means the
 * node controls its own energy: harvests from solar/RF/thermal, stores in
 * batteries, budgets consumption by operation priority, and degrades gracefully
 * rather than dying suddenly. The mesh stays alive even when grid power is gone.
 *
 * Components:
 *   MPPTController       — Maximum Power Point Tracking for solar panels (P&O algorithm)
 *   BatteryMonitor       — State of Charge via Coulomb counting + Kalman filter
 *   LoadSheddingEngine   — Priority-based load shedding under power constraints
 *   RFEnergyHarvester    — Ambient RF energy harvesting from WiFi/cellular/broadcast
 *   ThermalHarvester     — Peltier/thermoelectric generation from temperature gradients
 *   PowerBudgetManager   — Per-operation energy accounting
 *   UPSController        — Seamless switchover between power sources
 *   PowerSovereigntyNode — Orchestrator: keeps node alive under any power condition
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// CONSTANTS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

const MPPT_PERTURBATION_STEP_V = 0.05;   // Voltage perturbation step (V)
const MPPT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS = 1_000;   // MPPT update interval
const BATTERY_CAPACITY_WH_DEFAULT = 100; // Wh (LiFePO4 100Wh default)
const BATTERY_CELL_NOMINAL_V = 3.2;      // LiFePO4 nominal voltage
const BATTERY_FULL_V = 3.65;             // LiFePO4 full charge voltage
const BATTERY_EMPTY_V = 2.80;            // LiFePO4 cutoff voltage
const COULOMB_EFFICIENCY = 0.98;         // Coulombic efficiency of LiFePO4
const KALMAN_PROCESS_NOISE = 0.001;      // SOC process noise variance
const KALMAN_MEASUREMENT_NOISE = 0.01;   // Voltage measurement noise variance
const THERMAL_THROTTLE_TEMP_C = 70;      // CPU throttle temperature
const THERMAL_SHUTDOWN_TEMP_C = 85;      // Emergency shutdown temperature
const RF_HARVEST_EFFICIENCY = 0.15;      // Typical RF-to-DC conversion efficiency
const LOAD_SHED_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS = 5_000;
const POWER_LOG_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// TYPES
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export type PowerSource = 'solar' | 'battery' | 'grid' | 'rf_harvest' | 'thermal' | 'wind' | 'usb';
export type BatteryChemistry = 'lifepo4' | 'li_ion' | 'lead_acid' | 'nimh' | 'supercap';
export type LoadClass = 'critical' | 'high' | 'normal' | 'low' | 'background' | 'idle';
export type PowerState = 'full' | 'normal' | 'conservation' | 'emergency' | 'critical' | 'shutdown';

export interface SolarPanel {
  id: string;
  peakWatts: number;          // Rated peak power (W)
  voc: number;                // Open circuit voltage (V)
  isc: number;                // Short circuit current (A)
  vmp: number;                // Max power point voltage (V)
  imp: number;                // Max power point current (A)
  tempCoeffPmax: number;      // Temperature coefficient of Pmax (%/°C)
  currentVoltage: number;     // Current operating voltage
  currentCurrent: number;     // Current operating current
  temperature: number;        // Panel temperature (°C)
}

export interface Battery {
  id: string;
  chemistry: BatteryChemistry;
  capacityWh: number;
  capacityAh: number;
  nominalVoltage: number;
  voltage: number;
  current: number;            // Positive = charging, negative = discharging
  temperature: number;
  cycleCount: number;
  stateOfCharge: number;      // 0.0–1.0
  stateOfHealth: number;      // 0.0–1.0 (1.0 = new)
  internalResistanceOhm: number;
}

export interface PowerLoad {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  class: LoadClass;
  nominalWatts: number;
  currentWatts: number;

  enabled: boolean;

}

export interface PowerSnapshot {

  source: PowerSource;
  solarWatts: number;
  batteryWatts: number;       // Positive = discharging
  loadWatts: number;
  rfHarvestWatts: number;
  thermalWatts: number;
  gridWatts: number;

  loadsShed: number;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// MPPT CONTROLLER — Perturb & Observe Algorithm
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class MPPTController extends EventEmitter {
  private panels: Map<string, SolarPanel> = new Map();
  private voltageSetpoints: Map<string, number> = new Map();
  private prevPower: Map<string, number> = new Map();
  private prevVoltage: Map<string, number> = new Map();
  private perturbDirection: Map<string, number> = new Map(); // +1 or -1
  private trackingTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private totalOutputWatts: number = 0;

  addPanel(panel: SolarPanel): void {
    this.panels.set(panel.id, panel);
    this.voltageSetpoints.set(panel.id, panel.vmp);
    this.prevPower.set(panel.id, 0);
    this.prevVoltage.set(panel.id, panel.vmp);
    this.perturbDirection.set(panel.id, 1);
  }

  startTracking(): void {
    this.trackingTimer = setInterval(() => this.updateAllPanels(), MPPT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS);
  }

  stopTracking(): void {
    if (this.trackingTimer) clearInterval(this.trackingTimer);
  }

  // P&O MPPT update for one panel
  updatePanel(panelId: string, measuredVoltage: number, measuredCurrent: number): void {
    const panel = this.panels.get(panelId);
    if (!panel) return;

    panel.currentVoltage = measuredVoltage;
    panel.currentCurrent = measuredCurrent;

    const currentPower = measuredVoltage * measuredCurrent;
    const prevP = this.prevPower.get(panelId) ?? 0;
    const prevV = this.prevVoltage.get(panelId) ?? panel.vmp;
    const direction = this.perturbDirection.get(panelId) ?? 1;

    const dP = currentPower - prevP;
    const dV = measuredVoltage - prevV;

    let newDirection = direction;
    if (Math.abs(dP) > 0.001) {
      // If power increased, continue same direction; if decreased, reverse
      newDirection = dP > 0 ? direction : -direction;
    }

    const newSetpoint = this.voltageSetpoints.get(panelId)! + newDirection * MPPT_PERTURBATION_STEP_V;
    const clampedSetpoint = Math.max(panel.vmp * 0.7, Math.min(panel.voc * 0.95, newSetpoint));

    this.voltageSetpoints.set(panelId, clampedSetpoint);
    this.prevPower.set(panelId, currentPower);
    this.prevVoltage.set(panelId, measuredVoltage);
    this.perturbDirection.set(panelId, newDirection);

    this.totalOutputWatts = this.computeTotalOutput();
    this.emit('mppt:update', { panelId, power: currentPower, voltage: measuredVoltage, setpoint: clampedSetpoint });
  }

  // Temperature correction for panel efficiency
  temperatureCorrect(panelId: string, temperature: number): void {
    const panel = this.panels.get(panelId);
    if (!panel) return;
    panel.temperature = temperature;
    // Standard test condition is 25°C
    const deltaT = temperature - 25;
    const correctedVmp = panel.vmp * (1 + panel.tempCoeffPmax / 100 * deltaT);
    // Adjust setpoint to compensate
    this.voltageSetpoints.set(panelId, correctedVmp);
  }

  getSetpoint(panelId: string): number {
    return this.voltageSetpoints.get(panelId) ?? 0;
  }

  getTotalOutputWatts(): number {
    return this.totalOutputWatts;
  }

  getEfficiency(panelId: string): number {
    const panel = this.panels.get(panelId);
    if (!panel) return 0;
    const actual = panel.currentVoltage * panel.currentCurrent;
    const theoretical = panel.peakWatts;
    return theoretical > 0 ? actual / theoretical : 0;
  }

  getIrradiance(panelId: string): number {
    // Estimate irradiance from current power vs rated power
    const panel = this.panels.get(panelId);
    if (!panel) return 0;
    const power = panel.currentVoltage * panel.currentCurrent;
    return (power / panel.peakWatts) * 1000; // W/m²
  }

  private updateAllPanels(): void {
    for (const panel of this.panels.values()) {
      // In production: read ADC for voltage and current
      // Simulation: slight random variation around MPP
      const irradiance = 800 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200;
      const simVoltage = panel.vmp * (0.95 + Math.random() * 0.05);
      const simCurrent = panel.imp * (irradiance / 1000) * (0.9 + Math.random() * 0.1);
      this.updatePanel(panel.id, simVoltage, simCurrent);
    }
  }

  private computeTotalOutput(): number {
    let total = 0;
    for (const panel of this.panels.values()) {
      total += panel.currentVoltage * panel.currentCurrent;
    }
    return total;
  }

  panelCount(): number { return this.panels.size; }
  allPanels(): SolarPanel[] { return Array.from(this.panels.values()); }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// BATTERY MONITOR — Coulomb Counting + Kalman Filter SOC
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface KalmanState {
  soc: number;           // State of charge estimate
  variance: number;      // Estimation uncertainty
}

export class BatteryMonitor extends EventEmitter {
  private batteries: Map<string, Battery> = new Map();
  private kalmanStates: Map<string, KalmanState> = new Map();
  private lastSampleTime: Map<string, number> = new Map();
  private monitorTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

  addBattery(battery: Battery): void {
    this.batteries.set(battery.id, battery);
    this.kalmanStates.set(battery.id, { soc: battery.stateOfCharge, variance: 0.1 });
    this.lastSampleTime.set(battery.id, Date.now());
  }

  update(batteryId: string, voltage: number, current: number, temperature: number): void {
    const battery = this.batteries.get(batteryId);
    if (!battery) return;

    const now = Date.now();
    const dtHours = (now - (this.lastSampleTime.get(batteryId) ?? now)) / 3_600_000;
    this.lastSampleTime.set(batteryId, now);

    battery.voltage = voltage;
    battery.current = current;
    battery.temperature = temperature;

    // Coulomb counting: integrate current over time
    const coulombDelta = (current * dtHours * COULOMB_EFFICIENCY) / battery.capacityAh;
    const coulombSOC = battery.stateOfCharge + coulombDelta;

    // OCV-based SOC estimate (Open Circuit Voltage method)
    const ocvSOC = this.ocvToSOC(battery.chemistry, voltage + current * battery.internalResistanceOhm);

    // Kalman filter fusion
    const kalman = this.kalmanStates.get(batteryId)!;
    const predicted = kalman.soc + coulombDelta;
    const predictedVariance = kalman.variance + KALMAN_PROCESS_NOISE;

    // Kalman gain
    const K = predictedVariance / (predictedVariance + KALMAN_MEASUREMENT_NOISE);
    const updated = predicted + K * (ocvSOC - predicted);
    const updatedVariance = (1 - K) * predictedVariance;

    this.kalmanStates.set(batteryId, { soc: updated, variance: updatedVariance });
    battery.stateOfCharge = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, updated));

    // Health estimation: capacity fade from cycle count
    battery.stateOfHealth = Math.max(0.5, 1 - battery.cycleCount * 0.0001);

    // Internal resistance estimation via voltage sag
    if (Math.abs(current) > 0.1) {
      const sagV = Math.abs(voltage - this.ocvFromSOC(battery.chemistry, battery.stateOfCharge));
      battery.internalResistanceOhm = sagV / Math.abs(current);
    }

    this.emit('battery:update', {
      id: batteryId,
      soc: battery.stateOfCharge,
      voltage,
      current,
      temperature,
      stateOfHealth: battery.stateOfHealth,
    });

    // Thermal protection
    if (temperature > THERMAL_THROTTLE_TEMP_C) {
      this.emit('battery:thermal_warning', { id: batteryId, temperature });
    }
    if (temperature > THERMAL_SHUTDOWN_TEMP_C) {
      this.emit('battery:thermal_critical', { id: batteryId, temperature });
    }
  }

  estimateRemainingHours(batteryId: string, loadWatts: number): number {
    const battery = this.batteries.get(batteryId);
    if (!battery || loadWatts <= 0) return Infinity;
    const availableWh = battery.stateOfCharge * battery.capacityWh * battery.stateOfHealth;
    return availableWh / loadWatts;
  }

  getSOC(batteryId: string): number {
    return this.batteries.get(batteryId)?.stateOfCharge ?? 0;
  }

  getTotalSOC(): number {
    const batteries = Array.from(this.batteries.values());
    if (batteries.length === 0) return 0;
    const totalWh = batteries.reduce((s, b) => s + b.capacityWh, 0);
    const availWh = batteries.reduce((s, b) => s + b.stateOfCharge * b.capacityWh, 0);
    return totalWh > 0 ? availWh / totalWh : 0;
  }

  getAggregatedCapacityWh(): number {
    return Array.from(this.batteries.values()).reduce((s, b) => s + b.capacityWh * b.stateOfHealth, 0);
  }

  startMonitoring(): void {
    this.monitorTimer = setInterval(() => {
      for (const battery of this.batteries.values()) {
        // In production: read from ADC/BMS via I2C/SPI
        this.emit('battery:poll', { id: battery.id });
      }
    }, 5_000);
  }

  stopMonitoring(): void {
    if (this.monitorTimer) clearInterval(this.monitorTimer);
  }

  // OCV → SOC lookup table (LiFePO4 characteristic curve)
  private ocvToSOC(chemistry: BatteryChemistry, voltage: number): number {
    const curves: Record<BatteryChemistry, Array<[number, number]>> = {
      lifepo4: [
        [2.80, 0.00], [3.00, 0.05], [3.10, 0.10], [3.20, 0.20],
        [3.25, 0.40], [3.30, 0.60], [3.35, 0.80], [3.45, 0.95], [3.65, 1.00],
      ],
      li_ion: [
        [3.00, 0.00], [3.30, 0.10], [3.60, 0.30], [3.80, 0.60],
        [4.00, 0.80], [4.10, 0.90], [4.20, 1.00],
      ],
      lead_acid: [
        [11.8, 0.00], [12.0, 0.20], [12.2, 0.40], [12.4, 0.60],
        [12.6, 0.80], [12.7, 0.90], [12.8, 1.00],
      ],
      nimh: [[1.0, 0.0], [1.2, 0.5], [1.4, 1.0]],
      supercap: [[0.0, 0.0], [2.7, 1.0]],
    };

    const curve = curves[chemistry] ?? curves.lifepo4;
    if (voltage <= curve[0][0]) return 0;
    if (voltage >= curve[curve.length - 1][0]) return 1;

    for (let i = 0; i < curve.length - 1; i++) {
      if (voltage >= curve[i][0] && voltage < curve[i + 1][0]) {
        const t = (voltage - curve[i][0]) / (curve[i + 1][0] - curve[i][0]);
        return curve[i][1] + t * (curve[i + 1][1] - curve[i][1]);
      }
    }
    return 0.5;
  }

  private ocvFromSOC(chemistry: BatteryChemistry, soc: number): number {
    const lifepo4: Array<[number, number]> = [
      [0.00, 2.80], [0.05, 3.00], [0.10, 3.10], [0.20, 3.20],
      [0.40, 3.25], [0.60, 3.30], [0.80, 3.35], [0.95, 3.45], [1.00, 3.65],
    ];
    const curve = chemistry === 'lifepo4' ? lifepo4 : lifepo4;
    for (let i = 0; i < curve.length - 1; i++) {
      if (soc >= curve[i][0] && soc < curve[i + 1][0]) {
        const t = (soc - curve[i][0]) / (curve[i + 1][0] - curve[i][0]);
        return curve[i][1] + t * (curve[i + 1][1] - curve[i][1]);
      }
    }
    return 3.2;
  }

  allBatteries(): Battery[] { return Array.from(this.batteries.values()); }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// RF ENERGY HARVESTER
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RFSource {
  frequency: number;    // Hz
  powerDensity: number; // μW/cm²
  type: 'wifi' | 'cellular' | 'broadcast_tv' | 'broadcast_fm' | 'gsm' | 'lte' | '5g';
  antennaSizeM2: number;
}

export interface HarvestResult {
  totalPowerUW: number;   // Microwatts
  totalPowerMW: number;   // Milliwatts
  sources: Array<{ type: string; powerUW: number }>;
  efficiency: number;
  storedEnergy: boolean;
}

export class RFEnergyHarvester extends EventEmitter {
  private sources: RFSource[] = [];
  private harvestedTodayUJ: number = 0;  // Microjoules
  private rectifierEfficiency: number = RF_HARVEST_EFFICIENCY;
  private storageSuperCapacitorUF: number = 1_000; // 1mF storage capacitor
  private storagVoltage: number = 0;
  private readonly storedMaxV: number = 5.0;

  addSource(source: RFSource): void { this.sources.push(source); }

  harvest(): HarvestResult {
    const sourceResults: Array<{ type: string; powerUW: number }> = [];
    let totalPowerUW = 0;

    for (const source of this.sources) {
      // Friis transmission: P_rx = P_tx * G_tx * G_rx * (λ/(4πd))²
      // Simplified: use measured power density directly
      const capturedPowerUW = source.powerDensity * source.antennaSizeM2 * 10_000; // Convert cm² to m²
      const harvestedUW = capturedPowerUW * this.rectifierEfficiency;
      sourceResults.push({ type: source.type, powerUW: harvestedUW });
      totalPowerUW += harvestedUW;
    }

    // Store in supercapacitor: E = ½CV²
    const harvestedJoules = (totalPowerUW * 1e-6) * (MPPT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS / 1000);
    const currentEnergy = 0.5 * (this.storageSuperCapacitorUF * 1e-6) * this.storedVoltage ** 2;
    const newEnergy = currentEnergy + harvestedJoules;
    this.storedVoltage = Math.min(
      this.storedMaxV,
      Math.sqrt((2 * newEnergy) / (this.storageSuperCapacitorUF * 1e-6)),
    );

    this.harvestedTodayUJ += totalPowerUW * (MPPT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS / 1000);
    const stored = this.storedVoltage >= 3.0; // Enough to power MCU

    this.emit('harvest', { totalPowerUW, storedVoltage: this.storedVoltage });
    return {
      totalPowerUW,
      totalPowerMW: totalPowerUW / 1000,
      sources: sourceResults,
      efficiency: this.rectifierEfficiency,
      storedEnergy: stored,
    };
  }

  getStoredVoltage(): number { return this.storedVoltage; }
  getStoredEnergyUJ(): number {
    return 0.5 * (this.storageSuperCapacitorUF * 1e-6) * this.storedVoltage ** 2 * 1e6;
  }
  getHarvestedTodayUJ(): number { return this.harvestedTodayUJ; }

  private get storedVoltage(): number { return this.storagVoltage; }
  private set storedVoltage(v: number) { this.storagVoltage = v; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// LOAD SHEDDING ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ShedEvent {
  loadId: string;
  action: 'shed' | 'restore';
  reason: PowerState;
  timestamp: number;
  previousWatts: number;
}

export class LoadSheddingEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private loads: Map<string, PowerLoad> = new Map();
  private shedHistory: ShedEvent[] = [];

  addLoad(load: PowerLoad): void {
    this.loads.set(load.id, load);
  }

  updateLoad(loadId: string, currentWatts: number): void {
    const load = this.loads.get(loadId);
    if (load) load.currentWatts = currentWatts;
  }

  // Determine which loads to shed for a given power state
  computeShedding(powerState: PowerState, availableWatts: number): {
    toShed: PowerLoad[];
    toRestore: PowerLoad[];
    projectedLoad: number;
  } {
    const now = Date.now();
    const thresholds: Record<PowerState, { maxLoadFraction: number }> = {
      full: { maxLoadFraction: 1.0 },
      normal: { maxLoadFraction: 0.9 },
      conservation: { maxLoadFraction: 0.6 },
      emergency: { maxLoadFraction: 0.3 },
      critical: { maxLoadFraction: 0.15 },
      shutdown: { maxLoadFraction: 0.05 },
    };

    const maxLoad = availableWatts * thresholds[powerState].maxLoadFraction;
    const allLoads = Array.from(this.loads.values()).sort((a, b) => a.shedOrder - b.shedOrder);

    let totalLoad = 0;
    const toShed: PowerLoad[] = [];
    const toRestore: PowerLoad[] = [];

    for (const load of allLoads) {
      const canToggle = now - load.lastToggle > load.minOnTimeMs;

      if (load.enabled) {
        if (totalLoad + load.currentWatts <= maxLoad) {
          totalLoad += load.currentWatts;
        } else if (load.canShed && canToggle && powerState !== 'full' && powerState !== 'normal') {
          toShed.push(load);
        } else {
          totalLoad += load.currentWatts;
        }
      } else {
        // Consider restoring if we have headroom
        if (totalLoad + load.nominalWatts <= maxLoad * 0.85 && powerState !== 'critical' && powerState !== 'shutdown') {
          toRestore.push(load);
          totalLoad += load.nominalWatts;
        }
      }
    }

    return { toShed, toRestore, projectedLoad: totalLoad };
  }

  applyShedding(toShed: PowerLoad[], toRestore: PowerLoad[], reason: PowerState): void {
    const now = Date.now();

    for (const load of toShed) {
      if (load.enabled) {
        this.shedHistory.push({ loadId: load.id, action: 'shed', reason, timestamp: now, previousWatts: load.currentWatts });
        load.enabled = false;
        load.lastToggle = now;
        this.emit('load:shed', { load, reason });
      }
    }

    for (const load of toRestore) {
      if (!load.enabled) {
        this.shedHistory.push({ loadId: load.id, action: 'restore', reason, timestamp: now, previousWatts: 0 });
        load.enabled = true;
        load.lastToggle = now;
        this.emit('load:restore', { load, reason });
      }
    }
  }

  getTotalLoad(): number {
    return Array.from(this.loads.values()).filter(l => l.enabled).reduce((s, l) => s + l.currentWatts, 0);
  }

  getEnabledLoads(): PowerLoad[] {
    return Array.from(this.loads.values()).filter(l => l.enabled);
  }

  getShedLoads(): PowerLoad[] {
    return Array.from(this.loads.values()).filter(l => !l.enabled);
  }

  getShedHistory(limit: number = 100): ShedEvent[] {
    return this.shedHistory.slice(-limit);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// POWER BUDGET MANAGER — Per-operation energy accounting
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface OperationEnergyCost {
  operationId: string;
  wattsTypical: number;
  durationMs: number;
  priority: LoadClass;
  canDefer: boolean;
}

export interface EnergyBudget {
  availableWh: number;
  reservedWh: number;
  spendableWh: number;
  operations: Map<string, number>; // operationId -> Wh spent
}

export class PowerBudgetManager {
  private costs: Map<string, OperationEnergyCost> = new Map();
  private spentWh: Map<string, number> = new Map();
  private totalCapacityWh: number;
  private reserveFraction: number = 0.20; // Keep 20% reserved

  constructor(totalCapacityWh: number) {
    this.totalCapacityWh = totalCapacityWh;
  }

  registerOperation(cost: OperationEnergyCost): void {
    this.costs.set(cost.operationId, cost);
  }

  canAfford(operationId: string, currentSOC: number): boolean {
    const cost = this.costs.get(operationId);
    if (!cost) return true;

    const availableWh = currentSOC * this.totalCapacityWh * (1 - this.reserveFraction);
    const costWh = (cost.wattsTypical * cost.durationMs) / 3_600_000;
    return availableWh >= costWh;
  }

  recordUsage(operationId: string, actualWatts: number, durationMs: number): void {
    const usedWh = (actualWatts * durationMs) / 3_600_000;
    const prev = this.spentWh.get(operationId) ?? 0;
    this.spentWh.set(operationId, prev + usedWh);
  }

  getBudget(currentSOC: number): EnergyBudget {
    const available = currentSOC * this.totalCapacityWh;
    const reserved = this.totalCapacityWh * this.reserveFraction;
    return {
      availableWh: available,
      reservedWh: reserved,
      spendableWh: Math.max(0, available - reserved),
      operations: new Map(this.spentWh),
    };
  }

  estimateBatteryLife(currentSOC: number, loadWatts: number): number {
    const available = currentSOC * this.totalCapacityWh;
    return loadWatts > 0 ? available / loadWatts : Infinity;
  }

  setTotalCapacity(wh: number): void {
    this.totalCapacityWh = wh;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// UPS CONTROLLER — Seamless source switchover
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export type SwitchoverReason = 'grid_fail' | 'battery_low' | 'solar_available' | 'manual' | 'optimization';

export interface SwitchoverEvent {
  from: PowerSource;
  to: PowerSource;
  reason: SwitchoverReason;
  timestamp: number;
  batterySOC: number;
  loadWatts: number;
}

export class UPSController extends EventEmitter {
  private currentSource: PowerSource = 'grid';
  private availableSources: Set<PowerSource> = new Set();
  private switchoverHistory: SwitchoverEvent[] = [];
  private readonly switchoverDelayMs: number = 20; // 20ms transfer time (UPS grade)

  declare(source: PowerSource, available: boolean): void {
    if (available) this.availableSources.add(source);
    else this.availableSources.delete(source);
  }

  async switchTo(
    source: PowerSource,
    reason: SwitchoverReason,
    batterySOC: number,
    loadWatts: number,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!this.availableSources.has(source)) return false;
    if (source === this.currentSource) return true;

    const from = this.currentSource;
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, this.switchoverDelayMs));
    this.currentSource = source;

    const event: SwitchoverEvent = { from, to: source, reason, timestamp: Date.now(), batterySOC, loadWatts };
    this.switchoverHistory.push(event);
    this.emit('switchover', event);
    return true;
  }

  selectBestSource(solarWatts: number, batterySOC: number): PowerSource {
    if (this.availableSources.has('grid')) return 'grid';
    if (solarWatts > 5 && this.availableSources.has('solar')) return 'solar';
    if (batterySOC > 0.1 && this.availableSources.has('battery')) return 'battery';
    if (this.availableSources.has('rf_harvest')) return 'rf_harvest';
    if (this.availableSources.has('thermal')) return 'thermal';
    return 'battery'; // Last resort
  }

  getCurrentSource(): PowerSource { return this.currentSource; }
  getHistory(): SwitchoverEvent[] { return [...this.switchoverHistory]; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// POWER STATE MACHINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

function socToPowerState(soc: number, inputWatts: number, loadWatts: number): PowerState {
  const netWatts = inputWatts - loadWatts;
  if (soc >= 0.80 || (soc >= 0.50 && netWatts > 0)) return 'full';
  if (soc >= 0.50) return 'normal';
  if (soc >= 0.30) return 'conservation';
  if (soc >= 0.15) return 'emergency';
  if (soc >= 0.05) return 'critical';
  return 'shutdown';
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// THERMAL HARVESTER
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ThermalHarvester extends EventEmitter {
  private hotSideTemp: number = 60;  // °C (e.g., CPU heat sink)
  private coldSideTemp: number = 25; // °C (ambient)
  private readonly seebeckCoefficient: number = 0.05; // V/K (typical thermoelectric)
  private readonly internalResistanceOhm: number = 3.0;
  private readonly thermalResistance: number = 0.5; // K/W

  update(hotTemp: number, coldTemp: number): void {
    this.hotSideTemp = hotTemp;
    this.coldSideTemp = coldTemp;
    this.emit('thermal:update', { hot: hotTemp, cold: coldTemp, power: this.getOutputWatts() });
  }

  getOpenCircuitVoltage(): number {
    return this.seebeckCoefficient * (this.hotSideTemp - this.coldSideTemp);
  }

  getMaxOutputWatts(): number {
    const voc = this.getOpenCircuitVoltage();
    // Maximum power transfer: load R = internal R
    return (voc * voc) / (4 * this.internalResistanceOhm);
  }

  getOutputWatts(): number {
    return this.getMaxOutputWatts() * 0.7; // Practical efficiency
  }

  getCarnotEfficiency(): number {
    const hotK = this.hotSideTemp + 273.15;
    const coldK = this.coldSideTemp + 273.15;
    return 1 - coldK / hotK;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// POWER SOVEREIGNTY NODE — Main Orchestrator
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface PowerSovereigntyConfig {
  panels?: SolarPanel[];
  batteries?: Battery[];
  loads?: PowerLoad[];
  enableRFHarvest?: boolean;
  enableThermal?: boolean;
  rfSources?: RFSource[];
  monthlyBatteryBudgetWh?: number;
}

export interface PowerSovereigntyStatus {
  powerState: PowerState;
  activeSource: PowerSource;
  solarWatts: number;
  loadWatts: number;
  batterySOC: number;
  batteryVoltage: number;
  batteryHoursRemaining: number;
  rfHarvestMW: number;
  thermalWatts: number;
  loadsActive: number;
  loadsShed: number;
  powerSelfSufficient: boolean;
  snapshots: PowerSnapshot[];
}

export class PowerSovereigntyNode extends EventEmitter {
  public readonly mppt: MPPTController;
  public readonly batteryMonitor: BatteryMonitor;
  public readonly loadShedder: LoadSheddingEngine;
  public readonly rfHarvester: RFEnergyHarvester;
  public readonly thermalHarvester: ThermalHarvester;
  public readonly budgetManager: PowerBudgetManager;
  public readonly ups: UPSController;

  private powerState: PowerState = 'normal';
  private snapshots: PowerSnapshot[] = [];
  private running: boolean = false;

  private shedCheckTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private logTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

  constructor(config: PowerSovereigntyConfig) {
    super();
    this.mppt = new MPPTController();
    this.batteryMonitor = new BatteryMonitor();
    this.loadShedder = new LoadSheddingEngine();
    this.rfHarvester = new RFEnergyHarvester();
    this.thermalHarvester = new ThermalHarvester();
    this.budgetManager = new PowerBudgetManager(config.monthlyBatteryBudgetWh ?? BATTERY_CAPACITY_WH_DEFAULT);
    this.ups = new UPSController();

    // Register configured components
    if (config.panels) config.panels.forEach(p => this.mppt.addPanel(p));
    if (config.batteries) config.batteries.forEach(b => { this.batteryMonitor.addBattery(b); this.ups.declare('battery', true); });
    if (config.loads) config.loads.forEach(l => this.loadShedder.addLoad(l));
    if (config.rfSources) config.rfSources.forEach(s => this.rfHarvester.addSource(s));

    if (config.panels && config.panels.length > 0) this.ups.declare('solar', true);
    if (config.enableRFHarvest) this.ups.declare('rf_harvest', true);
    if (config.enableThermal) this.ups.declare('thermal', true);

    this.registerDefaultOperations();
    this.wireEvents();
  }

  start(): void {
    this.mppt.startTracking();
    this.batteryMonitor.startMonitoring();
    this.running = true;

    this.shedCheckTimer = setInterval(() => this.runPowerCycle(), LOAD_SHED_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS);
    this.logTimer = setInterval(() => this.logSnapshot(), POWER_LOG_INTERVAL_MS);

    this.emit('started');
  }

  stop(): void {
    this.running = false;
    this.mppt.stopTracking();
    this.batteryMonitor.stopMonitoring();
    if (this.shedCheckTimer) clearInterval(this.shedCheckTimer);
    if (this.logTimer) clearInterval(this.logTimer);
    this.emit('stopped');
  }

  canRun(operationId: string): boolean {
    const soc = this.batteryMonitor.getTotalSOC();
    return this.budgetManager.canAfford(operationId, soc);
  }

  recordOperationUsage(operationId: string, watts: number, durationMs: number): void {
    this.budgetManager.recordUsage(operationId, watts, durationMs);
  }

  getStatus(): PowerSovereigntyStatus {
    const soc = this.batteryMonitor.getTotalSOC();
    const battVoltage = this.batteryMonitor.allBatteries()[0]?.voltage ?? 0;
    const solarWatts = this.mppt.getTotalOutputWatts();
    const loadWatts = this.loadShedder.getTotalLoad();
    const rfResult = this.rfHarvester.harvest();
    const thermalWatts = this.thermalHarvester.getOutputWatts();

    return {
      powerState: this.powerState,
      activeSource: this.ups.getCurrentSource(),
      solarWatts,
      loadWatts,
      batterySOC: soc,
      batteryVoltage: battVoltage,
      batteryHoursRemaining: this.batteryMonitor.allBatteries()[0]
        ? this.batteryMonitor.estimateRemainingHours(this.batteryMonitor.allBatteries()[0].id, loadWatts)
        : 0,
      rfHarvestMW: rfResult.totalPowerMW,
      thermalWatts,
      loadsActive: this.loadShedder.getEnabledLoads().length,
      loadsShed: this.loadShedder.getShedLoads().length,
      powerSelfSufficient: solarWatts + rfResult.totalPowerMW / 1000 + thermalWatts >= loadWatts,
      snapshots: this.snapshots.slice(-60),
    };
  }

  private runPowerCycle(): void {
    const soc = this.batteryMonitor.getTotalSOC();
    const solarWatts = this.mppt.getTotalOutputWatts();
    const loadWatts = this.loadShedder.getTotalLoad();
    const inputWatts = solarWatts;

    const newState = socToPowerState(soc, inputWatts, loadWatts);

    if (newState !== this.powerState) {
      const prev = this.powerState;
      this.powerState = newState;
      this.emit('power_state:change', { from: prev, to: newState, soc, solarWatts, loadWatts });
    }

    // Run load shedding
    const { toShed, toRestore } = this.loadShedder.computeShedding(this.powerState, inputWatts || soc * 20);
    if (toShed.length > 0 || toRestore.length > 0) {
      this.loadShedder.applyShedding(toShed, toRestore, this.powerState);
    }

    // Switchover if needed
    const bestSource = this.ups.selectBestSource(solarWatts, soc);
    if (bestSource !== this.ups.getCurrentSource()) {
      this.ups.switchTo(bestSource, 'optimization', soc, loadWatts);
    }

    if (this.powerState === 'shutdown') {
      this.emit('power:shutdown_imminent', { soc, hoursRemaining: 0 });
    }
  }

  private logSnapshot(): void {
    const s = this.getStatus();
    const rf = this.rfHarvester.harvest();
    const snap: PowerSnapshot = {
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      source: s.activeSource,
      solarWatts: s.solarWatts,
      batteryWatts: s.batterySOC * 10,
      loadWatts: s.loadWatts,
      rfHarvestWatts: rf.totalPowerMW / 1000,
      thermalWatts: s.thermalWatts,
      gridWatts: 0,
      netWatts: s.solarWatts - s.loadWatts,
      batterySOC: s.batterySOC,
      batteryVoltage: s.batteryVoltage,
      batteryTemperature: this.batteryMonitor.allBatteries()[0]?.temperature ?? 25,
      powerState: this.powerState,
      loadsActive: s.loadsActive,
      loadsShed: s.loadsShed,
    };
    this.snapshots.push(snap);
    if (this.snapshots.length > 1440) this.snapshots.shift(); // Keep 24h at 1-min intervals
    this.emit('snapshot', snap);
  }

  private registerDefaultOperations(): void {
    const ops: OperationEnergyCost[] = [
      { operationId: 'mesh_tx', wattsTypical: 2.5, durationMs: 100, priority: 'high', canDefer: false },
      { operationId: 'mesh_rx', wattsTypical: 0.5, durationMs: 1000, priority: 'critical', canDefer: false },
      { operationId: 'lora_tx', wattsTypical: 0.8, durationMs: 500, priority: 'high', canDefer: true },
      { operationId: 'crypto_op', wattsTypical: 1.5, durationMs: 50, priority: 'normal', canDefer: true },
      { operationId: 'consensus', wattsTypical: 3.0, durationMs: 2000, priority: 'high', canDefer: false },
      { operationId: 'dht_lookup', wattsTypical: 1.0, durationMs: 5000, priority: 'normal', canDefer: true },
      { operationId: 'satellite_tx', wattsTypical: 5.0, durationMs: 10000, priority: 'low', canDefer: true },
    ];
    ops.forEach(op => this.budgetManager.registerOperation(op));
  }

  private wireEvents(): void {
    this.batteryMonitor.on('battery:thermal_critical', (data) => {
      this.emit('emergency:thermal', data);
      this.powerState = 'shutdown';
    });
    this.loadShedder.on('load:shed', (data) => this.emit('load:shed', data));
    this.loadShedder.on('load:restore', (data) => this.emit('load:restore', data));
    this.ups.on('switchover', (event) => this.emit('power:switchover', event));
  }
}

export default PowerSovereigntyNode;

--- FILE: packages/sdk/src/phase11/meshConsensus.ts ---
/**
 * UBE Phase 11 — meshConsensus.ts
 * Byzantine Fault Tolerant Consensus — Tendermint Protocol
 *
 * Consensus is what separates a mesh of nodes from a sovereign distributed system.
 * Without consensus, any node can lie, fork the state, or replay old decisions.
 * With BFT consensus, up to f < n/3 malicious nodes cannot corrupt the system.
 *
 * Protocol: Tendermint (used by Cosmos, Celestia, Penumbra)
 * Safety: No two honest nodes commit different blocks at the same height (ever)
 * Liveness: Progress guaranteed when >2/3 of validators are honest and online
 *
 * Phases per round:
 *   PROPOSE   → Leader broadcasts a Block proposal
 *   PREVOTE   → Each validator votes on the proposal (or nil)
 *   PRECOMMIT → Each validator precommits if 2/3+ prevotes for same block
 *   COMMIT    → Block committed when 2/3+ precommits for same block
 *
 * View change (round change): automatic timeout escalation if no progress
 *
 * Components:
 *   Block              — Unit of consensus (batch of transactions)
 *   Vote               — Signed message: prevote or precommit
 *   ValidatorSet       — Dynamic set of voting nodes with weights
 *   RoundState         — State machine for one consensus round
 *   ProposerSelector   — Round-robin weighted proposer election
 *   CommitLog          — Append-only log of committed blocks
 *   ConsensusEngine    — Orchestrates the full protocol
 */

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { NodeIdentity } from './meshNode';

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// CONSTANTS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

const CONSENSUS_PROPOSE_TIMEOUT_MS = 3_000;
const CONSENSUS_PREVOTE_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_000;
const CONSENSUS_PRECOMMIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_000;
const CONSENSUS_COMMIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 1_000;
const CONSENSUS_TIMEOUT_DELTA_MS = 500;   // Add per round for adaptive timeouts
const MAX_BLOCK_TRANSACTIONS = 1000;
const MAX_BLOCK_BYTES = 1_048_576;        // 1 MB
const COMMIT_LOG_MAX = 100_000;
const BFT_THRESHOLD_NUMERATOR = 2;
const BFT_THRESHOLD_DENOMINATOR = 3;
const ROUND_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS = 60_000;
const VALIDATOR_MAX_MISSED_ROUNDS = 10;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// TYPES
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export type VoteType = 'PREVOTE' | 'PRECOMMIT';
export type RoundStep = 'PROPOSE' | 'PREVOTE' | 'PRECOMMIT' | 'COMMIT' | 'NEW_HEIGHT';
export type ConsensusMessageType = 'PROPOSAL' | 'VOTE' | 'ROUND_CHANGE' | 'COMMIT_CERT' | 'SYNC_REQUEST' | 'SYNC_RESPONSE';

export interface Transaction {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  data: Buffer;
  sender: string;
  timestamp: number;
  signature: string;
  fee: number;
}

export interface BlockHeader {
  height: number;
  round: number;
  timestamp: number;
  prevBlockHash: string;
  txRoot: string;           // Merkle root of transactions
  stateRoot: string;        // Merkle root of state
  validatorsHash: string;   // Hash of current validator set
  proposer: string;         // hex nodeId of proposer
  chainId: string;
}

export interface Block {
  header: BlockHeader;
  transactions: Transaction[];
  hash: string;
  commitCertificate?: CommitCertificate;
}

export interface Vote {
  type: VoteType;
  height: number;
  round: number;
  blockHash: string | null;   // null = nil vote
  validatorId: string;
  validatorPublicKey: string;
  timestamp: number;
  signature: string;
}

export interface Proposal {
  height: number;
  round: number;
  polRound: number;           // Proof-of-Lock round (-1 if none)
  block: Block;
  proposerId: string;
  timestamp: number;
  signature: string;
}

export interface CommitCertificate {
  height: number;
  round: number;
  blockHash: string;
  signatures: Array<{ validatorId: string; signature: string }>;
}

export interface ValidatorInfo {
  nodeId: string;
  publicKey: string;
