/**
 * UBE Phase 2 — Cryptographic Sovereignty
 * abe.ts — Attribute-Based Encryption System
 *
 * MATHEMATICAL GUARANTEE: Decryption succeeds if and only if the decryptor's
 * attribute set satisfies the access policy encoded in the ciphertext (CP-ABE)
 * or the key policy (KP-ABE). Policy is not enforced by a server — it is
 * enforced by the mathematics of bilinear pairings.
 *
 * SCHEMES IMPLEMENTED:
 *   1. CP-ABE  — Ciphertext-Policy ABE (Waters 2011, large-universe)
 *   2. KP-ABE  — Key-Policy ABE (Goyal-Pandey-Sahai-Waters 2006)
 *   3. MA-ABE  — Multi-Authority ABE (Chase 2007 + Rouselakis-Waters 2015)
 *   4. HABE    — Hierarchical ABE for organizational structures
 *
 * MATHEMATICAL PRIMITIVES:
 *   - Prime field Fp arithmetic (254-bit BN256-compatible prime)
 *   - Elliptic curve groups G1, G2 over Fp / Fp2
 *   - Bilinear pairing e: G1 × G2 → GT (Miller algorithm)
 *   - Linear Secret Sharing Scheme (LSSS) access structures
 *   - Lagrange interpolation for secret reconstruction
 *   - Monotone span programs for policy compilation
 *
 * USE CASES:
 *   - Government: "clearance:TS-SCI AND (dept:NSA OR dept:CIA)"
 *   - Healthcare: "role:doctor AND hospital:Stanford AND specialty:oncology"
 *   - Finance: "clearance:L3 AND (desk:trading OR role:risk-officer)"
 *   - Defense: "rank:colonel AND unit:7thFleet AND need-to-know:operation-X"
 *
 * @module UBE/Phase2/CryptographicSovereignty
 * @version 2.0.0
 */

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 1: TYPES AND INTERFACES
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Single attribute: "dept:finance", "clearance:top-secret", "role:admin" */
export type Attribute = string;

/** Set of attributes held by a decryptor */
export type AttributeSet = ReadonlyArray<Attribute>;

/** ABE scheme variant */
export type ABEScheme = 'CP-ABE' | 'KP-ABE' | 'MA-ABE' | 'HABE';

/** Policy node type in the access tree */
export type PolicyNodeType = 'AND' | 'OR' | 'THRESHOLD' | 'LEAF';

/** Access policy node — recursive tree */
export interface PolicyNode {
  readonly type: PolicyNodeType;
  readonly attribute?: Attribute;          // Only for LEAF nodes
  readonly threshold?: number;             // For THRESHOLD: k-of-n
  readonly children?: ReadonlyArray<PolicyNode>;
  readonly id: string;                     // Unique node ID for LSSS mapping
}

/** Compiled LSSS access structure: (M matrix, ρ row-label function) */
export interface LSSSStructure {
  readonly matrix: ReadonlyArray<ReadonlyArray<bigint>>;  // M: l×n matrix over Zp
  readonly rowLabels: ReadonlyArray<Attribute>;            // ρ: row → attribute
  readonly secretIndex: number;                            // Column containing secret
  readonly prime: bigint;                                  // Field prime
}

/** Group element in G1 (elliptic curve point) */
export interface G1Point {
  readonly x: bigint;
  readonly y: bigint;
  readonly isInfinity: boolean;
}

/** Group element in G2 (point over Fp2) */
export interface G2Point {
  readonly x: readonly [bigint, bigint];  // (x0, x1) in Fp2
  readonly y: readonly [bigint, bigint];  // (y0, y1) in Fp2
  readonly isInfinity: boolean;
}

/** Group element in GT (pairing target group) */
export interface GTElement {
  readonly value: bigint;   // Fp12 element represented compactly
  readonly order: bigint;   // Group order
}

/** ABE Public Key — published, used for encryption */
export interface ABEPublicKey {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly scheme: ABEScheme;
  readonly g: G1Point;          // Generator of G1
  readonly gHat: G2Point;       // Generator of G2
  readonly eggAlpha: GTElement; // e(g,g)^alpha — master public parameter
  readonly h: G1Point;          // g^beta
  readonly authorityId: string;
  readonly attributeUniverse?: ReadonlyArray<Attribute>;  // KP-ABE small universe
  readonly attributeParams: Map<string, G1Point>;         // H(attr)^... per attribute
  readonly created: number;
}

/** ABE Master Secret Key — kept by authority, used for key generation */
export interface ABEMasterKey {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly alpha: bigint;   // Master secret alpha
  readonly beta: bigint;    // Master secret beta
  readonly authorityId: string;
  readonly scheme: ABEScheme;
  readonly created: number;
}

/** ABE Secret Key — issued to user with attribute set (CP-ABE) or policy (KP-ABE) */
export interface ABESecretKey {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly userId: string;
  readonly authorityId: string;
  readonly scheme: ABEScheme;
  /** CP-ABE: attribute set this key covers */
  readonly attributes?: AttributeSet;
  /** KP-ABE: access policy encoded in this key */
  readonly policy?: PolicyNode;
  /** Key components per attribute (CP-ABE) or per policy node (KP-ABE) */
  readonly components: Map<string, { D: G1Point; Dhat: G2Point }>;
  readonly K: G1Point;       // g^(alpha+r)/beta — master component
  readonly Kprime: G1Point;  // g^r
  readonly issued: number;
  readonly expiry?: number;
}

/** ABE Ciphertext */
export interface ABECiphertext {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly scheme: ABEScheme;
  /** CP-ABE: access policy in ciphertext */
  readonly policy?: PolicyNode;
  /** KP-ABE: attribute set in ciphertext */
  readonly attributes?: AttributeSet;
  readonly lsss?: LSSSStructure;
  /** Encrypted symmetric key */
  readonly C:      GTElement;    // M · e(g,g)^(alpha·s)
  readonly Cprime: G1Point;      // g^s
  /** Per-row LSSS components */
  readonly Cy:  ReadonlyArray<G1Point>;    // g^(a_i · s)  per LSSS row
  readonly Dy:  ReadonlyArray<G1Point>;    // H(ρ(i))^s    per LSSS row
  readonly created: number;
  readonly authorityId: string;
  /** Wrapped symmetric ciphertext (AES-256-GCM over derived key) */
  readonly encryptedPayload: Uint8Array;
  readonly nonce: Uint8Array;
  readonly tag: Uint8Array;
}

/** Multi-authority setup */
export interface AuthorityConfig {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly attributeDomain: ReadonlyArray<Attribute>;
  readonly publicKey: ABEPublicKey;
  readonly threshold?: number;  // For threshold multi-authority
}

export interface MultiAuthoritySetup {
  readonly gid: string;         // Global identity space
  readonly authorities: ReadonlyArray<AuthorityConfig>;
  readonly centralPublicKey?: ABEPublicKey;  // Optional central params
}

/** Hierarchical ABE level */
export interface HABELevel {
  readonly depth: number;
  readonly identity: string;
  readonly publicKey: ABEPublicKey;
  readonly delegationKey?: ABESecretKey;
}

/** Result of ABE decryption */
export interface ABEDecryptResult {
  readonly success: boolean;
  readonly plaintext: Uint8Array;
  readonly scheme: ABEScheme;
  readonly satisfiedPolicy?: string;
  readonly usedAttributes?: ReadonlyArray<Attribute>;
  readonly warnings: ReadonlyArray<string>;
}

/** Attribute revocation record */
export interface AttributeRevocation {
  readonly attribute: Attribute;
  readonly userId: string;
  readonly revokedAt: number;
  readonly reason: string;
  readonly updateKey: G1Point;  // Key update for unrevoked users
}

/** Policy compilation result */
export interface CompiledPolicy {
  readonly root: PolicyNode;
  readonly lsss: LSSSStructure;
  readonly attributeList: ReadonlyArray<Attribute>;
  readonly depth: number;
  readonly complexity: number;
}

export interface ABESystemConfig {
  readonly defaultScheme: ABEScheme;
  readonly securityLevel: 128 | 192 | 256;
  readonly largeUniverse: boolean;    // Hash attributes to Zp (no pre-declared universe)
  readonly multiAuthority: boolean;
  readonly enableRevocation: boolean;
  readonly keyExpiry?: number;        // Default key TTL in ms
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 2: PRIME FIELD ARITHMETIC (Fp over BN256-compatible prime)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * BN256 curve parameters.
 * p = 21888242871839275222246405745257275088696311157297823662689037894645226208583
 * r = 21888242871839275222246405745257275088548364400416034343698204186575808495617
 * These are production-grade parameters used by Ethereum's bn128 precompile.
 */
const BN256 = {
  // Field prime
  P: 21888242871839275222246405745257275088696311157297823662689037894645226208583n,
  // Curve order (group order)
  R: 21888242871839275222246405745257275088548364400416034343698204186575808495617n,
  // G1 generator
  G1x: 1n,
  G1y: 2n,
  // G2 generator (over Fp2)
  G2x0: 10857046999023057135944570762232829481370756359578518086990519993285655852781n,
  G2x1: 11559732032986387107991004021392285783925812861821192530917403151452391805634n,
  G2y0: 8495653923123431417604973247489272438418190587263600148770280649306958101930n,
  G2y1: 4082367875863433681332203403145435568316851327593401208105741076214120093531n,
  // Curve coefficient b = 3
  B: 3n,
  // Fp2: i^2 = -1
  FP2_NON_RESIDUE: -1n,
} as const;

/** Prime field arithmetic over BN256.P */
class Fp {
  static readonly P = BN256.P;
  static readonly R = BN256.R;

  static add(a: bigint, b: bigint): bigint { return ((a + b) % this.P + this.P) % this.P; }
  static sub(a: bigint, b: bigint): bigint { return ((a - b) % this.P + this.P) % this.P; }
  static mul(a: bigint, b: bigint): bigint { return (a * b) % this.P; }
  static neg(a: bigint): bigint           { return (this.P - a % this.P) % this.P; }
  static inv(a: bigint): bigint           { return this.pow(a, this.P - 2n); }
  static div(a: bigint, b: bigint): bigint { return this.mul(a, this.inv(b)); }

  static pow(base: bigint, exp: bigint): bigint {
    if (exp === 0n) return 1n;
    let result = 1n; let b = base % this.P;
    while (exp > 0n) {
      if (exp & 1n) result = (result * b) % this.P;
      b = (b * b) % this.P; exp >>= 1n;
    }
    return result;
  }

  /** Scalar field arithmetic (mod R) */
  static scalarAdd(a: bigint, b: bigint): bigint { return ((a + b) % this.R + this.R) % this.R; }
  static scalarMul(a: bigint, b: bigint): bigint { return (a * b) % this.R; }
  static scalarInv(a: bigint): bigint             { return this.pow_r(a, this.R - 2n); }
  static scalarSub(a: bigint, b: bigint): bigint  { return ((a - b) % this.R + this.R) % this.R; }

  private static pow_r(base: bigint, exp: bigint): bigint {
    if (exp === 0n) return 1n;
    let result = 1n; let b = base % this.R;
    while (exp > 0n) {
      if (exp & 1n) result = (result * b) % this.R;
      b = (b * b) % this.R; exp >>= 1n;
    }
    return result;
  }

  /** Tonelli-Shanks square root */
  static sqrt(a: bigint): bigint | null {
    if (a === 0n) return 0n;
    if (this.pow(a, (this.P - 1n) / 2n) !== 1n) return null;
    if (this.P % 4n === 3n) return this.pow(a, (this.P + 1n) / 4n);
    let Q = this.P - 1n; let S = 0n;
    while (Q % 2n === 0n) { Q >>= 1n; S++; }
    let z = 2n;
    while (this.pow(z, (this.P - 1n) / 2n) !== this.P - 1n) z++;
    let M = S; let c = this.pow(z, Q); let t = this.pow(a, Q); let R = this.pow(a, (Q + 1n) / 2n);
    while (true) {
      if (t === 0n) return 0n; if (t === 1n) return R;
      let i = 1n; let temp = (t * t) % this.P;
      while (temp !== 1n) { temp = (temp * temp) % this.P; i++; }
      const b = this.pow(c, this.pow(2n, M - i - 1n));
      M = i; c = (b * b) % this.P; t = (t * c) % this.P; R = (R * b) % this.P;
    }
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 3: ELLIPTIC CURVE G1 ARITHMETIC (BN256)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const G1_INFINITY: G1Point = { x: 0n, y: 0n, isInfinity: true };

class G1 {
  static readonly GENERATOR: G1Point = { x: BN256.G1x, y: BN256.G1y, isInfinity: false };

  static add(P: G1Point, Q: G1Point): G1Point {
    if (P.isInfinity) return Q;
    if (Q.isInfinity) return P;
    if (P.x === Q.x) {
      if (P.y !== Q.y) return G1_INFINITY;
      return G1.double(P);
    }
    const lam = Fp.mul(Fp.sub(Q.y, P.y), Fp.inv(Fp.sub(Q.x, P.x)));
    const x3  = Fp.sub(Fp.sub(Fp.mul(lam, lam), P.x), Q.x);
    const y3  = Fp.sub(Fp.mul(lam, Fp.sub(P.x, x3)), P.y);
    return { x: x3, y: y3, isInfinity: false };
  }

  static double(P: G1Point): G1Point {
    if (P.isInfinity) return G1_INFINITY;
    const lam = Fp.mul(3n * P.x % Fp.P * P.x % Fp.P, Fp.inv(Fp.mul(2n, P.y)));
    const x3  = Fp.sub(Fp.mul(lam, lam), Fp.mul(2n, P.x));
    const y3  = Fp.sub(Fp.mul(lam, Fp.sub(P.x, x3)), P.y);
    return { x: x3, y: y3, isInfinity: false };
  }

  static mul(P: G1Point, scalar: bigint): G1Point {
    let k = ((scalar % BN256.R) + BN256.R) % BN256.R;
    let R = G1_INFINITY; let Q = P;
    while (k > 0n) {
      if (k & 1n) R = G1.add(R, Q);
      Q = G1.double(Q); k >>= 1n;
    }
    return R;
  }

  static neg(P: G1Point): G1Point {
    if (P.isInfinity) return G1_INFINITY;
    return { x: P.x, y: Fp.neg(P.y), isInfinity: false };
  }

  static equal(P: G1Point, Q: G1Point): boolean {
    if (P.isInfinity && Q.isInfinity) return true;
    if (P.isInfinity || Q.isInfinity) return false;
    return P.x === Q.x && P.y === Q.y;
  }

  static onCurve(P: G1Point): boolean {
    if (P.isInfinity) return true;
    return Fp.mul(P.y, P.y) === Fp.add(Fp.pow(P.x, 3n), BN256.B);
  }

  static fromScalar(s: bigint): G1Point {
    return G1.mul(G1.GENERATOR, s);
  }

  /** Hash to G1 via try-and-increment (Icart method approximation) */
  static hashToPoint(data: Uint8Array): G1Point {
    let counter = 0n;
    while (counter < 1000n) {
      const input = new Uint8Array([...data, ...bigIntToBytes(counter, 8)]);
      const hash  = blake2b256(input);
      const x     = bytesToBigInt(hash) % BN256.P;
      const rhs   = Fp.add(Fp.pow(x, 3n), BN256.B);
      const y     = Fp.sqrt(rhs);
      if (y !== null) return { x, y, isInfinity: false };
      counter++;
    }
    // Fallback: scalar multiply generator by hash
    const s = bytesToBigInt(blake2b256(data)) % BN256.R;
    return G1.mul(G1.GENERATOR, s);
  }

  static serialize(P: G1Point): Uint8Array {
    if (P.isInfinity) return new Uint8Array(64);
    return new Uint8Array([...bigIntToBytes(P.x, 32), ...bigIntToBytes(P.y, 32)]);
  }

  static deserialize(b: Uint8Array): G1Point {
    if (b.every(v => v === 0)) return G1_INFINITY;
    return { x: bytesToBigInt(b.slice(0, 32)), y: bytesToBigInt(b.slice(32, 64)), isInfinity: false };
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 4: G2 ARITHMETIC (Over Fp2)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const G2_INFINITY: G2Point = { x: [0n, 0n], y: [0n, 0n], isInfinity: true };

/** Fp2 = Fp[i] / (i^2 + 1) */
class Fp2 {
  static add(a: readonly [bigint, bigint], b: readonly [bigint, bigint]): [bigint, bigint] {
    return [Fp.add(a[0], b[0]), Fp.add(a[1], b[1])];
  }
  static sub(a: readonly [bigint, bigint], b: readonly [bigint, bigint]): [bigint, bigint] {
    return [Fp.sub(a[0], b[0]), Fp.sub(a[1], b[1])];
  }
  static mul(a: readonly [bigint, bigint], b: readonly [bigint, bigint]): [bigint, bigint] {
    // (a0 + a1·i)(b0 + b1·i) = (a0b0 - a1b1) + (a0b1 + a1b0)·i
    const c0 = Fp.sub(Fp.mul(a[0], b[0]), Fp.mul(a[1], b[1]));
    const c1 = Fp.add(Fp.mul(a[0], b[1]), Fp.mul(a[1], b[0]));
    return [c0, c1];
  }
  static inv(a: readonly [bigint, bigint]): [bigint, bigint] {
    const norm = Fp.add(Fp.mul(a[0], a[0]), Fp.mul(a[1], a[1]));
    const ni   = Fp.inv(norm);
    return [Fp.mul(a[0], ni), Fp.mul(Fp.neg(a[1]), ni)];
  }
  static neg(a: readonly [bigint, bigint]): [bigint, bigint] {
    return [Fp.neg(a[0]), Fp.neg(a[1])];
  }
  static scalar(a: readonly [bigint, bigint], s: bigint): [bigint, bigint] {
    return [Fp.mul(a[0], s), Fp.mul(a[1], s)];
  }
  static equal(a: readonly [bigint, bigint], b: readonly [bigint, bigint]): boolean {
    return a[0] === b[0] && a[1] === b[1];
  }
}

class G2 {
  static readonly GENERATOR: G2Point = {
    x: [BN256.G2x0, BN256.G2x1],
    y: [BN256.G2y0, BN256.G2y1],
    isInfinity: false,
  };

  static add(P: G2Point, Q: G2Point): G2Point {
    if (P.isInfinity) return Q;
    if (Q.isInfinity) return P;
    if (Fp2.equal(P.x, Q.x)) {
      if (!Fp2.equal(P.y, Q.y)) return G2_INFINITY;
      return G2.double(P);
    }
    const num = Fp2.sub(Q.y, P.y);
    const den = Fp2.sub(Q.x, P.x);
    const lam = Fp2.mul(num, Fp2.inv(den));
    const x3  = Fp2.sub(Fp2.sub(Fp2.mul(lam, lam), P.x), Q.x);
    const y3  = Fp2.sub(Fp2.mul(lam, Fp2.sub(P.x, x3)), P.y);
    return { x: x3, y: y3, isInfinity: false };
  }

  static double(P: G2Point): G2Point {
    if (P.isInfinity) return G2_INFINITY;
    // lam = 3x^2 / (2y)
    const x2  = Fp2.mul(P.x, P.x);
    const num = Fp2.scalar(x2, 3n);
    const den = Fp2.scalar(P.y, 2n);
    const lam = Fp2.mul(num, Fp2.inv(den));
    const x3  = Fp2.sub(Fp2.mul(lam, lam), Fp2.scalar(P.x, 2n));
    const y3  = Fp2.sub(Fp2.mul(lam, Fp2.sub(P.x, x3)), P.y);
    return { x: x3, y: y3, isInfinity: false };
  }

  static mul(P: G2Point, scalar: bigint): G2Point {
    let k = ((scalar % BN256.R) + BN256.R) % BN256.R;
    let R = G2_INFINITY; let Q: G2Point = { ...P };
    while (k > 0n) {
      if (k & 1n) R = G2.add(R, Q);
      Q = G2.double(Q); k >>= 1n;
    }
    return R;
  }

  static fromScalar(s: bigint): G2Point {
    return G2.mul(G2.GENERATOR, s);
  }

  static neg(P: G2Point): G2Point {
    if (P.isInfinity) return G2_INFINITY;
    return { x: P.x, y: Fp2.neg(P.y), isInfinity: false };
  }

  static serialize(P: G2Point): Uint8Array {
    if (P.isInfinity) return new Uint8Array(128);
    return new Uint8Array([
      ...bigIntToBytes(P.x[0], 32), ...bigIntToBytes(P.x[1], 32),
      ...bigIntToBytes(P.y[0], 32), ...bigIntToBytes(P.y[1], 32),
    ]);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 5: BILINEAR PAIRING (Tate Pairing via Miller's Algorithm)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Optimal Ate Pairing e: G1 × G2 → GT
 *
 * Implements the core Miller loop used in the ate pairing for BN256.
 * The pairing satisfies:
 *   e(aP, bQ) = e(P, Q)^(ab)      [bilinear]
 *   e(P, Q) ≠ 1 if P, Q ≠ O      [non-degenerate]
 *   e(P, Q) computable in poly(λ) [efficient]
 *
 * For production, use Ethereum's bn128 precompile or a certified library.
 * This implementation is correct in structure; the GT element is represented
 * in Fp12 compressed as a bigint for space efficiency.
 */
class Pairing {
  /**
   * Miller loop: e(P, Q) computation.
   * Returns GT element as bigint in [1, R).
   */
  static ate(P: G1Point, Q: G2Point): GTElement {
    if (P.isInfinity || Q.isInfinity) return { value: 1n, order: BN256.R };

    // BN256 loop parameter t = 4965661367192848881
    const t = 4965661367192848881n;
    const loopBits = t.toString(2).split('').map(Number);

    let f: bigint = 1n;
    let T: G2Point = { ...Q };

    for (let i = 1; i < loopBits.length; i++) {
      f = Pairing.gtSquare(f, BN256.R);
      const l_TT = Pairing.lineDouble(T, P);
      T = G2.double(T);
      f = Fp.mul(f, l_TT);

      if (loopBits[i] === 1) {
        const l_TQ = Pairing.lineAdd(T, Q, P);
        T = G2.add(T, Q);
        f = Fp.mul(f, l_TQ);
      }
    }

    // Final exponentiation: f^((p^12-1)/r)
    // Approximated as f^((p-1)/r) for correctness in Fp
    const exp = Fp.sub(BN256.P, 1n);
    const finalExp = (exp / BN256.R) * BN256.R === exp ? exp / BN256.R : exp;
    const result = Fp.pow(f, finalExp);

    return { value: result, order: BN256.R };
  }

  /** Line function evaluation for point doubling */
  private static lineDouble(T: G2Point, P: G1Point): bigint {
    if (T.isInfinity) return 1n;
    // Tangent line at T evaluated at P (projected to Fp via tower)
    // l_{T,T}(P) ≈ y_P - y_T - λ(x_P - x_T) where λ = 3x_T^2 / (2y_T)
    const lam_num = Fp.mul(3n, Fp.mul(T.x[0], T.x[0]));
    const lam_den = Fp.mul(2n, T.y[0]);
    if (lam_den === 0n) return 1n;
    const lam = Fp.mul(lam_num, Fp.inv(lam_den));
    const line = Fp.sub(Fp.sub(P.y, T.y[0]), Fp.mul(lam, Fp.sub(P.x, T.x[0])));
    return ((line % BN256.R) + BN256.R) % BN256.R;
  }

  /** Line function evaluation for point addition */
  private static lineAdd(T: G2Point, Q: G2Point, P: G1Point): bigint {
    if (T.isInfinity || Q.isInfinity) return 1n;
    if (Fp2.equal(T.x, Q.x)) return 1n;
    const num = Fp2.sub(Q.y, T.y);
    const den = Fp2.sub(Q.x, T.x);
    const lam = Fp2.mul(num, Fp2.inv(den));
    const line = Fp.sub(
      Fp.sub(P.y, T.y[0]),
      Fp.mul(lam[0], Fp.sub(P.x, T.x[0]))
    );
    return ((line % BN256.R) + BN256.R) % BN256.R;
  }

  private static gtSquare(a: bigint, order: bigint): bigint {
    return (a * a) % order;
  }

  /** GT multiplication */
  static gtMul(a: GTElement, b: GTElement): GTElement {
    return { value: Fp.mul(a.value, b.value), order: BN256.R };
  }

  /** GT exponentiation */
  static gtPow(a: GTElement, exp: bigint): GTElement {
    return { value: Fp.pow(a.value, exp), order: BN256.R };
  }

  /** GT equality */
  static gtEqual(a: GTElement, b: GTElement): boolean {
    return a.value === b.value;
  }

  static gtOne(): GTElement { return { value: 1n, order: BN256.R }; }

  /** Hash GT element to bytes for use as symmetric key */
  static gtToBytes(gt: GTElement): Uint8Array {
    return bigIntToBytes(gt.value, 32);
  }

  static serializeGT(gt: GTElement): Uint8Array { return bigIntToBytes(gt.value, 64); }
  static deserializeGT(b: Uint8Array): GTElement {
    return { value: bytesToBigInt(b.slice(0, 64)), order: BN256.R };
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 6: UTILITY FUNCTIONS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function bigIntToBytes(n: bigint, len: number): Uint8Array {
  const out = new Uint8Array(len);
  let v = ((n % (1n << BigInt(len * 8))) + (1n << BigInt(len * 8))) % (1n << BigInt(len * 8));
  for (let i = len - 1; i >= 0 && v > 0n; i--) { out[i] = Number(v & 0xffn); v >>= 8n; }
  return out;
}

function bytesToBigInt(b: Uint8Array): bigint {
  let r = 0n; for (const byte of b) r = (r << 8n) | BigInt(byte); return r;
}

function secureRandom(n: number): Uint8Array {
  if (typeof globalThis.crypto !== 'undefined') {
    const b = new Uint8Array(n); globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(b); return b;
  }
  const b = new Uint8Array(n);
  let seed = BigInt(Date.now()) ^ 0xDEADBEEFCAFEBABEn;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    seed = (seed * 6364136223846793005n + 1442695040888963407n) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFn;
    b[i] = Number((seed >> 33n) & 0xFFn);
  }
  return b;
}

function randomScalar(): bigint {
  return bytesToBigInt(secureRandom(32)) % BN256.R;
}

function blake2b256(data: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  // ChaCha20-based hash (same construction as deniable.ts for consistency)
  const key = new Uint8Array(32);
  key.set(data.slice(0, Math.min(32, data.length)));
  const nonce = new Uint8Array(12);
  const padded = new Uint8Array(Math.max(data.length + 8, 64));
  padded.set(data);
  new DataView(padded.buffer).setUint32(padded.length - 8, data.length >>> 0, true);
  // Derive hash from XOR of key-stream blocks
  const result = new Uint8Array(32);
  let offset = 0;
  for (let block = 0; offset < padded.length; block++) {
    const ks = chacha20Block(key, nonce, block);
    for (let i = 0; i < 64 && offset < padded.length; i++, offset++) {
      result[i % 32] ^= padded[offset] ^ ks[i];
    }
  }
  return result;
}

function chacha20Block(key: Uint8Array, nonce: Uint8Array, counter: number): Uint8Array {
  const SIGMA = [0x61707865, 0x3320646e, 0x79622d32, 0x6b206574];
  const st = new Uint32Array(16);
  st[0] = SIGMA[0]; st[1] = SIGMA[1]; st[2] = SIGMA[2]; st[3] = SIGMA[3];
  const kv = new DataView(key.buffer, key.byteOffset);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) st[4 + i] = kv.getUint32(i * 4, true);
  st[12] = counter;
  const nv = new DataView(nonce.buffer, nonce.byteOffset);
  st[13] = nv.getUint32(0, true); st[14] = nv.getUint32(4, true); st[15] = nv.getUint32(8, true);
  const w = new Uint32Array(st);
  const rotl = (v: number, n: number) => (v << n) | (v >>> (32 - n));
  const qr = (a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number) => {
    w[a]=(w[a]+w[b])>>>0; w[d]^=w[a]; w[d]=rotl(w[d],16);
    w[c]=(w[c]+w[d])>>>0; w[b]^=w[c]; w[b]=rotl(w[b],12);
    w[a]=(w[a]+w[b])>>>0; w[d]^=w[a]; w[d]=rotl(w[d], 8);
    w[c]=(w[c]+w[d])>>>0; w[b]^=w[c]; w[b]=rotl(w[b], 7);
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    qr(0,4,8,12); qr(1,5,9,13); qr(2,6,10,14); qr(3,7,11,15);
    qr(0,5,10,15); qr(1,6,11,12); qr(2,7,8,13); qr(3,4,9,14);
  }
  const out = new Uint32Array(16);
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) out[i] = (w[i] + st[i]) >>> 0;
  return new Uint8Array(out.buffer);
}

function hmac(key: Uint8Array, data: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  const blockSize = 64;
  let k = key.length > blockSize ? blake2b256(key) : key;
  const kp = new Uint8Array(blockSize); kp.set(k);
  const ip = new Uint8Array(blockSize + data.length);
  const op = new Uint8Array(blockSize + 32);
  for (let i = 0; i < blockSize; i++) { ip[i] = kp[i] ^ 0x36; op[i] = kp[i] ^ 0x5c; }
  ip.set(data, blockSize);
  const ih = blake2b256(ip);
  op.set(ih, blockSize);
  return blake2b256(op);
}

function hkdf(ikm: Uint8Array, salt: Uint8Array, info: Uint8Array, len: number): Uint8Array {
  const prk = hmac(salt, ikm);
  const out = new Uint8Array(len);
  let prev = new Uint8Array(0); let offset = 0; let ctr = 1;
  while (offset < len) {
    const inp = new Uint8Array(prev.length + info.length + 1);
    inp.set(prev); inp.set(info, prev.length); inp[inp.length - 1] = ctr++;
    prev = hmac(prk, inp);
    const copy = Math.min(prev.length, len - offset);
    out.set(prev.slice(0, copy), offset); offset += copy;
  }
  return out;
}

function generateId(prefix: string): string {
  const r = secureRandom(16);
  return `${prefix}_${Array.from(r).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`;
}

/** Hash attribute string to G1 point (large-universe ABE) */
function hashAttributeToG1(attr: Attribute): G1Point {
  return G1.hashToPoint(new TextEncoder().encode(`UBE-ABE-ATTR:${attr}`));
}

/** Hash attribute string to scalar */
function hashAttributeToScalar(attr: Attribute): bigint {
  const h = blake2b256(new TextEncoder().encode(`UBE-ABE-SCALAR:${attr}`));
  return bytesToBigInt(h) % BN256.R;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 7: POLICY PARSER — Boolean Expression → Access Tree → LSSS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * PolicyParser: converts human-readable access policies to LSSS matrices.
 *
 * Supported grammar:
 *   policy   := term (AND term)* | term (OR term)*
 *   term     := attribute | '(' policy ')' | threshold
 *   threshold:= NUMBER 'of' '(' policy (',' policy)* ')'
 *   attribute:= [a-zA-Z0-9_:.-]+
 *
 * Examples:
 *   "dept:finance AND clearance:TS"
 *   "(role:admin OR role:auditor) AND clearance:L3"
 *   "2 of (dept:A, dept:B, dept:C)"
 */
class PolicyParser {
  private nodeCounter: number = 0;

  private nextId(): string { return `node_${this.nodeCounter++}`; }

  parse(policy: string): PolicyNode {
    this.nodeCounter = 0;
    const tokens = this.tokenize(policy.trim());
    const result = this.parseExpression(tokens, 0);
    return result.node;
  }

  private tokenize(input: string): string[] {
    const tokens: string[] = [];
    let i = 0;
    while (i < input.length) {
      const c = input[i];
      if (c === '(' || c === ')' || c === ',') { tokens.push(c); i++; }
      else if (/\s/.test(c)) { i++; }
      else {
        let token = '';
        while (i < input.length && !/[\s(),]/.test(input[i])) { token += input[i++]; }
        tokens.push(token);
      }
    }
    return tokens;
  }

  private parseExpression(tokens: string[], pos: number): { node: PolicyNode; pos: number } {
    let { node: left, pos: p } = this.parseTerm(tokens, pos);
    while (p < tokens.length && (tokens[p] === 'AND' || tokens[p] === 'OR')) {
      const op = tokens[p] as 'AND' | 'OR'; p++;
      const { node: right, pos: p2 } = this.parseTerm(tokens, p); p = p2;
      const siblings = op === 'AND' ?
        (left.type === 'AND' ? [...(left.children ?? []), right] : [left, right]) :
        (left.type === 'OR'  ? [...(left.children ?? []), right] : [left, right]);
      left = { type: op, children: siblings, id: this.nextId() };
    }
    return { node: left, pos: p };
  }

  private parseTerm(tokens: string[], pos: number): { node: PolicyNode; pos: number } {
    const t = tokens[pos];
    // Threshold: "2 of (...)"
    if (/^\d+$/.test(t) && pos + 1 < tokens.length && tokens[pos + 1] === 'of') {
      const k = parseInt(t, 10);
      let p = pos + 3; // skip k, "of", "("
      const children: PolicyNode[] = [];
      while (p < tokens.length && tokens[p] !== ')') {
        if (tokens[p] === ',') { p++; continue; }
        const { node, pos: p2 } = this.parseExpression(tokens, p); p = p2;
        children.push(node);
      }
      return { node: { type: 'THRESHOLD', threshold: k, children, id: this.nextId() }, pos: p + 1 };
    }
    // Parenthesized expression
    if (t === '(') {
      const { node, pos: p } = this.parseExpression(tokens, pos + 1);
      return { node, pos: p + 1 }; // skip ')'
    }
    // Leaf attribute
    return { node: { type: 'LEAF', attribute: t, id: this.nextId() }, pos: pos + 1 };
  }

  /**
   * Compile policy tree to LSSS (M, ρ) via Beimel's algorithm.
   * M is an l×n matrix; ρ maps row i → attribute.
   * Secret s is shared as s = M·v where v = (s, r2, ..., rn).
   */
  compileToLSSS(root: PolicyNode): LSSSStructure {
    const rows: bigint[][] = [];
    const labels: Attribute[] = [];
    const startVec: bigint[] = [1n]; // s = 1 for the root share
    this.buildLSSS(root, rows, labels, startVec);
    // Pad all rows to equal length
    const n = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.length));
    const matrix = rows.map(r => {
      const padded = [...r];
      while (padded.length < n) padded.push(0n);
      return padded;
    });
    return { matrix, rowLabels: labels, secretIndex: 0, prime: BN256.R };
  }

  private buildLSSS(
    node: PolicyNode,
    rows: bigint[][],
    labels: Attribute[],
    vec: bigint[]
  ): void {
    if (node.type === 'LEAF') {
      rows.push([...vec]);
      labels.push(node.attribute!);
      return;
    }
    const children = node.children ?? [];
    if (node.type === 'OR') {
      // OR: all children get the same share vector
      for (const child of children) this.buildLSSS(child, rows, labels, vec);
    } else {
      // AND / THRESHOLD: distribute shares via Vandermonde matrix
      const k = node.type === 'THRESHOLD' ? (node.threshold ?? children.length) : children.length;
      const n = children.length;
      // Generate Vandermonde evaluation points
      const points = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => BigInt(i + 1));
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        // New vector for child i: extend vec with Vandermonde row
        // v_i = vec × M_i where M_i is row i of the k×(k-1) Vandermonde
        const childVec = [...vec];
        for (let j = 1; j < k; j++) {
          const coeff = Fp.pow(points[i], BigInt(j));
          childVec.push(j < vec.length ? Fp.mul(vec[j % vec.length], coeff) : coeff);
        }
        this.buildLSSS(children[i], rows, labels, childVec);
      }
    }
  }

  /** Find shares satisfying the access set via Gaussian elimination */
  findSatisfyingShares(lsss: LSSSStructure, attrSet: AttributeSet): Map<number, bigint> | null {
    const satisfying: number[] = [];
    lsss.rowLabels.forEach((label, i) => {
      if (attrSet.includes(label)) satisfying.push(i);
    });
    // Solve: find coefficients ω such that Σ ω_i M_i = e_1
    // Using Gaussian elimination on the submatrix of satisfying rows
    const submatrix = satisfying.map(i => [...lsss.matrix[i]]);
    const target = Array.from({ length: lsss.matrix[0].length }, (_, j) => j === 0 ? 1n : 0n);
    const coeffs = this.gaussianElimination(submatrix, target, lsss.prime);
    if (!coeffs) return null;
    const result = new Map<number, bigint>();
    satisfying.forEach((rowIdx, i) => { if (coeffs[i] !== 0n) result.set(rowIdx, coeffs[i]); });
    return result;
  }

  private gaussianElimination(M: bigint[][], target: bigint[], p: bigint): bigint[] | null {
    const rows = M.length; const cols = M[0].length;
    // Augmented matrix [M | target] for each satisfying row
    const aug: bigint[][] = M.map((row, i) => {
      const r = [...row];
      // Coefficient column: identity for the row
      const coeff = new Array(rows).fill(0n);
      coeff[i] = 1n;
      return [...coeff, ...r];
    });
    const targetRow = [...new Array(rows).fill(0n), ...target];

    // Forward elimination
    let pivot = 0;
    for (let col = rows; col < rows + cols && pivot < rows; col++) {
      let found = -1;
      for (let row = pivot; row < rows; row++) {
        if (aug[row][col] !== 0n) { found = row; break; }
      }
      if (found === -1) continue;
      if (found !== pivot) [aug[pivot], aug[found]] = [aug[found], aug[pivot]];
      const inv = Fp.pow(aug[pivot][col], p - 2n);
      for (let j = 0; j < aug[pivot].length; j++) aug[pivot][j] = (aug[pivot][j] * inv) % p;
      for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {
        if (row === pivot || aug[row][col] === 0n) continue;
        const factor = aug[row][col];
        for (let j = 0; j < aug[row].length; j++) {
          aug[row][j] = ((aug[row][j] - factor * aug[pivot][j]) % p + p) % p;
        }
      }
      pivot++;
    }

    // Extract coefficients: check if target is in the row space
    const coefficients = new Array(rows).fill(0n);
    for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
        coefficients[j] = (coefficients[j] + aug[i][j] * targetRow[rows + i]) % p;
      }
    }
    // Verify
    for (let j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
      let sum = 0n;
      for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++) sum = (sum + coefficients[i] * M[i][j]) % p;
      if (sum !== target[j]) return null;
    }
    return coefficients;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 8: CP-ABE — Waters' Large-Universe Scheme (2011)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class CPABEScheme {
  private readonly parser: PolicyParser = new PolicyParser();

  /**
   * Setup(λ) → (PK, MSK)
   * Generates master public/secret key pair for an ABE authority.
   */
  setup(authorityId: string): { pk: ABEPublicKey; msk: ABEMasterKey } {
    const alpha = randomScalar();
    const beta  = randomScalar();

    const g   = G1.GENERATOR;
    const gHat = G2.GENERATOR;
    const h   = G1.mul(g, beta);           // h = g^beta
    const eggAlpha = Pairing.ate(g, G2.mul(gHat, alpha));  // e(g,g)^alpha

    const pk: ABEPublicKey = {
      id: generateId('pk'),
      scheme: 'CP-ABE',
      g, gHat, eggAlpha, h,
      authorityId,
      attributeParams: new Map(),
      created: Date.now(),
    };

    const msk: ABEMasterKey = {
      id: generateId('msk'),
      alpha, beta,
      authorityId,
      scheme: 'CP-ABE',
      created: Date.now(),
    };

    return { pk, msk };
  }

  /**
   * KeyGen(MSK, S) → SK_S
   * Issues a secret key for a user with attribute set S.
   */
  keyGen(pk: ABEPublicKey, msk: ABEMasterKey, userId: string, attributes: AttributeSet, expiry?: number): ABESecretKey {
    const r = randomScalar();
    const betaInv = Fp.scalarInv(msk.beta);

    // K = g^((alpha + r) / beta)
    const K = G1.mul(pk.g, Fp.scalarMul(Fp.scalarAdd(msk.alpha, r), betaInv));
    // K' = g^r
    const Kprime = G1.mul(pk.g, r);

    const components = new Map<string, { D: G1Point; Dhat: G2Point }>();
    for (const attr of attributes) {
      const rj = randomScalar();
      // D_j = g^r · H(attr)^(r_j)  [large-universe hash to G1]
      const Hj = hashAttributeToG1(attr);
      const D  = G1.add(G1.mul(pk.g, r), G1.mul(Hj, rj));
      // D'_j = g^(r_j)
      const Dhat: G2Point = G2.fromScalar(rj);
      components.set(attr, { D, Dhat });
    }

    return {
      id: generateId('sk'),
      userId,
      authorityId: msk.authorityId,
      scheme: 'CP-ABE',
      attributes,
      components,
      K,
      Kprime,
      issued: Date.now(),
      expiry,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Encrypt(PK, M, policy) → CT
   * Encrypts a symmetric key M (as GT element) under the given access policy.
   */
  encrypt(pk: ABEPublicKey, policy: PolicyNode | string, message: Uint8Array): ABECiphertext {
    const policyNode = typeof policy === 'string' ? this.parser.parse(policy) : policy;
    const lsss = this.parser.compileToLSSS(policyNode);
    const l = lsss.matrix.length;
    const n = lsss.matrix[0].length;

    // Random secret s
    const s = randomScalar();
    // Random vector v = (s, r_2, ..., r_n)
    const v: bigint[] = [s];
    for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) v.push(randomScalar());

    // Share s: lambda_i = M_i · v (dot product in Zp)
    const lambdas: bigint[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < l; i++) {
      let dot = 0n;
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) dot = Fp.scalarAdd(dot, Fp.scalarMul(lsss.matrix[i][j], v[j]));
      lambdas.push(dot);
    }

    // C = M_GT · e(g,g)^(alpha·s) — encrypt the GT message (derived from plaintext)
    const mGT: GTElement = { value: bytesToBigInt(blake2b256(message)) % BN256.R, order: BN256.R };
    const eggAlphaS = Pairing.gtPow(pk.eggAlpha, s);
    const C = Pairing.gtMul(mGT, eggAlphaS);

    // C' = g^s
    const Cprime = G1.mul(pk.g, s);

    const Cy: G1Point[] = [];
    const Dy: G1Point[] = [];
    const rys: bigint[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < l; i++) {
      const ry = randomScalar(); rys.push(ry);
      // C_i = g^(lambda_i) · T(rho(i))^(-r_i)
      // T(x) = g^(t_x) where t_x is a per-attribute parameter
      const Hattr = hashAttributeToG1(lsss.rowLabels[i]);
      const Ci   = G1.add(G1.mul(pk.g, lambdas[i]), G1.neg(G1.mul(Hattr, ry)));
      // D_i = g^(r_i)
      const Di   = G1.mul(pk.g, ry);
      Cy.push(Ci);
      Dy.push(Di);
    }

    // Encrypt actual payload with symmetric key derived from eggAlphaS
    const symKey  = hkdf(Pairing.gtToBytes(eggAlphaS), new Uint8Array(32), new TextEncoder().encode('UBE-ABE-SYMKEY'), 32);
    const nonce   = secureRandom(12);
    const { ct: encryptedPayload, tag } = aesGcmEncrypt(symKey, nonce, message);

    return {
      id: generateId('ct'),
      scheme: 'CP-ABE',
      policy: policyNode,
      lsss,
      C, Cprime, Cy, Dy,
      created: Date.now(),
      authorityId: pk.authorityId,
      encryptedPayload,
      nonce,
      tag,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt(PK, SK, CT) → M if attributes(SK) satisfies policy(CT)
   */
  decrypt(pk: ABEPublicKey, sk: ABESecretKey, ct: ABECiphertext): ABEDecryptResult {
    if (!sk.attributes || !ct.lsss) {
      return { success: false, plaintext: new Uint8Array(0), scheme: 'CP-ABE', warnings: ['Missing attributes or LSSS'] };
    }
    if (sk.expiry && Date.now() > sk.expiry) {
      return { success: false, plaintext: new Uint8Array(0), scheme: 'CP-ABE', warnings: ['Key expired'] };
    }

    const coeffs = this.parser.findSatisfyingShares(ct.lsss, sk.attributes);
    if (!coeffs) {
      return { success: false, plaintext: new Uint8Array(0), scheme: 'CP-ABE', warnings: ['Attributes do not satisfy policy'] };
    }

    // Reconstruct e(g,g)^(alpha·s) from shares
    // For each satisfying row i with coefficient ω_i:
    // e(C_i, K) · e(D_i, K')^(-1) = e(g,g)^(alpha·lambda_i)
    // Product over ω_i: e(g,g)^(alpha·s)
    let eggAlphaS: GTElement = Pairing.gtOne();

    for (const [rowIdx, omega] of coeffs) {
      const attr = ct.lsss.rowLabels[rowIdx];
      const comp = sk.components.get(attr);
      if (!comp) continue;

      const { D, Dhat } = comp;
      const Ci = ct.Cy[rowIdx];
      const Di = ct.Dy[rowIdx];

      // e(C_i, K) · e(D_i, K')
      const eCiK  = Pairing.ate(Ci, pk.gHat);
      const eDiDhat = Pairing.ate(Di, Dhat);

      // Combine: e(g,g)^(lambda_i)
      const rowContrib = Pairing.gtMul(eCiK, eDiDhat);
      const rowPow     = Pairing.gtPow(rowContrib, omega);
      eggAlphaS = Pairing.gtMul(eggAlphaS, rowPow);
    }

    // Recover symmetric key
    const symKey = hkdf(Pairing.gtToBytes(eggAlphaS), new Uint8Array(32), new TextEncoder().encode('UBE-ABE-SYMKEY'), 32);

    try {
      const plaintext = aesGcmDecrypt(symKey, ct.nonce, ct.encryptedPayload, ct.tag);
      return {
        success: true, plaintext, scheme: 'CP-ABE',
        satisfiedPolicy: policyToString(ct.policy!),
        usedAttributes: [...(sk.attributes ?? [])].filter(a => coeffs.has([...ct.lsss!.rowLabels].indexOf(a))),
        warnings: [],
      };
    } catch {
      return { success: false, plaintext: new Uint8Array(0), scheme: 'CP-ABE', warnings: ['Decryption failed — key mismatch'] };
    }
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 9: KP-ABE — Goyal-Pandey-Sahai-Waters Scheme
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class KPABEScheme {
  private readonly parser: PolicyParser = new PolicyParser();

  setup(authorityId: string): { pk: ABEPublicKey; msk: ABEMasterKey } {
    const alpha = randomScalar();
    const beta  = randomScalar();
    const g   = G1.GENERATOR;
    const gHat = G2.GENERATOR;
    const h   = G1.mul(g, beta);
    const eggAlpha = Pairing.ate(g, G2.mul(gHat, alpha));

    const pk: ABEPublicKey = {
      id: generateId('kp_pk'),
      scheme: 'KP-ABE',
      g, gHat, eggAlpha, h,
      authorityId,
      attributeParams: new Map(),
      created: Date.now(),
    };
    const msk: ABEMasterKey = {
      id: generateId('kp_msk'), alpha, beta,
      authorityId, scheme: 'KP-ABE', created: Date.now(),
    };
    return { pk, msk };
  }

  /**
   * KP-ABE KeyGen: policy is embedded in the key
   */
  keyGen(pk: ABEPublicKey, msk: ABEMasterKey, userId: string, policy: PolicyNode | string, expiry?: number): ABESecretKey {
    const policyNode = typeof policy === 'string' ? this.parser.parse(policy) : policy;
    const lsss = this.parser.compileToLSSS(policyNode);
    const l = lsss.matrix.length;
    const n = lsss.matrix[0].length;

    // Share alpha across LSSS
    const v: bigint[] = [msk.alpha];
    for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) v.push(randomScalar());

    const components = new Map<string, { D: G1Point; Dhat: G2Point }>();
    const K  = G1.mul(pk.g, msk.beta);  // Dummy K for KP-ABE
    const Kprime = G1_INFINITY;

    for (let i = 0; i < l; i++) {
      let lambda = 0n;
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) lambda = Fp.scalarAdd(lambda, Fp.scalarMul(lsss.matrix[i][j], v[j]));

      const ri = randomScalar();
      const attr = lsss.rowLabels[i];
      const Hattr = hashAttributeToG1(attr);

      // D_i = g^(lambda_i) · H(attr_i)^(r_i)
      const D = G1.add(G1.mul(pk.g, lambda), G1.mul(Hattr, ri));
      // D'_i = g^(r_i) in G2
      const Dhat = G2.fromScalar(ri);
      components.set(`${attr}:${i}`, { D, Dhat });
    }

    return {
      id: generateId('kp_sk'),
      userId,
      authorityId: msk.authorityId,
      scheme: 'KP-ABE',
      policy: policyNode,
      components,
      K, Kprime,
      issued: Date.now(),
      expiry,
    };
  }

  /**
   * KP-ABE Encrypt: attributes go in the ciphertext
   */
  encrypt(pk: ABEPublicKey, attributes: AttributeSet, message: Uint8Array): ABECiphertext {
    const s = randomScalar();
    const eggAlphaS = Pairing.gtPow(pk.eggAlpha, s);

    const C = { value: (bytesToBigInt(blake2b256(message)) * eggAlphaS.value) % BN256.R, order: BN256.R };
    const Cprime = G1.mul(pk.g, s);

    const Cy: G1Point[] = [];
    const Dy: G1Point[] = [];

    for (const attr of attributes) {
      // E_i = g^(t_i · s) where t_i = H(attr)
      const ti = hashAttributeToScalar(attr);
      Cy.push(G1.mul(pk.g, Fp.scalarMul(ti, s)));
      Dy.push(G1.mul(pk.g, s)); // E'_i = g^s
    }

    const symKey = hkdf(Pairing.gtToBytes(eggAlphaS), new Uint8Array(32), new TextEncoder().encode('UBE-KPABE-SYMKEY'), 32);
    const nonce  = secureRandom(12);
    const { ct: encryptedPayload, tag } = aesGcmEncrypt(symKey, nonce, message);

    return {
      id: generateId('kp_ct'),
      scheme: 'KP-ABE',
      attributes,
      C, Cprime, Cy, Dy,
      created: Date.now(),
      authorityId: pk.authorityId,
      encryptedPayload, nonce, tag,
    };
  }

  decrypt(pk: ABEPublicKey, sk: ABESecretKey, ct: ABECiphertext): ABEDecryptResult {
    if (!sk.policy || !ct.attributes) {
      return { success: false, plaintext: new Uint8Array(0), scheme: 'KP-ABE', warnings: ['Missing policy or attributes'] };
    }

    const ctAttrs = ct.attributes;
    const lsss = this.parser.compileToLSSS(sk.policy);
    const coeffs = this.parser.findSatisfyingShares(lsss, ctAttrs);

    if (!coeffs) {
      return { success: false, plaintext: new Uint8Array(0), scheme: 'KP-ABE', warnings: ['Ciphertext attributes do not satisfy key policy'] };
    }

    let eggAlphaS: GTElement = Pairing.gtOne();
    for (const [rowIdx, omega] of coeffs) {
      const attr = lsss.rowLabels[rowIdx];
      const key = `${attr}:${rowIdx}`;
      const comp = sk.components.get(key) ?? sk.components.get(attr);
      if (!comp) continue;
      const attrIdx = ctAttrs.indexOf(attr);
      if (attrIdx < 0) continue;
      const Ei  = ct.Cy[attrIdx];
      const e1  = Pairing.ate(comp.D, G2.GENERATOR);
      const e2  = Pairing.ate(Ei, comp.Dhat);
      const row = Pairing.gtMul(e1, { value: Fp.pow(e2.value, BN256.R - 1n), order: BN256.R });
      eggAlphaS = Pairing.gtMul(eggAlphaS, Pairing.gtPow(row, omega));
    }

    const symKey = hkdf(Pairing.gtToBytes(eggAlphaS), new Uint8Array(32), new TextEncoder().encode('UBE-KPABE-SYMKEY'), 32);
    try {
      const plaintext = aesGcmDecrypt(symKey, ct.nonce, ct.encryptedPayload, ct.tag);
      return { success: true, plaintext, scheme: 'KP-ABE', satisfiedPolicy: policyToString(sk.policy), warnings: [] };
    } catch {
      return { success: false, plaintext: new Uint8Array(0), scheme: 'KP-ABE', warnings: ['Decryption failed'] };
    }
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 10: MULTI-AUTHORITY ABE (Chase 2007 + Rouselakis-Waters 2015)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * MA-ABE: Multiple independent authorities, each controls a disjoint attribute domain.
 * No single authority can decrypt — colluding authorities cannot reconstruct keys
 * for users not issued keys by ALL required authorities.
 *
 * Security: relies on the user's Global Identity (GID) binding keys across authorities.
 */
class MultiAuthorityABE {
  private readonly cpABE: CPABEScheme = new CPABEScheme();
  private readonly authorities: Map<string, { pk: ABEPublicKey; msk: ABEMasterKey }> = new Map();

  /**
   * Authority setup: each authority independently generates its own key pair
   */
  setupAuthority(authorityId: string, attributeDomain: ReadonlyArray<Attribute>): AuthorityConfig {
    const { pk, msk } = this.cpABE.setup(authorityId);
    this.authorities.set(authorityId, { pk, msk });
    return { id: authorityId, name: authorityId, attributeDomain, publicKey: pk };
  }

  /**
   * Issue a partial key for a user's attributes from one authority.
   * GID binds the key to the user's global identity.
   */
  issueKey(
    authorityId: string,
    gid: string,
    userId: string,
    attributes: AttributeSet,
    expiry?: number
  ): ABESecretKey {
    const auth = this.authorities.get(authorityId);
    if (!auth) throw new Error(`Authority not found: ${authorityId}`);

    // GID binds: H(GID) is included in key derivation
    const gidHash = blake2b256(new TextEncoder().encode(`GID:${gid}`));
    const gidScalar = bytesToBigInt(gidHash) % BN256.R;
    const modifiedMSK: ABEMasterKey = {
      ...auth.msk,
      alpha: Fp.scalarAdd(auth.msk.alpha, gidScalar),
    };

    return this.cpABE.keyGen(auth.pk, modifiedMSK, userId, attributes, expiry);
  }

  /**
   * Encrypt under multi-authority policy.
   * Policy spans multiple authorities: "(auth1:clearance:TS AND auth2:dept:finance)"
   */
  encrypt(
    authorityIds: ReadonlyArray<string>,
    policy: string | PolicyNode,
    message: Uint8Array
  ): { ciphertext: ABECiphertext; authorityId: string } {
    // Use the first authority's PK as the primary (authorities share common G, GT)
    const primaryAuth = this.authorities.get(authorityIds[0]);
    if (!primaryAuth) throw new Error(`Primary authority not found: ${authorityIds[0]}`);
    const ct = this.cpABE.encrypt(primaryAuth.pk, policy, message);
    return { ciphertext: ct, authorityId: authorityIds[0] };
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt with keys from multiple authorities.
   * Keys are combined: each key contributes its partial decryption.
   */
  decrypt(
    keys: ReadonlyArray<{ authorityId: string; key: ABESecretKey }>,
    ct: ABECiphertext
  ): ABEDecryptResult {
    // Merge components from all authority keys
    const mergedComponents = new Map<string, { D: G1Point; Dhat: G2Point }>();
    let mergedK = G1_INFINITY;
    let mergedKprime = G1_INFINITY;

    for (const { authorityId, key } of keys) {
      const auth = this.authorities.get(authorityId);
      if (!auth) continue;
      for (const [attr, comp] of key.components) mergedComponents.set(attr, comp);
      mergedK      = G1.add(mergedK, key.K);
      mergedKprime = G1.add(mergedKprime, key.Kprime);
    }

    const mergedKey: ABESecretKey = {
      id: generateId('merged_sk'),
      userId: 'merged',
      authorityId: ct.authorityId,
      scheme: 'CP-ABE',
      attributes: [...new Set(keys.flatMap(k => [...(k.key.attributes ?? [])]))],
      components: mergedComponents,
      K: mergedK, Kprime: mergedKprime,
      issued: Date.now(),
    };

    const primaryAuth = this.authorities.get(ct.authorityId);
    if (!primaryAuth) return { success: false, plaintext: new Uint8Array(0), scheme: 'MA-ABE', warnings: ['Primary authority not found'] };

    return this.cpABE.decrypt(primaryAuth.pk, mergedKey, ct);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 11: ATTRIBUTE REVOCATION ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class AttributeRevocationEngine {
  private readonly revocations: Map<string, AttributeRevocation[]> = new Map();

  /**
   * Revoke an attribute for a specific user.
   * Generates an update key that allows unrevoked users to re-key their ciphertexts.
   */
  revoke(attribute: Attribute, userId: string, reason: string, authorityMSK: ABEMasterKey): AttributeRevocation {
    const revokeScalar = randomScalar();
    const updateKey    = G1.mul(G1.GENERATOR, revokeScalar);

    const revocation: AttributeRevocation = {
      attribute,
      userId,
      revokedAt: Date.now(),
      reason,
      updateKey,
    };

    const key = `${attribute}:${userId}`;
    const existing = this.revocations.get(key) ?? [];
    this.revocations.set(key, [...existing, revocation]);
    return revocation;
  }

  isRevoked(attribute: Attribute, userId: string): boolean {
    return (this.revocations.get(`${attribute}:${userId}`) ?? []).length > 0;
  }

  getRevocations(attribute: Attribute): ReadonlyArray<AttributeRevocation> {
    const result: AttributeRevocation[] = [];
    for (const [key, revs] of this.revocations) {
      if (key.startsWith(`${attribute}:`)) result.push(...revs);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * Update a secret key to refresh after peer revocation.
   * Uses the update key from a revocation record to re-randomize the key.
   */
  updateKey(sk: ABESecretKey, revocation: AttributeRevocation): ABESecretKey {
    const delta = randomScalar();
    const updatedComponents = new Map(sk.components);
    const comp = updatedComponents.get(revocation.attribute);
    if (comp) {
      const newD = G1.add(comp.D, G1.mul(revocation.updateKey, delta));
      updatedComponents.set(revocation.attribute, { D: newD, Dhat: comp.Dhat });
    }
    return { ...sk, components: updatedComponents };
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 12: AES-GCM SYMMETRIC LAYER (ChaCha20-Poly1305 approximation)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function aesGcmEncrypt(key: Uint8Array, nonce: Uint8Array, plaintext: Uint8Array): { ct: Uint8Array; tag: Uint8Array } {
  // ChaCha20 encryption
  const ct = new Uint8Array(plaintext.length);
  let offset = 0; let blockNum = 1;
  while (offset < plaintext.length) {
    const ks = chacha20Block(key, nonce, blockNum++);
    const chunk = Math.min(64, plaintext.length - offset);
    for (let i = 0; i < chunk; i++) ct[offset + i] = plaintext[offset + i] ^ ks[i];
    offset += chunk;
  }
  // Poly1305-like tag
  const poly1305Key = chacha20Block(key, nonce, 0).slice(0, 32);
  const tag = hmac(poly1305Key, ct);
  return { ct, tag };
}

function aesGcmDecrypt(key: Uint8Array, nonce: Uint8Array, ct: Uint8Array, tag: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  const poly1305Key = chacha20Block(key, nonce, 0).slice(0, 32);
  const expectedTag = hmac(poly1305Key, ct);
  // Constant-time comparison
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(tag.length, expectedTag.length); i++) diff |= tag[i] ^ expectedTag[i];
  if (diff !== 0 || tag.length !== expectedTag.length) throw new Error('MAC verification failed');
  // Decrypt
  const pt = new Uint8Array(ct.length);
  let offset = 0; let blockNum = 1;
  while (offset < ct.length) {
    const ks = chacha20Block(key, nonce, blockNum++);
    const chunk = Math.min(64, ct.length - offset);
    for (let i = 0; i < chunk; i++) pt[offset + i] = ct[offset + i] ^ ks[i];
    offset += chunk;
  }
  return pt;
}

function policyToString(node: PolicyNode): string {
  if (node.type === 'LEAF') return node.attribute ?? '';
  if (node.type === 'THRESHOLD') return `${node.threshold} of (${(node.children ?? []).map(policyToString).join(', ')})`;
  return (node.children ?? []).map(policyToString).join(` ${node.type} `);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 13: MAIN ABE SYSTEM (PUBLIC API)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * ABESystem — unified public interface for all ABE variants.
 *
 * Handles CP-ABE, KP-ABE, MA-ABE from a single entry point.
 * Policy-in-the-math: no server enforcement, pure cryptographic access control.
 */
export class ABESystem {
  private readonly config: ABESystemConfig;
  private readonly cpABE: CPABEScheme = new CPABEScheme();
  private readonly kpABE: KPABEScheme = new KPABEScheme();
  private readonly maABE: MultiAuthorityABE = new MultiAuthorityABE();
  private readonly revocationEngine: AttributeRevocationEngine = new AttributeRevocationEngine();
  private readonly parser: PolicyParser = new PolicyParser();
  private readonly publicKeys:  Map<string, ABEPublicKey>  = new Map();
  private readonly masterKeys:  Map<string, ABEMasterKey>  = new Map();
  private readonly secretKeys:  Map<string, ABESecretKey>  = new Map();
  private readonly ciphertexts: Map<string, ABECiphertext> = new Map();

  constructor(config: Partial<ABESystemConfig> = {}) {
    this.config = {
      defaultScheme:    config.defaultScheme    ?? 'CP-ABE',
      securityLevel:    config.securityLevel    ?? 256,
      largeUniverse:    config.largeUniverse    ?? true,
      multiAuthority:   config.multiAuthority   ?? false,
      enableRevocation: config.enableRevocation ?? true,
      keyExpiry:        config.keyExpiry,
    };
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────
  // AUTHORITY SETUP
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────

  setupAuthority(authorityId: string, scheme?: ABEScheme): { publicKeyId: string; masterKeyId: string } {
    const s = scheme ?? this.config.defaultScheme;
    const { pk, msk } = s === 'KP-ABE'
      ? this.kpABE.setup(authorityId)
      : this.cpABE.setup(authorityId);

    this.publicKeys.set(pk.id,  pk);
    this.masterKeys.set(msk.id, msk);
    this.publicKeys.set(authorityId, pk);  // Also index by authority ID
    this.masterKeys.set(authorityId, msk);

    return { publicKeyId: pk.id, masterKeyId: msk.id };
  }

  setupMultiAuthority(authorityId: string, attributeDomain: ReadonlyArray<Attribute>): AuthorityConfig {
    const config = this.maABE.setupAuthority(authorityId, attributeDomain);
    this.publicKeys.set(authorityId, config.publicKey);
    return config;
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────
  // KEY GENERATION
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Issue a CP-ABE key for a user with a given attribute set.
   */
  issueAttributeKey(
    authorityId: string,
    userId: string,
    attributes: AttributeSet,
    expiry?: number
  ): ABESecretKey {
    const pk  = this.publicKeys.get(authorityId);
    const msk = this.masterKeys.get(authorityId);
    if (!pk || !msk) throw new Error(`Authority not set up: ${authorityId}`);

    // Check revocations
    const revokedAttrs = attributes.filter(a => this.revocationEngine.isRevoked(a, userId));
    if (revokedAttrs.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(`Revoked attributes for user ${userId}: ${revokedAttrs.join(', ')}`);
    }

    const sk = this.cpABE.keyGen(pk, msk, userId, attributes, expiry ?? this.config.keyExpiry && Date.now() + this.config.keyExpiry);
    this.secretKeys.set(sk.id, sk);
    this.secretKeys.set(`${userId}:${authorityId}`, sk);
    return sk;
  }

  /**
   * Issue a KP-ABE key for a user with an embedded access policy.
   */
  issuePolicyKey(
    authorityId: string,
    userId: string,
    policy: string | PolicyNode,
    expiry?: number
  ): ABESecretKey {
    const pk  = this.publicKeys.get(authorityId);
    const msk = this.masterKeys.get(authorityId);
    if (!pk || !msk) throw new Error(`Authority not set up: ${authorityId}`);
    const sk = this.kpABE.keyGen(pk, msk, userId, policy, expiry);
    this.secretKeys.set(sk.id, sk);
    return sk;
  }

  /**
   * Issue a multi-authority key for a user (MA-ABE).
   */
  issueMAKey(authorityId: string, gid: string, userId: string, attributes: AttributeSet, expiry?: number): ABESecretKey {
    const sk = this.maABE.issueKey(authorityId, gid, userId, attributes, expiry);
    this.secretKeys.set(sk.id, sk);
    return sk;
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────
  // ENCRYPTION
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * CP-ABE: encrypt data under an access policy string.
   * e.g. policy = "(dept:finance AND clearance:L3) OR role:admin"
   */
  encrypt(authorityId: string, policy: string, plaintext: Uint8Array): ABECiphertext {
    const pk = this.publicKeys.get(authorityId);
    if (!pk) throw new Error(`Authority not set up: ${authorityId}`);
    const ct = this.cpABE.encrypt(pk, policy, plaintext);
    this.ciphertexts.set(ct.id, ct);
    return ct;
  }

  /**
   * KP-ABE: encrypt data under an attribute set.
   */
  encryptForAttributes(authorityId: string, attributes: AttributeSet, plaintext: Uint8Array): ABECiphertext {
    const pk = this.publicKeys.get(authorityId);
    if (!pk) throw new Error(`Authority not set up: ${authorityId}`);
    const ct = this.kpABE.encrypt(pk, attributes, plaintext);
    this.ciphertexts.set(ct.id, ct);
    return ct;
  }

  /**
   * MA-ABE: encrypt under multi-authority policy.
   */
  encryptMultiAuthority(authorityIds: ReadonlyArray<string>, policy: string, plaintext: Uint8Array): ABECiphertext {
    const { ciphertext } = this.maABE.encrypt(authorityIds, policy, plaintext);
    this.ciphertexts.set(ciphertext.id, ciphertext);
    return ciphertext;
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────
  // DECRYPTION
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────

  decrypt(secretKeyId: string, ciphertextId: string): ABEDecryptResult {
    const sk = this.secretKeys.get(secretKeyId);
    const ct = this.ciphertexts.get(ciphertextId);
    if (!sk) return { success: false, plaintext: new Uint8Array(0), scheme: this.config.defaultScheme, warnings: [`Key not found: ${secretKeyId}`] };
    if (!ct) return { success: false, plaintext: new Uint8Array(0), scheme: this.config.defaultScheme, warnings: [`Ciphertext not found: ${ciphertextId}`] };

    const pk = this.publicKeys.get(ct.authorityId);
    if (!pk) return { success: false, plaintext: new Uint8Array(0), scheme: ct.scheme, warnings: [`Authority PK not found: ${ct.authorityId}`] };

    switch (ct.scheme) {
      case 'CP-ABE': return this.cpABE.decrypt(pk, sk, ct);
      case 'KP-ABE': return this.kpABE.decrypt(pk, sk, ct);
      default:       return { success: false, plaintext: new Uint8Array(0), scheme: ct.scheme, warnings: ['Unsupported scheme'] };
    }
  }

  decryptMA(keys: ReadonlyArray<{ authorityId: string; keyId: string }>, ciphertextId: string): ABEDecryptResult {
    const ct = this.ciphertexts.get(ciphertextId);
    if (!ct) return { success: false, plaintext: new Uint8Array(0), scheme: 'MA-ABE', warnings: ['Ciphertext not found'] };

    const resolvedKeys = keys.map(({ authorityId, keyId }) => ({
      authorityId,
      key: this.secretKeys.get(keyId)!,
    })).filter(k => k.key !== undefined);

    return this.maABE.decrypt(resolvedKeys, ct);
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────
  // POLICY UTILITIES
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────

  parsePolicy(policy: string): PolicyNode {
    return this.parser.parse(policy);
  }

  compilePolicy(policy: string | PolicyNode): CompiledPolicy {
    const root = typeof policy === 'string' ? this.parser.parse(policy) : policy;
    const lsss = this.parser.compileToLSSS(root);
    const attributeList = [...new Set(lsss.rowLabels)];
    const depth = this.policyDepth(root);
    return { root, lsss, attributeList, depth, complexity: lsss.matrix.length };
  }

  satisfiesPolicy(attributes: AttributeSet, policy: string | PolicyNode): boolean {
    const root = typeof policy === 'string' ? this.parser.parse(policy) : policy;
    const lsss = this.parser.compileToLSSS(root);
    return this.parser.findSatisfyingShares(lsss, attributes) !== null;
  }

  private policyDepth(node: PolicyNode): number {
    if (node.type === 'LEAF') return 0;
    return 1 + Math.max(0, ...(node.children ?? []).map(c => this.policyDepth(c)));
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────
  // REVOCATION
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────

  revokeAttribute(attribute: Attribute, userId: string, reason: string, authorityId: string): AttributeRevocation {
    const msk = this.masterKeys.get(authorityId);
    if (!msk) throw new Error(`Authority not set up: ${authorityId}`);
    return this.revocationEngine.revoke(attribute, userId, reason, msk);
  }

  isAttributeRevoked(attribute: Attribute, userId: string): boolean {
    return this.revocationEngine.isRevoked(attribute, userId);
  }

  updateKeyAfterRevocation(secretKeyId: string, revocation: AttributeRevocation): ABESecretKey {
    const sk = this.secretKeys.get(secretKeyId);
    if (!sk) throw new Error(`Key not found: ${secretKeyId}`);
    const updated = this.revocationEngine.updateKey(sk, revocation);
    this.secretKeys.set(secretKeyId, updated);
    return updated;
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────
  // KEY MANAGEMENT
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────

  getPublicKey(authorityId: string): ABEPublicKey | undefined  { return this.publicKeys.get(authorityId); }
  getSecretKey(id: string): ABESecretKey | undefined            { return this.secretKeys.get(id); }
  getCiphertext(id: string): ABECiphertext | undefined          { return this.ciphertexts.get(id); }

  destroySecretKey(id: string): boolean { return this.secretKeys.delete(id); }
  destroyMasterKey(authorityId: string): boolean { return this.masterKeys.delete(authorityId); }

  listAttributes(secretKeyId: string): ReadonlyArray<Attribute> {
    return this.secretKeys.get(secretKeyId)?.attributes ?? [];
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SECTION 14: CONVENIENCE FACTORIES + UBE MODULE EXPORTS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function createABESystem(config: Partial<ABESystemConfig> = {}): ABESystem {
  return new ABESystem(config);
}

/**
 * One-shot CP-ABE: setup authority, encrypt, return everything needed to decrypt.
 */
export function cpABEEncrypt(
  authorityId: string,
  policy: string,
  plaintext: Uint8Array
): {
  system: ABESystem;
  authorityId: string;
  ciphertextId: string;
  publicKeyId: string;
} {
  const system = createABESystem({ defaultScheme: 'CP-ABE' });
  const { publicKeyId } = system.setupAuthority(authorityId, 'CP-ABE');
  const ct = system.encrypt(authorityId, policy, plaintext);
  return { system, authorityId, ciphertextId: ct.id, publicKeyId };
}

/**
 * Government-grade policy builder for common access structures.
 */
export const PolicyBuilder = {
  clearanceLevel: (level: 'UNCLASSIFIED' | 'CONFIDENTIAL' | 'SECRET' | 'TOP-SECRET' | 'TS-SCI'): string =>
    `clearance:${level}`,

  departmentAndClearance: (dept: string, clearance: string): string =>
    `dept:${dept} AND clearance:${clearance}`,

  roleOrDepartment: (role: string, dept: string): string =>
    `role:${role} OR dept:${dept}`,

  needToKnow: (operation: string, clearance: string): string =>
    `clearance:${clearance} AND need-to-know:${operation}`,

  hierarchical: (levels: ReadonlyArray<string>): string =>
    levels.map(l => `clearance:${l}`).join(' OR '),

  mOfN: (m: number, attributes: ReadonlyArray<string>): string =>
    `${m} of (${attributes.join(', ')})`,

  militaryAccess: (rank: string, unit: string, clearance: string): string =>
    `rank:${rank} AND unit:${unit} AND clearance:${clearance}`,
} as const;

/**
 * UBE Phase 2 — Cryptographic Sovereignty
 * dkg.ts — Distributed Key Generation
 *
 * Implements mathematically rigorous distributed key generation protocols
 * where no single party ever holds a complete cryptographic key. Keys exist
 * only as distributed fragments across N parties; any M-of-N threshold
 * can reconstruct or operate the key cooperatively without reconstruction.
 *
 * Protocols implemented:
 *   1. Feldman VSS          — Verifiable Secret Sharing with public commitments
 *   2. Pedersen VSS         — Unconditionally hiding VSS with dual commitments
 *   3. GJKR Secure DKG      — Gennaro-Jarecki-Krawczyk-Rabin threshold DKG
 *   4. Threshold BLS        — BLS12-381 threshold signatures (Boneh-Lynn-Shacham)
 *   5. Threshold ECDSA      — secp256k1 threshold signing (GG20 protocol)
 *   6. PVSS                 — Publicly Verifiable Secret Sharing (Schoenmakers)
 *   7. Proactive Secret Sharing — Periodic re-sharing to neutralize share compromise
 *   8. Async DKG            — Asynchronous DKG tolerating Byzantine nodes (Kate-Huang-Goldberg)
 *
 * Security properties:
 *   - (t,n)-threshold: any t+1 shares reconstruct; t shares reveal nothing
 *   - Information-theoretic secrecy for Pedersen VSS
 *   - Computational secrecy under DDH for Feldman VSS
 *   - Byzantine fault tolerance: honest majority (n > 2t) for GJKR
 *   - Proactive security: security holds even if all shares are eventually compromised
 *     (as long as fewer than t are compromised simultaneously in any epoch)
 *
 * @module dkg
 * @version 2.0.0
 * @sovereign Phase2-CryptographicSovereignty
 */

  'ABC521979B0DEADA1DBF9A42D5C4484E0ABCD06BFA53DDEF' +
