  '7930E9E4E58857B6AC7D5F42D69F6D187763CF1D5503400487F55BA57E31CC7A7135C886EFB4318AED6A1E012D9E6832A907600A918130C46DC778F971AD0038092999A333CB8B7A1A1DB93D7140003C2A4ECEA9F98D0ACC0A8291CDCEC97DCF8EC9B55A7F88A46B4DB5A851F44182E1C68A007E5E655F6AFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF'
);

interface Point {
  x: bigint;
  y: bigint;
  infinity: boolean;
}

const INFINITY_POINT: Point = { x: BigInt(0), y: BigInt(0), infinity: true };

function modPow(base: bigint, exp: bigint, mod: bigint): bigint {
  if (mod === BigInt(1)) return BigInt(0);
  let result = BigInt(1);
  base = base % mod;
  if (base < BigInt(0)) base += mod;
  while (exp > BigInt(0)) {
    if (exp % BigInt(2) === BigInt(1)) result = (result * base) % mod;
    exp = exp >> BigInt(1);
    base = (base * base) % mod;
  }
  return result;
}

function modInverse(a: bigint, m: bigint): bigint {
  const g = gcd(a < BigInt(0) ? -a : a, m);
  if (g !== BigInt(1)) throw new Error(`modInverse: ${a} has no inverse mod ${m}`);
  return modPow(a < BigInt(0) ? a + m : a, m - BigInt(2), m);
}

function gcd(a: bigint, b: bigint): bigint {
  while (b !== BigInt(0)) { [a, b] = [b, a % b]; }
  return a;
}

function mod(a: bigint, m: bigint): bigint {
  return ((a % m) + m) % m;
}

/** Constant-time BigInt comparison to resist timing attacks */
function ctEqual(a: bigint, b: bigint): boolean {
  const aStr = a.toString(16).padStart(128, '0');
  const bStr = b.toString(16).padStart(128, '0');
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < aStr.length; i++) {
    diff |= aStr.charCodeAt(i) ^ bStr.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  return diff === 0;
}

/** Cryptographically secure random bigint in [1, max-1] */
function randomBigInt(max: bigint): bigint {
  const byteLen = Math.ceil(max.toString(16).length / 2);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(byteLen);
  crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
  let result = BigInt(0);
  for (const b of bytes) result = (result << BigInt(8)) | BigInt(b);
  return (result % (max - BigInt(1))) + BigInt(1);
}

/** SHA-256 hash of concatenated bigints — returns bigint */
async function hashBigInts(...values: bigint[]): Promise<bigint> {
  const hex = values.map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(64, '0')).join('');
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(hex.match(/.{2}/g)!.map(b => parseInt(b, 16)));
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', bytes);
  const arr = new Uint8Array(hash);
  let result = BigInt(0);
  for (const b of arr) result = (result << BigInt(8)) | BigInt(b);
  return result;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Elliptic Curve Arithmetic (secp256k1)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function pointAdd(P: Point, Q: Point): Point {
  if (P.infinity) return Q;
  if (Q.infinity) return P;
  const p = SECP256K1.p;
  if (P.x === Q.x) {
    if (P.y !== Q.y) return INFINITY_POINT;
    return pointDouble(P);
  }
  const lambda = mod((Q.y - P.y) * modInverse(Q.x - P.x, p), p);
  const x3 = mod(lambda * lambda - P.x - Q.x, p);
  const y3 = mod(lambda * (P.x - x3) - P.y, p);
  return { x: x3, y: y3, infinity: false };
}

function pointDouble(P: Point): Point {
  if (P.infinity) return P;
  const p = SECP256K1.p;
  const lambda = mod((BigInt(3) * P.x * P.x + SECP256K1.a) * modInverse(BigInt(2) * P.y, p), p);
  const x3 = mod(lambda * lambda - BigInt(2) * P.x, p);
  const y3 = mod(lambda * (P.x - x3) - P.y, p);
  return { x: x3, y: y3, infinity: false };
}

function scalarMul(k: bigint, P: Point): Point {
  let result: Point = INFINITY_POINT;
  let addend = P;
  let scalar = mod(k, SECP256K1.n);
  while (scalar > BigInt(0)) {
    if (scalar & BigInt(1)) result = pointAdd(result, addend);
    addend = pointDouble(addend);
    scalar >>= BigInt(1);
  }
  return result;
}

function generatorPoint(): Point {
  return { x: SECP256K1.Gx, y: SECP256K1.Gy, infinity: false };
}

/** Verify point is on curve */
function isOnCurve(P: Point): boolean {
  if (P.infinity) return true;
  const p = SECP256K1.p;
  const lhs = mod(P.y * P.y, p);
  const rhs = mod(P.x * P.x * P.x + SECP256K1.b, p);
  return ctEqual(lhs, rhs);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 1. Feldman VSS — Verifiable Secret Sharing
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface FeldmanShare {
  index: number;           // party index i (1-based)
  value: bigint;           // f(i) — the share value
  commitments: Point[];    // C_j = a_j * G for j = 0..t
}

export interface FeldmanVSSResult {
  shares: FeldmanShare[];
  secret: bigint;
  publicKey: Point;        // a_0 * G = commitment to the secret
  polynomial: bigint[];    // [a_0, a_1, ..., a_t] — KEEP PRIVATE
}

export class FeldmanVSS {
  private readonly threshold: number;
  private readonly parties: number;
  private readonly G: Point;
  private readonly order: bigint;

  constructor(threshold: number, parties: number) {
    if (threshold < 1) throw new Error('Threshold must be at least 1');
    if (parties < threshold + 1) throw new Error(`Need at least ${threshold + 1} parties for (${threshold},${parties}) scheme`);
    this.threshold = threshold;
    this.parties = parties;
    this.G = generatorPoint();
    this.order = SECP256K1.n;
  }

  /**
   * Dealer: generate a secret and split into n shares with t-degree polynomial.
   * Commitments allow any party to verify their share without learning the secret.
   */
  deal(secret?: bigint): FeldmanVSSResult {
    const s = secret ?? randomBigInt(this.order);
    // Random polynomial f(x) = s + a_1*x + a_2*x^2 + ... + a_t*x^t
    const poly: bigint[] = [s];
    for (let i = 1; i <= this.threshold; i++) {
      poly.push(randomBigInt(this.order));
    }

    // Commitments C_j = a_j * G
    const commitments: Point[] = poly.map(coeff => scalarMul(coeff, this.G));

    // Shares: s_i = f(i) mod n
    const shares: FeldmanShare[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= this.parties; i++) {
      const xi = BigInt(i);
      let fi = BigInt(0);
      let xPow = BigInt(1);
      for (const coeff of poly) {
        fi = mod(fi + coeff * xPow, this.order);
        xPow = mod(xPow * xi, this.order);
      }
      shares.push({ index: i, value: fi, commitments });
    }

    return {
      shares,
      secret: s,
      publicKey: commitments[0],
      polynomial: poly,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Verify that a share is consistent with the public commitments.
   * s_i * G should equal sum_{j=0}^{t} C_j * i^j
   */
  verify(share: FeldmanShare): boolean {
    const { index, value, commitments } = share;
    const xi = BigInt(index);

    // Compute sum_{j=0}^{t} C_j * i^j
    let expected: Point = INFINITY_POINT;
    let xPow = BigInt(1);
    for (const C of commitments) {
      const term = scalarMul(xPow, C);
      expected = pointAdd(expected, term);
      xPow = mod(xPow * xi, this.order);
    }

    // Compute s_i * G
    const actual = scalarMul(value, this.G);

    if (actual.infinity || expected.infinity) return false;
    return ctEqual(actual.x, expected.x) && ctEqual(actual.y, expected.y);
  }

  /**
   * Reconstruct secret from t+1 shares using Lagrange interpolation.
   * Does NOT require all n shares.
   */
  reconstruct(shares: FeldmanShare[]): bigint {
    if (shares.length < this.threshold + 1) {
      throw new Error(`Need at least ${this.threshold + 1} shares, got ${shares.length}`);
    }

    const subset = shares.slice(0, this.threshold + 1);
    let secret = BigInt(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < subset.length; i++) {
      let numerator = BigInt(1);
      let denominator = BigInt(1);
      const xi = BigInt(subset[i].index);

      for (let j = 0; j < subset.length; j++) {
        if (i === j) continue;
        const xj = BigInt(subset[j].index);
        numerator = mod(numerator * (-xj), this.order);
        denominator = mod(denominator * (xi - xj), this.order);
      }

      const lagrange = mod(numerator * modInverse(denominator, this.order), this.order);
      secret = mod(secret + subset[i].value * lagrange, this.order);
    }

    return secret;
  }

  /** Reconstruct public key from public commitments (no secret needed) */
  reconstructPublicKey(commitmentSets: Point[][]): Point {
    let combined: Point = INFINITY_POINT;
    for (const commitments of commitmentSets) {
      combined = pointAdd(combined, commitments[0]); // C_0 = a_0 * G
    }
    return combined;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 2. Pedersen VSS — Unconditionally Hiding
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface PedersenShare {
  index: number;
  value: bigint;     // f(i)
  blindValue: bigint; // g(i) — blinding polynomial evaluation
  commitments: Point[]; // C_j = a_j*G + b_j*H
}

export interface PedersenVSSResult {
  shares: PedersenShare[];
  secret: bigint;
  publicCommitment: Point; // C_0 = secret*G + blind*H
  polynomial: bigint[];
  blindPoly: bigint[];
}

export class PedersenVSS {
  private readonly threshold: number;
  private readonly parties: number;
  private readonly G: Point;
  private readonly H: Point; // second independent generator
  private readonly order: bigint;

  constructor(threshold: number, parties: number) {
    this.threshold = threshold;
    this.parties = parties;
    this.G = generatorPoint();
    // H = hash_to_curve("UBE-Pedersen-H") — using a fixed nothing-up-my-sleeve point
    // In production: hash a public string to a curve point via try-and-increment
    this.H = scalarMul(
      BigInt('0x2CF24DBA5FB0A30E26E83B2AC5B9E29E1B161E5C1FA7425E73043362938B9824'),
      generatorPoint()
    );
    this.order = SECP256K1.n;
  }

  deal(secret?: bigint): PedersenVSSResult {
    const s = secret ?? randomBigInt(this.order);
    const blind = randomBigInt(this.order);

    const poly: bigint[] = [s];
    const blindPoly: bigint[] = [blind];
    for (let i = 1; i <= this.threshold; i++) {
      poly.push(randomBigInt(this.order));
      blindPoly.push(randomBigInt(this.order));
    }

    // C_j = a_j*G + b_j*H  (Pedersen commitment to each coefficient)
    const commitments: Point[] = poly.map((a, j) =>
      pointAdd(scalarMul(a, this.G), scalarMul(blindPoly[j], this.H))
    );

    const shares: PedersenShare[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= this.parties; i++) {
      const xi = BigInt(i);
      let fi = BigInt(0), gi = BigInt(0);
      let xPow = BigInt(1);
      for (let j = 0; j <= this.threshold; j++) {
        fi = mod(fi + poly[j] * xPow, this.order);
        gi = mod(gi + blindPoly[j] * xPow, this.order);
        xPow = mod(xPow * xi, this.order);
      }
      shares.push({ index: i, value: fi, blindValue: gi, commitments });
    }

    return { shares, secret: s, publicCommitment: commitments[0], polynomial: poly, blindPoly };
  }

  /**
   * Verify: f(i)*G + g(i)*H == sum_j C_j * i^j
   * Information-theoretically secure — even computationally unbounded adversary
   * cannot determine secret from commitments alone.
   */
  verify(share: PedersenShare): boolean {
    const { index, value, blindValue, commitments } = share;
    const xi = BigInt(index);

    let expected: Point = INFINITY_POINT;
    let xPow = BigInt(1);
    for (const C of commitments) {
      expected = pointAdd(expected, scalarMul(xPow, C));
      xPow = mod(xPow * xi, this.order);
    }

    const actual = pointAdd(scalarMul(value, this.G), scalarMul(blindValue, this.H));
    if (actual.infinity || expected.infinity) return false;
    return ctEqual(actual.x, expected.x) && ctEqual(actual.y, expected.y);
  }

  reconstruct(shares: PedersenShare[]): bigint {
    if (shares.length < this.threshold + 1) {
      throw new Error(`Need ${this.threshold + 1} shares`);
    }
    const subset = shares.slice(0, this.threshold + 1);
    let secret = BigInt(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < subset.length; i++) {
      let num = BigInt(1), den = BigInt(1);
      const xi = BigInt(subset[i].index);
      for (let j = 0; j < subset.length; j++) {
        if (i === j) continue;
        const xj = BigInt(subset[j].index);
        num = mod(num * (-xj), this.order);
        den = mod(den * (xi - xj), this.order);
      }
      secret = mod(secret + subset[i].value * mod(num * modInverse(den, this.order), this.order), this.order);
    }
    return secret;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 3. GJKR Secure DKG — Gennaro-Jarecki-Krawczyk-Rabin
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type DKGPartyState = 'initialized' | 'shared' | 'verified' | 'qualified' | 'complete' | 'aborted';

export interface GJKRParty {
  id: number;
  secretShare: bigint;
  publicKey: Point;
  qualifiedSet: Set<number>;
  state: DKGPartyState;
}

export interface GJKRRound1Message {
  from: number;
  commitments: Point[];        // Feldman commitments
  pedersenCommits: Point[];    // Pedersen commitments
  proof: SchnorrProof;         // NIZK proof of knowledge of secret
}

export interface GJKRRound2Message {
  from: number;
  to: number;
  shareValue: bigint;          // encrypted share s_{i,j}
  blindValue: bigint;          // encrypted blind t_{i,j}
}

export interface GJKRComplaint {
  complainant: number;
  accused: number;
  reason: string;
  evidence?: {
    share: bigint;
    blind: bigint;
  };
}

export interface SchnorrProof {
  R: Point;    // R = r*G
  s: bigint;   // s = r - challenge*secret
  challenge: bigint;
}

export interface GJKRDKGState {
  round1Messages: Map<number, GJKRRound1Message>;
  round2Messages: Map<string, GJKRRound2Message>; // key: "from-to"
  complaints: GJKRComplaint[];
  qualifiedSet: Set<number>;
  jointPublicKey?: Point;
  shares: Map<number, bigint>;
  phase: 'round1' | 'round2' | 'complaints' | 'complete';
}

export class GJKRSecureDKG {
  private readonly threshold: number;
  private readonly parties: number;
  private readonly order: bigint;
  private readonly G: Point;
  private state: GJKRDKGState;
  private feldmanVSS: FeldmanVSS;
  private pedersenVSS: PedersenVSS;

  constructor(threshold: number, parties: number) {
    if (parties <= 3 * threshold) {
      throw new Error(`GJKR requires n > 3t. Got n=${parties}, t=${threshold}`);
    }
    this.threshold = threshold;
    this.parties = parties;
    this.order = SECP256K1.n;
    this.G = generatorPoint();
    this.feldmanVSS = new FeldmanVSS(threshold, parties);
    this.pedersenVSS = new PedersenVSS(threshold, parties);
    this.state = {
      round1Messages: new Map(),
      round2Messages: new Map(),
      complaints: [],
      qualifiedSet: new Set(),
      shares: new Map(),
      phase: 'round1',
    };
  }

  /** Round 1: Each party i generates their VSS deal and NIZK proof */
  async generateRound1(partyId: number, secret?: bigint): Promise<{
    round1: GJKRRound1Message;
    shares: FeldmanShare[];
    pedersenShares: PedersenShare[];
  }> {
    const feldman = this.feldmanVSS.deal(secret);
    const pedersen = this.pedersenVSS.deal(feldman.secret);
    const proof = await this.generateSchnorrProof(feldman.secret);

    const round1: GJKRRound1Message = {
      from: partyId,
      commitments: feldman.shares[0].commitments,
      pedersenCommits: pedersen.shares[0].commitments,
      proof,
    };

    return { round1, shares: feldman.shares, pedersenShares: pedersen.shares };
  }

  /** Generate Schnorr NIZK proof of knowledge: prove knowledge of x s.t. X = x*G */
  async generateSchnorrProof(secret: bigint): Promise<SchnorrProof> {
    const r = randomBigInt(this.order);
    const R = scalarMul(r, this.G);
    const X = scalarMul(secret, this.G);

    // Fiat-Shamir challenge: H(G || X || R)
    const challenge = mod(
      await hashBigInts(this.G.x, this.G.y, X.x, X.y, R.x, R.y),
      this.order
    );
    const s = mod(r - challenge * secret, this.order);

    return { R, s, challenge };
  }

  /** Verify Schnorr proof: s*G + challenge*X == R */
  verifySchnorrProof(proof: SchnorrProof, publicKey: Point): boolean {
    if (!isOnCurve(proof.R) || !isOnCurve(publicKey)) return false;
    const sG = scalarMul(proof.s, this.G);
    const cX = scalarMul(proof.challenge, publicKey);
    const expected = pointAdd(sG, cX);
    if (expected.infinity) return false;
    return ctEqual(expected.x, proof.R.x) && ctEqual(expected.y, proof.R.y);
  }

  /** Round 1 verification: validate all received messages */
  processRound1(messages: GJKRRound1Message[]): { valid: Set<number>; invalid: Set<number> } {
    const valid = new Set<number>();
    const invalid = new Set<number>();

    for (const msg of messages) {
      this.state.round1Messages.set(msg.from, msg);
      // Verify NIZK proof
      const publicKey = msg.commitments[0]; // C_0 = a_0 * G
      if (this.verifySchnorrProof(msg.proof, publicKey)) {
        valid.add(msg.from);
      } else {
        invalid.add(msg.from);
      }
    }

    return { valid, invalid };
  }

  /** Round 2: verify received shares, raise complaints if invalid */
  processRound2(
    partyId: number,
    receivedShares: FeldmanShare[],
    receivedPedersenShares: PedersenShare[],
    round1Messages: GJKRRound1Message[]
  ): GJKRComplaint[] {
    const complaints: GJKRComplaint[] = [];
    const r1Map = new Map(round1Messages.map(m => [m.from, m]));

    for (let i = 0; i < receivedShares.length; i++) {
      const fShare = receivedShares[i];
      const pShare = receivedPedersenShares[i];
      const r1 = r1Map.get(fShare.index);
      if (!r1) continue;

      // Override commitments from round 1 broadcast
      fShare.commitments = r1.commitments;
      pShare.commitments = r1.pedersenCommits;

      if (!this.feldmanVSS.verify(fShare) || !this.pedersenVSS.verify(pShare)) {
        complaints.push({
          complainant: partyId,
          accused: fShare.index,
          reason: 'Invalid share: VSS verification failed',
          evidence: { share: fShare.value, blind: pShare.blindValue },
        });
      }
    }

    this.state.complaints.push(...complaints);
    return complaints;
  }

  /**
   * Complaint resolution: determine qualified set QUAL.
   * Party j is disqualified if they have > t valid complaints against them.
   * Their secret is publicly reconstructed from revealed shares if they are dealer.
   */
  resolveComplaints(allParties: Set<number>): Set<number> {
    const complaintCount = new Map<number, number>();
    for (const c of this.state.complaints) {
      complaintCount.set(c.accused, (complaintCount.get(c.accused) ?? 0) + 1);
    }

    const qualified = new Set<number>();
    for (const p of allParties) {
      const count = complaintCount.get(p) ?? 0;
      if (count <= this.threshold) {
        qualified.add(p);
      }
    }

    if (qualified.size < this.threshold + 1) {
      throw new Error(`DKG failed: qualified set too small (${qualified.size} < ${this.threshold + 1})`);
    }

    this.state.qualifiedSet = qualified;
    return qualified;
  }

  /**
   * Final step: compute joint public key from qualified set.
   * pk = sum_{i in QUAL} C_{i,0}  (sum of each party's constant commitment)
   */
  computeJointPublicKey(qualifiedCommitments: Map<number, Point[]>): Point {
    let pk: Point = INFINITY_POINT;
    for (const [partyId, commits] of qualifiedCommitments) {
      if (this.state.qualifiedSet.has(partyId)) {
        pk = pointAdd(pk, commits[0]);
      }
    }
    this.state.jointPublicKey = pk;
    return pk;
  }

  /**
   * Compute party j's share of the joint secret.
   * x_j = sum_{i in QUAL} s_{i,j}
   */
  computeJointShare(receivedShares: Map<number, bigint>): bigint {
    let share = BigInt(0);
    for (const [partyId, s] of receivedShares) {
      if (this.state.qualifiedSet.has(partyId)) {
        share = mod(share + s, this.order);
      }
    }
    return share;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 4. Threshold BLS Signatures (BLS12-381)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface BLSKeyShare {
  index: number;
  privateShare: bigint;
  publicShare: Point;  // sk_i * G
  groupPublicKey: Point;
}

export interface BLSSignatureShare {
  index: number;
  sigma: Point;  // sk_i * H(m) — partial signature
}

export interface BLSThresholdSignature {
  sigma: Point;  // aggregated threshold signature
  signers: number[];
  message: Uint8Array;
}

export class ThresholdBLS {
  private readonly threshold: number;
  private readonly parties: number;
  private readonly order: bigint;
  private readonly G: Point;
  private readonly feldman: FeldmanVSS;

  constructor(threshold: number, parties: number) {
    this.threshold = threshold;
    this.parties = parties;
    this.order = SECP256K1.n;
    this.G = generatorPoint();
    this.feldman = new FeldmanVSS(threshold, parties);
  }

  /** Distributed key generation for BLS */
  async keyGen(): Promise<{ shares: BLSKeyShare[]; groupPublicKey: Point }> {
    // Each party runs VSS; aggregate public key = sum of individual keys
    const deal = this.feldman.deal();
    const groupPublicKey = deal.publicKey;

    const shares: BLSKeyShare[] = deal.shares.map(s => ({
      index: s.index,
      privateShare: s.value,
      publicShare: scalarMul(s.value, this.G),
      groupPublicKey,
    }));

    return { shares, groupPublicKey };
  }

  /** Hash message to curve point (hash-to-curve using try-and-increment) */
  async hashToPoint(message: Uint8Array): Promise<Point> {
    // Simplified: in production use BLS12-381 hash_to_curve per RFC 9380
    const msgHash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', message);
    const arr = new Uint8Array(msgHash);
    let x = BigInt(0);
    for (const b of arr) x = (x << BigInt(8)) | BigInt(b);
    x = mod(x, SECP256K1.p);

    // Try-and-increment to find valid curve point
    for (let attempt = 0n; attempt < 100n; attempt++) {
      const xTry = mod(x + attempt, SECP256K1.p);
      const rhs = mod(xTry * xTry * xTry + SECP256K1.b, SECP256K1.p);
      const y2 = rhs;
      // Check if y2 is a quadratic residue
      const legendreExp = (SECP256K1.p - BigInt(1)) / BigInt(2);
      const legendre = modPow(y2, legendreExp, SECP256K1.p);
      if (legendre === BigInt(1)) {
        const yExp = (SECP256K1.p + BigInt(1)) / BigInt(4);
        const y = modPow(y2, yExp, SECP256K1.p);
        return { x: xTry, y, infinity: false };
      }
    }
    throw new Error('hash_to_curve failed after 100 attempts');
  }

  /** Partial sign: sigma_i = sk_i * H(m) */
  async partialSign(share: BLSKeyShare, message: Uint8Array): Promise<BLSSignatureShare> {
    const H = await this.hashToPoint(message);
    const sigma = scalarMul(share.privateShare, H);
    return { index: share.index, sigma };
  }

  /** Verify a partial signature */
  async verifyPartial(
    partialSig: BLSSignatureShare,
    publicShare: Point,
    message: Uint8Array
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    // Verify: e(sigma_i, G) == e(H(m), pk_i)
    // Simplified pairing check via scalar equality (full BLS requires pairing)
    const H = await this.hashToPoint(message);
    // In full BLS12-381: e(sigma, G) == e(H, pk)
    // Approximation for demo — production uses actual pairing
    const lhs = scalarMul(BigInt(1), partialSig.sigma); // Would be pairing result
    const rhs = scalarMul(BigInt(1), scalarMul(partialSig.index, H));
    return isOnCurve(partialSig.sigma) && isOnCurve(publicShare);
  }

  /**
   * Aggregate t+1 partial signatures using Lagrange interpolation in the exponent.
   * sigma = sum_{i in S} lambda_i * sigma_i  (where lambda_i is Lagrange coefficient)
   */
  aggregate(partials: BLSSignatureShare[]): BLSThresholdSignature {
    if (partials.length < this.threshold + 1) {
      throw new Error(`Need ${this.threshold + 1} partial signatures`);
    }

    const subset = partials.slice(0, this.threshold + 1);
    let sigma: Point = INFINITY_POINT;

    for (let i = 0; i < subset.length; i++) {
      let num = BigInt(1), den = BigInt(1);
      const xi = BigInt(subset[i].index);
      for (let j = 0; j < subset.length; j++) {
        if (i === j) continue;
        const xj = BigInt(subset[j].index);
        num = mod(num * (-xj), this.order);
        den = mod(den * (xi - xj), this.order);
      }
      const lambda = mod(num * modInverse(den, this.order), this.order);
      sigma = pointAdd(sigma, scalarMul(lambda, subset[i].sigma));
    }

    return {
      sigma,
      signers: subset.map(p => p.index),
      message: new Uint8Array(),
    };
  }

  /** Verify threshold signature against group public key */
  async verifyThreshold(
    sig: BLSThresholdSignature,
    groupPK: Point,
    message: Uint8Array
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const H = await this.hashToPoint(message);
    // Full BLS verify: e(sigma, G) == e(H(m), groupPK)
    // Production: uses BLS12-381 pairing
    return isOnCurve(sig.sigma) && isOnCurve(groupPK);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 5. Threshold ECDSA (GG20 Protocol — Gennaro & Goldfeder 2020)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ECDSAKeyShare {
  index: number;
  xi: bigint;          // additive share of secret key
  Xi: Point;           // xi * G — public verification share
  groupPublicKey: Point;
  paillierKey?: PaillierKeyPair; // for maliciously secure version
}

export interface ECDSASignatureShare {
  index: number;
  r: bigint;    // partial r
  si: bigint;   // partial s contribution
  Ri: Point;    // ki^{-1} * G
}

export interface ECDSAThresholdSig {
  r: bigint;
  s: bigint;
  v: number; // recovery bit
}

export interface PaillierKeyPair {
  n: bigint;
  lambda: bigint;
  mu: bigint;
  nSquared: bigint;
}

export class ThresholdECDSA {
  private readonly threshold: number;
  private readonly parties: number;
  private readonly order: bigint;
  private readonly G: Point;
  private readonly feldman: FeldmanVSS;

  constructor(threshold: number, parties: number) {
    this.threshold = threshold;
    this.parties = parties;
    this.order = SECP256K1.n;
    this.G = generatorPoint();
    this.feldman = new FeldmanVSS(threshold, parties);
  }

  /** Phase 1: Distributed key generation */
  keyGen(): { shares: ECDSAKeyShare[]; groupPublicKey: Point } {
    const deal = this.feldman.deal();
    const groupPublicKey = deal.publicKey;

    const shares: ECDSAKeyShare[] = deal.shares.map(s => ({
      index: s.index,
      xi: s.value,
      Xi: scalarMul(s.value, this.G),
      groupPublicKey,
    }));

    return { shares, groupPublicKey };
  }

  /**
   * Phase 2: Distributed signing — Round 1
   * Each signer i generates ephemeral key ki, computes Ri = ki^{-1} * G
   * and broadcasts commitment to Ri.
   */
  signRound1(share: ECDSAKeyShare): {
    ki: bigint;
    gammaI: bigint;
    Ri: Point;
    commitment: bigint;
  } {
    // ki and gammaI are random nonce shares
    // k = sum(ki) but we use multiplicative sharing in GG20
    const ki = randomBigInt(this.order);
    const gammaI = randomBigInt(this.order);
    const Ri = scalarMul(modInverse(ki, this.order), this.G);

    // Commitment: hash(Ri) — revealed in round 2 to prevent rushing
    const commitment = mod(Ri.x ^ Ri.y, this.order);

    return { ki, gammaI, Ri, commitment };
  }

  /**
   * Phase 3: Distributed signing — compute R = (sum gammaI * G) properly
   * In GG20, parties run MtA (Multiplicative-to-Additive) sub-protocol
   * to convert multiplicative shares to additive shares for s.
   */
  signRound2(
    share: ECDSAKeyShare,
    ki: bigint,
    gammaI: bigint,
    allRi: Map<number, Point>,
    message: Uint8Array
  ): { deltaI: bigint; sigmaI: bigint } {
    // Simplified GG20 — production requires full MtA with Paillier encryption
    // deltaI = ki * gammaI mod n  (MtA result for delta)
    // sigmaI = ki * xi mod n      (MtA result for sigma)
    const deltaI = mod(ki * gammaI, this.order);
    const sigmaI = mod(ki * share.xi, this.order);
    return { deltaI, sigmaI };
  }

  /**
   * Phase 4: Final signature computation
   * r = R.x mod n
   * s = k^{-1} * (m + r * x) mod n  — threshold version uses additive shares
   */
  async finalizeSignature(
    message: Uint8Array,
    deltaShares: bigint[],     // additive shares of k*gamma
    sigmaShares: bigint[],     // additive shares of k*x
    gammaG: Point,             // sum(gammaI * G)
    groupPublicKey: Point
  ): Promise<ECDSAThresholdSig> {
    // Reconstruct delta = sum(deltaI)
    const delta = deltaShares.reduce((acc, d) => mod(acc + d, this.order), BigInt(0));

    // R = delta^{-1} * Gamma where Gamma = sum(gammaI * G)
    const R = scalarMul(modInverse(delta, this.order), gammaG);
    const r = mod(R.x, this.order);
    if (r === BigInt(0)) throw new Error('Invalid r: 0');

    // Hash message
    const msgHash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', message);
    const m = mod(
      Array.from(new Uint8Array(msgHash)).reduce((acc, b) => (acc << BigInt(8)) | BigInt(b), BigInt(0)),
      this.order
    );

    // s = sum(sigmaI) * (m + r*...) — simplified
    const sigma = sigmaShares.reduce((acc, s) => mod(acc + s, this.order), BigInt(0));
    const s = mod(modInverse(sigma, this.order) * m, this.order);

    const v = R.y % BigInt(2) === BigInt(0) ? 0 : 1;
    return { r, s, v };
  }

  /** Verify ECDSA signature against group public key */
  async verify(sig: ECDSAThresholdSig, message: Uint8Array, publicKey: Point): Promise<boolean> {
    const msgHash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', message);
    const m = mod(
      Array.from(new Uint8Array(msgHash)).reduce((acc, b) => (acc << BigInt(8)) | BigInt(b), BigInt(0)),
      this.order
    );

    if (sig.r <= BigInt(0) || sig.r >= this.order) return false;
    if (sig.s <= BigInt(0) || sig.s >= this.order) return false;

    const sInv = modInverse(sig.s, this.order);
    const u1 = mod(m * sInv, this.order);
    const u2 = mod(sig.r * sInv, this.order);

    const P = pointAdd(scalarMul(u1, this.G), scalarMul(u2, publicKey));
    if (P.infinity) return false;

    return ctEqual(mod(P.x, this.order), sig.r);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 6. PVSS — Publicly Verifiable Secret Sharing (Schoenmakers 1999)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface PVSSEncryptedShare {
  index: number;
  Y: Point;     // s_i * G — encrypted share on curve
  proof: ChaumPedersenProof; // NIZK proof of correct encryption
}

export interface ChaumPedersenProof {
  a1: Point;   // r * G
  a2: Point;   // r * pk_i
  z: bigint;   // r - challenge * secret
  challenge: bigint;
}

export interface PVSSPublicParams {
  commitments: Point[];
  encryptedShares: PVSSEncryptedShare[];
  groupPublicKey: Point;
}

export class PVSS {
  private readonly threshold: number;
  private readonly parties: number;
  private readonly order: bigint;
  private readonly G: Point;

  constructor(threshold: number, parties: number) {
    this.threshold = threshold;
    this.parties = parties;
    this.order = SECP256K1.n;
    this.G = generatorPoint();
  }

  /**
   * Distribute: dealer splits secret and produces publicly verifiable encrypted shares.
   * Anyone can verify the distribution without knowing the secret.
   */
  async distribute(
    secret: bigint,
    publicKeys: Point[]
  ): Promise<PVSSPublicParams> {
    const poly: bigint[] = [secret];
    for (let i = 1; i <= this.threshold; i++) poly.push(randomBigInt(this.order));

    const commitments: Point[] = poly.map(c => scalarMul(c, this.G));

    const encryptedShares: PVSSEncryptedShare[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.parties; i++) {
      const xi = BigInt(i + 1);
      let si = BigInt(0);
      let xPow = BigInt(1);
      for (const c of poly) {
        si = mod(si + c * xPow, this.order);
        xPow = mod(xPow * xi, this.order);
      }

      // Encrypt: Y_i = si * pk_i
      const Y = scalarMul(si, publicKeys[i]);

      // NIZK proof of correct encryption via Chaum-Pedersen
      const proof = await this.proveEncryption(si, publicKeys[i], Y);
      encryptedShares.push({ index: i + 1, Y, proof });
    }

    const groupPublicKey = commitments[0];
    return { commitments, encryptedShares, groupPublicKey };
  }

  /** Prove: Y = si * pk AND C_eval = si * G (same si) */
  async proveEncryption(si: bigint, pk: Point, Y: Point): Promise<ChaumPedersenProof> {
    const r = randomBigInt(this.order);
    const a1 = scalarMul(r, this.G);
    const a2 = scalarMul(r, pk);

    const challenge = mod(
      await hashBigInts(this.G.x, pk.x, Y.x, a1.x, a2.x),
      this.order
    );
    const z = mod(r - challenge * si, this.order);

    return { a1, a2, z, challenge };
  }

  /** Verify: anyone can check the distribution is correct */
  async verify(params: PVSSPublicParams, publicKeys: Point[]): Promise<boolean> {
    for (let i = 0; i < params.encryptedShares.length; i++) {
      const enc = params.encryptedShares[i];
      const pk = publicKeys[i];
      const { a1, a2, z, challenge } = enc.proof;

      // Check a1 == z*G + challenge*(si*G)
      // First compute si*G from polynomial evaluation
      const xi = BigInt(enc.index);
      let CiEval: Point = INFINITY_POINT;
      let xPow = BigInt(1);
      for (const C of params.commitments) {
        CiEval = pointAdd(CiEval, scalarMul(xPow, C));
        xPow = mod(xPow * xi, this.order);
      }

      const lhs1 = pointAdd(scalarMul(z, this.G), scalarMul(challenge, CiEval));
      const lhs2 = pointAdd(scalarMul(z, pk), scalarMul(challenge, enc.Y));

      if (!ctEqual(lhs1.x, a1.x) || !ctEqual(lhs2.x, a2.x)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  /** Reconstruct: party i decrypts their share using their private key */
  decryptShare(encShare: PVSSEncryptedShare, privateKey: bigint): bigint {
    // si*G = si_pk * G decrypted via: Y / pk_i = (si * pk_i) / (sk_i * G)
    // Simplified: in practice the share is the discrete log which is hard
    // PVSS operates on the curve — reconstruction is done in the exponent
    const skInv = modInverse(privateKey, this.order);
    const siG = scalarMul(skInv, encShare.Y); // si * G
    return mod(siG.x, this.order); // Placeholder — actual DL computation
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 7. Proactive Secret Sharing
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ProactiveEpoch {
  epochId: number;
  startTime: number;
  endTime: number;
  refreshShares: Map<number, bigint>; // new additive blinding for each party
  active: boolean;
}

export interface ProactiveShare {
  partyId: number;
  epochId: number;
  share: bigint;    // refreshed share
  commitment: Point; // commitment to share
}

export interface RefreshMessage {
  from: number;
  to: number;
  delta: bigint;      // additive share of zero-secret
  commitment: Point;  // Feldman commitment to delta
}

export class ProactiveSecretSharing {
  private readonly threshold: number;
  private readonly parties: number;
  private readonly order: bigint;
  private readonly G: Point;
  private readonly epochDurationMs: number;
  private epochs: Map<number, ProactiveEpoch>;
  private currentEpoch: number;
  private feldman: FeldmanVSS;

  constructor(threshold: number, parties: number, epochDurationMs = 3_600_000) {
    this.threshold = threshold;
    this.parties = parties;
    this.order = SECP256K1.n;
    this.G = generatorPoint();
    this.epochDurationMs = epochDurationMs;
    this.epochs = new Map();
    this.currentEpoch = 0;
    this.feldman = new FeldmanVSS(threshold, parties);
  }

  /** Initialize epoch 0 from initial shares */
  initializeEpoch(initialShares: bigint[]): ProactiveEpoch {
    const now = Date.now();
    const epoch: ProactiveEpoch = {
      epochId: 0,
      startTime: now,
      endTime: now + this.epochDurationMs,
      refreshShares: new Map(initialShares.map((s, i) => [i + 1, s])),
      active: true,
    };
    this.epochs.set(0, epoch);
    return epoch;
  }

  /**
   * Refresh protocol: each party i generates a random sharing of ZERO
   * and distributes additive shares to all other parties.
   * New share = old share + sum of received zero-sharings.
   * The underlying secret is unchanged; old shares become useless.
   */
  generateRefreshMessages(partyId: number, epochId: number): RefreshMessage[] {
    // Generate random polynomial with zero constant term: p(0) = 0
    const zeroPoly: bigint[] = [BigInt(0)];
    for (let i = 1; i <= this.threshold; i++) {
      zeroPoly.push(randomBigInt(this.order));
    }

    const messages: RefreshMessage[] = [];
    for (let j = 1; j <= this.parties; j++) {
      const xj = BigInt(j);
      let delta = BigInt(0);
      let xPow = BigInt(1);
      for (const c of zeroPoly) {
        delta = mod(delta + c * xPow, this.order);
        xPow = mod(xPow * xj, this.order);
      }

      const commitment = scalarMul(delta, this.G);
      messages.push({ from: partyId, to: j, delta, commitment });
    }

    return messages;
  }

  /**
   * Apply refresh: add all received deltas to current share.
   * Key property: sum of all zero-polynomial evaluations at any point = 0
   * Therefore: new_share = old_share + 0 = same secret, new share values.
   */
  applyRefresh(
    currentShare: bigint,
    receivedMessages: RefreshMessage[],
    expectedCommitments: Map<number, Point[]>
  ): { newShare: bigint; valid: boolean } {
    // Verify all received messages
    for (const msg of receivedMessages) {
      const expected = expectedCommitments.get(msg.from);
      if (!expected) continue;

      // Verify commitment
      const computed = scalarMul(msg.delta, this.G);
      if (!ctEqual(computed.x, msg.commitment.x)) {
        return { newShare: BigInt(0), valid: false };
      }
    }

    // Sum all deltas
    const totalDelta = receivedMessages.reduce(
      (acc, msg) => mod(acc + msg.delta, this.order),
      BigInt(0)
    );

    const newShare = mod(currentShare + totalDelta, this.order);
    return { newShare, valid: true };
  }

  /** Schedule next epoch — call at epoch boundary */
  scheduleNextEpoch(): ProactiveEpoch {
    const prev = this.epochs.get(this.currentEpoch);
    if (!prev) throw new Error('No current epoch');

    prev.active = false;
    this.currentEpoch++;

    const now = Date.now();
    const next: ProactiveEpoch = {
      epochId: this.currentEpoch,
      startTime: now,
      endTime: now + this.epochDurationMs,
      refreshShares: new Map(),
      active: true,
    };
    this.epochs.set(this.currentEpoch, next);
    return next;
  }

  /** Verify proactive security: t-compromise in any epoch does not break security */
  proactiveSecurityAnalysis(compromisedParties: Map<number, Set<number>>): {
    secure: boolean;
    vulnerableEpochs: number[];
    reason: string;
  } {
    const vulnerableEpochs: number[] = [];

    for (const [epochId, compromised] of compromisedParties) {
      if (compromised.size > this.threshold) {
        vulnerableEpochs.push(epochId);
      }
    }

    return {
      secure: vulnerableEpochs.length === 0,
      vulnerableEpochs,
      reason: vulnerableEpochs.length === 0
        ? `Proactively secure: no single epoch has >${this.threshold} compromised parties`
        : `Vulnerable in epochs: ${vulnerableEpochs.join(', ')}`,
    };
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 8. Asynchronous DKG (Kate-Huang-Goldberg ADKG)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type AsyncMessageType =
  | 'PROPOSE'
  | 'ECHO'
  | 'READY'
  | 'SHARE'
  | 'COMPLETE';

export interface AsyncDKGMessage {
  type: AsyncMessageType;
  from: number;
  epochId: string;
  payload: AsyncMessagePayload;
  signature: AsyncSig;
}

export interface AsyncMessagePayload {
  commitments?: Point[];
  shares?: Map<number, bigint>;
  proof?: SchnorrProof;
  readyCount?: number;
  echoCount?: number;
  value?: bigint;
}

export interface AsyncSig {
  r: bigint;
  s: bigint;
}

export interface AsyncDKGPartyState {
  partyId: number;
  phase: 'idle' | 'proposing' | 'echoing' | 'ready' | 'complete';
  receivedEchos: Map<number, AsyncDKGMessage>;
  receivedReadys: Map<number, AsyncDKGMessage>;
  receivedShares: Map<number, bigint>;
  output?: bigint; // party's share of the joint DKG key
}

/**
 * Asynchronous DKG tolerates f Byzantine faults with n >= 3f+1 parties.
 * Does NOT require synchrony — works over asynchronous networks.
 * Based on reliable broadcast (Bracha's protocol) + VSS.
 */
export class AsyncDKG {
  private readonly threshold: number;
  private readonly parties: number;
  private readonly faultTolerance: number; // f = floor((n-1)/3)
  private readonly order: bigint;
  private readonly G: Point;
  private readonly feldman: FeldmanVSS;
  private partyStates: Map<number, AsyncDKGPartyState>;

  constructor(threshold: number, parties: number) {
    if (parties < 3 * threshold + 1) {
      throw new Error(`Async DKG requires n >= 3f+1. Got n=${parties}, f=${threshold}`);
    }
    this.threshold = threshold;
    this.parties = parties;
    this.faultTolerance = Math.floor((parties - 1) / 3);
    this.order = SECP256K1.n;
    this.G = generatorPoint();
    this.feldman = new FeldmanVSS(threshold, parties);
    this.partyStates = new Map();
  }

  /** Initialize party state */
  initParty(partyId: number): AsyncDKGPartyState {
    const state: AsyncDKGPartyState = {
      partyId,
      phase: 'idle',
      receivedEchos: new Map(),
      receivedReadys: new Map(),
      receivedShares: new Map(),
    };
    this.partyStates.set(partyId, state);
    return state;
  }

  /**
   * PROPOSE phase: party i runs VSS deal and broadcasts to all
   * This starts Bracha reliable broadcast
   */
  async propose(partyId: number): Promise<{
    messages: AsyncDKGMessage[];
    epochId: string;
  }> {
    const deal = this.feldman.deal();
    const proof = await this.generateProof(deal.secret);
    const epochId = `epoch-${partyId}-${Date.now()}`;

    const state = this.partyStates.get(partyId);
    if (state) state.phase = 'proposing';

    const sharesMap = new Map<number, bigint>();
    deal.shares.forEach(s => sharesMap.set(s.index, s.value));

    const msg: AsyncDKGMessage = {
      type: 'PROPOSE',
      from: partyId,
      epochId,
      payload: {
        commitments: deal.shares[0].commitments,
        shares: sharesMap,
        proof,
      },
      signature: await this.sign(partyId, epochId),
    };

    return { messages: [msg], epochId };
  }

  /** ECHO phase: upon receiving valid PROPOSE, broadcast ECHO */
  async processPropose(
    receiver: number,
    msg: AsyncDKGMessage
  ): Promise<AsyncDKGMessage | null> {
    if (msg.type !== 'PROPOSE') return null;

    // Verify VSS commitments and NIZK proof
    const share = msg.payload.shares?.get(receiver);
    const commitments = msg.payload.commitments;
    if (!share || !commitments) return null;

    const feldmanShare: FeldmanShare = { index: receiver, value: share, commitments };
    if (!this.feldman.verify(feldmanShare)) return null;
    if (msg.payload.proof && !this.verifyProof(msg.payload.proof, commitments[0])) return null;

    const echoMsg: AsyncDKGMessage = {
      type: 'ECHO',
      from: receiver,
      epochId: msg.epochId,
      payload: { value: share, commitments },
      signature: await this.sign(receiver, msg.epochId),
    };

    const state = this.partyStates.get(receiver);
    if (state) state.phase = 'echoing';

    return echoMsg;
  }

  /** READY phase: upon receiving n-f ECHOs, broadcast READY */
  async processEchos(
    receiver: number,
    echos: AsyncDKGMessage[]
  ): Promise<AsyncDKGMessage | null> {
    const state = this.partyStates.get(receiver);
    if (!state) return null;

    for (const echo of echos) {
      state.receivedEchos.set(echo.from, echo);
    }

    const echoThreshold = this.parties - this.faultTolerance; // n - f
    if (state.receivedEchos.size < echoThreshold) return null;

    const readyMsg: AsyncDKGMessage = {
      type: 'READY',
      from: receiver,
      epochId: echos[0]?.epochId ?? '',
      payload: { echoCount: state.receivedEchos.size },
      signature: await this.sign(receiver, echos[0]?.epochId ?? ''),
    };

    state.phase = 'ready';
    return readyMsg;
  }

  /** COMPLETE phase: upon receiving f+1 READYs, output share */
  async processReadys(
    receiver: number,
    readys: AsyncDKGMessage[],
    proposalShares: Map<number, bigint>
  ): Promise<{ complete: boolean; share?: bigint }> {
    const state = this.partyStates.get(receiver);
    if (!state) return { complete: false };

    for (const ready of readys) {
      state.receivedReadys.set(ready.from, ready);
    }

    const readyThreshold = this.faultTolerance + 1; // f + 1
    if (state.receivedReadys.size < readyThreshold) return { complete: false };

    // Upon receiving f+1 READYs: accept the proposal
    // Compute joint share = sum of all accepted dealer shares
    let jointShare = BigInt(0);
    for (const [, s] of proposalShares) {
      jointShare = mod(jointShare + s, this.order);
    }

    state.output = jointShare;
    state.phase = 'complete';

    return { complete: true, share: jointShare };
  }

  private async generateProof(secret: bigint): Promise<SchnorrProof> {
    const r = randomBigInt(this.order);
    const R = scalarMul(r, this.G);
    const X = scalarMul(secret, this.G);
    const challenge = mod(await hashBigInts(X.x, R.x, R.y), this.order);
    const s = mod(r - challenge * secret, this.order);
    return { R, s, challenge };
  }

  private verifyProof(proof: SchnorrProof, publicKey: Point): boolean {
    if (!isOnCurve(proof.R) || !isOnCurve(publicKey)) return false;
    const sG = scalarMul(proof.s, this.G);
    const cX = scalarMul(proof.challenge, publicKey);
    const expected = pointAdd(sG, cX);
    if (expected.infinity) return false;
    return ctEqual(expected.x, proof.R.x) && ctEqual(expected.y, proof.R.y);
  }

  private async sign(partyId: number, data: string): Promise<AsyncSig> {
    const k = randomBigInt(this.order);
    const R = scalarMul(k, this.G);
    const msgBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(`${partyId}:${data}`);
    const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', msgBytes);
    const m = mod(
      Array.from(new Uint8Array(hash)).reduce((acc, b) => (acc << BigInt(8)) | BigInt(b), BigInt(0)),
      this.order
    );
    const r = mod(R.x, this.order);
    const s = mod(modInverse(k, this.order) * (m + r * BigInt(partyId)), this.order);
    return { r, s };
  }

  /** Get network stats for this DKG session */
  networkStats(): {
    totalParties: number;
    faultTolerance: number;
    threshold: number;
    requiredForCompletion: number;
    messageComplexity: string;
  } {
    return {
      totalParties: this.parties,
      faultTolerance: this.faultTolerance,
      threshold: this.threshold,
      requiredForCompletion: this.threshold + 1,
      messageComplexity: `O(n^2)`,
    };
  }
}

export type DKGProtocol =
  | 'feldman-vss'
  | 'pedersen-vss'
  | 'gjkr'
  | 'threshold-bls'
  | 'threshold-ecdsa'
  | 'pvss'
  | 'proactive'
  | 'async-dkg';

export interface DKGConfig {
  protocol: DKGProtocol;
  threshold: number;
  parties: number;
  epochDurationMs?: number;
  requireMaliciousSecurity?: boolean;
  requireAsynchrony?: boolean;
}

export interface DKGSession {
  sessionId: string;
  config: DKGConfig;
  createdAt: number;
  status: 'active' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'aborted';
  jointPublicKey?: Point;
  parties: Set<number>;
  auditLog: DKGAuditEntry[];
}

export interface DKGAuditEntry {
  timestamp: number;
  event: string;
  partyId?: number;
  details: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface DKGHealthReport {
  sessionId: string;
  protocol: DKGProtocol;
  totalParties: number;
  threshold: number;
  activeParties: number;
  faultTolerance: number;
  epochsCompleted: number;
  lastRefreshTime?: number;
  proactiveSecurity: boolean;
  maliciousSecurity: boolean;
  byzantineFaultTolerant: boolean;
  quantumResistant: boolean;
  securityLevel: number; // bits
  estimatedAttackCost: string;
}

export class DKGOrchestrator {
  private sessions: Map<string, DKGSession>;
  private protocols: Map<DKGProtocol, unknown>;

  constructor() {
    this.sessions = new Map();
    this.protocols = new Map();
  }

  /** Create a new DKG session */
  createSession(config: DKGConfig): DKGSession {
    const sessionId = this.generateSessionId();
    const session: DKGSession = {
      sessionId,
      config,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      status: 'active',
      parties: new Set(Array.from({ length: config.parties }, (_, i) => i + 1)),
      auditLog: [],
    };

    this.sessions.set(sessionId, session);
    this.audit(session, 'SESSION_CREATED', undefined, { config });

    return session;
  }

  /** Run Feldman VSS deal and verify all shares */
  runFeldmanVSS(sessionId: string, secret?: bigint): {
    result: FeldmanVSSResult;
    allValid: boolean;
    invalidParties: number[];
  } {
    const session = this.getSession(sessionId);
    const vss = new FeldmanVSS(session.config.threshold, session.config.parties);
    const result = vss.deal(secret);

    const invalidParties: number[] = [];
    for (const share of result.shares) {
      if (!vss.verify(share)) invalidParties.push(share.index);
    }

    this.audit(session, 'FELDMAN_VSS_COMPLETE', undefined, {
      publicKey: result.publicKey.x.toString(16),
      invalidCount: invalidParties.length,
    });

    return { result, allValid: invalidParties.length === 0, invalidParties };
  }

  /** Run Pedersen VSS */
  runPedersenVSS(sessionId: string, secret?: bigint): {
    result: PedersenVSSResult;
    allValid: boolean;
  } {
    const session = this.getSession(sessionId);
    const vss = new PedersenVSS(session.config.threshold, session.config.parties);
    const result = vss.deal(secret);

    let allValid = true;
    for (const share of result.shares) {
      if (!vss.verify(share)) { allValid = false; break; }
    }

    this.audit(session, 'PEDERSEN_VSS_COMPLETE', undefined, { allValid });
    return { result, allValid };
  }

  /** Run GJKR DKG across multiple rounds */
  async runGJKR(sessionId: string): Promise<{
    jointPublicKey: Point;
    qualifiedSet: Set<number>;
  }> {
    const session = this.getSession(sessionId);
    const dkg = new GJKRSecureDKG(session.config.threshold, session.config.parties);

    // Round 1: all parties generate and broadcast
    const round1Messages: GJKRRound1Message[] = [];
    const allShares: FeldmanShare[][] = [];
    const allPShares: PedersenShare[][] = [];

    for (let i = 1; i <= session.config.parties; i++) {
      const { round1, shares, pedersenShares } = await dkg.generateRound1(i);
      round1Messages.push(round1);
      allShares.push(shares);
      allPShares.push(pedersenShares);
    }

    const { valid, invalid } = dkg.processRound1(round1Messages);
    this.audit(session, 'GJKR_ROUND1_COMPLETE', undefined, {
      valid: valid.size, invalid: invalid.size,
    });

    // Round 2: verify received shares, collect complaints
    const allComplaints: GJKRComplaint[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= session.config.parties; i++) {
      if (!valid.has(i)) continue;
      const received = allShares.map(shares => shares[i - 1]);
      const pReceived = allPShares.map(shares => shares[i - 1]);
      const complaints = dkg.processRound2(i, received, pReceived, round1Messages);
      allComplaints.push(...complaints);
    }

    this.audit(session, 'GJKR_ROUND2_COMPLETE', undefined, { complaints: allComplaints.length });

    // Resolve complaints, compute qualified set
    const qualifiedSet = dkg.resolveComplaints(valid);

    // Compute joint public key
    const qualifiedCommitments = new Map<number, Point[]>();
    for (const r1 of round1Messages) {
      if (qualifiedSet.has(r1.from)) {
        qualifiedCommitments.set(r1.from, r1.commitments);
      }
    }
    const jointPublicKey = dkg.computeJointPublicKey(qualifiedCommitments);
    session.jointPublicKey = jointPublicKey;
    session.status = 'complete';

    this.audit(session, 'GJKR_COMPLETE', undefined, {
      qualifiedCount: qualifiedSet.size,
      jointPK: jointPublicKey.x.toString(16).slice(0, 16) + '...',
    });

    return { jointPublicKey, qualifiedSet };
  }

  /** Generate health report for a session */
  healthReport(sessionId: string): DKGHealthReport {
    const session = this.getSession(sessionId);
    const { config } = session;

    const faultTolerance = config.protocol === 'gjkr' || config.protocol === 'async-dkg'
      ? Math.floor((config.parties - 1) / 3)
      : config.threshold;

    return {
      sessionId,
      protocol: config.protocol,
      totalParties: config.parties,
      threshold: config.threshold,
      activeParties: session.parties.size,
      faultTolerance,
      epochsCompleted: 0,
      proactiveSecurity: config.protocol === 'proactive',
      maliciousSecurity: config.requireMaliciousSecurity ?? false,
      byzantineFaultTolerant: ['gjkr', 'async-dkg'].includes(config.protocol),
      quantumResistant: false, // Requires lattice-based DKG (Phase 2 Quantum layer)
      securityLevel: 128,
      estimatedAttackCost: `2^128 group operations (~${(2n ** 128n).toString().length} digit number)`,
    };
  }

  private getSession(sessionId: string): DKGSession {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session) throw new Error(`Session ${sessionId} not found`);
    return session;
  }

  private generateSessionId(): string {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(16);
    crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
    return Array.from(bytes).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  }

  private audit(
    session: DKGSession,
    event: string,
    partyId: number | undefined,
    details: Record<string, unknown>
  ): void {
    session.auditLog.push({ timestamp: Date.now(), event, partyId, details });
  }

  /** List all active sessions */
  listSessions(): { sessionId: string; protocol: DKGProtocol; status: string; parties: number }[] {
    return Array.from(this.sessions.values()).map(s => ({
      sessionId: s.sessionId,
      protocol: s.config.protocol,
      status: s.status,
      parties: s.config.parties,
    }));
  }
}

/**
 * UBE Phase 2 — Cryptographic Sovereignty
 * pir.ts — Private Information Retrieval
 *
 * PIR solves the fundamental privacy paradox of database queries:
 * A client wants to retrieve record i from a database without the
 * database server learning WHICH record was retrieved. Without PIR,
 * every query reveals intent — a government agency querying a name,
 * a bank checking a transaction, a hospital looking up a patient.
 * PIR makes the query itself invisible.
 *
 * Protocols implemented:
 *
 *   1. Trivial PIR              — Download entire DB (baseline, information-theoretically optimal)
 *   2. IT-PIR (2-server)        — Information-theoretic PIR across non-colluding servers
 *   3. IT-PIR (k-server)        — Generalized k-server PIR (Chor-Goldreich-Kushilevitz-Sudan)
 *   4. cPIR (Regev/LWE)         — Computational PIR: single server using LWE encryption
 *   5. SealPIR (BFV-based)      — Batched PIR using BFV homomorphic encryption scheme
 *   6. Batch Codes              — Amortized PIR for multiple simultaneous queries
 *   7. Private Keyword Search   — PIR over keyword-indexed databases
 *   8. OPRF-PIR                 — Oblivious PRF based PIR (two-round protocol)
 *   9. Recursive PIR            — Kushilevitz-Ostrovsky recursion for sub-linear communication
 *  10. Verifiable PIR           — Client can verify server answered honestly
 *
 * Security properties:
 *   - IT-PIR: information-theoretically private (server learns zero bits about index)
 *   - cPIR: computationally private under LWE hardness assumption
 *   - Communication complexity: O(sqrt(n)) for cPIR, O(n^{1/k}) for k-server IT-PIR
 *   - Verifiable PIR: server cannot return wrong record without detection
 *
 * @module pir
 * @version 2.0.0
 * @sovereign Phase2-CryptographicSovereignty
 */

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Mathematical Primitives
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** LWE parameters — NIST post-quantum security level 1 */
const LWE_PARAMS = {
  n: 512,            // dimension
  q: BigInt(12289),  // modulus (prime, 2^14 friendly)
  sigma: 3.2,        // Gaussian noise std deviation
  t: BigInt(2),      // plaintext modulus (binary PIR)
  k: 3,              // number of ring elements per ciphertext
} as const;

/** BFV parameters for SealPIR */
const BFV_PARAMS = {
  polyDegree: 4096,             // n — polynomial ring degree
  plaintextModulus: BigInt(40961), // t — plaintext modulus (must be 1 mod 2n)
  coeffModulus: BigInt('0xFFFFFFFF00000001'), // q — ciphertext modulus
  batchSize: 4096,              // SIMD slots
} as const;

function mod(a: bigint, m: bigint): bigint {
  return ((a % m) + m) % m;
}

function modPow(base: bigint, exp: bigint, mod_: bigint): bigint {
  if (mod_ === BigInt(1)) return BigInt(0);
  let result = BigInt(1);
  base = base % mod_;
  while (exp > BigInt(0)) {
    if (exp % BigInt(2) === BigInt(1)) result = (result * base) % mod_;
    exp >>= BigInt(1);
    base = (base * base) % mod_;
  }
  return result;
}

function modInverse(a: bigint, m: bigint): bigint {
  return modPow(a < BigInt(0) ? a + m : a, m - BigInt(2), m);
}

/** Discrete Gaussian sampling (Box-Muller approximation) */
function sampleGaussian(sigma: number): bigint {
  // Box-Muller transform on uniform random bytes
  const u1 = (crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0] + 1) / 0x100000001;
  const u2 = (crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0] + 1) / 0x100000001;
  const z = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u1)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * u2);
  return BigInt(Math.round(z * sigma));
}

/** Sample uniform random bigint in [0, q) */
function sampleUniform(q: bigint): bigint {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(Math.ceil(q.toString(2).length / 8) + 8);
  crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
  let r = BigInt(0);
  for (const b of bytes) r = (r << BigInt(8)) | BigInt(b);
  return mod(r, q);
}

/** XOR two Uint8Arrays */
function xorBytes(a: Uint8Array, b: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  const result = new Uint8Array(Math.max(a.length, b.length));
  for (let i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
    result[i] = (a[i] ?? 0) ^ (b[i] ?? 0);
  }
  return result;
}

/** SHA-256 as a PRF for IT-PIR share generation */
async function prf(key: Uint8Array, index: number): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const data = new Uint8Array(key.length + 4);
  data.set(key);
  new DataView(data.buffer).setUint32(key.length, index, false);
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);
  return new Uint8Array(hash);
}

/** Hash to produce a pseudorandom database index subset */
async function prfSubset(key: Uint8Array, dbSize: number, subsetSize: number): Promise<Set<number>> {
  const indices = new Set<number>();
  let counter = 0;
  while (indices.size < subsetSize) {
    const h = await prf(key, counter++);
    const view = new DataView(h.buffer);
    for (let i = 0; i + 4 <= h.length && indices.size < subsetSize; i += 4) {
      indices.add(view.getUint32(i, false) % dbSize);
    }
  }
  return indices;
}

async function sha256(data: Uint8Array): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  return new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data));
}

async function sha256BigInt(...values: bigint[]): Promise<bigint> {
  const hex = values.map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(64, '0')).join('');
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(hex.match(/.{2}/g)!.map(b => parseInt(b, 16)));
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', bytes);
  let r = BigInt(0);
  for (const b of new Uint8Array(hash)) r = (r << BigInt(8)) | BigInt(b);
  return r;
}

export type PIRProtocol =
  | 'trivial'
  | 'it-pir-2server'
  | 'it-pir-kserver'
  | 'cpir-lwe'
  | 'sealpir'
  | 'batch'
