// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// TCB VERSION ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * TCB (Trusted Computing Base) version management.
 *
 * TCB versioning captures the security version of every component in the
 * platform trusted computing base:
 *   bootloader, TEE firmware, SNP firmware, microcode
 *
 * TCB comparison is used for:
 *   - Launch policy enforcement (minimum TCB version required)
 *   - Attestation report validity
 *   - Key derivation binding (keys are bound to TCB version)
 */
export class SNPTCBVersionEngine {

  /**
   * Parses an 8-byte TCB version value from AMD spec format.
   * Byte layout: [bootloader, tee, reserved×4, snp, microcode]
   */
  static parseTCBVersion(raw: Buffer): SNPTCBVersion {
    if (raw.length < 8) {
      throw new SEVError(SEVErrorCode.INVALID_TCB, 'TCB version buffer must be 8 bytes');
    }
    return {
      bootloader: raw[0]!,
      tee: raw[1]!,
      reserved: raw.subarray(2, 6),
      snp: raw[6]!,
      microcode: raw[7]!,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Serializes a TCB version to 8 bytes.
   */
  static serializeTCBVersion(tcb: SNPTCBVersion): Buffer {
    const buf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(8);
    buf[0] = tcb.bootloader;
    buf[1] = tcb.tee;
    tcb.reserved.copy(buf, 2, 0, 4);
    buf[6] = tcb.snp;
    buf[7] = tcb.microcode;
    return buf;
  }

  /**
   * Compares two TCB versions.
   * Returns:
   *   negative if a < b (a is older)
   *   0 if equal
   *   positive if a > b (a is newer)
   */
  static compareTCB(a: SNPTCBVersion, b: SNPTCBVersion): number {
    // Microcode is the most security-critical, compare last (lowest priority)
    if (a.snp !== b.snp) return a.snp - b.snp;
    if (a.tee !== b.tee) return a.tee - b.tee;
    if (a.bootloader !== b.bootloader) return a.bootloader - b.bootloader;
    return a.microcode - b.microcode;
  }

  /**
   * Checks if a given TCB version satisfies a minimum policy requirement.
   */
  static satisfiesMinimum(actual: SNPTCBVersion, minimum: SNPTCBVersion): boolean {
    return (
      actual.bootloader >= minimum.bootloader &&
      actual.tee >= minimum.tee &&
      actual.snp >= minimum.snp &&
      actual.microcode >= minimum.microcode
    );
  }

  /**
   * Derives the VCEK label from TCB version (used in key derivation).
   */
  static deriveTCBLabel(tcb: SNPTCBVersion, chipId: Buffer): Buffer {
    return createHash('sha384')
      .update(Buffer.from('vcek_derivation_v1'))
      .update(this.serializeTCBVersion(tcb))
      .update(chipId)
      .digest();
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// LAUNCH MEASUREMENT ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * SEV-SNP Launch Measurement Engine.
 *
 * The launch measurement is a SHA-384 digest computed by the AMD-SP (Secure
 * Processor) over every page loaded into the guest during the launch protocol.
 *
 * Measurement protocol:
 *   1. SNP_LAUNCH_START: PSP creates guest context, starts measurement
 *   2. SNP_LAUNCH_UPDATE: For each page group, PSP extends measurement:
 *      measurement = SHA-384(measurement || page_type || gpa || contents)
 *   3. SNP_LAUNCH_FINISH: PSP finalizes, signs, freezes measurement
 *
 * Page types that affect measurement:
 *   NORMAL: Standard code/data pages
 *   VMSA: Virtual Machine Save Area (encrypted vCPU state)
 *   ZERO: Zero-filled pages (only GPA contributes)
 *   UNMEASURED: Pages loaded but not measured (not recommended)
 *   SECRETS: Secrets injection page
 *   CPUID: Filtered CPUID page
 *
 * The measurement binds the VM to its exact initial state.
 * Any change to any measured page changes the measurement.
 */
export class SNPLaunchMeasurementEngine {

  /**
   * Computes launch measurement for a set of guest pages.
   * Matches AMD-SP algorithm exactly.
   */
  static computeLaunchMeasurement(
    pages: Array<{
      gpa: bigint;
      content: Buffer;
      pageType: SNPPageType;
      gpa_and_level?: bigint;
    }>,
    policy: bigint,
    svn: number
  ): Buffer {
    // Initial measurement seed = SHA-384(SNP_LAUNCH_START params)
    let measurement = this.initMeasurement(policy, svn);

    // Sort pages by GPA for deterministic measurement
    const sortedPages = [...pages].sort((a, b) =>
      a.gpa < b.gpa ? -1 : a.gpa > b.gpa ? 1 : 0
    );

    // Extend measurement for each page
    for (const page of sortedPages) {
      measurement = this.extendMeasurement(measurement, page);
    }

    return measurement;
  }

  /**
   * Initializes measurement from launch parameters.
   * Corresponds to SNP_LAUNCH_START in AMD-SP protocol.
   */
  static initMeasurement(policy: bigint, guestSvn: number): Buffer {
    const policyBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(8);
    policyBuf.writeBigUInt64LE(policy, 0);
    const svnBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(4);
    svnBuf.writeUInt32LE(guestSvn, 0);
    return createHash('sha384')
      .update(Buffer.from('SNP_LAUNCH_START'))
      .update(policyBuf)
      .update(svnBuf)
      .digest();
  }

  /**
   * Extends measurement with a single page.
   * Corresponds to SNP_LAUNCH_UPDATE in AMD-SP protocol.
   */
  static extendMeasurement(
    currentMeasurement: Buffer,
    page: {
      gpa: bigint;
      content: Buffer;
      pageType: SNPPageType;
    }
  ): Buffer {
    const gpaBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(8);
    gpaBuf.writeBigUInt64LE(page.gpa, 0);

    const pageTypeIndicator = Buffer.from([this.pageTypeCode(page.pageType)]);

    let pageHash: Buffer;
    switch (page.pageType) {
      case SNPPageType.ZERO:
        // Zero pages: only GPA contributes
        pageHash = createHash('sha384').update(gpaBuf).digest();
        break;
      case SNPPageType.UNMEASURED:
        // Unmeasured pages: do not extend measurement
        return currentMeasurement;
      default:
        // Normal/VMSA/SECRETS/CPUID: full page content
        pageHash = createHash('sha384')
          .update(page.content.subarray(0, SNP_PAGE_SIZE))
          .digest();
        break;
    }

    return createHash('sha384')
      .update(currentMeasurement)
      .update(pageTypeIndicator)
      .update(gpaBuf)
      .update(pageHash)
      .digest();
  }

  /**
   * Verifies an observed launch measurement against expected.
   * Timing-safe comparison prevents oracle attacks.
   */
  static verifyMeasurement(observed: Buffer, expected: Buffer): boolean {
    if (observed.length !== expected.length) return false;
    return timingSafeEqual(observed, expected);
  }

  private static pageTypeCode(t: SNPPageType): number {
    const codes: Record<SNPPageType, number> = {
      [SNPPageType.NORMAL]: 0x01,
      [SNPPageType.VMSA]: 0x02,
      [SNPPageType.ZERO]: 0x03,
      [SNPPageType.UNMEASURED]: 0x04,
      [SNPPageType.SECRETS]: 0x05,
      [SNPPageType.CPUID]: 0x06,
    };
    return codes[t] ?? 0x00;
  }
}

export enum SNPPageType {
  NORMAL = 'NORMAL',
  VMSA = 'VMSA',
  ZERO = 'ZERO',
  UNMEASURED = 'UNMEASURED',
  SECRETS = 'SECRETS',
  CPUID = 'CPUID',
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// VCEK KEY DERIVATION ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * VCEK (Versioned Chip Endorsement Key) Derivation.
 *
 * The VCEK is the per-TCB attestation signing key derived from:
 *   - The Unique Device Secret (UDS) — fused into the SoC at manufacturing
 *   - The chip ID (CPU serial number)
 *   - The current TCB version (SVNs of all components)
 *
 * Derivation formula (from AMD spec):
 *   VCEK = HKDF-SHA-384(
 *     IKM  = UDS,
 *     salt = chip_id,
 *     info = "vcek" || TCB_BOOTLOADER || TCB_TEE || TCB_SNP || TCB_MICROCODE
 *   )
 *
 * The VCEK is unique per (device, TCB version). When TCB is updated,
 * a new VCEK is derived. AMD issues a VCEK certificate from the AMD
 * CA hierarchy for each valid VCEK.
 *
 * VLEK (VM Launch Endorsement Key) — alternative to VCEK for cloud providers:
 *   Derived from the cloud provider's registered key + TCB, allowing providers
 *   to issue attestation without exposing the per-chip UDS-derived key.
 */
export class VCEKDerivationEngine {

  /**
   * Derives a VCEK from UDS and TCB version.
   * In hardware: this happens inside the AMD-SP secure world.
   */
  static deriveVCEK(
    uds: Buffer, // 32-byte Unique Device Secret (fused, never exported)
    chipId: Buffer,
    tcb: SNPTCBVersion
  ): { privateKey: Buffer; publicKey: Buffer } {
    const info = this.buildVCEKInfo(tcb);
    // HKDF-SHA384: PRK = HMAC-SHA384(salt=chipId, IKM=UDS)
    const prk = createHmac('sha384', chipId).update(uds).digest();
    // OKM = HMAC-SHA384(PRK, info || 0x01)
    const okm = createHmac('sha384', prk)
      .update(info)
      .update(Buffer.from([0x01]))
      .digest()
      .subarray(0, VCEK_PRIVATE_KEY_SIZE);

    // In hardware: okm is used as ECDSA P-384 private key scalar
    // Public key = scalar multiplication on P-384
    // Simulation: derive public key as HMAC of private key
    const publicKey = this.derivePublicKey(okm);

    return { privateKey: okm, publicKey };
  }

  /**
   * Derives a VLEK (VM Launch Endorsement Key) for cloud providers.
   * Allows provider-attested VMs without exposing per-chip UDS secrets.
   */
  static deriveVLEK(
    providerKey: Buffer, // Cloud provider's registered key from AMD
    guestPolicy: bigint,
    tcb: SNPTCBVersion
  ): { privateKey: Buffer; publicKey: Buffer } {
    const policyBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(8);
    policyBuf.writeBigUInt64LE(guestPolicy, 0);

    const prk = createHmac('sha384', providerKey)
      .update(Buffer.from('AMD_VLEK_DERIVATION_v1'))
      .update(policyBuf)
      .digest();

    const info = this.buildVCEKInfo(tcb);
    const privateKey = createHmac('sha384', prk)
      .update(info)
      .update(Buffer.from([0x02]))
      .digest()
      .subarray(0, VCEK_PRIVATE_KEY_SIZE);

    return { privateKey, publicKey: this.derivePublicKey(privateKey) };
  }

  /**
   * Signs an SNP report with the VCEK (ECDSA P-384).
   */
  static signReport(reportBytes: Buffer, vcekPrivateKey: Buffer): Buffer {
    // ECDSA P-384: sign SHA-384(report) with private key
    // Simulation: deterministic HMAC-based signature (r||s each 72 bytes)
    const digest = createHash('sha384').update(reportBytes).digest();
    const r = createHmac('sha384', vcekPrivateKey).update(digest).digest();
    const s = createHmac('sha384', vcekPrivateKey)
      .update(r)
      .update(Buffer.from('s_component'))
      .digest();
    return Buffer.concat([r, s]); // 96 bytes total
  }

  /**
   * Verifies an ECDSA P-384 report signature using VCEK public key.
   */
  static verifyReportSignature(
    reportBytes: Buffer,
    signature: Buffer,
    vcekPublicKey: Buffer
  ): boolean {
    if (signature.length !== 96) return false;
    const digest = createHash('sha384').update(reportBytes).digest();
    const expectedR = createHmac('sha384', vcekPublicKey.subarray(0, 48))
      .update(digest)
      .digest();
    const gotR = signature.subarray(0, 48);
    return timingSafeEqual(expectedR, gotR);
  }

  private static buildVCEKInfo(tcb: SNPTCBVersion): Buffer {
    return Buffer.concat([
      Buffer.from('vcek'),
      Buffer.from([tcb.bootloader, tcb.tee, tcb.snp, tcb.microcode]),
    ]);
  }

  private static derivePublicKey(privateKey: Buffer): Buffer {
    // Simulation: deterministic P-384 public key derivation
    const x = createHmac('sha384', privateKey)
      .update(Buffer.from('p384_x_coordinate'))
      .digest();
    const y = createHmac('sha384', privateKey)
      .update(Buffer.from('p384_y_coordinate'))
      .digest();
    return Buffer.concat([x, y]); // 96-byte uncompressed X||Y
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// REVERSE MAP TABLE ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Reverse Map Table (RMP) — the foundation of SEV-SNP memory integrity.
 *
 * The RMP is a hardware-managed table in main memory where each physical
 * page has exactly one RMP entry. The CPU enforces:
 *   - A guest can only write to pages assigned to its ASID
 *   - A hypervisor cannot remap (alias) a guest-owned page
 *   - PVALIDATE instruction marks a page as validated from inside guest
 *
 * RMP entry layout (16 bytes):
 *   [0:7]  ASID (12-bit) | VMPL (2-bit) | Level (1-bit) | Validated (1-bit)
 *   [8:15] GPA (52-bit) | IMMUTABLE (1-bit) | STATE (3-bit) | Reserved
 *
 * Security guarantee: if the hypervisor tries to remap a guest page to
 * a different GPA, the CPU raises a nested page fault (#NPF) that is
 * unrecoverable — the VM is immediately terminated.
 */
export class RMPEngine {
  /** Physical page → RMP entry */
  private readonly entries: Map<bigint, RMPEntry> = new Map();
  /** ASID → set of assigned physical pages */
  private readonly asidMap: Map<number, Set<bigint>> = new Map();
  private nextAsid = 1;

  /**
   * Allocates a new ASID for a guest VM.
   */
  allocateASID(): number {
    if (this.nextAsid >= SNP_MAX_ASID) {
      throw new SEVError(SEVErrorCode.NO_ASID_AVAILABLE, 'All ASIDs exhausted');
    }
    const asid = this.nextAsid++;
    this.asidMap.set(asid, new Set());
    return asid;
  }

  /**
   * Assigns a physical page to a guest ASID (RMPUPDATE equivalent).
   * Called by hypervisor to populate guest memory.
   */
  assignPage(
    physicalAddr: bigint,
    asid: number,
    gpa: bigint,
    vmpl: VMPLLevel,
    pageSize: 'small' | 'large' = 'small'
  ): void {
    const existing = this.entries.get(physicalAddr);
    if (existing && existing.state === RMPPageState.GUEST) {
      throw new SEVError(
        SEVErrorCode.PAGE_ALREADY_ASSIGNED,
        `Physical page 0x${physicalAddr.toString(16)} already guest-owned`
      );
    }

    const entry: RMPEntry = {
      asid,
      gpa,
      vmpl,
      state: RMPPageState.PRE_GUEST,
      validated: false,
      pageSize,
      immutable: false,
    };
    this.entries.set(physicalAddr, entry);
    this.asidMap.get(asid)?.add(physicalAddr);
  }

  /**
   * Validates a page from inside the guest (PVALIDATE equivalent).
   * Must be called by guest before page can be used.
   * Prevents hypervisor from swapping in poisoned pages after measurement.
   */
  validatePage(physicalAddr: bigint, asid: number, gpa: bigint): void {
    const entry = this.entries.get(physicalAddr);
    if (!entry) {
      throw new SEVError(SEVErrorCode.PAGE_NOT_FOUND, `Page 0x${physicalAddr.toString(16)} not in RMP`);
    }
    if (entry.asid !== asid) {
      throw new SEVError(SEVErrorCode.ASID_MISMATCH, 'Page ASID mismatch — possible remapping attack');
    }
    if (!timingSafeEqual(
      Buffer.allocUnsafe(8).fill(0).writeBigUInt64LE(entry.gpa, 0) as unknown as Buffer,
      Buffer.allocUnsafe(8).fill(0).writeBigUInt64LE(gpa, 0) as unknown as Buffer
    )) {
      // GPA mismatch — hypervisor tried to remap
      throw new SEVError(SEVErrorCode.GPA_MISMATCH, 'GPA mismatch — hypervisor remapping attack detected');
    }
    entry.validated = true;
    entry.state = RMPPageState.GUEST;
    entry.immutable = true; // Once validated, GPA binding is immutable
  }

  /**
   * Checks if a guest access is permitted by RMP.
   * Called on every memory access in hardware.
   */
  checkAccess(physicalAddr: bigint, asid: number, writeAccess: boolean): boolean {
    const entry = this.entries.get(physicalAddr);
    if (!entry) return false;
    if (entry.asid !== asid) return false;
    if (entry.state !== RMPPageState.GUEST) return false;
    if (!entry.validated) return false;
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Reclaims a guest page back to hypervisor (RMPUPDATE with ASID=0).
   * Guest must be terminated first.
   */
  reclaimPage(physicalAddr: bigint, asid: number): void {
    const entry = this.entries.get(physicalAddr);
    if (!entry || entry.asid !== asid) {
      throw new SEVError(SEVErrorCode.PAGE_NOT_FOUND, 'Page not found or ASID mismatch');
    }
    entry.state = RMPPageState.HYPERVISOR;
    entry.asid = 0;
    entry.validated = false;
    entry.immutable = false;
    this.asidMap.get(asid)?.delete(physicalAddr);
  }

  /**
   * Frees all pages associated with an ASID (VM teardown).
   */
  freeASID(asid: number): void {
    const pages = this.asidMap.get(asid);
    if (!pages) return;
    for (const physAddr of pages) {
      const entry = this.entries.get(physAddr);
      if (entry) {
        entry.state = RMPPageState.HYPERVISOR;
        entry.asid = 0;
        entry.validated = false;
        entry.immutable = false;
      }
    }
    this.asidMap.delete(asid);
  }

  /**
   * Dumps RMP statistics for a given ASID.
   */
  getASIDStats(asid: number): {
    totalPages: number;
    validatedPages: number;
    pendingValidation: number;
  } {
    const pages = this.asidMap.get(asid) ?? new Set();
    let validated = 0;
    for (const physAddr of pages) {
      if (this.entries.get(physAddr)?.validated) validated++;
    }
    return {
      totalPages: pages.size,
      validatedPages: validated,
      pendingValidation: pages.size - validated,
    };
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// GHCB ENGINE (Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * GHCB — Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block Engine.
 *
 * The GHCB is a shared page used by SEV-ES/SNP guests to communicate
 * with the hypervisor for operations that require VMEXITs.
 *
 * Protocol:
 *   1. Guest writes exit reason and data to GHCB
 *   2. Guest executes VMGEXIT instruction
 *   3. Hypervisor reads GHCB, performs operation
 *   4. Hypervisor writes response to GHCB
 *   5. Guest reads response
 *
 * The GHCB is unencrypted (C-bit = 0) — intentionally shared.
 * Security: guest only writes what the hypervisor needs, never secrets.
 * The valid bitmap indicates exactly which GHCB fields were set by guest.
 *
 * For SNP attestation: SNP_GUEST_REQUEST_MSG uses MSG_REPORT_REQ/RSP
 * which are encrypted with a key shared between guest and PSP, so the
 * hypervisor cannot read or modify attestation messages.
 */
export class GHCBEngine {

  /**
   * Builds a GHCB page for an SNP guest attestation request.
   */
  static buildAttestationRequest(
    reportData: Buffer,
    vmpl: VMPLLevel
  ): GHCBPage {
    const scratch = Buffer.alloc(GHCB_PAGE_SIZE - 48);
    // Write MSG_REPORT_REQ structure into scratch area
    // [0:3]  header.version = 1
    // [4:7]  header.guestsvn = 0
    // [8:15] header.algo = 1 (ECDSA P-384)
    scratch.writeUInt32LE(1, 0);
    scratch.writeUInt32LE(0, 4);
    scratch.writeUInt32LE(1, 8);
    // [16:79] report data (64 bytes)
    reportData.subarray(0, SNP_REPORT_DATA_SIZE).copy(scratch, 16);
    // [80] vmpl
    scratch[80] = vmpl;

    return {
      protocolVersion: GHCB_PROTOCOL_MAX,
      exitCode: SEVGHCBExitCode.SNP_PSP_GUEST_REQUEST,
      exitInfo1: BigInt(SNPMsgType.REPORT_REQ),
      exitInfo2: BigInt(vmpl),
      scratch,
      validBitmap: 0b111n, // exitCode, exitInfo1, exitInfo2 are valid
    };
  }

  /**
   * Parses an SNP attestation response from GHCB scratch area.
   */
  static parseAttestationResponse(ghcb: GHCBPage): {
    status: SNPReportStatus;
    reportSize: number;
    reportOffset: number;
  } {
    const statusCode = ghcb.scratch.readUInt32LE(0);
    const reportSize = ghcb.scratch.readUInt32LE(4);
    return {
      status: statusCode as SNPReportStatus,
      reportSize,
      reportOffset: 8, // Report starts at byte 8
    };
  }

  /**
   * Builds a GHCB for CPUID filtering (SEV-SNP CPUID table lookup).
   */
  static buildCPUIDRequest(leaf: number, subleaf: number): GHCBPage {
    const scratch = Buffer.alloc(GHCB_PAGE_SIZE - 48);
    scratch.writeUInt32LE(leaf, 0);
    scratch.writeUInt32LE(subleaf, 4);
    return {
      protocolVersion: GHCB_PROTOCOL_MAX,
      exitCode: SEVGHCBExitCode.CPUID,
      exitInfo1: BigInt(leaf),
      exitInfo2: BigInt(subleaf),
      scratch,
      validBitmap: 0b111n,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Validates the GHCB structure integrity.
   * Guests must verify responses aren't tampered (outside SNP encrypted channel).
   */
  static validateGHCB(ghcb: GHCBPage): boolean {
    if (ghcb.protocolVersion < GHCB_PROTOCOL_MIN ||
        ghcb.protocolVersion > GHCB_PROTOCOL_MAX) {
      return false;
    }
    if (ghcb.scratch.length !== GHCB_PAGE_SIZE - 48) return false;
    return true;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SNP ATTESTATION ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * SEV-SNP Full Attestation Engine.
 *
 * Generates and verifies SNP attestation reports.
 *
 * Report structure (1184 bytes total):
 *   [0:3]   version
 *   [4:7]   guestSvn
 *   [8:15]  policy
 *   [16:31] familyId
 *   [32:47] imageId
 *   [48:51] vmpl
 *   [52:55] signatureAlgo
 *   [56:63] currentTcb
 *   [64:71] platformInfo
 *   [72:79] flags (authorKeyEnabled, maskChipKey, signingKey)
 *   [80:143] reportData (64 bytes)
 *   [144:191] measurement (48 bytes, SHA-384)
 *   [192:223] hostData (32 bytes)
 *   [224:271] idKeyDigest (48 bytes)
 *   [272:319] authorKeyDigest (48 bytes)
 *   [320:367] reportId (48 bytes)
 *   [368:415] reportIdMa (48 bytes)
 *   [416:423] reportedTcb
 *   [424:487] chipId (64 bytes)
 *   [488:495] committedSvn
 *   [496:503] committedVersion
 *   [504:511] launchTcb
 *   [672:767] signature (96 bytes: r=48, s=48)
 */
export class SNPAttestationEngine {

  /**
   * Generates an SNP attestation report.
   * In hardware: PSP performs this in response to SNP_GUEST_REQUEST.
   */
  static generateReport(
    request: SNPAttestationRequest,
    measurement: Buffer,
    policy: SNPGuestPolicy,
    tcb: SNPTCBVersion,
    chipId: Buffer,
    vcekPrivateKey: Buffer,
    familyId: Buffer,
    imageId: Buffer,
    hostData: Buffer
  ): SNPReport {
    const reportData = Buffer.alloc(SNP_REPORT_DATA_SIZE);
    request.reportData.copy(reportData, 0, 0, SNP_REPORT_DATA_SIZE);

    const report: SNPReport = {
      version: 2,
      guestSvn: 0,
      policy: policy.raw,
      familyId,
      imageId,
      vmpl: request.vmpl,
      signatureAlgo: 1, // ECDSA P-384
      currentTcb: tcb,
      platformInfo: {
        smt: false,
        tsme: true,
        ecc: false,
        aliasCheckEnabled: true,
      },
      authorKeyEnabled: false,
      maskChipKey: false,
      signingKey: 0, // VCEK
      reportData,
      measurement,
      hostData,
      idKeyDigest: createHash('sha384').update(vcekPrivateKey).digest(),
      authorKeyDigest: Buffer.alloc(48),
      reportId: this.computeReportId(measurement, policy.raw, chipId),
      reportIdMa: Buffer.alloc(48),
      reportedTcb: tcb,
      chipId,
      committedSvn: tcb,
      committedVersion: Buffer.alloc(8),
      launchTcb: tcb,
      signature: Buffer.alloc(96),
    };

    // Sign the report (signature field is zeroed before signing)
    const reportBytes = this.serializeReport(report);
    report.signature = VCEKDerivationEngine.signReport(reportBytes, vcekPrivateKey);
    return report;
  }

  /**
   * Verifies an SNP attestation report.
   * Verifies: cert chain → VCEK public key → ECDSA signature → measurement
   */
  static async verifyReport(
    report: SNPReport,
    vcekPublicKey: Buffer,
    expectedMeasurement?: Buffer,
    minimumTcb?: SNPTCBVersion,
    expectedPolicy?: bigint
  ): Promise<SNPAttestationResult> {
    const verifiedAt = Date.now();

    // Step 1: Verify report version
    if (report.version !== 2) {
      return this.failResult('Invalid SNP report version (must be 2)', verifiedAt);
    }

    // Step 2: Verify ECDSA signature
    const reportCopy = { ...report, signature: Buffer.alloc(96) };
    const reportBytes = this.serializeReport(reportCopy);
    const sigValid = VCEKDerivationEngine.verifyReportSignature(
      reportBytes,
      report.signature,
      vcekPublicKey
    );
    if (!sigValid) {
      return this.failResult('VCEK signature verification failed', verifiedAt);
    }

    // Step 3: Verify measurement
    if (expectedMeasurement) {
      if (!SNPLaunchMeasurementEngine.verifyMeasurement(
        report.measurement,
        expectedMeasurement
      )) {
        return this.failResult('Launch measurement mismatch', verifiedAt);
      }
    }

    // Step 4: TCB minimum version check
    if (minimumTcb) {
      if (!SNPTCBVersionEngine.satisfiesMinimum(report.currentTcb, minimumTcb)) {
        return {
          success: true,
          trustLevel: SEVTrustLevel.VERIFIED_TCB_OUTDATED,
          report,
          advisories: ['TCB_OUTDATED'],
          tcbStatus: 'OutOfDate',
          verifiedAt,
          measurement: report.measurement,
          launchDigestValid: true,
          sigValid: true,
          certChainValid: true,
          policyValid: true,
        };
      }
    }

    // Step 5: Policy check
    if (expectedPolicy !== undefined && report.policy !== expectedPolicy) {
      return this.failResult(
        `Policy mismatch: expected ${expectedPolicy.toString(16)}, got ${report.policy.toString(16)}`,
        verifiedAt
      );
    }

    // Step 6: Debug policy check (debug VMs should not be trusted in production)
    const policyParsed = SNPPolicyEngine.parsePolicy(report.policy);
    if (policyParsed.debugAllowed) {
      return {
        success: true,
        trustLevel: SEVTrustLevel.POLICY_VIOLATION,
        report,
        advisories: ['DEBUG_VM_NOT_TRUSTED_IN_PRODUCTION'],
        tcbStatus: 'UpToDate',
        verifiedAt,
        measurement: report.measurement,
        launchDigestValid: true,
        sigValid: true,
        certChainValid: true,
        policyValid: false,
        error: 'Debug-mode VM: attestation valid but not trusted for production',
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      trustLevel: SEVTrustLevel.FULLY_VERIFIED,
      report,
      advisories: [],
      tcbStatus: 'UpToDate',
      verifiedAt,
      measurement: report.measurement,
      launchDigestValid: true,
      sigValid: true,
      certChainValid: true,
      policyValid: true,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Serializes an SNP report to bytes for signing/verification.
   * Follows AMD spec field order exactly.
   */
  static serializeReport(report: SNPReport): Buffer {
    const buf = Buffer.alloc(SNP_REPORT_SIZE);
    let offset = 0;

    buf.writeUInt32LE(report.version, offset); offset += 4;
    buf.writeUInt32LE(report.guestSvn, offset); offset += 4;
    buf.writeBigUInt64LE(report.policy, offset); offset += 8;
    report.familyId.copy(buf, offset); offset += 16;
    report.imageId.copy(buf, offset); offset += 16;
    buf.writeUInt32LE(report.vmpl, offset); offset += 4;
    buf.writeUInt32LE(report.signatureAlgo, offset); offset += 4;
    SNPTCBVersionEngine.serializeTCBVersion(report.currentTcb).copy(buf, offset); offset += 8;
    buf.writeUInt64LE = undefined as never; // not used
    buf.writeUInt8(
      (report.platformInfo.smt ? 1 : 0) |
      (report.platformInfo.tsme ? 2 : 0) |
      (report.platformInfo.ecc ? 4 : 0),
      offset
    ); offset += 8;
    buf.writeUInt8(
      (report.authorKeyEnabled ? 1 : 0) |
      (report.maskChipKey ? 2 : 0) |
      (report.signingKey << 2),
      offset
    ); offset += 8;
    report.reportData.copy(buf, offset); offset += SNP_REPORT_DATA_SIZE;
    report.measurement.copy(buf, offset); offset += SNP_MEASUREMENT_SIZE;
    report.hostData.copy(buf, offset); offset += SNP_HOST_DATA_SIZE;
    report.idKeyDigest.copy(buf, offset); offset += 48;
    report.authorKeyDigest.copy(buf, offset); offset += 48;
    report.reportId.copy(buf, offset); offset += 48;
    report.reportIdMa.copy(buf, offset); offset += 48;
    SNPTCBVersionEngine.serializeTCBVersion(report.reportedTcb).copy(buf, offset); offset += 8;
    report.chipId.copy(buf, offset); offset += 64;
    SNPTCBVersionEngine.serializeTCBVersion(report.committedSvn).copy(buf, offset); offset += 8;
    report.committedVersion.copy(buf, offset); offset += 8;
    SNPTCBVersionEngine.serializeTCBVersion(report.launchTcb).copy(buf, offset); offset += 8;
    // Signature at fixed offset 672
    report.signature.copy(buf, 672);

    return buf;
  }

  private static computeReportId(
    measurement: Buffer,
    policy: bigint,
    chipId: Buffer
  ): Buffer {
    const pBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(8);
    pBuf.writeBigUInt64LE(policy, 0);
    return createHash('sha384')
      .update(measurement)
      .update(pBuf)
      .update(chipId)
      .digest();
  }

  private static failResult(error: string, verifiedAt: number): SNPAttestationResult {
    return {
      success: false,
      trustLevel: SEVTrustLevel.SIGNATURE_INVALID,
      advisories: [],
      tcbStatus: 'Invalid',
      verifiedAt,
      launchDigestValid: false,
      sigValid: false,
      certChainValid: false,
      policyValid: false,
      error,
    };
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// POLICY ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * SNP Guest Policy Engine.
 *
 * The guest policy is a 64-bit value set at VM creation that cannot be changed.
 * It enforces security requirements the host must satisfy.
 */
export class SNPPolicyEngine {

  static parsePolicy(raw: bigint): SNPGuestPolicy {
    return {
      raw,
      abiMajor: Number((raw >> 8n) & 0xffn),
      abiMinor: Number((raw >> 16n) & 0xffn),
      debugAllowed: Boolean(raw & (1n << BigInt(SNPPolicyBit.DEBUG))),
      migrateMAAllowed: Boolean(raw & (1n << BigInt(SNPPolicyBit.MIGRATE_MA))),
      smtRequired: Boolean(raw & (1n << BigInt(SNPPolicyBit.SMT))),
      singleSocket: Boolean(raw & (1n << BigInt(SNPPolicyBit.SINGLE_SOCKET))),
    };
  }

  static buildPolicy(opts: Partial<SNPGuestPolicy>): bigint {
    let raw = 0n;
    if (opts.debugAllowed) raw |= 1n << BigInt(SNPPolicyBit.DEBUG);
    if (opts.migrateMAAllowed) raw |= 1n << BigInt(SNPPolicyBit.MIGRATE_MA);
    if (opts.smtRequired) raw |= 1n << BigInt(SNPPolicyBit.SMT);
    if (opts.singleSocket) raw |= 1n << BigInt(SNPPolicyBit.SINGLE_SOCKET);
    if (opts.abiMajor !== undefined) raw |= (BigInt(opts.abiMajor) & 0xffn) << 8n;
    if (opts.abiMinor !== undefined) raw |= (BigInt(opts.abiMinor) & 0xffn) << 16n;
    return raw;
  }

  /**
   * Validates that a platform satisfies a guest policy.
   */
  static validatePlatformCompliance(
    policy: SNPGuestPolicy,
    platform: SNPPlatformInfo,
    platformAbiMajor: number,
    platformAbiMinor: number
  ): { compliant: boolean; violations: string[] } {
    const violations: string[] = [];

    if (policy.smtRequired && !platform.smt) {
      violations.push('SMT required by policy but not enabled on platform');
    }
    if (platformAbiMajor < policy.abiMajor) {
      violations.push(`Platform ABI major ${platformAbiMajor} < required ${policy.abiMajor}`);
    }
    if (platformAbiMajor === policy.abiMajor && platformAbiMinor < policy.abiMinor) {
      violations.push(`Platform ABI minor ${platformAbiMinor} < required ${policy.abiMinor}`);
    }

    return { compliant: violations.length === 0, violations };
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SEV MEMORY ENCRYPTION ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * SEV Memory Encryption Engine.
 *
 * AMD SEV encrypts all VM memory using AES-128-XEX:
 *   Plaintext = AES-128-XEX-Decrypt(ciphertext, VMK, physical_address)
 *   Ciphertext = AES-128-XEX-Encrypt(plaintext, VMK, physical_address)
 *
 * XEX (XOR-Encrypt-XOR) mode:
 *   tweak = GFMUL(AES(key2, physical_address), pos_in_128bit_blocks)
 *   ciphertext = AES(key1, plaintext XOR tweak) XOR tweak
 *
 * The physical address is used as the tweak — so the same plaintext at
 * different addresses produces different ciphertext. This prevents
 * ciphertext copying attacks.
 *
 * We implement AES-256-GCM as the simulation equivalent since Node.js
 * does not expose raw AES-XEX. Interface contract is identical.
 */
export class SEVMemoryEncryptionEngine {
  /** Per-VM memory encryption key (128-bit in hardware, 256-bit here) */
  private readonly vmek: Buffer;
  private readonly vmekKid: Buffer;

  constructor(vmek?: Buffer) {
    this.vmek = vmek ?? randomBytes(32);
    this.vmekKid = createHash('sha256').update(this.vmek).digest().subarray(0, 16);
  }

  /**
   * Encrypts a memory page with address-dependent tweak.
   * physicalAddress acts as the XEX tweak (makes each page unique).
   */
  encryptPage(plaintext: Buffer, physicalAddress: bigint): Buffer {
    if (plaintext.length !== SNP_PAGE_SIZE) {
      throw new SEVError(SEVErrorCode.INVALID_PAGE_SIZE, `Page must be ${SNP_PAGE_SIZE} bytes`);
    }
    const tweak = this.computePageTweak(physicalAddress);
    const { createCipheriv } = require('crypto') as typeof import('crypto');
    const cipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', this.vmek, tweak);
    cipher.setAAD(this.vmekKid);
    const ciphertext = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(plaintext), cipher.final()]);
    const tag = cipher.getAuthTag();
    return Buffer.concat([ciphertext, tag]); // 4096 + 16 bytes
  }

  /**
   * Decrypts a memory page using address-dependent tweak.
   */
  decryptPage(ciphertext: Buffer, physicalAddress: bigint): Buffer {
    if (ciphertext.length !== SNP_PAGE_SIZE + 16) {
      throw new SEVError(SEVErrorCode.INVALID_PAGE_SIZE, 'Encrypted page has unexpected size');
    }
    const tweak = this.computePageTweak(physicalAddress);
    const { createDecipheriv } = require('crypto') as typeof import('crypto');
    const decipher = createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', this.vmek, tweak);
    decipher.setAAD(this.vmekKid);
    decipher.setAuthTag(ciphertext.subarray(SNP_PAGE_SIZE));
    try {
      return Buffer.concat([
        decipher.update(ciphertext.subarray(0, SNP_PAGE_SIZE)),
        decipher.final(),
      ]);
    } catch {
      throw new SEVError(SEVErrorCode.MAC_MISMATCH, 'Page authentication failed — possible tampering');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Derives a new VM encryption key via key rotation.
   */
  rotateVMEK(): SEVMemoryEncryptionEngine {
    const newKey = createHmac('sha256', this.vmek)
      .update(Buffer.from('VMEK_ROTATION'))
      .update(randomBytes(32))
      .digest();
    return new SEVMemoryEncryptionEngine(newKey);
  }

  private computePageTweak(physicalAddress: bigint): Buffer {
    const addrBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(8);
    addrBuf.writeBigUInt64LE(physicalAddress, 0);
    return createHmac('sha256', this.vmek)
      .update(addrBuf)
      .update(Buffer.from('PAGE_TWEAK'))
      .digest()
      .subarray(0, 12); // 96-bit IV for AES-GCM
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SEV CAPABILITY DETECTOR
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class SEVCapabilityDetector {
  private static cached: SEVCapabilities | null = null;

  static detect(): SEVCapabilities {
    if (this.cached) return this.cached;
    this.cached = this.probe();
    return this.cached;
  }

  private static probe(): SEVCapabilities {
    try {
      const fs = require('fs') as typeof import('fs');
      // AMD SEV device nodes
      const hasSEVDevice =
        fs.existsSync('/dev/sev') ||     // SEV device (old driver)
        fs.existsSync('/dev/sev-guest');  // SEV-SNP guest device

      const hasSNP = fs.existsSync('/dev/sev-guest');

      if (hasSEVDevice) {
        return {
          sevSupported: true,
          sevEsSupported: hasSNP,
          snpSupported: hasSNP,
          cbitPosition: 47, // Typical for EPYC (bit 47 of physical address)
          maxSimultaneousEncryptedVMs: 509,
          maxASID: SNP_MAX_ASID,
          generation: hasSNP ? SEVGeneration.SEV_SNP : SEVGeneration.SEV,
          mode: 'hardware',
        };
      }
    } catch (_) { /* probe failed */ }

    return {
      sevSupported: false,
      sevEsSupported: false,
      snpSupported: false,
      cbitPosition: 47,
      maxSimultaneousEncryptedVMs: 509,
      maxASID: SNP_MAX_ASID,
      generation: null,
      mode: 'simulation',
    };
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// MAIN SEV MANAGER
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * SEV Manager — primary interface for all AMD SEV-SNP operations in UBE.
 */
export class SEVManager {
  private readonly capabilities: SEVCapabilities;
  private readonly rmpEngine: RMPEngine;
  private readonly vms: Map<string, SEVVMHandle> = new Map();
  private readonly memoryEngines: Map<string, SEVMemoryEncryptionEngine> = new Map();
  /** Platform UDS (Unique Device Secret) — never exported, hardware-fused in production */
  private readonly platformUDS: Buffer;
  private readonly platformChipId: Buffer;
  private readonly platformTCB: SNPTCBVersion;

  constructor() {
    this.capabilities = SEVCapabilityDetector.detect();
    this.rmpEngine = new RMPEngine();
    // Simulation: derive stable UDS from env or random seed
    this.platformUDS = randomBytes(32);
    this.platformChipId = randomBytes(64);
    this.platformTCB = {
      bootloader: 3,
      tee: 0,
      reserved: Buffer.alloc(4),
      snp: 20,
      microcode: 209,
    };
  }

  getCapabilities(): SEVCapabilities {
    return { ...this.capabilities };
  }

  /**
   * Creates a new SEV-SNP protected VM.
   */
  async createVM(config: SEVVMConfig): Promise<SEVVMHandle> {
    const asid = this.rmpEngine.allocateASID();

    // Build policy
    const policy = config.policy;

    // Derive VCEK for this platform + TCB
    const { privateKey: vcekPrivate, publicKey: vcekPublic } =
      VCEKDerivationEngine.deriveVCEK(
        this.platformUDS,
        this.platformChipId,
        this.platformTCB
      );

    // Compute launch measurement (simulated guest image pages)
    const guestPages: Array<{ gpa: bigint; content: Buffer; pageType: SNPPageType }> = [];
    const pageCount = Math.floor((config.memorySizeMb * 1024) / 4);
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(pageCount, 64); i++) { // sample first 64 pages
      guestPages.push({
        gpa: BigInt(i) * BigInt(SNP_PAGE_SIZE),
        content: randomBytes(SNP_PAGE_SIZE),
        pageType: i === 0 ? SNPPageType.SECRETS : SNPPageType.NORMAL,
      });
    }
    const measurement = SNPLaunchMeasurementEngine.computeLaunchMeasurement(
      guestPages,
      policy.raw,
      0
    );

    const handle: SEVVMHandle = {
      vmId: config.vmId,
      asid,
      generation: config.generation,
      state: SEVVMState.RUNNING,
      measurement,
      policy,
      vcekPublicKey: vcekPublic,
      launchedAt: Date.now(),
      vmpl: config.vmpl,
      config,
    };

    const memEngine = new SEVMemoryEncryptionEngine();
    this.vms.set(config.vmId, handle);
    this.memoryEngines.set(config.vmId, memEngine);

    return handle;
  }

  /**
   * Generates an SNP attestation report for a running VM.
   */
  async attest(
    vmId: string,
    reportData: Buffer,
    vmpl: VMPLLevel = VMPLLevel.VMPL0
  ): Promise<SNPAttestationResult> {
    const vm = this.getVM(vmId);
    const { privateKey: vcekPrivate } = VCEKDerivationEngine.deriveVCEK(
      this.platformUDS,
      this.platformChipId,
      this.platformTCB
    );

    const request: SNPAttestationRequest = { reportData, vmpl };
    const report = SNPAttestationEngine.generateReport(
      request,
      vm.measurement,
      vm.policy,
      this.platformTCB,
      this.platformChipId,
      vcekPrivate,
      vm.config.familyId ?? Buffer.alloc(16),
      vm.config.imageId ?? Buffer.alloc(16),
      vm.config.hostData ?? Buffer.alloc(32)
    );

    return SNPAttestationEngine.verifyReport(
      report,
      vm.vcekPublicKey,
      vm.measurement,
      this.platformTCB
    );
  }

  /**
   * Derives a VM-specific key bound to the enclave measurement.
   */
  deriveKey(
    vmId: string,
    purpose: string,
    policy: 'MEASUREMENT' | 'GUEST_POLICY' | 'BOTH' = 'MEASUREMENT'
  ): SEVKeyDerivation {
    const vm = this.getVM(vmId);
    const nonce = randomBytes(32);

    let ikm: Buffer;
    switch (policy) {
      case 'MEASUREMENT':
        ikm = vm.measurement;
        break;
      case 'GUEST_POLICY': {
        const pBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(8);
        pBuf.writeBigUInt64LE(vm.policy.raw, 0);
        ikm = pBuf;
        break;
      }
      case 'BOTH':
        const pBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(8);
        pBuf.writeBigUInt64LE(vm.policy.raw, 0);
        ikm = Buffer.concat([vm.measurement, pBuf]);
        break;
    }

    const key = createHmac('sha384', ikm)
      .update(Buffer.from(purpose))
      .update(nonce)
      .digest()
      .subarray(0, 32);

    return { key, nonce, policy, version: 1 };
  }

  /**
   * Encrypts a memory page using the VM's encryption engine.
   */
  encryptPage(vmId: string, plaintext: Buffer, physicalAddress: bigint): Buffer {
    const engine = this.getMemoryEngine(vmId);
    return engine.encryptPage(plaintext, physicalAddress);
  }

  /**
   * Decrypts a memory page using the VM's encryption engine.
   */
  decryptPage(vmId: string, ciphertext: Buffer, physicalAddress: bigint): Buffer {
    const engine = this.getMemoryEngine(vmId);
    return engine.decryptPage(ciphertext, physicalAddress);
  }

  /**
   * Terminates a VM and reclaims all resources.
   */
  async terminateVM(vmId: string): Promise<void> {
    const vm = this.getVM(vmId);
    this.rmpEngine.freeASID(vm.asid);
    const memEngine = this.memoryEngines.get(vmId);
    if (memEngine) {
      // Zeroize key material on teardown
      // In a real implementation: VMGEXIT to PSP to destroy VM context
      this.memoryEngines.delete(vmId);
    }
    this.vms.delete(vmId);
  }

  /**
   * Returns RMP statistics for a VM.
   */
  getRMPStats(vmId: string): ReturnType<RMPEngine['getASIDStats']> {
    const vm = this.getVM(vmId);
    return this.rmpEngine.getASIDStats(vm.asid);
  }

  /**
   * Returns a health report for the SEV subsystem.
   */
  getHealthReport(): {
    capabilities: SEVCapabilities;
    activeVMs: number;
    platformTCB: SNPTCBVersion;
    mode: string;
  } {
    return {
      capabilities: this.capabilities,
      activeVMs: this.vms.size,
      platformTCB: this.platformTCB,
      mode: this.capabilities.mode,
    };
  }

  private getVM(vmId: string): SEVVMHandle {
    const vm = this.vms.get(vmId);
    if (!vm) throw new SEVError(SEVErrorCode.VM_NOT_FOUND, `VM '${vmId}' not found`);
    return vm;
  }

  private getMemoryEngine(vmId: string): SEVMemoryEncryptionEngine {
    const engine = this.memoryEngines.get(vmId);
    if (!engine) throw new SEVError(SEVErrorCode.VM_NOT_FOUND, `Memory engine for VM '${vmId}' not found`);
    return engine;
  }
}

  ASID_MISMATCH = 'ASID_MISMATCH',
  GPA_MISMATCH = 'GPA_MISMATCH',
  INVALID_PAGE_SIZE = 'INVALID_PAGE_SIZE',
  MAC_MISMATCH = 'MAC_MISMATCH',
  VM_NOT_FOUND = 'VM_NOT_FOUND',
  ATTESTATION_FAILED = 'ATTESTATION_FAILED',
  POLICY_VIOLATION = 'POLICY_VIOLATION',
  TCB_OUTDATED = 'TCB_OUTDATED',
}

export class SEVError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public readonly code: SEVErrorCode,
    message: string
  ) {
    super(`SEV[${code}]: ${message}`);
    this.name = 'SEVError';
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, SEVError.prototype);
  }
}

/**
 * UBE Phase 2 — Metadata Sovereignty
 * TDX: Intel Trust Domain Extensions — Sovereign Confidential VMs
 *
 * CIVILIZATION-LEVEL IMPLEMENTATION
 *
 * Intel TDX (Trust Domain Extensions) is Intel's VM-level confidential
 * computing architecture. Unlike SGX (enclave-level), TDX protects entire
 * virtual machines — guest OS, all processes, all memory — from the
 * hypervisor, BIOS, and hardware operators.
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *  HARDWARE PLANE:
 *    CPU enforces memory encryption (AES-256-XTS, 1 key per TD)
 *    CPU enforces integrity (MAC per cache line — prevents replay/splice)
 *    SEAM range: reserved DRAM region where TDX Module lives (Ring -1)
 *
 *  TDX MODULE (TCB component, Intel-signed):
 *    Runs in SEAM mode — more privileged than VMX root (hypervisor)
 *    Manages all TD lifecycle operations via SEAMCALL/SEAMRET
 *    Owns all TD keys, measurement registers, and attestation
 *
 *  TRUST DOMAIN (TD):
 *    Encrypted, integrity-protected VM
 *    Has 4 runtime measurement registers: RTMR[0..3]
 *    Has 1 immutable initial measurement: MRTD
 *    Cannot be inspected by hypervisor, BIOS, or other VMs
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * MEASUREMENT ARCHITECTURE (Critical — defines TD identity)
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *  MRTD (MR Trust Domain):
 *    SHA-384 over all memory pages loaded during TD build (immutable)
 *    Built via sequence of TDCALL[MEM.PAGE.ACCEPT] from TD
 *    Committed by SEAMCALL[TDH.MR.FINALIZE]
 *
 *  MRCONFIGID:  64-byte configuration ID (host-provided, measured)
 *  MROWNER:     64-byte owner ID (software-defined)
 *  MROWNERCONFIG: 64-byte owner config ID
 *
 *  RTMR[0..3] (Runtime Measurement Registers):
 *    Each is SHA-384 accumulator — only extends, never resets
 *    RTMR[0]: BIOS/firmware measurements (by TDVF)
 *    RTMR[1]: boot loader measurements
 *    RTMR[2]: OS kernel / initrd measurements
 *    RTMR[3]: application measurements (TD-controlled)
 *    Extension: RTMR[i] = SHA-384(RTMR[i] || new_measurement)
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * ATTESTATION FLOW
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *  1. TD calls TDCALL[GET.TDREPORT] with 64-byte REPORTDATA (nonce/pubkey)
 *  2. TDX Module generates TDREPORT (1024 bytes), signs with TDREPORT_KEY
 *     TDREPORT contains: MRTD, RTMRs, MRCONFIGID, MROWNER, attributes
 *  3. TD requests TDQUOTE from TDQE (TD Quoting Enclave, runs in SGX)
 *     TDQUOTE = ECDSA-P256 signature over TDREPORT using platform AK
 *  4. Relying party verifies:
 *     PCK cert chain → Intel Root CA
 *     QE identity via Intel SGX collateral
 *     ECDSA signature over TD QUOTE
 *     MRTD + RTMRs match expected values
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * CONFIDENTIAL COMPUTING EVENT LOG (CCEL)
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *  The CCEL records all measurement extensions in order.
 *  Format mirrors TCG EFI Platform Specification (TPM PCR log).
 *  Each event: { register, hash_algo, digest, event_type, event_data }
 *  CCEL allows a verifier to replay all measurements and verify they
 *  match the final RTMR values — providing a full audit trail.
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * MATHEMATICAL FOUNDATIONS
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *  MRTD:    SHA-384 streaming over page-ordered TD memory content
 *  RTMR:    SHA-384(RTMR_current || event_digest) — monotone extension
 *  TDREPORT_MAC: HMAC-SHA256 with hardware TDREPORT_KEY (128-bit)
 *  TDQUOTE_SIG:  ECDSA-P256 over SHA-256(TDQUOTE_header || TDREPORT)
 *  Memory:  AES-256-XTS (tweaked block cipher — each cache line unique)
 *  Integrity: Galois MAC per 64-byte cache line, stored in TME DRAM
 *
 * No stubs. No any. No lies.
 *
 * @module tdx
 * @version 2.0.0
 * @author UBE Sovereign Architecture
 */

import { createHash, createHmac, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto';

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// CONSTANTS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** TDX TDREPORT size in bytes */
const TDREPORT_SIZE = 1024;

/** TDREPORT reportdata field size */
const TDREPORT_DATA_SIZE = 64;

/** Measurement register sizes */
const MRTD_SIZE = 48;     // SHA-384
const RTMR_SIZE = 48;     // SHA-384
const RTMR_COUNT = 4;     // RTMR[0..3]
const MRCONFIGID_SIZE = 48;
const MROWNER_SIZE = 48;
const MROWNERCONFIG_SIZE = 48;
const MRSEAM_SIZE = 48;
const MRSIGNERSEAM_SIZE = 48;

/** TDX attributes bitfield */
const TDX_ATTR_DEBUG_BIT = 0n;
const TDX_ATTR_SEPT_VE_DISABLE_BIT = 28n;
const TDX_ATTR_PKS_BIT = 30n;
const TDX_ATTR_KL_BIT = 31n;
const TDX_ATTR_PERFMON_BIT = 63n;

/** TDQUOTE header */
const TDQUOTE_VERSION = 4;
const TDQUOTE_ATTEST_KEY_TYPE_ECDSA_P256 = 2;
const TDQUOTE_TEE_TYPE_TDX = 0x00000081;

/** TDCALL leaf numbers */
const TDCALL_TDINFO = 1n;
const TDCALL_TDATTESTGETREPORT = 4n;
const TDCALL_TDGETQUOTE = 0x10000n;
const TDCALL_TDMREXTEND = 0n; // Extends RTMR

/** Memory page size */
const TDX_PAGE_SIZE = 4096;

/** AES-256-XTS block size */
const TDX_CACHE_LINE_SIZE = 64;

/** Max vCPUs per TD */
const TDX_MAX_VCPUS = 512;

/** TDX Module version */
const TDX_MODULE_MAJOR = 1;
const TDX_MODULE_MINOR = 5;

/** CCEL event types (TCG spec) */
const EV_PREBOOT_CERT = 0;
const EV_NO_ACTION = 3;
const EV_SEPARATOR = 4;
const EV_ACTION = 5;
const EV_EFI_VARIABLE_DRIVER_CONFIG = 0x80000001;
const EV_EFI_BOOT_SERVICES_APPLICATION = 0x80000003;

export interface TDXCapabilities {

  generation: TDXGeneration | null;

  seamrrSize: bigint;
  mode: 'hardware' | 'simulation';
