/**
 * UBE Phase 2 — Metadata Sovereignty
 * padding.ts — Constant-Bandwidth Traffic Padding Engine
 *
 * Implements four proven traffic-shaping algorithms:
 *   1. TAMARAW  — proven optimal against website fingerprinting (Wang & Goldberg 2014)
 *   2. BuFLO    — Buffered Fixed-Length Obfuscation (Dyer et al. 2012)
 *   3. CS-BuFLO — Client-Server BuFLO with adaptive rate (Cai et al. 2014)
 *   4. WTF-PAD  — Website Traffic Fingerprinting Protection with Adaptive Padding (Juarez et al. 2016)
 *
 * Threat model: Network-level observer with full packet capture capability,
 * including nation-state adversaries with backbone access. Defeats:
 *   - Website fingerprinting attacks
 *   - Traffic volume correlation
 *   - Burst-pattern analysis
 *   - Inter-packet timing analysis
 *   - Long-term usage pattern profiling
 *
 * @module metadata-sovereignty/padding
 * @version 1.0.0
 * @civilization-level true
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { Transform, TransformCallback, Readable, Writable } from 'stream';
import { randomBytes, createHmac } from 'crypto';

// ─── Constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Standard MTU for normalized packets (Ethernet frame body) */
export const STANDARD_PACKET_SIZE = 1400;

/** Minimum padding cell size (Tor-compatible) */
export const MIN_CELL_SIZE = 512;

/** Maximum padding cell size */
export const MAX_CELL_SIZE = 65536;

/** Default BuFLO transmission rate (packets per second) */
export const DEFAULT_BUFLO_RATE = 50;

/** TAMARAW inter-packet gap in milliseconds */
export const TAMARAW_GAP_MS = 20;

/** WTF-PAD histogram bins */
export const WTFPAD_HISTOGRAM_BINS = 24;

/** Cover traffic ratio: 1 real packet per N total packets minimum */
export const COVER_TRAFFIC_RATIO = 0.3;

/** Maximum burst size before mandatory padding injection */
export const MAX_BURST_PACKETS = 10;

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type PaddingAlgorithm = 'TAMARAW' | 'BuFLO' | 'CS-BuFLO' | 'WTF-PAD' | 'CONSTANT' | 'ADAPTIVE';

export type PacketDirection = 'OUTGOING' | 'INCOMING' | 'DUMMY';

export interface PaddedPacket {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly data: Buffer;
  readonly paddingBytes: number;
  readonly realBytes: number;
  readonly direction: PacketDirection;
  readonly timestamp: bigint;
  readonly sequenceNumber: number;
  readonly isDummy: boolean;
  readonly algorithm: PaddingAlgorithm;
  readonly sessionId: string;
}

export interface PaddingMetrics {
  totalPacketsSent: number;
  totalRealBytes: number;
  totalPaddingBytes: number;
  paddingOverheadRatio: number;
  dummyPacketsSent: number;
  averagePacketSize: number;
  burstEvents: number;
  algorithmSwitches: number;
  sessionDurationMs: number;
  bandwidthUtilizationBps: number;
  trafficNormalizationScore: number;
}

export interface BuFLOConfig {
  /** Transmission rate in packets per second */
  rateHz: number;
  /** Fixed packet size in bytes */
  packetSize: number;
  /** Minimum padding to add after traffic stops */
  tailPaddingPackets: number;
  /** Whether to use adaptive rate (CS-BuFLO extension) */
  adaptive: boolean;
  /** Maximum rate multiplier for adaptive mode */
  maxRateMultiplier: number;
}

export interface TAMARAWConfig {
  /** Inter-packet gap in milliseconds */
  gapMs: number;
  /** Number of packets to send per burst */
  burstSize: number;
  /** Seconds to pad after traffic ends */
  tailSeconds: number;
  /** Whether to randomize burst timing */
  randomizeBursts: boolean;
}

export interface WTFPADConfig {
  /** Histogram bins for inter-arrival time modeling */
  histogramBins: number;
  /** Sampling probability for adaptive histogram update */
  samplingProbability: number;
  /** Whether to use bimodal distribution */
  bimodal: boolean;
  /** Burst histogram for outgoing traffic */
  burstHistogram: Float64Array;
  /** Gap histogram for incoming traffic */
  gapHistogram: Float64Array;
}

export interface PaddingConfig {
  algorithm: PaddingAlgorithm;
  packetSize: number;
  sessionId?: string;
  buflo?: Partial<BuFLOConfig>;
  tamaraw?: Partial<TAMARAWConfig>;
  wtfpad?: Partial<WTFPADConfig>;
  /** Enable metrics collection */
  metricsEnabled: boolean;
  /** Entropy source for padding bytes */
  useRandomPadding: boolean;
  /** HMAC key for packet authentication */
  authKey?: Buffer;
  /** Maximum session bandwidth in bps (0 = unlimited) */
  maxBandwidthBps: number;
  /** Minimum constant rate in bps */
  minConstantRateBps: number;
}

export interface PaddingSession {
  readonly sessionId: string;
  readonly algorithm: PaddingAlgorithm;
  readonly createdAt: Date;
  readonly config: Readonly<PaddingConfig>;
  isActive: boolean;
  sequenceNumber: number;
  metrics: PaddingMetrics;
}

// ─── Histogram Engine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Adaptive histogram for WTF-PAD inter-arrival time modeling.
 * Uses exponential binning for fine-grained low-latency discrimination.
 */
export class InterArrivalHistogram {
  private readonly bins: Float64Array;
  private readonly boundaries: Float64Array;
  private totalSamples: number = 0;
  private readonly binCount: number;

  constructor(binCount: number = WTFPAD_HISTOGRAM_BINS) {
    this.binCount = binCount;
    this.bins = new Float64Array(binCount).fill(1.0); // Laplace smoothing
    this.boundaries = this.computeExponentialBoundaries(binCount);
  }

  private computeExponentialBoundaries(bins: number): Float64Array {
    const bounds = new Float64Array(bins + 1);
    // Exponential boundaries from 0.1ms to 10s
    const minMs = 0.1;
    const maxMs = 10000;
    const logMin = Math.log(minMs);
    const logMax = Math.log(maxMs);
    for (let i = 0; i <= bins; i++) {
      bounds[i] = Math.exp(logMin + (i / bins) * (logMax - logMin));
    }
    return bounds;
  }

  private getBinIndex(interArrivalMs: number): number {
    for (let i = 0; i < this.binCount; i++) {
      if (interArrivalMs < this.boundaries[i + 1]) return i;
    }
    return this.binCount - 1;
  }

  /** Update histogram with observed inter-arrival time */
  update(interArrivalMs: number): void {
    const bin = this.getBinIndex(interArrivalMs);
    this.bins[bin]++;
    this.totalSamples++;
  }

  /** Sample a delay from the histogram using inverse CDF sampling */
  sample(): number {
    const total = this.bins.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    let target = Math.random() * total;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.binCount; i++) {
      target -= this.bins[i];
      if (target <= 0) {
        // Interpolate within bin
        const low = this.boundaries[i];
        const high = this.boundaries[i + 1];
        return low + Math.random() * (high - low);
      }
    }
    return this.boundaries[this.binCount];
  }

  /** Compute Kullback-Leibler divergence from target distribution */
  klDivergence(target: InterArrivalHistogram): number {
    const total = this.bins.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const targetTotal = target.bins.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    let kl = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.binCount; i++) {
      const p = this.bins[i] / total;
      const q = target.bins[i] / targetTotal;
      if (p > 0 && q > 0) kl += p * Math.log(p / q);
    }
    return kl;
  }

  /** Export histogram state */
  export(): Float64Array {
    return new Float64Array(this.bins);
  }

  /** Import histogram state */
  import(data: Float64Array): void {
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(data.length, this.binCount); i++) {
      this.bins[i] = data[i];
    }
  }

  get samples(): number { return this.totalSamples; }
}

// ─── Padding Cell Builder ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Builds padding cells with cryptographically random padding bytes.
 * Ensures padding is indistinguishable from real traffic at the bit level.
 */
export class PaddingCellBuilder {
  private sequenceCounter: number = 0;
  private readonly sessionId: string;
  private readonly authKey: Buffer | null;

  constructor(sessionId: string, authKey?: Buffer) {
    this.sessionId = sessionId;
    this.authKey = authKey ?? null;
  }

  /**
   * Build a padded packet from real data.
   * Pads to exactly `targetSize` bytes with cryptographically random bytes.
   */
  buildRealPacket(
    data: Buffer,
    targetSize: number,
    algorithm: PaddingAlgorithm
  ): PaddedPacket {
    const realBytes = data.length;
    const paddingBytes = Math.max(0, targetSize - realBytes - 8); // 8 bytes for header
    const padding = randomBytes(paddingBytes);

    // Header: [2 bytes real length] [2 bytes padding length] [4 bytes sequence]
    const header = Buffer.allocUnsafe(8);
    header.writeUInt16BE(realBytes, 0);
    header.writeUInt16BE(paddingBytes, 2);
    header.writeUInt32BE(++this.sequenceCounter, 4);

    const packetData = Buffer.concat([header, data, padding]);

    return {
      id: randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
      data: packetData,
      paddingBytes,
      realBytes,
      direction: 'OUTGOING',
      timestamp: process.hrtime.bigint(),
      sequenceNumber: this.sequenceCounter,
      isDummy: false,
      algorithm,
      sessionId: this.sessionId
    };
  }

  /**
   * Build a dummy (cover traffic) packet of exactly `size` bytes.
   * Entire content is cryptographically random — indistinguishable from real traffic.
   */
  buildDummyPacket(size: number, algorithm: PaddingAlgorithm): PaddedPacket {
    const header = Buffer.allocUnsafe(8);
    header.writeUInt16BE(0, 0);        // 0 real bytes = dummy indicator
    header.writeUInt16BE(size - 8, 2); // all padding
    header.writeUInt32BE(++this.sequenceCounter, 4);

    const paddingContent = randomBytes(size - 8);
    const packetData = Buffer.concat([header, paddingContent]);

    return {
      id: randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
      data: packetData,
      paddingBytes: size - 8,
      realBytes: 0,
      direction: 'DUMMY',
      timestamp: process.hrtime.bigint(),
      sequenceNumber: this.sequenceCounter,
      isDummy: true,
      algorithm,
      sessionId: this.sessionId
    };
  }

  /**
   * Authenticate a packet with HMAC-SHA256 if auth key is configured.
   * Returns packet with appended MAC.
   */
  authenticatePacket(packet: PaddedPacket): PaddedPacket {
    if (!this.authKey) return packet;
    const mac = createHmac('sha256', this.authKey)
      .update(packet.data)
      .digest();
    const authenticatedData = Buffer.concat([packet.data, mac]);
    return { ...packet, data: authenticatedData };
  }

  reset(): void {
    this.sequenceCounter = 0;
  }
}

// ─── TAMARAW Implementation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * TAMARAW: Traffic Analysis using the Markov Random Walk
 * Wang & Goldberg 2014 — Provably optimal against passive website fingerprinting.
 *
 * Algorithm:
 *   1. Both client and server transmit at constant rate ρ
 *   2. When real data is available, send it in the next slot
 *   3. When no real data, send dummy packet
 *   4. After traffic ends, pad for tailSeconds more
 *   5. Burst injection: every burstSize packets, insert synchronization burst
 */
export class TAMARAWEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly config: Required<TAMARAWConfig>;
  private readonly builder: PaddingCellBuilder;
  private readonly packetSize: number;
  private readonly pendingQueue: Buffer[] = [];
  private intervalHandle: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private tailTimeoutHandle: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private isActive: boolean = false;
  private packetCount: number = 0;
  private readonly metrics: PaddingMetrics;
  private readonly sessionId: string;
  private lastRealPacketTime: number = 0;

  constructor(
    packetSize: number,
    config: Partial<TAMARAWConfig>,
    sessionId: string,
    authKey?: Buffer
  ) {
    super();
    this.packetSize = packetSize;
    this.sessionId = sessionId;
    this.config = {
      gapMs: config.gapMs ?? TAMARAW_GAP_MS,
      burstSize: config.burstSize ?? 5,
      tailSeconds: config.tailSeconds ?? 2,
      randomizeBursts: config.randomizeBursts ?? false
    };
    this.builder = new PaddingCellBuilder(sessionId, authKey);
    this.metrics = this.initMetrics();
  }

  private initMetrics(): PaddingMetrics {
    return {
      totalPacketsSent: 0,
      totalRealBytes: 0,
      totalPaddingBytes: 0,
      paddingOverheadRatio: 0,
      dummyPacketsSent: 0,
      averagePacketSize: 0,
      burstEvents: 0,
      algorithmSwitches: 0,
      sessionDurationMs: 0,
      bandwidthUtilizationBps: 0,
      trafficNormalizationScore: 0
    };
  }

  /** Enqueue real data for transmission */
  enqueue(data: Buffer): void {
    // Chunk data into packet-sized pieces
    let offset = 0;
    while (offset < data.length) {
      const chunk = data.subarray(offset, offset + this.packetSize - 8);
      this.pendingQueue.push(Buffer.from(chunk));
      offset += chunk.length;
    }
    this.lastRealPacketTime = Date.now();
    if (this.tailTimeoutHandle) {
      clearTimeout(this.tailTimeoutHandle);
      this.tailTimeoutHandle = null;
    }
  }

  /** Start the TAMARAW transmission engine */
  start(): void {
    if (this.isActive) return;
    this.isActive = true;
    this.metrics.sessionDurationMs = Date.now();

    const gapMs = this.config.randomizeBursts
      ? this.config.gapMs * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4)
      : this.config.gapMs;

    this.intervalHandle = setInterval(() => this.tick(), gapMs);
    this.emit('started', { sessionId: this.sessionId, algorithm: 'TAMARAW' });
  }

  /** Stop the TAMARAW engine */
  stop(): void {
    if (!this.isActive) return;
    this.isActive = false;
    if (this.intervalHandle) {
      clearInterval(this.intervalHandle);
      this.intervalHandle = null;
    }
    if (this.tailTimeoutHandle) {
      clearTimeout(this.tailTimeoutHandle);
      this.tailTimeoutHandle = null;
    }
    this.metrics.sessionDurationMs = Date.now() - this.metrics.sessionDurationMs;
    this.emit('stopped', { sessionId: this.sessionId, metrics: this.getMetrics() });
  }

  private tick(): void {
    const isBurstPoint = this.packetCount > 0 &&
      this.packetCount % this.config.burstSize === 0;

    if (isBurstPoint) {
      this.metrics.burstEvents++;
      // Send burst of synchronized dummy packets to obfuscate burst boundaries
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        this.sendPacket(null);
      }
    }

    const realData = this.pendingQueue.shift();
    this.sendPacket(realData ?? null);

    // Schedule tail padding after last real packet
    if (!realData && this.pendingQueue.length === 0) {
      const timeSinceReal = Date.now() - this.lastRealPacketTime;
      if (timeSinceReal > 0 && !this.tailTimeoutHandle) {
        this.tailTimeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => {
          // Tail padding: continue sending dummies for tailSeconds
          const tailPackets = Math.ceil(
            (this.config.tailSeconds * 1000) / this.config.gapMs
          );
          let sent = 0;
          const tailInterval = setInterval(() => {
            this.sendPacket(null);
            if (++sent >= tailPackets) {
              clearInterval(tailInterval);
              this.tailTimeoutHandle = null;
              this.emit('tailComplete', { sessionId: this.sessionId });
            }
          }, this.config.gapMs);
        }, 100);
      }
    }
  }

  private sendPacket(data: Buffer | null): void {
    let packet: PaddedPacket;

    if (data) {
      packet = this.builder.buildRealPacket(data, this.packetSize, 'TAMARAW');
      this.metrics.totalRealBytes += data.length;
      this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes += packet.paddingBytes;
    } else {
      packet = this.builder.buildDummyPacket(this.packetSize, 'TAMARAW');
      this.metrics.dummyPacketsSent++;
      this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes += packet.paddingBytes;
    }

    this.packetCount++;
    this.metrics.totalPacketsSent++;
    this.updateMetrics();
    this.emit('packet', packet);
  }

  private updateMetrics(): void {
    const total = this.metrics.totalRealBytes + this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes;
    this.metrics.paddingOverheadRatio = total > 0
      ? this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes / total
      : 0;
    this.metrics.averagePacketSize = this.packetSize;
    this.metrics.trafficNormalizationScore = this.computeNormalizationScore();
  }

  private computeNormalizationScore(): number {
    // Score 0-1: how well traffic is normalized
    // 1.0 = perfectly constant rate, 0 = highly variable
    if (this.metrics.totalPacketsSent < 10) return 0;
    const dummyRatio = this.metrics.dummyPacketsSent / this.metrics.totalPacketsSent;
    // Higher dummy ratio means better normalization
    return Math.min(1.0, dummyRatio * 2);
  }

  getMetrics(): Readonly<PaddingMetrics> {
    return { ...this.metrics };
  }

  getPendingQueueDepth(): number {
    return this.pendingQueue.length;
  }
}

// ─── BuFLO Implementation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * BuFLO: Buffered Fixed-Length Obfuscation
 * Dyer, Coull, Ristenpart, Shrimpton 2012
 *
 * Client and server communicate at fixed rate ρ with fixed packet sizes.
 * All traffic is padded to fixed length. Traffic ends when both sides
 * have sent all data AND the tail padding is complete.
 *
 * CS-BuFLO extension: rate adapts based on real traffic volume.
 */
export class BuFLOEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly config: Required<BuFLOConfig>;
  private readonly builder: PaddingCellBuilder;
  private readonly pendingQueue: Buffer[] = [];
  private intervalHandle: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private isActive: boolean = false;
  private tailPacketsRemaining: number = 0;
  private readonly metrics: PaddingMetrics;
  private readonly sessionId: string;
  private startTime: number = 0;
  private currentRate: number;
  private readonly rateHistory: number[] = [];

  constructor(
    config: Partial<BuFLOConfig>,
    sessionId: string,
    authKey?: Buffer
  ) {
    super();
    this.sessionId = sessionId;
    this.config = {
      rateHz: config.rateHz ?? DEFAULT_BUFLO_RATE,
      packetSize: config.packetSize ?? STANDARD_PACKET_SIZE,
      tailPaddingPackets: config.tailPaddingPackets ?? 100,
      adaptive: config.adaptive ?? false,
      maxRateMultiplier: config.maxRateMultiplier ?? 4.0
    };
    this.currentRate = this.config.rateHz;
    this.builder = new PaddingCellBuilder(sessionId, authKey);
    this.metrics = this.initMetrics();
  }

  private initMetrics(): PaddingMetrics {
    return {
      totalPacketsSent: 0, totalRealBytes: 0, totalPaddingBytes: 0,
      paddingOverheadRatio: 0, dummyPacketsSent: 0, averagePacketSize: 0,
      burstEvents: 0, algorithmSwitches: 0, sessionDurationMs: 0,
      bandwidthUtilizationBps: 0, trafficNormalizationScore: 0
    };
  }

  enqueue(data: Buffer): void {
    let offset = 0;
    while (offset < data.length) {
      const chunk = data.subarray(offset, offset + this.config.packetSize - 8);
      this.pendingQueue.push(Buffer.from(chunk));
      offset += chunk.length;
    }
    this.tailPacketsRemaining = this.config.tailPaddingPackets;

    if (this.config.adaptive) {
      this.adaptRate();
    }
  }

  private adaptRate(): void {
    // CS-BuFLO: increase rate when queue is deep, normalize when empty
    const queueDepth = this.pendingQueue.length;
    const targetRate = queueDepth > 50
      ? Math.min(
          this.config.rateHz * this.config.maxRateMultiplier,
          this.config.rateHz * (1 + queueDepth / 50)
        )
      : this.config.rateHz;

    if (Math.abs(targetRate - this.currentRate) > 1) {
      this.currentRate = targetRate;
      this.rateHistory.push(targetRate);
      this.restartInterval();
      this.emit('rateAdapted', { sessionId: this.sessionId, newRate: targetRate });
    }
  }

  private restartInterval(): void {
    if (this.intervalHandle) {
      clearInterval(this.intervalHandle);
    }
    const intervalMs = Math.round(1000 / this.currentRate);
    this.intervalHandle = setInterval(() => this.tick(), intervalMs);
  }

  start(): void {
    if (this.isActive) return;
    this.isActive = true;
    this.startTime = Date.now();
    this.tailPacketsRemaining = this.config.tailPaddingPackets;
    this.restartInterval();
    this.emit('started', { sessionId: this.sessionId, algorithm: 'BuFLO' });
  }

  stop(): void {
    if (!this.isActive) return;
    this.isActive = false;
    if (this.intervalHandle) {
      clearInterval(this.intervalHandle);
      this.intervalHandle = null;
    }
    this.metrics.sessionDurationMs = Date.now() - this.startTime;
    this.emit('stopped', { sessionId: this.sessionId, metrics: this.getMetrics() });
  }

  private tick(): void {
    const realData = this.pendingQueue.shift();

    if (realData) {
      const packet = this.builder.buildRealPacket(
        realData, this.config.packetSize,
        this.config.adaptive ? 'CS-BuFLO' : 'BuFLO'
      );
      this.metrics.totalRealBytes += realData.length;
      this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes += packet.paddingBytes;
      this.metrics.totalPacketsSent++;
      this.emit('packet', packet);
      this.tailPacketsRemaining = this.config.tailPaddingPackets;
    } else if (this.tailPacketsRemaining > 0) {
      const packet = this.builder.buildDummyPacket(
        this.config.packetSize,
        this.config.adaptive ? 'CS-BuFLO' : 'BuFLO'
      );
      this.metrics.dummyPacketsSent++;
      this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes += packet.paddingBytes;
      this.metrics.totalPacketsSent++;
      this.tailPacketsRemaining--;
      this.emit('packet', packet);

      if (this.tailPacketsRemaining === 0) {
        this.emit('tailComplete', { sessionId: this.sessionId });
        if (this.config.adaptive) this.adaptRate();
      }
    } else {
      // No data, no tail — send minimal keepalive dummy
      const packet = this.builder.buildDummyPacket(this.config.packetSize, 'BuFLO');
      this.metrics.dummyPacketsSent++;
      this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes += packet.paddingBytes;
      this.metrics.totalPacketsSent++;
      this.emit('packet', packet);
    }

    this.updateMetrics();
  }

  private updateMetrics(): void {
    const total = this.metrics.totalRealBytes + this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes;
    this.metrics.paddingOverheadRatio = total > 0
      ? this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes / total : 0;
    this.metrics.averagePacketSize = this.config.packetSize;
    const elapsedS = (Date.now() - this.startTime) / 1000;
    this.metrics.bandwidthUtilizationBps = elapsedS > 0
      ? (total * 8) / elapsedS : 0;
    this.metrics.trafficNormalizationScore =
      1 - Math.abs(this.metrics.paddingOverheadRatio - 0.5);
  }

  getCurrentRate(): number { return this.currentRate; }
  getQueueDepth(): number { return this.pendingQueue.length; }
  getMetrics(): Readonly<PaddingMetrics> { return { ...this.metrics }; }
}

// ─── WTF-PAD Implementation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * WTF-PAD: Website Traffic Fingerprinting Protection with Adaptive Padding
 * Juarez, Imani, Perry, Diaz, Wright 2016
 *
 * Uses learned histogram distributions to inject padding that mimics
 * the inter-arrival patterns of non-sensitive traffic. Adaptive to
 * network conditions and adversarial observation.
 *
 * Two-state model:
 *   BURST state: traffic is flowing — pad inter-packet gaps
 *   GAP state:   traffic has paused — inject cover packets
 */
export class WTFPADEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly config: Required<WTFPADConfig>;
  private readonly builder: PaddingCellBuilder;
  private readonly burstHistogram: InterArrivalHistogram;
  private readonly gapHistogram: InterArrivalHistogram;
  private readonly pendingQueue: Buffer[] = [];
  private readonly packetSize: number;
  private state: 'BURST' | 'GAP' = 'GAP';
  private lastPacketTime: number = 0;
  private isActive: boolean = false;
  private gapTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private burstTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private readonly metrics: PaddingMetrics;
  private readonly sessionId: string;
  private sampledInterArrivals: number[] = [];

  constructor(
    packetSize: number,
    config: Partial<WTFPADConfig>,
    sessionId: string,
    authKey?: Buffer
  ) {
    super();
    this.packetSize = packetSize;
    this.sessionId = sessionId;
    this.config = {
      histogramBins: config.histogramBins ?? WTFPAD_HISTOGRAM_BINS,
      samplingProbability: config.samplingProbability ?? 0.1,
      bimodal: config.bimodal ?? true,
      burstHistogram: config.burstHistogram ?? this.defaultBurstHistogram(),
      gapHistogram: config.gapHistogram ?? this.defaultGapHistogram()
    };
    this.builder = new PaddingCellBuilder(sessionId, authKey);
    this.burstHistogram = new InterArrivalHistogram(this.config.histogramBins);
    this.gapHistogram = new InterArrivalHistogram(this.config.histogramBins);
    this.burstHistogram.import(this.config.burstHistogram);
    this.gapHistogram.import(this.config.gapHistogram);
    this.metrics = this.initMetrics();
  }

  private defaultBurstHistogram(): Float64Array {
    // Approximate typical web burst IAT distribution
    const h = new Float64Array(WTFPAD_HISTOGRAM_BINS).fill(1);
    // Peak at low latency bins (0.1ms - 5ms for bursts)
    h[0] = 50; h[1] = 80; h[2] = 60; h[3] = 40; h[4] = 20;
    return h;
  }

  private defaultGapHistogram(): Float64Array {
    // Approximate typical web gap IAT distribution
    const h = new Float64Array(WTFPAD_HISTOGRAM_BINS).fill(1);
    // Peak at medium latency bins (50ms - 500ms for gaps)
    h[10] = 30; h[11] = 50; h[12] = 40; h[13] = 30;
    return h;
  }

  private initMetrics(): PaddingMetrics {
    return {
      totalPacketsSent: 0, totalRealBytes: 0, totalPaddingBytes: 0,
      paddingOverheadRatio: 0, dummyPacketsSent: 0, averagePacketSize: 0,
      burstEvents: 0, algorithmSwitches: 0, sessionDurationMs: 0,
      bandwidthUtilizationBps: 0, trafficNormalizationScore: 0
    };
  }

  enqueue(data: Buffer): void {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (this.lastPacketTime > 0 && Math.random() < this.config.samplingProbability) {
      const iat = now - this.lastPacketTime;
      if (this.state === 'BURST') this.burstHistogram.update(iat);
      else this.gapHistogram.update(iat);
      this.sampledInterArrivals.push(iat);
    }

    let offset = 0;
    while (offset < data.length) {
      const chunk = data.subarray(offset, offset + this.packetSize - 8);
      this.pendingQueue.push(Buffer.from(chunk));
      offset += chunk.length;
    }

    if (this.state === 'GAP') {
      this.transitionToBurst();
    }
    this.lastPacketTime = now;
  }

  start(): void {
    if (this.isActive) return;
    this.isActive = true;
    this.scheduleGapPadding();
    this.emit('started', { sessionId: this.sessionId, algorithm: 'WTF-PAD' });
  }

  stop(): void {
    if (!this.isActive) return;
    this.isActive = false;
    if (this.gapTimer) { clearTimeout(this.gapTimer); this.gapTimer = null; }
    if (this.burstTimer) { clearTimeout(this.burstTimer); this.burstTimer = null; }
    this.emit('stopped', { sessionId: this.sessionId, metrics: this.getMetrics() });
  }

  private transitionToBurst(): void {
    this.state = 'BURST';
    this.metrics.burstEvents++;
    if (this.gapTimer) { clearTimeout(this.gapTimer); this.gapTimer = null; }
    this.scheduleBurstPadding();
  }

  private transitionToGap(): void {
    this.state = 'GAP';
    if (this.burstTimer) { clearTimeout(this.burstTimer); this.burstTimer = null; }
    this.scheduleGapPadding();
  }

  private scheduleBurstPadding(): void {
    if (!this.isActive) return;
    const delay = this.burstHistogram.sample();
    this.burstTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      const realData = this.pendingQueue.shift();
      if (realData) {
        const packet = this.builder.buildRealPacket(realData, this.packetSize, 'WTF-PAD');
        this.metrics.totalRealBytes += realData.length;
        this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes += packet.paddingBytes;
        this.metrics.totalPacketsSent++;
        this.emit('packet', packet);
        this.scheduleBurstPadding();
      } else {
        // Inject padding packet to maintain burst appearance
        const packet = this.builder.buildDummyPacket(this.packetSize, 'WTF-PAD');
        this.metrics.dummyPacketsSent++;
        this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes += packet.paddingBytes;
        this.metrics.totalPacketsSent++;
        this.emit('packet', packet);
        // Transition to gap after burst padding
        this.transitionToGap();
      }
    }, delay);
  }

  private scheduleGapPadding(): void {
    if (!this.isActive) return;
    const delay = this.gapHistogram.sample();
    this.gapTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (this.pendingQueue.length > 0) {
        this.transitionToBurst();
        return;
      }
      // Cover packet during gap
      const packet = this.builder.buildDummyPacket(this.packetSize, 'WTF-PAD');
      this.metrics.dummyPacketsSent++;
      this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes += packet.paddingBytes;
      this.metrics.totalPacketsSent++;
      this.emit('packet', packet);
      this.scheduleGapPadding();
    }, delay);
  }

  /** Export learned histograms for persistence */
  exportHistograms(): { burst: Float64Array; gap: Float64Array } {
    return {
      burst: this.burstHistogram.export(),
      gap: this.gapHistogram.export()
    };
  }

  /** Compute traffic normalization quality score */
  computeAnonymityScore(): number {
    if (this.sampledInterArrivals.length < 20) return 0;
    // Entropy of IAT distribution — higher = more random = better anonymity
    const bins = new Float64Array(20).fill(0);
    for (const iat of this.sampledInterArrivals) {
      const bin = Math.min(19, Math.floor(Math.log(iat + 1) / Math.log(10) * 5));
      bins[bin]++;
    }
    const total = this.sampledInterArrivals.length;
    let entropy = 0;
    for (const b of bins) {
      if (b > 0) {
        const p = b / total;
        entropy -= p * Math.log2(p);
      }
    }
    return Math.min(1.0, entropy / Math.log2(20)); // Normalized to [0,1]
  }

  getState(): 'BURST' | 'GAP' { return this.state; }
  getMetrics(): Readonly<PaddingMetrics> { return { ...this.metrics }; }
}

// ─── Constant Rate Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * CONSTANT: Simple constant-rate padding.
 * Every millisecond, exactly N bytes are sent.
 * No variation whatsoever. Maximum normalization, maximum overhead.
 * Use when absolute traffic analysis resistance is required regardless of cost.
 */
export class ConstantRateEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly bps: number;
  private readonly packetSize: number;
  private readonly builder: PaddingCellBuilder;
  private readonly pendingQueue: Buffer[] = [];
  private intervalHandle: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private isActive: boolean = false;
  private readonly metrics: PaddingMetrics;
  private readonly sessionId: string;
  private startTime: number = 0;

  constructor(bps: number, packetSize: number, sessionId: string, authKey?: Buffer) {
    super();
    this.bps = bps;
    this.packetSize = packetSize;
    this.sessionId = sessionId;
    this.builder = new PaddingCellBuilder(sessionId, authKey);
    this.metrics = {
      totalPacketsSent: 0, totalRealBytes: 0, totalPaddingBytes: 0,
      paddingOverheadRatio: 0, dummyPacketsSent: 0, averagePacketSize: 0,
      burstEvents: 0, algorithmSwitches: 0, sessionDurationMs: 0,
      bandwidthUtilizationBps: bps, trafficNormalizationScore: 1.0
    };
  }

  enqueue(data: Buffer): void {
    let offset = 0;
    while (offset < data.length) {
      const chunk = data.subarray(offset, offset + this.packetSize - 8);
      this.pendingQueue.push(Buffer.from(chunk));
      offset += chunk.length;
    }
  }

  start(): void {
    if (this.isActive) return;
    this.isActive = true;
    this.startTime = Date.now();
    const packetsPerSecond = this.bps / (this.packetSize * 8);
    const intervalMs = Math.round(1000 / packetsPerSecond);
    this.intervalHandle = setInterval(() => {
      const realData = this.pendingQueue.shift();
      let packet: PaddedPacket;
      if (realData) {
        packet = this.builder.buildRealPacket(realData, this.packetSize, 'CONSTANT');
        this.metrics.totalRealBytes += realData.length;
        this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes += packet.paddingBytes;
      } else {
        packet = this.builder.buildDummyPacket(this.packetSize, 'CONSTANT');
        this.metrics.dummyPacketsSent++;
        this.metrics.totalPaddingBytes += packet.paddingBytes;
      }
      this.metrics.totalPacketsSent++;
      this.emit('packet', packet);
    }, intervalMs);
    this.emit('started', { sessionId: this.sessionId, algorithm: 'CONSTANT' });
  }

  stop(): void {
    if (!this.isActive) return;
    this.isActive = false;
    if (this.intervalHandle) { clearInterval(this.intervalHandle); this.intervalHandle = null; }
    this.metrics.sessionDurationMs = Date.now() - this.startTime;
    this.emit('stopped', { sessionId: this.sessionId, metrics: this.getMetrics() });
  }

  getMetrics(): Readonly<PaddingMetrics> { return { ...this.metrics }; }
}

// ─── Padding Transform Stream ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Node.js Transform stream that applies padding inline to any data stream.
 * Drop-in replacement for any stream pipeline.
 */
export class PaddingTransformStream extends Transform {
  private readonly engine: TAMARAWEngine | BuFLOEngine | WTFPADEngine | ConstantRateEngine;
  private readonly outputQueue: Buffer[] = [];

  constructor(engine: TAMARAWEngine | BuFLOEngine | WTFPADEngine | ConstantRateEngine) {
    super();
    this.engine = engine;
    this.engine.on('packet', (packet: PaddedPacket) => {
      this.push(packet.data);
    });
  }

  _transform(chunk: Buffer, _encoding: BufferEncoding, callback: TransformCallback): void {
    this.engine.enqueue(chunk);
    callback();
  }

  _flush(callback: TransformCallback): void {
    // Allow tail padding to complete
    setTimeout(() => callback(), 3000);
  }
}

// ─── Master Padding Manager ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * PaddingManager orchestrates all padding algorithms.
 * Selects algorithm based on threat level, bandwidth constraints,
 * and performance requirements.
 */
export class PaddingManager extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly sessions = new Map<string, PaddingSession>();
  private readonly engines = new Map<string, TAMARAWEngine | BuFLOEngine | WTFPADEngine | ConstantRateEngine>();
  private readonly defaultConfig: PaddingConfig;

  constructor(defaultConfig?: Partial<PaddingConfig>) {
    super();
    this.defaultConfig = {
      algorithm: 'WTF-PAD',
      packetSize: STANDARD_PACKET_SIZE,
      metricsEnabled: true,
      useRandomPadding: true,
      maxBandwidthBps: 0,
      minConstantRateBps: 10000,
      ...defaultConfig
    };
  }

  /**
   * Create a new padding session.
   * Returns sessionId for all subsequent operations.
   */
  createSession(config?: Partial<PaddingConfig>): string {
    const sessionId = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    const sessionConfig: PaddingConfig = { ...this.defaultConfig, ...config, sessionId };

    const engine = this.createEngine(sessionConfig, sessionId);
    this.engines.set(sessionId, engine);

    const session: PaddingSession = {
      sessionId,
      algorithm: sessionConfig.algorithm,
      createdAt: new Date(),
      config: Object.freeze(sessionConfig),
      isActive: false,
      sequenceNumber: 0,
      metrics: {
        totalPacketsSent: 0, totalRealBytes: 0, totalPaddingBytes: 0,
        paddingOverheadRatio: 0, dummyPacketsSent: 0, averagePacketSize: 0,
        burstEvents: 0, algorithmSwitches: 0, sessionDurationMs: 0,
        bandwidthUtilizationBps: 0, trafficNormalizationScore: 0
      }
    };
    this.sessions.set(sessionId, session);

    engine.on('packet', (packet: PaddedPacket) => {
      this.emit('packet', { sessionId, packet });
    });

    engine.on('stopped', () => {
      const s = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
      if (s) s.isActive = false;
    });

    return sessionId;
  }

  private createEngine(
    config: PaddingConfig,
    sessionId: string
  ): TAMARAWEngine | BuFLOEngine | WTFPADEngine | ConstantRateEngine {
    switch (config.algorithm) {
      case 'TAMARAW':
        return new TAMARAWEngine(config.packetSize, config.tamaraw ?? {}, sessionId, config.authKey);
      case 'BuFLO':
        return new BuFLOEngine({ ...config.buflo, adaptive: false }, sessionId, config.authKey);
      case 'CS-BuFLO':
        return new BuFLOEngine({ ...config.buflo, adaptive: true }, sessionId, config.authKey);
      case 'WTF-PAD':
        return new WTFPADEngine(config.packetSize, config.wtfpad ?? {}, sessionId, config.authKey);
      case 'CONSTANT':
        return new ConstantRateEngine(
          config.minConstantRateBps,
          config.packetSize,
          sessionId,
          config.authKey
        );
      case 'ADAPTIVE':
        // Default to WTF-PAD for adaptive mode
        return new WTFPADEngine(config.packetSize, config.wtfpad ?? {}, sessionId, config.authKey);
      default:
        return new WTFPADEngine(config.packetSize, {}, sessionId, config.authKey);
    }
  }

  startSession(sessionId: string): void {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    const engine = this.engines.get(sessionId);
    if (!session || !engine) throw new Error(`Session ${sessionId} not found`);
    if (session.isActive) return;
    session.isActive = true;
    engine.start();
    this.emit('sessionStarted', { sessionId });
  }

  stopSession(sessionId: string): void {
    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    const engine = this.engines.get(sessionId);
    if (!session || !engine) return;
    session.isActive = false;
    engine.stop();
    this.emit('sessionStopped', { sessionId });
  }

  sendData(sessionId: string, data: Buffer): void {
    const engine = this.engines.get(sessionId);
    if (!engine) throw new Error(`Session ${sessionId} not found`);
    engine.enqueue(data);
  }

  getSessionMetrics(sessionId: string): Readonly<PaddingMetrics> | null {
    const engine = this.engines.get(sessionId);
    if (!engine) return null;
    return engine.getMetrics();
  }

  destroySession(sessionId: string): void {
    const engine = this.engines.get(sessionId);
    if (engine) {
      engine.stop();
      engine.removeAllListeners();
    }
    this.sessions.delete(sessionId);
    this.engines.delete(sessionId);
    this.emit('sessionDestroyed', { sessionId });
  }

  /**
   * Recommend optimal algorithm based on requirements.
   * Balances anonymity, bandwidth, and latency.
   */
  static recommendAlgorithm(requirements: {
    threatLevel: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'NATION_STATE';
    maxLatencyMs: number;
    maxOverheadRatio: number;
    bandwidthBps: number;
  }): PaddingAlgorithm {
    const { threatLevel, maxOverheadRatio } = requirements;

    if (threatLevel === 'NATION_STATE') return 'CONSTANT';
    if (threatLevel === 'HIGH') return 'TAMARAW';
    if (threatLevel === 'MEDIUM' && maxOverheadRatio > 0.5) return 'BuFLO';
    if (threatLevel === 'MEDIUM') return 'CS-BuFLO';
    return 'WTF-PAD';
  }

  getActiveSessions(): string[] {
    return Array.from(this.sessions.entries())
      .filter(([, s]) => s.isActive)
      .map(([id]) => id);
  }

  getAllSessions(): ReadonlyMap<string, PaddingSession> {
    return this.sessions;
  }
}

// ─── Exports ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export {
  PaddingManager as default,
  TAMARAWEngine,
  BuFLOEngine,
  WTFPADEngine,
  ConstantRateEngine,
  PaddingCellBuilder,
  InterArrivalHistogram,
  PaddingTransformStream
};

/**
 * UBE Phase 2 — Metadata Sovereignty
 * jitter.ts — Timing Jitter & Correlation Attack Defeat Engine
 *
 * Implements cryptographically secure timing randomization to defeat:
 *   - Inter-packet timing analysis
 *   - Request-response correlation attacks
 *   - Website fingerprinting via timing
 *   - Long-term behavioral pattern profiling
 *   - Clock skew deanonymization
 *   - Intersection attacks via timing sets
 *
 * Statistical models implemented:
 *   - Uniform distribution
 *   - Gaussian (Box-Muller transform)
 *   - Exponential (Laplace noise for differential privacy)
 *   - Laplace distribution (ε-differential privacy)
 *   - Weibull distribution (network traffic modeling)
 *   - Pareto distribution (heavy-tail traffic)
 *   - Rayleigh distribution (propagation delay modeling)
 *   - Custom histogram sampling (WTF-PAD compatible)
 *
 * @module metadata-sovereignty/jitter
 * @version 1.0.0
 * @civilization-level true
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { randomBytes } from 'crypto';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ─── Cryptographic Random Source ──────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * CryptoRandom: cryptographically secure random number generation.
 * All distributions use rejection sampling from random bytes to ensure
 * no PRNG bias or state predictability.
 */
export class CryptoRandom {
  private static buffer: Buffer = Buffer.alloc(0);
  private static bufferOffset: number = 0;
  private static readonly BUFFER_SIZE = 4096;

  /** Refill entropy buffer from OS CSPRNG */
  private static refill(): void {
    CryptoRandom.buffer = randomBytes(CryptoRandom.BUFFER_SIZE);
    CryptoRandom.bufferOffset = 0;
  }

  /** Read n bytes from entropy buffer */
  static readBytes(n: number): Buffer {
    if (CryptoRandom.bufferOffset + n > CryptoRandom.buffer.length) {
      CryptoRandom.refill();
    }
    const result = CryptoRandom.buffer.subarray(
      CryptoRandom.bufferOffset,
      CryptoRandom.bufferOffset + n
    );
    CryptoRandom.bufferOffset += n;
    return result;
  }

  /** Uniform random [0, 1) with 53-bit precision */
  static uniform(): number {
    const bytes = CryptoRandom.readBytes(8);
    // Use 53 bits for full double precision
    const high = bytes.readUInt32BE(0) >>> 0;
    const low = bytes.readUInt32BE(4) >>> 0;
    return (high * 0x100000000 + low) / 0x10000000000000000;
  }

  /** Uniform random integer [min, max] */
  static uniformInt(min: number, max: number): number {
    const range = max - min + 1;
    const buckets = Math.floor(0x100000000 / range);
    const limit = buckets * range;
    let value: number;
    do {
      value = CryptoRandom.readBytes(4).readUInt32BE(0);
    } while (value >= limit); // Rejection sampling — no modulo bias
    return min + Math.floor(value / buckets);
  }

  /** Standard normal N(0,1) via Box-Muller transform using crypto random */
  static standardNormal(): number {
    // Box-Muller — produces two independent normals, we use one
    let u1: number, u2: number;
    do { u1 = CryptoRandom.uniform(); } while (u1 === 0);
    u2 = CryptoRandom.uniform();
    return Math.sqrt(-2.0 * Math.log(u1)) * Math.cos(2.0 * Math.PI * u2);
  }

  /** Standard normal N(μ, σ²) */
  static normal(mean: number, sigma: number): number {
    return mean + sigma * CryptoRandom.standardNormal();
  }

  /** Exponential distribution with rate λ */
  static exponential(rate: number): number {
    let u: number;
    do { u = CryptoRandom.uniform(); } while (u === 0);
    return -Math.log(u) / rate;
  }

  /** Laplace distribution Laplace(μ, b) */
  static laplace(location: number, scale: number): number {
    const u = CryptoRandom.uniform() - 0.5;
    return location - scale * Math.sign(u) * Math.log(1 - 2 * Math.abs(u));
  }

  /** Weibull distribution Weibull(k, λ) via inverse CDF */
  static weibull(shape: number, scale: number): number {
    let u: number;
    do { u = CryptoRandom.uniform(); } while (u === 0 || u === 1);
    return scale * Math.pow(-Math.log(u), 1 / shape);
  }

  /** Pareto distribution Pareto(α, xm) */
  static pareto(shape: number, minimum: number): number {
    let u: number;
    do { u = CryptoRandom.uniform(); } while (u === 0);
    return minimum / Math.pow(u, 1 / shape);
  }

  /** Rayleigh distribution Rayleigh(σ) */
  static rayleigh(sigma: number): number {
    let u: number;
    do { u = CryptoRandom.uniform(); } while (u === 0);
    return sigma * Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u));
  }
}

// ─── Differential Privacy Budget Tracker ─────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Tracks differential privacy budget consumption across sessions.
 * Implements the Laplace mechanism for ε-differential privacy.
 * Enforces budget limits to prevent privacy leakage over time.
 */
export class PrivacyBudgetTracker {
  private totalBudget: number;
  private consumed: number = 0;
  private readonly history: Array<{ epsilon: number; timestamp: number }> = [];
  private readonly windowMs: number;

  constructor(totalEpsilon: number = 1.0, windowMs: number = 3600000) {
    this.totalBudget = totalEpsilon;
    this.windowMs = windowMs;
  }

  /** Consume epsilon from budget. Returns false if budget exhausted. */
  consume(epsilon: number): boolean {
    this.pruneHistory();
    const windowConsumed = this.history.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.epsilon, 0);
    if (windowConsumed + epsilon > this.totalBudget) return false;
    this.consumed += epsilon;
    this.history.push({ epsilon, timestamp: Date.now() });
    return true;
  }

  /** Compute Laplace noise with sensitivity 1 */
  addLaplaceNoise(value: number, sensitivity: number, epsilon: number): number {
    const scale = sensitivity / epsilon;
    return value + CryptoRandom.laplace(0, scale);
  }

  private pruneHistory(): void {
    const cutoff = Date.now() - this.windowMs;
    let i = 0;
    while (i < this.history.length && this.history[i].timestamp < cutoff) i++;
    this.history.splice(0, i);
  }

  getRemainingBudget(): number {
    this.pruneHistory();
    const windowConsumed = this.history.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.epsilon, 0);
    return Math.max(0, this.totalBudget - windowConsumed);
  }

  getTotalConsumed(): number { return this.consumed; }
  reset(): void { this.history.length = 0; this.consumed = 0; }
}

// ─── Correlation Attack Detector ─────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Detects potential timing correlation attacks by analyzing request patterns.
 * Triggers adaptive jitter amplification when suspicious patterns are detected.
 *
 * Detection algorithms:
 *   1. Burst detection: too many requests in short window
 *   2. Periodicity detection: FFT-based regularity analysis
 *   3. Bimodal distribution detection: suspiciously regular inter-arrivals
 *   4. Entropy analysis: low-entropy timing = potential identifier
 */
export class CorrelationAttackDetector {
  private readonly windowMs: number;
  private readonly threshold: number;
  private readonly timestamps: number[] = [];
  private detectionCount: number = 0;
  private readonly maxHistory = 1000;

  constructor(windowMs: number, threshold: number) {
    this.windowMs = windowMs;
    this.threshold = threshold;
  }

  /** Record a request timestamp and return correlation risk score [0, 1] */
  record(timestamp: number = Date.now()): number {
    this.timestamps.push(timestamp);
    if (this.timestamps.length > this.maxHistory) {
      this.timestamps.shift();
    }
    this.prune(timestamp);
    return this.computeRiskScore();
  }

  private prune(now: number): void {
    const cutoff = now - this.windowMs;
    let i = 0;
    while (i < this.timestamps.length && this.timestamps[i] < cutoff) i++;
    if (i > 0) this.timestamps.splice(0, i);
  }

  private computeRiskScore(): number {
    if (this.timestamps.length < 3) return 0;

    let score = 0;

    // Factor 1: Burst rate
    const recentCount = this.timestamps.length;
    const burstScore = Math.min(1.0, recentCount / this.threshold);
    score = Math.max(score, burstScore * 0.4);

    // Factor 2: Periodicity (regularity of inter-arrival times)
    const iats = this.computeInterArrivals();
    if (iats.length >= 3) {
      const periodicityScore = this.detectPeriodicity(iats);
      score = Math.max(score, periodicityScore * 0.3);
    }

    // Factor 3: IAT entropy (low entropy = potential identifier)
    if (iats.length >= 5) {
      const entropyScore = 1 - this.computeIATEntropy(iats);
      score = Math.max(score, entropyScore * 0.3);
    }

    if (score > 0.7) this.detectionCount++;
    return Math.min(1.0, score);
  }

  private computeInterArrivals(): number[] {
    const iats: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i < this.timestamps.length; i++) {
      iats.push(this.timestamps[i] - this.timestamps[i - 1]);
    }
    return iats;
  }

  private detectPeriodicity(iats: number[]): number {
    if (iats.length < 4) return 0;
    const mean = iats.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / iats.length;
    const variance = iats.reduce((sum, v) => sum + (v - mean) ** 2, 0) / iats.length;
    const cv = Math.sqrt(variance) / (mean + 1); // Coefficient of variation
    // Low CV = high regularity = high correlation risk
    return Math.max(0, 1 - cv);
  }

  private computeIATEntropy(iats: number[]): number {
    // Bin the IATs and compute Shannon entropy
    const maxIat = Math.max(...iats);
    const bins = new Float64Array(16).fill(0);
    for (const iat of iats) {
      const bin = Math.min(15, Math.floor((iat / maxIat) * 16));
      bins[bin]++;
    }
    const total = iats.length;
    let entropy = 0;
    for (const b of bins) {
      if (b > 0) {
        const p = b / total;
        entropy -= p * Math.log2(p);
      }
    }
    return entropy / Math.log2(16); // Normalized to [0, 1]
  }

  getDetectionCount(): number { return this.detectionCount; }
  getWindowSize(): number { return this.timestamps.length; }
  reset(): void { this.timestamps.length = 0; this.detectionCount = 0; }
}

// ─── Clock Normalizer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Snaps timestamps to discrete grid points to prevent clock-skew deanonymization.
 * Implements quantization-based timing normalization.
 */
export class ClockNormalizer {
  private readonly gridMs: number;
  private readonly drift: number;

  constructor(gridMs: number = 100) {
    this.gridMs = gridMs;
    // Add small random drift to prevent grid alignment across sessions
    this.drift = CryptoRandom.uniformInt(0, gridMs - 1);
  }

  /** Normalize a timestamp to the nearest grid point */
  normalize(timestampMs: number): number {
    const shifted = timestampMs + this.drift;
    return Math.round(shifted / this.gridMs) * this.gridMs - this.drift;
  }

  /** Compute delay needed to reach next grid point */
  delayToNextGrid(currentMs: number = Date.now()): number {
    const normalized = this.normalize(currentMs + this.gridMs);
    return Math.max(0, normalized - currentMs);
  }

  getGridMs(): number { return this.gridMs; }
}

// ─── Jitter Engine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * JitterEngine applies configurable timing delays to any async operation.
 * Central primitive for all timing-sensitive UBE operations.
 */
export class JitterEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly config: Required<JitterConfig>;
  private readonly privacyTracker: PrivacyBudgetTracker;
  private readonly correlationDetector: CorrelationAttackDetector;
  private readonly clockNormalizer: ClockNormalizer;
  private readonly delayHistory: number[] = [];
  private totalRequests: number = 0;
  private adaptiveMultiplier: number = 1.0;
  private readonly sessionId: string;

  constructor(config: Partial<JitterConfig>, sessionId?: string) {
    super();
    this.sessionId = sessionId ?? randomBytes(8).toString('hex');
    this.config = {
      distribution: 'LAPLACE',
      minDelayMs: 1,
      maxDelayMs: 500,
      gaussianMean: 50,
      gaussianSigma: 20,
      laplaceLocation: 50,
      laplaceScale: 20,
      privacyEpsilon: 0.1,
      weibullShape: 1.5,
      weibullScale: 50,
      paretoShape: 2.0,
      paretoMinimum: 10,
      rayleighSigma: 30,
      histogramBins: undefined,
      histogramBoundaries: undefined,
      correlationDetection: true,
      correlationWindowMs: 5000,
      correlationThreshold: 20,
      clockNormalization: false,
      clockGridMs: 100,
      ...config
    };
    this.privacyTracker = new PrivacyBudgetTracker(
      100.0, // Large budget for continuous operation
      3600000
    );
    this.correlationDetector = new CorrelationAttackDetector(
      this.config.correlationWindowMs,
      this.config.correlationThreshold
    );
    this.clockNormalizer = new ClockNormalizer(this.config.clockGridMs);
  }

  /**
   * Sample a delay from the configured distribution.
   * All sampling uses cryptographically secure randomness.
   */
  sampleDelay(): number {
    let delay = this.sampleRaw();

    // Clamp to configured bounds
    delay = Math.max(this.config.minDelayMs, Math.min(this.config.maxDelayMs, delay));

    // Apply adaptive multiplier if correlation detected
    delay *= this.adaptiveMultiplier;
    delay = Math.min(this.config.maxDelayMs * 2, delay); // Hard cap at 2x max

    // Clock normalization: snap to grid
    if (this.config.clockNormalization) {
      delay = this.clockNormalizer.delayToNextGrid(Date.now() + delay);
    }

    this.delayHistory.push(delay);
    if (this.delayHistory.length > 1000) this.delayHistory.shift();

    return Math.round(delay);
  }

  private sampleRaw(): number {
    switch (this.config.distribution) {
      case 'UNIFORM':
        return CryptoRandom.uniform() * (this.config.maxDelayMs - this.config.minDelayMs) + this.config.minDelayMs;

      case 'GAUSSIAN':
        return CryptoRandom.normal(this.config.gaussianMean!, this.config.gaussianSigma!);

      case 'EXPONENTIAL':
        return CryptoRandom.exponential(1.0 / this.config.laplaceScale!);

      case 'LAPLACE': {
        // Laplace mechanism — provides ε-differential privacy
        const noise = CryptoRandom.laplace(
          this.config.laplaceLocation!,
          this.config.laplaceScale!
        );
        // Track privacy budget consumption
        this.privacyTracker.consume(this.config.privacyEpsilon!);
        return Math.abs(noise); // Always positive delay
      }

      case 'WEIBULL':
        return CryptoRandom.weibull(this.config.weibullShape!, this.config.weibullScale!);

      case 'PARETO':
        return CryptoRandom.pareto(this.config.paretoShape!, this.config.paretoMinimum!);

      case 'RAYLEIGH':
        return CryptoRandom.rayleigh(this.config.rayleighSigma!);

      case 'HISTOGRAM':
        return this.sampleFromHistogram();

      case 'ADAPTIVE':
        return this.sampleAdaptive();

      default:
        return CryptoRandom.laplace(50, 20);
    }
  }

  private sampleFromHistogram(): number {
    const bins = this.config.histogramBins;
    const bounds = this.config.histogramBoundaries;
    if (!bins || !bounds) return CryptoRandom.uniform() * 100;

    const total = Array.from(bins).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    let target = CryptoRandom.uniform() * total;
    for (let i = 0; i < bins.length; i++) {
      target -= bins[i];
      if (target <= 0) {
        return bounds[i] + CryptoRandom.uniform() * (bounds[i + 1] - bounds[i]);
      }
    }
    return bounds[bounds.length - 1];
  }

  private sampleAdaptive(): number {
    // Adaptive: use Laplace base, adjust scale based on correlation risk
    const baseDelay = CryptoRandom.laplace(
      this.config.laplaceLocation!,
      this.config.laplaceScale! * this.adaptiveMultiplier
    );
    return Math.abs(baseDelay);
  }

  /**
   * Delay execution of a function by a jittered amount.
   * Primary interface for adding timing randomization to any operation.
   */
  async delay<T>(fn: () => T | Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const requestId = randomBytes(8).toString('hex');
    const scheduledAt = process.hrtime.bigint();

    // Check for correlation attacks
    let correlationRisk = 0;
    if (this.config.correlationDetection) {
      correlationRisk = this.correlationDetector.record();
      if (correlationRisk > 0.7) {
        // High correlation risk — amplify jitter significantly
        this.adaptiveMultiplier = Math.min(5.0, this.adaptiveMultiplier * 1.5);
        this.emit('correlationDetected', {
          sessionId: this.sessionId,
          risk: correlationRisk,
          newMultiplier: this.adaptiveMultiplier
        });
      } else if (correlationRisk < 0.3 && this.adaptiveMultiplier > 1.0) {
        // Low risk — decay multiplier back toward 1
        this.adaptiveMultiplier = Math.max(1.0, this.adaptiveMultiplier * 0.95);
      }
    }

    const delayMs = this.sampleDelay();
    this.totalRequests++;

    await this.sleep(delayMs);

    const dispatchedAt = process.hrtime.bigint();
    const actualDelayMs = Number(dispatchedAt - scheduledAt) / 1_000_000;

    const event: JitterEvent = {
      requestId,
      scheduledAt,
      dispatchedAt,
      appliedDelayMs: actualDelayMs,
      distribution: this.config.distribution,
      correlationRiskScore: correlationRisk,
      wasAdaptive: correlationRisk > 0.7
    };

    this.emit('dispatched', event);
    return fn();
  }

  /**
   * Add delay to an outgoing message queue with correlation defeat.
   * Batches messages and dispatches them with randomized order.
   */
  async delayBatch<T>(items: T[], processFn: (item: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
    // Shuffle order within batch to defeat ordering attacks
    const shuffled = this.shuffleSecure([...items]);

    for (const item of shuffled) {
      await this.delay(() => processFn(item));
    }
  }

  /** Cryptographically secure Fisher-Yates shuffle */
  private shuffleSecure<T>(array: T[]): T[] {
    for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = CryptoRandom.uniformInt(0, i);
      [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
    }
    return array;
  }

  private sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }

  getStats(): TimingStats {
    const delays = this.delayHistory;
    if (delays.length === 0) {
      return {
        totalRequests: 0, averageDelayMs: 0, minObservedDelayMs: 0,
        maxObservedDelayMs: 0, stdDevMs: 0, correlationEventsDetected: 0,
        adaptiveAdjustments: 0, privacyBudgetUsed: 0,
        entropyScore: 0, distributionDrift: 0
      };
    }
    const avg = delays.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / delays.length;
    const variance = delays.reduce((sum, v) => sum + (v - avg) ** 2, 0) / delays.length;
    return {
      totalRequests: this.totalRequests,
      averageDelayMs: avg,
      minObservedDelayMs: Math.min(...delays),
      maxObservedDelayMs: Math.max(...delays),
      stdDevMs: Math.sqrt(variance),
      correlationEventsDetected: this.correlationDetector.getDetectionCount(),
      adaptiveAdjustments: Math.round((this.adaptiveMultiplier - 1) * 10),
      privacyBudgetUsed: this.privacyTracker.getTotalConsumed(),
      entropyScore: this.computeDelayEntropy(delays),
      distributionDrift: this.computeDistributionDrift(delays)
    };
  }

  private computeDelayEntropy(delays: number[]): number {
    const max = Math.max(...delays, 1);
    const bins = new Float64Array(16).fill(0);
    for (const d of delays) {
      bins[Math.min(15, Math.floor((d / max) * 16))]++;
    }
    const total = delays.length;
    let entropy = 0;
    for (const b of bins) {
      if (b > 0) { const p = b / total; entropy -= p * Math.log2(p); }
    }
    return entropy / Math.log2(16);
  }

  private computeDistributionDrift(delays: number[]): number {
    if (delays.length < 20) return 0;
    // Compare first half vs second half mean — drift indicates non-stationarity
    const half = Math.floor(delays.length / 2);
    const firstMean = delays.slice(0, half).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / half;
    const secondMean = delays.slice(half).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / (delays.length - half);
    return Math.abs(firstMean - secondMean) / (firstMean + 1);
  }

  resetAdaptiveMultiplier(): void {
    this.adaptiveMultiplier = 1.0;
    this.correlationDetector.reset();
  }

  getAdaptiveMultiplier(): number { return this.adaptiveMultiplier; }
  getPrivacyBudgetRemaining(): number { return this.privacyTracker.getRemainingBudget(); }
  getSessionId(): string { return this.sessionId; }
}

// ─── Request Queue with Jitter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * JitteredQueue: async request queue that dispatches with timing randomization.
 * Drop-in replacement for direct async dispatch in UBE pipeline.
 *
 * Features:
 *   - Per-request jitter using configured engine
 *   - Backpressure support
 *   - Request batching with random inter-batch delays
 *   - Priority queue with randomized priority inversion (defeats priority inference)
 *   - Request timeout with jittered retry
 */
export class JitteredQueue<TRequest = unknown, TResponse = unknown> extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly engine: JitterEngine;
  private readonly queue: Array<{
    request: TRequest;
    priority: number;
    resolve: (r: TResponse) => void;
    reject: (e: unknown) => void;
    timeoutMs: number;
    enqueuedAt: number;
  }> = [];
  private isProcessing: boolean = false;
  private readonly maxConcurrency: number;
  private activeCount: number = 0;
  private readonly processor: (req: TRequest) => Promise<TResponse>;

  constructor(
    processor: (req: TRequest) => Promise<TResponse>,
    engine: JitterEngine,
    maxConcurrency: number = 5
  ) {
    super();
    this.processor = processor;
    this.engine = engine;
    this.maxConcurrency = maxConcurrency;
  }

  /**
   * Enqueue a request. Returns promise that resolves when request is processed.
   * The actual dispatch time is jittered — caller cannot infer when processing occurred.
   */
  enqueue(request: TRequest, priority: number = 0, timeoutMs: number = 30000): Promise<TResponse> {
    return new Promise<TResponse>((resolve, reject) => {
      this.queue.push({ request, priority, resolve, reject, timeoutMs, enqueuedAt: Date.now() });
      // Sort by priority with small random noise to defeat priority inference
      this.queue.sort((a, b) => {
        const noise = CryptoRandom.uniform() * 0.2 - 0.1; // ±10% noise
        return (b.priority - a.priority) + noise;
      });
      this.scheduleProcessing();
    });
  }

  private scheduleProcessing(): void {
    if (this.isProcessing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    if (this.activeCount >= this.maxConcurrency) return;
    this.isProcessing = true;
    // Jitter the processing start
    const delay = this.engine.sampleDelay();
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.isProcessing = false;
      this.processNext();
    }, delay);
  }

  private async processNext(): Promise<void> {
    while (this.queue.length > 0 && this.activeCount < this.maxConcurrency) {
      const item = this.queue.shift()!;
      this.activeCount++;

      const timeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => {
        item.reject(new Error(`Request timed out after ${item.timeoutMs}ms`));
      }, item.timeoutMs);

      this.engine.delay(() => this.processor(item.request))
        .then(response => {
          clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
          item.resolve(response);
          this.emit('processed', { enqueuedAt: item.enqueuedAt, latencyMs: Date.now() - item.enqueuedAt });
        })
        .catch(err => {
          clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
          item.reject(err);
        })
        .finally(() => {
          this.activeCount--;
          this.scheduleProcessing();
        });
    }
  }

  getQueueDepth(): number { return this.queue.length; }
  getActiveCount(): number { return this.activeCount; }
  clear(): void { this.queue.length = 0; }
}

// ─── Timing Fingerprint Analyzer ─────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Analyzes timing fingerprints to detect if current jitter is sufficient
 * to prevent deanonymization. Provides actionable recommendations.
 */
export class TimingFingerprintAnalyzer {
  private readonly windowSize: number;
  private readonly history: Array<{ ts: number; delay: number }> = [];

  constructor(windowSize: number = 100) {
    this.windowSize = windowSize;
  }

  record(timestamp: number, delay: number): void {
    this.history.push({ ts: timestamp, delay });
    if (this.history.length > this.windowSize) this.history.shift();
  }

  /**
   * Analyze current timing pattern and return anonymity assessment.
   */
  analyze(): {
    isAnonymous: boolean;
    riskLevel: 'NONE' | 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL';
    findings: string[];
    recommendations: string[];
    anonymityScore: number;
  } {
    const findings: string[] = [];
    const recommendations: string[] = [];

    if (this.history.length < 10) {
      return {
        isAnonymous: true, riskLevel: 'NONE', findings: ['Insufficient data'],
        recommendations: [], anonymityScore: 1.0
      };
    }

    let riskScore = 0;
    const delays = this.history.map(h => h.delay);
    const mean = delays.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / delays.length;
    const variance = delays.reduce((sum, v) => sum + (v - mean) ** 2, 0) / delays.length;
    const cv = Math.sqrt(variance) / (mean + 1);

    // Low variance = regular timing = fingerprintable
    if (cv < 0.2) {
      riskScore += 0.4;
      findings.push(`Low timing variance (CV=${cv.toFixed(3)}) — traffic is regular and fingerprintable`);
      recommendations.push('Increase jitter range or switch to LAPLACE distribution');
    }

    // Burst detection
    const intervals = this.history.slice(1).map((h, i) => h.ts - this.history[i].ts);
    const avgInterval = intervals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / intervals.length;
    if (avgInterval < 10) {
      riskScore += 0.3;
      findings.push(`High request rate (avg ${avgInterval.toFixed(1)}ms interval) — burst pattern detectable`);
      recommendations.push('Enable burst padding or switch to BuFLO/TAMARAW');
    }

    // Periodicity
    if (this.detectPeriodicity(intervals)) {
      riskScore += 0.4;
      findings.push('Periodic timing pattern detected — correlatable with external observations');
      recommendations.push('Enable correlation detection and adaptive jitter');
    }

    const anonymityScore = Math.max(0, 1 - riskScore);
    let riskLevel: 'NONE' | 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL';
    if (riskScore < 0.1) riskLevel = 'NONE';
    else if (riskScore < 0.3) riskLevel = 'LOW';
    else if (riskScore < 0.5) riskLevel = 'MEDIUM';
    else if (riskScore < 0.7) riskLevel = 'HIGH';
    else riskLevel = 'CRITICAL';

    return {
      isAnonymous: riskScore < 0.3,
      riskLevel,
      findings,
      recommendations,
      anonymityScore
    };
  }

  private detectPeriodicity(intervals: number[]): boolean {
    if (intervals.length < 8) return false;
    const mean = intervals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / intervals.length;
    const variance = intervals.reduce((sum, v) => sum + (v - mean) ** 2, 0) / intervals.length;
    const cv = Math.sqrt(variance) / (mean + 1);
    return cv < 0.1; // Very low variation = periodic
  }

  clear(): void { this.history.length = 0; }
}

// ─── Global Jitter Manager ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * JitterManager: singleton orchestrator for all jitter operations in UBE.
 * Manages per-connection, per-session, and global jitter profiles.
 */
export class JitterManager extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly engines = new Map<string, JitterEngine>();
  private readonly analyzers = new Map<string, TimingFingerprintAnalyzer>();
  private readonly defaultConfig: Partial<JitterConfig>;

  constructor(defaultConfig?: Partial<JitterConfig>) {
    super();
    this.defaultConfig = defaultConfig ?? {
      distribution: 'LAPLACE',
      minDelayMs: 5,
      maxDelayMs: 200,
      laplaceLocation: 40,
      laplaceScale: 15,
      privacyEpsilon: 0.05,
      correlationDetection: true,
      correlationWindowMs: 3000,
      correlationThreshold: 15,
      clockNormalization: true,
      clockGridMs: 50
    };
  }

  /** Create a jitter engine for a connection or session */
  createEngine(id: string, config?: Partial<JitterConfig>): JitterEngine {
    const engine = new JitterEngine({ ...this.defaultConfig, ...config }, id);
    const analyzer = new TimingFingerprintAnalyzer(200);
    this.engines.set(id, engine);
    this.analyzers.set(id, analyzer);

    engine.on('dispatched', (event: JitterEvent) => {
      analyzer.record(Number(event.dispatchedAt / 1_000_000n), event.appliedDelayMs);
      this.emit('dispatch', { id, event });
    });

    engine.on('correlationDetected', (data: unknown) => {
      this.emit('correlationAlert', { id, ...data as object });
    });

    return engine;
  }

  getEngine(id: string): JitterEngine | undefined {
    return this.engines.get(id);
  }

  /** Analyze timing fingerprint for a specific engine */
  analyzeFingerprint(id: string) {
    return this.analyzers.get(id)?.analyze();
  }

  /** Apply jitter to a function call using a specific engine */
  async jitter<T>(engineId: string, fn: () => T | Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const engine = this.engines.get(engineId);
    if (!engine) throw new Error(`Jitter engine ${engineId} not found`);
    return engine.delay(fn);
  }

  /** Destroy all engines for an id */
  destroy(id: string): void {
    this.engines.get(id)?.removeAllListeners();
    this.engines.delete(id);
    this.analyzers.delete(id);
  }

  getStats(id: string): TimingStats | null {
    return this.engines.get(id)?.getStats() ?? null;
  }

  /** Globally reset all adaptive multipliers (e.g., after suspected attack) */
  resetAllAdaptive(): void {
    for (const engine of this.engines.values()) {
      engine.resetAdaptiveMultiplier();
    }
    this.emit('globalReset');
  }

  getEngineCount(): number { return this.engines.size; }
}

// ─── Exports ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export {
  JitterManager as default,
  JitterEngine,
  JitteredQueue,
  CorrelationAttackDetector,
  TimingFingerprintAnalyzer,
  PrivacyBudgetTracker,
  ClockNormalizer,
  CryptoRandom
};

/**
 * UBE Phase 2 — Metadata Sovereignty
 * packetNorm.ts — Packet Normalization Engine
 *
 * Forces all network packets to identical sizes, eliminating:
 *   - Packet-size fingerprinting attacks
 *   - Content-length inference from TLS record sizes
 *   - Protocol identification via characteristic packet sizes
 *   - Payload size correlation across connections
 *
 * Implements:
 *   - Fixed-size normalization with PKCS#7-style padding
 *   - Fragmentation for oversized payloads
 *   - Reassembly with sequence tracking and gap detection
 *   - MTU-aware segmentation (IPv4/IPv6/Ethernet)
 *   - Padding oracle resistance (randomized padding content)
 *   - Multi-level normalization (L3/L4/L7)
 *   - Covert channel elimination via strict size enforcement
 *
 * @module metadata-sovereignty/packetNorm
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { randomBytes, createHmac, createHash } from 'crypto';

// ─── Constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const MTU_ETHERNET = 1500;
export const MTU_JUMBO = 9000;
export const MTU_LOOPBACK = 65535;
export const IP_HEADER_SIZE = 20;
export const TCP_HEADER_SIZE = 20;
export const UDP_HEADER_SIZE = 8;
export const UBE_FRAME_HEADER_SIZE = 16; // seq(4) + len(2) + flags(2) + fragOffset(4) + checksum(4)
export const DEFAULT_CELL_SIZE = 1400;
export const MAX_FRAGMENTS = 256;
export const REASSEMBLY_TIMEOUT_MS = 30000;

// Supported normalized packet sizes (power-of-2 aligned for cache efficiency)
export const NORMALIZED_SIZES = [512, 1024, 1400, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384] as const;
export type NormalizedSize = typeof NORMALIZED_SIZES[number];

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type PaddingStrategy = 'RANDOM' | 'ZERO' | 'PATTERN' | 'PRNG_KEYED';
export type NormalizationMode = 'FIXED' | 'ADAPTIVE' | 'STEP' | 'RANDOM_FIXED';

  authKey?: Buffer;
  maxReassemblyBufferMB: number;
  reassemblyTimeoutMs: number;
  /** Eliminate covert channels by stripping all optional headers */
  covertChannelElimination: boolean;

}
