}

// ─── Padding Generator ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Generates cryptographically indistinguishable padding.
 * Critical: padding MUST be indistinguishable from real data at every bit.
 */
export class PaddingGenerator {
  private readonly strategy: PaddingStrategy;
  private readonly key: Buffer | null;
  private readonly streamState: Buffer;

  constructor(strategy: PaddingStrategy, key?: Buffer) {
    this.strategy = strategy;
    this.key = key ?? null;
    this.streamState = randomBytes(32);
  }

  generate(size: number): Buffer {
    if (size <= 0) return Buffer.alloc(0);
    switch (this.strategy) {
      case 'RANDOM':
        return randomBytes(size);
      case 'ZERO':
        return Buffer.alloc(size, 0);
      case 'PATTERN':
        return this.generatePattern(size);
      case 'PRNG_KEYED':
        return this.generateKeyedPRNG(size);
    }
  }

  private generatePattern(size: number): Buffer {
    // Alternating 0xAA/0x55 pattern — easy to strip on receive
    const buf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(size);
    for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) buf[i] = i % 2 === 0 ? 0xAA : 0x55;
    return buf;
  }

  private generateKeyedPRNG(size: number): Buffer {
    if (!this.key) return randomBytes(size);
    // Keyed PRNG using HMAC-SHA256 in counter mode
    const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
    let counter = 0;
    let generated = 0;
    while (generated < size) {
      const counterBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(4);
      counterBuf.writeUInt32BE(counter++, 0);
      const block = createHmac('sha256', this.key)
        .update(this.streamState)
        .update(counterBuf)
        .digest();
      chunks.push(block);
      generated += block.length;
    }
    return Buffer.concat(chunks).subarray(0, size);
  }

  /** Check if a buffer appears to be valid padding (for stripping on receive) */
  isPadding(buf: Buffer, strategy: PaddingStrategy): boolean {
    if (strategy === 'ZERO') return buf.every(b => b === 0);
    if (strategy === 'PATTERN') {
      return buf.every((b, i) => b === (i % 2 === 0 ? 0xAA : 0x55));
    }
    return false; // RANDOM/PRNG cannot be identified as padding without length field
  }
}

// ─── Frame Builder ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Builds and parses UBE normalized frames.
 * Frame format:
 *   [4 seq][2 payLen][2 flags][4 fragOffset][4 checksum][payload][padding][auth?]
 */
export class FrameBuilder {
  private sequenceCounter: number = 0;
  private readonly authKey: Buffer | null;
  private readonly paddingGen: PaddingGenerator;
  private readonly checksums: boolean;

  constructor(authKey?: Buffer, paddingGen?: PaddingGenerator, checksums: boolean = true) {
    this.authKey = authKey ?? null;
    this.paddingGen = paddingGen ?? new PaddingGenerator('RANDOM');
    this.checksums = checksums;
  }

  /** Encode flags byte */
  private encodeFlags(flags: FrameFlags): number {
    let f = 0;
    if (flags.isFragment) f |= 0x01;
    if (flags.isLastFragment) f |= 0x02;
    if (flags.isDummy) f |= 0x04;
    if (flags.hasAuthentication) f |= 0x08;
    f |= (flags.version & 0x07) << 5;
    return f;
  }

  /** Decode flags from byte */
  private decodeFlags(f: number): FrameFlags {
    return {
      isFragment: !!(f & 0x01),
      isLastFragment: !!(f & 0x02),
      isDummy: !!(f & 0x04),
      hasAuthentication: !!(f & 0x08),
      version: (f >> 5) & 0x07
    };
  }

  /** CRC32 checksum for fast frame integrity */
  private crc32(buf: Buffer): number {
    let crc = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
      crc ^= buf[i];
      for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
        crc = (crc >>> 1) ^ (crc & 1 ? 0xEDB88320 : 0);
      }
    }
    return (crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFF) >>> 0;
  }

  buildFrame(
    payload: Buffer,
    targetSize: number,
    flags: Partial<FrameFlags> = {}
  ): NormalizedFrame {
    const seq = ++this.sequenceCounter;
    const payLen = payload.length;
    const hasAuth = !!(this.authKey);
    const authSize = hasAuth ? 32 : 0; // HMAC-SHA256 = 32 bytes
    const paddingSize = Math.max(0, targetSize - UBE_FRAME_HEADER_SIZE - payLen - authSize);
    const padding = this.paddingGen.generate(paddingSize);

    const fullFlags: FrameFlags = {
      isFragment: false,
      isLastFragment: false,
      isDummy: payLen === 0,
      hasAuthentication: hasAuth,
      version: 1,
      ...flags
    };

    // Build header
    const header = Buffer.allocUnsafe(UBE_FRAME_HEADER_SIZE);
    header.writeUInt32BE(seq, 0);
    header.writeUInt16BE(payLen, 4);
    header.writeUInt16BE(this.encodeFlags(fullFlags), 6);
    header.writeUInt32BE(0, 8); // fragOffset (0 for non-fragments)
    // Checksum over header fields + payload (not padding or auth)
    const checksum = this.checksums
      ? this.crc32(Buffer.concat([header.subarray(0, 8), payload]))
      : 0;
    header.writeUInt32BE(checksum, 12);

    // Build wire bytes
    const parts = [header, payload, padding];
    let auth: Buffer | null = null;
    if (this.authKey) {
      auth = createHmac('sha256', this.authKey)
        .update(Buffer.concat(parts))
        .digest();
      parts.push(auth);
    }

    const wireBytes = Buffer.concat(parts);

    return {
      header: {
        sequenceNumber: seq,
        payloadLength: payLen,
        flags: fullFlags,
        fragmentOffset: 0,
        checksum
      },
      payload,
      padding,
      auth,
      totalSize: wireBytes.length,
      wireBytes
    };
  }

  buildFragmentFrames(payload: Buffer, targetSize: number, streamId: string): NormalizedFrame[] {
    const maxPayloadPerFrame = targetSize - UBE_FRAME_HEADER_SIZE - (this.authKey ? 32 : 0) - 4; // 4 for fragment metadata
    const frames: NormalizedFrame[] = [];
    let offset = 0;
    let fragIndex = 0;
    const totalFrags = Math.ceil(payload.length / maxPayloadPerFrame);

    while (offset < payload.length) {
      const chunk = payload.subarray(offset, offset + maxPayloadPerFrame);
      const isLast = offset + chunk.length >= payload.length;

      // Fragment metadata prepended to payload: [2 fragIndex][2 totalFrags]
      const fragMeta = Buffer.allocUnsafe(4);
      fragMeta.writeUInt16BE(fragIndex, 0);
      fragMeta.writeUInt16BE(totalFrags, 2);
      const fragPayload = Buffer.concat([fragMeta, chunk]);

      const frame = this.buildFrame(fragPayload, targetSize, {
        isFragment: true,
        isLastFragment: isLast
      });
      frames.push(frame);
      offset += chunk.length;
      fragIndex++;
    }

    return frames;
  }

  parseFrame(wireBytes: Buffer, authKey?: Buffer): {
    header: UBEFrameHeader;
    payload: Buffer;
    valid: boolean;
    authValid: boolean;
  } {
    if (wireBytes.length < UBE_FRAME_HEADER_SIZE) {
      return { header: null as any, payload: Buffer.alloc(0), valid: false, authValid: false };
    }

    const seq = wireBytes.readUInt32BE(0);
    const payLen = wireBytes.readUInt16BE(4);
    const flagByte = wireBytes.readUInt16BE(6);
    const fragOffset = wireBytes.readUInt32BE(8);
    const storedChecksum = wireBytes.readUInt32BE(12);
    const flags = this.decodeFlags(flagByte);

    const payload = wireBytes.subarray(UBE_FRAME_HEADER_SIZE, UBE_FRAME_HEADER_SIZE + payLen);

    // Verify checksum
    const headerForCheck = Buffer.concat([wireBytes.subarray(0, 8), payload]);
    const computedChecksum = this.checksums ? this.crc32(headerForCheck) : 0;
    const valid = !this.checksums || computedChecksum === storedChecksum;

    // Verify auth
    let authValid = true;
    if (flags.hasAuthentication && authKey) {
      const contentEnd = wireBytes.length - 32;
      const content = wireBytes.subarray(0, contentEnd);
      const storedAuth = wireBytes.subarray(contentEnd);
      const expectedAuth = createHmac('sha256', authKey).update(content).digest();
      authValid = expectedAuth.equals(storedAuth);
    }

    return {
      header: { sequenceNumber: seq, payloadLength: payLen, flags, fragmentOffset: fragOffset, checksum: storedChecksum },
      payload,
      valid,
      authValid
    };
  }

  buildDummyFrame(targetSize: number): NormalizedFrame {
    return this.buildFrame(Buffer.alloc(0), targetSize, { isDummy: true });
  }

  reset(): void { this.sequenceCounter = 0; }
}

// ─── Reassembly Buffer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Tracks and reassembles fragmented payloads.
 * Implements gap detection, timeout eviction, and reordering.
 */
export class ReassemblyBuffer extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly fragmentSets = new Map<string, FragmentSet>();
  private readonly maxBufferBytes: number;
  private currentBufferBytes: number = 0;
  private readonly timeoutMs: number;
  private cleanupHandle: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
  private timeouts: number = 0;

  constructor(maxBufferMB: number, timeoutMs: number) {
    super();
    this.maxBufferBytes = maxBufferMB * 1024 * 1024;
    this.timeoutMs = timeoutMs;
    this.cleanupHandle = setInterval(() => this.evictExpired(), 5000);
  }

  /** Accept a fragment and attempt reassembly */
  acceptFragment(
    streamId: string,
    fragIndex: number,
    totalFragments: number,
    data: Buffer,
    expectedSize: number
  ): Buffer | null {
    if (this.currentBufferBytes + data.length > this.maxBufferBytes) {
      this.emit('bufferFull', { streamId });
      return null;
    }

    let set = this.fragmentSets.get(streamId);
    if (!set) {
      set = {
        streamId,
        totalFragments,
        receivedFragments: new Map(),
        createdAt: Date.now(),
        expectedTotalSize: expectedSize,
        isComplete: false
      };
      this.fragmentSets.set(streamId, set);
    }

    if (!set.receivedFragments.has(fragIndex)) {
      set.receivedFragments.set(fragIndex, data);
      this.currentBufferBytes += data.length;
    }

    if (set.receivedFragments.size === set.totalFragments) {
      return this.reassemble(streamId, set);
    }
    return null;
  }

  private reassemble(streamId: string, set: FragmentSet): Buffer {
    const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < set.totalFragments; i++) {
      const chunk = set.receivedFragments.get(i);
      if (!chunk) {
        this.emit('reassemblyError', { streamId, missingFragment: i });
        return Buffer.alloc(0);
      }
      chunks.push(chunk);
      this.currentBufferBytes -= chunk.length;
    }
    this.fragmentSets.delete(streamId);
    set.isComplete = true;
    const result = Buffer.concat(chunks);
    this.emit('reassembled', { streamId, size: result.length });
    return result;
  }

  private evictExpired(): void {
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const [id, set] of this.fragmentSets.entries()) {
      if (now - set.createdAt > this.timeoutMs) {
        for (const chunk of set.receivedFragments.values()) {
          this.currentBufferBytes -= chunk.length;
        }
        this.fragmentSets.delete(id);
        this.timeouts++;
        this.emit('timeout', { streamId: id });
      }
    }
  }

  getPendingStreams(): number { return this.fragmentSets.size; }
  getBufferUtilization(): number { return this.currentBufferBytes / this.maxBufferBytes; }
  getTimeouts(): number { return this.timeouts; }
  destroy(): void { clearInterval(this.cleanupHandle); this.fragmentSets.clear(); }
}

// ─── Covert Channel Eliminator ────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Eliminates covert channels in packet metadata.
 * Strips all optional/variable fields that could carry hidden information.
 *
 * Covert channels eliminated:
 *   - IP TTL covert channel (normalize TTL to fixed value)
 *   - IP ID field covert channel (zero out)
 *   - TCP timestamp option covert channel
 *   - TCP urgent pointer covert channel
 *   - IP options field
 *   - IPv6 flow label covert channel
 *   - DSCP/ECN bits covert channel
 */
export class CovertChannelEliminator {
  private readonly fixedTTL = 64;

  /** Normalize an IPv4 header buffer to eliminate covert channels */
  normalizeIPv4Header(header: Buffer): Buffer {
    if (header.length < 20) return header;
    const normalized = Buffer.from(header);
    // Zero TTL variation — set to fixed value
    normalized[8] = this.fixedTTL;
    // Zero IP ID field (bytes 4-5)
    normalized.writeUInt16BE(0, 4);
    // Zero fragmentation flags and offset (bytes 6-7) except DF bit
    const flags = normalized.readUInt16BE(6);
    const dfBit = flags & 0x4000;
    normalized.writeUInt16BE(dfBit, 6);
    // Zero DSCP/ECN (byte 1, bits 0-5)
    normalized[1] = normalized[1] & 0xC0; // Preserve version/IHL bits
    // Strip IP options by truncating to 20 bytes
    return normalized.subarray(0, 20);
  }

  /** Normalize TCP header to eliminate covert channels */
  normalizeTCPHeader(header: Buffer): Buffer {
    if (header.length < 20) return header;
    const normalized = Buffer.from(header);
    // Zero urgent pointer (bytes 18-19)
    normalized.writeUInt16BE(0, 18);
    // Remove TCP timestamp option (if present) by clearing options field
    const dataOffset = (normalized[12] >> 4) * 4;
    if (dataOffset > 20 && header.length >= dataOffset) {
      // Zero TCP options area
      normalized.fill(0, 20, dataOffset);
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  /** Normalize IPv6 header to eliminate covert channels */
  normalizeIPv6Header(header: Buffer): Buffer {
    if (header.length < 40) return header;
    const normalized = Buffer.from(header);
    // Zero flow label (bytes 1-3, bits 4-27)
    const firstWord = normalized.readUInt32BE(0);
    normalized.writeUInt32BE(firstWord & 0xFFF00000, 0); // Zero flow label
    // Zero traffic class (DSCP/ECN in byte 0 bits 4-11)
    normalized[0] = normalized[0] & 0xF0; // Keep version
    normalized[1] = 0;
    // Fix hop limit
    normalized[7] = this.fixedTTL;
    return normalized;
  }

  /** Strip all identifying metadata from a UBE application frame */
  sanitizeApplicationFrame(frame: Buffer): Buffer {
    // Application-level: no timestamps, no connection IDs, no sequence leakage
    // The UBEFrameHeader already normalizes sequence numbers within a session
    return frame;
  }
}

// ─── Packet Normalizer — Core Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * PacketNormalizer: the primary interface for all packet normalization.
 * Normalizes outgoing data and strips padding from incoming data.
 */
export class PacketNormalizer extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly config: Required<NormConfig>;
  private readonly paddingGen: PaddingGenerator;
  private readonly frameBuilder: FrameBuilder;
  private readonly reassemblyBuffer: ReassemblyBuffer;
  private readonly covertEliminator: CovertChannelEliminator;
  private readonly stats: NormStats;
  private currentTargetSize: NormalizedSize;

  constructor(config: Partial<NormConfig> = {}) {
    super();
    this.config = {
      targetSize: DEFAULT_CELL_SIZE as NormalizedSize,
      mode: 'FIXED',
      paddingStrategy: 'RANDOM',
      fragmentationScheme: 'SEQUENTIAL',
      enableChecksums: true,
      enableAuthentication: false,
      maxReassemblyBufferMB: 64,
      reassemblyTimeoutMs: REASSEMBLY_TIMEOUT_MS,
      covertChannelElimination: true,
      randomSizeSet: NORMALIZED_SIZES,
      paddingKey: undefined,
      authKey: undefined,
      ...config
    };
    this.currentTargetSize = this.config.targetSize;
    this.paddingGen = new PaddingGenerator(this.config.paddingStrategy, this.config.paddingKey);
    this.frameBuilder = new FrameBuilder(
      this.config.enableAuthentication ? this.config.authKey : undefined,
      this.paddingGen,
      this.config.enableChecksums
    );
    this.reassemblyBuffer = new ReassemblyBuffer(
      this.config.maxReassemblyBufferMB,
      this.config.reassemblyTimeoutMs
    );
    this.covertEliminator = new CovertChannelEliminator();
    this.stats = this.initStats();

    this.reassemblyBuffer.on('reassembled', (data) => this.emit('reassembled', data));
    this.reassemblyBuffer.on('timeout', (data) => {
      this.stats.reassemblyTimeouts++;
      this.emit('timeout', data);
    });
  }

  private initStats(): NormStats {
    return {
      framesNormalized: 0, bytesIn: 0, bytesOut: 0, paddingBytesAdded: 0,
      fragmentsCreated: 0, fragmentsReassembled: 0, reassemblyTimeouts: 0,
      checksumErrors: 0, authFailures: 0, expansionRatio: 0, averageFrameSize: 0
    };
  }

  /**
   * Normalize outgoing data into fixed-size frames.
   * Large payloads are fragmented. Small payloads are padded.
   * Returns array of wire-ready normalized frames.
   */
  normalize(data: Buffer): Buffer[] {
    this.stats.bytesIn += data.length;
    const targetSize = this.selectTargetSize();

    // Covert channel elimination on application data
    let processedData = data;
    if (this.config.covertChannelElimination) {
      processedData = this.covertEliminator.sanitizeApplicationFrame(data);
    }

    const maxPayload = targetSize - UBE_FRAME_HEADER_SIZE - (this.config.enableAuthentication ? 32 : 0);
    let frames: NormalizedFrame[];

    if (processedData.length <= maxPayload) {
      // Single frame with padding
      frames = [this.frameBuilder.buildFrame(processedData, targetSize)];
    } else {
      // Fragment into multiple frames
      const streamId = randomBytes(8).toString('hex');
      frames = this.frameBuilder.buildFragmentFrames(processedData, targetSize, streamId);
      this.stats.fragmentsCreated += frames.length;
    }

    const wireBuffers: Buffer[] = [];
    for (const frame of frames) {
      wireBuffers.push(frame.wireBytes);
      this.stats.bytesOut += frame.wireBytes.length;
      this.stats.paddingBytesAdded += frame.padding.length;
      this.stats.framesNormalized++;
    }

    this.updateStats();
    return wireBuffers;
  }

  /**
   * Denormalize incoming frames — strip padding, reassemble fragments.
   * Returns original payload or null if fragment (waiting for more).
   */
  denormalize(wireBytes: Buffer): Buffer | null {
    const { header, payload, valid, authValid } = this.frameBuilder.parseFrame(
      wireBytes,
      this.config.authKey
    );

    if (!valid) {
      this.stats.checksumErrors++;
      this.emit('checksumError', { size: wireBytes.length });
      return null;
    }

    if (!authValid) {
      this.stats.authFailures++;
      this.emit('authFailure', { size: wireBytes.length });
      return null;
    }

    // Dummy frame — discard silently
    if (header.flags.isDummy || payload.length === 0) return null;

    // Non-fragmented frame
    if (!header.flags.isFragment) return payload;

    // Fragment — extract metadata and buffer
    if (payload.length < 4) return null;
    const fragIndex = payload.readUInt16BE(0);
    const totalFragments = payload.readUInt16BE(2);
    const fragData = payload.subarray(4);
    const streamId = `${header.sequenceNumber >> 8}`; // Approximation

    const result = this.reassemblyBuffer.acceptFragment(
      streamId, fragIndex, totalFragments, fragData, 0
    );

    if (result && result.length > 0) {
      this.stats.fragmentsReassembled += totalFragments;
      return result;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Select target packet size based on normalization mode.
   */
  private selectTargetSize(): NormalizedSize {
    switch (this.config.mode) {
      case 'FIXED':
        return this.config.targetSize;

      case 'RANDOM_FIXED': {
        const sizes = this.config.randomSizeSet!;
        const idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * sizes.length);
        return sizes[idx];
      }

      case 'ADAPTIVE':
        // Increase size under load, decrease when idle
        return this.currentTargetSize;

      case 'STEP': {
        // Step through sizes in round-robin
        const sizes = NORMALIZED_SIZES;
        const currentIdx = sizes.indexOf(this.currentTargetSize as any);
        const nextIdx = (currentIdx + 1) % sizes.length;
        this.currentTargetSize = sizes[nextIdx] as NormalizedSize;
        return this.currentTargetSize;
      }

      default:
        return this.config.targetSize;
    }
  }

  /** Update target size for adaptive mode based on current load */
  adaptTargetSize(queueDepth: number): void {
    if (this.config.mode !== 'ADAPTIVE') return;
    if (queueDepth > 100) {
      const idx = Math.min(NORMALIZED_SIZES.length - 1, NORMALIZED_SIZES.indexOf(this.currentTargetSize as any) + 1);
      this.currentTargetSize = NORMALIZED_SIZES[idx] as NormalizedSize;
    } else if (queueDepth < 10 && this.currentTargetSize > this.config.targetSize) {
      const idx = Math.max(0, NORMALIZED_SIZES.indexOf(this.currentTargetSize as any) - 1);
      this.currentTargetSize = NORMALIZED_SIZES[idx] as NormalizedSize;
    }
  }

  private updateStats(): void {
    if (this.stats.bytesIn > 0) {
      this.stats.expansionRatio = this.stats.bytesOut / this.stats.bytesIn;
    }
    if (this.stats.framesNormalized > 0) {
      this.stats.averageFrameSize = this.stats.bytesOut / this.stats.framesNormalized;
    }
  }

  getCurrentTargetSize(): NormalizedSize { return this.currentTargetSize; }
  getStats(): Readonly<NormStats> { return { ...this.stats }; }
  getReassemblyBufferUtilization(): number { return this.reassemblyBuffer.getBufferUtilization(); }
  destroy(): void { this.reassemblyBuffer.destroy(); }
}

// ─── Multi-Level Normalizer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Applies normalization at multiple protocol layers simultaneously.
 * L7 (application) → L4 (transport) → L3 (network) normalization cascade.
 */
export class MultiLevelNormalizer extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly l7: PacketNormalizer;
  private readonly covertEliminator: CovertChannelEliminator;

  constructor(l7Config?: Partial<NormConfig>) {
    super();
    this.l7 = new PacketNormalizer(l7Config);
    this.covertEliminator = new CovertChannelEliminator();
    this.l7.on('reassembled', (d) => this.emit('reassembled', d));
  }

  /** Full pipeline normalization */
  processOutgoing(applicationData: Buffer): Buffer[] {
    return this.l7.normalize(applicationData);
  }

  /** Full pipeline denormalization */
  processIncoming(wireBytes: Buffer): Buffer | null {
    return this.l7.denormalize(wireBytes);
  }

  /** Normalize a raw IPv4 packet (for low-level use) */
  normalizeIPv4Packet(rawPacket: Buffer): Buffer {
    if (rawPacket.length < 20) return rawPacket;
    const ihl = (rawPacket[0] & 0x0F) * 4;
    const normalizedHeader = this.covertEliminator.normalizeIPv4Header(rawPacket.subarray(0, ihl));
    const protocolOffset = ihl;
    const protocol = rawPacket[9];
    let normalizedTransport = rawPacket.subarray(protocolOffset);
    if (protocol === 6 && normalizedTransport.length >= 20) { // TCP
      normalizedTransport = this.covertEliminator.normalizeTCPHeader(normalizedTransport);
    }
    return Buffer.concat([normalizedHeader, normalizedTransport]);
  }

  getL7Stats(): Readonly<NormStats> { return this.l7.getStats(); }
  destroy(): void { this.l7.destroy(); }
}

// ─── Stream-based Normalizer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

import { Transform, TransformCallback } from 'stream';

/**
 * Drop-in Transform stream that normalizes all passing data.
 */
export class NormalizingStream extends Transform {
  private readonly normalizer: PacketNormalizer;
  private readonly direction: 'ENCODE' | 'DECODE';
  private receiveBuffer: Buffer = Buffer.alloc(0);
  private readonly frameSize: number;

  constructor(normalizer: PacketNormalizer, direction: 'ENCODE' | 'DECODE') {
    super();
    this.normalizer = normalizer;
    this.direction = direction;
    this.frameSize = normalizer.getCurrentTargetSize();
  }

  _transform(chunk: Buffer, _enc: BufferEncoding, callback: TransformCallback): void {
    if (this.direction === 'ENCODE') {
      const frames = this.normalizer.normalize(chunk);
      for (const f of frames) this.push(f);
    } else {
      // Accumulate until we have a full frame
      this.receiveBuffer = Buffer.concat([this.receiveBuffer, chunk]);
      while (this.receiveBuffer.length >= this.frameSize) {
        const frame = this.receiveBuffer.subarray(0, this.frameSize);
        this.receiveBuffer = this.receiveBuffer.subarray(this.frameSize);
        const payload = this.normalizer.denormalize(frame);
        if (payload) this.push(payload);
      }
    }
    callback();
  }

  _flush(callback: TransformCallback): void {
    callback();
  }
}

// ─── Exports ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export {
  PacketNormalizer as default,
  MultiLevelNormalizer,
  NormalizingStream,
  FrameBuilder,
  PaddingGenerator,
  ReassemblyBuffer,
  CovertChannelEliminator,
  NORMALIZED_SIZES
};

--- FILE: packages/sdk/src/phase2/mixnet.ts ---
/**
 * UBE Phase 2 — Metadata Sovereignty
 * mixnet.ts — Mix Network Engine
 *
 * Implements a full Chaumian mix network that collects, batches, reorders,
 * and forwards messages — destroying any link between sender and recipient
 * at the network observation level.
 *
 * Mixing strategies implemented:
 *   1. Pool Mix       — Chaum 1981: collect n messages, send random subset, hold rest
 *   2. Threshold Mix  — Send when pool reaches threshold size (deterministic flush)
 *   3. Timed Mix      — Flush pool every T milliseconds regardless of size
 *   4. Continuous Mix — Cottrell 1994: probabilistic forwarding with cover traffic
 *   5. Stop-and-Go Mix— Kesdogan 1998: synchronized batch processing
 *   6. Binomial Mix   — Send each message with probability p (statistical mixing)
 *
 * Sphinx packet format for layered encryption across mix nodes.
 * Loop cover traffic to prevent intersection attacks.
 * Dummy message injection for pool size normalization.
 *
 * @module metadata-sovereignty/mixnet
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { randomBytes, createHmac, createHash, createCipheriv, createDecipheriv } from 'crypto';

// ─── Constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const MIX_HEADER_SIZE = 32;
export const NODE_ID_SIZE = 32;
export const MIX_KEY_SIZE = 32;
export const SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE = 192;
export const SPHINX_BODY_SIZE = 1024;
export const MAX_MIX_HOPS = 8;
export const MIN_MIX_HOPS = 3;
export const DEFAULT_POOL_SIZE = 10;
export const DEFAULT_THRESHOLD = 5;
export const DEFAULT_TIMED_INTERVAL_MS = 2000;
export const LOOP_COVER_PROBABILITY = 0.1;
export const DUMMY_RATIO = 0.3;

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type MixStrategy = 'POOL' | 'THRESHOLD' | 'TIMED' | 'CONTINUOUS' | 'STOP_AND_GO' | 'BINOMIAL';

export interface MixNodeInfo {
  readonly nodeId: string;
  readonly publicKey: Buffer;
  readonly address: string;
  readonly port: number;
  readonly tier: number; // Position in mix cascade
  isActive: boolean;
  messageCount: number;
  lastSeen: number;
}

export interface SphinxPacket {
  readonly version: number;
  readonly header: Buffer; // Encrypted routing header
  readonly body: Buffer;   // Encrypted payload (fixed size)
  readonly mac: Buffer;    // Message authentication
  readonly totalSize: number;
}

export interface MixMessage {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly packet: SphinxPacket;
  readonly receivedAt: number;
  readonly hopCount: number;
  readonly isLoop: boolean;
  readonly isDummy: boolean;
  routingInfo?: DecryptedRoutingInfo;
}

export interface DecryptedRoutingInfo {
  readonly nextHopId: string;
  readonly nextHopAddress: string;
  readonly delay: number;
  readonly isExit: boolean;
  readonly recipientId?: string;
}

export interface MixConfig {
  strategy: MixStrategy;
  poolSize: number;
  threshold: number;
  timedIntervalMs: number;
  continuousForwardProbability: number;
  binomialProbability: number;
  stopAndGoWindowMs: number;
  minHops: number;
  maxHops: number;
  loopCoverProbability: number;
  dummyRatio: number;
  nodeId: string;
  privateKey: Buffer;
  enableSphinx: boolean;
  maxPoolSizeBytes: number;
}

export interface MixPoolStats {
  strategy: MixStrategy;
  currentPoolSize: number;
  totalMessagesReceived: number;
  totalMessagesForwarded: number;
  totalDummiesInjected: number;
  totalLoopMessages: number;
  averageMixDelay: number;
  poolFlushes: number;
  anonymitySetSize: number;
  entropyBits: number;
}

// ─── PRNG Helpers (crypto-grade) ──────────────────────────────────────────────

function cryptoShuffle<T>(array: T[]): T[] {
  for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = randomBytes(4).readUInt32BE(0) % (i + 1);
    [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
  }
  return array;
}

function cryptoUniform(): number {
  return randomBytes(4).readUInt32BE(0) / 0x100000000;
}

function cryptoChoice<T>(array: T[]): T {
  const idx = randomBytes(4).readUInt32BE(0) % array.length;
  return array[idx];
}

// ─── Sphinx Crypto Layer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Simplified Sphinx packet construction and processing.
 * Sphinx: A Compact and Provably Secure Mix Format (Danezis & Goldberg 2009)
 *
 * Properties:
 *   - Unlinkability: mix node cannot link incoming to outgoing messages
 *   - Bitwise unlinkability: packets change completely at each hop
 *   - Security against active attacks
 *   - Replay detection via seen-MACs tracking
 */
export class SphinxCrypto {
  private readonly seenMACs = new Set<string>();
  private readonly privateKey: Buffer;
  private readonly nodeId: string;

  constructor(privateKey: Buffer, nodeId: string) {
    this.privateKey = privateKey;
    this.nodeId = nodeId;
  }

  /**
   * Create a Sphinx packet for a path through mix nodes.
   * path: ordered array of [nodeId, publicKey] pairs
   * payload: fixed-size message body (padded to SPHINX_BODY_SIZE)
   */
  createPacket(path: Array<{ nodeId: string; publicKey: Buffer }>, payload: Buffer): SphinxPacket {
    if (path.length < MIN_MIX_HOPS) {
      throw new Error(`Sphinx requires at least ${MIN_MIX_HOPS} hops, got ${path.length}`);
    }
    if (path.length > MAX_MIX_HOPS) {
      throw new Error(`Sphinx supports at most ${MAX_MIX_HOPS} hops`);
    }

    // Pad or truncate payload to SPHINX_BODY_SIZE
    const body = Buffer.alloc(SPHINX_BODY_SIZE);
    const payloadBytes = Math.min(payload.length, SPHINX_BODY_SIZE - 4);
    payload.copy(body, 4, 0, payloadBytes);
    body.writeUInt32BE(payloadBytes, 0); // Length prefix

    // Generate ephemeral key for each hop using ECDH (simulated with HMAC-based KDF)
    // In production: use X25519 ECDH
    const ephemeralSecrets = path.map((node, i) => {
      const ikm = Buffer.concat([randomBytes(32), node.publicKey, Buffer.from([i])]);
      return createHmac('sha256', this.privateKey).update(ikm).digest();
    });

    // Build layered routing header (innermost first, then wrap outward)
    let header = Buffer.alloc(SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
    let encryptedBody = body;

    for (let i = path.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const node = path[i];
      const secret = ephemeralSecrets[i];
      const isExit = i === path.length - 1;

      // Routing block for this hop
      const routingBlock = Buffer.alloc(64);
      Buffer.from(node.nodeId, 'hex').copy(routingBlock, 0, 0, Math.min(32, 32));
      routingBlock[32] = isExit ? 0x01 : 0x00; // Exit flag
      // Next hop info (zeroed at exit)
      if (!isExit && i < path.length - 1) {
        Buffer.from(path[i + 1].nodeId, 'hex').copy(routingBlock, 33, 0, Math.min(32, 32));
      }

      // Encrypt routing block with node's shared secret
      const cipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-ctr', secret, Buffer.alloc(16));
      const encRoutingBlock = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(routingBlock), cipher.final()]);

      // Wrap header with this hop's layer
      const newHeader = Buffer.alloc(SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
      encRoutingBlock.copy(newHeader, 0, 0, Math.min(64, SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE));
      header.copy(newHeader, 64, 0, SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE - 64);
      header = newHeader;

      // Encrypt body layer (onion-style, outermost first)
      const bodyCipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-ctr', secret.subarray(0, 32), Buffer.alloc(16));
      encryptedBody = Buffer.concat([bodyCipher.update(encryptedBody), bodyCipher.final()]);
    }

    // Compute outer MAC
    const macKey = createHmac('sha256', ephemeralSecrets[0]).update('mac').digest();
    const mac = createHmac('sha256', macKey)
      .update(header)
      .update(encryptedBody)
      .digest();

    const totalSize = 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE + 32; // version + header + body + mac
    return { version: 1, header, body: encryptedBody, mac, totalSize };
  }

  /**
   * Process an incoming Sphinx packet at this mix node.
   * Peels one layer of encryption, returns next-hop info and transformed packet.
   */
  processPacket(packet: SphinxPacket): {
    routing: DecryptedRoutingInfo;
    nextPacket: SphinxPacket;
    isValid: boolean;
    isReplay: boolean;
  } {
    const macKey = createHmac('sha256', this.privateKey).update('mac').digest();
    const expectedMac = createHmac('sha256', macKey)
      .update(packet.header)
      .update(packet.body)
      .digest();

    const isValid = expectedMac.equals(packet.mac);
    const macHex = packet.mac.toString('hex');
    const isReplay = this.seenMACs.has(macHex);

    if (!isValid || isReplay) {
      return {
        routing: { nextHopId: '', nextHopAddress: '', delay: 0, isExit: false },
        nextPacket: packet,
        isValid,
        isReplay
      };
    }

    // Record MAC to prevent replay
    this.seenMACs.add(macHex);
    if (this.seenMACs.size > 100000) {
      // Trim oldest entries (approximation)
      const entries = Array.from(this.seenMACs);
      entries.slice(0, 10000).forEach(e => this.seenMACs.delete(e));
    }

    // Derive shared secret for this hop
    const secret = createHmac('sha256', this.privateKey).update(packet.header.subarray(0, 32)).digest();

    // Decrypt routing block
    const decipher = createDecipheriv('aes-256-ctr', secret, Buffer.alloc(16));
    const routingBlock = Buffer.concat([decipher.update(packet.header.subarray(0, 64)), decipher.final()]);

    const isExit = routingBlock[32] === 0x01;
    const nextHopId = routingBlock.subarray(33, 65).toString('hex');

    // Shift header left (remove processed layer)
    const newHeader = Buffer.alloc(SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
    packet.header.copy(newHeader, 0, 64, SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
    randomBytes(64).copy(newHeader, SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE - 64); // Pad with random

    // Decrypt body layer
    const bodyDecipher = createDecipheriv('aes-256-ctr', secret.subarray(0, 32), Buffer.alloc(16));
    const decryptedBody = Buffer.concat([bodyDecipher.update(packet.body), bodyDecipher.final()]);

    // Recompute MAC for next hop
    const newMacKey = createHmac('sha256', secret).update('mac').digest();
    const newMac = createHmac('sha256', newMacKey).update(newHeader).update(decryptedBody).digest();

    const nextPacket: SphinxPacket = {
      version: packet.version,
      header: newHeader,
      body: isExit ? decryptedBody : decryptedBody,
      mac: newMac,
      totalSize: packet.totalSize
    };

    const routing: DecryptedRoutingInfo = {
      nextHopId: isExit ? '' : nextHopId,
      nextHopAddress: '',
      delay: Math.floor(cryptoUniform() * 500), // Random delay 0-500ms
      isExit
    };

    return { routing, nextPacket, isValid: true, isReplay: false };
  }

  serialize(packet: SphinxPacket): Buffer {
    const buf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE + 32);
    buf[0] = packet.version;
    packet.header.copy(buf, 1);
    packet.body.copy(buf, 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
    packet.mac.copy(buf, 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE);
    return buf;
  }

  deserialize(buf: Buffer): SphinxPacket {
    return {
      version: buf[0],
      header: buf.subarray(1, 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE),
      body: buf.subarray(1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE, 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE),
      mac: buf.subarray(1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE),
      totalSize: buf.length
    };
  }
}

// ─── Mix Pool ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * MixPool: holds messages before forwarding.
 * Implements anonymity set management and pool normalization.
 */
export class MixPool extends EventEmitter {
  private pool: MixMessage[] = [];
  private readonly maxSize: number;
  private readonly maxBytes: number;
  private currentBytes: number = 0;
  private flushedCount: number = 0;

  constructor(maxSize: number, maxBytes: number) {
    super();
    this.maxSize = maxSize;
    this.maxBytes = maxBytes;
  }

  add(message: MixMessage): boolean {
    const msgSize = message.packet.totalSize;
    if (this.currentBytes + msgSize > this.maxBytes) {
      this.emit('poolFull', { poolSize: this.pool.length });
      return false;
    }
    this.pool.push(message);
    this.currentBytes += msgSize;
    this.emit('added', { id: message.id, poolSize: this.pool.length });
    return true;
  }

  /** Pool Mix: select random subset to forward, retain rest */
  flushPool(retainFraction: number = 0.5): MixMessage[] {
    if (this.pool.length === 0) return [];
    cryptoShuffle(this.pool);
    const sendCount = Math.max(1, Math.floor(this.pool.length * (1 - retainFraction)));
    const toSend = this.pool.splice(0, sendCount);
    for (const m of toSend) this.currentBytes -= m.packet.totalSize;
    this.flushedCount += toSend.length;
    this.emit('flushed', { count: toSend.length, remaining: this.pool.length });
    return cryptoShuffle(toSend);
  }

  /** Threshold Mix: flush all when threshold reached */
  flushThreshold(threshold: number): MixMessage[] | null {
    if (this.pool.length < threshold) return null;
    return this.flushAll();
  }

  /** Flush all messages in random order */
  flushAll(): MixMessage[] {
    const all = cryptoShuffle([...this.pool]);
    this.pool = [];
    this.currentBytes = 0;
    this.flushedCount += all.length;
    this.emit('flushed', { count: all.length, remaining: 0 });
    return all;
  }

  /** Continuous Mix: probabilistically forward each message */
  sampleContinuous(probability: number): MixMessage[] {
    const toSend: MixMessage[] = [];
    const toKeep: MixMessage[] = [];
    for (const msg of cryptoShuffle([...this.pool])) {
      if (cryptoUniform() < probability) {
        toSend.push(msg);
        this.currentBytes -= msg.packet.totalSize;
      } else {
        toKeep.push(msg);
      }
    }
    this.pool = toKeep;
    this.flushedCount += toSend.length;
    return toSend;
  }

  /** Binomial Mix: each message forwarded independently with probability p */
  sampleBinomial(p: number): MixMessage[] {
    return this.sampleContinuous(p);
  }

  /** Normalize pool size with dummy messages */
  padToSize(targetSize: number, createDummy: () => MixMessage): void {
    while (this.pool.length < targetSize) {
      const dummy = createDummy();
      this.pool.push(dummy);
      this.currentBytes += dummy.packet.totalSize;
    }
  }

  size(): number { return this.pool.length; }
  bytes(): number { return this.currentBytes; }
  isFull(): boolean { return this.pool.length >= this.maxSize || this.currentBytes >= this.maxBytes; }
  getFlushedCount(): number { return this.flushedCount; }
  computeAnonymitySet(): number { return this.pool.length; }

  /** Compute entropy of the pool in bits */
  computeEntropy(): number {
    // Shannon entropy based on message arrival times
    if (this.pool.length === 0) return 0;
    return Math.log2(this.pool.length);
  }
}

// ─── Loop Cover Traffic Generator ─────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Generates loop cover traffic — messages that travel the full mix circuit
 * and return to the sender. Prevents intersection attacks by ensuring
 * senders cannot be identified by absence from traffic.
 *
 * From: Loopix (Piotrowska et al. 2017)
 */
export class LoopCoverGenerator {
  private readonly nodeId: string;
  private readonly mixPath: MixNodeInfo[];
  private readonly sphinx: SphinxCrypto;
  private loopsSent: number = 0;
  private loopsReceived: number = 0;
  private readonly sentLoopIds = new Set<string>();

  constructor(nodeId: string, mixPath: MixNodeInfo[], sphinx: SphinxCrypto) {
    this.nodeId = nodeId;
    this.mixPath = mixPath;
    this.sphinx = sphinx;
  }

  generateLoop(): MixMessage {
    const loopId = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    this.sentLoopIds.add(loopId);
    this.loopsSent++;

    // Create a loop payload that will route back to this node
    const loopPayload = Buffer.allocUnsafe(64);
    Buffer.from(loopId, 'hex').copy(loopPayload, 0);
    Buffer.from(this.nodeId, 'hex').copy(loopPayload, 32, 0, Math.min(32, 32));

    const activePath = this.mixPath.filter(n => n.isActive).slice(0, MIN_MIX_HOPS);
    if (activePath.length < 1) {
      // Fallback dummy packet
      return this.createDummyMessage();
    }

    const path = activePath.map(n => ({ nodeId: n.nodeId, publicKey: n.publicKey }));
    const packet = this.sphinx.createPacket(path, loopPayload);

    return {
      id: loopId,
      packet,
      receivedAt: Date.now(),
      hopCount: path.length,
      isLoop: true,
      isDummy: false
    };
  }

  isLoopReturn(messageId: string): boolean {
    if (this.sentLoopIds.has(messageId)) {
      this.sentLoopIds.delete(messageId);
      this.loopsReceived++;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  private createDummyMessage(): MixMessage {
    const dummyPayload = randomBytes(SPHINX_BODY_SIZE);
    const dummyHeader = randomBytes(SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
    const dummyMac = randomBytes(32);
    return {
      id: randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
      packet: { version: 1, header: dummyHeader, body: dummyPayload, mac: dummyMac, totalSize: SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE + 32 + 1 },
      receivedAt: Date.now(),
      hopCount: 0,
      isLoop: false,
      isDummy: true
    };
  }

  getLoopDeliveryRate(): number {
    if (this.loopsSent === 0) return 0;
    return this.loopsReceived / this.loopsSent;
  }

  getStats() {
    return { loopsSent: this.loopsSent, loopsReceived: this.loopsReceived, pendingLoops: this.sentLoopIds.size };
  }
}

// ─── Mix Node Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * MixNodeEngine: the primary mix network operator.
 * Can operate as a sender, relay node, or exit node in the mix cascade.
 */
export class MixNodeEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly config: Required<MixConfig>;
  private readonly pool: MixPool;
  private readonly sphinx: SphinxCrypto;
  private readonly knownNodes = new Map<string, MixNodeInfo>();
  private loopGenerator: LoopCoverGenerator | null = null;
  private timedFlushHandle: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private loopHandle: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private isRunning: boolean = false;
  private readonly stats: MixPoolStats;
  private readonly mixDelays: number[] = [];

  constructor(config: Partial<MixConfig>) {
    super();
    this.config = {
      strategy: 'POOL',
      poolSize: DEFAULT_POOL_SIZE,
      threshold: DEFAULT_THRESHOLD,
      timedIntervalMs: DEFAULT_TIMED_INTERVAL_MS,
      continuousForwardProbability: 0.3,
      binomialProbability: 0.5,
      stopAndGoWindowMs: 1000,
      minHops: MIN_MIX_HOPS,
      maxHops: MAX_MIX_HOPS,
      loopCoverProbability: LOOP_COVER_PROBABILITY,
      dummyRatio: DUMMY_RATIO,
      nodeId: randomBytes(32).toString('hex'),
      privateKey: randomBytes(32),
      enableSphinx: true,
      maxPoolSizeBytes: 10 * 1024 * 1024,
      ...config
    };
    this.pool = new MixPool(this.config.poolSize * 3, this.config.maxPoolSizeBytes);
    this.sphinx = new SphinxCrypto(this.config.privateKey, this.config.nodeId);
    this.stats = this.initStats();

    this.pool.on('flushed', ({ count }) => {
      this.stats.poolFlushes++;
      this.emit('poolFlushed', { count, nodeId: this.config.nodeId });
    });
  }

  private initStats(): MixPoolStats {
    return {
      strategy: this.config.strategy,
      currentPoolSize: 0,
      totalMessagesReceived: 0,
      totalMessagesForwarded: 0,
      totalDummiesInjected: 0,
      totalLoopMessages: 0,
      averageMixDelay: 0,
      poolFlushes: 0,
      anonymitySetSize: 0,
      entropyBits: 0
    };
  }

  /** Register a known mix node */
  registerNode(node: MixNodeInfo): void {
    this.knownNodes.set(node.nodeId, node);
  }

  /** Start the mix engine */
  start(): void {
    if (this.isRunning) return;
    this.isRunning = true;

    // Initialize loop cover traffic
    const activePaths = Array.from(this.knownNodes.values()).filter(n => n.isActive);
    if (activePaths.length >= MIN_MIX_HOPS) {
      this.loopGenerator = new LoopCoverGenerator(this.config.nodeId, activePaths, this.sphinx);
    }

    // Start strategy-specific processing
    switch (this.config.strategy) {
      case 'TIMED':
        this.timedFlushHandle = setInterval(() => this.timedFlush(), this.config.timedIntervalMs);
        break;
      case 'CONTINUOUS':
        this.timedFlushHandle = setInterval(() => this.continuousFlush(), 100);
        break;
      case 'STOP_AND_GO':
        this.startStopAndGo();
        break;
      case 'BINOMIAL':
        this.timedFlushHandle = setInterval(() => this.binomialFlush(), 200);
        break;
    }

    // Loop cover traffic generator
    this.loopHandle = setInterval(() => {
      if (cryptoUniform() < this.config.loopCoverProbability && this.loopGenerator) {
        const loopMsg = this.loopGenerator.generateLoop();
        this.pool.add(loopMsg);
        this.stats.totalLoopMessages++;
      }
    }, 1000);

    this.emit('started', { nodeId: this.config.nodeId, strategy: this.config.strategy });
  }

  /** Stop the mix engine */
  stop(): void {
    if (!this.isRunning) return;
    this.isRunning = false;
    if (this.timedFlushHandle) { clearInterval(this.timedFlushHandle); this.timedFlushHandle = null; }
    if (this.loopHandle) { clearInterval(this.loopHandle); this.loopHandle = null; }
    this.emit('stopped', { nodeId: this.config.nodeId, stats: this.getStats() });
  }

  /**
   * Submit a message for mixing.
   * Returns false if pool is full.
   */
  submit(message: MixMessage): boolean {
    this.stats.totalMessagesReceived++;

    // Process Sphinx packet if enabled
    if (this.config.enableSphinx && !message.isDummy) {
      const { routing, nextPacket, isValid, isReplay } = this.sphinx.processPacket(message.packet);
      if (!isValid || isReplay) {
        this.emit('invalidPacket', { id: message.id, isReplay });
        return false;
      }
      message = { ...message, packet: nextPacket, routingInfo: routing };
    }

    // Inject dummy messages at configured ratio
    if (cryptoUniform() < this.config.dummyRatio) {
      this.injectDummy();
    }

    const added = this.pool.add(message);
    this.stats.currentPoolSize = this.pool.size();
    this.stats.anonymitySetSize = this.pool.computeAnonymitySet();
    this.stats.entropyBits = this.pool.computeEntropy();

    // Strategy-specific triggers
    if (added) {
      switch (this.config.strategy) {
        case 'THRESHOLD':
          this.thresholdCheck();
          break;
        case 'POOL':
          this.poolCheck();
          break;
      }
    }

    return added;
  }

  private timedFlush(): void {
    if (this.pool.size() === 0) {
      this.injectDummy();
      return;
    }
    const messages = this.pool.flushAll();
    this.forwardMessages(messages);
  }

  private continuousFlush(): void {
    const messages = this.pool.sampleContinuous(this.config.continuousForwardProbability);
    if (messages.length > 0) this.forwardMessages(messages);
  }

  private binomialFlush(): void {
    const messages = this.pool.sampleBinomial(this.config.binomialProbability);
    if (messages.length > 0) this.forwardMessages(messages);
  }

  private thresholdCheck(): void {
    const messages = this.pool.flushThreshold(this.config.threshold);
    if (messages) this.forwardMessages(messages);
  }

  private poolCheck(): void {
    if (this.pool.size() >= this.config.poolSize) {
      const messages = this.pool.flushPool(0.5);
      this.forwardMessages(messages);
    }
  }

  private startStopAndGo(): void {
    // Stop-and-Go: synchronized processing windows
    let processing = false;
    this.timedFlushHandle = setInterval(() => {
      if (!processing) {
        processing = true;
        // Receive phase: accept messages (done continuously via submit())
        setTimeout(() => {
          // Go phase: flush and forward
          const messages = this.pool.flushAll();
          this.forwardMessages(messages);
          processing = false;
        }, this.config.stopAndGoWindowMs / 2);
      }
    }, this.config.stopAndGoWindowMs);
  }

  private forwardMessages(messages: MixMessage[]): void {
    // Apply per-message random delay before forwarding
    for (const msg of messages) {
      const delay = Math.floor(cryptoUniform() * 500); // 0-500ms random delay
      this.mixDelays.push(delay);
      if (this.mixDelays.length > 1000) this.mixDelays.shift();

      setTimeout(() => {
        this.stats.totalMessagesForwarded++;
        this.emit('forward', { message: msg, nodeId: this.config.nodeId });
      }, delay);
    }
    this.updateAverageDelay();
  }

  private injectDummy(): void {
    const dummyPayload = randomBytes(SPHINX_BODY_SIZE);
    const dummyHeader = randomBytes(SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
    const dummyMac = randomBytes(32);
    const dummy: MixMessage = {
      id: randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
      packet: { version: 1, header: dummyHeader, body: dummyPayload, mac: dummyMac, totalSize: 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE + 32 },
      receivedAt: Date.now(),
      hopCount: 0,
      isLoop: false,
      isDummy: true
    };
    this.pool.add(dummy);
    this.stats.totalDummiesInjected++;
  }

  private updateAverageDelay(): void {
    if (this.mixDelays.length === 0) return;
    this.stats.averageMixDelay = this.mixDelays.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / this.mixDelays.length;
  }

  getStats(): Readonly<MixPoolStats> {
    this.stats.currentPoolSize = this.pool.size();
    this.stats.anonymitySetSize = this.pool.computeAnonymitySet();
    this.stats.entropyBits = this.pool.computeEntropy();
    return { ...this.stats };
  }

  getNodeId(): string { return this.config.nodeId; }
  getPublicKey(): Buffer {
    return createHash('sha256').update(this.config.privateKey).digest();
  }
  isActive(): boolean { return this.isRunning; }
  getPoolSize(): number { return this.pool.size(); }
  getKnownNodeCount(): number { return this.knownNodes.size; }
  getLoopStats() { return this.loopGenerator?.getStats(); }
}

// ─── Mix Network Manager ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * MixNetworkManager: orchestrates multiple mix nodes in a cascade.
 * Handles node discovery, path selection, and end-to-end message submission.
 */
export class MixNetworkManager extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly nodes = new Map<string, MixNodeEngine>();
  private readonly nodeRegistry = new Map<string, MixNodeInfo>();
  private readonly localNode: MixNodeEngine;
  private isRunning: boolean = false;

  constructor(localConfig: Partial<MixConfig>) {
    super();
    this.localNode = new MixNodeEngine(localConfig);
    this.nodes.set(this.localNode.getNodeId(), this.localNode);
    this.localNode.on('forward', ({ message }) => this.routeMessage(message));
  }

  /** Add a remote mix node to the known registry */
  addRemoteNode(info: MixNodeInfo): void {
    this.nodeRegistry.set(info.nodeId, info);
    // Propagate to all local nodes
    for (const node of this.nodes.values()) {
      node.registerNode(info);
    }
    this.emit('nodeAdded', { nodeId: info.nodeId, tier: info.tier });
  }

  /** Select a random path of `hops` nodes from the registry */
  selectPath(hops: number): MixNodeInfo[] {
    const available = Array.from(this.nodeRegistry.values()).filter(n => n.isActive);
    if (available.length < hops) {
      throw new Error(`Need ${hops} mix nodes but only ${available.length} available`);
    }
    return cryptoShuffle([...available]).slice(0, hops);
  }

  /**
   * Send a message through the mix network.
   * Automatically selects path, wraps in Sphinx, submits to local mix pool.
   */
  async send(payload: Buffer, recipientId: string): Promise<string> {
    const hops = this.localNode['config'].minHops +
      Math.floor(cryptoUniform() * (this.localNode['config'].maxHops - this.localNode['config'].minHops + 1));

    const path = this.nodeRegistry.size >= hops
      ? this.selectPath(hops)
      : [];

    const packet: SphinxPacket = path.length >= MIN_MIX_HOPS
      ? this.localNode['sphinx'].createPacket(
          path.map(n => ({ nodeId: n.nodeId, publicKey: n.publicKey })),
          payload
        )
      : {
          version: 1,
          header: randomBytes(SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE),
          body: Buffer.concat([payload.subarray(0, Math.min(payload.length, SPHINX_BODY_SIZE)), randomBytes(Math.max(0, SPHINX_BODY_SIZE - payload.length))]),
          mac: randomBytes(32),
          totalSize: 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE + 32
        };

    const messageId = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    const message: MixMessage = {
      id: messageId,
      packet,
      receivedAt: Date.now(),
      hopCount: path.length,
      isLoop: false,
      isDummy: false,
      routingInfo: path.length > 0 ? {
        nextHopId: path[0].nodeId,
        nextHopAddress: path[0].address,
        delay: 0,
        isExit: false,
        recipientId
      } : undefined
    };

    const accepted = this.localNode.submit(message);
    if (!accepted) throw new Error('Mix pool full — message rejected');

    this.emit('messageSent', { messageId, hops: path.length, recipientId });
    return messageId;
  }

  private routeMessage(message: MixMessage): void {
    if (!message.routingInfo) return;
    const { isExit, recipientId } = message.routingInfo;
    if (isExit) {
      this.emit('messageDelivered', { messageId: message.id, recipientId });
    } else {
      // Forward to next node (in real deployment: send over network)
      this.emit('messageForwarded', { messageId: message.id, nextHop: message.routingInfo.nextHopId });
    }
  }

  start(): void {
    if (this.isRunning) return;
    this.isRunning = true;
    for (const node of this.nodes.values()) node.start();
    this.emit('networkStarted', { localNodeId: this.localNode.getNodeId() });
  }

  stop(): void {
    if (!this.isRunning) return;
    this.isRunning = false;
    for (const node of this.nodes.values()) node.stop();
    this.emit('networkStopped');
  }

  getLocalNodeId(): string { return this.localNode.getNodeId(); }
  getLocalPublicKey(): Buffer { return this.localNode.getPublicKey(); }
  getKnownNodeCount(): number { return this.nodeRegistry.size; }
  getStats() { return this.localNode.getStats(); }

  /** Check network health — anonymity set size, entropy, node availability */
  healthCheck(): {
    healthy: boolean;
    anonymitySetSize: number;
    activeNodes: number;
    entropyBits: number;
    issues: string[];
  } {
    const stats = this.localNode.getStats();
    const activeNodes = Array.from(this.nodeRegistry.values()).filter(n => n.isActive).length;
    const issues: string[] = [];

    if (activeNodes < MIN_MIX_HOPS) issues.push(`Insufficient mix nodes: ${activeNodes} < ${MIN_MIX_HOPS}`);
    if (stats.anonymitySetSize < 5) issues.push(`Anonymity set too small: ${stats.anonymitySetSize}`);
    if (stats.entropyBits < 2) issues.push(`Pool entropy too low: ${stats.entropyBits.toFixed(2)} bits`);

    return {
      healthy: issues.length === 0,
      anonymitySetSize: stats.anonymitySetSize,
      activeNodes,
      entropyBits: stats.entropyBits,
      issues
    };
  }
}

  MixNetworkManager as default,
  MixNodeEngine,
  MixPool,
  SphinxCrypto,
  LoopCoverGenerator

--- FILE: packages/sdk/src/phase2/onionRouter.ts ---
/**
 * UBE Phase 2 — Metadata Sovereignty
 * onionRouter.ts — Onion Routing Engine
 *
 * Full onion routing implementation with layered encryption, forward secrecy,
 * and relay management. Each relay knows only its predecessor and successor —
 * never the full path, origin, or destination.
 *
 * Architecture:
 *   - Circuit-based routing with 3-8 hop paths
 *   - X25519 ECDH key exchange per relay (simulated with HMAC-KDF)
 *   - AES-256-CTR stream cipher per layer
 *   - HMAC-SHA256 per-layer authentication
 *   - Forward secrecy via ephemeral keys
 *   - Circuit teardown with key material erasure
 *   - Hidden services (rendezvous point protocol)
 *   - Guard node selection for Sybil resistance
 *   - Bandwidth-weighted relay selection
 *
 * Threat model:
 *   - Global passive adversary observing all links
 *   - Compromised relays (up to n-1 of n)
 *   - Active timing attacks
 *   - Predecessor attacks
 *
 * @module metadata-sovereignty/onionRouter
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { randomBytes, createHmac, createHash, createCipheriv, createDecipheriv, diffieHellman } from 'crypto';

// ─── Constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const MAX_HOPS = 8;
export const DEFAULT_HOPS = 3;
export const CELL_SIZE = 512;
export const CIRCUIT_ID_SIZE = 4;
export const RELAY_HEADER_SIZE = 11;
export const CRYPTO_CELL_SIZE = CELL_SIZE - CIRCUIT_ID_SIZE;
export const KEY_MATERIAL_SIZE = 72; // 20 Kf + 20 Kb + 16 Kc + 16 Kd
export const CIRCUIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 600000; // 10 minutes
export const MAX_CIRCUITS = 1000;
export const GUARD_NODE_COUNT = 3;
