// ─── XOR Distance (Kademlia) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function xorDistance(a: string, b: string): bigint {
  const bufA = Buffer.from(a.padEnd(64, '0').substring(0, 64), 'hex');
  const bufB = Buffer.from(b.padEnd(64, '0').substring(0, 64), 'hex');
  let dist = 0n;
  for (let i = 0; i < bufA.length; i++) {
    dist = (dist << 8n) | BigInt(bufA[i] ^ bufB[i]);
  }
  return dist;
}

export function bucketIndex(distance: bigint): number {
  if (distance === 0n) return 0;
  let bucket = 0;
  let d = distance;
  while (d > 0n) { d >>= 1n; bucket++; }
  return Math.min(bucket - 1, 255);
}

// ─── Peer Scorer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class PeerScorer {
  static compute(peer: PeerRecord): number {
    let score = 0;

    // Latency: lower is better (max 30 points)
    if (peer.latencyMs < 50) score += 30;
    else if (peer.latencyMs < 100) score += 25;
    else if (peer.latencyMs < 200) score += 20;
    else if (peer.latencyMs < 500) score += 10;
    else score += 0;

    // Success rate (max 25 points)
    score += Math.round(peer.successRate * 25);

    // Capabilities (max 20 points)
    if (peer.capabilities.includes('relay')) score += 5;
    if (peer.capabilities.includes('storage')) score += 5;
    if (peer.phase11Capable) score += 5;
    if (peer.dhtCapable) score += 5;

    // Recency (max 15 points)
    const ageMs = Date.now() - peer.lastSeen;
    if (ageMs < 60_000) score += 15;
    else if (ageMs < 300_000) score += 10;
    else if (ageMs < 3_600_000) score += 5;

    // Bootstrap peers (max 10 points)
    if (peer.bootstrapPeer) score += 10;

    return Math.min(100, score);
  }

  static decay(peer: PeerRecord, factor = 0.95): PeerRecord {
    return { ...peer, score: peer.score * factor };
  }
}

// ─── K-Bucket Routing Table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class KBucketTable {
  private buckets: Map<number, KademliaNode[]> = new Map();

  constructor(private nodeId: string, private k: number = 20) {}

  insert(peer: PeerRecord): boolean {
    const dist = xorDistance(this.nodeId, peer.peerId);
    const bucket = bucketIndex(dist);

    if (!this.buckets.has(bucket)) this.buckets.set(bucket, []);
    const list = this.buckets.get(bucket)!;

    const existing = list.findIndex(n => n.peerId === peer.peerId);
    if (existing >= 0) {
      // Move to tail (most recently seen)
      list.splice(existing, 1);
      list.push({ peerId: peer.peerId, distance: dist, bucket, lastContacted: Date.now(), failureCount: 0 });
      return true;
    }

    if (list.length < this.k) {
      list.push({ peerId: peer.peerId, distance: dist, bucket, lastContacted: Date.now(), failureCount: 0 });
      return true;
    }

    // Bucket full: evict head (least recently seen) if it has failures
    if (list[0].failureCount > 2) {
      list.shift();
      list.push({ peerId: peer.peerId, distance: dist, bucket, lastContacted: Date.now(), failureCount: 0 });
      return true;
    }

    return false; // Bucket full, peer not inserted
  }

  findClosest(targetId: string, count: number = 20): KademliaNode[] {
    const all: KademliaNode[] = [];
    for (const list of this.buckets.values()) all.push(...list);
    const dist = xorDistance(this.nodeId, targetId);
    return all
      .map(n => ({ ...n, distance: xorDistance(n.peerId, targetId) }))
      .sort((a, b) => (a.distance < b.distance ? -1 : a.distance > b.distance ? 1 : 0))
      .slice(0, count);
  }

  remove(peerId: PeerId): void {
    for (const list of this.buckets.values()) {
      const i = list.findIndex(n => n.peerId === peerId);
      if (i >= 0) { list.splice(i, 1); return; }
    }
  }

  markFailure(peerId: PeerId): void {
    for (const list of this.buckets.values()) {
      const node = list.find(n => n.peerId === peerId);
      if (node) { node.failureCount++; return; }
    }
  }

  size(): number {
    let total = 0;
    for (const list of this.buckets.values()) total += list.length;
    return total;
  }

  getAllPeerIds(): PeerId[] {
    const ids: PeerId[] = [];
    for (const list of this.buckets.values()) ids.push(...list.map(n => n.peerId));
    return ids;
  }

  getBucketStats(): Record<number, number> {
    const stats: Record<number, number> = {};
    for (const [bucket, list] of this.buckets) stats[bucket] = list.length;
    return stats;
  }
}

// ─── Peer Cache (disk persistence) ───────────────────────────────────────────

export class PeerCache {
  private peers: Map<PeerId, PeerRecord> = new Map();

  constructor(private cachePath: string) {}

  load(): void {
    if (!fs.existsSync(this.cachePath)) return;
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(this.cachePath, 'utf8')) as PeerRecord[];
      for (const peer of data) {
        if (!peer.banned) this.peers.set(peer.peerId, peer);
      }
    } catch { /* corrupt cache — start fresh */ }
  }

  save(): void {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(this.cachePath), { recursive: true });
    const data = [...this.peers.values()];
    const tmp = this.cachePath + '.tmp';
    fs.writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
    fs.renameSync(tmp, this.cachePath);
  }

  upsert(peer: PeerRecord): void {
    this.peers.set(peer.peerId, peer);
  }

  get(peerId: PeerId): PeerRecord | undefined {
    return this.peers.get(peerId);
  }

  delete(peerId: PeerId): void {
    this.peers.delete(peerId);
  }

  all(): PeerRecord[] {
    return [...this.peers.values()];
  }

  active(): PeerRecord[] {
    const cutoff = Date.now() - 24 * 3600 * 1000;
    return this.all().filter(p => !p.banned && p.lastSeen > cutoff);
  }

  size(): number {
    return this.peers.size;
  }
}

// ─── mDNS LAN Discovery ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class MdnsDiscovery extends EventEmitter {
  private socket: dgram.Socket | null = null;
  private announceTimer?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
  private readonly MULTICAST_ADDR = '224.0.0.251';

  constructor(
    private port: number,
    private localAnnouncement: PeerAnnouncement,
  ) {
    super();
  }

  start(): void {
    try {
      this.socket = dgram.createSocket({ type: 'udp4', reuseAddr: true });
      this.socket.bind(this.port, () => {
        try {
          this.socket!.addMembership(this.MULTICAST_ADDR);
          this.socket!.setMulticastTTL(2);
          this.socket!.setMulticastLoopback(false);
        } catch { /* ignore multicast setup errors */ }
      });

      this.socket.on('message', (msg, rinfo) => {
        try {
          const announcement = JSON.parse(msg.toString()) as PeerAnnouncement;
          if (announcement.peerId !== this.localAnnouncement.peerId) {
            this.emit('peer', announcement, rinfo.address);
          }
        } catch { /* ignore malformed */ }
      });

      // Announce ourselves every 30s
      this.announceTimer = setInterval(() => this.announce(), 30_000);
      this.announce();
    } catch { /* mDNS not available on all systems */ }
  }

  private announce(): void {
    if (!this.socket) return;
    const msg = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(this.localAnnouncement));
    try {
      this.socket.send(msg, this.port, this.MULTICAST_ADDR);
    } catch { /* ignore send errors */ }
  }

  stop(): void {
    if (this.announceTimer) clearInterval(this.announceTimer);
    try { this.socket?.close(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
}

// ─── DNS Seed Resolver ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class DnsSeedResolver {
  async resolve(seeds: string[]): Promise<Endpoint[]> {
    const endpoints: Endpoint[] = [];
    await Promise.allSettled(
      seeds.map(async (seed) => {
        try {
          const addresses = await dnsResolve(seed);
          for (const addr of addresses) endpoints.push(`${addr}:7432`);
        } catch { /* DNS seed unreachable */ }
      }),
    );
    return endpoints;
  }
}

// ─── Peer Announcement Signer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class AnnouncementSigner {
  constructor(private privateKey: Buffer, private publicKey: Buffer) {}

  sign(announcement: Omit<PeerAnnouncement, 'signature'>): PeerAnnouncement {
    const canonical = JSON.stringify(announcement);
    const sig = crypto.createHmac('sha256', this.privateKey)
      .update(canonical).digest('hex');
    return { ...announcement, signature: sig };
  }

  verify(announcement: PeerAnnouncement): boolean {
    const { signature, ...rest } = announcement;
    const canonical = JSON.stringify(rest);
    // In production: Ed25519 verify with announcement.publicKey
    // Here: HMAC with public key as a stand-in
    try {
      const expected = crypto.createHmac('sha256', Buffer.from(announcement.publicKey, 'hex'))
        .update(canonical).digest('hex');
      return crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(signature, 'hex'), Buffer.from(expected, 'hex'));
    } catch { return false; }
  }
}

// ─── Bootstrap Registry — Main Class ─────────────────────────────────────────

export class BootstrapRegistry extends EventEmitter {
  private cache: PeerCache;
  private kBucket: KBucketTable;
  private signer: AnnouncementSigner;
  private mdns?: MdnsDiscovery;
  private dnsResolver: DnsSeedResolver;
  private reconnectTimers: Map<PeerId, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>> = new Map();
  private discoveryStats: Record<string, number> = {
    seed: 0, dns: 0, mdns: 0, dht: 0, peer_exchange: 0,
  };
  private startTime = Date.now();
  private lastBootstrap = 0;
  private announceTimer?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
  private decayTimer?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
  private localAnnouncement: PeerAnnouncement;

  constructor(private config: BootstrapConfig) {
    super();
    this.cache = new PeerCache(config.peerCachePath);
    this.kBucket = new KBucketTable(config.nodeId, config.kBucketSize);
    this.signer = new AnnouncementSigner(config.privateKey, config.publicKey);
    this.dnsResolver = new DnsSeedResolver();

    this.localAnnouncement = this.signer.sign({
      peerId: config.peerId,
      nodeId: config.nodeId,
      endpoints: [],
      publicKey: config.publicKey.toString('hex'),
      capabilities: config.capabilities,
      region: config.region,
      jurisdiction: config.jurisdiction,
      version: config.version,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      nonce: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
    });
  }

  async initialize(): Promise<void> {
    // Load persisted peers
    this.cache.load();
    const cached = this.cache.active();
    for (const peer of cached) {
      this.kBucket.insert(peer);
    }

    // Start mDNS if enabled
    if (this.config.enableMdns) {
      this.mdns = new MdnsDiscovery(this.config.mdnsPort, this.localAnnouncement);
      this.mdns.on('peer', (announcement: PeerAnnouncement, address: string) => {
        this.handleIncomingAnnouncement(announcement, address, 'mdns');
      });
      this.mdns.start();
    }

    // Periodic announce
    this.announceTimer = setInterval(() => {
      this.emit('announce', this.localAnnouncement);
    }, this.config.announceInterval);

    // Periodic score decay
    this.decayTimer = setInterval(() => {
      for (const peer of this.cache.all()) {
        const decayed = PeerScorer.decay(peer);
        this.cache.upsert(decayed);
      }
    }, this.config.peerScoreDecayInterval);

    await this.bootstrap();
    this.emit('ready', { nodeId: this.config.nodeId, peerId: this.config.peerId });
  }

  // ─── Bootstrap Sequence ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async bootstrap(): Promise<void> {
    this.lastBootstrap = Date.now();
    this.emit('bootstrap:start');

    const discovered: Array<{ endpoint: Endpoint; source: string }> = [];

    // 1. Hardcoded seed peers
    for (const seed of this.config.seedPeers) {
      discovered.push({ endpoint: seed.endpoint, source: 'seed' });
    }

    // 2. DNS seeds
    if (this.config.dnsSeeds.length > 0) {
      const dnsEndpoints = await this.dnsResolver.resolve(this.config.dnsSeeds);
      for (const ep of dnsEndpoints) {
        discovered.push({ endpoint: ep, source: 'dns' });
      }
    }

    // 3. Cached peers (most reliable — we've connected before)
    for (const peer of this.cache.active().slice(0, 50)) {
      for (const ep of peer.endpoints) {
        discovered.push({ endpoint: ep, source: 'cache' });
      }
    }

    // Attempt connections in parallel (α at a time)
    const chunks = this.chunkArray(discovered, this.config.alphaParallelism);
    for (const chunk of chunks) {
      await Promise.allSettled(
        chunk.map(({ endpoint, source }) => this.connectToEndpoint(endpoint, source)),
      );
    }

    // If we still don't have enough peers, do DHT walk
    if (this.kBucket.size() < this.config.minPeers && this.config.enableDht) {
      await this.dhtWalk();
    }

    this.cache.save();
    this.emit('bootstrap:complete', {
      peers: this.kBucket.size(),
      stats: this.discoveryStats,
    });
  }

  // ─── DHT Walk ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async dhtWalk(): Promise<void> {
    this.emit('dht:walk:start');

    // Find nodes closest to our own ID — this populates our routing table
    const closest = this.kBucket.findClosest(this.config.nodeId, this.config.kBucketSize);
    const visited = new Set<PeerId>();
    const queue = [...closest];

    let iterations = 0;
    while (queue.length > 0 && iterations < 100) {
      iterations++;
      const batch = queue.splice(0, this.config.alphaParallelism);

      await Promise.allSettled(batch.map(async (node) => {
        if (visited.has(node.peerId)) return;
        visited.add(node.peerId);

        const peer = this.cache.get(node.peerId);
        if (!peer) return;

        this.emit('dht:find_node', { target: this.config.nodeId, peer: peer.peerId });

        // Simulate receiving closer nodes from this peer
        const closer = this.kBucket.findClosest(this.config.nodeId, this.config.kBucketSize)
          .filter(n => !visited.has(n.peerId));

        queue.push(...closer);
        this.discoveryStats.dht++;
      }));
    }

    this.emit('dht:walk:complete', { visited: visited.size });
  }

  // ─── Peer Connection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async connectToEndpoint(endpoint: Endpoint, source: string): Promise<void> {
    // In real implementation: TCP/QUIC connection attempt
    // Here we model the state machine

    this.emit('connect:attempt', { endpoint, source });

    // Simulate connection attempt
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.random() * 100));

    // On success: emit 'peer:connected' and registry records the peer
    // This is where real network code hooks in (natTraversal.ts handles punching)
    this.discoveryStats[source] = (this.discoveryStats[source] ?? 0) + 1;
    this.emit('connect:endpoint', { endpoint, source });
  }

  // ─── Peer Record Management ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  registerPeer(peer: PeerRecord): void {
    if (peer.banned) return;

    const existing = this.cache.get(peer.peerId);
    const updated: PeerRecord = {
      ...peer,
      score: PeerScorer.compute(peer),
      firstSeen: existing?.firstSeen ?? Date.now(),
      lastSeen: Date.now(),
    };

    this.cache.upsert(updated);
    this.kBucket.insert(updated);
    this.emit('peer:registered', updated);
  }

  handleIncomingAnnouncement(
    announcement: PeerAnnouncement,
    sourceAddress: string,
    discoveryMethod: string,
  ): void {
    // Verify signature
    if (!this.signer.verify(announcement)) {
      this.emit('announcement:invalid', { peerId: announcement.peerId, reason: 'bad_signature' });
      return;
    }

    // Reject stale announcements (> 5 minutes)
    if (Date.now() - announcement.timestamp > 300_000) {
      this.emit('announcement:stale', { peerId: announcement.peerId });
      return;
    }

    // Check if banned
    const existing = this.cache.get(announcement.peerId);
    if (existing?.banned) return;

    // Resolve endpoints — prefer the one we received the announcement from
    const endpoints = announcement.endpoints.length > 0
      ? announcement.endpoints
      : [`${sourceAddress}:7432`];

    const peer: PeerRecord = {
      peerId: announcement.peerId,
      nodeId: announcement.nodeId,
      endpoints,
      publicKey: announcement.publicKey,
      capabilities: announcement.capabilities,
      region: announcement.region,
      jurisdiction: announcement.jurisdiction,
      lastSeen: Date.now(),
      firstSeen: existing?.firstSeen ?? Date.now(),
      latencyMs: existing?.latencyMs ?? 999,
      successRate: existing?.successRate ?? 0.5,
      connectionCount: (existing?.connectionCount ?? 0) + 1,
      score: 0,
      version: announcement.version,
      signature: announcement.signature,
      banned: false,
      phase11Capable: announcement.capabilities.includes('phase11'),
      relayCapable: announcement.capabilities.includes('relay'),
      dhtCapable: announcement.capabilities.includes('dht'),
      bootstrapPeer: false,
    };
    peer.score = PeerScorer.compute(peer);

    this.registerPeer(peer);
    this.discoveryStats[discoveryMethod] = (this.discoveryStats[discoveryMethod] ?? 0) + 1;
  }

  updatePeerStats(peerId: PeerId, latencyMs: number, success: boolean): void {
    const peer = this.cache.get(peerId);
    if (!peer) return;

    const alpha = 0.2; // EWMA factor
    const updated: PeerRecord = {
      ...peer,
      latencyMs: peer.latencyMs * (1 - alpha) + latencyMs * alpha,
      successRate: peer.successRate * (1 - alpha) + (success ? 1 : 0) * alpha,
      lastSeen: success ? Date.now() : peer.lastSeen,
      connectionCount: peer.connectionCount + 1,
    };
    updated.score = PeerScorer.compute(updated);
    this.cache.upsert(updated);

    if (!success) {
      this.kBucket.markFailure(peerId);
      this.scheduleReconnect(peerId);
    }
  }

  // ─── Reconnection with Exponential Backoff ────────────────────────────────

  private reconnectAttempts: Map<PeerId, number> = new Map();

  private scheduleReconnect(peerId: PeerId): void {
    if (this.reconnectTimers.has(peerId)) return;

    const attempts = this.reconnectAttempts.get(peerId) ?? 0;
    const base = this.config.reconnectInterval;
    const max = this.config.reconnectMaxInterval;
    const jitter = Math.random() * base * 0.5;
    const delay = Math.min(base * Math.pow(2, attempts) + jitter, max);

    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      this.reconnectTimers.delete(peerId);
      const peer = this.cache.get(peerId);
      if (!peer || peer.banned) return;

      this.emit('reconnect:attempt', { peerId, attempt: attempts + 1 });
      this.reconnectAttempts.set(peerId, attempts + 1);

      await Promise.allSettled(
        peer.endpoints.map(ep => this.connectToEndpoint(ep, 'reconnect')),
      );
    }, delay);

    this.reconnectTimers.set(peerId, timer);
  }

  // ─── Peer Selection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  selectPeers(options: {
    count?: number;
    capabilities?: Capability[];
    region?: string;
    jurisdiction?: string;
    excludeIds?: PeerId[];
    minScore?: number;
    preferPhase11?: boolean;
  } = {}): PeerRecord[] {
    const {
      count = 10,
      capabilities = [],
      region,
      jurisdiction,
      excludeIds = [],
      minScore = 0,
      preferPhase11 = false,
    } = options;

    let candidates = this.cache.active()
      .filter(p => !excludeIds.includes(p.peerId))
      .filter(p => p.score >= minScore)
      .filter(p => capabilities.every(cap => p.capabilities.includes(cap)));

    if (region) candidates = candidates.filter(p => p.region === region);
    if (jurisdiction) candidates = candidates.filter(p => p.jurisdiction === jurisdiction);

    // Sort: phase11 preference, then by score
    candidates.sort((a, b) => {
      if (preferPhase11 && a.phase11Capable !== b.phase11Capable) {
        return a.phase11Capable ? -1 : 1;
      }
      return b.score - a.score;
    });

    return candidates.slice(0, count);
  }

  findClosestPeers(targetId: string, count = 20): PeerRecord[] {
    const closest = this.kBucket.findClosest(targetId, count);
    return closest
      .map(n => this.cache.get(n.peerId))
      .filter((p): p is PeerRecord => p !== undefined);
  }

  // ─── Peer Exchange (PEX) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  getPeerListForExchange(requesterId: PeerId, maxPeers = 50): PeerRecord[] {
    return this.cache.active()
      .filter(p => p.peerId !== requesterId)
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
      .slice(0, maxPeers)
      .map(p => ({
        ...p,
        // Strip private info before sharing
        latencyMs: 0,
        connectionCount: 0,
      }));
  }

  receivePeerList(peers: PeerRecord[], fromPeer: PeerId): void {
    let added = 0;
    for (const peer of peers) {
      if (this.cache.size() >= this.config.maxPeers) break;
      if (!this.cache.get(peer.peerId)) {
        this.registerPeer(peer);
        added++;
        this.discoveryStats.peer_exchange++;
      }
    }
    this.emit('pex:received', { fromPeer, count: peers.length, added });
  }

  // ─── Ban Management ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  banPeer(peerId: PeerId, reason: string, durationMs?: number): void {
    const peer = this.cache.get(peerId);
    if (!peer) return;

    const banned: PeerRecord = { ...peer, banned: true, banReason: reason };
    this.cache.upsert(banned);
    this.kBucket.remove(peerId);

    if (durationMs) {
      setTimeout(() => this.unbanPeer(peerId), Math.min(durationMs, this.config.maxBanDuration));
    }

    this.emit('peer:banned', { peerId, reason });
  }

  unbanPeer(peerId: PeerId): void {
    const peer = this.cache.get(peerId);
    if (!peer) return;
    const unbanned: PeerRecord = { ...peer, banned: false, banReason: undefined };
    this.cache.upsert(unbanned);
    this.kBucket.insert(unbanned);
    this.emit('peer:unbanned', { peerId });
  }

  // ─── FindNode RPC ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  handleFindNodeRequest(req: FindNodeRequest): FindNodeResponse | null {
    // Verify request is fresh
    if (Date.now() - req.timestamp > 30_000) return null;

    const closest = this.findClosestPeers(req.targetId, this.config.kBucketSize);
    const response: Omit<FindNodeResponse, 'signature'> = {
      requestNonce: req.nonce,
      responderId: this.config.peerId,
      closestPeers: closest,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    };

    const sig = crypto.createHmac('sha256', this.config.privateKey)
      .update(JSON.stringify(response)).digest('hex');

    return { ...response, signature: sig };
  }

  // ─── Announce ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  updateLocalEndpoints(endpoints: Endpoint[]): void {
    this.localAnnouncement = this.signer.sign({
      ...this.localAnnouncement,
      endpoints,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      nonce: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
    });
    this.emit('announce', this.localAnnouncement);
  }

  getLocalAnnouncement(): PeerAnnouncement {
    return { ...this.localAnnouncement };
  }

  // ─── Shutdown ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async shutdown(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.announceTimer) clearInterval(this.announceTimer);
    if (this.decayTimer) clearInterval(this.decayTimer);
    for (const timer of this.reconnectTimers.values()) clearTimeout(timer);
    this.mdns?.stop();
    this.cache.save();
    this.emit('shutdown');
  }

  // ─── Stats & Health ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  getStats(): BootstrapStats {
    const all = this.cache.all();
    return {
      totalPeers: all.length,
      connectedPeers: this.kBucket.size(),
      bannedPeers: all.filter(p => p.banned).length,
      dhtNodes: this.kBucket.size(),
      uptime: Date.now() - this.startTime,
      lastBootstrap: this.lastBootstrap,
      discoveryMethod: { ...this.discoveryStats },
    };
  }

  getRoutingTable(): { buckets: Record<number, number>; totalNodes: number } {
    return {
      buckets: this.kBucket.getBucketStats(),
      totalNodes: this.kBucket.size(),
    };
  }

  private chunkArray<T>(arr: T[], size: number): T[][] {
    const chunks: T[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += size) chunks.push(arr.slice(i, i + size));
    return chunks;
  }
}

// ─── Factory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function createBootstrapRegistry(overrides: Partial<BootstrapConfig> & {
  nodeId: string;
  peerId: PeerId;
  privateKey: Buffer;
  publicKey: Buffer;
}): BootstrapRegistry {
  const config: BootstrapConfig = {
    peerCachePath: path.join(os.homedir(), '.ube', 'peers.json'),
    maxPeers: 1000,
    kBucketSize: 20,
    alphaParallelism: 3,
    seedPeers: [
      // UBE genesis seed peers — replace with real ones at Phase 4
      { endpoint: 'seed1.ube.network:7432' },
      { endpoint: 'seed2.ube.network:7432' },
      { endpoint: 'seed3.ube.network:7432' },
    ],
    dnsSeeds: [
      'seed.ube.network',
      'nodes.ube.network',
    ],
    enableMdns: true,
    mdnsPort: 5353,
    enableDht: true,
    dhtPort: 7433,
    reconnectInterval: 5_000,
    reconnectMaxInterval: 300_000,
    peerScoreDecayInterval: 60_000,
    minPeers: 8,
    maxBanDuration: 86_400_000,    // 24 hours
    capabilities: ['api', 'dht', 'relay'],
    version: '3.0.0',
    region: 'GLOBAL',
    jurisdiction: 'INTERNATIONAL',
    announceInterval: 300_000,      // 5 minutes
    ...overrides,
  };
  return new BootstrapRegistry(config);
}

export default BootstrapRegistry;

--- FILE: packages/sdk/src/phase3/natTraversal.ts ---
/**
 * UBE Phase 3 — NAT Traversal Engine
 * =====================================
 * Kills the firewall dependency. Most UBE nodes are behind NAT, CGNAT,
 * enterprise firewalls, or carrier-grade middleboxes. This module punches
 * through all of them using the same DCUtR (Direct Connection Upgrade Through
 * Relay) technique that IPFS uses across 85,000 networks worldwide.
 *
 * Techniques (layered, tried in order):
 *   1. Direct connection (no NAT, or UPnP/NAT-PMP mapped port)
 *   2. STUN — discover external IP:port via RFC 5389
 *   3. UDP hole punching — simultaneous open, exploits NAT state machines
 *   4. TCP hole punching — SYN simultaneous open (RFC 5128)
 *   5. DCUtR — relay-assisted direct upgrade (libp2p spec)
 *   6. TURN relay — full relay fallback (RFC 5766)
 *   7. Phase 11 mesh relay — LoRa/satellite fallback if all IP fails
 *
 * Features:
 *   - QUIC transport: 0-RTT reconnection, built-in TLS 1.3, multiplexing
 *   - ICE (RFC 8445): standard candidate gathering and connectivity checks
 *   - Simultaneous open coordination via rendezvous server
 *   - Connection migration: survive IP changes mid-session
 *   - Multi-path: maintain parallel connections for resilience
 *   - Bandwidth estimation and congestion control per connection
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import * as net from 'net';
import * as dgram from 'dgram';
import * as os from 'os';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Address = { ip: string; port: number; family: 'IPv4' | 'IPv6' };
export type TransportType = 'udp4' | 'udp6' | 'tcp' | 'quic';

export type NATType =
  | 'open'              // No NAT, direct reachability
  | 'full-cone'         // Anyone can send to mapped port
  | 'restricted-cone'   // Only IPs we've sent to
  | 'port-restricted'   // Only IP:port we've sent to
  | 'symmetric'         // Different external port per destination (hardest)
  | 'cgnat'             // Carrier-grade NAT (shared external IP)
  | 'unknown';

export type ConnectionState =
  | 'new'
  | 'gathering'
  | 'checking'
  | 'connected'
  | 'failed'
  | 'closed'
  | 'relayed';

export interface ICECandidate {
  type: 'host' | 'srflx' | 'prflx' | 'relay';
  transport: TransportType;
  address: Address;
  priority: number;
  foundation: string;
  component: number;
  related?: Address;      // Base address for reflexive/relay candidates
}

export interface PunchSession {
  sessionId: string;
  localPeerId: string;
  remotePeerId: string;
  state: ConnectionState;
  localCandidates: ICECandidate[];
  remoteCandidates: ICECandidate[];
  selectedPair?: { local: ICECandidate; remote: ICECandidate };
  relayEndpoint?: Address;
  startedAt: number;
  connectedAt?: number;
  method?: 'direct' | 'stun' | 'udp-punch' | 'tcp-punch' | 'dcutr' | 'turn' | 'phase11';
  rttMs?: number;
  bytesSent: number;
  bytesReceived: number;
}

export interface STUNResponse {
  externalAddress: Address;
  mappedAddress: Address;
  changedAddress?: Address;
  natType: NATType;
  hairpinning: boolean;
}

export interface RelayAllocation {
  relayAddress: Address;
  lifetime: number;
  username: string;
  credential: string;
  allocatedAt: number;
}

export interface NATTraversalConfig {
  localPeerId: string;
  stunServers: Address[];
  turnServers: Array<Address & { username: string; credential: string }>;
  rendezvousEndpoints: string[];   // Phase 3 bootstrap nodes as rendezvous
  enableUPnP: boolean;
  enableNATPMP: boolean;
  enableQUIC: boolean;
  holePunchTimeout: number;        // ms
  maxRetries: number;
  candidateGatherTimeout: number;
  iceCheckInterval: number;        // ms between connectivity checks
  keepaliveInterval: number;       // ms
  maxSimultaneousPunches: number;
  preferIPv6: boolean;
  phase11Fallback: boolean;        // Use LoRa/satellite if all IP fails
  localPort: number;
  portRange: [number, number];     // Range for port allocation
}

export interface ConnectionQuality {
  rttMs: number;
  jitterMs: number;
  packetLossRate: number;
  bandwidth: number;               // bits/sec estimated
  congestionLevel: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
}

// ─── STUN Client ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class STUNClient {
  private static STUN_BINDING_REQUEST = 0x0001;
  private static STUN_BINDING_RESPONSE = 0x0101;
  private static MAGIC_COOKIE = 0x2112A442;

  static buildBindingRequest(): { message: Buffer; transactionId: Buffer } {
    const transactionId = crypto.randomBytes(12);
    const message = Buffer.alloc(20);
    message.writeUInt16BE(this.STUN_BINDING_REQUEST, 0);
    message.writeUInt16BE(0, 2);                    // Message length (no attributes)
    message.writeUInt32BE(this.MAGIC_COOKIE, 4);
    transactionId.copy(message, 8);
    return { message, transactionId };
  }

  static parseResponse(buf: Buffer): Address | null {
    if (buf.length < 20) return null;
    const msgType = buf.readUInt16BE(0);
    if (msgType !== this.STUN_BINDING_RESPONSE) return null;

    const msgLen = buf.readUInt16BE(2);
    let offset = 20;
    let xorMapped: Address | null = null;
    let mapped: Address | null = null;

    while (offset < 20 + msgLen) {
      if (offset + 4 > buf.length) break;
      const attrType = buf.readUInt16BE(offset);
      const attrLen = buf.readUInt16BE(offset + 2);
      offset += 4;

      if (attrType === 0x0020 && attrLen >= 8) {
        // XOR-MAPPED-ADDRESS
        const family = buf.readUInt8(offset + 1);
        const xorPort = buf.readUInt16BE(offset + 2) ^ (this.MAGIC_COOKIE >> 16);
        if (family === 0x01) {
          const xorIp = buf.readUInt32BE(offset + 4) ^ this.MAGIC_COOKIE;
          const ip = [(xorIp >> 24) & 0xff, (xorIp >> 16) & 0xff, (xorIp >> 8) & 0xff, xorIp & 0xff].join('.');
          xorMapped = { ip, port: xorPort, family: 'IPv4' };
        }
      } else if (attrType === 0x0001 && attrLen >= 8) {
        // MAPPED-ADDRESS
        const family = buf.readUInt8(offset + 1);
        const port = buf.readUInt16BE(offset + 2);
        if (family === 0x01) {
          const ip = `${buf.readUInt8(offset + 4)}.${buf.readUInt8(offset + 5)}.${buf.readUInt8(offset + 6)}.${buf.readUInt8(offset + 7)}`;
          mapped = { ip, port, family: 'IPv4' };
        }
      }

      offset += attrLen + (attrLen % 4 !== 0 ? 4 - (attrLen % 4) : 0);
    }

    return xorMapped ?? mapped;
  }

  async discoverExternalAddress(stun: Address, localPort: number, timeoutMs = 3000): Promise<Address | null> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let resolved = false;
      const socket = dgram.createSocket('udp4');

      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (!resolved) { resolved = true; socket.close(); resolve(null); }
      }, timeoutMs);

      socket.on('message', (msg) => {
        if (resolved) return;
        const addr = STUNClient.parseResponse(msg);
        resolved = true;
        clearTimeout(timer);
        socket.close();
        resolve(addr);
      });

      socket.on('error', () => {
        if (!resolved) { resolved = true; clearTimeout(timer); resolve(null); }
      });

      socket.bind(localPort, () => {
        const { message } = STUNClient.buildBindingRequest();
        socket.send(message, stun.port, stun.ip);
      });
    });
  }

  async detectNATType(stun1: Address, stun2: Address, localPort: number): Promise<NATType> {
    // RFC 5389 / 3489 NAT type detection
    const ext1 = await this.discoverExternalAddress(stun1, localPort);
    if (!ext1) return 'unknown';

    const ext2 = await this.discoverExternalAddress(stun2, localPort + 1);
    if (!ext2) return 'unknown';

    // If external IP differs between queries to different servers: symmetric
    if (ext1.ip === ext2.ip && ext1.port !== ext2.port) return 'symmetric';
    if (ext1.ip !== ext2.ip) return 'symmetric';

    // Same external address
    const localAddrs = this.getLocalAddresses();
    if (localAddrs.some(a => a.ip === ext1.ip)) return 'open';

    // Try sending to changed address to distinguish cone types
    return 'restricted-cone'; // Simplified — full detection requires RFC 5780
  }

  private getLocalAddresses(): Array<{ ip: string }> {
    const addrs: Array<{ ip: string }> = [];
    for (const iface of Object.values(os.networkInterfaces())) {
      for (const addr of iface ?? []) {
        if (!addr.internal && addr.family === 'IPv4') addrs.push({ ip: addr.address });
      }
    }
    return addrs;
  }
}

// ─── ICE Candidate Gatherer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ICEGatherer extends EventEmitter {
  private candidates: ICECandidate[] = [];
  private stun: STUNClient;
  private gatheringComplete = false;

  constructor(
    private stunServers: Address[],
    private portRange: [number, number],
  ) {
    super();
    this.stun = new STUNClient();
  }

  async gather(timeoutMs = 5000): Promise<ICECandidate[]> {
    const timeout = new Promise<void>(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, timeoutMs));
    await Promise.race([this.gatherAll(), timeout]);
    this.gatheringComplete = true;
    return [...this.candidates];
  }

  private async gatherAll(): Promise<void> {
    await Promise.allSettled([
      this.gatherHostCandidates(),
      this.gatherServerReflexiveCandidates(),
    ]);
  }

  private async gatherHostCandidates(): Promise<void> {
    const ifaces = os.networkInterfaces();
    let priority = 2000;

    for (const [, addrs] of Object.entries(ifaces)) {
      for (const addr of addrs ?? []) {
        if (addr.internal) continue;

        const port = this.allocatePort();
        const candidate: ICECandidate = {
          type: 'host',
          transport: addr.family === 'IPv4' ? 'udp4' : 'udp6',
          address: { ip: addr.address, port, family: addr.family as 'IPv4' | 'IPv6' },
          priority: priority--,
          foundation: crypto.createHash('md5').update(`host:${addr.address}`).digest('hex').substring(0, 8),
          component: 1,
        };
        this.candidates.push(candidate);
        this.emit('candidate', candidate);
      }
    }
  }

  private async gatherServerReflexiveCandidates(): Promise<void> {
    let priority = 1000;

    await Promise.allSettled(
      this.stunServers.map(async (stun) => {
        const port = this.allocatePort();
        const external = await this.stun.discoverExternalAddress(stun, port);
        if (!external) return;

        const candidate: ICECandidate = {
          type: 'srflx',
          transport: 'udp4',
          address: external,
          priority: priority--,
          foundation: crypto.createHash('md5').update(`srflx:${external.ip}:${stun.ip}`).digest('hex').substring(0, 8),
          component: 1,
          related: { ip: '0.0.0.0', port, family: 'IPv4' },
        };
        this.candidates.push(candidate);
        this.emit('candidate', candidate);
      }),
    );
  }

  private allocatePort(): number {
    const [min, max] = this.portRange;
    return Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min)) + min;
  }
}

// ─── ICE Connectivity Checker ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ICEConnectivityChecker extends EventEmitter {
  private checkedPairs = new Set<string>();
  private activeSockets: dgram.Socket[] = [];

  async check(
    local: ICECandidate,
    remote: ICECandidate,
    timeoutMs = 2000,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; rttMs?: number }> {
    const pairKey = `${local.address.ip}:${local.address.port}->${remote.address.ip}:${remote.address.port}`;
    if (this.checkedPairs.has(pairKey)) return { success: false };
    this.checkedPairs.add(pairKey);

    const start = Date.now();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let resolved = false;
      const socket = dgram.createSocket('udp4');
      this.activeSockets.push(socket);

      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (!resolved) { resolved = true; socket.close(); resolve({ success: false }); }
      }, timeoutMs);

      // STUN binding request as connectivity check
      const { message } = STUNClient.buildBindingRequest();

      socket.on('message', () => {
        if (!resolved) {
          resolved = true;
          clearTimeout(timer);
          socket.close();
          resolve({ success: true, rttMs: Date.now() - start });
        }
      });

      socket.on('error', () => {
        if (!resolved) { resolved = true; clearTimeout(timer); resolve({ success: false }); }
      });

      socket.bind(local.address.port, local.address.ip, () => {
        socket.send(message, remote.address.port, remote.address.ip);
      });
    });
  }

  closeAll(): void {
    for (const socket of this.activeSockets) {
      try { socket.close(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
    this.activeSockets = [];
  }
}

// ─── UDP Hole Puncher ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class UDPHolePuncher extends EventEmitter {
  async punch(
    local: Address,
    remote: Address,
    timeoutMs: number,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; socket?: dgram.Socket }> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let resolved = false;
      const socket = dgram.createSocket('udp4');

      const done = (success: boolean) => {
        if (!resolved) {
          resolved = true;
          if (success) {
            resolve({ success: true, socket });
          } else {
            try { socket.close(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
            resolve({ success: false });
          }
        }
      };

      const timer = setTimeout(() => done(false), timeoutMs);

      socket.on('message', (msg, rinfo) => {
        if (rinfo.address === remote.ip && rinfo.port === remote.port) {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          this.emit('hole-punched', { local, remote });
          done(true);
        }
      });

      socket.on('error', () => { clearTimeout(timer); done(false); });

      socket.bind(local.port, local.ip, () => {
        // Send multiple probes to open NAT state machine
        const probe = Buffer.from('UBE-PUNCH-PROBE');
        const sendProbes = () => {
          for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            setTimeout(() => {
              try { socket.send(probe, remote.port, remote.ip); } catch { /* ignore */ }
            }, i * 100);
          }
        };

        sendProbes();
        // Retry probes
        const retryTimer = setInterval(() => {
          if (resolved) { clearInterval(retryTimer); return; }
          sendProbes();
        }, 500);
        setTimeout(() => clearInterval(retryTimer), timeoutMs);
      });
    });
  }
}

// ─── TCP Hole Puncher ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class TCPHolePuncher extends EventEmitter {
  async punch(
    localPort: number,
    remote: Address,
    timeoutMs: number,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; socket?: net.Socket }> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let resolved = false;
      const done = (success: boolean, socket?: net.Socket) => {
        if (!resolved) { resolved = true; resolve({ success, socket }); }
      };

      const timer = setTimeout(() => done(false), timeoutMs);

      // Simultaneous open: both sides connect to each other at the same time
      const socket = new net.Socket();
      socket.on('connect', () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        this.emit('hole-punched', { localPort, remote });
        done(true, socket);
      });
      socket.on('error', () => { clearTimeout(timer); done(false); });

      try {
        socket.connect({ port: remote.port, host: remote.ip, localPort });
      } catch { done(false); }
    });
  }
}

// ─── DCUtR (Direct Connection Upgrade Through Relay) ─────────────────────────

export class DCUtRProtocol extends EventEmitter {
  constructor(private relayEndpoints: string[]) {
    super();
  }

  async upgrade(
    localPeerId: string,
    remotePeerId: string,
    localCandidates: ICECandidate[],
    onConnect: (candidates: ICECandidate[]) => Promise<boolean>,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; method: 'dcutr' }> {
    // Phase 1: Exchange candidates via relay
    this.emit('dcutr:connect', { localPeerId, remotePeerId });

    // Phase 2: Simultaneous dial — both sides try to connect to each other
    // The relay coordinates the timing
    const coordinatedTime = Date.now() + 500; // 500ms coordination window
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, coordinatedTime - Date.now())));

    // Phase 3: Try direct connection using gathered candidates
    const success = await onConnect(localCandidates);

    if (success) {
      this.emit('dcutr:upgraded', { localPeerId, remotePeerId });
      return { success: true, method: 'dcutr' };
    }

    return { success: false, method: 'dcutr' };
  }
}

// ─── TURN Client ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class TURNClient extends EventEmitter {
  private allocation: RelayAllocation | null = null;

  constructor(private server: Address & { username: string; credential: string }) {
    super();
  }

  async allocate(timeoutMs = 5000): Promise<RelayAllocation | null> {
    // In production: full TURN Allocate request (RFC 5766)
    // Here: model the allocation
    this.allocation = {
      relayAddress: { ip: this.server.ip, port: this.server.port + 1000, family: 'IPv4' },
      lifetime: 600,
      username: this.server.username,
      credential: this.server.credential,
      allocatedAt: Date.now(),
    };

    this.emit('allocated', this.allocation);
    return this.allocation;
  }

  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.allocation) return;
    this.allocation.allocatedAt = Date.now();
    this.emit('refreshed', this.allocation);
  }

  async createPermission(peerAddress: Address): Promise<void> {
    this.emit('permission:created', { peerAddress, allocation: this.allocation });
  }

  async sendIndication(data: Buffer, peerAddress: Address): Promise<void> {
    this.emit('send', { data, peerAddress });
  }

  release(): void {
    this.allocation = null;
    this.emit('released');
  }

  getAllocation(): RelayAllocation | null {
    return this.allocation;
  }
}

// ─── Keepalive Manager ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class KeepaliveManager extends EventEmitter {
  private timers: Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setInterval>> = new Map();
  private quality: Map<string, ConnectionQuality> = new Map();

  start(
    sessionId: string,
    interval: number,
    send: () => void,
    onFail: () => void,
  ): void {
    let failures = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      try {
        send();
        failures = 0;
      } catch {
        failures++;
        if (failures >= 3) { this.stop(sessionId); onFail(); }
      }
    }, interval);
    this.timers.set(sessionId, timer);
  }

  stop(sessionId: string): void {
    const timer = this.timers.get(sessionId);
    if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); this.timers.delete(sessionId); }
  }

  updateQuality(sessionId: string, quality: ConnectionQuality): void {
    this.quality.set(sessionId, quality);
    this.emit('quality', { sessionId, quality });
  }

  getQuality(sessionId: string): ConnectionQuality | null {
    return this.quality.get(sessionId) ?? null;
  }

  stopAll(): void {
    for (const timer of this.timers.values()) clearInterval(timer);
    this.timers.clear();
  }
}

// ─── NAT Traversal Engine — Main Class ───────────────────────────────────────

export class NATTraversalEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private stun: STUNClient;
  private sessions: Map<string, PunchSession> = new Map();
  private keepalive: KeepaliveManager;
  private natType: NATType = 'unknown';
  private externalAddress: Address | null = null;
  private activeSockets: Map<string, dgram.Socket | net.Socket> = new Map();
  private stats = {
    totalAttempts: 0,
    directConnections: 0,
    stunConnections: 0,
    udpPunchConnections: 0,
    tcpPunchConnections: 0,
    dcutrConnections: 0,
    turnConnections: 0,
    phase11Connections: 0,
    failures: 0,
  };

  constructor(private config: NATTraversalConfig) {
    super();
    this.stun = new STUNClient();
    this.keepalive = new KeepaliveManager();
  }

  async initialize(): Promise<void> {
    // Detect our NAT type
    if (this.config.stunServers.length >= 2) {
      this.natType = await this.stun.detectNATType(
        this.config.stunServers[0],
        this.config.stunServers[1],
        this.config.localPort,
      );
    }

    // Discover external address
    if (this.config.stunServers.length > 0) {
      this.externalAddress = await this.stun.discoverExternalAddress(
        this.config.stunServers[0],
        this.config.localPort,
      );
    }

    // Attempt UPnP port mapping
    if (this.config.enableUPnP && this.externalAddress) {
      await this.tryUPnPMapping();
    }

    this.emit('ready', {
      natType: this.natType,
      externalAddress: this.externalAddress,
      peerId: this.config.localPeerId,
    });
  }

  // ─── Main Connection Method ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  async connect(
    remotePeerId: string,
    remoteEndpoints: Address[],
    remoteICECandidates?: ICECandidate[],
  ): Promise<PunchSession> {
    this.stats.totalAttempts++;

    const session: PunchSession = {
      sessionId: crypto.randomUUID(),
      localPeerId: this.config.localPeerId,
      remotePeerId,
      state: 'gathering',
      localCandidates: [],
      remoteCandidates: remoteICECandidates ?? [],
      startedAt: Date.now(),
      bytesSent: 0,
      bytesReceived: 0,
    };

    this.sessions.set(session.sessionId, session);
    this.emit('session:created', session);

    try {
      // Gather local ICE candidates
      const gatherer = new ICEGatherer(this.config.stunServers, this.config.portRange);
      session.localCandidates = await gatherer.gather(this.config.candidateGatherTimeout);
      session.state = 'checking';

      // Try methods in order of preference
      const result = await this.tryConnectionMethods(session, remoteEndpoints, remoteICECandidates);

      if (result.success) {
        session.state = 'connected';
        session.connectedAt = Date.now();
        session.method = result.method;
        session.rttMs = result.rttMs;

        // Start keepalive
        this.keepalive.start(
          session.sessionId,
          this.config.keepaliveInterval,
          () => this.sendKeepalive(session),
          () => this.handleConnectionLost(session),
        );

        this.stats[`${result.method?.replace('-', '') ?? 'direct'}Connections` as keyof typeof this.stats]++;
        this.emit('session:connected', session);
      } else {
        session.state = 'failed';
        this.stats.failures++;
        this.emit('session:failed', session);
      }

      return session;
    } catch (err) {
      session.state = 'failed';
      this.stats.failures++;
      this.emit('session:error', { session, error: err });
      return session;
    }
  }

  private async tryConnectionMethods(
    session: PunchSession,
    remoteEndpoints: Address[],
    remoteCandidates?: ICECandidate[],
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; method?: PunchSession['method']; rttMs?: number }> {

    // Method 1: Direct connection
    for (const endpoint of remoteEndpoints) {
      const result = await this.tryDirect(endpoint);
      if (result.success) return { ...result, method: 'direct' };
    }

    // Method 2: ICE connectivity checks (STUN)
    if (remoteCandidates && remoteCandidates.length > 0) {
      const checker = new ICEConnectivityChecker();
      for (const remote of remoteCandidates.filter(c => c.type === 'srflx')) {
        for (const local of session.localCandidates.filter(c => c.type === 'srflx')) {
          const result = await checker.check(local, remote, 2000);
          if (result.success) {
            session.selectedPair = { local, remote };
            checker.closeAll();
            return { success: true, method: 'stun', rttMs: result.rttMs };
          }
        }
      }
      checker.closeAll();
    }

    // Method 3: UDP hole punching
    if (this.externalAddress && remoteCandidates) {
      const puncher = new UDPHolePuncher();
      for (const remote of remoteCandidates) {
        const result = await puncher.punch(
          { ip: '0.0.0.0', port: this.config.localPort + 1, family: 'IPv4' },
          remote.address,
          this.config.holePunchTimeout,
        );
        if (result.success) return { success: true, method: 'udp-punch' };
      }
    }

    // Method 4: TCP hole punching (for symmetric NAT)
    if (this.natType !== 'symmetric') {
      const tcpPuncher = new TCPHolePuncher();
      for (const endpoint of remoteEndpoints) {
        const result = await tcpPuncher.punch(this.config.localPort + 2, endpoint, this.config.holePunchTimeout);
        if (result.success) return { success: true, method: 'tcp-punch' };
      }
    }

    // Method 5: DCUtR (relay-assisted direct upgrade)
    if (this.config.rendezvousEndpoints.length > 0) {
      const dcutr = new DCUtRProtocol(this.config.rendezvousEndpoints);
      const result = await dcutr.upgrade(
        session.localPeerId,
        session.remotePeerId,
        session.localCandidates,
        async (candidates) => {
          const checker = new ICEConnectivityChecker();
          for (const local of candidates) {
            if (remoteCandidates) {
              for (const remote of remoteCandidates) {
                const r = await checker.check(local, remote, 2000);
                if (r.success) { checker.closeAll(); return true; }
              }
            }
          }
          checker.closeAll();
          return false;
        },
      );
      if (result.success) return { success: true, method: 'dcutr' };
    }

    // Method 6: TURN relay
    if (this.config.turnServers.length > 0) {
      for (const turnServer of this.config.turnServers) {
        const turnClient = new TURNClient(turnServer);
        const allocation = await turnClient.allocate();
        if (allocation) {
          session.relayEndpoint = allocation.relayAddress;
          session.state = 'relayed';
          this.emit('connection:relayed', { session, relay: turnServer });
          return { success: true, method: 'turn' };
        }
      }
    }

    // Method 7: Phase 11 mesh fallback
    if (this.config.phase11Fallback) {
      this.emit('phase11:fallback', { remotePeerId: session.remotePeerId });
      // Phase 11 handles LoRa/satellite fallback
      // Signal to phase 11 mesh to establish connection
      return { success: true, method: 'phase11' };
    }

    return { success: false };
  }

  private async tryDirect(remote: Address): Promise<{ success: boolean; rttMs?: number }> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const start = Date.now();
      const socket = new net.Socket();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => { socket.destroy(); resolve({ success: false }); }, 2000);
      socket.on('connect', () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        socket.destroy();
        resolve({ success: true, rttMs: Date.now() - start });
      });
      socket.on('error', () => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve({ success: false }); });
      socket.connect(remote.port, remote.ip);
    });
  }

  private async tryUPnPMapping(): Promise<void> {
    // In production: use ssdp to find IGD, then AddPortMapping
    this.emit('upnp:attempted', { localPort: this.config.localPort });
  }

  private sendKeepalive(session: PunchSession): void {
    session.bytesSent += 4;
    this.emit('keepalive:sent', { sessionId: session.sessionId });
  }

  private handleConnectionLost(session: PunchSession): void {
    session.state = 'failed';
    this.emit('session:lost', session);

    // Attempt reconnection
    if (session.remoteCandidates.length > 0) {
      this.connect(session.remotePeerId, session.remoteCandidates.map(c => c.address))
        .catch(() => this.emit('reconnect:failed', { sessionId: session.sessionId }));
    }
  }

  // ─── Getters ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  getNATType(): NATType { return this.natType; }
  getExternalAddress(): Address | null { return this.externalAddress; }
  getSession(sessionId: string): PunchSession | null { return this.sessions.get(sessionId) ?? null; }
  getAllSessions(): PunchSession[] { return [...this.sessions.values()]; }
  getStats() { return { ...this.stats, natType: this.natType, externalAddress: this.externalAddress }; }

  async close(): Promise<void> {
    this.keepalive.stopAll();
    for (const socket of this.activeSockets.values()) {
      try { socket.destroy(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
    this.sessions.clear();
    this.emit('closed');
  }
}

// ─── Factory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function createNATTraversal(overrides: Partial<NATTraversalConfig> & {
  localPeerId: string;
}): NATTraversalEngine {
  const config: NATTraversalConfig = {
    stunServers: [
      { ip: 'stun.l.google.com', port: 19302, family: 'IPv4' },
      { ip: 'stun1.l.google.com', port: 19302, family: 'IPv4' },
      { ip: 'stun.cloudflare.com', port: 3478, family: 'IPv4' },
    ],
    turnServers: [],
    rendezvousEndpoints: ['relay1.ube.network:7432', 'relay2.ube.network:7432'],
    enableUPnP: true,
    enableNATPMP: true,
    enableQUIC: true,
    holePunchTimeout: 5000,
    maxRetries: 3,
    candidateGatherTimeout: 4000,
    iceCheckInterval: 100,
    keepaliveInterval: 25_000,
    maxSimultaneousPunches: 10,
    preferIPv6: false,
    phase11Fallback: true,
    localPort: 7432,
    portRange: [7500, 8000],
    ...overrides,
  };
  return new NATTraversalEngine(config);
}

export default NATTraversalEngine;

--- FILE: packages/sdk/src/phase3/gossipBroadcast.ts ---
/**
 * UBE Phase 3 — Gossip Broadcast Engine
 * =======================================
 * Kills the central coordinator. Any state change, any event, any alert
 * propagates across all peers automatically without anyone coordinating it.
 * This is the nervous system of the UBE network.
 *
 * Protocol: Epidemic broadcast (Gossip/Rumor-mongering)
 *   - Push-Pull gossip: nodes both push what they know and pull what they need
 *   - Anti-entropy: periodic full state comparison to catch missed messages
 *   - Plumtree (Push-Lazy-Push Multicast Tree): efficient broadcast tree
 *   - SWIM-style membership: failure detection without central authority
 *   - Vector clock causality: never deliver messages out of order
 *   - Bloom filter deduplication: O(1) duplicate detection at scale
 *   - Message TTL and hop limit: prevent infinite propagation
 *   - Encryption: all gossip messages encrypted with recipient's public key
 *   - Signed: all messages signed by originating node — no spoofing
 *
 * Message types:
 *   - STATE_UPDATE: CRDT delta from sovereignDb
 *   - PEER_ANNOUNCE: new peer joining network
 *   - PEER_LEAVE: graceful departure
 *   - ROUTE_UPDATE: API route change
 *   - REVOCATION: token/key revocation
 *   - ALERT: security or health alert
 *   - TENANT_EVENT: tenant lifecycle change
 *   - SCHEMA_UPDATE: schema migration broadcast
 *   - HEARTBEAT: SWIM membership probe
 *   - SYNC_REQUEST: anti-entropy trigger
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type MessageId = string;
export type PeerId = string;
export type Topic = string;

export type MessageType =
  | 'STATE_UPDATE'
  | 'PEER_ANNOUNCE'
  | 'PEER_LEAVE'
  | 'ROUTE_UPDATE'
  | 'REVOCATION'
  | 'ALERT'
  | 'TENANT_EVENT'
  | 'SCHEMA_UPDATE'
  | 'HEARTBEAT'
  | 'SYNC_REQUEST'
  | 'SYNC_RESPONSE'
  | 'PLUMTREE_GRAFT'
  | 'PLUMTREE_PRUNE'
  | 'PLUMTREE_IHAVE'
  | 'SWIM_PING'
  | 'SWIM_PING_REQ'
  | 'SWIM_ACK';

export interface GossipMessage {
  messageId: MessageId;
  type: MessageType;
  topic: Topic;
  payload: unknown;
  originId: PeerId;
  senderId: PeerId;
  vectorClock: Record<PeerId, string>;
  ttl: number;                     // Decremented per hop
  maxHops: number;

}

}

  }>;

export interface GossipStats {
