// ─── Local Route Registry ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class LocalRouteRegistry {
  private handlers: Map<string, { capability: ServiceCapability; handler: RouteHandler }> = new Map();

  register(capability: ServiceCapability, handler: RouteHandler): void {
    const key = this.routeKey(capability.methods[0], capability.pathPattern);
    this.handlers.set(key, { capability, handler });
  }

  match(method: HTTPMethod, path: string): { capability: ServiceCapability; handler: RouteHandler; params: Record<string, string> } | null {
    for (const { capability, handler } of this.handlers.values()) {
      if (!capability.methods.includes(method)) continue;
      const params = this.matchPattern(capability.pathPattern, path);
      if (params) return { capability, handler, params };
    }
    return null;
  }

  private matchPattern(pattern: string, path: string): Record<string, string> | null {
    const patternParts = pattern.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    const pathParts = path.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    if (patternParts.length !== pathParts.length) return null;

    const params: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (let i = 0; i < patternParts.length; i++) {
      if (patternParts[i].startsWith(':')) {
        params[patternParts[i].substring(1)] = decodeURIComponent(pathParts[i]);
      } else if (patternParts[i] !== pathParts[i]) {
        return null;
      }
    }
    return params;
  }

  private routeKey(method: HTTPMethod, pattern: string): string {
    return `${method}:${pattern}`;
  }

  getAllCapabilities(): ServiceCapability[] {
    return [...this.handlers.values()].map(h => h.capability);
  }
}

// ─── Remote Route Table (CRDT-backed, synced via gossip) ────────────────────

export class RemoteRouteTable extends EventEmitter {
  private routes: Map<RouteId, RouteAdvertisement> = new Map();
  private byCapability: Map<string, Set<RouteId>> = new Map();
  private cleanupTimer?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;

  start(): void {
    this.cleanupTimer = setInterval(() => this.evictExpired(), 30_000);
  }

  stop(): void {
    if (this.cleanupTimer) clearInterval(this.cleanupTimer);
  }

  upsert(route: RouteAdvertisement): void {
    this.routes.set(route.routeId, route);
    const capKey = route.capability.capabilityId;
    if (!this.byCapability.has(capKey)) this.byCapability.set(capKey, new Set());
    this.byCapability.get(capKey)!.add(route.routeId);
    this.emit('route:updated', route);
  }

  remove(routeId: RouteId): void {
    const route = this.routes.get(routeId);
    if (!route) return;
    this.routes.delete(routeId);
    this.byCapability.get(route.capability.capabilityId)?.delete(routeId);
    this.emit('route:removed', { routeId });
  }

  removeAllForPeer(peerId: PeerId): void {
    for (const [id, route] of this.routes) {
      if (route.peerId === peerId) this.remove(id);
    }
  }

  findByCapability(capabilityId: string, method: HTTPMethod, path: string): RouteAdvertisement[] {
    const routeIds = this.byCapability.get(capabilityId) ?? new Set();
    return [...routeIds]
      .map(id => this.routes.get(id))
      .filter((r): r is RouteAdvertisement => {
        if (!r) return false;
        if (!r.capability.methods.includes(method)) return false;
        return this.pathMatches(r.capability.pathPattern, path);
      });
  }

  findByPath(method: HTTPMethod, path: string): RouteAdvertisement[] {
    return [...this.routes.values()].filter(
      r => r.capability.methods.includes(method) && this.pathMatches(r.capability.pathPattern, path),
    );
  }

  private pathMatches(pattern: string, path: string): boolean {
    const patternParts = pattern.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    const pathParts = path.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    if (patternParts.length !== pathParts.length) return false;
    return patternParts.every((p, i) => p.startsWith(':') || p === pathParts[i]);
  }

  private evictExpired(): void {
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const [id, route] of this.routes) {
      if (now > route.expiresAt) this.remove(id);
    }
  }

  size(): number { return this.routes.size; }
  getAll(): RouteAdvertisement[] { return [...this.routes.values()]; }
}

// ─── Circuit Breaker ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class CircuitBreakerRegistry {
  private circuits: Map<PeerId, CircuitBreakerState> = new Map();

  constructor(private threshold: number, private cooldown: number) {}

  canAttempt(peerId: PeerId): boolean {
    const circuit = this.circuits.get(peerId);
    if (!circuit || circuit.state === 'closed') return true;
    if (circuit.state === 'open') {
      if (Date.now() > circuit.nextRetry) {
        circuit.state = 'half-open';
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    return true; // half-open: allow one attempt
  }

  recordSuccess(peerId: PeerId): void {
    const circuit = this.getOrCreate(peerId);
    circuit.successCount++;
    circuit.failureCount = 0;
    circuit.state = 'closed';
  }

  recordFailure(peerId: PeerId): void {
    const circuit = this.getOrCreate(peerId);
    circuit.failureCount++;
    circuit.lastFailure = Date.now();

    if (circuit.failureCount >= this.threshold) {
      circuit.state = 'open';
      circuit.nextRetry = Date.now() + this.cooldown;
    }
  }

  private getOrCreate(peerId: PeerId): CircuitBreakerState {
    if (!this.circuits.has(peerId)) {
      this.circuits.set(peerId, {
        peerId, state: 'closed', failureCount: 0, successCount: 0,
        lastFailure: 0, nextRetry: 0,
      });
    }
    return this.circuits.get(peerId)!;
  }

  getState(peerId: PeerId): CircuitBreakerState | null {
    return this.circuits.get(peerId) ?? null;
  }

  getOpenCount(): number {
    return [...this.circuits.values()].filter(c => c.state === 'open').length;
  }
}

// ─── Response Cache ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ResponseCache {
  private cache: Map<string, CacheEntry> = new Map();
  private accessOrder: string[] = [];

  constructor(private maxSize: number) {}

  get(key: string): GatewayResponse | null {
    const entry = this.cache.get(key);
    if (!entry) return null;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.cache.delete(key);
      return null;
    }
    this.touchLRU(key);
    return { ...entry.response, fromCache: true };
  }

  set(key: string, response: GatewayResponse, ttl: number, vectorClock: Record<string, string> = {}): void {
    if (this.cache.size >= this.maxSize && !this.cache.has(key)) {
      const oldest = this.accessOrder.shift();
      if (oldest) this.cache.delete(oldest);
    }

    this.cache.set(key, {
      key, response, cachedAt: Date.now(), expiresAt: Date.now() + ttl,
      vectorClockSnapshot: vectorClock,
    });
    this.touchLRU(key);
  }

  invalidate(keyPrefix: string): number {
    let count = 0;
    for (const key of this.cache.keys()) {
      if (key.startsWith(keyPrefix)) { this.cache.delete(key); count++; }
    }
    return count;
  }

  private touchLRU(key: string): void {
    const idx = this.accessOrder.indexOf(key);
    if (idx >= 0) this.accessOrder.splice(idx, 1);
    this.accessOrder.push(key);
  }

  static buildKey(method: HTTPMethod, path: string, query: Record<string, string>): string {
    const sortedQuery = Object.keys(query).sort().map(k => `${k}=${query[k]}`).join('&');
    return `${method}:${path}${sortedQuery ? '?' + sortedQuery : ''}`;
  }

  size(): number { return this.cache.size; }
}

// ─── Token Bucket Rate Limiter (per-DID) ──────────────────────────────────────

export class DIDRateLimiter {
  private buckets: Map<string, RateLimitBucket> = new Map();

  constructor(private defaultRPS: number) {}

  check(did: string, customLimit?: { requests: number; windowMs: number }): boolean {
    const maxTokens = customLimit ? customLimit.requests : this.defaultRPS;
    const refillRate = customLimit ? customLimit.requests / customLimit.windowMs : this.defaultRPS / 1000;

    let bucket = this.buckets.get(did);
    if (!bucket) {
      bucket = { did, tokens: maxTokens, maxTokens, refillRate, lastRefill: Date.now() };
      this.buckets.set(did, bucket);
    }

    const now = Date.now();
    const elapsed = now - bucket.lastRefill;
    bucket.tokens = Math.min(bucket.maxTokens, bucket.tokens + elapsed * bucket.refillRate);
    bucket.lastRefill = now;

    if (bucket.tokens >= 1) {
      bucket.tokens -= 1;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  reset(did: string): void {
    this.buckets.delete(did);
  }
}

// ─── Request/Response Signer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class GatewaySigner {
  constructor(private privateKey: Buffer) {}

  signRequest(req: Omit<GatewayRequest, 'signature'>): string {
    const canonical = JSON.stringify({ ...req, signature: undefined });
    return crypto.createHmac('sha256', this.privateKey).update(canonical).digest('hex');
  }

  signResponse(res: Omit<GatewayResponse, 'signature'>): string {
    const canonical = JSON.stringify({ ...res, signature: undefined });
    return crypto.createHmac('sha256', this.privateKey).update(canonical).digest('hex');
  }

  verify(payload: Record<string, unknown>, signature: string, publicKey: Buffer): boolean {
    const canonical = JSON.stringify(payload);
    const expected = crypto.createHmac('sha256', publicKey).update(canonical).digest('hex');
    try {
      return crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(signature, 'hex'), Buffer.from(expected, 'hex'));
    } catch { return false; }
  }
}

// ─── Load Balancer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class LoadBalancer {
  private roundRobinCursor: Map<string, number> = new Map();

  select(
    routes: RouteAdvertisement[],
    strategy: 'round-robin' | 'weighted' | 'least-latency' | 'health-aware' = 'health-aware',
  ): RouteAdvertisement | null {
    if (routes.length === 0) return null;
    if (routes.length === 1) return routes[0];

    if (strategy === 'health-aware') {
      return routes.reduce((best, r) => (r.healthScore > best.healthScore ? r : best), routes[0]);
    }

    if (strategy === 'weighted') {
      const totalWeight = routes.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.weight, 0);
      let rand = Math.random() * totalWeight;
      for (const r of routes) {
        rand -= r.weight;
        if (rand <= 0) return r;
      }
      return routes[routes.length - 1];
    }

    if (strategy === 'round-robin') {
      const key = routes[0].capability.capabilityId;
      const cursor = (this.roundRobinCursor.get(key) ?? 0) % routes.length;
      this.roundRobinCursor.set(key, cursor + 1);
      return routes[cursor];
    }

    // least-latency would need RTT tracking; fall back to health
    return routes.reduce((best, r) => (r.healthScore > best.healthScore ? r : best), routes[0]);
  }
}

// ─── P2P API Gateway — Main Class ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class P2PApiGateway extends EventEmitter {
  private localRegistry = new LocalRouteRegistry();
  private remoteRoutes = new RemoteRouteTable();
  private circuitBreakers: CircuitBreakerRegistry;
  private cache: ResponseCache;
  private rateLimiter: DIDRateLimiter;
  private signer: GatewaySigner;
  private loadBalancer = new LoadBalancer();
  private httpServer?: http.Server;
  private advertiseTimer?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
  private stats: GatewayStats = {
    totalRequests: 0, localServed: 0, remoteServed: 0, cacheHits: 0,
    errors: 0, avgLatencyMs: 0, activeRoutes: 0, circuitsOpen: 0, rateLimited: 0,
  };
  private latencySamples: number[] = [];

  constructor(
    private config: GatewayConfig,
    private didAuth: DIDAuthProvider,
    private gossip: GossipProvider,
    private natTraversal: NATTraversalProvider,
    private privateKey: Buffer,
  ) {
    super();
    this.circuitBreakers = new CircuitBreakerRegistry(config.circuitBreakerThreshold, config.circuitBreakerCooldown);
    this.cache = new ResponseCache(config.cacheMaxSize);
    this.rateLimiter = new DIDRateLimiter(config.rateLimitDefaultRPS);
    this.signer = new GatewaySigner(privateKey);

    // Listen for gossiped route updates — replaces central route registry
    this.gossip.on('topic:routes', (msg: unknown) => {
      const m = msg as { type: string; payload: RouteAdvertisement | { peerId: PeerId } };
      if (m.type === 'ROUTE_UPDATE') {
        this.remoteRoutes.upsert(m.payload as RouteAdvertisement);
      } else if (m.type === 'PEER_LEAVE') {
        this.remoteRoutes.removeAllForPeer((m.payload as { peerId: PeerId }).peerId);
      }
    });
  }

  async initialize(): Promise<void> {
    this.remoteRoutes.start();
    this.startHttpServer();

    // Periodically re-advertise our local capabilities to the network
    this.advertiseTimer = setInterval(() => this.advertiseLocalCapabilities(), this.config.reAdvertiseInterval);
    await this.advertiseLocalCapabilities();

    this.emit('ready', { nodeId: this.config.nodeId, peerId: this.config.peerId, port: this.config.localPort });
  }

  // ─── Route Registration (local handlers) ──────────────────────────────────

  registerRoute(capability: ServiceCapability, handler: RouteHandler): void {
    this.localRegistry.register(capability, handler);
    this.emit('route:registered', { capabilityId: capability.capabilityId });
  }

  private async advertiseLocalCapabilities(): Promise<void> {
    const capabilities = this.localRegistry.getAllCapabilities();

    for (const capability of capabilities) {
      const routeId = `${this.config.peerId}:${capability.capabilityId}`;
      const advertisement: Omit<RouteAdvertisement, 'signature'> = {
        routeId,
        peerId: this.config.peerId,
        capability,
        endpoint: `${this.config.bindAddress}:${this.config.localPort}`,
        weight: 100,
        healthScore: 100,
        region: this.config.region,
        advertisedAt: Date.now(),
        expiresAt: Date.now() + this.config.routeTTL,
      };

      const signature = crypto.createHmac('sha256', this.privateKey)
        .update(JSON.stringify(advertisement)).digest('hex');

      const full: RouteAdvertisement = { ...advertisement, signature };
      this.remoteRoutes.upsert(full); // Also track our own route locally

      await this.gossip.broadcast({
        type: 'ROUTE_UPDATE',
        topic: 'routes',
        payload: full,
        priority: 'normal',
      });
    }
  }

  // ─── HTTP Server (local entry point) ───────────────────────────────────────

  private startHttpServer(): void {
    this.httpServer = http.createServer((req, res) => this.handleHttpRequest(req, res));
    this.httpServer.listen(this.config.localPort, this.config.bindAddress, () => {
      this.emit('listening', { port: this.config.localPort, address: this.config.bindAddress });
    });
  }

  private async handleHttpRequest(httpReq: http.IncomingMessage, httpRes: http.ServerResponse): Promise<void> {
    const start = Date.now();
    this.stats.totalRequests++;

    if (this.config.corsEnabled) {
      httpRes.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
      httpRes.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET,POST,PUT,PATCH,DELETE,OPTIONS');
      httpRes.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type,Authorization');
      if (httpReq.method === 'OPTIONS') { httpRes.writeHead(204); httpRes.end(); return; }
    }

    try {
      const url = new URL(httpReq.url ?? '/', `http://${httpReq.headers.host ?? 'localhost'}`);
      const body = await this.readBody(httpReq);

      const query: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const [k, v] of url.searchParams) query[k] = v;

      const gatewayReq: Omit<GatewayRequest, 'signature'> = {
        requestId: crypto.randomUUID(),
        method: (httpReq.method ?? 'GET') as HTTPMethod,
        path: url.pathname,
        headers: this.flattenHeaders(httpReq.headers),
        body,
        query,
        originPeerId: this.config.peerId,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      const signature = this.signer.signRequest(gatewayReq);
      const response = await this.route({ ...gatewayReq, signature });

      httpRes.writeHead(response.statusCode, response.headers);
      httpRes.end(response.body ? JSON.stringify(response.body) : undefined);
    } catch (err) {
      this.stats.errors++;
      httpRes.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
      httpRes.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Internal gateway error', message: (err as Error).message }));
    } finally {
      this.recordLatency(Date.now() - start);
    }
  }

  private flattenHeaders(headers: http.IncomingHttpHeaders): Record<string, string> {
    const flat: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(headers)) {
      if (typeof v === 'string') flat[k] = v;
      else if (Array.isArray(v)) flat[k] = v.join(', ');
    }
    return flat;
  }

  private async readBody(req: http.IncomingMessage): Promise<unknown> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      let data = '';
      let size = 0;
      req.on('data', (chunk) => {
        size += chunk.length;
        if (size > this.config.maxBodySize) {
          reject(new Error('Body too large'));
          req.destroy();
          return;
        }
        data += chunk;
      });
      req.on('end', () => {
        if (!data) return resolve(undefined);
        try { resolve(JSON.parse(data)); } catch { resolve(data); }
      });
      req.on('error', reject);
    });
  }

  // ─── Core Routing Logic ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async route(req: GatewayRequest): Promise<GatewayResponse> {
    const start = Date.now();

    // Authentication
    let ctx: RequestContext = { capabilities: [], nodeId: this.config.nodeId };
    const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];

    const localMatch = this.localRegistry.match(req.method, req.path);

    if (localMatch?.capability.authRequired && authHeader) {
      const authResult = this.didAuth.verifyToken(authHeader, localMatch.capability.requiredCapabilities);
      if (!authResult.success) {
        return this.errorResponse(req.requestId, 403, authResult.error ?? 'Unauthorized', start);
      }
      ctx = { did: authResult.did, capabilities: authResult.capabilities ?? [], nodeId: this.config.nodeId };
    } else if (localMatch?.capability.authRequired && !authHeader) {
      return this.errorResponse(req.requestId, 401, 'Missing authorization', start);
    }

    // Rate limiting
    if (ctx.did) {
      const allowed = this.rateLimiter.check(ctx.did, localMatch?.capability.rateLimit);
      if (!allowed) {
        this.stats.rateLimited++;
        return this.errorResponse(req.requestId, 429, 'Rate limit exceeded', start);
      }
    }

    // Cache check
    if (localMatch?.capability.cacheable && req.method === 'GET') {
      const cacheKey = ResponseCache.buildKey(req.method, req.path, req.query);
      const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey);
      if (cached) {
        this.stats.cacheHits++;
        return { ...cached, requestId: req.requestId };
      }
    }

    // 1. Try local handler first
    if (localMatch) {
      try {
        const result = await localMatch.handler(req, ctx);
        const response = this.buildResponse(req.requestId, result, start, this.config.peerId, false);

        if (localMatch.capability.cacheable && req.method === 'GET' && result.statusCode === 200) {
          const cacheKey = ResponseCache.buildKey(req.method, req.path, req.query);
          this.cache.set(cacheKey, response, localMatch.capability.cacheTTL ?? this.config.defaultCacheTTL);
        }

        this.stats.localServed++;
        return response;
      } catch (err) {
        this.stats.errors++;
        return this.errorResponse(req.requestId, 500, (err as Error).message, start);
      }
    }

    // 2. Route to remote peer via P2P
    const remoteRoutes = this.remoteRoutes.findByPath(req.method, req.path)
      .filter(r => r.peerId !== this.config.peerId)
      .filter(r => this.circuitBreakers.canAttempt(r.peerId));

    if (remoteRoutes.length > 0) {
      const selected = this.loadBalancer.select(remoteRoutes, 'health-aware');
      if (selected) {
        try {
          const response = await this.forwardToRemote(selected, req);
          this.circuitBreakers.recordSuccess(selected.peerId);
          this.stats.remoteServed++;
          return response;
        } catch (err) {
          this.circuitBreakers.recordFailure(selected.peerId);
          this.stats.errors++;

          // Retry with next best route
          const remaining = remoteRoutes.filter(r => r.peerId !== selected.peerId);
          if (remaining.length > 0) {
            const fallback = this.loadBalancer.select(remaining, 'health-aware');
            if (fallback) {
              try {
                const response = await this.forwardToRemote(fallback, req);
                this.circuitBreakers.recordSuccess(fallback.peerId);
                this.stats.remoteServed++;
                return response;
              } catch {
                this.circuitBreakers.recordFailure(fallback.peerId);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    this.stats.errors++;
    return this.errorResponse(req.requestId, 404, 'No handler found for this route, locally or in the network', start);
  }

  private async forwardToRemote(route: RouteAdvertisement, req: GatewayRequest): Promise<GatewayResponse> {
    const [host, portStr] = route.endpoint.split(':');
    const port = parseInt(portStr, 10);

    // Establish P2P connection via NAT traversal
    await this.natTraversal.connect(route.peerId, [{ ip: host, port, family: 'IPv4' }]);

    // In production: send signed request over the established P2P channel
    // Here: model via HTTP since the channel abstracts the transport
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Remote request timeout')), this.config.requestTimeout);

      const options: http.RequestOptions = {
        hostname: host,
        port,
        path: req.path + (Object.keys(req.query).length ? '?' + new URLSearchParams(req.query).toString() : ''),
        method: req.method,
        headers: { ...req.headers, 'x-ube-forwarded-by': this.config.peerId },
        timeout: this.config.requestTimeout,
      };

      const httpReq = http.request(options, (httpRes) => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        let data = '';
        httpRes.on('data', (chunk) => data += chunk);
        httpRes.on('end', () => {
          let body: unknown;
          try { body = JSON.parse(data); } catch { body = data; }

          resolve({
            requestId: req.requestId,
            statusCode: httpRes.statusCode ?? 502,
            headers: this.flattenHeaders(httpRes.headers),
            body,
            servedBy: route.peerId,
            timestamp: Date.now(),
            durationMs: 0,
            fromCache: false,
            signature: '',
          });
        });
      });

      httpReq.on('error', (err) => { clearTimeout(timeout); reject(err); });
      if (req.body) httpReq.write(JSON.stringify(req.body));
      httpReq.end();
    });
  }

  private buildResponse(
    requestId: RequestId,
    result: { statusCode: number; headers?: Record<string, string>; body?: unknown },
    start: number,
    servedBy: PeerId,
    fromCache: boolean,
  ): GatewayResponse {
    const response: Omit<GatewayResponse, 'signature'> = {
      requestId,
      statusCode: result.statusCode,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...result.headers },
      body: result.body,
      servedBy,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      durationMs: Date.now() - start,
      fromCache,
    };
    return { ...response, signature: this.signer.signResponse(response) };
  }

  private errorResponse(requestId: RequestId, statusCode: number, message: string, start: number): GatewayResponse {
    return this.buildResponse(
      requestId,
      { statusCode, body: { error: message } },
      start,
      this.config.peerId,
      false,
    );
  }

  // ─── Cache Invalidation (hook for sovereignDb CRDT writes) ─────────────────

  invalidateCache(pathPrefix: string): number {
    return this.cache.invalidate(pathPrefix);
  }

  // ─── Stats & Health ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private recordLatency(ms: number): void {
    this.latencySamples.push(ms);
    if (this.latencySamples.length > 1000) this.latencySamples.shift();
    this.stats.avgLatencyMs = this.latencySamples.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / this.latencySamples.length;
    this.stats.activeRoutes = this.remoteRoutes.size();
    this.stats.circuitsOpen = this.circuitBreakers.getOpenCount();
  }

  getStats(): GatewayStats { return { ...this.stats }; }

  getActiveRoutes(): RouteAdvertisement[] { return this.remoteRoutes.getAll(); }

  getCircuitState(peerId: PeerId): CircuitBreakerState | null {
    return this.circuitBreakers.getState(peerId);
  }

  // ─── Shutdown ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async shutdown(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.advertiseTimer) clearInterval(this.advertiseTimer);
    this.remoteRoutes.stop();

    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      if (this.httpServer) this.httpServer.close(() => resolve());
      else resolve();
    });

    this.emit('shutdown');
  }
}

// ─── Factory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function createP2PApiGateway(
  overrides: Partial<GatewayConfig> & { nodeId: string; peerId: PeerId },
  didAuth: DIDAuthProvider,
  gossip: GossipProvider,
  natTraversal: NATTraversalProvider,
  privateKey: Buffer,
): P2PApiGateway {
  const config: GatewayConfig = {
    localPort: 7000,
    bindAddress: '0.0.0.0',
    externalAdvertise: true,
    routeTTL: 600_000,             // 10 minutes
    reAdvertiseInterval: 120_000,   // 2 minutes
    requestTimeout: 30_000,
    maxRetries: 2,
    circuitBreakerThreshold: 5,
    circuitBreakerCooldown: 30_000,
    cacheMaxSize: 5_000,
    defaultCacheTTL: 10_000,
    rateLimitDefaultRPS: 20,
    enableLocalFallback: true,
    maxBodySize: 10 * 1024 * 1024,  // 10 MB
    corsEnabled: true,
    region: 'GLOBAL',
    ...overrides,
  };
  return new P2PApiGateway(config, didAuth, gossip, natTraversal, privateKey);
}

export default P2PApiGateway;

--- FILE: packages/sdk/src/phase3/clientKeySovereignty.ts ---
/**
 * UBE Phase 3 — Client Key Sovereignty
 * =======================================
 * The seventh pillar of Section 1. UBE nodes have DIDs (didAuthMiddleware.ts)
 * for node-to-node identity — but that solves *node* trust, not *client* trust.
 * This module ensures the client's root key is generated, held, and used
 * entirely on client-controlled hardware. UBE — including every node in the
 * network, including the original author — mathematically cannot reconstruct
 * a client's root key, decrypt their data, or impersonate them.
 *
 * Core guarantee: "Even UBE itself cannot access client data once deployed."
 *
 * Architecture:
 *   - Client root key generated client-side only (browser WebCrypto, hardware
 *     wallet, HSM, or air-gapped device) — never transmitted, never logged
 *   - Hierarchical deterministic (HD) key derivation (BIP32-style) — one root
 *     key derives unlimited child keys per-tenant, per-app, per-purpose
 *   - Key never leaves client except as: (a) Shamir shares the client
 *     explicitly chooses to distribute, (b) zero-knowledge proofs of
 *     possession, (c) signatures — never the raw key material
 *   - UBE nodes only ever see: public keys, signatures, ZK proofs, and
 *     encrypted ciphertext they cannot decrypt
 *   - Local key vault: encrypted-at-rest, unlocked by passphrase/biometric/
 *     hardware token — UBE has no copy, no backdoor, no recovery capability
 *   - Recovery is the client's sole responsibility, supported via:
 *     social recovery (Shamir, client-chosen guardians), mnemonic seed
 *     phrases (BIP39), or hardware-backed escrow the client alone controls
 *   - Proof-of-non-custody: cryptographic attestation that UBE infrastructure
 *     never received raw key material, verifiable independently by the client
 */

import * as crypto from 'crypto';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type ClientId = string;
export type KeyPath = string;          // e.g. "m/44'/7432'/0'/0/0" (BIP32-style)
export type PublicKeyHex = string;
export type Mnemonic = string;

export interface RootKeyMaterial {
  // This type only ever exists in client-side memory. It is NEVER serialized
  // to any UBE node, NEVER logged, NEVER transmitted over any channel.
  seed: Buffer;                        // 64-byte master seed (BIP39-derived)
  chainCode: Buffer;                   // 32-byte chain code for HD derivation
  fingerprint: string;                 // First 4 bytes of pubkey hash — public-safe identifier
}

export interface DerivedKey {
  path: KeyPath;
  privateKey: Buffer;                  // Still client-side only
  publicKey: Buffer;                   // Safe to share with UBE nodes
  chainCode: Buffer;
  depth: number;
  index: number;
  parentFingerprint: string;
}

export interface PublicKeyBundle {
  // This is the ONLY thing that ever crosses to a UBE node
  path: KeyPath;
  publicKeyHex: PublicKeyHex;
  fingerprint: string;
  purpose: 'signing' | 'encryption' | 'auth' | 'recovery';
  createdAt: number;
}

export interface ShamirShare {
  shareIndex: number;
  threshold: number;
  totalShares: number;
  shareData: string;                   // base64 — encrypted with guardian's public key
  guardianId: string;
  commitmentHash: string;              // Hash commitment for verifiable secret sharing
}

export interface RecoveryConfiguration {
  method: 'mnemonic' | 'shamir-social' | 'hardware-escrow' | 'none';
  threshold?: number;                  // For Shamir: M-of-N
  totalShares?: number;
  guardianIds?: string[];              // Client-chosen, not UBE-chosen
  hardwareDeviceFingerprint?: string;
}

export interface NonCustodyProof {
  proofId: string;
  clientId: ClientId;
  nodeId: string;                      // The UBE node attesting it never held the key
  attestedAt: number;
  challengeNonce: string;
  // The node proves it can verify signatures without ever having held the
  // private key — proof is a transcript of challenge/response over public key only
  verificationTranscript: {
    challenge: string;
    publicKeySeen: PublicKeyHex;
    privateKeyNeverTransmitted: true;
  };
  nodeSignature: string;               // Node signs its own attestation
}

export interface ZKPossessionProof {
  // Schnorr-style ZK proof: "I know the private key for this public key"
  // without revealing the private key
  publicKey: PublicKeyHex;
  commitment: string;                  // R = g^k
  challenge: string;                   // e = H(R || publicKey || message)
  response: string;                    // s = k + e*privateKey (mod n)
  message: string;                     // What's being proven (e.g. a nonce)
}

export interface KeyVaultConfig {
  encryptionAlgorithm: 'aes-256-gcm' | 'chacha20-poly1305';
  kdfIterations: number;               // PBKDF2/Argon2 iterations
  kdfMemoryCost?: number;              // For Argon2
  autoLockTimeoutMs: number;
  requireBiometric: boolean;
  requireHardwareToken: boolean;
}

export interface EncryptedVault {
  ciphertext: string;                  // base64
  nonce: string;                       // base64
  salt: string;                        // base64 — for KDF
  kdfAlgorithm: 'pbkdf2' | 'argon2id' | 'scrypt';
  kdfParams: Record<string, number>;
  authTag: string;                     // base64
  version: number;
}

// ─── BIP39-style Mnemonic Generation ─────────────────────────────────────────

export class MnemonicGenerator {
  // Simplified English wordlist subset for demonstration —
  // production uses the full BIP39 2048-word list
  private static WORDLIST_SAMPLE_SIZE = 2048;

  static generateEntropy(bits: 128 | 160 | 192 | 224 | 256 = 256): Buffer {
    return crypto.randomBytes(bits / 8);
  }

  static entropyToMnemonic(entropy: Buffer, wordlist: string[]): Mnemonic {
    if (wordlist.length !== this.WORDLIST_SAMPLE_SIZE) {
      throw new Error(`Wordlist must contain exactly ${this.WORDLIST_SAMPLE_SIZE} words (BIP39 standard)`);
    }

    const checksum = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(entropy).digest();
    const checksumBits = entropy.length * 8 / 32;

    // Combine entropy + checksum bits
    const combined = Buffer.concat([entropy, checksum]);
    const totalBits = entropy.length * 8 + checksumBits;

    const words: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < totalBits / 11; i++) {
      let index = 0;
      for (let bit = 0; bit < 11; bit++) {
        const byteIndex = Math.floor((i * 11 + bit) / 8);
        const bitIndex = 7 - ((i * 11 + bit) % 8);
        const bitValue = (combined[byteIndex] >> bitIndex) & 1;
        index = (index << 1) | bitValue;
      }
      words.push(wordlist[index]);
    }

    return words.join(' ');
  }

  static mnemonicToSeed(mnemonic: Mnemonic, passphrase: string = ''): Buffer {
    // PBKDF2 with 2048 rounds, HMAC-SHA512 (BIP39 standard)
    const salt = 'mnemonic' + passphrase;
    return crypto.pbkdf2Sync(mnemonic.normalize('NFKD'), salt.normalize('NFKD'), 2048, 64, 'sha512');
  }

  static validateChecksum(mnemonic: Mnemonic, wordlist: string[]): boolean {
    const words = mnemonic.trim().split(/\s+/);
    if (![12, 15, 18, 21, 24].includes(words.length)) return false;

    const indices = words.map(w => wordlist.indexOf(w));
    if (indices.some(i => i === -1)) return false;

    return true; // Full implementation re-derives and compares checksum bits
  }
}

// ─── HD Key Derivation (BIP32-style) ──────────────────────────────────────────

export class HDKeyDerivation {
  private static HARDENED_OFFSET = 0x80000000;

  static masterKeyFromSeed(seed: Buffer): RootKeyMaterial {
    const hmac = crypto.createHmac('sha512', 'UBE Sovereign Seed');
    hmac.update(seed);
    const digest = hmac.digest();

    const masterPrivateKey = digest.subarray(0, 32);
    const chainCode = digest.subarray(32, 64);

    const publicKey = this.derivePublicKey(masterPrivateKey);
    const fingerprint = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(publicKey).digest().subarray(0, 4).toString('hex');

    return { seed, chainCode, fingerprint };
  }

  static derive(parentKey: DerivedKey | { privateKey: Buffer; chainCode: Buffer }, index: number, hardened: boolean): DerivedKey {
    const trueIndex = hardened ? index + this.HARDENED_OFFSET : index;
    const indexBuf = Buffer.alloc(4);
    indexBuf.writeUInt32BE(trueIndex, 0);

    let data: Buffer;
    if (hardened) {
      data = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0x00]), parentKey.privateKey, indexBuf]);
    } else {
      const pubKey = this.derivePublicKey(parentKey.privateKey);
      data = Buffer.concat([pubKey, indexBuf]);
    }

    const hmac = crypto.createHmac('sha512', parentKey.chainCode);
    hmac.update(data);
    const digest = hmac.digest();

    const tweak = digest.subarray(0, 32);
    const childChainCode = digest.subarray(32, 64);

    // child private key = (parent private key + tweak) mod n
    const childPrivateKey = this.addMod(parentKey.privateKey, tweak);
    const childPublicKey = this.derivePublicKey(childPrivateKey);
    const parentFingerprint = crypto.createHash('sha256')
      .update(this.derivePublicKey(parentKey.privateKey)).digest().subarray(0, 4).toString('hex');

    const depth = 'depth' in parentKey ? (parentKey as DerivedKey).depth + 1 : 1;

    return {
      path: '', // Caller sets full path
      privateKey: childPrivateKey,
      publicKey: childPublicKey,
      chainCode: childChainCode,
      depth,
      index: trueIndex,
      parentFingerprint,
    };
  }

  static deriveFromPath(root: RootKeyMaterial, path: KeyPath): DerivedKey {
    const segments = path.split('/').filter(s => s !== 'm' && s !== '');
    const masterHmac = crypto.createHmac('sha512', 'UBE Sovereign Seed').update(root.seed).digest();
    let current: { privateKey: Buffer; chainCode: Buffer } = {
      privateKey: masterHmac.subarray(0, 32),
      chainCode: masterHmac.subarray(32, 64),
    };

    let derived: DerivedKey = {
      path: 'm',
      privateKey: current.privateKey,
      publicKey: this.derivePublicKey(current.privateKey),
      chainCode: current.chainCode,
      depth: 0,
      index: 0,
      parentFingerprint: '00000000',
    };

    for (const segment of segments) {
      const hardened = segment.endsWith("'");
      const index = parseInt(hardened ? segment.slice(0, -1) : segment, 10);
      derived = this.derive(derived, index, hardened);
    }

    derived.path = path;
    return derived;
  }

  private static derivePublicKey(privateKey: Buffer): Buffer {
    // Production: secp256k1 or Ed25519 scalar multiplication.
    // Modeled here via deterministic hash-based derivation for a self-contained spec.
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(Buffer.concat([Buffer.from('pubkey'), privateKey])).digest();
  }

  private static addMod(a: Buffer, b: Buffer): Buffer {
    // Modular addition over the curve order — production uses real curve arithmetic.
    // Modeled here with a deterministic combine that preserves the HD-derivation shape.
    const result = Buffer.alloc(32);
    let carry = 0;
    for (let i = 31; i >= 0; i--) {
      const sum = a[i] + b[i] + carry;
      result[i] = sum & 0xff;
      carry = sum >> 8;
    }
    return result;
  }
}

// ─── Shamir Secret Sharing (for client-chosen social recovery) ──────────────

export class ShamirSecretSharing {
  private static PRIME = (1n << 256n) - 189n; // Large prime for GF(p) arithmetic

  static split(secret: Buffer, threshold: number, totalShares: number): ShamirShare[] {
    if (threshold > totalShares) throw new Error('Threshold cannot exceed total shares');
    if (threshold < 2) throw new Error('Threshold must be at least 2 (no single point of recovery)');

    const secretInt = BigInt('0x' + secret.toString('hex'));
    const coefficients = [secretInt];
    for (let i = 1; i < threshold; i++) {
      coefficients.push(this.randomFieldElement());
    }

    const shares: ShamirShare[] = [];
    const commitments: bigint[] = coefficients.map(c => this.commit(c));

    for (let x = 1; x <= totalShares; x++) {
      const y = this.evaluatePolynomial(coefficients, BigInt(x));
      shares.push({
        shareIndex: x,
        threshold,
        totalShares,
        shareData: Buffer.from(y.toString(16).padStart(64, '0'), 'hex').toString('base64'),
        guardianId: '', // Caller assigns based on client's chosen guardians
        commitmentHash: crypto.createHash('sha256')
          .update(commitments.map(c => c.toString(16)).join(',')).digest('hex'),
      });
    }

    return shares;
  }

  static reconstruct(shares: ShamirShare[]): Buffer {
    if (shares.length < shares[0]?.threshold) {
      throw new Error(`Need at least ${shares[0]?.threshold} shares, got ${shares.length}`);
    }

    const points = shares.map(s => ({
      x: BigInt(s.shareIndex),
      y: BigInt('0x' + Buffer.from(s.shareData, 'base64').toString('hex')),
    }));

    // Lagrange interpolation at x=0
    let secret = 0n;
    for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
      let numerator = 1n;
      let denominator = 1n;
      for (let j = 0; j < points.length; j++) {
        if (i === j) continue;
        numerator = this.mulMod(numerator, this.negMod(points[j].x));
        denominator = this.mulMod(denominator, this.subMod(points[i].x, points[j].x));
      }
      const lagrangeCoeff = this.mulMod(numerator, this.invMod(denominator));
      secret = this.addMod(secret, this.mulMod(points[i].y, lagrangeCoeff));
    }

    const hex = secret.toString(16).padStart(64, '0');
    return Buffer.from(hex, 'hex');
  }

  private static evaluatePolynomial(coefficients: bigint[], x: bigint): bigint {
    let result = 0n;
    let xPower = 1n;
    for (const coeff of coefficients) {
      result = this.addMod(result, this.mulMod(coeff, xPower));
      xPower = this.mulMod(xPower, x);
    }
    return result;
  }

  private static commit(value: bigint): bigint {
    // Pedersen-style commitment placeholder — production uses elliptic curve commitment
    return BigInt('0x' + crypto.createHash('sha256').update(value.toString(16)).digest('hex')) % this.PRIME;
  }

  private static randomFieldElement(): bigint {
    const bytes = crypto.randomBytes(32);
    return BigInt('0x' + bytes.toString('hex')) % this.PRIME;
  }

  private static addMod(a: bigint, b: bigint): bigint { return ((a + b) % this.PRIME + this.PRIME) % this.PRIME; }
  private static subMod(a: bigint, b: bigint): bigint { return ((a - b) % this.PRIME + this.PRIME) % this.PRIME; }
  private static negMod(a: bigint): bigint { return (this.PRIME - (a % this.PRIME)) % this.PRIME; }
  private static mulMod(a: bigint, b: bigint): bigint { return ((a * b) % this.PRIME + this.PRIME) % this.PRIME; }

  private static invMod(a: bigint): bigint {
    // Extended Euclidean algorithm for modular inverse
    let [old_r, r] = [a % this.PRIME, this.PRIME];
    let [old_s, s] = [1n, 0n];
    while (r !== 0n) {
      const q = old_r / r;
      [old_r, r] = [r, old_r - q * r];
      [old_s, s] = [s, old_s - q * s];
    }
    return ((old_s % this.PRIME) + this.PRIME) % this.PRIME;
  }
}

// ─── Local Encrypted Key Vault ────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class LocalKeyVault {
  constructor(private config: KeyVaultConfig) {}

  async lock(rootKey: RootKeyMaterial, passphrase: string): Promise<EncryptedVault> {
    const salt = crypto.randomBytes(32);
    const derivedKey = await this.deriveKeyFromPassphrase(passphrase, salt);

    const plaintext = JSON.stringify({
      seed: rootKey.seed.toString('hex'),
      chainCode: rootKey.chainCode.toString('hex'),
      fingerprint: rootKey.fingerprint,
    });

    const nonce = crypto.randomBytes(12);
    const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv(
      this.config.encryptionAlgorithm === 'aes-256-gcm' ? 'aes-256-gcm' : 'chacha20-poly1305',
      derivedKey,
      nonce,
      { authTagLength: 16 } as crypto.CipherCCMOptions,
    );

    const ciphertext = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(plaintext, 'utf8'), cipher.final()]);
    const authTag = (cipher as crypto.CipherGCM).getAuthTag();

    return {
      ciphertext: ciphertext.toString('base64'),
      nonce: nonce.toString('base64'),
      salt: salt.toString('base64'),
      kdfAlgorithm: 'pbkdf2',
      kdfParams: { iterations: this.config.kdfIterations },
      authTag: authTag.toString('base64'),
      version: 1,
    };
  }

  async unlock(vault: EncryptedVault, passphrase: string): Promise<RootKeyMaterial> {
    const salt = Buffer.from(vault.salt, 'base64');
    const derivedKey = await this.deriveKeyFromPassphrase(passphrase, salt);

    const nonce = Buffer.from(vault.nonce, 'base64');
    const ciphertext = Buffer.from(vault.ciphertext, 'base64');
    const authTag = Buffer.from(vault.authTag, 'base64');

    const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv(
      this.config.encryptionAlgorithm === 'aes-256-gcm' ? 'aes-256-gcm' : 'chacha20-poly1305',
      derivedKey,
      nonce,
      { authTagLength: 16 } as crypto.CipherCCMOptions,
    );
    (decipher as crypto.DecipherGCM).setAuthTag(authTag);

    const plaintext = decipher.update(ciphertext).toString('utf8') + decipher.final('utf8');
    const parsed = JSON.parse(plaintext) as { seed: string; chainCode: string; fingerprint: string };

    return {
      seed: Buffer.from(parsed.seed, 'hex'),
      chainCode: Buffer.from(parsed.chainCode, 'hex'),
      fingerprint: parsed.fingerprint,
    };
  }

  private async deriveKeyFromPassphrase(passphrase: string, salt: Buffer): Promise<Buffer> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      crypto.pbkdf2(passphrase, salt, this.config.kdfIterations, 32, 'sha512', (err, key) => {
        if (err) reject(err); else resolve(key);
      });
    });
  }

  // Secure erasure — overwrite key material in memory before garbage collection
  static wipe(material: RootKeyMaterial | DerivedKey): void {
    if ('seed' in material) {
      material.seed.fill(0);
      material.chainCode.fill(0);
    } else {
      material.privateKey.fill(0);
      material.chainCode.fill(0);
    }
  }
}

// ─── Zero-Knowledge Proof of Key Possession (Schnorr) ────────────────────────

export class ZKPossessionProver {
  private static GROUP_ORDER = (1n << 256n) - 189n;

  // Client-side: prove "I know the private key for this public key" without
  // revealing it. Used so UBE nodes can verify identity/authorization
  // without ever touching raw key material.
  static prove(privateKey: Buffer, publicKey: Buffer, message: string): ZKPossessionProof {
    const privInt = BigInt('0x' + privateKey.toString('hex'));
    const k = BigInt('0x' + crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex')) % this.GROUP_ORDER;

    // Commitment R = g^k (modeled as hash-based commitment for self-containment)
    const commitment = crypto.createHash('sha256')
      .update(Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(k.toString(16).padStart(64, '0'), 'hex')]))
      .digest('hex');

    const challenge = crypto.createHash('sha256')
      .update(commitment + publicKey.toString('hex') + message)
      .digest('hex');
    const e = BigInt('0x' + challenge) % this.GROUP_ORDER;

    // s = k + e * privateKey (mod group order)
    const s = (k + e * privInt) % this.GROUP_ORDER;

    return {
      publicKey: publicKey.toString('hex'),
      commitment,
      challenge,
      response: s.toString(16).padStart(64, '0'),
      message,
    };
  }

  // Server-side (any UBE node): verify the proof without ever seeing the private key
  static verify(proof: ZKPossessionProof): boolean {
    const expectedChallenge = crypto.createHash('sha256')
      .update(proof.commitment + proof.publicKey + proof.message)
      .digest('hex');

    // In a full elliptic-curve implementation this also checks
    // g^s == R * publicKey^e. Here we verify the Fiat-Shamir challenge
    // binding, which is the part relevant to the non-custody guarantee:
    // the verifier never needed the private key to check this.
    return expectedChallenge === proof.challenge;
  }
}

// ─── Non-Custody Attestation Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────

export class NonCustodyAttestor {
  constructor(private nodeId: string, private nodePrivateKey: Buffer) {}

  // A UBE node generates this to cryptographically prove, to the client or
  // any auditor, that it only ever observed public material — never the
  // client's private key.
  attest(clientId: ClientId, publicKeySeen: PublicKeyHex, challengeNonce: string): NonCustodyProof {
    const proof: Omit<NonCustodyProof, 'nodeSignature'> = {
      proofId: crypto.randomUUID(),
      clientId,
      nodeId: this.nodeId,
      attestedAt: Date.now(),
      challengeNonce,
      verificationTranscript: {
        challenge: challengeNonce,
        publicKeySeen,
        privateKeyNeverTransmitted: true,
      },
    };

    const canonical = JSON.stringify(proof);
    const signature = crypto.createHmac('sha256', this.nodePrivateKey).update(canonical).digest('hex');

    return { ...proof, nodeSignature: signature };
  }

  verifyAttestation(proof: NonCustodyProof, nodePublicKey: Buffer): boolean {
    const { nodeSignature, ...rest } = proof;
    const canonical = JSON.stringify(rest);
    const expected = crypto.createHmac('sha256', nodePublicKey).update(canonical).digest('hex');
    try {
      return crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(nodeSignature, 'hex'), Buffer.from(expected, 'hex'));
    } catch { return false; }
  }
}

// ─── Client Key Sovereignty — Main Orchestrator (client-side only) ──────────

export class ClientKeySovereignty {
  private vault: LocalKeyVault;
  private unlockedRoot: RootKeyMaterial | null = null;
  private autoLockTimer?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
  private derivedKeyCache: Map<KeyPath, DerivedKey> = new Map();

  constructor(
    private clientId: ClientId,
    private config: KeyVaultConfig,
  ) {
    this.vault = new LocalKeyVault(config);
  }

  // ─── Generation (happens once, entirely client-side) ──────────────────────

  generateNewIdentity(wordlist: string[], entropyBits: 128 | 256 = 256): {
    mnemonic: Mnemonic;
    rootKey: RootKeyMaterial;
  } {
    const entropy = MnemonicGenerator.generateEntropy(entropyBits);
    const mnemonic = MnemonicGenerator.entropyToMnemonic(entropy, wordlist);
    const seed = MnemonicGenerator.mnemonicToSeed(mnemonic);
    const rootKey = HDKeyDerivation.masterKeyFromSeed(seed);

    entropy.fill(0); // Wipe intermediate entropy buffer

    return { mnemonic, rootKey };
  }

  restoreFromMnemonic(mnemonic: Mnemonic, passphrase: string = ''): RootKeyMaterial {
    const seed = MnemonicGenerator.mnemonicToSeed(mnemonic, passphrase);
    return HDKeyDerivation.masterKeyFromSeed(seed);
  }

  // ─── Vault Lock/Unlock ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async createVault(rootKey: RootKeyMaterial, passphrase: string): Promise<EncryptedVault> {
    const vault = await this.vault.lock(rootKey, passphrase);
    // rootKey is wiped by caller after this — vault never persists it unencrypted
    return vault;
  }

  async unlockVault(vault: EncryptedVault, passphrase: string): Promise<void> {
    this.unlockedRoot = await this.vault.unlock(vault, passphrase);
    this.resetAutoLock();
  }

  lockVault(): void {
    if (this.unlockedRoot) LocalKeyVault.wipe(this.unlockedRoot);
    this.unlockedRoot = null;
    this.derivedKeyCache.forEach(k => LocalKeyVault.wipe(k));
    this.derivedKeyCache.clear();
    if (this.autoLockTimer) clearTimeout(this.autoLockTimer);
  }

  private resetAutoLock(): void {
    if (this.autoLockTimer) clearTimeout(this.autoLockTimer);
    this.autoLockTimer = setTimeout(() => this.lockVault(), this.config.autoLockTimeoutMs);
  }

  isUnlocked(): boolean {
    return this.unlockedRoot !== null;
  }

  // ─── Key Derivation (per-tenant, per-purpose) ────────────────────────────────

  derive(path: KeyPath): DerivedKey {
    if (!this.unlockedRoot) throw new Error('Vault is locked — cannot derive keys');
    this.resetAutoLock();

    const cached = this.derivedKeyCache.get(path);
    if (cached) return cached;

    const derived = HDKeyDerivation.deriveFromPath(this.unlockedRoot, path);
    this.derivedKeyCache.set(path, derived);
    return derived;
  }

  // Standard UBE derivation paths
  deriveTenantSigningKey(tenantIndex: number): DerivedKey {
    return this.derive(`m/7432'/0'/${tenantIndex}'/0`);
  }

  deriveTenantEncryptionKey(tenantIndex: number): DerivedKey {
    return this.derive(`m/7432'/1'/${tenantIndex}'/0`);
  }

  deriveAuthKey(tenantIndex: number, appIndex: number): DerivedKey {
    return this.derive(`m/7432'/2'/${tenantIndex}'/${appIndex}`);
  }

  // ─── Export Only Public Material (the only thing UBE nodes ever receive) ───

  exportPublicBundle(path: KeyPath, purpose: PublicKeyBundle['purpose']): PublicKeyBundle {
    const derived = this.derive(path);
    return {
      path,
      publicKeyHex: derived.publicKey.toString('hex'),
      fingerprint: crypto.createHash('sha256').update(derived.publicKey).digest().subarray(0, 4).toString('hex'),
      purpose,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    };
  }

  // ─── Signing (private key never leaves this method's stack frame) ──────────

  sign(path: KeyPath, message: Buffer): { signature: string; publicKey: PublicKeyHex } {
    const derived = this.derive(path);
    const signature = crypto.createHmac('sha256', derived.privateKey).update(message).digest('hex');
    return { signature, publicKey: derived.publicKey.toString('hex') };
  }

  provePossession(path: KeyPath, message: string): ZKPossessionProof {
    const derived = this.derive(path);
    return ZKPossessionProver.prove(derived.privateKey, derived.publicKey, message);
  }

  // ─── Social Recovery Setup (client chooses guardians — not UBE) ─────────────

  setupSocialRecovery(
    rootKey: RootKeyMaterial,
    config: { threshold: number; guardianIds: string[] },
  ): ShamirShare[] {
    if (config.guardianIds.length < config.threshold) {
      throw new Error('Must have at least as many guardians as the threshold');
    }

    const combined = Buffer.concat([rootKey.seed, rootKey.chainCode]).subarray(0, 32);
    const shares = ShamirSecretSharing.split(combined, config.threshold, config.guardianIds.length);

    return shares.map((share, i) => ({ ...share, guardianId: config.guardianIds[i] }));
  }

  recoverFromShares(shares: ShamirShare[]): RootKeyMaterial {
    const reconstructed = ShamirSecretSharing.reconstruct(shares);
    // Re-derive full root key material from reconstructed seed component
    return HDKeyDerivation.masterKeyFromSeed(Buffer.concat([reconstructed, reconstructed]));
  }

  // ─── Non-Custody Verification (client-side check against node claims) ──────

  verifyNodeNonCustodyClaim(proof: NonCustodyProof, nodePublicKey: Buffer): boolean {
    const attestor = new NonCustodyAttestor(proof.nodeId, Buffer.alloc(32)); // public verify only
    return attestor.verifyAttestation(proof, nodePublicKey);
  }

  // ─── Cleanup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  destroy(): void {
    this.lockVault();
  }
}

// ─── Factory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function createClientKeySovereignty(
  clientId: ClientId,
  overrides: Partial<KeyVaultConfig> = {},
): ClientKeySovereignty {
  const config: KeyVaultConfig = {
    encryptionAlgorithm: 'chacha20-poly1305',
    kdfIterations: 600_000,           // OWASP 2023 recommendation for PBKDF2-SHA512
    autoLockTimeoutMs: 15 * 60_000,   // 15 minutes
    requireBiometric: false,
    requireHardwareToken: false,
    ...overrides,
  };
  return new ClientKeySovereignty(clientId, config);
}

export default ClientKeySovereignty;

  // Workflow

  WORKFLOW_ALREADY_RUNNING = 'WORKFLOW_ALREADY_RUNNING',
  WORKFLOW_INVALID_DEFINITION = 'WORKFLOW_INVALID_DEFINITION',
  WORKFLOW_FAILED = 'WORKFLOW_FAILED',

  // Usage

  SOVEREIGN_UNREACHABLE = 'SOVEREIGN_UNREACHABLE',
  SOVEREIGN_KEY_INVALID = 'SOVEREIGN_KEY_INVALID',

  SERIALIZATION_ERROR = 'SERIALIZATION_ERROR',

// ============================================================
// BASE ERROR CLASS
// ============================================================

export class UBEError extends Error {
  readonly code: UBEErrorCode;
  readonly statusCode?: number;
  readonly retryable: boolean;
  readonly retryAfterMs?: number;
  readonly requestId?: string;
  readonly details?: unknown;
  readonly documentation?: string;
  readonly timestamp: Date;

  constructor(
    code: UBEErrorCode,
    message: string,
    options: {
      statusCode?: number;
      retryable?: boolean;
      retryAfterMs?: number;
      requestId?: string;
      details?: unknown;
      documentation?: string;
      cause?: Error;
    } = {}
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'UBEError';
    this.code = code;
    this.statusCode = options.statusCode;
    this.retryable = options.retryable ?? false;
    this.retryAfterMs = options.retryAfterMs;
    this.requestId = options.requestId;
    this.details = options.details;
    this.documentation = options.documentation;
    this.timestamp = new Date();
    if (options.cause) this.cause = options.cause;
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);
  }

  toJSON(): Record<string, unknown> {
    return {
      name: this.name,
      code: this.code,
      message: this.message,
      statusCode: this.statusCode,
      retryable: this.retryable,
      retryAfterMs: this.retryAfterMs,
      requestId: this.requestId,
      details: this.details,
      timestamp: this.timestamp.toISOString(),
    };
  }

  toString(): string {
    return `[${this.code}] ${this.message}${this.requestId ? ` (request: ${this.requestId})` : ''}`;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// ERROR FACTORY
// ============================================================

export class UBEErrorFactory {
  static fromResponse(response: UBEErrorResponse, requestId?: string): UBEError {
    const opts = {
      statusCode: undefined as number | undefined,
      retryable: response.retryable,
      retryAfterMs: response.retryAfterMs,
      requestId,
      details: response.details,
      documentation: response.documentation,
    };

    switch (response.code) {
      case UBEErrorCode.AUTH_INVALID_KEY:
      case UBEErrorCode.AUTH_EXPIRED_TOKEN:
        return new UBEAuthError(response.message, response.code as UBEErrorCode, opts);
      case UBEErrorCode.AUTH_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS:
        return new UBEPermissionError(response.message, opts);
      case UBEErrorCode.API_RATE_LIMITED:
      case UBEErrorCode.AUTH_RATE_LIMITED:
        return new UBERateLimitError(response.message, 0, 0, new Date(Date.now() + (response.retryAfterMs || 60000)), response.retryAfterMs);
      case UBEErrorCode.CLIENT_TIMEOUT:
        return new UBETimeoutError(response.message, 0, opts);
      case UBEErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR:
        return new UBEValidationError(response.message);
      case UBEErrorCode.LEGAL_COMPLIANCE_VIOLATION:
      case UBEErrorCode.LEGAL_TRANSFER_BLOCKED:
        return new UBELegalError(response.message, [], opts);
      case UBEErrorCode.USAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED:
        return new UBEUsageLimitError('api', 0, 0);
      case UBEErrorCode.TIER_FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE:
        return new UBETierError('feature', 'enterprise');
      case UBEErrorCode.WORKFLOW_FAILED:
        return new UBEWorkflowError(response.message, undefined, undefined, opts);
      case UBEErrorCode.SOVEREIGN_UNREACHABLE:
      case UBEErrorCode.SOVEREIGN_KEY_INVALID:
        return new UBESovereignError(response.message, response.code as UBEErrorCode, opts);
      default:
        return new UBEError(
          (response.code as UBEErrorCode) || UBEErrorCode.UNKNOWN,
          response.message,
          opts
        );
    }
  }

  static fromHTTPStatus(status: number, message: string, requestId?: string): UBEError {
    const map: Record<number, [UBEErrorCode, boolean]> = {
      400: [UBEErrorCode.API_BAD_REQUEST, false],
      401: [UBEErrorCode.AUTH_INVALID_KEY, false],
      402: [UBEErrorCode.TIER_FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE, false],
      403: [UBEErrorCode.AUTH_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS, false],
      404: [UBEErrorCode.API_NOT_FOUND, false],
      408: [UBEErrorCode.CLIENT_TIMEOUT, true],
      429: [UBEErrorCode.API_RATE_LIMITED, true],
      451: [UBEErrorCode.LEGAL_TRANSFER_BLOCKED, false],
      500: [UBEErrorCode.API_SERVER_ERROR, true],
      502: [UBEErrorCode.API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, true],
      503: [UBEErrorCode.API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, true],
      504: [UBEErrorCode.CLIENT_TIMEOUT, true],
    };
    const [code, retryable] = map[status] || [UBEErrorCode.UNKNOWN, false];
    return new UBEError(code, message, { statusCode: status, retryable, requestId });
  }

  static networkError(cause: Error): UBENetworkError {
    return new UBENetworkError(`Network error: ${cause.message}`, cause);
  }

  static timeout(ms: number): UBETimeoutError {
    return new UBETimeoutError(`Request timed out after ${ms}ms`, ms);
  }

  static validation(fields: ValidationField[]): UBEValidationError {
    const fieldNames = fields.map(f => f.field).join(', ');
    return new UBEValidationError(`Validation failed for fields: ${fieldNames}`, fields);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// ERROR UTILITIES
// ============================================================

export function isUBEError(err: unknown): err is UBEError {
  return err instanceof UBEError;
}

export function isRetryableError(err: unknown): boolean {
  if (err instanceof UBEError) return err.retryable;
  if (err instanceof Error) {
    return err.message.includes('ECONNRESET') ||
      err.message.includes('ECONNREFUSED') ||
      err.message.includes('ETIMEDOUT') ||
      err.message.includes('ENOTFOUND');
  }
  return false;
}

export function getRetryDelay(err: unknown): number {
  if (err instanceof UBEError && err.retryAfterMs) return err.retryAfterMs;
  if (err instanceof UBERateLimitError) return err.retryAfterMs || 60000;
  return 1000;
}

export function formatError(err: unknown): string {
  if (err instanceof UBEError) return err.toString();
  if (err instanceof Error) return err.message;
  return String(err);
}

export function serializeError(err: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (err instanceof UBEError) return err.toJSON();
  if (err instanceof Error) return { name: err.name, message: err.message, stack: err.stack };
  return { message: String(err) };
}

import crypto from 'crypto';
import {
  AuthMethod, AuthToken, APIKeyInfo, OAuth2Config,
  UBEConfig, RateLimitInfo, UBETier
} from './types';
import { UBEAuthError, UBEErrorCode, UBENetworkError } from './errors';

// ============================================================
// UBE SDK — AUTHENTICATION
// ============================================================

export interface AuthState {
  method: AuthMethod;
  token?: AuthToken;
  apiKey?: string;
  tenantId?: string;
  keyInfo?: APIKeyInfo;
  lastRefresh?: Date;
  refreshCount: number;
}

export interface AuthHeaders {
  Authorization?: string;
  'X-API-Key'?: string;
  'X-Tenant-ID'?: string;
  'X-HMAC-Signature'?: string;
  'X-HMAC-Timestamp'?: string;
  'X-HMAC-Nonce'?: string;
  'X-Sovereign-Key'?: string;
}

// ============================================================
// TOKEN STORE
// ============================================================

export class TokenStore {
  private tokens: Map<string, AuthToken> = new Map();
  private readonly maxSize: number;

  constructor(maxSize: number = 100) {
    this.maxSize = maxSize;
  }

  set(key: string, token: AuthToken): void {
    if (this.tokens.size >= this.maxSize) {
      const oldest = this.tokens.keys().next().value;
      if (oldest) this.tokens.delete(oldest);
    }
    this.tokens.set(key, token);
  }

  get(key: string): AuthToken | undefined {
    const token = this.tokens.get(key);
    if (!token) return undefined;
    if (token.expiresAt <= new Date()) {
      this.tokens.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    return token;
  }

  isExpired(key: string): boolean {
    const token = this.tokens.get(key);
    if (!token) return true;
    return token.expiresAt <= new Date(Date.now() + 60000);
  }

  clear(key?: string): void {
    if (key) this.tokens.delete(key);
    else this.tokens.clear();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// HMAC SIGNER
// ============================================================

export class HMACSigner {
  private readonly secret: string;
  private readonly algorithm: string;

  constructor(secret: string, algorithm: string = 'sha256') {
    this.secret = secret;
    this.algorithm = algorithm;
  }

  sign(method: string, path: string, body: string, timestamp: string, nonce: string): string {
    const payload = [method.toUpperCase(), path, body, timestamp, nonce].join('\n');
    return crypto
      .createHmac(this.algorithm, this.secret)
      .update(payload)
      .digest('hex');
  }

  verify(signature: string, method: string, path: string, body: string, timestamp: string, nonce: string): boolean {
    const expected = this.sign(method, path, body, timestamp, nonce);
    try {
      return crypto.timingSafeEqual(
        Buffer.from(signature, 'hex'),
        Buffer.from(expected, 'hex')
      );
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  generateNonce(): string {
    return crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
  }
}

// ============================================================
// SOVEREIGN KEY MANAGER
// ============================================================

export class SovereignKeyManager {
  private readonly key: string;
  private readonly tenantId: string;

  constructor(key: string, tenantId: string) {
    this.key = key;
    this.tenantId = tenantId;
  }

  generateToken(expiryMs: number = 3600000): AuthToken {
    const now = new Date();
    const payload = {
      tenantId: this.tenantId,
      issuedAt: now.toISOString(),
      nonce: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
    };
    const signature = crypto
      .createHmac('sha512', this.key)
      .update(JSON.stringify(payload))
      .digest('hex');

    const accessToken = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ ...payload, signature })).toString('base64');

    return {
      accessToken,
      tokenType: 'Sovereign',
      expiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + expiryMs),
      tenantId: this.tenantId,
      scope: ['*'],
    };
  }

  verify(token: string): boolean {
    try {
      const decoded = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token, 'base64').toString('utf8'));
      const { signature, ...payload } = decoded;
      const expected = crypto
        .createHmac('sha512', this.key)
        .update(JSON.stringify(payload))
        .digest('hex');
      return crypto.timingSafeEqual(
        Buffer.from(signature, 'hex'),
        Buffer.from(expected, 'hex')
      );
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================
// OAUTH2 CLIENT
// ============================================================

export class OAuth2Client {
  private readonly config: OAuth2Config;
  private readonly tokenStore: TokenStore;
  private readonly cacheKey: string;

  constructor(config: OAuth2Config) {
    this.config = config;
    this.tokenStore = new TokenStore();
    this.cacheKey = `oauth2:${config.clientId}`;
  }

  async getToken(): Promise<AuthToken> {
    const cached = this.tokenStore.get(this.cacheKey);
    if (cached && !this.tokenStore.isExpired(this.cacheKey)) return cached;
    return this.fetchToken();
  }

  private async fetchToken(): Promise<AuthToken> {
    const body = new URLSearchParams({
      grant_type: this.config.grantType || 'client_credentials',
      client_id: this.config.clientId,
      client_secret: this.config.clientSecret,
      scope: (this.config.scope || ['*']).join(' '),
    });

    try {
      const res = await fetch(this.config.tokenEndpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
        body: body.toString(),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new UBEAuthError(`OAuth2 token fetch failed: ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);
      }

      const data = await res.json() as {
        access_token: string;
        token_type: string;
        expires_in?: number;
        refresh_token?: string;
        scope?: string;
      };

      const token: AuthToken = {
        accessToken: data.access_token,
        tokenType: 'Bearer',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + (data.expires_in || 3600) * 1000),
        refreshToken: data.refresh_token,
        scope: data.scope?.split(' '),
      };

      this.tokenStore.set(this.cacheKey, token);
      return token;
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof UBEAuthError) throw err;
      throw new UBENetworkError(`OAuth2 request failed: ${String(err)}`);
    }
  }

  async refreshToken(refreshToken: string): Promise<AuthToken> {
    const body = new URLSearchParams({
      grant_type: 'refresh_token',
      refresh_token: refreshToken,
      client_id: this.config.clientId,
      client_secret: this.config.clientSecret,
    });

    const res = await fetch(this.config.tokenEndpoint, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: body.toString(),
    });

    if (!res.ok) throw new UBEAuthError('Token refresh failed');
    const data = await res.json() as { access_token: string; expires_in?: number; refresh_token?: string };

    const token: AuthToken = {
      accessToken: data.access_token,
      tokenType: 'Bearer',
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + (data.expires_in || 3600) * 1000),
      refreshToken: data.refresh_token || refreshToken,
    };

    this.tokenStore.set(this.cacheKey, token);
    return token;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// API KEY VALIDATOR
// ============================================================

export class APIKeyValidator {
  private readonly cache: Map<string, APIKeyInfo> = new Map();
  private readonly endpoint: string;

  constructor(endpoint: string) {
    this.endpoint = endpoint;
  }

  async validate(apiKey: string): Promise<APIKeyInfo> {
    const cacheKey = this.hash(apiKey);
    const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached && new Date() < (cached.expiresAt || new Date('9999-12-31'))) {
      return cached;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${this.endpoint}/auth/validate`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'X-API-Key': apiKey,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ apiKey }),
      });

      if (res.status === 401) throw new UBEAuthError('Invalid API key', UBEErrorCode.AUTH_INVALID_KEY);
      if (!res.ok) throw new UBEAuthError(`API key validation failed: ${res.status}`);

      const info = await res.json() as APIKeyInfo;
      this.cache.set(cacheKey, info);
      return info;
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof UBEAuthError) throw err;
      throw new UBENetworkError(`Validation request failed: ${String(err)}`);
    }
  }

  private hash(key: string): string {
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(key).digest('hex').substring(0, 16);
  }

  clearCache(): void {
    this.cache.clear();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// MAIN AUTH MANAGER
// ============================================================

export class AuthManager {
  private state: AuthState;
  private readonly tokenStore: TokenStore;
  private hmacSigner?: HMACSigner;
  private oauth2Client?: OAuth2Client;
  private sovereignKeyManager?: SovereignKeyManager;
  private refreshTimer?: NodeJS.Timeout;
  private readonly config: UBEConfig;
  private readonly endpoint: string;

  constructor(config: UBEConfig, endpoint: string) {
    this.config = config;
    this.endpoint = endpoint;
    this.tokenStore = new TokenStore();
    this.state = {
      method: config.authMethod || (config.apiKey ? AuthMethod.API_KEY : AuthMethod.JWT),
      apiKey: config.apiKey,
      tenantId: config.tenantId,
      refreshCount: 0,
    };

    this.initializeMethod();
  }

  private initializeMethod(): void {
    switch (this.state.method) {
      case AuthMethod.HMAC:
        if (this.config.apiKey) {
          this.hmacSigner = new HMACSigner(this.config.apiKey);
        }
        break;
      case AuthMethod.SOVEREIGN_KEY:
        if (this.config.sovereignKey && this.config.tenantId) {
          this.sovereignKeyManager = new SovereignKeyManager(
            this.config.sovereignKey,
            this.config.tenantId
          );
        }
        break;
    }
  }

  async getHeaders(method: string = 'GET', path: string = '/', body: string = ''): Promise<AuthHeaders> {
    const headers: AuthHeaders = {};

    if (this.config.tenantId) {
      headers['X-Tenant-ID'] = this.config.tenantId;
    }

    switch (this.state.method) {
      case AuthMethod.API_KEY:
        if (!this.state.apiKey) throw new UBEAuthError('API key not configured');
        headers['X-API-Key'] = this.state.apiKey;
        break;

      case AuthMethod.JWT: {
        const token = await this.getValidToken();
        headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token.accessToken}`;
        break;
      }

      case AuthMethod.OAUTH2: {
        const token = await this.getValidToken();
        headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token.accessToken}`;
        break;
      }

      case AuthMethod.HMAC: {
        if (!this.hmacSigner || !this.state.apiKey) {
          throw new UBEAuthError('HMAC signer not initialized');
        }
        const timestamp = Date.now().toString();
        const nonce = this.hmacSigner.generateNonce();
        const signature = this.hmacSigner.sign(method, path, body, timestamp, nonce);
        headers['X-API-Key'] = this.state.apiKey;
        headers['X-HMAC-Signature'] = signature;
        headers['X-HMAC-Timestamp'] = timestamp;
        headers['X-HMAC-Nonce'] = nonce;
        break;
      }

      case AuthMethod.SOVEREIGN_KEY: {
        if (!this.sovereignKeyManager) throw new UBEAuthError('Sovereign key not configured');
        const token = this.sovereignKeyManager.generateToken();
        headers['X-Sovereign-Key'] = token.accessToken;
        if (this.config.tenantId) headers['X-Tenant-ID'] = this.config.tenantId;
        break;
      }

      case AuthMethod.MTLS:
        break;
    }

    return headers;
  }

  private async getValidToken(): Promise<AuthToken> {
    const cacheKey = `token:${this.state.tenantId || 'default'}`;
    const cached = this.tokenStore.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached && !this.tokenStore.isExpired(cacheKey)) return cached;

    const fresh = await this.fetchToken();
    this.tokenStore.set(cacheKey, fresh);
    this.state.token = fresh;
    this.state.lastRefresh = new Date();
    this.state.refreshCount++;
    this.scheduleRefresh(fresh);
    return fresh;
  }

  private async fetchToken(): Promise<AuthToken> {
    if (this.oauth2Client) return this.oauth2Client.getToken();
    if (this.state.apiKey) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${this.endpoint}/auth/token`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-API-Key': this.state.apiKey,
          },
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json() as { accessToken: string; expiresAt: string };
          return {
            accessToken: data.accessToken,
            tokenType: 'Bearer',
            expiresAt: new Date(data.expiresAt),
          };
        }
      } catch {
        // Fall through to API key auth
      }
    }
    return {
      accessToken: this.state.apiKey || '',
      tokenType: 'Bearer',
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
    };
  }

  private scheduleRefresh(token: AuthToken): void {
    if (this.refreshTimer) clearTimeout(this.refreshTimer);
    const refreshIn = token.expiresAt.getTime() - Date.now() - 300000;
    if (refreshIn > 0) {
      this.refreshTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.tokenStore.clear(`token:${this.state.tenantId || 'default'}`);
      }, refreshIn);
    }
  }

  isAuthenticated(): boolean {
    return !!(this.state.apiKey || this.state.token?.accessToken);
  }

  getState(): AuthState {
    return { ...this.state };
  }

  setTenantId(tenantId: string): void {
    this.state.tenantId = tenantId;
  }

  clearTokens(): void {
    this.tokenStore.clear();
    this.state.token = undefined;
  }

  destroy(): void {
    if (this.refreshTimer) clearTimeout(this.refreshTimer);
    this.clearTokens();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// REQUEST QUEUE
// ============================================================

class RequestQueue {
  private readonly queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private running: number = 0;
  private readonly maxConcurrent: number;

  constructor(maxConcurrent: number = 10) {
    this.maxConcurrent = maxConcurrent;
  }

  async add<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
      this.queue.push(async () => {
        try { resolve(await fn()); }
        catch (err) { reject(err); }
      });
      this.drain();
    });
  }

  private async drain(): Promise<void> {
    while (this.queue.length > 0 && this.running < this.maxConcurrent) {
      const fn = this.queue.shift();
      if (!fn) break;
      this.running++;
      fn().finally(() => {
        this.running--;
        this.drain();
      });
    }
  }

  get size(): number { return this.queue.length; }
  get active(): number { return this.running; }
}

// ============================================================
// RATE LIMITER
// ============================================================

class ClientRateLimiter {
  private windows: Map<string, { count: number; resetAt: Date }> = new Map();

  check(key: string, limit: number, windowMs: number): boolean {
    const now = new Date();
    const existing = this.windows.get(key);
    if (!existing || existing.resetAt < now) {
      this.windows.set(key, { count: 1, resetAt: new Date(now.getTime() + windowMs) });
      return true;
    }
    if (existing.count >= limit) return false;
    existing.count++;
    return true;
  }

  getResetAt(key: string): Date {
    return this.windows.get(key)?.resetAt || new Date();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// RESPONSE CACHE
// ============================================================

class ResponseCache {
  private readonly cache: Map<string, { data: unknown; expiresAt: Date }> = new Map();
  private readonly maxSize: number;

  constructor(maxSize: number = 200) {
    this.maxSize = maxSize;
  }

  set(key: string, data: unknown, ttlMs: number): void {
    if (this.cache.size >= this.maxSize) {
      const oldest = this.cache.keys().next().value;
      if (oldest) this.cache.delete(oldest);
    }
    this.cache.set(key, { data, expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + ttlMs) });
  }

  get(key: string): unknown | undefined {
    const entry = this.cache.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (entry.expiresAt < new Date()) {
      this.cache.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    return entry.data;
  }

  invalidate(pattern?: string): void {
    if (!pattern) { this.cache.clear(); return; }
    for (const key of this.cache.keys()) {
      if (key.includes(pattern)) this.cache.delete(key);
    }
  }
}
