export class ConsoleLogger implements SDKLogger {
  private readonly level: LogLevel;
  private readonly prefix: string;

  constructor(level: LogLevel = LogLevel.INFO, prefix: string = '[UBE]') {
    this.level = level;
    this.prefix = prefix;
  }

  private shouldLog(level: LogLevel): boolean {
    const levels = [LogLevel.TRACE, LogLevel.DEBUG, LogLevel.INFO, LogLevel.WARN, LogLevel.ERROR, LogLevel.SILENT];
    return levels.indexOf(level) >= levels.indexOf(this.level);
  }

  trace(msg: string, data?: unknown): void {
    if (this.shouldLog(LogLevel.TRACE)) console.debug(`${this.prefix} TRACE ${msg}`, data || '');
  }
  debug(msg: string, data?: unknown): void {
    if (this.shouldLog(LogLevel.DEBUG)) console.debug(`${this.prefix} DEBUG ${msg}`, data || '');
  }
  info(msg: string, data?: unknown): void {
    if (this.shouldLog(LogLevel.INFO)) console.info(`${this.prefix} INFO ${msg}`, data || '');
  }
  warn(msg: string, data?: unknown): void {
    if (this.shouldLog(LogLevel.WARN)) console.warn(`${this.prefix} WARN ${msg}`, data || '');
  }
  error(msg: string, data?: unknown): void {
    if (this.shouldLog(LogLevel.ERROR)) console.error(`${this.prefix} ERROR ${msg}`, data || '');
  }
}

// ============================================================
// METRICS COLLECTOR
// ============================================================

class MetricsCollector {
  private requests: number = 0;
  private errors: number = 0;
  private totalLatency: number = 0;
  private readonly byEndpoint: Map<string, { count: number; totalMs: number; errors: number }> = new Map();
  readonly startTime: Date = new Date();

  record(endpoint: string, latencyMs: number, success: boolean): void {
    this.requests++;
    this.totalLatency += latencyMs;
    if (!success) this.errors++;

    const existing = this.byEndpoint.get(endpoint) || { count: 0, totalMs: 0, errors: 0 };
    existing.count++;
    existing.totalMs += latencyMs;
    if (!success) existing.errors++;
    this.byEndpoint.set(endpoint, existing);
  }

  get stats() {
    return {
      totalRequests: this.requests,
      totalErrors: this.errors,
      errorRate: this.requests > 0 ? this.errors / this.requests : 0,
      averageLatencyMs: this.requests > 0 ? this.totalLatency / this.requests : 0,
      uptime: Date.now() - this.startTime.getTime(),
    };
  }
}

// ============================================================
// WEBHOOK MANAGER
// ============================================================

class WebhookManager {
  private readonly webhooks: Map<string, WebhookConfig> = new Map();
  private readonly handlers: Map<WebhookEvent, ((payload: WebhookPayload) => void)[]> = new Map();

  register(config: WebhookConfig): string {
    const id = config.id || crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
    this.webhooks.set(id, { ...config, id });
    return id;
  }

  on(event: WebhookEvent, handler: (payload: WebhookPayload) => void): void {
    const existing = this.handlers.get(event) || [];
    existing.push(handler);
    this.handlers.set(event, existing);
  }

  async dispatch(payload: WebhookPayload): Promise<void> {
    const handlers = this.handlers.get(payload.event) || [];
    await Promise.allSettled(handlers.map(h => Promise.resolve(h(payload))));
  }

  verify(payload: string, signature: string, secret: string): boolean {
    try {
      const { createHmac } = require('crypto');
      const expected = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(payload).digest('hex');
      const sigBuffer = Buffer.from(signature.replace('sha256=', ''), 'hex');
      const expBuffer = Buffer.from(expected, 'hex');
      if (sigBuffer.length !== expBuffer.length) return false;
      return require('crypto').timingSafeEqual(sigBuffer, expBuffer);
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
}

export class UBEHttpClient {
  private readonly endpoint: string;
  private readonly auth: AuthManager;
  private readonly config: UBEConfig;
  private readonly logger: SDKLogger;
  private readonly queue: RequestQueue;
  private readonly rateLimiter: ClientRateLimiter;
  private readonly cache: ResponseCache;
  private readonly metrics: MetricsCollector;
  readonly webhooks: WebhookManager;
  private lastRateLimit?: RateLimitInfo;
  private eventHandlers: Map<SDKEvent, ((data: unknown) => void)[]> = new Map();

  constructor(config: UBEConfig) {
    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...config };
    this.endpoint = this.resolveEndpoint(config);
    this.auth = new AuthManager(this.config, this.endpoint);
    this.logger = config.logger || new ConsoleLogger(config.logLevel || LogLevel.WARN);
    this.queue = new RequestQueue(config.maxConnections || 10);
    this.rateLimiter = new ClientRateLimiter();
    this.cache = new ResponseCache();
    this.metrics = new MetricsCollector();
    this.webhooks = new WebhookManager();
  }

  private resolveEndpoint(config: UBEConfig): string {
    if (config.endpoint) return config.endpoint.replace(/\/$/, '');
    const env = config.environment || UBEEnvironment.CLOUD;
    return DEFAULT_ENDPOINTS[env] || DEFAULT_ENDPOINTS[UBEEnvironment.CLOUD];
  }

  async get<T>(path: string, options: UBERequestOptions = {}): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('GET', path, undefined, options);
  }

  async post<T>(path: string, body?: unknown, options: UBERequestOptions = {}): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('POST', path, body, options);
  }

  async put<T>(path: string, body?: unknown, options: UBERequestOptions = {}): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('PUT', path, body, options);
  }

  async patch<T>(path: string, body?: unknown, options: UBERequestOptions = {}): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('PATCH', path, body, options);
  }

  async delete<T>(path: string, options: UBERequestOptions = {}): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('DELETE', path, undefined, options);
  }

  private async request<T>(
    method: string,
    path: string,
    body?: unknown,
    options: UBERequestOptions = {}
  ): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    return this.queue.add(() => this.executeRequest<T>(method, path, body, options));
  }

  private async executeRequest<T>(
    method: string,
    path: string,
    body?: unknown,
    options: UBERequestOptions = {}
  ): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    const policy = options.retryPolicy || this.config.retryPolicy || { maxAttempts: 3, strategy: RetryStrategy.EXPONENTIAL_JITTER, baseDelayMs: 500, maxDelayMs: 10000 };
    const url = `${this.endpoint}${path}`;
    const bodyStr = body ? JSON.stringify(body) : '';
    const start = Date.now();
    let lastError: Error | undefined;

    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < policy.maxAttempts; attempt++) {
      if (attempt > 0) {
        const delay = this.computeDelay(attempt, policy);
        this.logger.debug(`Retry ${attempt}/${policy.maxAttempts - 1} after ${delay}ms`, { url, attempt });
        await this.sleep(delay);
      }

      try {
        const authHeaders = await this.auth.getHeaders(method, path, bodyStr);
        const headers: Record<string, string> = {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Accept': 'application/json',
          'X-UBE-SDK-Version': '1.0.0',
          'X-UBE-SDK-Language': 'typescript',
          'User-Agent': this.config.userAgent || 'ube-sdk/1.0.0 (typescript)',
          ...(options.traceId ? { 'X-Trace-ID': options.traceId } : {}),
          ...(options.idempotencyKey ? { 'X-Idempotency-Key': options.idempotencyKey } : {}),
          ...this.config.customHeaders,
          ...options.headers,
          ...authHeaders as Record<string, string>,
        };

        this.emit(SDKEvent.REQUEST_START, { method, url, attempt });

        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), options.timeout || this.config.timeout || 30000);
        const signal = options.signal
          ? this.mergeSignals(options.signal, controller.signal)
          : controller.signal;

        let res: Response;
        try {
          res = await fetch(url, {
            method,
            headers,
            body: body ? bodyStr : undefined,
            signal,
          });
        } finally {
          clearTimeout(timeout);
        }

        const latency = Date.now() - start;
        this.extractRateLimit(res.headers);

        if (res.status === 429) {
          const retryAfter = parseInt(res.headers.get('Retry-After') || '60') * 1000;
          throw new UBERateLimitError(
            'Rate limit exceeded',
            parseInt(res.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Limit') || '0'),
            parseInt(res.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Remaining') || '0'),
            new Date(Date.now() + retryAfter),
            retryAfter
          );
        }

        let data: unknown;
        const contentType = res.headers.get('Content-Type') || '';
        if (contentType.includes('application/json')) {
          data = await res.json();
        } else {
          data = await res.text();
        }

        if (!res.ok) {
          const errData = data as { error?: { code: string; message: string; retryable?: boolean } };
          if (errData?.error) {
            throw UBEErrorFactory.fromResponse({
              code: errData.error.code,
              message: errData.error.message,
              retryable: errData.error.retryable ?? false,
            });
          }
          throw UBEErrorFactory.fromHTTPStatus(res.status, `HTTP ${res.status}`);
        }

        const meta: ResponseMeta = {
          requestId: res.headers.get('X-Request-ID') || '',
          traceId: options.traceId || res.headers.get('X-Trace-ID') || '',
          timestamp: new Date(),
          processingMs: latency,
          rateLimit: this.lastRateLimit,
          version: res.headers.get('X-UBE-Version') || '1.0.0',
          region: res.headers.get('X-UBE-Region') || undefined,
        };

        this.metrics.record(path, latency, true);
        this.emit(SDKEvent.REQUEST_END, { method, url, latency, status: res.status });
        this.logger.trace(`${method} ${path} → ${res.status} (${latency}ms)`);

        const responseData = data as { data?: T; success?: boolean };
        return {
          success: true,
          data: responseData?.data !== undefined ? responseData.data : data as T,
          meta,
        };

      } catch (err) {
        const latency = Date.now() - start;
        lastError = err as Error;

        if (err instanceof Error && err.name === 'AbortError') {
          throw new UBETimeoutError(`Request aborted: ${url}`, options.timeout || 30000);
        }

        if (!isRetryableError(err) || attempt === policy.maxAttempts - 1) {
          this.metrics.record(path, latency, false);
          this.emit(SDKEvent.REQUEST_ERROR, { method, url, error: err });
          throw err;
        }

        this.logger.warn(`Request failed (attempt ${attempt + 1}), retrying...`, { error: String(err) });
      }
    }

    throw lastError || new UBEError('UNKNOWN' as any, 'Request failed after all retries');
  }

  private computeDelay(attempt: number, policy: SDKRetryPolicy): number {
    let delay: number;
    switch (policy.strategy) {
      case RetryStrategy.FIXED:
        delay = policy.baseDelayMs;
        break;
      case RetryStrategy.EXPONENTIAL:
        delay = policy.baseDelayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);
        break;
      case RetryStrategy.EXPONENTIAL_JITTER:
        delay = policy.baseDelayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);
        delay += Math.random() * delay * 0.1;
        break;
      default:
        delay = policy.baseDelayMs;
    }
    return Math.min(delay, policy.maxDelayMs);
  }

  private extractRateLimit(headers: Headers): void {
    const limit = headers.get('X-RateLimit-Limit');
    const remaining = headers.get('X-RateLimit-Remaining');
    const reset = headers.get('X-RateLimit-Reset');
    if (limit && remaining) {
      this.lastRateLimit = {
        limit: parseInt(limit),
        remaining: parseInt(remaining),
        resetAt: reset ? new Date(parseInt(reset) * 1000) : new Date(Date.now() + 60000),
        window: '1m',
      };
    }
  }

  private mergeSignals(s1: AbortSignal, s2: AbortSignal): AbortSignal {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const abort = () => controller.abort();
    s1.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
    s2.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
    return controller.signal;
  }

  private sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }

  on(event: SDKEvent, handler: (data: unknown) => void): void {
    const existing = this.eventHandlers.get(event) || [];
    existing.push(handler);
    this.eventHandlers.set(event, existing);
  }

  off(event: SDKEvent, handler: (data: unknown) => void): void {
    const existing = this.eventHandlers.get(event) || [];
    this.eventHandlers.set(event, existing.filter(h => h !== handler));
  }

  private emit(event: SDKEvent, data: unknown): void {
    const handlers = this.eventHandlers.get(event) || [];
    for (const handler of handlers) {
      try { handler(data); } catch { /* non-fatal */ }
    }
    if (this.config.onEvent) {
      try { this.config.onEvent(event, data); } catch { /* non-fatal */ }
    }
  }

  getMetrics() { return this.metrics.stats; }
  getRateLimit(): RateLimitInfo | undefined { return this.lastRateLimit; }
  getAuth(): AuthManager { return this.auth; }
  getEndpoint(): string { return this.endpoint; }
  invalidateCache(pattern?: string): void { this.cache.invalidate(pattern); }

  async ping(): Promise<number> {
    const start = Date.now();
    await this.get('/health');
    return Date.now() - start;
  }

  destroy(): void {
    this.auth.destroy();
    this.cache.invalidate();
    this.eventHandlers.clear();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// CRYPTO HELPER (for randomUUID in non-Node environments)
// ============================================================

function generateId(): string {
  try {
    return crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() :
      Array.from({ length: 16 }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 256).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  } catch {
    return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// FIELD VALIDATOR
// ============================================================

export class FieldValidator {
  validate(value: unknown, field: string, definition: FieldDefinition): ValidationField[] {
    const errors: ValidationField[] = [];

    if (definition.required && (value === undefined || value === null || value === '')) {
      errors.push({ field, message: `${field} is required`, value });
      return errors;
    }

    if (value === undefined || value === null) return errors;

    if (definition.type === 'string' && typeof value !== 'string') {
      errors.push({ field, message: `${field} must be a string` });
    }
    if (definition.type === 'number' && typeof value !== 'number') {
      errors.push({ field, message: `${field} must be a number` });
    }
    if (definition.type === 'boolean' && typeof value !== 'boolean') {
      errors.push({ field, message: `${field} must be a boolean` });
    }
    if (definition.type === 'array' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
      errors.push({ field, message: `${field} must be an array` });
    }

    if (typeof value === 'number') {
      if (definition.min !== undefined && value < definition.min) {
        errors.push({ field, message: `${field} must be >= ${definition.min}` });
      }
      if (definition.max !== undefined && value > definition.max) {
        errors.push({ field, message: `${field} must be <= ${definition.max}` });
      }
    }

    if (typeof value === 'string' && definition.pattern) {
      if (!new RegExp(definition.pattern).test(value)) {
        errors.push({ field, message: `${field} does not match pattern ${definition.pattern}` });
      }
    }

    if (definition.enum && !definition.enum.includes(value)) {
      errors.push({ field, message: `${field} must be one of: ${definition.enum.join(', ')}` });
    }

    return errors;
  }

  validateObject(obj: Record<string, unknown>, schema: Record<string, FieldDefinition>): ValidationField[] {
    const errors: ValidationField[] = [];
    for (const [field, def] of Object.entries(schema)) {
      errors.push(...this.validate(obj[field], field, def));
    }
    return errors;
  }
}

export class ConnectorSecretsImpl implements ConnectorSecrets {
  private readonly secrets: Map<string, string>;

  constructor(secrets: Record<string, string> = {}) {
    this.secrets = new Map(Object.entries(secrets));
  }

  get(key: string): string | undefined {
    return this.secrets.get(key);
  }

  getRequired(key: string): string {
    const value = this.secrets.get(key);
    if (!value) throw new UBEConnectorError('', `Required secret "${key}" not found`);
    return value;
  }

  getAll(): Record<string, string> {
    return Object.fromEntries(this.secrets);
  }

  set(key: string, value: string): void {
    this.secrets.set(key, value);
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.secrets.clear();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// ABSTRACT CONNECTOR BASE CLASS
// ============================================================

export abstract class ConnectorBase implements ConnectorLifecycle, ConnectorHooks {
  abstract readonly manifest: ConnectorManifest;
  protected context?: ConnectorContext;
  protected initialized: boolean = false;
  protected readonly validator: FieldValidator = new FieldValidator();
  private actionHandlers: Map<string, (input: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ConnectorContext) => Promise<unknown>> = new Map();

  // Lifecycle
  async onInit(context: ConnectorContext): Promise<void> {
    this.context = context;
    this.initialized = true;
    context.logger.debug(`Connector ${this.manifest.name} initialized`);
  }

  async onDestroy(): Promise<void> {
    this.initialized = false;
    this.context?.logger.debug(`Connector ${this.manifest.name} destroyed`);
  }

  async onAuth(_credentials: Record<string, string>): Promise<boolean> {
    return true;
  }

  async onHealthCheck(): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.initialized;
  }

  // Hooks
  async beforeExecute(_action: string, input: Record<string, unknown>, _context: ConnectorContext): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
    return input;
  }

  async afterExecute(_action: string, output: unknown, _context: ConnectorContext): Promise<unknown> {
    return output;
  }

  async onError(action: string, error: Error, context: ConnectorContext): Promise<void> {
    context.logger.error(`Connector ${this.manifest.name} action ${action} failed: ${error.message}`);
  }

  async onRetry(action: string, attempt: number, context: ConnectorContext): Promise<void> {
    context.logger.warn(`Retrying ${this.manifest.name}.${action} (attempt ${attempt})`);
  }

  // Action registration
  protected registerAction(
    name: string,
    handler: (input: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ConnectorContext) => Promise<unknown>
  ): void {
    this.actionHandlers.set(name, handler);
  }

  // Execution
  async execute(action: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown> {
    if (!this.context) throw new UBEConnectorError(this.manifest.name, 'Connector not initialized');

    const actionDef = this.manifest.actions.find(a => a === action);
    if (!actionDef) throw new UBEConnectorError(this.manifest.name, `Action "${action}" not found`, action);

    const processedInput = await this.beforeExecute(action, input, this.context);
    const handler = this.actionHandlers.get(action);
    if (!handler) throw new UBEConnectorError(this.manifest.name, `Handler for "${action}" not registered`);

    let output: unknown;
    try {
      output = await this.context.retry(() => handler(processedInput, this.context!));
    } catch (err) {
      await this.onError(action, err as Error, this.context);
      throw err;
    }

    return this.afterExecute(action, output, this.context);
  }

  // Validation helper
  protected validateInput(input: Record<string, unknown>, schema: Record<string, FieldDefinition>): void {
    const errors = this.validator.validateObject(input, schema);
    if (errors.length > 0) throw new UBEValidationError('Input validation failed', errors);
  }

  // Retry helper
  protected async withRetry<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, maxAttempts: number = 3, baseDelayMs: number = 500): Promise<T> {
    let lastErr: Error | undefined;
    for (let i = 0; i < maxAttempts; i++) {
      try {
        return await fn();
      } catch (err) {
        lastErr = err as Error;
        if (i < maxAttempts - 1) {
          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, baseDelayMs * Math.pow(2, i)));
        }
      }
    }
    throw lastErr;
  }

  // HTTP helper for connectors that make HTTP calls
  protected async httpRequest(url: string, options: {
    method?: string;
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    body?: unknown;
    timeout?: number;
  } = {}): Promise<unknown> {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), options.timeout || 30000);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, {
        method: options.method || 'GET',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...options.headers },
        body: options.body ? JSON.stringify(options.body) : undefined,
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new UBEConnectorError(this.manifest.name, `HTTP ${res.status}: ${url}`, options.method);
      const ct = res.headers.get('Content-Type') || '';
      return ct.includes('application/json') ? res.json() : res.text();
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }

  getName(): string { return this.manifest.name; }
  getVersion(): string { return this.manifest.version; }
  getType(): ConnectorType { return this.manifest.type; }
  isInitialized(): boolean { return this.initialized; }
  getActions(): string[] { return this.manifest.actions; }
}

// ============================================================
// CONNECTOR REGISTRY
// ============================================================

export class ConnectorRegistry {
  private readonly connectors: Map<string, ConnectorBase> = new Map();
  private readonly definitions: Map<string, ConnectorManifest> = new Map();

  register(connector: ConnectorBase): void {
    const name = connector.getName();
    this.connectors.set(name, connector);
    this.definitions.set(name, connector.manifest);
  }

  unregister(name: string): boolean {
    return this.connectors.delete(name) && this.definitions.delete(name);
  }

  get(name: string): ConnectorBase | undefined {
    return this.connectors.get(name);
  }

  getManifest(name: string): ConnectorManifest | undefined {
    return this.definitions.get(name);
  }

  list(): ConnectorManifest[] {
    return Array.from(this.definitions.values());
  }

  listByType(type: ConnectorType): ConnectorManifest[] {
    return this.list().filter(m => m.type === type);
  }

  has(name: string): boolean {
    return this.connectors.has(name);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// CONNECTOR CONTEXT BUILDER
// ============================================================

export class ConnectorContextBuilder {
  static build(
    executionId: string,
    config: Record<string, unknown>,
    secrets: Record<string, string>,
    logger: SDKLogger,
    options: {
      automationId?: string;
      workflowId?: string;
      tenantId?: string;
      traceId?: string;
      encryptionMode?: EncryptionMode;
    } = {}
  ): ConnectorContext {
    const secretsImpl = new ConnectorSecretsImpl(secrets);

    return {
      executionId,
      automationId: options.automationId,
      workflowId: options.workflowId,
      tenantId: options.tenantId,
      traceId: options.traceId || Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
      encryptionMode: options.encryptionMode || EncryptionMode.NONE,
      logger,
      config,
      secrets: secretsImpl,
      retry: async (fn) => {
        let lastErr: Error | undefined;
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          try { return await fn(); }
          catch (err) {
            lastErr = err as Error;
            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500 * Math.pow(2, i)));
          }
        }
        throw lastErr;
      },
      emit: (event, data) => {
        logger.debug(`[${executionId}] Event: ${event}`, data);
      },
    };
  }
}

// ============================================================
// CONNECTOR SDK API CLASS
// ============================================================

export class ConnectorSDK {
  private readonly http: UBEHttpClient;
  private readonly registry: ConnectorRegistry;
  private readonly validator: FieldValidator;

  constructor(http: UBEHttpClient) {
    this.http = http;
    this.registry = new ConnectorRegistry();
    this.validator = new FieldValidator();
  }

  // Register a connector class locally
  register(connector: ConnectorBase): void {
    this.registry.register(connector);
  }

  // Execute a registered local connector
  async executeLocal(
    connectorName: string,
    action: string,
    input: Record<string, unknown>,
    secrets: Record<string, string> = {}
  ): Promise<ConnectorExecuteResult> {
    const connector = this.registry.get(connectorName);
    if (!connector) {
      throw new UBEConnectorError(connectorName, `Connector "${connectorName}" not registered`);
    }

    const logger = this.http['logger'];
    const context = ConnectorContextBuilder.build(
      Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
      {},
      secrets,
      logger
    );

    if (!connector.isInitialized()) {
      await connector.onInit(context);
    }

    const start = Date.now();
    try {
      const output = await connector.execute(action, input);
      return { success: true, output, latencyMs: Date.now() - start };
    } catch (err) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: String(err),
        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,
      };
    }
  }

  // Execute a remote connector via UBE API
  async execute(request: ConnectorExecuteRequest, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<ConnectorExecuteResult> {
    const res = await this.http.post<ConnectorExecuteResult>(
      `/connectors/${request.connectorId}/execute`,
      request,
      options
    );
    if (!res.success || !res.data) {
      throw new UBEConnectorError(request.connectorId, 'Connector execution failed');
    }
    return res.data;
  }

  // List available connectors from registry
  async list(type?: ConnectorType, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<ConnectorManifest[]> {
    const params = type ? `?type=${type}` : '';
    const res = await this.http.get<{ connectors: ConnectorManifest[] }>(
      `/connectors${params}`,
      options
    );
    return res.data?.connectors || [];
  }

  // Get connector definition
  async get(connectorId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<ConnectorManifest> {
    const res = await this.http.get<ConnectorManifest>(`/connectors/${connectorId}`, options);
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEConnectorError(connectorId, 'Connector not found');
    return res.data;
  }

  // Test connector connection
  async test(connectorId: string, config?: Record<string, unknown>, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<ConnectorTestResult> {
    const res = await this.http.post<ConnectorTestResult>(
      `/connectors/${connectorId}/test`,
      { config },
      options
    );
    return res.data || { success: false, latencyMs: 0, error: 'Test failed' };
  }

  // Publish a new connector to UBE marketplace
  async publish(request: ConnectorPublishRequest, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<ConnectorPublishResult> {
    const res = await this.http.post<ConnectorPublishResult>(
      '/connectors/publish',
      request,
      options
    );
    if (!res.success || !res.data) {
      throw new UBEConnectorError(request.manifest.name, 'Connector publish failed');
    }
    return res.data;
  }

  // Install a connector from marketplace
  async install(connectorId: string, version?: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.post(
      `/connectors/${connectorId}/install`,
      { version },
      options
    );
    return res.success;
  }

  // Uninstall a connector
  async uninstall(connectorId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.delete(`/connectors/${connectorId}`, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  // Validate connector input against schema
  validateInput(schema: Record<string, FieldDefinition>, input: Record<string, unknown>): ValidationField[] {
    return this.validator.validateObject(input, schema);
  }

  // Get local registry
  getRegistry(): ConnectorRegistry {
    return this.registry;
  }

  // Build context for local execution
  buildContext(
    executionId: string,
    config: Record<string, unknown>,
    secrets: Record<string, string>,
    options = {}
  ): ConnectorContext {
    return ConnectorContextBuilder.build(executionId, config, secrets, this.http['logger'], options);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// EXAMPLE: HTTP CONNECTOR IMPLEMENTATION
// ============================================================

export class HTTPConnectorImpl extends ConnectorBase {
  readonly manifest: ConnectorManifest = {
    name: 'http',
    version: '1.0.0',
    type: ConnectorType.HTTP,
    description: 'Universal HTTP connector for any REST API',
    author: 'UBE',
    license: 'MIT',
    ubeVersion: '1.0.0',
    actions: ['get', 'post', 'put', 'patch', 'delete', 'head'],
    configSchema: {
      baseUrl: { type: 'string', required: false, description: 'Base URL for all requests' },
      timeout: { type: 'number', required: false, default: 30000, description: 'Request timeout in ms' },
      headers: { type: 'object', required: false, description: 'Default headers' },
    },
    tags: ['http', 'rest', 'api', 'universal'],
    verified: true,
    repository: 'https://github.com/ube-platform/connectors',
  };

  async onInit(context: ConnectorContext): Promise<void> {
    await super.onInit(context);
    this.registerAction('get', this.get.bind(this));
    this.registerAction('post', this.post.bind(this));
    this.registerAction('put', this.put.bind(this));
    this.registerAction('patch', this.patch.bind(this));
    this.registerAction('delete', this.delete.bind(this));
    this.registerAction('head', this.head.bind(this));
  }

  private async get(input: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ConnectorContext): Promise<unknown> {
    const url = this.buildUrl(input);
    return this.httpRequest(url, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: input.headers as Record<string, string>,
      timeout: (input.timeout as number) || 30000,
    });
  }

  private async post(input: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ConnectorContext): Promise<unknown> {
    const url = this.buildUrl(input);
    return this.httpRequest(url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: input.headers as Record<string, string>,
      body: input.body,
      timeout: (input.timeout as number) || 30000,
    });
  }

  private async put(input: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ConnectorContext): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.httpRequest(this.buildUrl(input), { method: 'PUT', body: input.body, headers: input.headers as Record<string, string> });
  }

  private async patch(input: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ConnectorContext): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.httpRequest(this.buildUrl(input), { method: 'PATCH', body: input.body, headers: input.headers as Record<string, string> });
  }

  private async delete(input: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ConnectorContext): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.httpRequest(this.buildUrl(input), { method: 'DELETE', headers: input.headers as Record<string, string> });
  }

  private async head(input: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ConnectorContext): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.httpRequest(this.buildUrl(input), { method: 'HEAD', headers: input.headers as Record<string, string> });
  }

  private buildUrl(input: Record<string, unknown>): string {
    const base = (this.context?.config.baseUrl as string) || '';
    const path = (input.url as string) || (input.path as string) || '';
    return path.startsWith('http') ? path : `${base}${path}`;
  }
}

import {

export interface AutomationBuilder {

  description(desc: string): AutomationBuilder;
  step(step: AutomationStep): AutomationBuilder;
  httpStep(name: string, url: string, method?: string, body?: unknown): AutomationBuilder;
  transformStep(name: string, transform: TransformConfig): AutomationBuilder;
  conditionStep(name: string, expression: string, onTrue?: string, onFalse?: string): AutomationBuilder;

  onSchedule(cron: string): AutomationBuilder;
  onWebhook(url: string): AutomationBuilder;
  withOptions(options: AutomationOptions): AutomationBuilder;

  withRetry(policy: SDKRetryPolicy): AutomationBuilder;
  withTag(...tags: string[]): AutomationBuilder;
  build(): AutomationRequest;

// ============================================================
// AUTOMATION BUILDER IMPLEMENTATION
// ============================================================

class AutomationBuilderImpl implements AutomationBuilder {
  private request: AutomationRequest = { steps: [] };

  name(name: string): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.name = name;
    return this;
  }

  description(desc: string): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.description = desc;
    return this;
  }

  step(step: AutomationStep): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.steps.push(step);
    return this;
  }

  httpStep(name: string, url: string, method: string = 'GET', body?: unknown): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'CONNECTOR' as any,
      connector: 'http',
      action: method.toLowerCase(),
      input: { url, method, body },
    });
  }

  transformStep(name: string, transform: TransformConfig): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'TRANSFORM' as any,
      action: 'transform',
      input: { transform },
    });
  }

  conditionStep(name: string, expression: string, onTrue?: string, onFalse?: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'CONDITION' as any,
      action: 'evaluate',
      conditions: [{ expression, onTrue: onTrue || 'continue', onFalse }],
    });
  }

  encryptStep(name: string, keyId?: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'ENCRYPT' as any,
      action: 'encrypt',
      input: { keyId },
      encrypt: true,
    });
  }

  storeStep(name: string, key: string, value?: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'STORE' as any,
      action: 'store',
      input: { key, value },
    });
  }

  notifyStep(name: string, channel: string, message: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'NOTIFY' as any,
      action: 'send',
      input: { channel, message },
    });
  }

  trigger(trigger: AutomationTrigger): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.trigger = trigger;
    return this;
  }

  onSchedule(cron: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.trigger({ type: WorkflowTriggerType.SCHEDULE, schedule: cron });
  }

  onWebhook(url: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.trigger({ type: WorkflowTriggerType.WEBHOOK, webhookUrl: url });
  }

  withOptions(options: AutomationOptions): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.options = { ...this.request.options, ...options };
    return this;
  }

  withEncryption(mode: EncryptionMode): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.withOptions({ encryptionMode: mode });
  }

  withRetry(policy: SDKRetryPolicy): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.withOptions({ retryPolicy: policy } as any);
  }

  withTag(...tags: string[]): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.tags = [...(this.request.tags || []), ...tags];
    return this;
  }

  build(): AutomationRequest {
    if (!this.request.steps.length) {
      throw new UBEValidationError('Automation must have at least one step', [
        { field: 'steps', message: 'At least one step is required' },
      ]);
    }
    return { ...this.request };
  }
}

// AUTOMATION SDK CLASS

export class AutomationSDK {
  private readonly http: UBEHttpClient;

  constructor(http: UBEHttpClient) {
    this.http = http;
  }

  // ── Run ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async run(request: AutomationRequest, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const res = await this.http.post<AutomationResult>('/automations/run', request, options);
    if (!res.success || !res.data) {
      throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Automation run failed');
    }
    return res.data;
  }

  async runAndWait(
    request: AutomationRequest,
    pollIntervalMs: number = 1000,
    timeoutMs: number = 300000,
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const result = await this.run(request, options);
    if (result.status === AutomationStatus.COMPLETED || result.status === AutomationStatus.FAILED) {
      return result;
    }
    return this.waitForCompletion(result.id, pollIntervalMs, timeoutMs, options);
  }

  async runBatch(
    batch: BatchRequest<AutomationRequest>,
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<BatchResult<AutomationResult>> {
    const res = await this.http.post<BatchResult<AutomationResult>>(
      '/automations/batch',
      batch,
      options
    );
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Batch run failed');
    return res.data;
  }

  // ── Status & Polling ─────────────────────────────────────

  async get(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const res = await this.http.get<AutomationResult>(`/automations/${automationId}`, options);
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.API_NOT_FOUND, `Automation ${automationId} not found`);
    return res.data;
  }

  async waitForCompletion(
    automationId: string,
    pollIntervalMs: number = 1000,
    timeoutMs: number = 300000,
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
    while (Date.now() < deadline) {
      const result = await this.get(automationId, options);
      if (
        result.status === AutomationStatus.COMPLETED ||
        result.status === AutomationStatus.FAILED ||
        result.status === AutomationStatus.CANCELLED
      ) {
        return result;
      }
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, pollIntervalMs));
    }
    throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_TIMEOUT, `Automation ${automationId} timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
  }

  async list(filter?: AutomationFilter, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<PaginatedResponse<AutomationListItem>> {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (filter?.status) params.set('status', filter.status.join(','));
    if (filter?.tags) params.set('tags', filter.tags.join(','));
    if (filter?.page) params.set('page', filter.page.toString());
    if (filter?.pageSize) params.set('pageSize', filter.pageSize.toString());
    if (filter?.sortBy) params.set('sortBy', filter.sortBy);
    if (filter?.sortOrder) params.set('sortOrder', filter.sortOrder);

    const res = await this.http.get<PaginatedResponse<AutomationListItem>>(
      `/automations?${params}`,
      options
    );
    return res.data || { items: [], total: 0, page: 1, pageSize: 20, hasMore: false };
  }

  // ── Control ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  async cancel(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/automations/${automationId}/cancel`, {}, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  async pause(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/automations/${automationId}/pause`, {}, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  async resume(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/automations/${automationId}/resume`, {}, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  async retry(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const res = await this.http.post<AutomationResult>(
      `/automations/${automationId}/retry`,
      {},
      options
    );
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Retry failed');
    return res.data;
  }

  async delete(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.delete(`/automations/${automationId}`, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  // ── Scheduling ────────────────────────────────────────────

  async schedule(
    request: AutomationRequest,
    cron: string,
    timezone: string = 'UTC',
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<ScheduledAutomation> {
    const res = await this.http.post<ScheduledAutomation>(
      '/automations/schedule',
      { request, schedule: cron, timezone },
      options
    );
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Schedule failed');
    return res.data;
  }

  async listScheduled(options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<ScheduledAutomation[]> {
    const res = await this.http.get<{ schedules: ScheduledAutomation[] }>('/automations/schedules', options);
    return res.data?.schedules || [];
  }

  async cancelSchedule(scheduleId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.delete(`/automations/schedules/${scheduleId}`, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  async pauseSchedule(scheduleId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/automations/schedules/${scheduleId}/pause`, {}, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  // ── Templates ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  async listTemplates(category?: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationTemplate[]> {
    const params = category ? `?category=${category}` : '';
    const res = await this.http.get<{ templates: AutomationTemplate[] }>(
      `/automations/templates${params}`,
      options
    );
    return res.data?.templates || [];
  }

  async getTemplate(templateId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationTemplate> {
    const res = await this.http.get<AutomationTemplate>(`/automations/templates/${templateId}`, options);
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.API_NOT_FOUND, `Template ${templateId} not found`);
    return res.data;
  }

  async runTemplate(
    templateId: string,
    variables: Record<string, unknown>,
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const res = await this.http.post<AutomationResult>(
      `/automations/templates/${templateId}/run`,
      { variables },
      options
    );
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Template run failed');
    return res.data;
  }

  // ── Metrics ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  async getMetrics(
    period: { start: Date; end: Date },
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<AutomationMetrics> {
    const res = await this.http.post<AutomationMetrics>('/automations/metrics', { period }, options);
    return res.data || {
      total: 0, byStatus: {} as any, averageDurationMs: 0,
      successRate: 0, totalDataProcessed: 0, topConnectors: [],
      period,
    };
  }

  // ── Dry Run ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  async dryRun(request: AutomationRequest, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<{
    valid: boolean;
    estimatedDurationMs: number;
    stepCount: number;
    warnings: string[];
    errors: string[];
  }> {
    const res = await this.http.post(
      '/automations/dry-run',
      { ...request, options: { ...request.options, dryRun: true } },
      options
    );
    return res.data as any || { valid: false, estimatedDurationMs: 0, stepCount: 0, warnings: [], errors: ['Dry run failed'] };
  }

  // ── Builder ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  builder(): AutomationBuilder {
    return new AutomationBuilderImpl();
  }

  // ── Quick shortcuts ───────────────────────────────────────

  async runHTTP(url: string, method: string = 'GET', body?: unknown): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    return this.run(
      this.builder()
        .name(`HTTP ${method} ${url}`)
        .httpStep('request', url, method, body)
        .build()
    );
  }

  async runTransform(data: unknown, transform: TransformConfig): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    return this.run(
      this.builder()
        .name('Transform')
        .step({ name: 'input', type: 'STORE' as any, action: 'store', input: { key: 'data', value: data } })
        .transformStep('transform', transform)
        .build()
    );
  }

  async runChain(steps: AutomationStep[], options?: AutomationOptions): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    return this.run(
      this.builder()
        .name('Chain')
        .withOptions(options || {})
        .build()
    );
  }
}

export { AutomationBuilderImpl };

/**
 * UBE SDK — sdk/src/encryption.ts
 * Universal Backend Engine — Client-Side Quantum-Safe Encryption Engine
 *
 * Mathematical Foundations:
 *   • Kyber-768 KEM  — Module-LWE over Rq = Z3329[x]/(x^256+1), NTT acceleration
 *   • AES-256-GCM    — Rijndael cipher, GF(2^8) arithmetic, GHASH polynomial MAC
 *   • BLAKE3          — Merkle-tree chaining, ChaCha-derived compression function
 *   • ChaCha20-Poly1305 — ARX cipher, Poly1305 over GF(2^130−5)
 *   • HKDF-SHA-512    — RFC 5869 extract+expand key derivation
 *   • Ed25519         — Twisted Edwards curve, Ristretto255 group operations
 *   • Hybrid KEM      — Kyber768 + X25519 combiner for classical+PQ safety
 *   • Threshold       — Shamir's Secret Sharing over GF(2^256)
 *   • Blind Tokens    — RSA-blind / VOPRF for anonymous computation requests
 *   • ZK Commitments  — Pedersen over BN128, range-proof request builders
 *
 * Civilization-scale design:
 *   Handles millions of concurrent encryption sessions.
 *   All operations constant-time where cryptographically required.
 *   Zero external dependencies — pure TypeScript mathematics.
 *   Production-deployable on Railway, Cloudflare Workers, Node 18+, Deno.
 *
 * @version 1.0.0
