// ─── Vector Clock ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class VectorClock {
  private clock: Map<string, number> = new Map();

  tick(nodeId: string): void {
    this.clock.set(nodeId, (this.clock.get(nodeId) ?? 0) + 1);
  }

  merge(other: VectorClock): void {
    for (const [id, t] of other.clock)
      this.clock.set(id, Math.max(this.clock.get(id) ?? 0, t));
  }

  happensBefore(other: VectorClock): boolean {
    const allIds = new Set([...this.clock.keys(), ...other.clock.keys()]);
    let strictlyLess = false;
    for (const id of allIds) {
      const a = this.clock.get(id) ?? 0;
      const b = other.clock.get(id) ?? 0;
      if (a > b) return false;
      if (a < b) strictlyLess = true;
    }
    return strictlyLess;
  }

  serialize(): Record<string, number> {
    return Object.fromEntries(this.clock);
  }

  static fromSerialized(data: Record<string, number>): VectorClock {
    const vc = new VectorClock();
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data)) vc.clock.set(k, v);
    return vc;
  }
}

// ─── Bloom Filter for Deduplication ──────────────────────────────────────────
// Space-efficient probabilistic data structure: P(false positive) = (1 - e^(-kn/m))^k

class BloomFilter {
  private bits:    Uint8Array;
  private readonly size:    number;
  private readonly hashFns: number;

  constructor(expectedItems: number, falsePositiveRate = 0.01) {
    this.size    = Math.ceil(-expectedItems * Math.log(falsePositiveRate) / (Math.LN2 ** 2));
    this.hashFns = Math.ceil((this.size / expectedItems) * Math.LN2);
    this.bits    = new Uint8Array(Math.ceil(this.size / 8));
  }

  add(item: string): void {
    for (const pos of this.positions(item))
      this.bits[Math.floor(pos / 8)] |= 1 << (pos % 8);
  }

  has(item: string): boolean {
    return this.positions(item).every(pos => (this.bits[Math.floor(pos / 8)] >> (pos % 8)) & 1);
  }

  private positions(item: string): number[] {
    const positions: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.hashFns; i++) {
      let h = 0x811c9dc5;
      const salted = `${i}:${item}`;
      for (let j = 0; j < salted.length; j++) { h ^= salted.charCodeAt(j); h = (h * 0x01000193) >>> 0; }
      positions.push(h % this.size);
    }
    return positions;
  }
}

// ─── Event Store ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class EventStore {
  private streams: Map<string, EventStoreEntry[]> = new Map();
  private states:  Map<string, StreamState>       = new Map();
  private globalLog: EventStoreEntry[]            = [];
  private position: number = 0;

  append(streamId: string, type: string, payload: unknown, metadata: EventMetadata, expectedVersion?: number): EventStoreEntry {
    if (!this.streams.has(streamId)) this.streams.set(streamId, []);
    const stream  = this.streams.get(streamId)!;
    const state   = this.getStreamState(streamId);

    if (expectedVersion !== undefined && state.version !== expectedVersion)
      throw new Error(`Optimistic concurrency conflict: expected version ${expectedVersion}, got ${state.version}`);

    const entry: EventStoreEntry = {
      streamId, eventId: this.uid(), type, payload, metadata,
      version:   state.version + 1,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      checksum:  this.checksum({ streamId, type, payload, version: state.version + 1 }),
    };

    stream.push(entry);
    this.globalLog.push(entry);
    state.version    = entry.version;
    state.lastEventAt = entry.timestamp;
    state.eventCount++;
    this.states.set(streamId, state);
    this.position++;
    return entry;
  }

  read(streamId: string, fromVersion = 0, toVersion?: number): EventStoreEntry[] {
    const stream = this.streams.get(streamId) ?? [];
    return stream.filter(e => e.version > fromVersion && (!toVersion || e.version <= toVersion));
  }

  readAll(fromPosition = 0, limit = 1000): EventStoreEntry[] {
    return this.globalLog.slice(fromPosition, fromPosition + limit);
  }

  getStreamState(streamId: string): StreamState {
    if (!this.states.has(streamId)) {
      this.states.set(streamId, { streamId, version: 0, lastEventAt: 0, eventCount: 0 });
    }
    return this.states.get(streamId)!;
  }

  saveSnapshot(streamId: string, version: number, state: unknown): void {
    const s = this.getStreamState(streamId);
    s.snapshot = { version, state, createdAt: Date.now() };
    this.states.set(streamId, s);
  }

  getSnapshot(streamId: string): { version: number; state: unknown } | null {
    return this.states.get(streamId)?.snapshot ?? null;
  }

  getPosition(): number { return this.position; }
  streamExists(streamId: string): boolean { return this.streams.has(streamId); }
  listStreams(): string[] { return Array.from(this.streams.keys()); }

  private uid(): string { return `evt-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8)}`; }
  private checksum(data: unknown): string {
    const s = JSON.stringify(data);
    let h = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = ((h << 5) - h + s.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
    return Math.abs(h).toString(16).padStart(8,'0');
  }
}

// ─── Dead Letter Queue ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class DeadLetterQueue {
  private items: Map<string, EventEnvelope[]> = new Map();

  push(queueName: string, envelope: EventEnvelope): void {
    if (!this.items.has(queueName)) this.items.set(queueName, []);
    const q = this.items.get(queueName)!;
    q.push({ ...envelope, status: 'dead_lettered' });
    if (q.length > 10_000) q.shift();
  }

  pop(queueName: string, limit = 10): EventEnvelope[] {
    const q = this.items.get(queueName) ?? [];
    return q.splice(0, limit);
  }

  size(queueName: string): number { return this.items.get(queueName)?.length ?? 0; }
  list(): string[] { return Array.from(this.items.keys()); }
}

// ─── Event Bus ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class EventBus {
  private subscriptions: Map<string, Subscription> = new Map();
  private pending:       Map<string, EventEnvelope> = new Map();
  private dlq:           DeadLetterQueue            = new DeadLetterQueue();
  private deduplication: BloomFilter                = new BloomFilter(100_000);
  private vectorClock:   VectorClock                = new VectorClock();
  private sequenceNum:   number                     = 0;
  private readonly nodeId: string;

  constructor(nodeId = 'ube-sdk') {
    this.nodeId = nodeId;
  }

  /** Subscribe to events matching a pattern */
  subscribe<T = unknown>(
    pattern: string | RegExp,
    handler: EventHandler<T>,
    options: Partial<SubscriptionOptions> = {}
  ): string {
    const id = `sub-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6)}`;
    const sub: Subscription = {
      id, pattern, handler: handler as EventHandler,
      options: {
        mode:          options.mode          ?? 'at_least_once',
        maxRetries:    options.maxRetries    ?? 3,
        retryDelayMs:  options.retryDelayMs  ?? 1000,
        timeout:       options.timeout       ?? 30_000,
        filter:        options.filter,
        concurrency:   options.concurrency   ?? 1,
        deadLetterQueue: options.deadLetterQueue,
      },
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      stats: { received:0, processed:0, failed:0, avgProcessingMs:0 },
    };
    this.subscriptions.set(id, sub);
    return id;
  }

  /** Unsubscribe */
  unsubscribe(subscriptionId: string): void {
    this.subscriptions.delete(subscriptionId);
  }

  /** Publish an event */
  async publish<T = unknown>(
    type:    string,
    payload: T,
    options: Partial<Omit<EventMetadata, 'compressed'|'encrypted'>> & {
      correlationId?: string;
      causationId?:   string;
      deduplicate?:   boolean;
    } = {}
  ): Promise<UBEEvent<T>> {
    this.vectorClock.tick(this.nodeId);

    const event: UBEEvent<T> = {
      id:            `evt-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10)}`,
      type,
      version:       1,
      payload,
      metadata: {
        source:     options.source     ?? this.nodeId,
        tenantId:   options.tenantId   ?? 'default',
        userId:     options.userId,
        traceId:    options.traceId,
        priority:   options.priority   ?? 'normal',
        tags:       options.tags       ?? [],
        compressed: false,
        encrypted:  false,
      },
      causationId:   options.causationId,
      correlationId: options.correlationId ?? `cor-${Date.now()}`,
      timestamp:     Date.now(),
      sequenceNum:   ++this.sequenceNum,
    };

    // Deduplication
    if (options.deduplicate !== false) {
      if (this.deduplication.has(event.id)) return event; // duplicate
      this.deduplication.add(event.id);
    }

    await this.dispatch(event);
    return event;
  }

  /** Publish multiple events atomically */
  async publishBatch<T = unknown>(events: Array<{ type: string; payload: T; options?: Parameters<EventBus['publish']>[2] }>): Promise<UBEEvent<T>[]> {
    return Promise.all(events.map(e => this.publish(e.type, e.payload, e.options)));
  }

  private async dispatch(event: UBEEvent): Promise<void> {
    const matchingSubs = Array.from(this.subscriptions.values()).filter(s => this.matches(event.type, s.pattern));
    if (matchingSubs.length === 0) return;

    // Sort by priority
    const priorityOrder: Record<EventPriority, number> = { critical:4, high:3, normal:2, low:1 };
    const priority = priorityOrder[event.metadata.priority];

    // Dispatch to all subscribers concurrently
    await Promise.allSettled(matchingSubs.map(sub => this.deliver(event, sub)));
  }

  private async deliver(event: UBEEvent, sub: Subscription): Promise<void> {
    sub.stats.received++;

    if (sub.options.filter && !sub.options.filter(event)) return;

    const envelope: EventEnvelope = {
      event, status: 'pending', attempts: 0,
    };

    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= sub.options.maxRetries + 1; attempt++) {
      envelope.attempts    = attempt;
      envelope.lastAttemptAt = Date.now();

      const start = Date.now();
      try {
        await Promise.race([
          Promise.resolve(sub.handler(event)),
          new Promise<never>((_, rej) => setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('Handler timeout')), sub.options.timeout)),
        ]);
        envelope.status      = 'delivered';
        envelope.deliveredAt = Date.now();
        sub.stats.processed++;
        sub.stats.lastEventAt = Date.now();
        const dur = Date.now() - start;
        sub.stats.avgProcessingMs = (sub.stats.avgProcessingMs * (sub.stats.processed - 1) + dur) / sub.stats.processed;
        return;
      } catch (err) {
        envelope.error = String(err);
        if (attempt <= sub.options.maxRetries) {
          const delay = sub.options.retryDelayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);
          envelope.nextRetryAt = Date.now() + delay;
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, delay));
        }
      }
    }

    // Dead letter
    sub.stats.failed++;
    envelope.status = 'dead_lettered';
    if (sub.options.deadLetterQueue)
      this.dlq.push(sub.options.deadLetterQueue, envelope);
  }

  private matches(eventType: string, pattern: string | RegExp): boolean {
    if (pattern instanceof RegExp) return pattern.test(eventType);
    if (pattern === '*') return true;
    if (pattern.endsWith('.*')) return eventType.startsWith(pattern.slice(0,-2));
    return pattern === eventType;
  }

  getSubscription(id: string): Subscription | null { return this.subscriptions.get(id) ?? null; }
  listSubscriptions(): Subscription[] { return Array.from(this.subscriptions.values()); }
  getDLQ(): DeadLetterQueue { return this.dlq; }
  getSequence(): number { return this.sequenceNum; }
  getVectorClock(): Record<string, number> { return this.vectorClock.serialize(); }
}

// ─── Event-Sourced Aggregate ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

export abstract class EventSourcedAggregate<S> {
  protected state!: S;
  protected version: number = 0;
  protected uncommittedEvents: UBEEvent[] = [];

  abstract applyEvent(event: UBEEvent): void;
  abstract readonly streamId: string;

  protected apply(type: string, payload: unknown, metadata: Partial<EventMetadata> = {}): UBEEvent {
    const event: UBEEvent = {
      id: `evt-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8)}`,
      type, version: this.version + 1, payload,
      metadata: { source:'aggregate', tenantId:'default', priority:'normal', tags:[], compressed:false, encrypted:false, ...metadata },
      correlationId: `cor-${Date.now()}`,
      timestamp: Date.now(), sequenceNum: this.version + 1,
    };
    this.applyEvent(event);
    this.version++;
    this.uncommittedEvents.push(event);
    return event;
  }

  rehydrate(events: EventStoreEntry[]): void {
    for (const e of events) {
      this.applyEvent({ id:e.eventId, type:e.type, version:e.version, payload:e.payload,
        metadata:e.metadata, correlationId:'', timestamp:e.timestamp, sequenceNum:e.version });
      this.version = e.version;
    }
  }

  getUncommitted(): UBEEvent[] { return [...this.uncommittedEvents]; }
  clearUncommitted(): void { this.uncommittedEvents = []; }
  getVersion(): number { return this.version; }
  getState(): S { return this.state; }
}

// ─── Projection Engine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ProjectionEngine {
  private projections: Map<string, {
    name:    string;
    handler: (state: Record<string,unknown>, event: UBEEvent) => Record<string,unknown>;
    state:   ProjectionState;
  }> = new Map();

  register(
    name:    string,
    handler: (state: Record<string,unknown>, event: UBEEvent) => Record<string,unknown>,
    initialState: Record<string,unknown> = {}
  ): void {
    this.projections.set(name, {
      name, handler,
      state: { id: `proj-${name}`, name, lastPosition: 0, updatedAt: Date.now(), state: initialState },
    });
  }

  process(events: UBEEvent[]): void {
    for (const event of events) {
      for (const proj of this.projections.values()) {
        proj.state.state        = proj.handler(proj.state.state, event);
        proj.state.lastPosition = event.sequenceNum;
        proj.state.updatedAt    = Date.now();
      }
    }
  }

  getState(name: string): ProjectionState | null {
    return this.projections.get(name)?.state ?? null;
  }

  rebuild(name: string, events: UBEEvent[], initialState: Record<string,unknown> = {}): ProjectionState {
    const proj = this.projections.get(name);
    if (!proj) throw new Error(`Projection "${name}" not registered`);
    proj.state.state = initialState;
    this.process(events);
    return proj.state;
  }
}

// ─── Master Event Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class UBEEventEngine {
  readonly bus:        EventBus;
  readonly store:      EventStore;
  readonly projections: ProjectionEngine;

  constructor(nodeId?: string) {
    this.bus        = new EventBus(nodeId);
    this.store      = new EventStore();
    this.projections = new ProjectionEngine();
  }

  /** Publish and store event */
  async emit<T>(streamId: string, type: string, payload: T, metadata?: Partial<EventMetadata>): Promise<UBEEvent<T>> {
    const event = await this.bus.publish(type, payload, metadata as Parameters<EventBus['publish']>[2]);
    this.store.append(streamId, type, payload, event.metadata);
    return event;
  }

  /** Replay events for a stream through projections */
  replay(streamId: string, projectionName: string): ProjectionState | null {
    const entries = this.store.read(streamId);
    const events  = entries.map(e => ({
      id: e.eventId, type: e.type, version: e.version, payload: e.payload,
      metadata: e.metadata, correlationId: '', timestamp: e.timestamp, sequenceNum: e.version,
    } as UBEEvent));
    this.projections.process(events);
    return this.projections.getState(projectionName);
  }
}

export default UBEEventEngine;
export { EventBus, EventStore, ProjectionEngine, VectorClock, BloomFilter, DeadLetterQueue };

// ─── Multibase Encoding ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class Multibase {
  static encodeBase58(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
    const ALPHABET = '123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';
    let num = 0n;
    for (const b of bytes) num = num * 256n + BigInt(b);
    let str = '';
    while (num > 0n) { str = ALPHABET[Number(num % 58n)]! + str; num = num / 58n; }
    for (const b of bytes) { if (b !== 0) break; str = '1' + str; }
    return str;
  }

  static decodeBase58(s: string): Uint8Array {
    const ALPHABET = '123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';
    let num = 0n;
    for (const c of s) { const idx = ALPHABET.indexOf(c); if (idx < 0) throw new Error('Invalid base58'); num = num * 58n + BigInt(idx); }
    const bytes: number[] = [];
    while (num > 0n) { bytes.unshift(Number(num & 0xffn)); num >>= 8n; }
    for (const c of s) { if (c !== '1') break; bytes.unshift(0); }
    return new Uint8Array(bytes);
  }

  static toMultibase(bytes: Uint8Array, encoding: 'z' = 'z'): string {
    return encoding + this.encodeBase58(bytes);
  }

  static fromMultibase(s: string): Uint8Array {
    if (!s.startsWith('z')) throw new Error('Only base58btc multibase supported');
    return this.decodeBase58(s.slice(1));
  }
}

// ─── Merkle Tree for Selective Disclosure ────────────────────────────────────

class MerkleTree {
  private leaves: string[];
  private tree:   string[][];

  constructor(leaves: string[]) {
    this.leaves = leaves;
    this.tree   = [leaves];
    this.build();
  }

  private hash(data: string): string {
    let h = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) { h ^= data.charCodeAt(i); h = (h * 0x01000193) >>> 0; }
    return h.toString(16).padStart(8,'0');
  }

  private build(): void {
    let level = this.leaves;
    while (level.length > 1) {
      const next: string[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < level.length; i += 2) {
        const l = level[i]!;
        const r = i+1 < level.length ? level[i+1]! : l;
        next.push(this.hash(l + r));
      }
      this.tree.push(next);
      level = next;
    }
  }

  root(): string { return this.tree[this.tree.length-1]?.[0] ?? ''; }

  proof(index: number): MerkleProof {
    const path: string[] = [];
    const indices: number[] = [];
    let i = index;
    for (let lvl = 0; lvl < this.tree.length - 1; lvl++) {
      const sibling = i % 2 === 0 ? i+1 : i-1;
      if (sibling < (this.tree[lvl]?.length ?? 0)) {
        path.push(this.tree[lvl]![sibling]!);
        indices.push(sibling);
      }
      i = Math.floor(i / 2);
    }
    return { root: this.root(), leaf: this.leaves[index] ?? '', path, indices };
  }

  static verify(proof: MerkleProof): boolean {
    let current = proof.leaf;
    const hash = (a: string, b: string) => {
      let h = 0x811c9dc5;
      const s = a+b;
      for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h ^= s.charCodeAt(i); h = (h*0x01000193)>>>0; }
      return h.toString(16).padStart(8,'0');
    };
    for (let i = 0; i < proof.path.length; i++) {
      const sibling = proof.path[i]!;
      current = proof.indices[i]! % 2 === 0 ? hash(current, sibling) : hash(sibling, current);
    }
    return current === proof.root;
  }
}

// ─── DID Document Builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class DIDBuilder {
  static createUBEDID(publicKey: Uint8Array, nodeId: string): string {
    const encoded = Multibase.toMultibase(publicKey);
    const suffix  = encoded.slice(1, 22);
    return `did:ube:${nodeId}:${suffix}`;
  }

  static buildDocument(keyPair: { publicKey: Uint8Array; did: string }): DIDDocument {
    const vmId = `${keyPair.did}#key-1`;
    const vm: VerificationMethod = {
      id:         vmId,
      type:       'Ed25519VerificationKey2020',
      controller: keyPair.did,
      publicKeyMultibase: Multibase.toMultibase(keyPair.publicKey),
    };
    return {
      '@context':           ['https://www.w3.org/ns/did/v1', 'https://w3id.org/security/suites/ed25519-2020/v1'],
      id:                   keyPair.did,
      verificationMethod:   [vm],
      authentication:       [vmId],
      assertionMethod:      [vmId],
      keyAgreement:         [vmId],
      capabilityInvocation: [vmId],
      capabilityDelegation: [vmId],
      created:              new Date().toISOString(),
      updated:              new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  }
}

// ─── Credential Engine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class CredentialEngine {
  private revocationList: Set<string> = new Set();
  private credentials:    Map<string, VerifiableCredential> = new Map();

  issue(
    issuerDid:   string,
    subjectDid:  string,
    types:       string[],
    claims:      Record<string, unknown>,
    options:     { expiresIn?: number; schemaId?: string; evidence?: Evidence[] } = {}
  ): VerifiableCredential {
    const now = new Date();
    const vc: VerifiableCredential = {
      '@context': ['https://www.w3.org/2018/credentials/v1', 'https://www.w3.org/2018/credentials/examples/v1'],
      id:         `urn:uuid:${this.uid()}`,
      type:       ['VerifiableCredential', ...types],
      issuer:     issuerDid,
      issuanceDate: now.toISOString(),
      expirationDate: options.expiresIn ? new Date(now.getTime() + options.expiresIn).toISOString() : undefined,
      credentialSubject: { id: subjectDid, ...claims },
      credentialSchema: options.schemaId ? { id: options.schemaId, type: 'JsonSchemaValidator2018' } : undefined,
      credentialStatus: {
        id:   `https://ube.io/status/${this.uid()}`,
        type: 'StatusList2021Entry',
        statusPurpose: 'revocation',
        statusListIndex: String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 100_000)),
        statusListCredential: 'https://ube.io/status/list/1',
      },
      evidence: options.evidence,
      proof: this.createProof(issuerDid, `${issuerDid}#key-1`),
    };
    this.credentials.set(vc.id, vc);
    return vc;
  }

  verify(vc: VerifiableCredential): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    if (!vc.proof) errors.push('Missing proof');
    if (!vc.issuer) errors.push('Missing issuer');
    if (!vc.credentialSubject) errors.push('Missing credentialSubject');
    if (vc.expirationDate && new Date(vc.expirationDate) < new Date()) errors.push('Credential expired');
    if (vc.credentialStatus && this.revocationList.has(vc.id)) errors.push('Credential revoked');
    if (!vc.type.includes('VerifiableCredential')) errors.push('Missing VerifiableCredential type');
    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }

  revoke(credentialId: string): void { this.revocationList.add(credentialId); }
  isRevoked(credentialId: string): boolean { return this.revocationList.has(credentialId); }

  createPresentation(
    holderDid: string,
    credentials: VerifiableCredential[],
    challenge: string,
    domain: string
  ): VerifiablePresentation {
    return {
      '@context': ['https://www.w3.org/2018/credentials/v1'],
      id: `urn:uuid:${this.uid()}`,
      type: ['VerifiablePresentation'],
      holder: holderDid,
      verifiableCredential: credentials,
      proof: { ...this.createProof(holderDid, `${holderDid}#key-1`), challenge, domain },
    };
  }

  /** Selective disclosure: reveal only specified fields */
  selectiveDisclosure(vc: VerifiableCredential, revealPaths: string[]): SelectiveDisclosure {
    const subject = vc.credentialSubject as Record<string, unknown>;
    const allPaths = Object.keys(subject);
    const leaves   = allPaths.map(p => `${p}:${JSON.stringify(subject[p])}`);
    const tree     = new MerkleTree(leaves);

    const blindedValues: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const path of allPaths) {
      if (!revealPaths.includes(path)) {
        let h = 0;
        const s = `${path}:${JSON.stringify(subject[path])}`;
        for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = ((h << 5) - h + s.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
        blindedValues[path] = Math.abs(h).toString(16);
      }
    }

    const revealIndex = revealPaths.map(p => allPaths.indexOf(p)).filter(i => i >= 0);
    const proof = revealIndex.length > 0 ? tree.proof(revealIndex[0]!) : { root: tree.root(), leaf: '', path: [], indices: [] };

    return { credentialId: vc.id, revealedPaths: revealPaths, proof, blindedValues };
  }

  private createProof(controller: string, verificationMethod: string): LinkedDataProof {
    return {
      type: 'Ed25519Signature2020',
      created: new Date().toISOString(),
      verificationMethod,
      proofPurpose: 'assertionMethod',
      proofValue: Multibase.toMultibase(new Uint8Array(64).fill(0).map(() => Math.floor(Math.random() * 256))),
    };
  }

  private uid(): string { return `${Date.now().toString(16)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10)}`; }
}

// ─── DID Resolver ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class DIDResolver {
  private documents: Map<string, DIDDocument> = new Map();

  register(document: DIDDocument): void { this.documents.set(document.id, document); }

  async resolve(did: string): Promise<DIDDocument | null> {
    if (this.documents.has(did)) return this.documents.get(did)!;
    // In production: HTTP resolution for web/ethr/ion methods
    if (did.startsWith('did:web:')) return this.resolveWeb(did);
    return null;
  }

  private async resolveWeb(did: string): Promise<DIDDocument | null> {
    const domain = did.replace('did:web:', '').replace(/:/g, '/');
    const url    = `https://${domain}/.well-known/did.json`;
    // Real impl: fetch(url); simplified here:
    return null;
  }

  getVerificationMethod(document: DIDDocument, id: string): VerificationMethod | null {
    return document.verificationMethod.find(vm => vm.id === id) ?? null;
  }
}

// ─── Identity Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class IdentityEngine {
  readonly credentials: CredentialEngine;
  readonly resolver:    DIDResolver;
  private identities:   Map<string, IdentityKeyPair> = new Map();

  constructor() { this.credentials = new CredentialEngine(); this.resolver = new DIDResolver(); }

  createIdentity(method: DIDMethod = 'ube', nodeId = 'main'): IdentityKeyPair {
    const privateKey  = new Uint8Array(32).map(() => Math.floor(Math.random() * 256));
    const publicKey   = new Uint8Array(32).map((_, i) => privateKey[i]! ^ 0xff); // simplified; real: ed25519 pk from sk
    const did         = DIDBuilder.createUBEDID(publicKey, nodeId);
    const document    = DIDBuilder.buildDocument({ publicKey, did });
    const identity: IdentityKeyPair = {
      did, method, publicKey, privateKey,
      publicKeyMultibase: Multibase.toMultibase(publicKey),
      document, createdAt: Date.now(),
    };
    this.identities.set(did, identity);
    this.resolver.register(document);
    return identity;
  }

  getIdentity(did: string): IdentityKeyPair | null { return this.identities.get(did) ?? null; }
  listIdentities(): IdentityKeyPair[] { return Array.from(this.identities.values()); }

  issueCredential(issuerDid: string, subjectDid: string, types: string[], claims: Record<string, unknown>, opts?: Parameters<CredentialEngine['issue']>[4]): VerifiableCredential {
    if (!this.identities.has(issuerDid)) throw new Error(`Issuer DID ${issuerDid} not found`);
    return this.credentials.issue(issuerDid, subjectDid, types, claims, opts);
  }

  createPresentationRequest(verifierDid: string, requiredTypes: string[], constraints: PresentationConstraint[] = []): PresentationRequest {
    return {
      id:            `req-${Date.now()}`,
      verifier:      verifierDid,
      challenge:     this.randomHex(32),
      domain:        'ube.io',
      requiredTypes,
      constraints,
      expiresAt:     Date.now() + 300_000,
    };
  }

  private randomHex(bytes: number): string {
    return Array.from({ length: bytes }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 256).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
  }
}

/**
 * UBE SDK — sdk/src/sync.ts
 * Real-time sync engine: CRDTs, operational transforms, offline-first, conflict resolution.
 * Mathematical: CRDT state merge (join-semilattice), Vector clocks, OT transformations.
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

export type SyncStatus   = 'synced'|'pending'|'conflict'|'offline'|'syncing'|'error';
export type CRDTType     = 'lww-register'|'mv-register'|'g-counter'|'pn-counter'|'g-set'|'or-set'|'rga'|'lww-map';
export type ConflictStrategy = 'last-write-wins'|'first-write-wins'|'merge'|'manual'|'crdt';

export interface SyncDocument<T = unknown> {
  id:        string;
  data:      T;
  version:   number;
  vectorClock: Record<string, number>;
  checksum:  string;
  updatedAt: number;
  updatedBy: string;
  status:    SyncStatus;
  conflicts: SyncConflict<T>[];
  history:   SyncOperation[];
  tenantId:  string;
}

export interface SyncOperation {
  id:        string;
  type:      'insert'|'update'|'delete'|'merge';
  path:      string;
  value?:    unknown;
  oldValue?: unknown;
  timestamp: number;
  nodeId:    string;
  vectorClock: Record<string, number>;
  applied:   boolean;
}

export interface SyncConflict<T = unknown> {
  id:        string;
  local:     T;
  remote:    T;
  base?:     T;
  timestamp: number;
  resolution?: T;
  resolvedAt?: number;
  resolvedBy?: string;
}

export interface CRDTState {
  type:  CRDTType;
  state: unknown;
  nodeId: string;
}

// ─── Vector Clock ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class VClock {
  private c: Map<string, number> = new Map();

  increment(node: string): VClock { const n = new VClock(); n.c = new Map(this.c); n.c.set(node, (n.c.get(node) ?? 0) + 1); return n; }
  merge(other: VClock): VClock {
    const n = new VClock(); n.c = new Map(this.c);
    for (const [k,v] of other.c) n.c.set(k, Math.max(n.c.get(k) ?? 0, v));
    return n;
  }
  happensBefore(other: VClock): boolean {
    const ids = new Set([...this.c.keys(), ...other.c.keys()]);
    let lt = false;
    for (const id of ids) {
      const a = this.c.get(id) ?? 0, b = other.c.get(id) ?? 0;
      if (a > b) return false; if (a < b) lt = true;
    }
    return lt;
  }
  concurrent(other: VClock): boolean { return !this.happensBefore(other) && !other.happensBefore(this); }
  serialize(): Record<string, number> { return Object.fromEntries(this.c); }
  static from(data: Record<string, number>): VClock { const v = new VClock(); v.c = new Map(Object.entries(data)); return v; }
}

// ─── LWW Register ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class LWWRegister<T> {
  private value: T;
  private ts:    number;
  private node:  string;

  constructor(initial: T, nodeId: string) { this.value = initial; this.ts = Date.now(); this.node = nodeId; }

  set(value: T, timestamp = Date.now(), nodeId = this.node): void {
    if (timestamp > this.ts || (timestamp === this.ts && nodeId > this.node)) {
      this.value = value; this.ts = timestamp; this.node = nodeId;
    }
  }
  get(): T { return this.value; }
  getTimestamp(): number { return this.ts; }
  merge(other: LWWRegister<T>): LWWRegister<T> {
    const r = new LWWRegister<T>(this.value, this.node);
    r.ts = this.ts; r.node = this.node;
    r.set(other.get(), other.getTimestamp(), other.node);
    return r;
  }
  state(): CRDTState { return { type: 'lww-register', state: { value: this.value, ts: this.ts, node: this.node }, nodeId: this.node }; }
}

// ─── G-Counter ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class GCounter {
  private counts: Map<string, number> = new Map();
  constructor(private nodeId: string) {}

  increment(n = 1): void { this.counts.set(this.nodeId, (this.counts.get(this.nodeId) ?? 0) + n); }
  value(): number { return Array.from(this.counts.values()).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); }
  merge(other: GCounter): GCounter {
    const r = new GCounter(this.nodeId);
    r.counts = new Map(this.counts);
    for (const [k, v] of other.counts) r.counts.set(k, Math.max(r.counts.get(k) ?? 0, v));
    return r;
  }
  state(): CRDTState { return { type: 'g-counter', state: Object.fromEntries(this.counts), nodeId: this.nodeId }; }
}

// ─── PN-Counter ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class PNCounter {
  private pos: GCounter;
  private neg: GCounter;
  constructor(nodeId: string) { this.pos = new GCounter(nodeId); this.neg = new GCounter(nodeId); }
  increment(n = 1): void { this.pos.increment(n); }
  decrement(n = 1): void { this.neg.increment(n); }
  value(): number { return this.pos.value() - this.neg.value(); }
  merge(other: PNCounter): PNCounter {
    const r = new PNCounter('merged');
    r.pos = this.pos.merge(other.pos);
    r.neg = this.neg.merge(other.neg);
    return r;
  }
}

// ─── OR-Set ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ORSet<T> {
  private elements: Map<string, { value: T; tags: Set<string> }> = new Map();
  private tombstones: Set<string> = new Set();

  add(value: T): string {
    const key = JSON.stringify(value);
    const tag = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
    if (!this.elements.has(key)) this.elements.set(key, { value, tags: new Set() });
    this.elements.get(key)!.tags.add(tag);
    return tag;
  }

  remove(value: T): void {
    const key = JSON.stringify(value);
    const el  = this.elements.get(key);
    if (el) { el.tags.forEach(t => this.tombstones.add(t)); el.tags.clear(); }
  }

  has(value: T): boolean {
    const key = JSON.stringify(value);
    const el  = this.elements.get(key);
    return el ? el.tags.size > 0 : false;
  }

  values(): T[] {
    return Array.from(this.elements.values()).filter(el => el.tags.size > 0).map(el => el.value);
  }

  merge(other: ORSet<T>): ORSet<T> {
    const r = new ORSet<T>();
    r.elements  = new Map(this.elements);
    r.tombstones = new Set([...this.tombstones, ...other.tombstones]);
    for (const [key, el] of other.elements) {
      if (!r.elements.has(key)) r.elements.set(key, { value: el.value, tags: new Set() });
      for (const tag of el.tags) { if (!r.tombstones.has(tag)) r.elements.get(key)!.tags.add(tag); }
    }
    return r;
  }
}

// ─── Operational Transform Engine ────────────────────────────────────────────

export class OTEngine {
  /** Transform two concurrent operations against each other */
  static transform(op1: SyncOperation, op2: SyncOperation): { op1: SyncOperation; op2: SyncOperation } {
    if (op1.path !== op2.path) return { op1, op2 };
    // Simple LWW transform: later timestamp wins
    if (op1.timestamp >= op2.timestamp) {
      return { op1, op2: { ...op2, value: op1.value } };
    }
    return { op1: { ...op1, value: op2.value }, op2 };
  }

  /** Apply operation to document */
  static apply<T>(doc: SyncDocument<T>, op: SyncOperation): SyncDocument<T> {
    let data = doc.data as Record<string, unknown>;
    const paths = op.path.split('.').filter(Boolean);

    if (op.type === 'delete') {
      const lastKey = paths.pop()!;
      let obj = data;
      for (const p of paths) obj = obj[p] as Record<string, unknown>;
      delete obj[lastKey];
    } else if (op.type === 'update' || op.type === 'insert') {
      let obj = data;
      for (let i = 0; i < paths.length - 1; i++) {
        if (!(paths[i]! in obj)) obj[paths[i]!] = {};
        obj = obj[paths[i]!] as Record<string, unknown>;
      }
      if (paths.length > 0) obj[paths[paths.length - 1]!] = op.value;
    }

    const vc = VClock.from(doc.vectorClock).increment(op.nodeId);
    return {
      ...doc,
      data:        data as T,
      version:     doc.version + 1,
      vectorClock: vc.serialize(),
      updatedAt:   op.timestamp,
      updatedBy:   op.nodeId,
    };
  }
}

// ─── Sync Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class SyncEngine {
  private documents: Map<string, SyncDocument>  = new Map();
  private pending:   Map<string, SyncOperation[]> = new Map();
  private listeners: Map<string, ((doc: SyncDocument) => void)[]> = new Map();
  private online = true;

  get<T>(id: string): SyncDocument<T> | null { return this.documents.get(id) as SyncDocument<T> | null; }

  set<T>(id: string, data: T, nodeId: string, tenantId = 'default'): SyncDocument<T> {
    const existing = this.documents.get(id);
    const vc = existing ? VClock.from(existing.vectorClock).increment(nodeId) : VClock.from({}).increment(nodeId);
    const doc: SyncDocument<T> = {
      id, data, version: (existing?.version ?? 0) + 1,
      vectorClock: vc.serialize(),
      checksum: this.hash(data),
      updatedAt: Date.now(), updatedBy: nodeId,
      status: this.online ? 'synced' : 'pending',
      conflicts: existing?.conflicts ?? [],
      history: [],
      tenantId,
    };
    this.documents.set(id, doc as SyncDocument);
    this.notify(id, doc as SyncDocument);
    return doc;
  }

  applyOp<T>(id: string, op: SyncOperation): SyncDocument<T> | null {
    const doc = this.documents.get(id);
    if (!doc) return null;
    const updated = OTEngine.apply(doc, op) as SyncDocument<T>;
    updated.history.push({ ...op, applied: true });
    this.documents.set(id, updated as SyncDocument);
    this.notify(id, updated as SyncDocument);
    return updated;
  }

  /** Sync with remote — detect and resolve conflicts */
  sync<T>(id: string, remote: SyncDocument<T>, strategy: ConflictStrategy = 'last-write-wins'): SyncDocument<T> {
    const local = this.documents.get(id) as SyncDocument<T> | undefined;
    if (!local) { this.documents.set(id, remote as SyncDocument); return remote; }

    const localVC  = VClock.from(local.vectorClock);
    const remoteVC = VClock.from(remote.vectorClock);

    if (localVC.happensBefore(remoteVC)) { this.documents.set(id, remote as SyncDocument); return remote; }
    if (remoteVC.happensBefore(localVC)) return local;

    // Concurrent — conflict!
    if (strategy === 'last-write-wins') {
      const winner = local.updatedAt >= remote.updatedAt ? local : remote;
      winner.conflicts.push({ id: `c-${Date.now()}`, local: local.data, remote: remote.data, timestamp: Date.now() });
      this.documents.set(id, winner as SyncDocument);
      return winner;
    }
    if (strategy === 'crdt') {
      // Deep merge: for each key, last write wins per field
      const merged = this.deepMerge(local.data, remote.data);
      const mergedVC = localVC.merge(remoteVC);
      const doc: SyncDocument<T> = { ...local, data: merged, vectorClock: mergedVC.serialize(), status: 'synced', updatedAt: Date.now() };
      this.documents.set(id, doc as SyncDocument);
      return doc;
    }
    // Manual — mark conflict for human resolution
    local.status = 'conflict';
    local.conflicts.push({ id: `c-${Date.now()}`, local: local.data, remote: remote.data, timestamp: Date.now() });
    this.documents.set(id, local as SyncDocument);
    return local;
  }

  resolveConflict<T>(docId: string, conflictId: string, resolution: T, resolvedBy: string): void {
    const doc = this.documents.get(docId);
    if (!doc) return;
    const conflict = doc.conflicts.find(c => c.id === conflictId);
    if (conflict) { conflict.resolution = resolution; conflict.resolvedAt = Date.now(); conflict.resolvedBy = resolvedBy; }
    if (doc.conflicts.every(c => c.resolvedAt)) doc.status = 'synced';
    this.documents.set(docId, doc);
  }

  subscribe(docId: string, cb: (doc: SyncDocument) => void): () => void {
    if (!this.listeners.has(docId)) this.listeners.set(docId, []);
    this.listeners.get(docId)!.push(cb);
    return () => { const l = this.listeners.get(docId) ?? []; this.listeners.set(docId, l.filter(x => x !== cb)); };
  }

  setOnline(online: boolean): void {
    this.online = online;
    if (online) {
      // Flush pending operations
      for (const [id, ops] of this.pending) {
        const doc = this.documents.get(id);
        if (doc) for (const op of ops) this.applyOp(id, op);
        this.pending.delete(id);
      }
    }
  }

  private notify(id: string, doc: SyncDocument): void { for (const cb of (this.listeners.get(id) ?? [])) { try { cb(doc); } catch {} } }
  private hash(data: unknown): string { let h = 0; const s = JSON.stringify(data); for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = ((h << 5) - h + s.charCodeAt(i)) | 0; return Math.abs(h).toString(16); }
  private deepMerge<T>(local: T, remote: T): T {
    if (typeof local !== 'object' || typeof remote !== 'object' || !local || !remote) return remote ?? local;
    const result = { ...local as object } as Record<string, unknown>;
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(remote as object)) {
      if (k in result) { result[k] = this.deepMerge(result[k], v); }
      else result[k] = v;
    }
    return result as T;
  }
}

export default SyncEngine;
export { VClock, OTEngine, LWWRegister, GCounter, PNCounter, ORSet };

/**

export type SpanStatus  = 'unset'|'ok'|'error';
export type MetricType  = 'counter'|'gauge'|'histogram'|'summary';

export interface Span {

// ─── Tracer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class Tracer {
  private spans:      Map<string, Span> = new Map();
  private completed:  Span[] = [];
  private readonly maxCompleted = 1000;

  constructor(private readonly service: string) {}

  startSpan(name: string, options: { parentId?: string; attributes?: Record<string, string|number|boolean> } = {}): Span {
    const span: Span = {
      traceId:    options.parentId ? this.spans.get(options.parentId)?.traceId ?? this.uid() : this.uid(),
      spanId:     this.uid(),
      parentId:   options.parentId,
      name, service: this.service,
      startTime:  Date.now(),
      status:     'unset',
      attributes: options.attributes ?? {},
      events: [], links: [],
    };
    this.spans.set(span.spanId, span);
    return span;
  }

  endSpan(spanId: string, status: SpanStatus = 'ok', error?: string): Span {
    const span = this.spans.get(spanId);
    if (!span) throw new Error(`Span ${spanId} not found`);
    span.endTime  = Date.now();
    span.duration = span.endTime - span.startTime;
    span.status   = status;
    if (error) span.error = error;
    this.spans.delete(spanId);
    this.completed.push(span);
    if (this.completed.length > this.maxCompleted) this.completed.shift();
    return span;
  }

  addEvent(spanId: string, name: string, attributes: Record<string, unknown> = {}): void {
    const span = this.spans.get(spanId);
    if (span) span.events.push({ name, timestamp: Date.now(), attributes });
  }

  setAttribute(spanId: string, key: string, value: string | number | boolean): void {
    const span = this.spans.get(spanId);
    if (span) span.attributes[key] = value;
  }

  /** Wrap an async function in a span */
  async trace<T>(name: string, fn: (span: Span) => Promise<T>, parentId?: string): Promise<T> {
    const span = this.startSpan(name, { parentId });
    try {
      const result = await fn(span);
      this.endSpan(span.spanId, 'ok');
      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      this.endSpan(span.spanId, 'error', String(err));
      throw err;
    }
  }

  getCompleted(limit = 100): Span[] { return this.completed.slice(-limit); }
  getActive(): Span[] { return Array.from(this.spans.values()); }
  getTrace(traceId: string): Span[] { return this.completed.filter(s => s.traceId === traceId); }

  private uid(): string {
    return Array.from({ length: 16 }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 16).toString(16)).join('');
  }
}

// ─── Metrics Registry ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class MetricsRegistry {
  private counters:    Map<string, { value: number; labels: Record<string, string> }> = new Map();
  private gauges:      Map<string, { value: number; labels: Record<string, string> }> = new Map();
  private histograms:  Map<string, number[]>                                           = new Map();
  private series:      Map<string, Metric[]>                                           = new Map();
  private alerts:      Alert[]                                                         = [];
  private alertRules:  AlertRule[]                                                     = [];
  private lastAlertAt: Map<string, number>                                             = new Map();

  counter(name: string, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): void {
    const key = this.key(name, labels);
    const c   = this.counters.get(key) ?? { value: 0, labels };
    c.value++;
    this.counters.set(key, c);
    this.record(name, 'counter', c.value, labels);
  }

  counterBy(name: string, n: number, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): void {
    const key = this.key(name, labels);
    const c   = this.counters.get(key) ?? { value: 0, labels };
    c.value += n;
    this.counters.set(key, c);
    this.record(name, 'counter', c.value, labels);
  }

  gauge(name: string, value: number, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): void {
    const key = this.key(name, labels);
    this.gauges.set(key, { value, labels });
    this.record(name, 'gauge', value, labels);
  }

  histogram(name: string, value: number, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): void {
    const key = this.key(name, labels);
    if (!this.histograms.has(key)) this.histograms.set(key, []);
    const arr = this.histograms.get(key)!;
    arr.push(value);
    if (arr.length > 10_000) arr.shift();
    this.record(name, 'histogram', value, labels);
  }

  getCounter(name: string, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): number {
    return this.counters.get(this.key(name, labels))?.value ?? 0;
  }

  getGauge(name: string, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): number {
    return this.gauges.get(this.key(name, labels))?.value ?? 0;
  }

  getSeries(name: string, lastN = 100): Metric[] {
    return (this.series.get(name) ?? []).slice(-lastN);
  }

  getHistogramStats(name: string, labels: Record<string,string> = {}): { p50: number; p95: number; p99: number; min: number; max: number; avg: number; count: number } {
    const arr = [...(this.histograms.get(this.key(name, labels)) ?? [])].sort((a,b) => a-b);
    const n = arr.length;
    if (n === 0) return { p50:0, p95:0, p99:0, min:0, max:0, avg:0, count:0 };
    return {
      p50: arr[Math.floor(n*0.50)] ?? 0,
      p95: arr[Math.floor(n*0.95)] ?? 0,
      p99: arr[Math.floor(n*0.99)] ?? 0,
      min: arr[0]!, max: arr[n-1]!,
      avg: arr.reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0) / n,
      count: n,
    };
  }

  addAlertRule(rule: AlertRule): void { this.alertRules.push(rule); }

  private checkAlerts(name: string, value: number): void {
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const rule of this.alertRules) {
      if (rule.metric !== name) continue;
      const cooldown = this.lastAlertAt.get(rule.name) ?? 0;
      if (now - cooldown < rule.cooldownMs) continue;

      const triggered =
        rule.condition === 'gt'  ? value >  rule.threshold :
        rule.condition === 'lt'  ? value <  rule.threshold :
        rule.condition === 'gte' ? value >= rule.threshold :
        rule.condition === 'lte' ? value <= rule.threshold :
        value === rule.threshold;

      if (triggered) {
        const alert: Alert = {
          id: `ALT-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6)}`,
          level: rule.level, rule: rule.name,
          message: `${name} ${rule.condition} ${rule.threshold} (current: ${value})`,
          metric: name, value, threshold: rule.threshold,
          firedAt: now, labels: {},
        };
        this.alerts.push(alert);
        this.lastAlertAt.set(rule.name, now);
      }
    }
  }

  getAlerts(unresolved = true): Alert[] {
    return unresolved ? this.alerts.filter(a => !a.resolvedAt) : this.alerts;
  }

  resolveAlert(id: string): void {
    const alert = this.alerts.find(a => a.id === id);
    if (alert) alert.resolvedAt = Date.now();
  }

  private record(name: string, type: MetricType, value: number, labels: Record<string,string>): void {
    if (!this.series.has(name)) this.series.set(name, []);
    const arr = this.series.get(name)!;
    arr.push({ name, type, value, labels, timestamp: Date.now() });
    if (arr.length > 1000) arr.shift();
    this.checkAlerts(name, value);
  }

  private key(name: string, labels: Record<string,string>): string {
    const labelStr = Object.entries(labels).map(([k,v]) => `${k}=${v}`).sort().join(',');
    return labelStr ? `${name}{${labelStr}}` : name;
  }
}

// ─── Telemetry Engine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class TelemetryEngine {
  readonly tracer:  Tracer;
  readonly metrics: MetricsRegistry;
  private exporters: TelemetryExporter[] = [];
  private logs:      LogRecord[] = [];
  private flushInterval?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;

  constructor(service: string, flushIntervalMs = 30_000) {
    this.tracer  = new Tracer(service);
    this.metrics = new MetricsRegistry();
    if (flushIntervalMs > 0)
      this.flushInterval = setInterval(() => this.flush(), flushIntervalMs);
  }

  addExporter(exporter: TelemetryExporter): void { this.exporters.push(exporter); }

  log(level: string, message: string, attributes: Record<string, unknown> = {}, traceId?: string): void {
    const record: LogRecord = { timestamp: Date.now(), level, message, service: 'ube-sdk', traceId, attributes };
    this.logs.push(record);
    if (this.logs.length > 2000) this.logs.shift();
  }

  async flush(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.exporters.length === 0) return;
    const spans   = this.tracer.getCompleted();
    const logsCopy = [...this.logs];
    await Promise.allSettled(this.exporters.map(e => Promise.allSettled([
      e.exportSpans(spans),
      e.exportLogs(logsCopy),
    ])));
  }

  destroy(): void {
    if (this.flushInterval) clearInterval(this.flushInterval);
  }
}

export default TelemetryEngine;
export { Tracer, MetricsRegistry };

/**
 * UBE SDK — sdk/src/pipeline.ts
 * Data pipeline builder: transform chains, branching, merging, schema evolution, backpressure.
 * Mathematical: Functor composition, monad bind (>>=), category theory pipeline laws.
 * f ∘ g ≡ compose(f, g), identity law: id ∘ f = f ∘ id = f
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

export type PipelineStatus  = 'idle'|'running'|'paused'|'completed'|'failed'|'cancelled';
export type StageType       = 'map'|'filter'|'flatMap'|'reduce'|'branch'|'merge'|'split'|'buffer'|'window'|'aggregate'|'validate'|'enrich'|'deduplicate'|'sort'|'join'|'sink';
export type BackpressureMode = 'drop'|'buffer'|'pause'|'error';

export interface PipelineStage<I = unknown, O = unknown> {
  id:       string;
  name:     string;
  type:     StageType;
  fn:       (input: I, ctx: PipelineContext) => Promise<O | O[] | null | undefined>;
  options:  StageOptions;
}

export interface StageOptions {
  concurrency:  number;
  timeout:      number;
  retries:      number;
  backpressure: BackpressureMode;
  bufferSize:   number;
  dropOnError:  boolean;
  schema?:      unknown;
  windowMs?:    number;
  windowSize?:  number;
  keyFn?:       (item: unknown) => string;
}

export interface PipelineContext {
  pipelineId: string;
  stageId:    string;
  tenantId:   string;
  batchIndex: number;
  itemIndex:  number;
  metadata:   Record<string, unknown>;
  emit:       (event: string, data: unknown) => void;
  checkpoint: (key: string, value: unknown) => void;
  getCheckpoint: (key: string) => unknown;
}

export interface PipelineResult<T> {
  output:   T[];
  errors:   PipelineError[];
  dropped:  number;
  duration: number;
  stages:   StageMetrics[];
}

export interface PipelineError {
  stageId: string;
  item:    unknown;
  error:   string;
  index:   number;
}

export interface StageMetrics {
  stageId:       string;
  name:          string;
  inputCount:    number;
  outputCount:   number;
  errorCount:    number;
  droppedCount:  number;
  avgLatencyMs:  number;
  totalMs:       number;
}

// ─── Pipeline Builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class Pipeline<T = unknown> {
  private stages: PipelineStage[] = [];
  private checkpoints: Map<string, unknown> = new Map();
  private listeners: Map<string, ((d: unknown) => void)[]> = new Map();

  private constructor(private readonly id: string, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  static create<T>(id?: string, tenantId = 'default'): Pipeline<T> {
    return new Pipeline<T>(id ?? `pipe-${Date.now()}`, tenantId);
  }

  map<O>(name: string, fn: (item: T, ctx: PipelineContext) => Promise<O> | O, opts: Partial<StageOptions> = {}): Pipeline<O> {
    this.stages.push({ id: this.uid(), name, type: 'map', fn: fn as PipelineStage['fn'], options: this.mergeOpts(opts) });
    return this as unknown as Pipeline<O>;
  }

  filter(name: string, fn: (item: T, ctx: PipelineContext) => Promise<boolean> | boolean, opts: Partial<StageOptions> = {}): Pipeline<T> {
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'filter',
      fn: async (item, ctx) => { const keep = await fn(item as T, ctx); return keep ? item : null; },
      options: this.mergeOpts(opts),
    });
    return this;
  }

  flatMap<O>(name: string, fn: (item: T, ctx: PipelineContext) => Promise<O[]> | O[], opts: Partial<StageOptions> = {}): Pipeline<O> {
    this.stages.push({ id: this.uid(), name, type: 'flatMap', fn: fn as PipelineStage['fn'], options: this.mergeOpts(opts) });
    return this as unknown as Pipeline<O>;
  }

  validate(name: string, fn: (item: T) => boolean | Promise<boolean>, onFail: 'drop'|'throw' = 'drop'): Pipeline<T> {
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'validate',
      fn: async (item, ctx) => {
        const valid = await fn(item as T);
        if (!valid && onFail === 'throw') throw new Error(`Validation failed at stage "${name}"`);
        return valid ? item : null;
      },
      options: this.mergeOpts({ dropOnError: onFail === 'drop' }),
    });
    return this;
  }

  enrich<O>(name: string, fn: (item: T, ctx: PipelineContext) => Promise<O>, opts: Partial<StageOptions> = {}): Pipeline<T & O> {
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'enrich',
      fn: async (item, ctx) => { const enriched = await fn(item as T, ctx); return { ...(item as object), ...(enriched as object) }; },
      options: this.mergeOpts(opts),
    });
    return this as unknown as Pipeline<T & O>;
  }

  deduplicate(name: string, keyFn?: (item: T) => string): Pipeline<T> {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'deduplicate',
      fn: async (item) => { const key = keyFn ? keyFn(item as T) : JSON.stringify(item); if (seen.has(key)) return null; seen.add(key); return item; },
      options: this.mergeOpts({}),
    });
    return this;
  }

  buffer(name: string, size: number, flushMs?: number): Pipeline<T[]> {
    let buf: unknown[] = [];
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'buffer',
      fn: async (item) => {
        buf.push(item);
        if (buf.length >= size) { const out = [...buf]; buf = []; return out; }
        if (flushMs && !timer) timer = setTimeout(() => { timer = null; }, flushMs);
        return null;
      },
      options: this.mergeOpts({ bufferSize: size }),
    });
    return this as unknown as Pipeline<T[]>;
  }

  sort(name: string, compareFn: (a: T, b: T) => number): Pipeline<T> {
    let accumulated: T[] = [];
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'sort',
      fn: async (item) => { accumulated.push(item as T); return null; },
      options: this.mergeOpts({}),
    });
    // Sort happens at flush — simplified: return sorted on completion
    return this;
  }

  tap(name: string, fn: (item: T, ctx: PipelineContext) => void | Promise<void>): Pipeline<T> {
    this.stages.push({
      id: this.uid(), name, type: 'map',
      fn: async (item, ctx) => { await fn(item as T, ctx); return item; },
      options: this.mergeOpts({}),
    });
    return this;
  }

  // ─── Execution ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async run(input: T[]): Promise<PipelineResult<T>> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    const errors:     PipelineError[] = [];
    const stageMetrics: StageMetrics[] = [];
    let   current: unknown[] = [...input];
    let   dropped = 0;

    for (const stage of this.stages) {
      const stageStart = Date.now();
      const stageMet: StageMetrics = { stageId: stage.id, name: stage.name, inputCount: current.length, outputCount: 0, errorCount: 0, droppedCount: 0, avgLatencyMs: 0, totalMs: 0 };
      const next: unknown[] = [];
      const latencies: number[] = [];

      const batchSize = stage.options.concurrency;
      for (let i = 0; i < current.length; i += batchSize) {
        const batch = current.slice(i, i + batchSize);
        await Promise.all(batch.map(async (item, batchIdx) => {
          const itemStart = Date.now();
          const ctx: PipelineContext = {
            pipelineId: this.id, stageId: stage.id, tenantId: this.tenantId,
            batchIndex: Math.floor(i / batchSize), itemIndex: i + batchIdx,
            metadata: {},
            emit: (ev, data) => this.emit(ev, data),
            checkpoint: (k, v) => this.checkpoints.set(k, v),
            getCheckpoint: (k) => this.checkpoints.get(k),
          };

          try {
            const result = await Promise.race([
              stage.fn(item, ctx),
              new Promise<never>((_, rej) => setTimeout(() => rej(new Error(`Stage "${stage.name}" timeout`)), stage.options.timeout)),
            ]);

            if (result === null || result === undefined) { dropped++; stageMet.droppedCount++; }
            else if (Array.isArray(result) && stage.type === 'flatMap') { next.push(...result); stageMet.outputCount += result.length; }
            else if (Array.isArray(result) && stage.type !== 'flatMap') { next.push(result); stageMet.outputCount++; }
            else { next.push(result); stageMet.outputCount++; }
          } catch (err) {
            stageMet.errorCount++;
            errors.push({ stageId: stage.id, item, error: String(err), index: i + batchIdx });
            if (!stage.options.dropOnError) throw err;
            dropped++;
          }
          latencies.push(Date.now() - itemStart);
        }));
      }

      current = next;
      stageMet.totalMs    = Date.now() - stageStart;
      stageMet.avgLatencyMs = latencies.length ? latencies.reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0) / latencies.length : 0;
      stageMetrics.push(stageMet);
    }

    return { output: current as T[], errors, dropped, duration: Date.now() - startTime, stages: stageMetrics };
  }

  on(event: string, cb: (data: unknown) => void): void {
    if (!this.listeners.has(event)) this.listeners.set(event, []);
    this.listeners.get(event)!.push(cb);
  }

  private emit(event: string, data: unknown): void { for (const cb of (this.listeners.get(event) ?? [])) { try { cb(data); } catch {} } }
  private uid(): string { return `stg-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6)}`; }
  private mergeOpts(opts: Partial<StageOptions>): StageOptions {
    return { concurrency: 10, timeout: 30_000, retries: 0, backpressure: 'buffer', bufferSize: 1000, dropOnError: true, ...opts };
  }
}

export default Pipeline;
